The Minister answers that only limited one-off funds (around 100,000 euros for coordination and a pilot) are available, that faculties must reprioritise within existing lump-sum money, and that no further sector plan funding exists, while noting ongoing cost-adequacy research and Flemish cooperation.
At this moment no funds are available for a languages sector plan.
Op dit moment zijn geen middelen beschikbaar voor een sectorplan talen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Dam en Van der Molen over de berichten 'Geweld door drillrappers verheerlijkt' en 'Ingewijden: Rotterdammer (19) doodgestoken door lid Amsterdamse drillrapgroep'

Two CDA MPs asked whether drill rap glorifying violence is linked to youth knife incidents, whether a causal link has been studied, and whether public broadcaster BNNVARA should have published violent drill videos on its platform. The minister said a national action plan on youth weapon possession is being drafted, that research on Rotterdam is awaited, that broadcasters are editorially independent and BNNVARA removed two videos and added warnings and classification.
The action plan is expected to be ready by early November.
Het actieplan zal naar verwachting begin november gereed zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Molen over het bericht 'China beïnvloedt Nederlands hoger onderwijs en wetenschap' en het rapport 'China’s invloed op onderwijs in Nederland'

An MP asks the Minister of Education about reports on Chinese influence on Dutch higher education and research, including academic freedom, self-censorship, Confucius Institutes, Chinese students and the CCP. The Minister answers that the government will inform parliament this autumn, that institutions are responsible for their own partnerships, and that awareness-raising and a checklist are in use, but gives no concrete new measures.
I am considering whether additional tools or frameworks are needed and will inform your House about this in the aforementioned letter.
Ik bekijk of aanvullende hulpmiddelen of kaders nodig zijn en zal uw Kamer hierover informeren in de eerder genoemde brief
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Helvert en Van der Molen over de naamswijziging van het Confucius instituut en het samenwerkingscontract Stichting Confucius Instituut Groningen

CDA MPs asked whether the renaming of the Confucius Institute headquarters signals stronger Chinese state control, and whether Dutch Confucius contracts, including that of Groningen, should be made more transparent and reviewed. The minister answered that the renaming appears to be a response to backlash and creates distance from Hanban, that Dutch institutions are autonomous and their contracts non-confidential by default, and that no extra measures are needed now, with a fuller update promised this autumn.
As indicated in the cover letter to this report, I will further inform your House this autumn about the position of the Netherlands vis-à-vis China in the field of education and science.
Zoals aangegeven in de aanbiedingsbrief bij dit rapport, zal ik uw Kamer dit najaar verder informeren over de positie van Nederland ten opzichte van China op het terrein van onderwijs en wetenschap.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Palland, Amhaouch, Van der Molen, Van Helvert en Van Weyenberg over het bericht "Nederland moet ondernemers in het buitenland mogelijk toch TOZO-uitkering geven"

MPs from CDA and D66 asked the State Secretary whether the European Commission's view that the Tozo is a special non-contributory benefit requires exporting it to cross-border entrepreneurs, and whether Tozo 2's partner test should be treated differently. The State Secretary answered that the Tozo is a social assistance benefit outside the scope of the coordination regulation, so it cannot be exported, and that cross-border entrepreneurs can use other support measures instead.
The Tozo is a social assistance benefit and cannot be regarded as a special non-contributory benefit.
De Tozo is een bijstandsuitkering en kan niet gezien worden als een bijzondere non-contributieve uitkering.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Molen over de lopende band aan seksadvertenties die worden geplaatst op platforms waarop veel kinderen actief zijn

An MP asked the Minister whether the government would act against automated sex-advertising spambots appearing in comments on platforms popular with children, and who is responsible for preventing this. The Minister answered that children should be protected through media literacy, that platforms bear responsibility and remove content mostly by AI, and that he will raise the concern with his Irish counterpart regarding the Irish regulation of platforms.
I will convey your and my concerns about inappropriate spam comments to my Irish counterpart, with the request to take this into account in the regulation for tech companies established in Ireland.
Ik zal mijn Ierse ambtsgenoot uw en mijn zorgen over ongepaste spamreacties overbrengen met het verzoek hier bij de regelgeving voor in Ierland gevestigde techbedrijven rekening mee te houden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Molen, Van Helvert, Van Dam inzake het bericht ‘Activist Zarza neergestoken in Leeuwarden, familie vermoedt politiek motief’

Three CDA MPs asked whether the stabbing of Iranian activist Sadegh Zarza in Leeuwarden had a political motive, whether Iranian academics should face broader screening, and what steps the government had taken regarding Iranian involvement in liquidations in the Netherlands. The minister answered that the Public Prosecution Service leads the investigation and no substantive statements can be made yet, that screening is limited to sensitive technical research areas under sanctions rules, and that no further action is currently planned.
It is up to the Public Prosecution Service to lead the criminal investigation into the offence and any possible motive.
Het is aan het Openbaar Ministerie om leiding te geven aan het strafrechtelijk onderzoek naar het strafbare feit en het eventuele motief.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Molen, Van den Berg en Wiersma over het bericht ‘Directeur Astron over zijn radiotelescoop versus de windmolens: ‘Lofar zou van beschermd nationaal belang moeten zijn’’

Three MPs (CDA and VVD) asked whether large national research infrastructure such as LOFAR deserves national protection, what the effects of 5G are on the Westerbork radio telescope, and whether ASTRON's measurements can be preserved. The minister replied that LOFAR is of national importance and is protected by regional permitting, that a 10 km protection zone with licence conditions shields Westerbork from 5G interference, and that talks with ASTRON and licensees will be arranged.
The Agentschap Telecom, based on internationally used and Dutch-specific calculation models, determined a 10-km protection zone around the radio telescopes at Westerbork.

Het Agentschap Telecom heeft op basis van internationaal gehanteerde en op de specifieke Nederlandse situatie toegespitste rekenmodellen een beschermingszone bepaald van 10 kilometer rond de radiotelescopen in Westerbork.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Von Martels en Van der Molen over de berichten ‘Thialf verder in de problemen nu tekort oploopt tot 1 miljoen euro’ en ‘Wie betaalt de medailles van Sven en Sjinkie’

Two CDA MPs asked the Minister for Medical Care about the financial continuity of the Thialf skating venue, a shortfall of about 1 million euro, and the funding of top sport infrastructure. The minister acknowledged the deficit and referred to a pending Mulier Institute study, existing NOC*NSF/CTO funding for ice rental, and a recovery plan being prepared, without committing to new funds.
I think it is too early to make any commitments on that at this moment.
Ik vind het te vroeg om daar op dit moment al toezeggingen over te doen.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Molen over de open brief van de hoogleraren Fries aan de minister en de publicatie van het Koninklijke Nederlandse Akademie van Wetenschappen (KNAW) rapport: 'Nederlands verdient me

An MP asked the education minister whether she would address an open letter from Frisian professors and the KNAW report on Dutch-language studies, including protection and funding for Frisian-language university education. The minister answered that she will respond to the letter in her policy reaction, committed to keeping Frisian education at its current scale, and asked faculties to prepare changes for 2022/2023.

I have asked the faculties involved to concretise the preparatory activities for further increasing the attractiveness of the education by summer 2021 so that the first changes can be implemented from academic year 2022/2023.
Ik heb de betrokken faculteiten verzocht om de voorbereidende activiteiten voor het verder vergroten van de aantrekkelijkheid van het onderwijs te concretiseren voor de zomer van 2021
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Geluk-Poortvliet en Van der Molen over het bericht ‘Provinsje tsjin foarnimmen minister Slob om Tresoar ôf te stjitten'

MPs Geluk-Poortvliet and Van der Molen asked the minister whether he intends to withdraw the Rijk from the joint regulation with Tresoar and keep funding only archive tasks, and whether this respects Frisian language obligations. The minister confirms the planned exit from the regional historical centres' joint regulations from around 2024, says the Rijk will continue funding both archive and Frisian language tasks, and states that partnership in the joint regulation is not needed to meet those obligations.
I intend to continue both of these contributions to Tresoar.
Ik ben van plan deze beide bijdragen aan Tresoar te continueren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Molen en Van Helvert over het bericht ‘Gemeente verleent vergunning voor Frans Klooster/Walram Site’

Two CDA MPs asked the ministers whether the municipality of Sittard-Geleen's permit for a Confucius Institute annex, and concerns about Chinese influence, warranted stricter policy. The minister answered that the municipality decides autonomously, that government is monitoring Chinese influence via a knowledge network and ongoing research, and that it would discuss arrangements with institutions if the research shows a need.
That is the responsibility and free choice of the municipality.
Dat is de verantwoordelijkheid en de vrije keuze van de gemeente.
Antwoord op de vragen van de leden Peters, Van der Molen en Slootweg over de uitgestelde invoering van het nieuwe woonplaatsbeginsel

Three CDA MPs asked why the new woonplaatsbeginsel (residence principle for youth care funding) was postponed and whether municipalities such as Goirle are financially harmed. The minister answered that the compensation scheme for guardianship and 18+ care is extended by a year and raised to 30 million euros, and that postponement to 2022 was chosen to ensure careful implementation given the COVID-19 workload on municipalities.
Now that the introduction of the youth residence principle has been postponed by one year, the compensation scheme for guardianship and 18+ is extended by one year.
Nu de invoering van het woonplaatsbeginsel jeugd met een jaar is uitgesteld, wordt de compensatieregeling voogdij en 18+ met een jaar verlengd.

Antwoord op van de leden Omtzigt, Van der Molen, Leijten, Verhoeven en Kuiken over het onderzoek naar de nevenfuncties van professor Kochenov van de Rijksuniversiteit Groningen (RUG) en zijn rol in de promotie van de ver

MPs asked about the RUG-commissioned investigation into professor Kochenov's secondary activities and his role in promoting the sale of passports on Malta, and whether he continued such advisory work. The minister reported that the report was released, that no passport-related advisory activities were found after September 2019 apart from attending a Henley & Partners congress, and that she cannot guarantee such cases will not recur.
The research report has today been made public by the RUG, and as promised I have sent you a copy of this report.
Het onderzoeksrapport is heden openbaar gemaakt door de RUG, een afschrift van dit rapport heb ik u – conform mijn toezegging – doen toekomen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Graaf, Van der Molen en Özütok over de coronacrisis en bewonersinitiatieven

Three MPs asked the Minister of Interior whether non-commercial citizen initiatives hit by COVID-19 revenue losses can access support schemes, and whether the ministry will coordinate emergency funding with municipalities and national funds. The minister answered that such bodies only qualify for some schemes if they count as enterprises, expressed willingness to consider case-by-case help with municipalities, but saw no need for a general additional support measure.
Beyond the cabinet-wide support package and support through the multi-year Democracy in Action programme, I see no reason at present to take additional initiative for a general support measure.

Naast het kabinetsbrede ondersteuningspakket en de ondersteuning via het meerjarige samenwerkingsprogramma Democratie in Actie zie ik vooralsnog geen aanleiding om op dit moment extra initiatief te nemen voor een algemene ondersteuningsmaatregel.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paternotte en Van der Molen over het bericht 'Oplossing voor onderzoekers aan universiteiten hard nodig'

MPs Paternotte and Van der Molen asked the minister about the precarious funding and temporary contracts of university researchers during the COVID-19 crisis, including NWO call delays and extensions. The minister gave data on project funding shares, said NWO is restarting procedures and handling extensions case by case, and said universities can resume on-site research within RIVM rules, without committing to new structural measures.
The aim is to not let any researchers fall between two stools.
Doel is om geen onderzoekers tussen wal en schip te laten vallen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Molen over het bericht ‘Promoveren én mantelzorgen, het valt niet mee’

MP Van der Molen (CDA) asked the Minister of Education about a study showing PhD candidates with informal caregiving duties face high stress and sleep problems, and about support, leave, timeline extensions and training for them. The Minister acknowledged the concern, said universities and the VSNU will raise leave options and balance discussions with PhD candidates, and that no specific schemes exist beyond general care leave, with case-by-case extensions possible.
I have brought this to the attention of the VSNU.
Dit heb ik onder de aandacht van de VSNU gebracht.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Molen en Middendorp over het jaarverslag van de Kiesraad over 2019

Two MPs asked the Minister of the Interior about the Electoral Council's 2019 annual report, including budget additions for replacing the election software (OSV), whether that work was completed, and the security findings and next steps for a new digital tool. The minister explained the budget composition, said the 2019 software work was completed, described a new OSV version commissioned for upcoming elections, and promised to inform the House before the summer recess of 2020 on vulnerabilities and tendering.
My planning aims to inform the House further on this before the 2020 summer recess, including on the timing of the tender.
Mijn planning is erop gericht om de Tweede Kamer daar voor het zomerreces van 2020 nader over te informeren, onder meer over het moment van aanbesteding.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Molen, Van den Berg en Kuik over de berichten ‘Prestatiedruk in het hoger onderwijs leidt tot misbruik ADHD-medicatie’ en ‘Braindrug modafinil is populair onder studenten, maar ‘je

CDA MPs asked the ministers of Education and Medical Care about reports of ADHD medication and modafinil misuse by students under performance pressure, and about illegal trade, monitoring, prevention and campaigns. The ministers answered that the Amsterdam study is qualitative and not representative, that a RIVM and Trimbos monitor on student mental health and substance use is underway with results expected in 2020 and 2021, that prevention measures will be considered depending on those results, and that the Health Inspectorate (IGJ) is working against illegal online trade within the limits of cross-border enforcement.
The exact scale and extent of trade in ADHD medication and modafinil is insufficiently known.
De exacte schaal en omvang van de handel in ADHD-medicatie en modafinil is onvoldoende bekend.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Molen, Van der Graaf, Sneller en El Yassini over het bericht ‘Lokale en regionale kranten zoeken steun om coronacrisis te overleven’

MPs asked the minister for Education and Media about the financial crisis facing local and regional newspapers during the coronavirus crisis, including support options, advertising revenue loss, consultation with publishers and foreign ownership risks. The minister announced a temporary support fund for free newspapers and local public broadcasters, coulance measures, and called on municipalities and provinces to contribute, without addressing executive oversight directly.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Dam, Van den Berg en Van der Molen over het bericht ‘Exclusief: Interview Citrix CISO, Fermín Sera, waar ging het mis?'

MPs from the CDA asked the Justice minister whether the Citrix vulnerability could have been prevented by timely application of the interim fix, why Dutch government bodies were affected, and whether a legal standoff period before public disclosure should be set. The minister answered that the NCSC advised quickly, government bodies were advised to apply mitigations, no misapplication by government was found, the case is being evaluated, and that a 60-day guideline exists but policy is left to vendors and organisations.
This case is being evaluated on the instructions of the Minister of Justice and Security.
Deze casus wordt geëvalueerd in opdracht van de Minister van Justitie en Veiligheid.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Molen over het bericht ‘UT-arts wil stop op instroom buitenlandse studenten: ‘Ze lopen psychisch vast’’

MP Van der Molen (CDA) asks the minister about reports that most international students at the University of Twente have psychological complaints, whether intake should be restricted, funding use, and English as campus language. The minister answers that a RIVM study on student mental health is underway with results expected end 2020, that intake is not a selection criterion, that internationalisation is valued but institutions must provide support, and that language choices are for the university.
I am awaiting the results of the RIVM study before making statements on the extent and severity of stress and mental pressure.
Ik wacht de resultaten van het RIVM-onderzoek af voordat ik uitspraken doe over de omvang en de ernst van stress en mentale druk.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Molen, Omtzigt en Wiersma over het bericht ‘Vanaf 1 januari wordt op de Universiteit Twente alleen Engels gesproken’

MPs Van der Molen, Omtzigt and Wiersma asked the Minister of Education whether the University of Twente's decision to use only English as its official language conflicts with ECHR article 14 and Awb article 2:6, and what the government will do. The Minister answered that the decision was taken in 2015, that no discrimination or legal violation has been identified, that language choice is for the institution with its works council, and that she will not intervene but expects the universities to consider accessibility effects.
If it were to turn out that the ECHR is not complied with because an employee or student is discriminated against, the usual legal protection is of course open to that student or employee.

Als zou blijken dat niet aan het EVRM wordt voldaan omdat een medewerker of student wordt gediscrimineerd, dan staat hiertegen uiteraard de gebruikelijke rechtsbescherming open voor de betreffende student of medewerker.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Molen, Von Martels en Van der Graaf over een onkostenvergoeding van vrijwilligers bij het Songfestival

MPs Van der Molen, Von Martels and Van der Graaf asked why volunteers at the Eurovision Song Contest cannot claim travel costs while paid staff can, and whether the minister would agree arrangements on volunteer expense reimbursement. The minister agreed volunteering deserves recognition, explained that paid staff are compensated under their contracts while volunteers get a local OV card, catering and clothing, and said he would raise volunteer positions with the NPO rather than commit to a specific reimbursement arrangement.
I will also draw the NPO's attention to the position of the volunteers.
Ik zal de NPO ook attenderen op de positie van de vrijwilligers.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Helvert en Van der Molen over het bericht dat een Chinese geneticus van het Erasmus MC werkt voor de Chinese politie

MPs Van Helvert and Van der Molen asked the government about reports that a Chinese geneticist at Erasmus MC worked for the Chinese police, and what the government had done in response, including contacts with China, funding, screening of Chinese researchers and university awareness. The minister answered that the disputed face-shape research was separate from the Rotterdam height study, was not funded by Erasmus MC or the EU, that the Chinese embassy was warned about misuse of knowledge, and that the cabinet is examining broader knowledge-security measures.

I cannot give detailed statements on what information is or is not known to the intelligence and security services, because this would reveal the current knowledge level, modus operandi and/or sources of the services.

Ik kan geen gedetailleerde uitspraken doen over welke informatie al dan niet bekend is bij de inlichtingen- en veiligheidsdiensten omdat dit inzicht geeft in het actuele kennisniveau, de modus operandi en/of bronnen van de diensten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt en Van der Molen over het onderzoek naar de nevenfuncties van professor Kochenov van de Rijksuniversiteit Groningen

MPs Omtzigt and Van der Molen asked about the investigation into Professor Kochenov's outside positions, including advisory work for Malta and links to Henley & Partners and the Investment Migration Council, and the Paradise Papers. The minister answered that an external investigation by the University of Groningen is underway, that the Inspectorate has not yet received results, that the report is expected in Q1 2020, and that the university is responsible for publishing it, with a commitment to forward a published version to parliament.
The dissemination and degree of publicity is the responsibility of the RUG.
De verspreiding en mate van openbaarheid is de verantwoordelijkheid van de RUG.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Molen en Van Helvert over het bericht 'België houdt grens dicht voor directeur Confucius-instituut'

Two CDA MPs asked whether the government was informed that Chinese professor Xinning Song was barred from Belgium and the Schengen area, and about screening, Chinese intelligence obligations and Confucius Institutes in the Netherlands. The minister replied that Belgium did not actively inform the Netherlands, that no security screening applies to Confucius Institute staff, that Chinese law cannot be ruled out as requiring cooperation with intelligence services, and that knowledge-security measures and a broader study are underway.
When relevant developments arise on this, I will inform the House further.
Bij relevante ontwikkelingen hieromtrent zal ik uw Kamer nader informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Molen over de wolk van verontwaardiging om 2 ton voor sterrenkundige die zwart gat wil kieken

An MP asked why the minister granted a one-off 200,000 euro to Professor Falcke's group for science communication after NWO rejected their research proposal, and whether this undermines NWO's independent peer-review process. The minister answered that the funds come from a separate budget for science communication, are not meant to finance the rejected proposal, and that NWO itself sees no problem, with no other such cases.
As stated in my answers to the parliamentary questions from members Paternotte and Futselaar, I do not intervene in NWO's objective assessment.
Zoals aangegeven in mijn antwoorden op de Kamervragen van de leden Paternotte en Futselaar intervenieer ik niet in de objectieve afweging van NWO.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Slootweg en Van der Molen over “de ANW-hiaatverzekering”

Two CDA MPs asked the ministers whether insurer Loyalis actively marketed ANW gap insurance, supplementary survivors' pension and IPAP disability cover to public-sector employees, whether their end dates tied to age 65 or the AOW age were disclosed, and whether the Pensioenkamer and the minister should act on policyholders left uninsured after the AOW-age increase. The minister answered that Loyalis responded to client requests and employer requests, informed affected policyholders and offered choices, and that the ministers have no responsibility for a private insurer, so they decline to convene the Pensioenkamer.
The Ministers of SZW and BZK have no responsibility for a private insurer.
De Ministers van SZW en BZK hebben geen verantwoordelijkheid voor een private verzekeraar.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Molen over het bericht ‘Studieschuld af te kopen’

The MP asks how the minister views a website offering to erase student debts from DUO's systems in exchange for bitcoin, and whether DUO's systems are secure, who can alter records, and what steps will be taken. The minister calls the offer unacceptable, states that debts cannot be removed, that all changes are logged and traceable, found no indications of unlawful changes, and that DUO has filed a criminal complaint while awaiting the justice investigation.
DUO has filed a criminal complaint about what it considers a punishable offence. I am awaiting the outcome of the judicial investigation and will then consider whether follow-up steps are necessary.
DUO heeft aangifte gedaan van dit in haar ogen strafbare feit. Ik wacht de uitkomsten van het justitiële onderzoek af en zal daarna bezien of vervolgstappen noodzakelijk zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt, Van Toorenburg en Van der Molen over de verkoop van paspoorten op Malta en de nevenfuncties van professor Kochenov van de Rijksuniversiteit Groningen

Three CDA MPs asked about Malta's passport-sale programme, its national security risks, and the undisclosed outside roles of a Groningen professor in the investment-migration industry. The minister said the programme is a security concern, that the university must investigate the professor's disclosure and conflicts of interest, and that the Inspectorate will advise on the findings.
I have asked the Inspectorate of Education to subsequently assess the findings of the investigation regarding the secondary activities and possible conflicts of interest and to advise me on them.

Ik heb de Inspectie van het onderwijs gevraagd om vervolgens de bevindingen van het onderzoek ten aanzien van de nevenwerkzaamheden en eventuele belangenverstrengeling te beoordelen en mij daarover te adviseren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Dam en Van der Molen over het bericht ‘Oud-studenten op Curaçao in financiële problemen door DUO’

CDA MPs Van Dam and Van der Molen asked the Education Minister about reports that at least a hundred former students on Curaçao got into financial trouble through DUO's communication and collection practices, including a Curaçao minister's claim of a non-integrous approach with a local bailiff. The minister said DUO had not received concrete cases, rejected the claim as unsupported, promised to examine specific cases, and committed to a joint meeting with the Curaçao minister and on-site DUO staff to help debtors.
DUO has asked the Ministry of Education, Science, Culture and Sport for concrete cases in which something would have gone wrong, but has not yet received them.
DUO heeft het Ministerie van Onderwijs, Wetenschap, Cultuur en Sport (OWCS) gevraagd naar concrete zaken waarin iets zou zijn misgegaan, maar deze nog niet ontvangen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Molen en Futselaar over het bericht ‘Liegen over je studieschuld lastiger: DUO komt met schuldverklaring’

MPs Van der Molen and Futselaar asked why DUO could not adapt its systems for a debt declaration (schuldverklaring) requested by parliament, while a request from another minister could be accommodated. The minister answered that the Blauwe Knop project was small, that work has been stopped following a motion, and that DUO serves several other ministries with maintenance and replacement currently prioritised.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Molen en Van Toorenburg over het bericht dat de Coöperatie Laatste Wil een handleiding online heeft gezet waarmee het mogelijk is om een leven te beëindigen

MPs Van der Molen and Van Toorenburg asked whether the government would act against the Coöperatie Laatste Wil after it posted online a manual naming chemicals usable for ending life, and whether a criminal investigation should be reopened. The government called the manual undesirable and said it was in talks with the CLW, but stated that the Public Prosecution Service independently decides whether to investigate and will inform parliament only once it has decided.
The OM makes an independent, autonomous assessment of whether or not to start a criminal investigation.
Het OM maakt een eigenstandige, onafhankelijke afweging over het al dan niet starten van een strafrechtelijk onderzoek.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Molen en Van Dam over de berichten ‘Verkeerde afslag politie’ en ‘OV-bedrijven gaan boerkaverbod niet handhaven’

CDA MPs Van der Molen and Van Dam asked the ministers how enforcement of the face-covering ban in public transport and public buildings is working after police statements suggested reluctance to prioritise it. The minister replied that the ban must be enforced, that police have aligned their communication with the law, that police can be called in via escalation, and that the law will be evaluated three years after entry into force.
De wet dient te worden gehandhaafd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Pater-Postma en Van der Molen over het niet handhaven van het verbod op gezichtsbedekkende kleding in het openbaar vervoer

MPs De Pater-Postma and Van der Molen asked why a bus driver in Limburg was reprimanded and police and employer did not support him after enforcing the partial ban on face-covering clothing in public transport, and how enforcement would be made effective. The minister replied that enforcement under the law rests with police and the Public Prosecution Service, that transport staff only address passengers and escalate, that the driver and police acted per the law, and that police response times and a conduct guideline have been agreed.
In the incident on a bus in Stein, both the bus driver and the police officer acted in accordance with the law.
Bij het voorval in een bus in Stein hebben zowel de buschauffeur als de politiemedewerker conform de wet gehandeld.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Molen en Sneller over het bericht dat de NPO overweegt om uit NLZIET te stappen

MPs Van der Molen and Sneller asked the minister about reports that the NPO might leave the NLZIET platform for NPO Start Plus, and about a working group's draft scenario diverging from the vision letter. The minister answered that the NPO denies this, the draft was an unapproved staff document, the NPO remains loyal to NLZIET, and stricter conditions for NPO Start Plus are planned from the next concession period.
The NPO has assured me that this report is not correct.
De NPO heeft mij verzekerd dat dit bericht niet klopt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller, Aartsen, Van der Molen en Van der Graaf over de problemen bij het Commissariaat voor de Media

MPs from D66, VVD, CDA and ChristenUnie asked the minister about problems at the Commissariaat voor de Media, including a reprimand of a board member, his side job at Mail.ru, the handling of a dismissed member, and the continuity of the board. The minister acknowledged inadequate information provision, said no consequences were attached to the reprimand, defended the Mail.ru side job as not objectionable for now, and promised to review the wachtgeld and side-job rules with the new chair.
However, I conclude that in this case the provision of information was not sufficient, as it has since emerged that I did not have certain information.
Wel concludeer ik dat in dit geval de informatievoorziening niet voldoende was nu achteraf is gebleken dat ik bepaalde informatie niet had.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Molen over het bericht ‘Friezin onterecht ingeschreven in Groningen: “Ik ben een Fries in hart en nieren”’

An MP asked how a Frisian woman from Dokkum came to be wrongly registered in Groningen's population register, and whether residents can be registered elsewhere without consent or notice. The State Secretary confirmed the error was corrected retroactively, explained that a legally authorised household member's change-of-address notification can trigger registration, and said no new measures are planned as cases are not shown to be widespread.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Molen over het verdwijnen van de website statengeneraaldigitaal.nl

An MP from the CDA asked why the Staten-Generaal Digitaal website disappeared, why historical parliamentary documents now have fewer search options and PDF-only access, and who maintains the collection. The State Secretary confirmed the move to officielebekendmakingen.nl, explained the management arrangement with the Tweede Kamer's DIA and KOOP, and referred the functionality questions to the Kamer's Presidium.
It is up to the Presidium of the House to answer questions in this area.
Het ligt op de weg van het presidium van de Kamer om vragen op dit gebied te beantwoorden.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Molen en Futselaar over de antwoorden op de schriftelijke vragen naar aanleiding van bericht dat studenten lang in de wacht staan door onderbezetting en nieuw systeem

MPs Van der Molen and Futselaar asked whether extra DUO staff capacity was available for summer phone waiting times, what effect the new student finance system had on waiting times, and what the average waiting time was in 2019 and targeted for summer. The minister answered that extra funds go mainly to maintenance, that waiting times fell with extra capacity and the new system (about 20% fewer calls in early 2019), and that waiting times will likely exceed 10 minutes in weeks 34-37.
But in weeks 34 through 37 the average waiting time will probably exceed 10 minutes.
Maar in de weken 34 tot en met 37 zal de gemiddelde wachttijd waarschijnlijk wel boven de 10 minuten uitkomen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt en Van der Molen over onbeantwoorde vragen over artikel 68 van de grondwet, de inlichtingenplicht van de regering

MPs Omtzigt and Van der Molen asked the government about delayed answers to parliamentary questions on the duty to provide information (article 68 of the Constitution), including state secrecy, deliberately delayed FOI requests and withheld information. The minister answered that questions were grouped for clarity, that the government does not track the requested statistics, that state-interest refusals are rare and pre-tested in cabinet, and that Parliament's information right is broader than the FOI law.
Parliament's right to information is in several respects also broader than the right to public access under the FOI law.
Het recht op inlichtingen van de Kamer is in een aantal opzichten ook breder dan het recht op openbaarheid onder de Wob.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der  Molen  en Van den  Berg over het  bericht 'Universiteiten nemen spionagerisico voor lief'

MPs Van der Molen and Van den Berg asked the ministers whether Dutch universities are exposed to espionage and theft of research findings, whether foreign students should be excluded, and what measures will strengthen security awareness. The government says it is examining broader knowledge-security rules, outlines existing legal tools (Iran and North Korea sanctions screening), declines to give case details or figures, and points to existing platforms and agencies while deferring the outcome of ongoing reviews.
The cabinet does not make public statements about case details that affect the current knowledge level and modus operandi of the Dutch intelligence and security services.
Het kabinet doet in het openbaar geen uitspraken over casuïstiek die het actuele kennisniveau en de modus operandi van de Nederlandse inlichtingen- en veiligheidsdiensten raken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Slootweg, Van der Molen en Van Dam over de inzet van een gebarentolk bij crisiscommunicatie door de overheid en bij persconferenties van de overheid

CDA MPs asked whether sign-language interpreters should be used in government crisis communication and press conferences, after the Utrecht attack gave deaf people no interpretation. The ministers answered that a plan of action will be sent to parliament after the summer, that transcripts of post-cabinet press conferences are published, and that the government does not consider the UN disability convention breached.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Molen over de uitzending 'Xi, Xi wat jij niet ziet' en het bericht 'Confucius Instituten voelen geen druk van Chinese zijde'

An MP asked the Minister of Education, Culture and Science about Confucius Institutes, including access to confidentiality clauses in HANBAN agreements, the independence of research chairs hosted by such institutes, academic freedom safeguards, and restrictions on Chinese students. The minister answered that the Zuyd agreement can be provided, that the RUG agreement runs to 2021, that academic freedom is safeguard by institutions under the WHW, and that a broader knowledge-security regulation is under study.
Yes. The entire cooperation agreement will be provided in this regard.
Ja. De gehele samenwerkingsovereenkomst gaat hierbij 3 .
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Molen en Bruins Slot over de algemene ledenvergadering van de Koninklijke Bond van Oranjeverenigingen en het manifest ‘Versterk vrijwilligerswerk’

MPs Bruins Slot and Van der Molen (CDA) asked ministers about the Koninklijke Bond van Oranjeverenigingen's manifesto on volunteering, including regulatory burden, asylum-seeker volunteering, training, municipal subsidy rules and event bureaucracy. The government supports the goals and the activities of Oranjeverenigingen, declines to abolish the volunteer declaration or change several rules, promises to examine further reductions in event regulation, and answered the final question (on Koningsdag 2019) as not answered in time.
The cabinet is also exploring other options to further reduce the regulatory burden of organising events.
Het kabinet onderzoekt daarnaast andere mogelijkheden om de regeldruk bij het organiseren van evenementen verder te verminderen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Molen, Kuik en Peters over het bericht 'Schuldhulpverlening lastig voor studenten met schulden'

MPs from the CDA asked the Minister of Education and the State Secretary of Social Affairs about the rising number of young people, including students, seeking debt assistance, and about municipal measures, study-stopping rules, DUO paying tuition directly, and a warning banner on DUO's website. The government gave partial answers: it had no exact figures, supported initiatives and dialogue with municipalities, declined the banner and direct tuition payment for now, and pointed to ongoing experiments and measures.
We cannot give you exact numbers and percentages.
We kunnen u geen exacte aantallen en procenten geven.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Bosch en Van der Molen over het dubbeldorp Spaarndam

MPs Van den Bosch and Van der Molen asked the Minister of the Interior why the government only asked the province in March 2019 to facilitate talks on a border correction for the twin village Spaarndam, and why the Chamber would only be informed by end 2019. The Minister answered that the new Haarlemmermeer municipality only existed from 1 January 2019, that talks by the province have started, and that the Chamber will be informed by end 2019 or earlier if there is clarity.
In line with the Chamber's request, and aware that a careful procedure also takes some time, I will therefore inform it further no later than the end of 2019.
In lijn met het verzoek van de Kamer en in de wetenschap dat een zorgvuldige procedure ook enige doorlooptijd vergt, zal ik haar daarom uiterlijk eind 2019 nader informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Molen over het bericht 'Televisie naar de smaak van de netmanager'

An MP from the CDA asked the minister whether network managers at the NPO interfere in programme content and presenter choice, whether the combined role of 'directeur televisie' and 'netmanager NPO1' is acceptable, and whether broadcaster autonomy is adequately protected. The minister acknowledged the concerns, said the combined role is not good from a checks-and-balances perspective and expects the NPO to remedy it, and argued that programme autonomy is well protected by law and that existing rules and dispute procedures suffice without further regulation.
From the perspective of checks and balances, I do not consider this a good combination.
Vanuit een oogpunt van checks and balances vind ik dit geen goede combinatie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt en Van der Molen over betere richtlijnen voor een lager maatschappelijk OZB-tarief voor bij voorbeeld sportverenigingen en buurthuizen

MPs Omtzigt and Van der Molen asked whether the government will help municipalities set a lower property tax (OZB) rate for sports clubs, community centres and similar non-profit organisations, and whether they agree such organisations should be taxed differently from businesses. The minister answered that talks with the VNG are ongoing, that OZB taxation follows the property rather than the owner so a lower rate for organisations does not fit its objective character, and that the government will consider the problems the VNG identifies.
Introducing the lower OZB rate for sports clubs and similar organisations does not fit the objective nature of this levy.
De invoering van het lagere ozb-tarief voor sportverenigingen e.a. sluit niet aan bij het objectieve karakter van deze heffing.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Molen, Tielen, Beertema en Bisschop inzake het experiment promotieonderwijs

MPs asked why no new application round was opened for the PhD education experiment, whether the experiment is being used improperly, and how it will be evaluated. The minister answered that no new round was opened because no other universities showed interest, that the evaluation is planned for 2021 with an interim review after three years, and that the number of participants and data gaps are acknowledged.
I am not terminating the experiment either in whole or in part.
Ik beëindig het experiment geheel noch gedeeltelijk.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Graaf , Aartsen en Van der Molen over de werkwijze van het NPO-fonds

MPs asked the Minister of Education and Media about the opaque NPO Fund procedure, including anonymous advisory committee members, undisclosed committee composition, possible conflicts of interest and limited objection options. The Minister answered that the NPO board is responsible for the procedure, that NPO keeps anonymity to protect advice quality, that conflicted members are excluded, and that the fund will better publicize existing exclusion and discussion options.
The working method and procedure of the NPO Fund is the responsibility of the NPO board of directors.
De werkwijze en procedure van het NPO-fonds is voor verantwoordelijkheid van de raad van bestuur van de NPO.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Molen en Rog over het onderwijs in het Fries

MPs Van der Molen and Rog asked about the quality of Frisian-language education, the Inspectorate's thematic research, school exemptions and oversight powers. The minister replied that exemptions are provincially granted, earlier recommendations have been largely implemented, a new inspectorate study is planned, but transferring supervision to the province is not on the agenda.
Transferring supervision to the province of Fryslân is not on the table.
Overdracht van het toezicht aan de provincie Fryslân is niet aan de orde.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Von Martels en Van der Molen over het bericht ‘Afsluitdijk dicht ook Fietsersbond baalt'

MPs asked the minister about the closure of the Afsluitdijk to cyclists for three years, the protests from cycling organisations, and whether temporary measures could keep the route open during high season. The minister confirmed the closure is needed for large construction works, pointed to a replacement bike bus, said temporary openings in summer are being investigated, and committed to sending the reply to the cycling organisations to the Chamber.
I am investigating whether temporary measures could make cycling over the Afsluitdijk safely possible on some days in high season.
Ik onderzoek of met tijdelijke voorzieningen op een aantal dagen in het hoogseizoen fietsen over de Afsluitdijk veilig mogelijk kan worden gemaakt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Molen en Slootweg over Nederlandstalige informatie over de staatsschuld

MPs Van der Molen and Slootweg asked why the annual Outlook on state debt financing is published only in English, whether this obscures the per-capita debt burden, and whether essential information should also be available in Dutch. The minister answered that the Outlook is in English since 2008 because its audience is English-speaking, that the essential content is available in Dutch elsewhere, and that Dutch press releases and publications on debt are issued, while rejecting the suggestion of deliberate obscuring.
Only information on turnover in the so-called secondary market regarding maturity, type of investor and geographic location of trading activity is not separately published in Dutch.
Alleen informatie over omzet op de zogenaamde secundaire markt inzake de looptijd, type investeerder en geografische locatie van de handelsactiviteit wordt niet apart in het Nederlands gepubliceerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Futselaar en Van der Molen over het bericht dat internationalisering Saxion moet redden voor krimp

MPs Futselaar and Van der Molen asked whether Saxion's shift to English-taught programmes to offset enrolment decline is lawful and justified, and about teacher quality, staff consultation and German-language programmes. The minister said English teaching should not be driven by finance, announced a bill to modernise the WHW language rules, judged Saxion's language code compliant, and reported no signals of insufficient teacher quality.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Molen en Omtzigt over de coreper-vergaderingen

Two CDA MPs asked the Interior Minister whether the Netherlands consistently argued in EU negotiations on the whistleblower directive that whistleblowers may always use the external channel directly, and for an overview of meetings and votes. The minister answered that Dutch practice allows direct external reporting where internal reporting cannot reasonably be expected, that the Netherlands actively promoted this flexible system at EU level, and that it acted consistently in all negotiating meetings.
During the negotiations the Netherlands actively and prominently worked to introduce this flexible system at European level as well.
Gedurende de onderhandelingen heeft Nederland zich actief en prominent ingezet om dit flexibele systeem ook op Europees niveau te introduceren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Peters en Van der Molen over het bestaan van zogenaamde “spookburgers.”

MPs Peters and Van der Molen (CDA) asked ministers about homeless people being refused registration and mail addresses by municipalities despite a 2016 agreement, and whether the government would compel municipalities to register them. The government acknowledged the problem and the duty to register, said it is pursuing guidance, workshops and a legislative clarification making registration on a mail address mandatory, but declined to name the refusing municipalities or to use direct enforcement powers for now.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kwint en Van der Molen over het bericht dat de lokale omroepen aan de rand van de afgrond staan

MPs Kwint and Van der Molen asked whether the minister knows of financial distress at local broadcasters such as 1Twente and whether bankruptcies would damage local democracy, and what should be done to make them viable. The minister replied that funding is a municipal responsibility, that an advisory request on organisation and financing was sent in February 2019, that a possible pilot for regional broadcasters is being explored, and that the EUR 5 million for investigative journalism is not meant to keep local broadcasters afloat.
I am aware of the signals about the precarious financial situation of the broadcasters 1Twente and Omroepstichting ZuidWest.
Ik ben bekend met de signalen over de precaire financiële situatie van de omroepen 1Twente en Omroepstichting ZuidWest
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Molen, Pieter Heerma en Van den Berg over de last onder dwangsom werkgeversportaal UWV

MPs Van der Molen, Heerma and Van den Berg (CDA) asked about the Dutch Data Protection Authority's penalty order against the UWV employer portal, the choice of eID assurance level (eHerkenning substantial versus eIDAS high), the role of UZI cards, and cost estimates for employers. The minister answered that UWV's 2018 risk analysis found the substantial level appropriate, that the cost estimates were not too low, and that the UZI card is only for patient identification.
I do not share the view that eHerkenning means were prescribed at the wrong level.
Ik deel niet de mening dat sprake is van het voorschrijven van eHerkenningsmiddelen op een verkeerd niveau.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bruins Slot en Van der Molen over de regelgeving voor verkeersregelaars

MPs Bruins Slot and Van der Molen ask why the 2017 amendment to the traffic controllers regulation makes it harder for volunteer event traffic controllers and their organisations, including the lack of substitution and individual-only e-instruction. The minister replies that the changes aimed to reduce administrative burden, that the process is supported digitally, that individual e-instruction is intentional, and that a meeting with SVNL is possible but no regulatory change is proposed.

I am always willing to talk with SVNL, but it is already possible to obtain appointment (after completing the e-instruction) as a volunteer event traffic controller for a period of one year per municipality.

Ik ben altijd bereid om in gesprek te gaan met SVNL, alleen is het al mogelijk om de aanstelling (na het afronden van de e-instructie) tot vrijwillige evenementenverkeersregelaar voor een periode van een jaar per gemeente te verkrijgen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Tielen en Van der Molen over het niet toestaan van een nieuwe aanvraagronde voor het experiment promotieonderwijs

MPs Tielen and Van der Molen asked why the interim evaluation of the PhD education experiment is late and why no new application round was opened. The minister replied that the evaluation started in January 2019 with a report due by April 2019, that no other universities showed interest, and that a new round would not automatically increase PhD numbers.
The report of the research is due by April 2019 at the latest.
Het rapport van het onderzoek uiterlijk april 2019 oplevert.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Molen, Von Martels en Omtzigt over de brand bij een Duitse kerncentrale vlakbij de Nederlandse grens

MPs from the CDA asked why the Dutch government and safety regions were not informed about a fire at a nuclear fuel plant in Lingen, Germany, and how the incident was classified and would be evaluated. The state secretary answered that the fire was not at the Emsland plant, no radioactive release occurred, it was provisionally classed INES-0, and the Veiligheidsregio Twente will evaluate it and share the findings with parliament.
The Veiligheidsregio Twente has indicated that it will evaluate this incident and involve the ANVS, the DCC IenW and the NCC (JenV).
De Veiligheidsregio Twente heeft aangegeven dit incident te gaan evalueren en daarbij de ANVS, het DCC IenW en het NCC (JenV) te zullen betrekken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Molen, Van den Berg en Omtzigt over het bericht ‘Topambtenaar kreeg ruim 40.000 euro voor achttien dagen Curaçao’

Three CDA MPs asked the State Secretary and Minister of Internal Affairs about a press report that a senior civil servant received over 40,000 euro in allowances for eighteen days on Curaçao, asking about the contracts, legality, tax treatment, and whether the Auditdienst Rijk should investigate. The government answered that all questions were addressed in a separate letter (Kamerstuk 35 000 VII and 35 000 IV, nr. 89), so this document itself gives no substantive answers.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Molen over een mogelijk ICT-fiasco bij het Rijk

An MP asked the Minister of the Interior about reports of a failing government intranet (Rijksportaal), its rising costs, a 2016 quick scan suggesting non-market-conform costs, abandoned releases, and duplicate internal document systems across ministries. The minister denied that the intranet is failing, acknowledged the unexecuted follow-up study, withheld detailed cost breakdowns citing confidentiality, and described replacement plans and reuse of old hardware.

I cannot share a breakdown of costs at the level of detail you request in a public answer, because part of the data available to me is confidential, relating to information from external parties outside the civil service.
Een uitsplitsing van kosten op het door u gevraagde detailniveau kan ik u vanwege de vertrouwelijkheid van een deel van de mij beschikbare gegevens, niet in openbare beantwoording met u delen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Geluk-Poortvliet en Van der Molen over een subsidieaanvraag door Stichting De Fryske Mole

Two CDA MPs asked the Minister of Education, Culture and Science whether the Stichting De Fryske Mole, which owns 42 mills in Fryslân, could be given the 60% subsidy rate that the SIM scheme adopts from 2019, after it applied before the change under the 50% rate. The minister answered that the application is governed by the rules in force at the time, that the foundation could not reasonably expect the higher rate, and that raising it now is not possible because of equal treatment and lack of funds.
That request was rejected, but as far as I am aware, not because a higher subsidy percentage could be obtained under the SIM.
Dat verzoek is afgewezen, maar voor zover mij bekend, niet omdat een hoger subsidiepercentage in de SIM zou worden verkregen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Molen over het bericht ‘TU wordt voor studenten buiten EU stuk duurder’

An MP asked whether non-EU students at TU Delft facing higher tuition amounts to indirect state subsidy of non-cost-covering programmes, and whether Dutch-language teaching could limit inflows. The minister explained that institutions set institutional tuition within limits, plans to cap it only for EEA students, and will consider requiring institutions to keep language policy under review.
It is up to the institution to decide how this funding is distributed across its statutory tasks, including education for non-EEA students.
Het is aan de instelling om te bepalen hoe deze bekostiging wordt verdeeld over haar wettelijke taken, waaronder ook het onderwijs aan niet-EER-studenten valt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Futselaar en Van der Molen over het bericht dat de RUG uit angst voor schadeclaims doorwerkt aan Chinese Branchcampus

MPs Futselaar and Van der Molen asked whether RUG continued planning a Chinese branch campus despite a no, whether the MoU is binding, how damage claims would be handled, and whether the university council was adequately informed. The minister answered that RUG did not apply for the required permission, that the MoU binds only its signatories, that the risk of claims is very low and no public funds may be used, and that council disputes go to the national complaints committee.
The Ministry of OCW was aware of this, but was not a party to those agreements.
Het Ministerie van OCW was hiervan op de hoogte, maar was geen partij in die overeenkomsten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Molen over het bericht ‘De diensten zijn regelmatig niet blij met ons’

An MP asked the Interior and Defence Ministers whether the law governing intelligence services should be amended to allow appointment of a deputy member of the TIB oversight committee, which the TIB chair says is a flaw in the law. The ministers answered that they consider the TIB's continued functioning important, were informing the TIB of plans to provide for deputy members in the law, but gave no firm commitment on the specific wording.
We consider it of great importance that the TIB can continue to carry out its work properly and we endorse the concern raised by the TIB.
Wij vinden het van groot belang dat de TIB haar werk goed kan blijven uitvoeren en onderschrijven de door de TIB naar voren gebrachte zorg.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Molen en Özdil over de antwoorden op de schriftelijke vragen naar aanleiding van de berichtgeving dat de studie Nederlands dreigt te verdwijnen en alleen in het buitenland populair

MPs Van der Molen (CDA) and Özdil (GroenLinks) asked the Minister of Education, Culture and Science to clarify earlier answers on the declining Dutch-language degree programmes, including whether the VU plans to close its programme and what actions are planned. The minister denies any contradiction, says no concrete closure plans are known, points to a Deltaplan for the languages due in 2019, a KNAW problem analysis, and a Taalunie study on Dutch abroad, and says further steps will follow in 2019.
However, as far as I am aware, there are no concrete plans by the VU or other higher education institutions to close Dutch programmes.
Echter, voor zover mij bekend is, zijn er geen concrete plannen van de VU of van andere hoger onderwijsinstellingen om opleidingen Nederlands te sluiten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Molen en Van Helvert over internet langs de grens in Schinveld

MPs Van der Molen and Van Helvert asked why residents of Schinveld lost internet access despite permits, and whether a cross-border solution would be pursued. The State Secretary replied that the government did not cut any existing connection, explained the wiretap and 112 conditions for a new network, and said talks with Agentschap Telecom and residents are ongoing with a progress update promised.
However, there has been no question of the government cutting the existing internet connection, nor any intention to do so.
Van het verbreken van de (bestaande) verbinding met internet door de Nederlandse overheid is echter geen sprake geweest, evenmin van een intentie daartoe.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Molen over het bericht 'Geef leraar onbeperkt toegang tot onderzoek’

An MP asked the ministers whether teachers should get free access to academic publications and whether the government would provide it quickly, rather than waiting for open access policy. The minister agreed knowledge access matters, pointed to open access goals for 2020 and existing NRO and KB services, and did not commit to free access for all teachers now.
That is why I am working to actually realise that free access.
Daarom span ik me in om die vrije toegang daadwerkelijk te realiseren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Molen over de berichtgeving dat de studie Nederlands dreigt te verdwijnen en alleen in het buitenland populair is

An MP from the CDA asked the Minister of Education, Culture and Science about press reports that Dutch-language study programmes face falling enrolment and possible closure, and about what the government will do to raise intake. The minister answered that the government sees no signs of closures, that enrolment in teacher-training programmes is being monitored with concern, that institutions are already taking initiatives, and that a broader study of Dutch-language promotion abroad has been requested.
I have received no signals from universities of applied sciences or universities of concrete plans to close Dutch-language programmes.
Ik heb geen signalen ontvangen van de hogescholen of universiteiten tot concrete voornemens om opleidingen Nederlands te sluiten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Molen, Ronnes en Van Dam over het bericht ‘Opmars No Cure, No Pay bureaus bij WOZ-bezwaren’

MPs asked about the growing share of WOZ property-valuation objections filed by no-cure-no-pay agencies, including calls for independent research, consumer protection, association sponsorship practices, municipal valuation quality, and an OZB inspection counter under the Omgevingswet. The ministers say they will commission research into the volume of such objections and related cost reimbursements before deciding on solutions, but decline to intervene in agency-association arrangements and point to existing Waarderingskamer oversight and the WOZ waardeloket.
My colleagues and I will have the development of the number of objections by no cure no pay companies and the related cost reimbursements examined.
Mijn ambtgenoten en ik zullen de ontwikkeling van de aantallen bezwaren door no cure no pay bedrijven en de in verband daarmee toegekende kostenvergoedingen laten onderzoeken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ronnes en Van der Molen over het bericht dat ex-studenten geen hypotheek krijgen bij een studieschuld

MPs Ronnes and Van der Molen (CDA) asked ministers whether banks wrongly count the original rather than remaining student debt when assessing mortgage applications, and whether DUO should improve information to students. The government answered that annuity repayment makes the monthly burden constant so the original debt is weighted via fixed factors, that the explain exception exists, that information will be improved, and that excluding student debt would raise over-indebtedness risk.

At the next Platform Hypotheken in 2019, where the sector and the supervisor discuss possible bottlenecks in mortgage lending, it will be inventoried how providers use this explain possibility and whether bottlenecks are encountered.

Tijdens het volgende Platform Hypotheken in 2019, waar met de sector en de toezichthouder wordt gesproken over mogelijke knelpunten in de hypotheekverstrekking, zal worden geïnventariseerd op welke wijze aanbieders gebruik maken van deze explain-mogelijkheid en of hier knelpunten worden ondervonden
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Dam en Van der Molen over het bericht ‘Staat aansprakelijk voor uitlatingen bewindspersoon over downloaden uit illegale bron’

Two CDA MPs asked the Minister for Legal Protection about a court ruling that the State acted unlawfully toward film producers by statements about downloading from illegal sources, asking about consequences, damages, and why the government long held downloading from illegal sources was not punishable and what enforcement followed. The Minister said the ruling is still being studied and appeal is possible, no damages have yet been claimed, and that since the 2014 CJEU ruling downloading from illegal sources was never permitted, with enforcement left largely to private collective action by Stichting Brein.
No statements can yet be made about the consequences of the judgment.
Over de gevolgen van het vonnis kunnen nog geen mededelingen worden gedaan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ronnes en Van der Molen over het tekort aan studentenkamers

Two CDA MPs asked about the shortage of student rooms, rising rents, housing options for starters, arrangements for international students, and whether the housing situation affects study choices. The minister disputed the figure of 40,000 unhoused students, pointed to monitor data and the rent-check route via the Huurcommissie, and said no trend yet shows housing affecting study choice.
I have not yet observed a trend showing that the housing market situation influences students' study choices.
Ik heb nog geen trend waargenomen waaruit blijkt dat de situatie op de woningmarkt de studiekeuze van studenten beïnvloedt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Molen over de herleidbare vermelding van het persoonlijke Burgerservicenummer (BSN) op de voorzijde van het paspoort

An MP asked whether the BSN printed on the front of post-2014 passports, which enables identity fraud, should be removed from the front of passports. The State Secretary acknowledged the risk, explained the ICAO-based reasons for the current placement, and committed to moving the BSN off the machine-readable zone at the next passport revision, pending agreement on timing with agencies.
Yes, I intend to remove the BSN from the MRZ and make it automatically readable on the back of the passport data page and identity cards.
Ja, ik ben voornemens het BSN uit de MRZ te halen en automatisch uitleesbaar te maken op de achterzijde van de houderpagina van paspoorten en identiteitskaarten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Molen over het bericht 'Rijbewijs vanaf 4 juni met toepassing inloggen DigiD'

An MP asked the State Secretary about reports that driving licences issued from 4 June 2018 carry a DigiD login chip before the Digital Government Act is in force, and whether citizens can use it and need the municipality to activate it. The State Secretary confirmed the chip rollout, said the login function will be usable once the pilot succeeds and the relevant law provisions take effect (expected 2019), and that citizens activate it online without the municipality.
Since 4 June, driving licences with this new chip are being issued.
Sinds 4 juni worden rijbewijzen met deze nieuwe chip uitgegeven.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Molen over het bericht ’Studenten lenen steeds meer en vaker’

An MP from the CDA asks the Minister of Education about reports that students borrow more, and that first-generation students and MBO students are advancing less to higher education, including effects of leenaversie (aversion to borrowing) and migration background. The Minister confirms concern about declining MBO-to-HBO progression, explains the definition and trends of first-generation students, notes that leenaversie does not clearly affect progression, and promises a letter on access and equal opportunities.
In my letter on accessibility and equal opportunities, which I will send you before the budget debate, I will go into detail on the progression of MBO students to higher education.
In mijn brief over toegankelijkheid en gelijke kansen, die ik u voor de begrotingsbehandeling toezend, ga ik uitvoerig in op de doorstroom van mbo-studenten naar het hoger onderwijs.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ronnes en Van der Molen over het bericht dat meer dan 100 Nederlandse studenten hun kamer moeten verlaten voor internationale studenten

Two CDA MPs asked ministers about reports that over 100 Dutch students must leave their rooms in the former Bijlmerbajes to make way for international students, and whether this is undesirable and what will be done. The ministers answered that the temporary housing is additional capacity once converted, that the affected students were told their stay was temporary, that they will be asked to help find alternatives, and that they know of no other similar cases.
Only once this location has been made suitable for international students do the rooms count as extra capacity on top of the existing supply.
Pas op het moment dat deze locatie geschikt is gemaakt voor internationale studenten, tellen de kamers als extra capaciteit op het bestaande aanbod.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt, Van der Molen, Voordewind en Özdil over de hogeschool Saxion, die een stuk over de Aramese genocide niet plaatst omdat er ophef en discussie over is in Nederland

MPs Omtzigt, Van der Molen, Voordewind and Özdil asked the Minister of Education, Culture and Science about Saxion's decision not to publish a student interview on the Aramean genocide due to public controversy, questioning whether such concerns justify withholding publication and whether the institution should be told so. The Minister replied that controversy alone should not be a reason to withhold publication, that the editorial decision was made independently for safety reasons, that the article was later published internally and on Saxion's website, and that she sees no need for further action or a joint statement.
I am of the view that controversy and debate should not be reasons to avoid speaking or writing about a subject.
Ik ben van mening dat ophef en discussie geen redenen mogen zijn om over een onderwerp niet te spreken of te schrijven.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Helvert en Van der Molen over de niet nagekomen beloftes van de regering van Malta

MPs Van Helvert and Van der Molen asked the Foreign Minister about Malta's Valletta 2018 director's comments on murdered journalist Daphne Caruana Galizia, Leeuwarden's suspension of official exchanges, the stalled murder investigation, and Dutch forensic assistance. The minister answered that the Dutch forensic institute helped Maltese police, that responsibility for the investigation lies with Malta, and that the issue has been raised bilaterally and in the EU and Council of Europe.
The Maltese authorities are responsible for the investigation into the murder of journalist Daphne Caruana Galizia and for tracking down and prosecuting the perpetrators.
De Maltese autoriteiten zijn verantwoordelijk voor het onderzoek naar de moord op journaliste Daphne Caruana Galizia en het opsporen en berechten van de daders.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Molen over het artikel 'Populariteit Psychologie en Kunstmatige Intelligentie leidt tot studentenstop'

An MP asked the minister whether a numerus fixus at Utrecht's psychology programme, linked to popularity of English-taught programmes, harms accessibility and whether action is needed. The minister denied a link to English-taught programmes, rejected the 'weak students' framing, and defended a temporary numerus fixus for quality reasons while declining further action.
I am not a supporter of numerus fixus, because it leads to a restriction of accessibility.
Ik ben geen voorstander van numeri fixi, omdat het leidt tot een beperking van de toegankelijkheid.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bruins Slot en Van der Molen over regeldruk voor kleine evenementen en festivals zoals de Lauwersland Fietsvierdaagse

CDA MPs asked the government about red tape for small events and festivals, including the Lauwersland Fietsvierdaagse needing municipal permits, cost burdens, temporary structure rules, event classification and safety handbooks. The minister answered that the rules are municipal, that the cycling event goes ahead in 2018, and that the government and VNG will keep monitoring, without committing to new national rules.
I endorse the social importance of volunteer organisations and associations, such as Oranje, scouting, carnival, sports and other associations.
Ik onderschrijf het maatschappelijk belang van vrijwilligersorganisaties en verenigingen, zoals Oranje-, scouting-, carnavals-, sport- en andere verenigingen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller, Westerveld, Van der Molen en Van der Graaf over het artikel ‘Zó ‘helpt’ de televisie kwetsbare tieners’

MPs from D66, GroenLinks, CDA and ChristenUnie asked the minister for Basic and Secondary Education and Media about an article on a broadcaster's treatment of vulnerable teenagers in a TV programme, including what rules apply and whether NPO governance rules and the NPO ombudsman's remit should be tightened. The minister replied that media freedom and the Mediawet 2008 leave programme content to broadcasters without prior supervision, that BNNVARA's own code applies, and that he will consult the NPO and College van Omroepen on whether duty of care toward participants can be added to governance rules or the ombudsman's remit, reporting to parliament with the 2019 media budget letter.

I will consult with the NPO and the CvO on how careful treatment of programme participants can be part of the codes of conduct, for example through the governance code or the broadcasters' programme statutes, and whether the ombudsman can have a role.

Ik zal met de NPO en het CvO overleggen op welke manier zorgvuldige omgang met deelnemers aan programma's onderdeel kan zijn van de gedragsregels, bijvoorbeeld via de governancecode of de programmastatuten van de omroepen, en of de ombudsman een rol kan krijgen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Molen over het bericht 'Britse universiteiten zoeken samenwerking'

An MP asked the Minister of Education about the Northumbria University satellite campus at the Amsterdam University of Applied Sciences and about how British universities can establish branches in the Netherlands. The minister said the campus is a pilot with about 50 students, that the government has little involvement, and promised further study of barriers to foreign institutions, pending Brexit outcomes.
As I already indicated in the General Consultation on Competitiveness on 23 May, I find it interesting that campuses of British universities are coming to the continent.
Zoals ik al aangaf in het Algemeen Overleg Concurrentievermogen op 23 mei jl., vind ik het interessant dat er campussen van Britse universiteiten naar het vasteland komen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Geurts, Von Martels en Van der Molen over oesterbanken voor de haven van Terschelling

Three CDA MPs asked the ministers about Japanese oyster banks affecting currents and access to the Terschelling harbour, dredging and ferry berths, a possible sailing ban near seal sandbanks, and the addition of the grey seal to Wadden dune habitat designations. The minister confirmed monitoring of the oyster banks with results expected end of the year, said the banks lie outside the ferry channel and do not affect access, confirmed planned maintenance of ferry infrastructure from 2019, and explained the limited scope of the grey seal designation.
These oyster banks are scheduled to be re-measured by Wageningen Marine Research this spring.
Deze oesterbanken worden volgens de planning dit voorjaar opnieuw ingemeten door Wageningen Marine Research.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Molen over het verkopen van tv-series aan video-on-demandbedrijven door de publieke omroep

An MP asked whether the public broadcaster NPO may license older series and documentaries to video-on-demand services, and how this fits the ban on serving commercial third-party interests. The minister answered that a limited, non-exclusive experiment is permitted, that the NPO board and the Commissariaat voor de Media supervise such side activities, and that commercial production for third parties would require Commissariaat approval.
Apart from the specific side-activities test, the prohibition on serving commercial interests also applies in full.
Behalve de specifieke nevenactiviteiten-toets geldt ook het dienstbaarheidsverbod onverkort.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Molen over het bericht ‘Ook gemeenten doen contant geld in de ban’

An MP asked the Minister of Interior whether municipalities refusing cash payments at counters exclude citizens, and whether she would act with the VNG and MOB. The minister confirmed about 21 municipalities went pin-only in 2016 with more since, acknowledged vulnerable groups need exceptions, and agreed to further consultation with the VNG and MOB.
Yes, I am willing to hold further consultation with the Association of Dutch Municipalities (VNG) and the MOB on municipalities' acceptance of cash.
Ja, ik ben bereid tot nader overleg met de Vereniging van Nederlandse Gemeenten (VNG) en het MOB over de acceptatie van contant geld door gemeenten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Molen over het bericht dat mbo- en hbo-studenten onvoldoende cybersecurity kennis en vaardigheden aanleren

An MP asked the education minister whether ICT and cybersecurity curricula in mbo and hbo are outdated, how accreditation and inspection address this, and whether teacher shortages and industry cooperation are being addressed. The minister acknowledges the concern, points to accreditation standards, inspection practice, Dcypher mapping of cybersecurity programmes and the need for closer industry ties, without committing to a specific new step.
I take this signal very seriously and find it very unpleasant that these students feel they are learning knowledge and skills that are outdated.
Ik neem dit signaal zeer serieus en vind het erg vervelend dat deze studenten het gevoel hebben dat ze kennis en vaardigheden leren die verouderd zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt, Bruins Slot en Van der Molen over de hoge OZB-rekeningen voor sportverenigingen en andere Sociaal Belang Behartigende Instellingen (SBBI)

CDA MPs asked whether municipalities charging sports clubs property tax (OZB) and then refunding it via subsidy is bureaucratic, whether non-residential OZB burdens on SBBI's are excessive, and whether the Municipalities Act should be amended to allow equal rates or an exemption. The minister answered that OZB rates and subsidies are a local democratic choice, declined to amend the law or grant a blanket exemption, and said no general judgement on burdens is possible.
An amendment of the Municipalities Act is not necessary in my view at this moment.
Een aanpassing van de Gemeentewet vind ik op dit moment niet nodig.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Molen over het rapport inzake kernenbeleid

An MP from the CDA asked the Minister of Interior whether she would address the costs of community-level policy (kernenbeleid) after municipal mergers, including a per-village increase in the municipal fund. The Minister said the policy falls under municipal autonomy, that it is too early to change the fund distribution based on a single-municipality report, and that the issue will be considered in the periodic maintenance report and the review of financial relations.
On the basis of the report, which concerns one municipality, it is currently too early to proceed to an adjustment of the distribution.
Op basis van het rapport, dat betrekking heeft op één gemeente, is het op dit moment te vroeg om over te gaan tot een aanpassing van de verdeling.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Molen en Van Dam over het bericht ‘Bizarre oproep: ’Maak lawaai tijdens dodenherdenking’

MPs Van der Molen and Van Dam asked whether a online call to make noise during the Dutch national Remembrance Day two-minute silence should be prevented, and whether the minister would engage Amsterdam. The minister condemned the call as disrespectful but said the local security triangle has full attention and is responsible for deciding how to respond.
It is up to them to decide how to deal with this call.
