Het is aan hen om te beslissen hoe met deze oproep moet worden omgegaan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Molen, Omtzigt en Lodders over het btw-nummer van zzp’ers dat het burgerservicenummer bevat

MPs Van der Molen, Omtzigt and Lodders asked whether the VAT number of sole traders contains the citizen service number (BSN) and whether this is lawful under privacy rules, and asked the government to stop including the BSN in new VAT numbers. The State Secretary of Finance answered that the BSN is part of the VAT number for natural persons for historical and EU-specification reasons, that a legal basis exists under the Wabb and Wet op de omzetbelasting, and that he is open to a different VAT number format, with information to the House before summer 2018 but declined to report on the Data Protection Authority's investigation.
I cannot make any statement about the status of the Data Protection Authority's investigation.
Over de stand van zaken van het onderzoek van de Autoriteit Persoonsgegevens (AP) kan ik geen mededelingen doen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Von Martels en Van der Molen over het bericht dat de vaarweg naar Ameland geen karrenspoor moet worden

MPs Von Martels and Van der Molen asked the minister about reports that the ferry route to Ameland should not become a 'cart track', about the reliability of the ferry connection due to low water, and whether the island could become unreachable. The minister answered that short-term measures are underway with Wagenborg, a long-term solution process starts after 2029, and there are no indications the island will become unreachable before then.
At the same time, under the direction of RWS and in line with the OPP advice, a process starts to reach a long-term solution for Ameland's accessibility beyond 2029.

Tegelijkertijd start onder regie van RWS – in overeenstemming met het OPP advies – een proces om te komen tot een lange termijn oplossing voor de bereikbaarheid van Ameland op de langere termijn (na 2029).
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Molen over de verengelsing in het hoger onderwijs

An MP asked the Minister of Education, Culture and Science about the push to make English the language of instruction and governance at Dutch universities, including TU/e, and how student and staff co-determination bodies are involved in language decisions. The minister reaffirmed that there are few compelling reasons for English-only governance, said co-determination bodies have instemmingsrecht over the OER and the university has sought consent for its language code, and promised to urge university umbrella organisations to take responsibility.
When foreign students and teachers feel co-responsible for governance and co-determination, I greatly appreciate that.
Wanneer buitenlandse studenten en docenten zich mede verantwoordelijk voelen voor bestuur en medezeggenschap, heb ik daar grote waardering voor.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Molen inzake het bericht 'Verplicht op eigen kosten naar New York voor een paar studiepunten'

An MP asked the Minister of Education about reports that university students must pay extra costs for excursions, materials and exams, which may breach the rules on charging such fees. The minister replied that the rules apply, that the Inspectorate found eight complaints justified and that institutions have promised better information, with no sanctions so far and a commitment to raise the issue with the universities' associations.
If it turns out that institutions do not comply with the law, the inspectorate will address them and, where necessary, take enforcement action.
Als blijkt dat instellingen zich niet aan de wet houden, zal de inspectie hen hierop aanspreken en zo nodig handhavend optreden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Berg en Van der Molen over het verdwijnen van de brievenbus in Tichelwurk

Two CDA MPs asked the State Secretary for Economic Affairs and Climate about the removal of the letterbox in Tichelwurk, which would leave residents six kilometres from the nearest box in winter, and whether ACM and PostNL could reconsider. The State Secretary said the rules allow removal but PostNL has decided to keep the box given the geographic circumstances, and that ACM has signalled no gaps in the supervisory framework.
The advisory process preceding a change, as PostNL applies it, ensures that account is taken of vulnerable groups and any special geographic circumstances.
Het adviesproces voorafgaand aan een wijziging zoals PostNL dat hanteert borgt dat er rekening wordt gehouden met kwetsbare groepen en eventuele bijzondere geografische omstandigheden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Molen over gemeentelijke herindeling in de Leidse regio

An MP asks whether the province of Zuid-Holland may impose a consistent regional end-state and grant itself power to force municipal mergers in the Leiden region, and what legal basis and remedies municipalities would have. The minister answers that the province only offers help and that a forced merger under the Arhi law is a last resort, with no objection or appeal possible against such a procedure.
No objection or appeal is possible against a merger procedure by the province under article 8 of the General Rules for Municipal Mergers Act.
Tegen een herindelingsprocedure door de provincie conform artikel 8 van de Wet algemene regels herindeling is geen bezwaar of beroep mogelijk.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Molen over de berichten ‘Steeds minder doorstroom van mbo naar hbo’ en ‘Minder mbo’ers naar hbo in afgelopen decennium’

MP Van der Molen (CDA) asked the Minister of Education about reports that the share of MBO graduates moving on to HBO has fallen since 2005, and whether this relates to the student loan system and to lower uptake among students from middle-income families. The Minister replied that the monitor shows no clear effect of the study grant reform yet, that the decline predates it and seems to be stabilising, and that the motives behind the decline will be examined in the next monitor, with a full policy response to be sent before summer.
I will send you the monitor on policy measures, with my response, before the summer.
Ik zal u de monitor beleidsmaatregelen, voorzien van mijn reactie, voor de zomer toesturen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Molen en Van der Graaf over de televisie-uitzending ‘Liever dood dan vermist’

MPs Van der Molen and Van der Graaf asked ministers about a TV documentary on missing WWII airmen and whether municipalities can be induced to recover aircraft wrecks. The government answers that recovery is a local decision, that it lacks an overview of refused requests, that it will help harmonise municipal policy via a framework being developed, and that the framework is delayed by complexity and many parties.
The central government has no overview of that.
Daar heeft de rijksoverheid geen overzicht van.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Berg en Van der Molen over het klaar maken van Nederland voor de uitrol van 5G

CDA MPs asked the State Secretary for Economic Affairs and Climate how the Netherlands can prepare for 5G, including the 3.5 GHz band, the 700 MHz alternative, trials such as the Leidseplein antenna, and whether Amsterdam can host the first 5G stadium for Euro 2020. The government answered that 700 MHz will be available nationally from 2020, the 26 GHz band is being prepared pending EU decisions, other European states are further along on 3.5 GHz, and it will facilitate experiments in Amsterdam without committing to a result.
I am already working on making the 700 MHz band available nationwide from 2020.
Ik werk reeds aan het landelijk beschikbaar stellen van de 700 MHz-band per 2020.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden van der Molen en Slootweg over overfinanciering bij agentschappen en ZBO’s

MPs Van der Molen and Slootweg (CDA) asked whether agencies and zbo's are over-financed, citing a November 2017 article, and whether the government will reclaim the surplus funds. Minister Hoekstra denies the over-financing picture, citing audited 2016 annual reports showing fixed assets exceed long-term debt and reserves, and points to existing supervisory instruments, while rejecting any need to recover funds.
I do not recognise the picture that unnecessary funds go to agencies and zbo's and therefore see no need for this.
Ik herken me niet in het beeld dat er onnodige middelen naar agentschappen en zbo's gaan en zie hiervoor daarom geen noodzaak.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Molen over regionale samenwerking tussen publieke en private mediabedrijven

The MP asks about the Friesland decision to end a regional media centre combining public broadcaster Omrop Fryslân with a private publisher, and whether the Mediawet blocks such public-private cooperation. The minister answers that EU state-aid rules and the Mediawet's dienstbaarheidsverbod limit such cooperation, that the Commissariaat has issued guidance and will intervene only if the law is breached, and that simply amending Dutch law would not solve the problem.
The Commissariaat recently published a new brochure clearly explaining in which cases cooperation is permitted and under which conditions.
Het Commissariaat heeft onlangs een nieuwe brochure uitgebracht waarin helder wordt uitgelegd in welke gevallen samenwerking is toegestaan, en onder welke voorwaarden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Molen en Kuik over de begeleiding van functiebeperkte studenten die te kort schiet

MPs Van der Molen and Kuik asked the ministers about the 2017 annual report on students with disabilities, uneven support across institutions, the inspectorate's role, and implementation of the UN disability convention. The minister replied that institutions are broadly adequate, that an Inspectorate study is underway with results expected spring 2018, and that a motion-based action plan is being worked out.
Furthermore, I can inform you that the inspectorate is currently conducting a study into the accessibility of higher education for students with a disability.
Verder kan ik u berichten dat de inspectie momenteel een onderzoek uitvoert naar de toegankelijkheid van het hoger onderwijs voor studenten met een functiebeperking.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Molen over het bericht “Waar blijven die extra uni-docenten”

MP Van der Molen (CDA) asked the Minister of Education whether universities, despite hiring about 900 of the promised 1400 extra lecturers, are falling behind student growth, and why university hiring lags behind hogeschool hiring. The Minister replied that institutions have discretion over how to spend study-advance funds, that she cannot confirm fewer lecturers work than in 2012, and that quality agreements on the funds will be made from 2018.
I assume that hiring additional lecturers has priority in the spending of the study-advance funds.
Ik ga ervan uit dat het aanstellen van extra docenten prioriteit heeft in de besteding van de studievoorschotmiddelen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Helvert en Van der Molen over het bericht dat de overtocht naar één van de Waddeneilanden 21% duurder wordt

MPs Van Helvert and Van der Molen asked about reports that ferry tickets to a Wadden island would become 21% more expensive, and about VAT, the concession and fare rises. The government answered that the reports are inaccurate, that the Tax Plan 2018 removes the zero VAT rate for ships used on the Wadden Sea, and that the concession transfer to the province will be studied in 2018.

When long-term solutions take more shape, the State Secretary intends to commission, together with the Province of Friesland, an independent study in 2018 into the consequences of transferring concession management and award.

Wanneer de lange termijn oplossingen meer vorm krijgen, is de Staatssecretaris van Infrastructuur en Milieu voornemens om samen met de Provincie Friesland in 2018 een onafhankelijk onderzoek uit te laten voeren
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Helvert en Van der Molen over het afbreken van een mast van de tweemastklipper Amicitia

MPs Van Helvert and Van der Molen asked the government about the mast collapse of the sailing ship Amicitia, the state of certification and inspection of the 'brown fleet', and inspection staffing compared with Germany and Denmark. The minister acknowledged the OVV findings, described inspection intensification and staffing, and promised a fuller response to the OVV recommendations by January 2018.
The accident with the Amicitia has been the reason for me to intensify the existing supervision of the inspection bodies.
Het ongeluk met de Amicitia is voor mij aanleiding geweest om het bestaande toezicht op de keuringsinstanties te intensiveren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Molen en Futselaar inzake het bericht 'studenten weg vanwege collegegeldschuld'

MPs Van der Molen and Futselaar asked about reports that students drop out over tuition debt, and about a proposal to pay benefits directly to institutions, and whether the government would collect national figures and change DUO's administration. The Minister rejected direct tuition payments to institutions for now, citing administrative costs, pointed to hogeschool coaching and municipal debt relief, and promised to await a research project before deciding.
Institutions are not obliged to report this information and I therefore do not have national total figures.
Instellingen zijn niet verplicht deze informatie te rapporteren en ik beschik derhalve niet over landelijke totaalcijfers.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Rog, Van der Molen en Amhaouch over het bericht Nederland moet ook Duitse diploma’s erkennen

Three CDA MPs asked the education minister about calls for mutual recognition of Dutch and German (NRW) diplomas, cross-border vocational programmes and Euregio schools. The minister said recognition in higher education is largely settled, that trust in vocational (mbo) diplomas is still lacking, that bilateral and Benelux talks continue, and that new cross-border mbo programmes would require legislative change only once internationalisation policy matures.
Our policy starting point is that mutual acceptance of diplomas in higher education is well arranged, through earlier EU and Benelux actions.
Ons beleidsuitgangspunt daarbij is dat de wederzijdse acceptatie van diploma's in het hoger onderwijs goed geregeld is, door eerdere acties van de EU en de Benelux.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Aukje de Vries, Visser en Van der Molen over het bericht “IFKS: comedy met Europese regels” in de Leeuwarder Courant

MPs Aukje de Vries, Visser and Van der Molen asked the minister of Infrastructure and Environment about EU certification (CvO) and AIS obligations affecting race skûtsjes reported in the Leeuwarder Courant. The minister says a clear transitional regime exists, enforcement only starts after 1 January 2019, and no legal basis exists for exemptions from the AIS or CvO obligations.
However, I am convinced that a clear and workable transitional arrangement exists for the vessels concerned.
Ik ben er echter van overtuigd dat er voor de betrokken schepen een heldere en werkbare overgangsregeling bestaat.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Molen over de huisvestingsplannen van Horizon College en Regio College in Purmerend

An MP asked the education minister why the ministry and inspectorate oppose the shared housing plans of two Purmerend vocational colleges, whether public housing finance rules block it, and why the ministry did not comment when the plans were submitted in 2015. The minister said talks are ongoing, cited the WEB rules on efficient use of funds, said ministry review of the 2015 loan application covered only collateral and not the plans' legality or efficiency, and promised a study of obstacles.
To gain better insight into possible obstacles posed by current laws and regulations to shared housing, I will have a study carried out this year in the (v)mbo and ho sectors.
Om beter zicht te krijgen op eventuele belemmeringen van de huidige wet- en regelgeving bij gedeelde huisvesting laat ik nog dit jaar een onderzoek uitvoeren in de sectoren (v)mbo en ho.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Duisenberg en Van der Molen over het bericht 'Waarom moeten studenten betalen voor een bestuursjaar?'

MPs Duisenberg and Van der Molen asked the minister about reports that students serving as full-time student board members must still pay tuition despite not studying, and whether institutions should proactively grant the tuition exemption created by their amendment. The minister answered that the exemption is optional and left to institutional boards and works-council agreements, that the 87% figure refers to 53 of 61 full-time student board members, and that she will alert student organisations and sector associations and reports on the flexstuderen experiment.
The board makes arrangements with the works council on how the board grants are filled in.
Het bestuur maakt met de medezeggenschap afspraken over de invulling van de bestuursbeurzen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Molen over het bericht studenten weg vanwege collegegeldschuld

An MP asked the education minister about reports that about 300 students at Hogeschool Rotterdam were removed for unpaid tuition, and whether DUO could pay the tuition credit directly to institutions. The minister confirmed the figures, said no national data exist, rejected direct payment to institutions for administrative and motivational reasons, and pointed to debt counselling, while accepting that a law change would be needed.

My officials will consult with colleagues at SZW and with the NVVK, the trade association for debt counselling and social banking, to examine how this vulnerable group can find its way to debt counselling and receive appropriate support.

Mijn ambtenaren zullen samen met de collega’s van SZW in overleg treden met de NVVK, de branchevereniging voor schuldhulpverlening en sociaal bankieren, met als doel te bezien hoe we ervoor kunnen zorgen dat deze kwetsbare groep de weg naar de schuldhulpverlening vindt en passende ondersteuning krijgt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Helvert en Van der Molen over nieuwe bruggen in de Afsluitdijk

MPs Van Helvert and Van der Molen asked whether the Afsluitdijk bridges would not be replaced until after 2050, causing repeated breakdowns, and asked about the delay, cost and temperature causes. The minister denied any delay, said replacement of the superstructure is planned for 2023-2025 with a repair in 2020, and gave no estimate of future breakdowns or their costs, citing lack of registration.
Incidentally, between mid-July 2016 and end April 2017 no breakdowns with consequences for (waterborne) road traffic occurred at either bridge.
Overigens hebben zich in de periode van midden juli 2016 tot eind april 2017 aan beide bruggen geen storingen met gevolgen voor het (vaar)wegverkeer voorgedaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Molen over de afhandeling van onrechtmatig afgegeven bindende studieadviezen

An MP asked the minister how institutions should remedy unlawfully issued binding study advices (BSA) and whether students who missed appeal deadlines should be informed and readmitted. The minister said institutions should treat affected students generously and that students may appeal refusals, but declined to intervene in disputes between institutions and students and to judge liability or the duty to inform.
I do not intervene in disputes between institutions and students.
Ik treed niet in geschillen tussen instellingen en studenten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Rog en Van der Molen over taalgebruik op de lerarenopleidingen

Two CDA MPs asked the minister whether teacher-training colleges tolerate poor Dutch-language skills among trainee teachers and whether schools in Rotterdam South have teachers without perfect Dutch. The minister answered that high language standards apply, that schools' boards are responsible for competent staff, and that she sees no reason to call colleges to account.
I have no reason to call the VH and the teacher-training colleges to account on this point.
Ik heb geen reden om de VH en de lerarenopleidingen op dit punt aan te spreken
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Duisenberg en Van der Molen inzake numeri fixi bij technische universiteiten

MPs Duisenberg and Van der Molen asked the minister about numerus fixus places at technical universities, the number of students turned away, and funding pressure on research. The minister answered that about 91 students could not enter their first-choice technical programme in 2016/17, that 2017/18 figures are not yet known, and that the investment fund proposal falls outside what a demissionary minister should take a position on.
Whether there will actually be a large over-enrolment in the eight TU programmes with a numerus fixus in academic year 2017–2018, I cannot say now.
Of er daadwerkelijk sprake zal zijn van een grote overinschrijving van de acht TU-opleidingen met een numerus fixus in collegejaar 2017–2018, kan ik nu niet zeggen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Amhaouch en Van der Molen over toegepast onderzoek in Nederland

MPs Amhaouch and Van der Molen (CDA) asked the Minister of Economic Affairs whether the cuts to applied research institutes (TO2) were compensated by innovation subsidies and private contracts, and what the ministry does to help these institutes win market work and keep room for societal research. The minister answered that public-private partnership via the topsector agendas and the PPS-toeslag is the policy, that the cuts were absorbed in topsector support and thematic research while statutory tasks were protected, and that a substantive reply on the TO2 evaluation will follow later.

m: Motie van het lid Belhaj c.s. over het groeipad voor uitgaven aan innovatie
Asks the government to inform the House on the growth path for defence R&D and innovation spending when presenting the Defence white paper and supplementary budget.
requests the government to inform the House about the growth path for spending on research and development and innovation
verzoekt de regering, de Kamer over het groeipad voor uitgaven aan research and development en innovatie te informeren
Motie van het lid Dijkgraaf over een langjarig perspectief voor het Defensiebudget
Asks the government to present concrete proposals in the next Defence white paper for a long-term perspective on the defence budget in line with NATO commitments.
requests the government to make concrete proposals in the upcoming Defence note for a long-term perspective for Defence
verzoekt de regering, in de komende Defensienota concrete voorstellen te doen voor de uitwerking van een langjarig perspectief voor Defensie
Motie van het lid Voordewind c.s. over de tweedaagse conferentie over geestelijke verzorging
Motion asking the government to make the two-day chaplaincy conference a fixed part of the training for land forces cadets and encourage participation before deployments.
requests the government to make the two-day chaplaincy conference also a fixed part of the training of land forces cadets
verzoekt de regering, de tweedaagse geestelijkeverzorgingsconferentie ook tot vast onderdeel te maken van de opleiding van de landmachtcadetten
Motie van het lid Belhaj c.s. over verruimen van de aanstellingsleeftijden
Asks the government to explore raising age limits for entry into certain defence job categories to support an adaptive armed forces.
requests the government to investigate the possibilities of relaxing the current maximum age when offering positions
verzoekt de regering om, de mogelijkheden te onderzoeken om de huidige maximalisering van leeftijd bij de aanbieding van betrekkingen te verruimen
Motie van het lid Diks c.s. over terugwinnen van landbouwgrond op de Sahara
Motion asking the government to study how the Netherlands can promote reclaiming farmland from the Sahara in the Sahel and inform the House in the next policy note.
requests the government to investigate how the Netherlands can efficiently promote the reclaiming of farmland from the Sahara in the Sahel region
verzoekt de regering, te onderzoeken hoe Nederland op doelmatige wijze het terugwinnen van landbouwgrond op de Sahara in de Sahelregio intensief kan bevorderen
Motie van het lid Kuik c.s. over de kennispositie op het gebied van water en voedsel
Asks the government to recognise and fully use the Dutch knowledge position on water and food in international trade policy.
requests the government to recognise this Dutch knowledge position in water and food and to make optimal use of it in international trade policy
verzoekt de regering, deze kennispositie van Nederland op het terrein van water en voedsel te erkennen en optimaal te benutten in het internationaal handelsbeleid
Gewijzigd amendement van het lid Dijkgraaf ter vervanging van nr. 41 over brede weersverzekeringen
Amendment exempting broad weather insurance from insurance tax and adjusting the gambling tax rate to fund it.
This amendment ensures that an exemption from insurance tax for broad weather insurance is included in the Dutch Tax on Legal Transactions Act.
Dit amendement zorgt ervoor dat in de Wet op belastingen van rechtsverkeer een vrijstelling van assurantiebelasting wordt opgenomen voor brede weersverzekeringen.
Motie van het lid Bruins c.s. over gebruikers van de landbouwregeling

qa: Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dijkgraaf over artikel 14 van de Meststoffenwet

MP Dijkgraaf (SGP) asked the Minister of Agriculture, Nature and Food Quality about the accuracy of sampling manure phosphate content, the court's suspension of fine cases, and how article 14 of the Meststoffenwet is enforced. The Minister defended the sampling accuracy, said both phosphate and nitrogen must be accounted for, and declined to break down fines by sector or give fine collection figures, citing lack of capacity.
The type of company is not separately registered for entrepreneurs who receive a fine, so I cannot answer this question.

An MP asked the Minister of Social Affairs about the Centrale Raad van Beroep ruling on the impartiality of UWV-employed medical experts and a Gelderland court finding of détournement de pouvoir in a WIA case. The minister answered that the CRvB stepping-stone plan binds courts rather than the UWV, that no procedural change is needed, that the ZW-WIA link justifies ending ZW benefits, and that the UWV has since accepted the ruling and will decide the other case promptly.
The UWV has in the meantime accepted the ruling.
Het UWV heeft inmiddels berust in de uitspraak.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dijkgraaf over het rapport van de Auditdienst Rijk over toepassing van het billijkheidsbeginsel bij het opleggen van mestboetes

An MP asked whether the government would publish the RVO.nl mitigation policy for manure fines, the average reduction percentages in 104 mitigated cases, and the reasons for mitigation. The minister refused to publish the policy to avoid strategic behaviour, said averages are not meaningful and no capacity exists for case-by-case review, and reported only that 71 fines for accountability violations were imposed in 2014–2016 without tracking how many were mitigated.
Publishing the mitigation policy could lead entrepreneurs to anticipate it and create strategic behaviour.
Openbaarmaking van het matigingsbeleid kan ertoe leiden dat ondernemers daarop gaan anticiperen en er berekenend gedrag ontstaat.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bruins, Geurts en Dijkgraaf over het bericht van het Centraal Bureau voor de Statistiek over het Living Planet Report

MPs Bruins, Geurts and Dijkgraaf asked about a CBS Living Planet Report claim that bottom trawling is a major cause of decline in North Sea benthic fauna, which Wageningen Marine Research said could not be concluded from its data, and about CBS's paid work for interest groups. The minister confirms the data sources, says CBS corrected the claim to attribute the finding to Wageningen research, and states that CBS's paid-work terms preserve its independence, while declining to go further on rectification or apology.
CBS concluded that its original report of 30 October required adjustments on some points and published a revised version on 3 November.
Het CBS is tot de conclusie gekomen dat het oorspronkelijke bericht van 30 oktober jl. op enkele punten aanpassing behoefde en heeft op 3 november jl. een aangepaste versie gepubliceerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bisschop en Dijkgraaf over de afschaffing van de huurtoeslag voor bewoners van vakantiewoningen

MPs Bisschop and Dijkgraaf asked how residents of holiday homes were informed about the abolition of rent allowance, why notices came late, and whether municipalities were informed. The Minister replied that holiday-home renters were not separately registered and could not be informed individually, that the VNG was asked to inform municipalities, and that the statutory notice period cannot be extended.
Following this recent reporting, it has become apparent that communication about the change in rent allowance rules for holiday homes on holiday-use businesses was not clear to everyone.

Naar aanleiding van deze recente berichtgeving is gebleken dat de communicatie over de wijziging van de regels voor huurtoeslag voor vakantiewoningen op vakantiebestedingsbedrijven niet voor iedereen duidelijk is geweest.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dijkgraaf over het bericht 'Werkgevers kunnen niet zomaar om FNV heen'

An SGP MP asked the Minister of Social Affairs about a court ruling that employers cannot simply bypass FNV, and how it squares with earlier answers on the Inretail/Alternatief voor vakbond Sunday allowance, and what it means for CAOs signed with small unions. The minister answered that representativeness is in principle irrelevant for algemeen verbindendverklaring, that the ruling concerns individual contract clauses with specific circumstances and draws no general conclusions, and that no regulatory revision is needed while the case is under appeal.
No general conclusions can be drawn from the specific circumstances of this ruling about CAOs concluded with an employee organisation of limited size.
Uit de specifieke omstandigheden van deze uitspraak zijn geen algemene gevolgtrekkingen te doen over cao's die worden afgesloten met een werknemersorganisatie van beperkte omvang.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dijkgraaf over de boetes op basis van de Meststoffenwet

An SGP MP asked the State Secretary for Economic Affairs about fines under the Meststoffenwet, including totals for 2014–2016 and breakdowns by type of violation and fine size. The minister confirmed the figures (about €22.6 million across 2,771 decisions) and gave detailed tables, while pointing to separate derogation reports and noting that derogation alone does not trigger fines.
For this I refer to the reports on the Dutch derogation as sent to the European Commission and to your House.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dijkgraaf over het gebruik van lokmiddelen bij de bestrijding van landelijk vrijgestelde soorten

The Minister answered that the Vogelrichtlijn requires named methods to be designated, that lures are now designated for the national exemption, and that a Regeling change will follow shortly.

in the short term, by amending the Regeling natuurbescherming, the methods of catching and killing using non-living decoy birds, acoustic devices that can produce lure sounds, and non-poisonous or non-narcotic bait will be designated as permitted methods for the national exemption

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dijkgraaf over de oplopende verschillen tussen de melkprijs voor boeren en voor consumenten

An MP asks whether the widening gap between dairy farmers' milk prices and consumer prices is due to retail concentration and the abolition of the milk quota, and whether the government will strengthen farmers' earning model for sustainability. The minister answers that the gap is a market matter, that he sees no evidence linking it to retail concentration or quota abolition, and that farmers bear primary responsibility for their earning model while the government supports sustainability through existing programmes.
I have no indications that the growing difference is due to increasing market concentration in retail combined with the abolition of the milk quota.
Ik heb geen aanwijzingen dat het oplopende verschil te wijten is aan de toenemende machtsconcentratie in de retail in combinatie met het afschaffen van het melkquotum.

An SGP MP asked the State Secretary whether iron-rich groundwater reduces phosphate's impact on water quality, and whether the WFD standards, the STONE model, the Nitrates Directive programme and EU reporting should be adjusted accordingly. The government largely maintains current policy, saying new insights will be incorporated in updates for 2022-2027 and the 7th programme, and that the 6th programme focuses on good agricultural practice.
Water managers can, on the basis of new scientific insights, adjust water quality targets for the river basin management plans 2022–2027.
Waterbeheerders kunnen op grond van nieuwe wetenschappelijke inzichten waterkwaliteitsdoelen voor de stroomgebiedbeheerplannen 2022–2027 bijstellen.

Two MPs asked the Defence Minister why the promised 2014 evaluation of helicopter low-flying areas was delayed, what the plan and timeline are, and how complaints are handled. The minister attributes the delay to waiting for a Council of State ruling and staff reductions, commits to presenting a draft report to the advisory group by end of May 2017 with a decision by year-end, and describes the complaint handling and communication practices.
The evaluation must result by the end of this year in a proposal on how a wider spread of low-flying exercises can be achieved.
De evaluatie moet voor het einde van dit jaar uitmonden in een voorstel op welke wijze meer spreiding van laagvliegoefeningen mogelijk is.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dijkgraaf en Bisschop over de aangescherpte regels voor gebruik van hoogwerkers bij asbestsanering

MPs Dijkgraaf and Bisschop asked whether the Inspectorate's stricter rules on aerial work platforms in asbestos removal make roof replacement impractical, and what support will be given. The minister replied that the rules were clarified in a brochure rather than tightened, that the existing exemption for occasional use remains available, and that a programmatic approach with financing options is being developed.
However, there is no question of tightening the rules.
Er is evenwel geen sprake van aanscherping van de regels.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dijkgraaf over de spieringvisserij op het IJsselmeer

An MP asked the state secretary for Economic Affairs whether provinces' refusal to grant Nature Conservation Act permits for smelt fishing on the IJsselmeer, and the unrevised Fisheries Act protocol, prevent smelt fishing this year. The state secretary answered that the protocol is separate from permit granting, that the protocol would have allowed fishing on the numbers, but trial fishing did not take place because applications were incomplete, and that a new study will be ready this year and discussed with the provinces.
The study referred to in the answer to question 4 will take place in consultation with the relevant provinces.
Het onderzoek waarnaar gerefereerd wordt in het antwoord op vraag 4, zal in overleg met de betreffende provincies plaatsvinden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dijkgraaf over het bericht dat de fosfaat-stikstof verhouding in de Noordzee uit balans is

MP Dijkgraaf (SGP) asked whether the phosphorus-nitrogen imbalance in the North Sea, linked to manure and detergent policy, justifies easing or pausing phosphate reduction and the phosphate rights system, and what measures could restore the balance. The state secretary rejected the claim of a phosphate shortage, argued that nitrogen reduction (including from abroad) is the priority, and said the findings will feed into the sixth Nitrates Directive action programme and EU reporting.
There is no shortage of phosphate in the coastal zone of the North Sea.
Er is geen sprake van een tekort aan fosfaat in de kustzone van de Noordzee.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Voordewind en Dijkgraaf over de oprichting van een internationaal fonds voor abortussen

Two MPs asked why the Dutch government is funding an international abortion fund focused on abortion rather than broader maternal care, and how it will be financed amid budget cuts. Minister Ploumen answered that the initiative promotes women's reproductive rights, that 10 million euro fits within the existing budget, and that the impact of the US Mexico City Policy is still being monitored.
The cabinet makes ten million euro available under the She Decides initiative.
Het kabinet stelt tien miljoen euro beschikbaar in het kader van het initiatief She Decides.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Laar over de positie van vrouwen en meisjes in de watersector

An MP asked the Minister for Foreign Trade and Development about the disadvantaged position of women and girls in access to and control over water, and about gender analysis, due diligence and protection of women human rights defenders. The minister agreed with the concerns, described existing gender analysis requirements, water strategy commitments, CSR and due diligence efforts, and measures on women human rights defenders.
A condition for approval of all programmes the Netherlands supports, including water, food security and climate, is carrying out a gender analysis.
Voorwaarde voor goedkeuring van alle programma's die Nederland ondersteunt, inclusief water, voedselzekerheid en klimaat, is het uitvoeren van een genderanalyse.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dijkgraaf over de medewerking van RVO.nl aan het akkerbouwonderzoek

An MP asked whether RVO.nl's refusal to cooperate in obtaining mandates for the arable farming research levy was jeopardising the research and why it was not cooperating. The minister confirmed the research is important and said that, within the limits of the Personal Data Protection Act, the industry body may obtain KvK numbers of non-members from RVO.nl so it can approach all levy-paying businesses.

I have decided, within the scope allowed by the Personal Data Protection Act, to enable the Arable Farming Industry Body to obtain the Chamber of Commerce numbers of non-member market participants from RVO.nl.

Een en ander afwegend heb ik besloten – binnen de ruimte die de Wbp biedt – het de Brancheorganisatie (BO) Akkerbouw mogelijk te maken de Kamer van Koophandel-nummers (KvK-nummers) van de niet bij haar aangesloten marktdeelnemers van RVO.nl te verkrijgen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ronnes, Van der Linde, Albert de Vries en Dijkgraaf over het bericht dat er chaos dreigt door nieuwe zienswijze van de Autoriteit Financiële Markten (AFM)

Four MPs asked the Minister for Housing and Government Service, on behalf of the Finance Minister, about the AFM's new view that mortgages must be tested against the lending norms in force when the binding offer is issued rather than at application, which could cause chaos for applicants. The Minister answered that a transition period until 1 February 2017 was agreed with the sector and the WEW for applications filed before 2017, that the AFM will take this into account in supervision, and that the timing of tests is a matter of clarifying the MCD-based rules.
For mortgage applications submitted before 1 January 2017 where the creditworthiness test for the binding offer takes place by 1 February 2017 at the latest, the 2016 lending norms may be applied.

Voor hypotheekaanvragen die zijn ingediend voor 1 januari 2017 waarbij de kredietwaardigheidstoets ten behoeve van het bindend aanbod uiterlijk 1 februari 2017 plaatsvindt, er met de leennormen van 2016 mag worden gerekend.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Geurts en Dijkgraaf over niet uitbetalen betalingsrechten en behandeling bezwaren

MPs Geurts and Dijkgraaf asked about thousands of unresolved objections to 2015 payment-right decisions by the agricultural agency RVO, including the share upheld, extended deadlines, and the timing of 2016 payments. The state secretary answered that about 1,400 objections had been upheld in part or in full (about 0.14% of payments), that remaining cases will be settled by 1 April 2017, and that a 2016 payment schedule was sent separately.
Before 1 April 2017, all objections are expected to have been processed.
Voor 1 april 2017 zullen alle bezwaren naar verwachting zijn afgehandeld.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Lodders, Dijkgraaf en Geurts over het persbericht ‘Innovatieve schimmel alternatief voor landbouwgif’

Three MPs asked why the Ministry of Economic Affairs press release on a fungus-based alternative used the term 'landbouwgif' rather than the statutory 'gewasbeschermingsmiddelen', and whether this framing harms agriculture. The Secretary of State acknowledged the term was chosen for a general audience, said the pilots for low-risk alternatives are still in the start-up phase, and stressed the importance of an adequate effective pesticide package.
The word landbouwgif was used as a synonym for the high-risk plant protection products.
Het woord landbouwgif is als synoniem gebruikt voor de risicovolle gewasbeschermingsmiddelen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dijkgraaf, Geurts en Lodders over het bericht dat fabrikanten woest zijn over eenzijdige aanpassing van emissies innovatieve stalvloeren

MPs Dijkgraaf, Geurts and Lodders asked why the government adjusted emission measurements for innovative low-emission stable floors, whether Wageningen University's overlapping roles are independent, why the Aeromix system received no provisional emission factor, and about the professionalisation of the advisory committee TacRav. The State Secretary answered that a expert panel is reviewing the measurements, a third party will advise by November, definitive factors are expected early 2017, and the TacRav professionalisation will be audited.
I want to have the advice at my disposal in November, so that after consultation with those involved I can definitively set the emission factors in early 2017.
Het advies wil ik in november tot mijn beschikking hebben, zodat ik na overleg met betrokkenen begin 2017 de emissiefactoren definitief kan vaststellen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bisschop, Dijkgraaf, Visser, Geurts, Graus, Bruins, Van Klaveren en Van Vliet over het bericht dat een groot deel van de Noordzee nauwelijks bevist wordt

MPs asked the minister whether the finding that nearly 40% of the North Sea is barely fished changes the government's commitment to closing 10% of Dutch waters to bottom-trawling and the proposed extra closures on the Friese Front and Centrale Oestergronden. The minister answered that the study does not address protected ecological areas, which is the focus of the Dutch ambition, that the proposal remains a valid implementation of the 10-15% goal, and that she will inform parliament on how the Bisschop motion is executed, but could not answer before the committee meeting.
Soon I will, on behalf of the State Secretary for Economic Affairs as well, inform your House how I have executed the Bisschop motion.
Binnenkort zal ik, mede namens de Staatssecretaris van Economische Zaken, uw Kamer informeren hoe ik de motie Bisschop heb uitgevoerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dijkgraaf, Bruins en Gesthuizen over de toegezegde evaluatie van de Winkeltijdenwet

Three MPs asked the Minister of Economic Affairs about the status of the promised evaluation of the Shop Opening Hours Act, including whether workers' interests, Sunday rest and small retailers are considered, whether municipalities copy neighbouring municipalities' policy, and when the report will be sent. The Minister answered that an external evaluation is underway covering these interests and neighbouring-municipality effects, that he will not anticipate its outcome, and that the results and a policy letter will be sent before year-end.
So as not to anticipate matters, I first await the outcomes of the evaluation.
Om niet op de zaken vooruit te lopen, wacht ik eerst de uitkomsten van de evaluatie af.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dijkgraaf en Bruins over het opleggen van boetes aan een winkelier die op zondag zijn winkel niet openstelt

MPs Dijkgraaf and Bruins asked whether landlords may fine shop tenants who keep their shops closed on Sundays, despite municipal freedom and earlier ROZ commitments. Minister Kamp answered that municipalities cannot oblige shops to open, that the contractual landlord-tenant arrangements fall under contract freedom, and that he will await the evaluation of the Winkeltijdenwet before committing to further measures.
I would like to await this evaluation before making statements on whether sufficient measures have been taken to prevent shopkeepers from receiving a fine if they do not want to open on Sunday.

Ik wil graag wachten op deze evaluatie alvorens uitspraken te doen of er voldoende maatregelen zijn genomen om te voorkomen dat winkeliers een boete krijgen indien zij op zondag niet open willen gaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dijkgraaf over de kritiek op de Wet dieraantallen

MP Dijkgraaf asks the state secretaries whether criticism of the Wet dieraantallen (animal numbers law), including from IRAS researcher Heederik, the provinces of Gelderland and Limburg, and a Brabant longkanker correlation analysis, undermines the bill and its link to public health. The government answers that a joint approach is needed, that animal numbers caps remain useful for overburdened areas, that the bill will be pursued, and that further research on endotoxins and health will be reported this autumn.
Therefore the cabinet will, in addition to this approach, further advance the previously announced animal numbers bill.
Daarom zal het kabinet aanvullend op deze aanpak het eerder aangekondigde wetsvoorstel dieraantallen verder in gang zetten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dijkgraaf en Gesthuizen over bancaire dienstverlening aan activiteiten van humanitaire organisaties in sanctielanden als Syrië en Rusland

MPs Dijkgraaf and Gesthuizen asked whether Dutch banks are wrongly over-applying sanctions regimes and blocking banking services to humanitarian organisations in Syria and Russia, and whether the government will act. The government replied that banks make their own risk assessments within EU sanctions rules, that humanitarian exemptions can be requested from the Ministry of Finance, that it is in dialogue with banks and will encourage them to facilitate humanitarian organisations, and that a 'white list' idea merits further EU discussion.
The cabinet is in dialogue with the banks on sanctions policy.
Het kabinet is over het sanctiebeleid in dialoog met de banken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dijkgraaf over vernielingen van de Nederlandse onderneming Esmeralda Farms in Ethiopië

An MP asked whether arson destroyed Esmeralda Farms in Ethiopia, whether other Dutch firms were affected, what drives the unrest and what Ethiopia is doing to protect foreign investors, and whether Dutch firms have a legal basis for compensation. The ministers confirmed major damage, explained the regional grievances and urged reform, said the Ethiopian authorities and investment commission will assess damage and that compensation is primarily a matter for Ethiopian courts or investment insurance, with no basis under the bilateral investment treaty.
The Dutch embassy in Addis Ababa is in close contact with the affected Dutch companies and Ethiopian authorities.
De Nederlandse ambassade in Addis Abeba staat in nauw contact met de Nederlandse getroffen bedrijven en Ethiopische autoriteiten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dijkgraaf over het bericht dat bij RVO geld zoek is geraakt

An SGP MP asked the Minister of Economic Affairs why RVO had not fully paid the 2015 farm direct payments despite a 1 July 2016 deadline and why the budget was underspent, and whether the reported full payment conflicted with this. The State Secretary answered that all applications were decided by 15 July 2016, with six farmers still lacking bank details, that the underspend stemmed from applicants not meeting conditions, and that unpaid funds would be used for objections and the 2016 budget.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dijkgraaf over het afdwingen van vijf aanvullende landbouwenquêtes door het CBS

An MP asked whether the statistics office CBS may compel farmers to take part in five additional agricultural surveys beyond the annual census, and on what EU basis and whether registers or extrapolation could replace them. The government answered that EU regulations require the data, that CBS already uses registers where possible, and that it will keep limiting the survey burden without committing to specific new steps.
The CBS has for decades strongly focused on reducing both the actual and the perceived administrative burden on businesses.
Het CBS zet al decennialang sterk in op het verlagen van zowel de feitelijke als de ervaren lastendruk bij het bedrijfsleven.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Geurts, Lodders, Graus, Dik-Faber, Dijkgraaf,  Van Klaveren en Houwers over het bericht van Cumela om voor 24 augustus 2016 duidelijkheid te geven over het verzoek van Cumela voor uitstel

MPs from several parties asked the State Secretary for Economic Affairs to clarify before 24 August 2016 whether he would postpone the manure spreading ban, as requested by the trade association Cumela. The State Secretary answered that he had asked the Technical Committee Soil for advice on a possible exemption under the Soil Protection Act, expected to decide within the week and communicate it promptly.
I expect this advice to be received shortly and will then decide on an exemption.
Ik verwacht dit advies op korte termijn te ontvangen en zal daarna besluiten over een vrijstelling.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dijkgraaf over de boycot van een bedrijf door de gemeente Smallingerland

An MP asked the Minister of Economic Affairs about the municipality of Smallingerland excluding agricultural machinery firm De Boer from procurement over a violation, questioning proportionality, transparency and compliance with the Aanbestedingswet 2012. The minister answered that the legal assessment of such municipal exclusion is for the courts, that procurement principles apply, and that the government is not in a position to judge or call the municipality to account.
It is not for me to call a municipality to account for its conduct.
Het is niet aan mij om een gemeente aan te spreken op haar handelwijze.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dijkgraaf over de armoedeval voor eenverdieners

An SGP MP asked the State Secretary of Finance and the Minister of Social Affairs about the poverty trap for single-earner households, citing a report that a 11,000 euro gross rise could mean a net loss, and asked for a net-income table and the marginal tax rates. The government answered with a table, acknowledged high marginal pressure between roughly 20,000 and 35,000 euro from the phasing out of benefits and allowances, and pointed to the 5-billion package to make work pay.
Phasing out allowances is inherent in a system of targeted income support for low-income households as we know it in the Netherlands.
Het afbouwen van toeslagen is inherent aan een systeem met gerichte inkomensondersteuning voor huishoudens met lage inkomens zoals wij dat in Nederland kennen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dijkgraaf over het aan Brussel voorgelegde gebruiksverbod voor imidacloprid in de glastuinbouw

An SGP MP asked the State Secretary for Economic Affairs why the draft ban on imidacloprid use in greenhouse horticulture, notified to Brussels, had not been shared with Parliament, and challenged its legal basis, its effectiveness and the claimed improvement in surface water concentrations. The State Secretary replied that Parliament had been informed earlier, that the draft was submitted to the Council of State and the EU TRIS notification procedure, that it would be sent to Parliament once adopted, and that entry into force is on hold pending a temporary measure by the Ctgb, without addressing the substance of the legal and water-quality arguments.
If and when this AMvB is adopted and published, your House will receive it.
Indien en wanneer deze AMvB is vastgesteld en gepubliceerd ontvangt uw Kamer deze.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dijkgraaf over de verhoging van de kinderopvangtoeslag

The MP asks the government about the increase in childcare allowance: its budgetary effects, whether it distorts competition with single and one-earner households, and updated welfare comparisons across household types. The minister replies that the effect on labour supply is limited, that the allowance is a subsidy on work, and that the cabinet monitors one-earner household purchasing power closely.
Because the effect is limited, it is not possible to give a quantitative estimate of the extra tax revenue resulting from the increase.
De beperkte omvang van het effect maakt dat het niet mogelijk is om een kwantitatieve schatting te geven hoeveel extra belastinginkomsten als gevolg van de verhoging worden gerealiseerd
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Agnes Mulder, Dijkgraaf, Jasper van Dijk, Bruins, De Roon en Grashoff over de voorlopige toepassing van het vrijhandelsverdrag met Canada (CETA)

MPs asked whether Netherlands had an effective veto over provisional application of the Ukraine association agreement and would have one over provisional application of CETA, and requested legal advice on provisional application. The minister confirmed unanimity applied for the association agreement, said CETA's voting rule depends on the legal basis not yet determined, and stated the government knows of no written legal advice received on provisional application.
Whether decision-making on signature and provisional application of CETA will be by unanimity or qualified majority depends on the legal basis.
Of besluitvorming over ondertekening en voorlopige toepassing van CETA zal geschieden met unanimiteit of gekwalificeerde meerderheid is afhankelijk van de rechtsgrondslag.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dijkgraaf inzake de onderbouwing van landelijke emissiecijfers voor erfafspoeling en riooloverstorten

An SGP MP asked the minister whether the national emission figures for surface runoff from farms and sewage overflows are reliable, since they rest on limited measurements. The minister answered that the farm estimate is based on 19 farms that had already taken measures and that total emissions are probably higher, promised to update the emission factsheet and sewage overflow estimate by the end of 2016, and described measures underway.

I see the measurement-based estimate by Stichting RIONED as a good starting point to work with the Emissieregistratie and the sewer and water managers toward an update of the total national surface water load from overflows.

Ik zie de op meetgegevens gebaseerde inschatting van Stichting RIONED als een goed startpunt om in samenwerking met de Emissieregistratie en de riool- en waterbeheerders tot een actualisatie van de totale nationale belasting van het oppervlaktewater uit overstorten te komen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bruins, Jasper van Dijk, Dijkgraaf, Grashoff, De Roon, Jan Vos en Agnes Mulder over de voorlopige inwerkingtreding van het handelsakkoord tussen de EU en Canada (CETA)

Seven MPs asked the trade minister whether the Commission's plan to provisionally apply the EU-Canada CETA would be put to parliament, how the parliamentary reservation demanded by an earlier motion would be implemented, and whether CETA will be a mixed agreement. The minister answered that the Commissioner's commitment to consult the European Parliament is noted, that the government will formally register a parliamentary reservation in the Council once a proposal is tabled and inform the Tweede Kamer promptly, and that which parts would apply provisionally is not yet known.

If the Commission has submitted a proposal for a Council decision on signature and provisional application, the cabinet will formally implement the motion by stating in the Council that the Netherlands cannot agree to the proposal before it has been discussed with the House of Representatives.

Als de Commissie een voorstel heeft gedaan voor een Raadsbesluit voor ondertekening en voorlopige toepassing, zal het kabinet formeel uitvoering geven aan de motie door in de Raad kenbaar te maken dat Nederland niet kan instemmen met het voorstel voordat het voorstel is besproken met de Tweede Kamer.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Laar, Jasper van Dijk, Van Veldhoven, Voordewind, Grashoff, Dijkgraaf, Thieme over het gebrek aan bescherming van Syrische kinderen

MPs from several parties asked the ministers about the lack of protection for Syrian children, including the petition and reports by UNICEF, Save the Children, War Child and World Vision, and what the Netherlands does on education, psychosocial aid and school protection. The minister answered that Dutch funding for education and psychosocial support in Syria and neighbouring countries is ongoing, that it supports the call to honour pledges, and that it will raise school protection and MHPSS at the EU and World Humanitarian Summit, but gave few figures on outcomes and no new binding commitments.
The Netherlands is working within international frameworks to ensure that the pledges are also honoured.
Nederland zet zich in internationaal verband in om ervoor te zorgen dat de toezeggingen ook worden nagekomen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dijkgraaf met betrekking tot de regeling voor jonge landbouwers

An MP from the SGP asked the State Secretary for Economic Affairs whether the model scheme and investment list for the young farmers subsidy (under the third rural development programme) are built so that farmers who took over a farm struggle to use it, and whether the scheme should be adjusted. The State Secretary rejected that reading, explained that the scheme is open to all farmers under 41 and that the EU age definition is the cause of complaints, and said adjustments are for the provinces to consider.
It is up to the provinces to consider adjusting the scheme or reopening it.
Het is aan de provincies om aanpassing van de regeling danwel hernieuwde openstelling te overwegen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Visser, Dijkgraaf en Geurts over de controle op de aanlandplicht

MPs Visser, Dijkgraaf and Geurts asked the State Secretary for Economic Affairs about a confrontation between Dutch North Sea fishers and German inspectors over the landing obligation and reported widespread ignorance among inspectors. The State Secretary replied that German protocols matched EU rules, that Germany acted quickly, and that harmonisation of enforcement across North Sea states is ongoing but slow.
I have asked the other North Sea member states to share their inspection instructions more widely with one another.
Ik heb de andere lidstaten rondom de Noordzee verzocht om de controle-instructies breder met elkaar te delen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dijkgraaf over de uitwerking van de dienstverleningsovereenkomst-vrijstelling

An MP asked the State Secretary of Finance how the DVO exemption (for service agreements between public bodies) is applied, including whether the competition criterion must be tested and how it applies to a municipal enforcement officer (BOA) working under an inter-municipal service agreement. The State Secretary said the exemption is applied as intended, that it does not cover activities a municipality could outsource to the market, and that the exemption is not a dead letter.
I see no reason to amend the statutory text on this point, since this would not materially change anything for stakeholders or for implementation.
Ik zie geen aanleiding om de wettekst op dit punt alsnog aan te passen, aangezien dit materieel niet tot een wijziging leidt voor belanghebbenden en voor de uitvoering.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bisschop en Dijkgraaf over de gevolgen van het Besluit huisvesting

MPs Bisschop and Dijkgraaf asked why small extensions of traditional barns were not exempted from the new emission requirements in the final Besluit huisvesting, and whether the government will consult the sector on exempting them. The State Secretary confirmed the change from the draft was made after consultation, explained that traditional barns cannot use the alternative, and promised to check the reported problems with the sector and consider adjusting the technical requirements in the leaflets.
I will consult with the sector to see whether they have proposals for amending these leaflets
Ik zal in overleg met de sector na gaan of zij wijzigingsvoorstellen hebben voor deze leaflets
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dijkgraaf over aanscherping van mestregels van GlobalGap

An MP asked the State Secretary of Economic Affairs whether GlobalGap's plan to restrict use of untreated animal manure would substantially raise costs for (organic) arable farmers, conflict with agricultural and manure policy, and whether the ministry would intervene and how competition law applies. The government answered that the measure is a market-initiated food safety precaution, that the ministry has no seat or advisory role in the platform, that the platform should address the issue, and that the ACM can act on abuse of market power.
The Ministry of Economic Affairs has no seat here and also no advisory role.
Het Ministerie van Economische Zaken heeft hier geen zitting en heeft ook geen adviserende rol.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dijkgraaf en Geurts over een juridische analyse van de visie van de Autoriteit Consument en Markt (ACM) op de Kip van Morgen

MPs Dijkgraaf and Geurts asked whether an informal ACM view on the Kip van Morgen chicken-welfare agreement should meet motivation duties, whether public interests like sustainability and animal welfare are weighed, and how competition rules and the Wouters doctrine apply. The minister answered that the ACM must motivate informal views but at a lower bar, that public interests are considered, and promised a revised sustainability policy rule by year end and follow-up with the European Commission.
An informal view is a provisional judgment and does not bind the ACM or the undertakings involved.
Een informele zienswijze is een voorlopig oordeel en bindt de ACM en de betrokken ondernemingen niet.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dijkgraaf over berichtgeving dat de Landmacht snijdt in het budget voor reservisten

An MP asked whether the Army would sharply cut the reservist budget, what operational effects this has, and about drone, tank and EOD problems. The Minister said reservist use grew faster than expected, so the Army took a temporary measure to limit extra activities to the end of 2015, mainly ceremonial and public-facing ones, while protecting readiness and missions.
To prevent this, the CLAS has taken a temporary management measure to moderate the growing deployment of reservists.
Om dat te voorkomen heeft het CLAS een tijdelijke beheersmaatregel genomen om de groeiende inzet van reservisten te temperen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Geurts, Lodders en Dijkgraaf over het openbaar maken van meetdata ammoniak door Wageningen Universiteit

MPs Geurts, Lodders and Dijkgraaf asked the state secretary whether Wageningen University should publish its ammonia measurement data and calculation methods behind manure emission factors, citing an international review's call for free data availability. The state secretary said the research was published and reviewed, that Wageningen UR is willing to share underlying data and show calculations to critics, and that older data from the 1990s no longer exists under the five-year retention rule, and declined to request further disclosure.

Since 1 January 2005 it has been customary to retain research data for 5 years, in accordance with the rules of the Dutch Code of Conduct for Research Integrity of the Association of Universities (VSNU).

Het is sinds 1 januari 2005 gebruikelijk om onderzoeksgegevens 5 jaar te bewaren, conform de hiervoor geldende regels vanuit de Nederlandse Gedragscode Wetenschapsbeoefening van de Vereniging van Universiteiten (VSNU).
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dijkgraaf en Ulenbelt over het feit dat Inretail een principeakkoord fashion en sport heeft gesloten met Alternatief voor vakbond

MPs Dijkgraaf and Ulenbelt asked whether a collective agreement between Inretail and the small union Alternatief voor vakbond could set terms for most workers in the sector, how extension (avv) is assessed, and how disproportionate effects can be prevented. The minister answered that such agreements bind non-members only indirectly, that membership numbers play little role in representativeness, that extension is discretionary and can be refused, and that the government does not decide which unions should sign.
In principle it is not for the Minister to "intervene" in collective agreements or to have a view on their content.
Het is in principe niet aan de Minister om «in te grijpen» in cao’s of om een oordeel te hebben over de inhoud daarvan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dijkgraaf over de btw op verkoop van grond

An SGP MP asked whether VAT is avoided when municipal development costs for streets and green space are charged directly to buyers, and whether a general arrangement between the tax authority, municipalities and developers exists or can be initiated. The State Secretary of Finance answered that the Wro obliges municipalities to recover these costs, that costs charged as exploitation contributions are VAT-free, that no general arrangement exists, and that he would facilitate clarity if VNG or the developers' association asks.

If the VNG and/or the Association of Dutch Project Development Companies raises this with me because they wish to obtain clarity on these situations, I am of course willing to promote that this clarity is provided.

Indien de VNG en/of de Vereniging van Nederlandse Projektontwikkeling Maatschappijen dit bij mij aankaart omdat men over deze situaties duidelijkheid wenst te verkrijgen, ben ik uiteraard graag bereid te bevorderen dat deze duidelijkheid wordt gegeven.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bisschop en Dijkgraaf over het bericht dat de minister van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties tijdens het Nederlandse EU-voorzitterschap in wil zetten op stedelijke ontwikkeling ten

MPs Bisschop and Dijkgraaf asked whether the Minister of Interior intends to shift CAP funds toward urban development during the Dutch EU presidency, and questioned the claims about urban green areas and regulation. The minister denied any plan to move CAP budget, pointed to existing EU urban funds (EFRO, ESF) and a planned European Urban Agenda, and did not commit to reconsidering.
The intention is not to take decisions during the Dutch presidency on shifting CAP or other European fund budgets to urban development.
De inzet is niet om tijdens het Nederlands voorzitterschap besluiten te nemen over het verschuiven van budget van het GLB of andere Europese fondsen naar stedelijke ontwikkeling.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Staaij en Dijkgraaf over verminderde douanecontrole, beveiliging en patrouilles op de Waddenzee en op de Westerschelde

Two SGP MPs asked whether reduced customs, marechaussee and police patrols on the Wadden Sea and Western Scheldt weaken interdiction of drugs and smuggling, and whether RHIB boats and port checks are adequate. The government replied that patrols are not being halted but shifted to intelligence-led, faster-response boats, that port controls continue 24/7, and that it sees no need for continuous patrols; it did not register controls or tips in a way that allows measuring their results.
This is not correct. Checks continue unchanged in the Zeeland ports of Terneuzen and Vlissingen.
Dit is niet juist. In de Zeeuwse havens Terneuzen en Vlissingen vinden onverminderd controles plaats.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dijkgraaf over de toepassing van resolutie BTW-283

Dijkgraaf (SGP) asked whether VAT entrepreneurship is a requirement under resolution BTW-283, whether the MFS II funding change justifies narrowing its scope, and whether it should be extended to MFS 1 and 2 subsidies for development organisations. Wiebes answered that entrepreneurship is a condition assessed under the Wet op de omzetbelasting, that the resolution will be clarified but not restricted, and that extending it to all MFS II recipients is not possible on VAT grounds.
The resolution will shortly be updated and clarified but not restricted.
De resolutie wordt binnenkort geactualiseerd en verduidelijkt maar niet beperkt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dijkgraaf over de uitspraak van de Raad van State over beweiding en bemesting in het kader van de Natuurbeschermingswet

MP Dijkgraaf asked whether the Council of State ruling on grazing and manure application under the Nature Conservation Act means these must be assessed per parcel for nitrogen deposition, what consequences this has for existing permits, the Programmatic Approach Nitrogen and encouraging grazing. The Secretary of State answered that a permit may be required near nitrogen-sensitive Natura 2000 areas unless existing use can be shown, that provincial executives must judge existing use, that per-parcel deposition calculations cannot be excluded, and referred to a separate letter on the exemption.
The provincial executives of the province concerned are the competent authority for the permit under the Nbw and will have to assess whether in the specific case there is existing use.
Gedeputeerde staten van de betrokken provincie zijn bevoegd gezag voor de vergunning op grond van de Nbw en zullen moeten beoordelen of in het concrete geval sprake is van «bestaand gebruik».
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dijkgraaf over de toepassing van resolutie BTW-283

An MP asked the State Secretary of Finance about the application of resolution BTW-283, which gives zero-rated VAT treatment to Dutch development NGOs carrying out services for the Ministry of Foreign Affairs, and whether MFS-funded projects qualify. The State Secretary explained the conditions for the zero rate and that MFS subsidies must be assessed case by case, and said the EU VAT Directive does not allow refunds to non-entrepreneurs, but made no commitment to change the rules.
Whether that is the case depends in part on the circumstances (such as the conditions) under which the subsidy is provided.
Of dat zo is, is mede afhankelijk van de omstandigheden (zoals de voorwaarden) waaronder de subsidie wordt verstrekt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt, Van Bommel, Segers, Dijkgraaf en Thieme over het wachtgeld voor de voorzitter van de Europese Raad

Five MPs asked the Finance and Foreign Affairs ministers about the EU transitional allowance (wachtgeld) for the outgoing President of the European Council, who had already reached pensionable age and could draw his Belgian pension alongside it, and about pension accrual rates and job-seeking obligations. The minister confirmed the facts, said the EU rules (Regulation 422/67/EEG) cap the allowance at three years with no job-seeking duty, and said the Netherlands is willing to examine modernising and reducing the scheme, though any change requires Council action.
The Netherlands is willing to examine whether modernising and reducing the current scheme for political office holders in the EU is possible
Nederland is bereid te bekijken of modernisering en versobering van de huidige regeling voor politieke ambtsdragers in de EU mogelijk is
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Rudmer Heerema over de aangepaste begrenzing van Natura 2000-gebieden na uitspraken van de Raad van State

MPs Heerema and Dijkgraaf asked why certain land was left out of two Natura 2000 area boundaries and whether the Council of State rulings will lead to more boundary changes. The State Secretary answered that the land was excluded for lack of present Natura 2000 values or proven necessity, that no other annulments on this ground are known, and that a limited number of further boundary changes may follow rulings expected in 2015.
Yes, this is possible due to a limited number of Council of State rulings expected during 2015.
Ja, dit is mogelijk door een beperkt aantal uitspraken van de Raad van State, die in de loop van 2015 te verwachten zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dijkgraaf over storingen bij de Belastingdienst

An MP asked the State Secretary of Finance about repeated outages on the Belastingdienst website and whether they were resolved, how the BelastingTelefoon was affected, whether late filings and payments would be penalised, and whether a paper VAT return could be offered during outages. The State Secretary answered that outages stemmed from a platform migration, that late filing and payment during outages would not be penalised under existing coulance rules, and that a paper VAT return would not be reintroduced because of workload and administrative burden.
This standard coulance provided sufficient accommodation for this outage.
Deze standaardcoulance bood voor deze storing voldoende tegemoetkoming.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dijkgraaf over belastingvrij schenken in 2015

An MP asked the ministers whether the temporary increased gift-tax exemption for home purchase or renovation in 2014 could still be used via a 'Groninger akte' (deferred-payment deed) in 2015, and whether the rules required a house to be owned at the time of the gift. The government answered that the exemption requires the recipient to already own the home in 2014, that spending may extend to 2016 for renovations, and that a Groninger akte does not change the regular conditions.
The temporarily increased exemption for maintenance or improvement can only be used if the recipient of the gift already owns the home in 2014.
Er kan alleen gebruik worden gemaakt van de tijdelijk verruimde vrijstelling voor onderhoud of verbetering indien de begunstigde van de schenking de eigen woning al in 2014 heeft.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dijkgraaf over de interpretatie van de Habitatrichtlijn

An SGP MP asked the State Secretary of Economic Affairs whether the Sweetman and Briels rulings of the EU Court of Justice imply a distinction between qualifying and non-qualifying habitat types and species when applying Article 6(3) of the Habitats Directive, and how Dutch rules reflect this. The State Secretary answered that the rulings do not support such a distinction, since they address only the permanent loss of qualifying or priority habitats and do not address non-qualifying ones.
No conclusion can be drawn from the rulings that, in applying Article 6(3) of the Habitats Directive, a distinction is made between qualifying habitat types and species and non-qualifying ones.

Uit de arresten kan niet de conclusie worden getrokken dat bij de toepassing van artikel 6, derde lid, habitatrichtlijn onderscheid wordt gemaakt tussen kwalificerende habitattypen en soorten en niet-kwalificerende habitattypen en soorten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dijkgraaf over modernisering van de liquidatieverliesregeling

MP Dijkgraaf (SGP) asked whether the liquidation loss scheme for subsidiaries should be modernised, including relaxing the non-continuation requirement, pro-rata treatment, loss recognition without liquidation and the share-price-based calculation. State Secretary Wiebes answered that the scheme is deliberately robust to prevent abuse and double loss relief, and saw no reason to revise it.
I therefore see insufficient reason to revise the current liquidation loss scheme on this point.
Ik zie dan ook onvoldoende aanleiding de huidige liquidatieverliesregeling op dit punt te herzien.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dijkgraaf over antisemitische incidenten in Nederland

An MP asked the ministers about the rise in antisemitic incidents in 2013 (147 vs 114 in 2012), measures against online antisemitism, and whether the government would investigate perceptions of Israel. The minister called the figures worrying, outlined round-table and education initiatives, said research on perceptions of Israel would not be commissioned, and committed to further meetings and reviews.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Lodders en Dijkgraaf over het bericht ‘Alleen ruimen bij risico voor volksgezondheid’

MPs Lodders (VVD) and Dijkgraaf (SGP) asked whether the NVWA failed to inform veterinarians directly about the furazolidon contamination incident and how farmers and industry bodies were informed, and whether the substance is freely available. The State Secretary replied that SMS alerts, the NVWA website, a beschikking to affected farmers and three information meetings with industry bodies were used, and that furazolidon is not available everywhere.
These remarks are taken into account by the NVWA in the evaluation of this furazolidon incident.
Deze opmerkingen worden door de NVWA meegenomen bij de evaluatie van dit incident met furazolidon.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dijkgraaf en Bisschop over de toegang van ge-moedsbezwaarden tot Nationale Hypotheek Garantie (NHG)

SGP MPs asked whether conscientious objectors recognised by a court, who refuse life-insurance coverage, can obtain a maximum NHG-guaranteed mortgage, and whether a 100% financing model backed by a buy-out amount, or separate case assessment, could be considered. The minister answered that NHG can be granted without life insurance if the bank demonstrably bears the mortgage-death risk, that this is the lender's choice, and that the fund's structure rules out a motor-insurance-style model or case-by-case assessment.
It is up to the lender to assess whether it is willing to do so in such cases.
Het is aan de geldverstrekker te beoordelen of zij hiertoe in voorkomende gevallen bereid is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dijkgraaf over het bezorgen van pakketten op zondag door PostNL

An MP asked the Minister of Economic Affairs whether PostNL's plan to deliver parcels on Sundays, which could erode the Sunday rest and bring a Sunday Act or shop-hours law into play, is lawful and what protections exist for workers and municipalities. The minister answered that the government sees no need for new rules, that the Shop Hours Act does not cover parcel delivery, that courts would decide any Sunday Act breach, and that workers' right to refuse Sunday work is protected.
No, as indicated in the answer to question 2, living and working patterns can change, as can consumer preferences.
Nee, zoals aangegeven in het antwoord op vraag 2 kunnen leef- en arbeidspatronen wijzigen, evenals consumentenvoorkeuren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Voordewind en Segers, Dijkgraaf, Van Bommel en De Roon over het bericht ‘Verboden vlag overschaduwt Veteranendag’

MPs from several parties asked whether veterans were barred from carrying the Morgenster flag at the National Veterans Day parade because of sensitivities with Indonesia, and whether the government had raised the matter with Indonesian authorities. The minister replied that the organising committee decided in 2013 to allow only regimental flags at the formal parade, a rule agreed with veterans' associations and not a ban, that Indonesia had objected in past years without the committee being pressured, and that the decision is the committee's responsibility.
The committee discussed this with the veterans' associations and they agreed to it.
