Het comité heeft dit met de veteranenverenigingen besproken en zij hebben hiermee ingestemd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bisschop en Dijkgraaf over het plan van het platform Bewust moslim om op de dag van dodenherdenking een symposium te houden over een zogenoemde schaduw Holocaust

MPs Bisschop and Dijkgraaf asked whether the government would try to stop a planned symposium on a so-called 'shadow Holocaust' and what powers the municipality had to prevent it. The Minister replied that the municipality and mosque cancelled the event, that ministers do not intervene in municipal matters or judge organisers' views, and that mayors may act only on public order grounds, not on the content of the meeting.
It is not for me as Minister to intervene in municipal affairs, nor is it for me to judge the views of people organising a meeting such as the questioners describe.

Het is niet aan mij als Minister om in gemeentelijke aangelegenheden te treden noch is het aan mij om de opvattingen te beoordelen van mensen die een bijeenkomst organiseren als door de vragenstellers bedoeld.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dijkgraaf, Lodders en Geurts over het rapport van Watermaatschappij Limburg over mogelijke overschatting van nitraatgehaltes in lössgrond

Three MPs asked the State Secretary about a Watermaatschappij Limburg report suggesting nitrate levels in loess soil may be overestimated by about 30% compared with RIVM's method, and whether this affects loess-soil use standards and EU reporting. The State Secretary answered that the report rests on a very small dataset, that the nationwide monitoring network (LMM) and model calculations still show concentrations above the 50 mg/l target, that WML and RIVM will discuss the methodology, and that a pilot with equivalent measures in loess areas is viewed positively.
RIVM and WML will soon enter into discussion about the methodology of nitrate measurements.
RIVM en WML gaan op korte termijn in gesprek over de methodiek van nitraatmetingen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt, Segers en Dijkgraaf over het rapport “The European Union Integrity System” van Transparency International

MPs Omtzigt, Segers and Dijkgraaf asked whether the government would act on Transparency International's report on EU integrity gaps (openness and corruption) and its 12 recommendations, whether it would raise the report at the European Council, and who should check EU institutions on rule of law. The minister said the government supports follow-up on transparency and anti-corruption measures in Council and EU fora, but declined to put the report on the European Council agenda, and stated the EU's rule-of-law oversight is shared with member states.
The cabinet attaches importance to the greatest possible transparency regarding European legislative and decision-making processes.
Het kabinet hecht aan een zo groot mogelijke transparantie ten aanzien van Europese wetgevings- en besluitvormingsprocessen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dijkgraaf over de advisering door de Technische Commissie Bodem

MP Dijkgraaf (SGP) asked whether the Technical Commission Soil Protection (TCB) may legally consider ammonia emissions when advising on a research exemption for surface spreading of manure, arguing its advice should be limited to soil protection. The state secretary answered that the law does not restrict TCB advice to soil protection, that ammonia effects fall within its remit, and that the government will weigh but not be bound by TCB advice.
In the final decision that the State Secretary for Infrastructure and the Environment and I take, the views of the TCB are weighed, but we make our own assessment.
In het uiteindelijke besluit dat de Staatssecretaris van Infrastructuur en Milieu en ik nemen, wegen de opvattingen van de TCB mee, maar wij maken onze eigen afweging.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dijkgraaf over de onhoudbaarheid van Joods leven in Europa

An MP from the SGP asked the Minister of Foreign Affairs about reports on rising antisemitism in Europe, Jewish fear of displaying identity, and what the government would do at European level. The minister answered that antisemitism is unacceptable and concerning, distinguished the EJC and FRA reports, declined to confirm some claims, and pointed to existing human rights policy without committing to a new concrete step.
Freedom of religion and belief is one of the priorities of the Dutch human rights policy.
Vrijheid van godsdienst en levensovertuiging is één van de prioriteiten van het Nederlandse mensenrechtenbeleid.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dijkgraaf over de bezuinigingen door de NAVO op radarvliegtuigen (AWACS; Geilenkirchen)

An SGP MP asked the Defence Minister whether NATO cuts to AWACS radar aircraft at Geilenkirchen weaken Western intelligence capacity, what consequences this has for Dutch airspace, Limburg employment and training noise, and what further NATO cuts are planned. The minister answered that the cuts follow from the AGS programme and Canada's withdrawal from AWACS funding, that SACEUR judged fourteen aircraft a prudent capability, that Dutch airspace management is unaffected, and that employment effects are not yet known.
The employment effects for the province of Limburg are not yet known at this time, because it is not yet definitively determined which posts will be eliminated and which staff will become surplus.
De werkgelegenheidseffecten voor de provincie Limburg zijn op dit moment nog niet bekend, omdat nog niet definitief vaststaat welke functies vervallen en welke medewerkers hierdoor overtollig worden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dijkgraaf over de aangekondigde evaluatie van de helikopterlaagvlieggebieden

An MP asked the Defence Minister about the timeline for a 2014 evaluation of helicopter low-flying areas, involvement of the local liaison group, noise complaints, simulator use and damage claims. The minister said a new evaluation will be carried out this year taking account of a pending court case, that communication with residents is being improved, and that complaint and damage-claim figures and handling are presented.
As announced when the previous evaluation was presented, a follow-up evaluation will be carried out this year.
Zoals aangekondigd bij de aanbieding van de vorige evaluatie zal dit jaar een volgende evaluatie worden uitgevoerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het de leden Bisschop en Dijkgraaf over het storten van staalslakken in de Oosterschelde

Two SGP MPs asked whether Rijkswaterstaat should cover steel slag dumped in the Oosterschelde with rubble to protect the Oosterschelde lobster and benthic life, and whether it will do so. The minister acknowledged the species' value, said consultation with lobster fishers and a provincial permit are in place, and offered an ecological finish on a test section and a joint exploration for the next cluster, but did not commit to rubble cover.

Besides the test section with ecological finishing being dumped in the second cluster, I will explore with the parties involved and the market what options exist within the current financial frameworks

Naast het testvak met de ecologische afwerking dat in het tweede cluster wordt bestort, zal ik samen met de betrokken partijen en de markt verkennen welke mogelijkheden er binnen de huidige financiële kaders zijn
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dijkgraaf over de openstelling van de markt voor het ophalen en verwerken van kadavers

MP Dijkgraaf (SGP) asked whether the Dutch rules allow more than one firm to enter the market for collecting and processing animal carcasses, whether competition would improve prices, and whether the minister would talk to interested parties. The State Secretary answered yes on the legal room for multiple regional operators, agreed in general that competition may help but noted it is not guaranteed and that the current system is efficient, and said she is willing to talk with interested parties.
I am happy to enter into discussion with parties that are interested in joining.
Ik ga graag in gesprek met partijen die belangstelling hebben om toe te treden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Segers en Voordewind en Dijkgraaf over de uitspraken van de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over het EU-lidmaatschap voor Turkije

MPs Segers, Voordewind and Dijkgraaf asked whether the Foreign Minister's remark that the Netherlands would welcome Turkey as an EU member was premature, given Turkey's rule-of-law shortcomings, the Cyprus blockade of chapters 23 and 24, and recognition of the Armenian genocide. The minister answered that accession talks are open-ended and conditional on meeting strict criteria, acknowledged serious shortcomings on press freedom and rule of law, and said concerns were raised in Ankara, while recognition of the genocide is not an accession criterion.
The cabinet particularly emphasised its concerns about press freedom and freedom of expression.
Het kabinet benadrukte in het bijzonder de zorgen over persvrijheid en vrijheid van meningsuiting.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dijkgraaf over de ecotopenkaarten van de Westerschelde

An MP asked the state secretary about changes in the ecotope areas of the Western Scheldt estuary since its Natura 2000 designation, and whether this matches the claimed decline used to justify polder restoration. The government corrected the maps for an error involving Flemish territory, said the area of low-dynamic intertidal habitat shows no structural positive trend, and maintained that the Natuurpakket Westerschelde is still needed to halt deterioration.
Hereby you receive the corrected maps and also an overview table with the correct figures.
Hierbij ontvangt u de gecorrigeerde kaarten en tevens een overzichtstabel met de juiste cijfers.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dijkgraaf en Lodders over het uitrijden van drijfmest op grasland

MPs Dijkgraaf and Lodders asked why manure spreading on grassland is allowed only from 15 February while arable land may be fertilised from 1 February, and whether earlier grassland application would benefit the environment and grass growth. The State Secretary defended the later grassland date on water-quality and leaching grounds, noting the uncertain agronomic benefit, and declined to bring the date forward.
Given the uncertain agronomic benefit attached to this, I therefore consider bringing forward the spreading period on grassland not justified.
Mede gezien het onzekere landbouwkundige voordeel dat daaraan is verbonden, acht ik daarom een vervroeging van de uitrijperiode op grasland niet verantwoord.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Gesthuizen en Dijkgraaf over de toename van het aantal winkelopenstellingen op Eerste Kerstdag

MPs Gesthuizen and Dijkgraaf asked the Minister of Economic Affairs about the rise in shop openings on Christmas Day and the protection of workers and small shopkeepers, and whether municipalities need a separate exemption with a draagvlak study. The minister replied that municipalities must weigh interests under the Algemene wet bestuursrecht, that workers can invoke existing laws and cao rules, and that enforcement against unlawful openings is a municipal responsibility, with no specific requirements for a support survey.
I do not have an overview of how the various municipalities give substance to this.
Ik heb geen overzicht over hoe de verschillende gemeenten hier invulling aan geven.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dijkgraaf over de afname van mineralengehaltes in gras door het mestbeleid

An SGP MP asked the State Secretary for Economic Affairs whether tighter manure-application standards have reduced mineral and protein content in grass, forcing dairy farmers to buy mineral supplements, and whether the Netherlands should press the European Commission for more room for circular farming. The State Secretary acknowledged the analysis but rejected the claim that circular farming is viable on dairy farms, citing environmental goals, and offered manure processing support as the remedy.
I welcome initiatives that lead to a larger share of the animal manure produced being put to useful application within Dutch agriculture.
Ik juich initiatieven toe die er toe leiden dat een groter deel van de geproduceerde dierlijke mest binnen de Nederlandse landbouw een nuttige toepassing vindt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dijkgraaf over verspilling van belastinggeld t.b.v. het oppoetsen van het imago van de EU

An MP asked the Foreign Minister why the EU is spending about 7 million euros extra on boosting its public image and whether this is a good use of tax money during the financial crisis. The minister answered that the campaign is a European Parliament information drive for the 2014 elections, that the government supports informing voters and a sober EU budget, but that setting communication priorities is for the Parliament itself.
The cabinet favours a frugal and efficient EU budget and, as is known, takes a critical stance on the level of administrative spending of the European institutions.
Het kabinet is voorstander van een sobere en efficiënte EU-begroting en neemt zoals bekend een kritische houding aan over de hoogte van de administratieve uitgaven van de Europese instellingen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Lodders, Geurts en Dijkgraaf over de Nederlandse inzet inzake het vijfde actieprogramma Nitraatrichtlijn

Dutch MPs from VVD, CDA and SGP asked the state secretaries about the Dutch negotiating position on the fifth Nitrates Directive action programme, including the 50 mg nitrate standard, phosphate norms, the derogation and the lack of sector support. The government answered that the 50 mg standard is a binding target Netherlands committed to, that equivalent measures are being developed with LTO, and that it will press the Commission on monitoring results and the derogation.

I am in consultation with LTO on a number of these measures, with a view to having the required justification and assurance in place before the nitrogen use standards for leaching-sensitive crops in the southern sand and loess region are lowered on 1 January 2015.

Ik ben met LTO in overleg over een aantal van deze maatregelen met het oog op het beschikbaar hebben van de vereiste onderbouwing en borging voordat op 1 januari 2015 de stikstofgebruiksnormen voor uitspoelingsgevoelige gewassen in het zuidelijke zand- en lössgebied worden verlaagd.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Dijkgraaf over de snelle opslibbing in de Hedwigepolder, de consequenties hiervan en de kostenverdeling met het Vlaams Gewest

An SGP MP asked the State Secretary for Economic Affairs about rapid silting of the Hedwigepolder after de-poldering, whether high salt marshes would replace the desired low dynamic intertidal area, the consequences for Natura 2000 targets, and Flemish cost-sharing. The State Secretary answered that the project creates estuarine habitats that expand the Natura 2000 target area, that monitoring will determine whether additional measures are needed, and referred to the treaty for Flemish financial obligations.
The financial obligations of the Flemish Region are laid down in the Treaty on the implementation of the Ontwikkelingsschets 2010.
De financiële verplichtingen van het Vlaams Gewest zijn vastgelegd in het Verdrag betreffende de uitvoering van de Ontwikkelingsschets 2010.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dijkgraaf over "kinderopvangtoeslag".

An SGP MP asked the Minister of Social Affairs why childcare allowance is tied only to the least-working partner's hours, why a court ruling distinguishing childcare from playgroup care was set aside, and how municipalities may redirect playgroup care into registered daycare to make parents eligible. The minister replied that the hours link adequately ensures the allowance supports work-care combination, that playgroup and childcare are distinct and municipalities bear responsibility for their policy, and that financing of playgroups will be moved under the Childcare Act with a letter to parliament in autumn.
I will inform your House about this in the autumn and hope thereby to answer your questions sufficiently.
Ik zal uw Kamer hierover in het najaar informeren en hoop daarmee uw vragen in voldoende mate te beantwoorden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dijkgraaf over "kinderopvangtoeslag"

An SGP MP asks the minister why childcare allowance can be paid for peuterspeelzaal-type care delivered in a registered daycare centre, despite a court ruling and the law's intent, and whether this weakens the standalone peuterspeelzaal. The minister replies that eligibility rests on registration and on the hours worked by the least-working parent, that the law's scope is unchanged, that municipalities are responsible for peuterspeelzalen, and that no change to the legal distinction was made.
I have no data on the extent of this specific form of organisation.
Over de omvang van deze specifieke vormgeving zijn mij geen gegevens bekend.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dijkgraaf over de toepassing van artikel 6 van de Habitatrichtlijn

An MP from the SGP asked the state secretary for Economic Affairs how Article 6 of the Habitats Directive should be applied, including whether Dutch practice wrongly equates 'natural characteristics' with site conservation objectives and whether non-qualifying bird species are covered. The state secretary answered that the two are not equated, that the case law on 'natural characteristics' is still developing, that Article 6 covers all species for which a site is designated, and that the local conservation status plays an important role.
The assumption that the 'natural characteristics' of an area and the conservation objectives formulated for that area are equated in the Netherlands is not correct.
De veronderstelling dat de «natuurlijke kenmerken» van een gebied en de voor dat gebied geformuleerde instandhoudingsdoelstellingen in Nederland aan elkaar gelijk worden gesteld is niet juist.
Antwoord vragen Dijkgraaf over de monitoring in het kader van Natura 2000

MP Dijkgraaf asked the state secretary about monitoring of habitat types and species under the Natura 2000 directives, including baseline data, Noordse woelmuis observations, and free access to the national fauna and flora database. The state secretary answered that monitoring is already adequate via national networks and area plans, refused to send historical data and declined free access for stakeholders, while committing to map updates and a legal anchoring of article 11 in the Wetsvoorstel natuurbescherming.
The government will not reimburse this for stakeholders.
De overheid zal dit niet voor belanghebbenden vergoeden.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Dijkgraaf over "kinderopvangtoeslag".

MP Dijkgraaf (SGP) asks the Social Affairs minister whether childcare allowance has been extended to peuterspeelzaal users through the December 2012 letter, whether the Tax Authority received guidance, and how this fits the Wet OKE and the court ruling in Middelburg. The minister denies any extension, says the allowance is still excluded for peuterspeelzalen, defends the minor-partner hours criterion, and promises to inform the Chamber before summer on financing plans.
Care in peuterspeelzalen does not give entitlement to childcare allowance.
Opvang in peuterspeelzalen geeft geen recht op kinderopvangtoeslag.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Dijkgraaf en Litjens over de Natura 2000-gebieden Nieuwkoopse Plassen & De Haeck en Binnenveld

MPs Dijkgraaf and Litjens asked whether the Natura 2000 conservation targets for Nieuwkoopse Plassen & De Haeck and Binnenveld should be changed to preservation targets given nitrogen problems, whether designation should wait for the PAS and local support, and what the provinces' advice is. The State Secretary refused to change the expansion targets, will not designate either area before summer, and noted that the regional governments want to take over the Binnenveld management plan.
Pursuant to the Geurts et al. motion, I will not designate the Nieuwkoopse Plassen & De Haeck area before the summer.
Het gebied Nieuwkoopse Plassen & De Haeck zal ik, ter uitvoering van de motie Geurts c.s. (Kamerstuk 33 037, nr. 62 ), niet voor de zomer aanwijzen.
Antwoord vragen Dijkgraaf over de column op www.boerenbusiness.nl dat Deutsche Bank in strijd handelt met de zorgplicht

MP Dijkgraaf asked whether Deutsche Bank breaches its duty of care by terminating credit agreements with about 18,000 clients and enforcing high break fees, and whether DNB and the AFM should intervene. Minister Dijsselbloem answered that the courts, not he or the supervisors, must judge civil-law duties, that the bank's strategy change is its own business decision, and that the bank has promised to find individual solutions.
On your questions concerning alleged violation of civil-law norms, I cannot give an answer.
Op uw vragen die betrekking hebben op vermeende schending van civielrechtelijke normen, kan ik geen antwoord geven.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dijkgraaf over de gevolgen van de overname van Deutsche Bank voor diverse klantengroepen

An MP asks the Finance and Economic Affairs ministers about Deutsche Bank Nederland dropping 18,000 clients, whether boetevrij exit should be allowed, what tools the government and DNB have, and whether the 2007 ABN Amro/HBU sale was flawed. The minister answers that the bank's strategic and contractual decisions are its own, that case-by-case solutions are expected, and that he will press the bank in a meeting.
It is not for me to directly intervene in the strategic decision of an individual bank or in the contractual relationship between a bank and its customers.
Het is niet aan mij om rechtstreeks in te grijpen in de strategische beslissing van een individuele bank of in de contractuele relatie tussen een bank en haar klanten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Hijum, Schouw, Segers, Leijten, Klaver, Tony van Dijck, Dijkgraaf, Ouwehand en Klein over het bericht “VNG wil overleg kabinet over bezuinigingen”

MPs asked whether the government would commission research, with the VNG, into whether the decentralisations and cumulative efficiency cuts are feasible for municipalities, and how risks and cumulative effects on vulnerable groups are monitored. The minister declined a separate CPB study for now, pointed to monitoring commitments and a motion-based independent study to be scoped with the VNG, and said the minister of Social Affairs would map cumulative effects.
Your House has since, in a motion by MP Schouw, asked the government to have an independent party investigate the financial and implementation risks of the decentralisations.

Uw Kamer heeft inmiddels in een motie van het lid Schouw aan de regering verzocht door een onafhankelijke partij een onderzoek te laten doen naar de financiële risico's en uitvoeringsrisico's van de decentralisaties
Antwoord vragen van het lid Dijkgraaf over de samenloop van de crisisheffing en de levensloopregeling

MP Dijkgraaf asked whether the extended crisis levy on high incomes clashes with the favourable 2013 life-course scheme, which raises employers' extra costs when employees withdraw their savings in one lump sum, and whether the one-off withdrawal could be exempted. Staatssecretaris Weekers answered that he shares the concern, will provide in the bill that wages from a full 2013 withdrawal under the 80% scheme do not count toward the crisis levy base.

When drafting the extension of the pseudo-final levy on high wages (the so-called crisis levy), I will therefore include in the bill that if an employee withdraws the full life-course balance in 2013 under the 80% scheme, the wages from that withdrawal will not count toward the base of the levy.

Bij de uitwerking van de verlenging van de pseudo-eindheffing voor hoog loon (ook wel de crisisheffing genoemd) zal ik daarom in het wetsvoorstel met betrekking tot deze verlenging opnemen dat indien een werknemer in het jaar 2013 met toepassing van die 80%-regeling het volledige tegoed van de levenslooprekening opneemt, het loon ter zake van die opname niet meetelt voor de grondslag van de pseudo-eindheffing voor hoog loon.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Dijkgraaf en Litjens over de aanmelding van Polder Stein als Habitatrichtlijngebied

MPs Dijkgraaf and Litjens asked the state secretary about the status of Polder Stein as a Habitat Directive area, including whether the habitat type H6510 occurs there and why its designation changed. The state secretary answered that the area will be re-notified to the European Commission this year, that the habitat was found present after a 2012 field visit, and that the earlier exclusion rested on an incorrect 2010 conclusion.
This area will be re-notified to the European Commission as a Habitat Directive area again this year.
Dit gebied zal nog dit jaar weer bij de Europese Commissie worden aangemeld als Habitatrichtlijngebied.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Dijkgraaf en Bosman over het vangstverbod voor wolhandkrab

Two MPs asked the state secretary about the ban on catching Chinese mitten crab in Dutch waters, citing reports suggesting limited health risk and the export potential of clean crab, and asking whether the ban should be reconsidered. The government answered that the latest risk assessment still shows elevated risks from high-dioxin brown meat in closed areas, that the ban stays, and that it declined to give a full opinion on some questions pending interdepartmental coordination.
The most recent analysis results for the mitten crab and the risk assessment by the bureau give me no reason to reconsider this catch ban.
De meest recente analyseresultaten van de wolhandkrab en de risicobeoordeling door bureau geven mij geen aanleiding op dit vangstverbod terug te komen.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Dijkgraaf over het vooruitlopen van diverse gemeenten op mogelijke wijziging van de Winkeltijdenwet

An SGP MP asked the Minister of Economic Affairs whether municipalities that tolerate Sunday opening in breach of the current Shop Hours Act should be stopped, and what leverage the minister has. The minister answered that such municipalities should enforce the law, that he has no direct means to force enforcement, that stakeholders can request enforcement and appeal to the administrative court, and that the ministry is consulting the VNG on a weighing framework for a guideline.
I have no means at my disposal to ensure that municipalities take enforcement action.
Ik heb geen middelen tot mijn beschikking om ervoor te zorgen dat gemeenten handhavend optreden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dijkgraaf over de berichten dat Deutsche Bank geen leningen meer verstrekt aan bedrijven met een omzet van minder dan 1 miljoen euro

Dijkgraaf (SGP) asked whether Deutsche Bank's withdrawal from lending to small businesses (turnover under 1 million euro), including agricultural firms, forces clients into costly refinancing, collateral lock-in and break fees, and what DNB or the AFM could do. Minister Dijsselbloem answered that the bank's strategy is a private choice, that DNB supervises strategy only for sustainability, that the AFM has no lending oversight, and that the bank will talk with affected clients, without committing to new action.
I am not aware of the precise content of the private contracts between entrepreneurs and Deutsche Bank.
Van de precieze inhoud van de private contracten tussen ondernemers en Deutsche Bank ben ik niet op de hoogte.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dijkgraaf over de juistheid van de berichten dat Deutsche Bank een toezegging doet aan boeren die met hun hele financiering naar een andere bank gaan

An MP asked the ministers of Finance and Economic Affairs whether Deutsche Bank's reported pledge to let farmers leave without penalty is accurate, how break-fee clauses apply to split loans and swaps, and whether the bank's changed lending policy will be put in writing. The minister says Deutsche Bank will work with clients to find solutions, may revisit break fees, and will inform clients about its strategy in April 2013, but he declines to intervene in the bank's commercial strategy and defends break-fee clauses in general.
It is not for me to directly intervene in the strategic decision of an individual bank.
Het is niet aan mij om rechtstreeks in te grijpen in de strategische beslissing van een individuele bank.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Dijkgraaf en De Boer betreffende de juridisering van het natuurbeschermingsbeleid

Two MPs (Dijkgraaf and De Boer) asked the state secretary whether she agrees that the Natura 2000 legal framework has juridified nature conservation policy and eroded local support, and what she will do with the article's findings, including on the Boetelerveld buffer zone dispute. The state secretary answered that clear legal boundary conditions are unavoidable but that local stakeholders should weigh options within them, and that she trusts the province to conduct a sound process.
Clear boundary conditions with possible legal consequences are unavoidable.
Duidelijke randvoorwaarden met mogelijk juridische consequenties zijn onontkoombaar.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Dijkgraaf en Geurts over het bericht dat Vlaanderen binnenkort de arbitrageprocedure over de ontpoldering van de Hedwigepolder wil starten

Two MPs asked the state secretary about Flanders starting arbitration over the Hedwige polder de-polderisation, the expected timeline, whether the government will reuse its earlier alternative plan, and whether positive dredging results could prevent de-polderisation. The state secretary answered that the arbitration timeline runs from 22 May 2012, that the earlier alternative was not accepted by the Commission, that a demissionary cabinet leaves the decision to its successor, and that the dredging results are preliminary.
The current demissionary cabinet is not taking any action on this matter and has left the decision to the next cabinet.
Het huidige demissionaire kabinet neemt geen actie in dezen en heeft besluitvorming aan het volgende kabinet overgelaten.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Dijkgraaf over het bericht "steeds meer ouders gebruiken kinderopvangtoeslag als extra salaris"

An SGP MP asked whether parents using childcare allowance as extra income is a government responsibility, whether the childcare allowance system inherently leads to misuse, whether a universal basic parenting budget should be considered, and whether maintaining the childcare subsidy is fiscally irresponsible given a CPB study. The state secretary answered that paying for childcare is a matter between parents and providers, the allowance is directly linked to costs so misuse is not inherent, a universal budget is not pursued because the existing scheme already covers child costs, and the CPB shows the allowance raised female labour participation while cuts were justified by rising costs.
No. The childcare allowance is a percentage of the costs parents incur for using childcare.
Nee. De kinderopvangtoeslag is een percentage van de kosten die ouders maken voor het gebruik van kinderopvang.
Antwoord vragen Dijkgraaf over de opstelling van de NMa inzake de MSC-certificering van de garnalenvisserij in de Noordzee

An MP asks why the competition authority NMa has not approved the garnalen sector's MSC management plan, especially the Catch Control Rule, and whether the government will intervene or issue policy rules. The state secretary answers that the NMa has independent supervisory status, that it is up to the sector to adapt its plans to competition rules, and that he will not intervene or issue policy rules on sustainability.
Given the independent position of the NMa as supervisor of the competition rules, it is not fitting for me to intervene in this.
Gezien de onafhankelijke positie van de NMa als toezichthouder van de mededingingsregels past het mij niet om hier in te treden.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Dijkgraaf over de regio-indeling in het Pachtprijzenbesluit

An MP asked the state secretary for Economic Affairs, Agriculture and Innovation about the region classification in the lease price decree, including analysis of Grondkamer decisions on lease price review requests, room for lower prices for low-yielding land, and whether the Grondkamer route will be clarified or the rules changed. The secretary answered that the analysis shows most reviews raised prices, that the Grondkamer route offers adequate tools without changing the law, and that a different region classification is only considered if all stakeholders unanimously ask for it.

However, I am of the view that amending article 333 of Book 7 of the Civil Code or article 21 of the 2007 Lease Price Decree is not warranted, because these articles provide good tools for an objective valuation of the land concerned.

Ik ben echter van mening dat aanpassing van artikel 333 van Boek 7 van het Burgerlijk Wetboek of artikel 21 van het Pachtprijzenbesluit 2007 niet in de rede ligt, omdat deze artikelen goede handvatten bieden voor een objectieve waardebepaling van de betreffende grond.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Dijkgraaf over het vonnis van de rechtbank Rotterdam inzake het Early Birdprogramma

An MP from the SGP asks the education minister how the Rotterdam court ruling on the Early Bird programme, which allows Dutch primary schools to teach partly in English without a formal experiment permit, fits with the Experiments Act and the inspectorate's oversight. The minister replies that the court limits the programme to 15% of teaching time in English, that the inspectorate will take the ruling into account, and that she sees no reason for further research but will send a plan on English in primary education later.
The Inspectorate of Education will take the ruling into account in its supervision.
De Inspectie van het Onderwijs zal het vonnis betrekken in haar toezicht.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dijkgraaf over de investeringsregeling jonge landbouwers

An SGP MP asked the state secretary why the budget ceiling and maximum investment amount of the young farmers investment scheme were lowered, and how this relates to EU co-financing and earlier motions. The state secretary said the scheme's future will be considered within the new CAP's young-farmer support, that the 2012 budget was raised by 2.5 million euro from national reserves to 5.3 million, and that the lower maximum investment amount lets more applications be honoured.
For the year 2011 I did not apply a budget ceiling for young farmers' support applications, in line with the Dijkgraaf/Koopmans motion.
Voor het jaar 2011 heb ik conform de motie Dijkgraaf/Koopmans geen budgettair plafond gehanteerd voor steunaanvragen van jonge boeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dijkgraaf over netneutraliteit

An SGP MP asked ministers about the Dutch net neutrality law, including criticism from EU Commissioner Kroes and OPTA, and whether the ban on ideologically motivated internet filtering by providers conflicts with the constitution and ECHR. The minister rejects these criticisms, defends the law as protecting freedom of expression and consumer choice, and declines an OPTA review for now because the law has not yet taken effect.
I do not see the value of such a study at this moment, because the law has just been adopted by the States General.
Ik zie het nut van zo’n onderzoek op dit moment niet in, omdat de wet net door de Staten-Generaal is aangenomen.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Dijkgraaf over geluidsoverlast van de Betuweroute

An MP asked the minister about a second opinion by Peutz disputing DGMR's noise measurements for Betuweroute freight noise at Hardinxveld-Giessendam, including speed correction, measurement spread, and whether planned traffic will exceed Tracébesluit values. The minister rejected most of the objections, stated current use does not exceed the values, and pointed to new noise production ceilings from 1 July 2012 with annual reporting and quieter rolling stock initiatives.
From 2013 the manager will report annually on compliance with these noise production ceilings.
Vanaf 2013 rapporteert de beheerder jaarlijks over de naleving van deze geluidproductieplafonds.
Antwoord vragen Dijkgraaf over het scheuren van grasland

An MP asked the state secretary whether he would press Brussels to move the grassland ploughing deadline on sandy soil from 31 May to 30 June 2012, citing reports on nitrate leaching. The state secretary replied that he will raise revising the grassland rules with the Commission, but will not seek a change within the current action programme, since the rules are a condition of the derogation, and sees no new facts warranting priority treatment.
These reports give me reason to advocate, with the European Commission, an adjustment of the applicable rules for destroying the grass sod of grassland.
Deze rapporten geven mij aanleiding een aanpassing van de geldende regels voor het vernietigen van de graszode van grasland bij de Europese Commissie te bepleiten.
Vragen van het lid Dijkgraaf (SGP) aan de staatssecretaris van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie over de uitvoering van Natura 2000 beleid (ingezonden 6 februari 2012).

An MP asked the state secretary about a Council of State ruling requiring permits for manure spreading in a Natura 2000 area, the PAS approach, and fees charged for nature data from the National Database Flora and Fauna, and whether that data will be made freely available. The state secretary answered that the ruling's consequences should be limited because manure spreading mostly falls under existing use, that fees are cost-recovery and falling in number is denied, and declined to release the requested data, pointing to the lead party of management plans.
Permit applicants and other interested parties can approach the lead party of a management plan to request relevant information on the natural values present in a Natura 2000 area.

Vergunningaanvragers en overige belanghebbende partijen kunnen zich richten tot de voortouwnemer van een beheerplan om relevante informatie op te vragen over de aanwezige natuurwaarden in een Natura 2000 gebied.
Antwoord vragen Dijkgraaf over de programmatische onafhankelijkheid van omroepen

An MP asked whether broadcasters' programmatic independence should be limited for content such as eating human flesh, whether the public broadcaster should be held morally accountable, and what criminal-law criteria apply. The minister answered that programmatic independence is not restricted in advance, that eating human flesh as such is not punishable though obtaining it may be, and that it is not for the government to set standards of decency.
No, as minister I do not decide on the moral choices a broadcaster makes.
Nee, als minister ga ik niet over de morele keuzes die een omroep maakt.
Antwoord vragen Dijkgraaf over de regio-indeling in het Pachtprijzenbesluit

An MP asked the state secretary about regional rent-price boundaries in the Pachtprijzenbesluit, which may disadvantage low-yield areas such as the Wieringermeer, and about follow-up on the Grondkamer route and boundary review. The secretary says the Grondkamer practice gives no reason for measures yet, boundary changes will only be considered if representativeness is seriously compromised, and any change requires broad support and a LEI study.
My officials hold periodic consultations with the secretariat of the (central) Grondkamer and take note of decisions concerning the application of article 7:333 of the Civil Code.

Mijn ambtenaren hebben periodiek overleg met het secretariaat van de (centrale) grondkamer en nemen kennis van beschikkingen die betrekking hebben op de toepassing van artikel 7:333 Burgerlijk Wetboek.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dijkgraaf over de Schipholrun

An MP asked the state secretary about the planned Schipholrun, a race partly across Schiphol's closed terrain, and its security risks and costs, and whether inspection or counter-terrorism bodies had approved it. The state secretary answered that the organisers cancelled the event, that Schiphol confirmed no effect on operations was allowed, and that no inspection or NCTV review was deemed necessary.
The organisation of the Schipholrun has since announced that the event will not go ahead.
De organisatie van de Schipholrun heeft inmiddels bekendgemaakt dat het evenement niet door zal gaan.

Vragen van de leden Dijkgraaf (SGP), Lodders (VVD) en Koppejan (CDA) aan de staatssecretaris van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie over de weegfactor van natuurproject Waterdunen (ingezonden 14 november 2011).

Three MPs asked the state secretary whether he would accept Zeeland's proposal to raise the weighting of the Waterdunen nature project toward the Natura 2000 Westerschelde management target from 30% to at least 50%. The state secretary answered that he is open to proposals within the Birds and Habitats Directives but that the Zeeland study did not lead to a request to change the agreed package, and he declined to commit to the higher weighting.
I am open to proposals to seek room for manoeuvre within the framework of the Birds and Habitats Directives.
Ik sta open voor voorstellen om rek en ruimte te zoeken binnen de kaders van de Vogel- en Habitatrichtlijn.
Vragen van het lid Dijkgraaf (SGP) aan de minister van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie over de effectiviteit van investeringen in R&D (ingezonden 15 november 2011).

MP Dijkgraaf asks the economy minister how the government evaluates a PhD study finding high GDP multipliers from R&D investment, the lower multiplier of fiscal R&D support, and proposals for an incremental R&D facility and attracting foreign R&D. The minister answers that R&D is central to innovation policy, that existing instruments (Innovatiefonds MKB+, WBSO, innovation contracts, RDA+) are being pursued, and that the government will not yet add an incremental scheme or claim firm returns on investment.
The cabinet aims, with the new business policy, to raise R&D intensity to 2.5% of GDP by 2020.
Het kabinet stelt zich ten doel om met het nieuwe bedrijfslevenbeleid in 2020 de R&D-intensiteit te verhogen naar 2,5% van het BBP.

Vragen van het lid Dijkgraaf (SGP) aan de staatssecretaris van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie over het praktijkonderzoek naar het effect van stikstof uit kunst- en drijfmest op grasland (ingezonden 25 oktober 2

MP Dijkgraaf asks the state secretary about practical research showing nitrogen and phosphate removal by grass exceeding application norms, and whether this shapes the nitrate action programme and manure policy. The state secretary defends the norms as consistent with practice, says further differentiation is under study, and states the research reports are public documentation with a 2010 English publication.

Vragen van de leden Lodders (VVD) en Dijkgraaf (SGP) aan de staatssecretaris van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie over de impasse rond de natuurontwikkeling in het Binnenveld (ingezonden 17 oktober 2011).

MPs Lodders and Dijkgraaf asked about the impasse over nature development in the Binnenveld Natura 2000 area, a municipal land-swap offer from Rhenen, and whether a water-level rise on the Grift is needed and affordable. The state secretary said an independent expert commission found a water-level rise necessary for Natura 2000 goals, that measures are technically feasible with lower costs, and that the offer can be considered only if Natura 2000 goals are not jeopardised.
I contributed to this by asking an independent commission of experts to map out feasible measures that lead to achieving the Natura 2000 goals.
Ik heb daaraan bijgedragen door een onafhankelijke commissie van deskundigen te vragen uitvoerbare maatregelen in beeld te brengen die leiden tot het realiseren van de Natura 2000-doelen.

Vragen van de leden Paulus Jansen (SP), Van Veldhoven (D66), Leegte (VVD), Van Tongeren (GL), Wiegman-van Meppelen Scheppink (CU), Van der Werf (CDA), Van Vliet (PVV), Samsom (PvdA) en Dijkgraaf (SGP) aan de staatssecret

Nine MPs asked why the Hagestein hydropower plant has been out of use since 2005, why a renovation plan and a private 20-year concession offer were not acted upon, and what the government's view is on the case. The state secretary answered that Rijkswaterstaat is still studying technical, legal and environmental requirements and will decide in 2012 whether to tender, integrate or shut down the plant, and will inform stakeholders in coming months.
RWS will take the initiative to inform the interested companies and governments about the state of affairs in a few months' time.
RWS zal het initiatief nemen om de belanghebbende bedrijven en overheden over enkele maanden in te lichten over de stand van zaken

Vragen van de leden Gesthuizen (SP), Dijkgraaf (SGP) en Schouten (ChristenUnie) aan de minister van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie over de grote gevolgen van schaalvergroting in de supermarktbranche voor kleine

MPs Gesthuizen, Dijkgraaf and Schouten asked the economy minister whether expanded Sunday opening harms small supermarket owners relative to chains and whether it should be reversed. The minister replied that the 2011 tightening of the tourism exemption is expected to help small shops, that Sunday opening is only one factor among several, and that no new measures are planned.
No, as I have already indicated, the expanded Sunday opening is only one of the factors contributing to the declining turnover and number of small supermarkets.
Nee, zoals ik reeds heb aangegeven is de ruimere openstelling op zondag slechts één van de factoren die een rol spelen bij de dalende trend van de omzet en aantal van kleine supermarkten.

Vragen van de leden Omtzigt (CDA), Dezentjé Hamming-Bluemink (VVD), Vermeij (PvdA), Ulenbelt (SP), Klaver (Groenlinks), Koolmees (D66), Schouten (ChristenUnie), Dijkgraaf (SGP), Van den Besselaar (PVV) en Thieme (Partij

Ten MPs asked the minister of Social Affairs about a reported 450 million euro fee paid by pension funds (PME and another fund) to Mn Services for asset management, and about transparency and remedies for members. The minister said the fee passage in the court ruling contained a typo, that supervisors alone may request such information and are bound by confidentiality, that members can raise concerns with the accountability body and as a last resort the Ondernemingskamer, and that a cost-reporting guideline is due in November 2011.
The Pension Act provides that only the supervisors, DNB and AFM, have the authority to request information from pension funds.
In de Pensioenwet is bepaald dat alleen de toezichthouders, DNB en AFM, de bevoegdheid hebben om informatie op te vragen bij pensioenfondsen.

Vragen van het lid Dijkgraaf (SGP) aan de ministers van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap, van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport en van Algemene Zaken over de voorlichtingscampagne met betrekking tot seksuele veiligheid (

An MP asked ministers whether a government sexual-safety campaign broadcast by day complied with Kijkwijzer age norms and whether it could backfire on young children. The minister said the spots now air only after 20:00, that government campaigns will be classified by Kijkwijzer going forward, and that such mass campaigns will no longer be funded from 2012.
Recently we instructed that these spots be broadcast only after 20:00 hours.
Onlangs hebben we opdracht gegeven deze spotjes alleen nog na 20:00 uur uit te zenden.
Vragen van het lid Dijkgraaf (SGP) aan de staatssecretaris van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie over de hoorzitting Prijsvorming in de agro-nutriketen (ingezonden 18 juli 2011).

MP Dijkgraaf asked the state secretary about an ombudsman for the agri-food chain, the timeline and participation for a fair-trade code, competition and quality-system issues, producer organisations, margin measurement, transparency, and overproduction. The government answered that an ombudsman's pros and cons cannot yet be judged, that a fair-trade code is being developed with TISCO and will be reported on in November, and that the other questions are answered largely by reference to existing competition and EU rules.
The minister will inform the House of the outcomes.
De minister zal uw Kamer informeren over de uitkomsten.

Vragen van de leden Dijkgraaf (SGP), Gesthuizen (SP) en Schouten (ChristenUnie) aan de staatssecretaris van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid en de minister van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie over het bericht da

MPs asked the government about reports that shop staff in Zoetermeer are pressured into Sunday work, and whether this reflects a wider trend, whether workers can enforce their rights, and whether the Labour Inspectorate will investigate compliance. The minister answered that the Zoetermeer decision meets the legal tourism criteria subject to a pending appeal, that workers can invoke the Working Hours Act and Civil Code before the courts, and that the government will not have the Labour Inspectorate supervise collective agreement provisions.
The judge has the final say in assessing whether the municipality of Zoetermeer rightly used the tourism provision.
De rechter heeft het laatste woord bij de beoordeling van de vraag of de gemeente Zoetermeer terecht gebruik heeft gemaakt van de toerismebepaling.
Vragen van het lid Dijkgraaf (SGP) aan de staatssecretaris van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie over het project Waterdunen in Zeeuws-Vlaanderen (ingezonden 24 januari 2011).

An MP asks the state secretary how the national government is involved in the Waterdunen project in Zeeuws-Vlaanderen, what influence it still has, and whether planned land reclamation conflicts with the coalition agreement and the motion against expropriation for nature. The government answers that the province leads the project, the national government funds it, the decision-making is complete with a pending appeal, and it sees no further national role, while noting it does not consider expropriation desirable and is open to reviewing the weighting if the province changes its view.
The province of Zeeland is responsible for the planning and decision-making.
De provincie Zeeland is verantwoordelijk voor de plan- en besluitvorming.
Vragen van het lid Dijkgraaf (SGP) aan de staatssecretaris van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie over de Beleidsregels Regeling GLB-inkomenssteun 2006 (ingezonden 11 juli 2011).

Parliamentary questions from MP Dijkgraaf (SGP) ask whether a new Article 5a of the 2006 GLB income support policy rules, applied by the Dienst Regelingen to the 2010 combined application, can be applied retroactively, who bears the burden of proof, and how farmers can invoke the exception. The state secretary replies that the rules took effect on 1 April 2011 and do not change earlier criteria, that responsibility is shared with farmers, that the requested reversal is not applicable, and that farmers can report misclassified parcels and object.
Assessments before 2011 are based on European regulations and the policy on the classification of land as agricultural land.
Beoordelingen vóór 2011 zijn gebaseerd op de Europese regelgeving en het beleid over de kwalificatie van grond als landbouwgrond.

Vragen van de leden Schouten (ChristenUnie), Dijkgraaf (SGP) en Gesthuizen (SP) aan de minister van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie over het raadsbesluit om in Zoetermeer 52 koopzondagen toe te staan (ingezonden

Three MPs asked the minister whether Zoetermeer's council decision to allow 52 Sunday shopping days under the tourism exemption of the Shop Opening Hours Act was lawful, given that the exemption should be interpreted strictly, the tourism must be autonomous and substantial, and workers' interests must be weighed. The minister answered that the municipality's assessment is its own responsibility, that an objection and possible appeal are pending before the Trade and Industry Appeals Tribunal, and that the courts have the final word.
The judge has the last word in assessing whether the municipality of Zoetermeer rightly used the tourism exemption.
De rechter heeft het laatste woord bij de beoordeling van de vraag of de gemeente Zoetermeer terecht gebruik heeft gemaakt van de toerismebepaling.
Vragen van de leden Lodders (VVD) en Dijkgraaf (SGP) aan de staatssecretaris van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie over de nationale koppen op Natura 2000 (ingezonden 12 april 2011).

MPs Lodders and Dijkgraaf asked the state secretary about the IQuatro report on national add-ons (koppen) to Natura 2000, including the proposed deletion of habitat targets, inclusion of the Leenheerenpolder, changes to habitat types in Stelkampsveld, and availability of ecological justifications. The state secretary promised an evaluation covering IQuatro themes, justified the habitat additions with updated data, and referred to publicly available selection documents.
The evaluation will indicate which national add-ons were identified in the implementation of Natura 2000.
In de evaluatie zal worden aangegeven welke nationale koppen zijn geïdentificeerd bij de implementatie van Natura 2000.

Vragen van de leden Dijkgraaf (SGP), Wiegman-van Meppelen Scheppink (ChristenUnie) en Gesthuizen (SP) aan de minister van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie over een koopzondagenbesluit van de gemeenteraad van Vlaa

MPs Dijkgraaf, Wiegman-van Meppelen Scheppink and Gesthuizen asked the minister whether Vlaardingen's council decision allotting 18 Sunday shopping days, with shopkeepers choosing 12, violates the Winkeltijdenwet, and whether the minister will petition for annulment. The minister answers that the council ordinance is lawful since it delegates 12 days to the mayor and aldermen, that the college's later designation has been ordered brought into line with the law, and that he will await the municipality's reply before deciding on annulment.
I have pointed this out to the municipality and asked it to adjust the designation of the number of Sunday shopping days so that it complies with the Winkeltijdenwet.
Ik heb de gemeente hierop gewezen en verzocht om de aanwijzing van het aantal koopzondagen aan te passen, zodat deze in overeenstemming met de Winkeltijdenwet is.

Vragen van de leden Voordewind (ChristenUnie), Dikkers (PvdA), Ouwehand (Partij voor de Dieren), Van Tongeren (GroenLinks), Gesthuizen (SP) en Dijkgraaf (SGP) aan de staatssecretaris van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en In

MPs from six parties asked the State Secretary for Economic Affairs and the Foreign Minister about child labour and underpaid adult labour in Dutch cocoa and hazelnut supply chains, including whether hazelnut processors acting through the FNLI and the IDH business network can be held responsible. The government answered that industry bodies are meeting their supply-chain responsibility within the limits of reasonable expectation, describes FNLI and IDH activities, and says the SZW dialogue with Turkey has not yet taken place.
Our answer of 15 December 2010 stated that companies must simply do what can reasonably be expected of them to combat child labour in their chain.
In ons antwoord van 15 december 2010 is aangegeven dat bedrijven zonder meer dienen te doen wat redelijkerwijs van hen mag worden verwacht om kinderarbeid in hun keten te bestrijden.

Vragen van de leden Slob (ChristenUnie), Koppejan (CDA), Dijkgraaf (SGP) en Houwer (VVD) aan de staatssecretaris van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie over blokkades van Franse havens (ingezonden 7 april 2011).

MPs asked the state secretary about French blockades of ports that prevented Dutch fishermen from sailing and whether Dutch fishermen in the Channel had legal rights and protection from French authorities. The state secretary answered that French authorities advised temporarily avoiding landings in northern French ports, that this advice was later narrowed to landing in Boulogne sur Mer, and that blockades conflict with free movement and a consultation was planned.
I consider blockades of ports and obstruction of fishing activities to be contrary to European free movement.
Blokkades van havens en het hinderen van visserij activiteiten acht ik in strijd met het Europese vrije verkeer.
Vragen van het lid Dijkgraaf (SGP) aan de staatssecretarissen van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie en van Infrastructuur en Milieu over het Besluit huisvesting (ingezonden 14 februari 2011).

An SGP MP asked whether pig and broiler farmers unable to afford stable upgrades could cut the number of batches to reduce ammonia emissions, and what changes to the housing decree could allow this. The state secretary said the decree requires best available techniques and offers no batch-reduction route, but a working group is examining an exception for farms ceasing operations, subject to sector consultation.
However, I want to consult the sector to examine whether it is desirable to make an exception for businesses that want to stop in the long term.
Wel wil ik in overleg met de sector bezien of het wenselijk is om voor bedrijven die op termijn willen stoppen een uitzondering te maken.
Vragen van het lid Dijkgraaf (SGP) aan de minister van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over het initiatief MEDIA & COO (ingezonden 11 februari 2011).

Dutch MP Dijkgraaf asked the minister of Education, Culture and Science about the OUDERS & COO report criticising Kijkwijzer media classification for lax application and weak oversight, and about foreign comparison, parent representation, hufterig gedrag criteria and the cinema parental guidance exemption. The minister rejected the criticism, cited Commissariaat voor de Media oversight and international comparisons, said NICAM would examine the hufterig gedrag criteria, and announced talks with the cinema sector to phase out parental guidance for 16-rated content.
I have asked NICAM to again examine whether hufterig gedrag is weighed sufficiently heavily in the classification.
Ik heb het NICAM gevraagd om nog eens na te gaan of hufterig gedrag in de codering voldoende zwaar wordt meegewogen.

Vragen van het lid Dijkgraaf (SGP) aan de minister van Infrastructuur en Milieu over een verbod op overslagactiviteiten en het verdwijnen van overslagplekken in de randstad (ingezonden 9 november 2010).

An SGP MP asked the minister of Infrastructure and Environment about a water board's ban on cargo transhipment at Kaai 85 after a Council of State annulment of the environmental permit, and about the disappearance of transhipment sites in the Randstad. The minister said the water board is responsible for its own decision, that alternative sites exist, and that regional authorities are responsible for transhipment locations, promising to ask them for an overview.
I therefore do not consider it appropriate to ask the water board to reconsider this decision.
Ik acht het daarom niet opportuun het waterschap te verzoeken dit besluit te heroverwegen.

Vragen van het lid Dijkgraaf (SGP) aan de minister van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie over het gedoogbeleid van de gemeente Sint-Oedenrode ten aanzien van de avondwinkelbepaling in de Winkeltijdenwet (ingezonde

An MP asked the minister whether the municipality of Sint-Oedenrode, by allowing two Sunday-open supermarkets against the one-per-15,000-residents limit in the Shop Opening Hours Act, should be held to account and what measures would prevent other municipalities from doing the same. The minister said municipalities must comply with the law, that interested parties can object and appeal (an objection has been filed), and that he has no power to intervene while that procedure is pending.
I therefore have no means to intervene.
Ik heb dan ook geen mogelijkheden om in te grijpen.
Vragen van het lid Dijkgraaf (SGP) aan de minister van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over Early bird scholen (ingezonden 21 december 2010).

An MP asked the education minister how the government will ensure Early bird schools operate within the law after a Rotterdam court ruling, whether English-medium instruction up to 15% can be guaranteed, and how many experiments with a foreign language as medium of instruction are running. The minister answered that the court has not yet ruled on the substance (a hearing is set for February), that 14 primary schools are running the 15% English-language pilot, and that the Inspectorate has found no schools using English for part of the curriculum outside an experiment.
No substantive ruling has yet been made on whether EarlyBird schools comply with education legislation.
Er is nog geen inhoudelijke uitspraak gedaan over of EarlyBird-scholen zich aan de onderwijswetgeving houden.
Vragen van het lid Dijkgraaf (SGP) aan de minister van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over het aanvragen van een verklaring omtrent het gedrag voor invalleerkrachten (ingezonden 25 november 2010).

An MP asked the education minister which rules apply to requesting a certificate of good conduct (VOG) for substitute teachers, whether repeated requests over years are unnecessarily bureaucratic, and whether rules could be relaxed for teachers staying with the same school board. The minister confirmed the VOG requirement protects children, a VOG older than six months must be renewed on new appointment, and declined to relax the rule while suggesting alternative contract arrangements.
I am not inclined to increase this risk again by relaxing the rules.
Ik voel er niet voor om door een versoepeling dit risico weer te vergroten.

Vragen van de leden Dijkgraaf (SGP), Wiegman-van Meppelen Scheppink (ChristenUnie) en Leijten (SP) aan de minister van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid over barrières in regelgeving voor stichting Solink (ingezonden 29 n

MPs from SGP, ChristenUnie and SP asked the Minister of Social Affairs whether regulatory barriers (AOW rules on shared households) hinder the SOlink initiative pairing students with lonely elderly people, and whether the SVB could treat such arrangements as commercial. The minister supports the initiative, says it can proceed within AOW rules if contracts are businesslike, and refuses a generic exemption on equality grounds.
Your request to instruct the SVB to generally regard the agreements between SOlink, the students and the lonely elderly as a 'commercial' relationship, I cannot grant.
Uw verzoek om de SVB op te dragen de overeenkomsten tussen SOlink, de studenten en de alleenstaande ouderen generiek te gaan beschouwen als een «commerciële» relatie, kan ik niet inwilligen.
Vragen van het lid Dijkgraaf (SGP) aan de minister van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over de taalverwerving van kinderen tot ongeveer zes jaar (ingezonden 27 oktober 2010).

Deputy Dijkgraaf (SGP) asked the Minister of Education about early language acquisition in young children, citing a dissertation on language problems, and questioned how VVE early-education policy, diagnosis, target-group selection, school readiness and teacher training should respond. The minister answered that language development varies, that language disorders require medical or speech therapy while exposure deficits justify VVE, that municipalities define target groups, and that the government will raise specialisation topics for young children in teacher training, without committing to structural change.
It is not automatic in schools to start a language-stimulation track or not based on a particular score.
Het is op scholen geen automatisme om bij een bepaalde score al dan niet een traject van taalstimulering in te zetten.

Vragen van het lid Dijkgraaf (SGP) aan de ministers van Verkeer en Waterstaat en van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over het verdwijnen van buslijn 112 en de consequenties daarvan voor vele scholieren (ingezonden 5 okt

An MP asked ministers whether bus line 112 between Huizen and Amersfoort, used heavily by pupils, would be discontinued in the new Gooi- en Vechtstreek concession, and what the consequences would be. The minister answered that provinces decide on regional public transport, that the province of Noord-Holland tendered the concession within a set budget without a bidder for the line, and declined to intervene, citing decentralised responsibility.
I am not willing to do so, because it does not fit the division of responsibilities under which the decentralised authorities are themselves responsible for regional public transport.
Ik ben hiertoe niet bereid, omdat het niet past bij de verantwoordelijkheidsverdeling waarbij de decentrale overheden zelf verantwoordelijk zijn voor het regionale openbaar vervoer.

Vragen van het lid Dijkgraaf (SGP) aan de ministers van Volkshuisvesting, Ruimtelijke Ordening en Milieubeheer, van Verkeer en Waterstaat en van Landbouw, Natuur en Voedselkwaliteit over belemmeringen voor reddingsboten

An MP asked ministers whether the Wadden Sea planning decision blocks dredging of the channel to the Ameland lifeboat station and whether they would grant an exemption to deepen it quickly. The minister answered that the planning decision does not prevent deepening if limited in scope, and that Rijkswaterstaat asked the lifeboat society to report shoaling locations so necessity can be assessed jointly.
The PKB Waddenzee does not constitute an obstacle to bringing the fairway to the desired depth, provided the deepening is limited in scope.
De PKB Waddenzee vormt geen belemmering om de vaargeul op de gewenste diepte te brengen, mits de verdieping beperkt in omvang is.
Vragen van het lid Dijkgraaf (SGP) aan de minister van Financiën over het rapport van de AFM met de bevindingen kwaliteit accountantscontrole en kwaliteitsbewaking (ingezonden 6 september 2010).

An MP asked the Finance Minister about the AFM report finding insufficient improvement in audit quality at the Big 4 firms, including its limited sample, the timing and tone of publication, anonymity of firms, and the risk of false audit opinions. The minister answered that the AFM sets its own approach and publication practice, that its supervision is adequate, that firms are taking remedial measures, and that the AFM will monitor and use enforcement powers where needed.
The AFM supervises all audit organisations that carry out statutory audits.
De AFM houdt toezicht op alle accountantsorganisaties die wettelijke controles verrichten.
Vragen van het lid Dijkgraaf (SGP) aan de minister van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over spellingvaardigheden (ingezonden 7 september 2010).

MP Dijkgraaf asks the education minister about news reports that spelling skills decline after primary school and that lowered spelling standards in primary education do not help, and whether the reference levels for language and arithmetic weaken requirements. The state secretary rejects the claim that the reference levels lower standards, says the examinations will be aligned with the reference levels, adds a arithmetic exam and a larger role for writing skills, and promises pilots and monitoring.
I will ensure that these tests align with the principle of realistic ambition
Ik zal er op toezien dat deze toetsen aansluiten bij het beginsel van een realistische ambitie

Vragen van het lid Dijkgraaf (SGP) aan de minister van Landbouw, Natuurbeheer en Voedselkwaliteit over de stand van zakenbrief inzake MKZ Kootwijkerbroek en het rapport van de Stichting Onderzoek MKZ Kootwijkerbroek (ing

An SGP MP asked the minister whether RT-PCR and IDAS ELISA test results on the Kootwijkerbroek farm in 2001 were interpreted and reported correctly, and why earlier answers omitted certain results, and requested all laboratory data. The minister answered that the positive result was confirmed by later tests and that the disputed sample readings were handled per protocol, but declined to release further lab data beyond what is needed, pointing to pending objection procedures and offering confidential inspection of some documents.
I point out that my predecessor offered the parties in Kootwijkerbroek a binding investigation by an independent committee of FMD experts.
Ik wijs erop dat mijn voorganger destijds de partijen in Kootwijkerbroek een bindend onderzoek door een onafhankelijke commissie van MKZ-deskundigen heeft aangeboden.
Vragen van het lid Dijkgraaf (SGP) aan de minister van Economische Zaken over een rechterlijke uitspraak inzake de toepassing van de Winkeltijdenwet in Rotterdam (ingezonden 6 augustus 2010).

An SGP MP asked the Minister of Economic Affairs whether a Hague appeals court ruling allowing Rotterdam's Alexandrium shops to open every Sunday undermines the Shop Opening Hours Act, and whether the minister will amend the law to close the tourism-exception loophole. The minister answered that courts interpret the law, that the court ruling is authoritative, and that a pending bill to give municipalities more guidance is before the Senate, though the House has no support for changing the law on this point.
It is for the judge to interpret the law.
Het is aan de rechter om de wet uit te leggen.
Vragen van het lid Dijkgraaf (SGP) aan de minister van Landbouw, Natuur en Voedselkwaliteit over de Nederlandse interpretatie en implementatie van de Habitatrichtlijn (ingezonden 28 juli 2010).

An SGP MP asked the Minister of Agriculture, Nature and Food Quality how the Netherlands interprets and implements the Habitats Directive, including whether conservation targets apply nationally, how ecological data and the standard data forms were compiled, and why habitat conservation status was classified inconsistently. The Minister defended a national-level conservation objective, explained that socio-economic factors do not enter site selection, and gave reasons for the differing classifications while noting that further research and updated assessments were underway.
Vragen van het lid Dijkgraaf (SGP) aan de minister van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over de effecten van etnische diversiteit op onderwijsprestaties (ingezonden 22 juni 2010).

An SGP MP asked the education minister whether he accepts Professor Dronkers' conclusion that ethnic school diversity harms learning outcomes, and questioned the Inspectorate's correction methodology and its scientific basis. The minister answered that research findings vary, that socio-cultural composition (parental education) is the main factor, that the inspectorate now corrects only for parental education, and that the methodology is in continuous development, without committing to new action.
Given the data the inspectorate currently has, this is the best possible approach.
Gezien de gegevens waarover de inspectie op dit moment beschikt, is dit de best mogelijke aanpak.

m: Motie van het lid Monasch over geen bemoeienis van kabinet en individuele kabinetsleden met het sinterklaasfeest
Motion asks the cabinet and individual ministers not to interfere in how Sinterklaas is celebrated, now or in future.
requests the cabinet that neither the cabinet nor individual cabinet members interfere now or in future with how Sinterklaas is celebrated
verzoekt het kabinet, dat zij noch individuele leden van het kabinet zich nu en in de toekomst bemoeien met de invulling van het sinterklaasfeest
Motie van het lid Monasch over een alomvattend plan voor inburgering en participatie
Asks the government to hold the Inburgering bill in abeyance and return after the 2017 elections with a comprehensive integration and participation plan.
requests the government to hold this amendment of the law in abeyance and, after the March 2017 elections, to come with a comprehensive and complete plan for integration and participation
verzoekt de regering om, deze wijziging van wet aan te houden en na de verkiezingen van maart 2017 te komen met een alomvattend en sluitend plan voor inburgering en participatie
Motie van het lid Monasch over een apart ministerie van Migratie
Asks the government to prepare, before the coalition formation, a file for a separate Ministry of Migration covering asylum, labour migration and integration.
requests the government to prepare, before the upcoming formation, a file for a separate Ministry of Migration
verzoekt de regering om, voor de aanstaande formatie een dossier voor te bereiden voor een apart Ministerie van Migratie
Amendement van het lid Jan Vos c.s. over een rendementseis van tenminste 48% voor kolencentrales vanaf 2031
Requires coal-fired power plants to reach a net electrical efficiency of at least 48% from 2031, effectively phasing out the last five coal plants, with the minister able to request efficiency data.
The net electrical efficiency of a large production installation fired with coal or a combination of coal and one or more other fuels is at least 48% from 1 January 2031.

Het netto elektrisch rendement van een grote productie-installatie die met steenkool of een combinatie van steenkool en een of meer andere brandstoffen wordt gestookt, is vanaf 1 januari 2031 ten minste 48%.
Amendement van het lid Jan Vos c.s. over een rendementseis van tenminste 45% voor kolencentrales vanaf 2021
Sets a minimum net electrical efficiency of 45% for coal-fired plants from 2021 and lets the minister request efficiency data, aiming to phase out two coal plants.
The net electrical efficiency of a large production installation fired with coal, or a combination of coal and one or more other fuels, is at least 45% from 1 January 2021.

Het netto elektrisch rendement van een grote productie-installatie die met steenkool of een combinatie van steenkool en een of meer andere brandstoffen wordt gestookt, is vanaf 1 januari 2021 ten minste 45%.
Motie van de leden Monasch en Van Vliet over geen toegang tot de procedure voor asielzoekers die de grondrechten niet onderschrijven en respecteren
Motion asking the government to deny access to the asylum procedure to asylum seekers who do not endorse and respect fundamental rights.
asylum seekers who do not endorse and respect Article 1 of the Constitution and other fundamental rights may not be admitted to the asylum procedure in the Netherlands
asielzoekers die artikel 1 van de Grondwet en andere grondrechten niet onderschrijven en respecteren niet in de asielzoekersprocedure in Nederland mogen worden opgenomen
Motie van het lid Marcouch c.s. over een specifiek inhaalprogramma voor achteropgeraakte 50-plussers
Asks the government to develop a targeted catch-up programme (literacy, vocational education, social skills) for left-behind native Dutch people aged 50 and over.
requests the government to come up with a specific catch-up programme for this specific group of native Dutch people aged 50 and over
verzoekt de regering om, met een specifiek inhaalprogramma te komen voor deze specifieke groep Nederlandse 50-plussers
Motie van het lid Marcouch c.s. over een pilot met anoniem solliciteren bij de rijksoverheid
Asks the government to launch a large-scale pilot with anonymous job applications in central government and report the results to the House.
requests the government to start a large-scale pilot with anonymous job applications at central government
verzoekt de regering om, bij de rijksoverheid een grootschalige pilot met anoniem solliciteren te starten
Motie van het lid Monasch over een onderzoek naar de invloed van de toestroom van Oost-Europese werknemers op de loonvorming
Asks the government to research the effect of East European worker inflows on wage formation in several sectors and report by March 2017.
requests the government to research the influence of the inflow of workers from Eastern Europe on wage formation
verzoekt de regering, onderzoek te doen naar de invloed van de toestroom van werknemers uit Oost-Europa op de loonvorming
Motie van het lid Voordewind c.s. over een rapport over het gebruik van de term genocide door politici
Asks the government to seek advice from the external international law adviser and the advisory committee CAVV on a joint report about politicians' use of the term genocide.
requests the government to seek advice from the External International Law Adviser (EVA) and the Advisory Committee on International Legal Issues (CAVV)
verzoekt de regering, advies in te winnen bij de Extern Volkenrechtelijk Adviseur (EVA) en de Commissie van advies inzake volkenrechtelijke vraagstukken (CAVV)
Motie van het lid Monasch c.s. over een aparte mkb-toets dan wel mkb-statuut
Asks the government to explore a separate SME test or SME statute for new legislation, and to inform the Chamber by 1 February 2017.
requests the government to explore the possibilities for a separate SME test or an SME statute
verzoekt de regering, de mogelijkheden te onderzoeken voor een aparte mkb-toets dan wel een mkb-statuut
Motie van het lid Visser c.s. over een landelijke bijdrage aan het regionale project Sluizen Kornwerderzand
Asks the government to examine whether a national contribution to the regional Kornwerderzand locks project is possible within the Delta Fund and inform the House before MIRT 2017.
requests the government, within the Delta Fund, to examine whether it is possible under the heading co-funding opportunities
verzoekt de regering, binnen het Deltafonds, onder de noemer «meekoppelkansen» na te gaan of het mogelijk is

Amendement van het lid Monasch dat regelt dat de exploitant van de luchthaven de overschrijding of de onderbenutting van het budget van investeringsprojecten boven de per AMvB vastgestelde drempel pas

Lengthens from one to two additional periods the delay before an airport operator may pass on budget overruns or underspends above the threshold to user tariffs, so such costs reach users only after nine years.
The amendment therefore provides that the airport operator may only pass on the budget overrun or underspend above the threshold to user tariffs after nine years.

Zodoende regelt dit amendement dat de exploitant van de luchthaven de overschrijding of de onderbenutting van het budget van investeringsprojecten boven de per AMvB vastgestelde drempel pas na negen jaar kan doorrekenen in de tarieven van de gebruikers.

Amendement van het lid Monasch ter vervanging van nr. 26, dat regelt dat het vaststellen van de economisch meest voordelige inschrijving uitsluitend op grond van de laagste prijs of kosteneffectivitei

Allows categories of contracts to be designated by general administrative order where awarding on lowest price or cost-effectiveness alone is prohibited, subject to a four-week pre-consultation with parliament.
The proposal for a general administrative order to be adopted under the fifth paragraph is not made until four weeks after the draft has been submitted to both chambers of the States General.

De voordracht voor een krachtens het vijfde lid vast te stellen algemene maatregel van bestuur wordt niet eerder gedaan dan vier weken nadat het ontwerp aan beide kamers der Staten-Generaal is overgelegd.

Amendement van het lid Monasch dat regelt dat het vaststellen van de economisch meest voordelige inschrijving uitsluitend op basis van de laagste prijs of laagste kosten berekend op basis van kostenef
Prohibits awarding contracts solely on lowest price or cost-effectiveness for categories set by AMvB, and subjects that AMvB to a light voorhang procedure before both chambers.
Furthermore this amendment provides that the general administrative order is subject to a light voorhang procedure, whereby the draft decision is submitted to both chambers of the States General.

Verder regelt dit amendement dat de algemene maatregel van bestuur is onderworpen aan een lichte voorhangprocedure, inhoudende dat het ontwerp van het besluit wordt voorgelegd aan de beide kamers der Staten-Generaal.

Amendement van het lid Monasch c.s. dat regelt dat een centrale aanbestedende dienst niet alleen ingeval wordt gegund op grond van de laagste prijs, maar ook in het geval dat wordt gegund op grond van
