Amends the public procurement law so contracting authorities may award on lowest cost based on cost-effectiveness with justification, and must give greater weight to social, environmental and innovation criteria in best price-quality awards.
the contracting authority that determines the most economically advantageous tender on best price-quality ratio always sets social, environmental and innovation criteria

de centrale aanbestedende dienst die de economisch meest voordelige inschrijving vaststelt op basis van de beste prijs-kwaliteitverhouding, altijd het nadere criterium sociale, milieu- en innovatieve kenmerken stelt
Motie van het lid Gesthuizen c.s. over voorkomen van onnodig clusteren van opdrachten
Asks the government to have the authors of the Proportionality Guide clarify when splitting contracts into lots counts as unnecessary clustering.
requests the government to ask the writing group of the Proportionality Guide to amend it so that it becomes clear when unnecessary clustering of contracts occurs
verzoekt de regering, de schrijfgroep van de Gids Proportionaliteit te vragen, deze aan te passen zodat verhelderd wordt wanneer sprake is van onnodig clusteren van opdrachten
Motie van het lid Verhoeven c.s. over tegengaan van onnodig samenvoegen van opdrachten
Asks the government to propose measures to stop the unnecessary bundling of public tenders, to help small businesses.
requests the government to come with proposals to prevent the unnecessary merging of contracts
verzoekt de regering, te komen met voorstellen om het onnodig samenvoegen van opdrachten tegen te gaan
Motie van het lid Agnes Mulder c.s. over uitbreiding van de Gids Proportionaliteit
Asks the government to consult the drafting group of the Proportionality Guide to add guidance reducing the weight of price in public tenders.
requests the government to consult the drafting group of the Proportionality Guide.
verzoekt de regering om, in overleg te treden met de schrijfgroep van de Gids Proportionaliteit
Motie van het lid Agnes Mulder c.s. over verhoging van de Europese aanbestedingsdrempels
Asks the government to put raising the European procurement thresholds on the EU agenda in 2016 and report results to the House.
requests the government to put a raise of the European procurement thresholds on the EU agenda in 2016
verzoekt de regering om, in 2016 een verhoging van de Europese aanbestedingsdrempels te agenderen in de Europese Unie
Motie van het lid Bruins c.s. over monitoren van de capaciteit en doorlooptijden van de Commissie van Aanbestedingsexperts
Asks the government to monitor the capacity and processing times of the Procurement Experts Committee and report to parliament at least yearly.
to monitor the capacity and processing times of the Procurement Experts Committee and to inform the House about this at least once a year
de capaciteit en doorlooptijden van de Commissie van Aanbestedingsexperts te monitoren en de Kamer hierover ten minste eens per jaar te informeren
Motie van het lid Agnes Mulder c.s. over aanbestedingsprocedures die te laat zijn ingetrokken
Asks the government to report how often tenders were withdrawn late and how many resulted in damages paid to bidders.
requests the government to make clear, before 1 January 2017, how often tender procedures were withdrawn too late in recent years
verzoekt de regering om, voor 1 januari 2017 inzichtelijk te maken hoe vaak aanbestedingsprocedures in de afgelopen jaren te laat zijn ingetrokken
Motie van de leden Van Veen en Monasch over overhevelen van de decentralisatieuitkering voor de periode 2017-2020 naar de cultuurbegroting
Asks the government to transfer the 2017-2020 decentralisation grant for visual arts to the culture budget and allocate it to culture sector purposes.
requests the government to transfer the decentralisation grant for 2017-2020 to the culture budget
verzoekt de regering om, de decentralisatie-uitkering voor de periode 2017–2020 over te hevelen naar de cultuurbegroting
Motie van de leden Monasch en Van Veen over zelfcensuur als direct gevolg van bedreigingen

Asks the government to ensure the revised Housing Act can be debated and adopted by parliament in the current session, with the bill sent by March 2011.

Amendement van het lid Monasch over het opheffen van de uitputting van het budget van de Wet bevordering Eigenwoningbezit

In article 03 on guaranteeing choice and affordability on the housing market, the commitment and expenditure amounts are increased by 40,000 (x 1,000) euro.

Motie-Slob c.s. over de mate van robuustheid van het spoorsysteem bij verstoringen

Asks the government, with ProRail and NS, to carry out a new analysis of how robust the rail system is to disruptions, including backup switching and whether to compartmentalise security at large hubs.
requests the government, with parties such as ProRail and NS, to make a new analysis of the degree of robustness of the rail system
verzoekt de regering met betrokken partijen als ProRail en NS een nieuwe analyse te maken van de mate van robuustheid van het spoorsysteem
Motie-Monasch/Slob over evenveel prioriteit aan de krimpregio's, het oosten en het noorden van het land
Asks the government to give the shrinking regions and the east and north equal priority in MIRT and infrastructure fund decisions.
requests the government to fully include these regions in the priority setting for the MIRT

Motion asks the government to calculate the societal profitability of peripheral public transport including societal costs and set a minimum service level, informing the House.
requests the government to calculate the societal profitability of peripheral public transport

Asks the government to spend unused Taskforce Mobiliteitsmanagement funds on mobility management projects for employers and employees.
requests the government to use the not-yet-spent money of the Taskforce Mobiliteitsmanagement
verzoekt de regering het nog niet bestede geld van de Taskforce Mobiliteitsmanagement te benutten

Asks the government not to investigate further the plan for an A3 toll road cutting through the Groene Hart.
requests the government not to investigate this plan further

Shifts 30 million euro within the budget from the national road network article to offset a restored 2011 public transport (BDU) cut.
This amendment serves to cover the Slob et al. amendment

Amendement van het lid Slob c.s. over het terugdraaien van de bezuiniging op BDU

qa: Antwoord op vragen van het lid Monasch over het alternatief “Vaargeul Walvischstaart” voor de ontpoldering van de Hedwigepolder

An MP asks the minister about the 'Vaargeul Walvischstaart' alternative to the Hedwigepolder de-poldering, including a report by a nautical adviser and whether the idea was discussed at the ministry. The minister says the studies and report are not known to him, that Rijkswaterstaat judged rerouting the channel unnecessary and risky, and sees no need for further research.
Rijkswaterstaat indicated at the time that rerouting the shipping route from Oostgat to Walvischstaart was not necessary from a nautical safety perspective.
Door Rijkswaterstaat is destijds aangegeven dat een vaarrouteverlegging van Oostgat naar Walvischstaart vanuit het oogpunt van nautische veiligheid niet noodzakelijk was.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Monasch over de voorgenomen gemeentelijke herindeling van Haren, Ten Boer en Groningen

An MP asked the Minister of the Interior whether the province of Groningen's postponement decision on Haren's 2017 budget should delay the assessment of the proposed municipal merger and the preparation of a merger bill, and whether a second opinion from COELO should be requested. The minister answered that there is no link between the provincial postponement and the merger timetable, that the four-month deadline for sending a merger proposal to cabinet will be kept, and that there is no indication the province will assess the budget inadequately, so no second opinion is planned.
In my view there is no link between the provincial postponement decision on approval of the municipal budget 2017 and the progress of any possible merger.
Naar mijn oordeel ontbreekt een relatie tussen het verdagingsbesluit van de provincie omtrent de goedkeuring van de gemeentelijke begroting 2017 en de voortgang van een eventuele herindeling.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Monasch over het behoud van de unieke stripverzameling Matla, de grootste collectie stripverzameling in Nederland (170.000 boeken en tijdschriften), die gereed staat voor overdracht naar de

An MP asked the minister whether the government would help finance the purchase of the Matla comic book collection by the Koninklijke Bibliotheek, to prevent it being sold to private owners, and what would happen if no agreement on price is reached. The minister acknowledged the collection's cultural value, referred the MP to the Mondriaan Fonds for possible funding, and declined to speculate on consequences of a failed acquisition.

There is little point in anticipating the ongoing negotiations between the KB and potential sponsors from the cultural field or speculating on possible consequences if the KB cannot acquire the collection.

Het heeft weinig zin vooruit te lopen op de lopende onderhandelingen tussen de KB en potentiële sponsoren uit het culturele veld en te speculeren op eventuele consequenties als de KB de collectie niet kan verwerven.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Monasch over het bericht van bestuursvoorzitter van het VU medisch centrum: Wouter Bos bepleit winstplafond voor farmabedrijven

An MP asked the health minister whether she supports a profit cap on pharmaceutical companies, proposed by a hospital director, and whether her existing pricing policy is adequate. The minister agrees excessive margins are undesirable but rejects a profit cap as unworkable due to international operation, enforcement difficulties and EU law, while pointing to transparency demands and a package of pricing and business-model measures.
Requiring pharmaceutical companies to make the development costs of a medicine transparent is not simply possible.
Farmaceutische bedrijven verplichten tot het inzichtelijk maken van de ontwikkelkosten van een medicijn is overigens niet zomaar mogelijk.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Monasch en Pechtold over het bericht dat de koninklijke familie heimelijk erfgoed heeft verkocht zonder dit eerst aan Nederlandse musea aan te bieden

MPs Monasch and Pechtold asked about reports that the royal family secretly sold heritage (an atlas and the painting Boschbrand) without first offering it to Dutch museums. The minister answered that the sales were private transactions within existing law, that the export permit followed the normal review, and that the works were private property, without committing to new action.
It concerns a private matter. This sale between private parties took place in accordance with the applicable laws and regulations.
Het betreft een privéaangelegenheid. Deze verkoop tussen particulieren is tot stand gekomen in overeenstemming met de geldende wet- en regelgeving.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Monasch, Van Dekken en Nijboer over Het bericht 'Lijmklassieker blijft een succes' en de problemen met de Europese regelgeving

Three PvdA MPs asked the government whether new EU limits on lead migration in children's toys and paints, which they claimed make paint production impossible, are justified and whether the government has acted on such regulation. The Minister of Health answered that the limit is a migration limit that is 340 times stricter than the drinking water standard, that production is not made impossible, that no cases of EU rules burdening entrepreneurs are known, and that no action has been taken because there is no reason to.
No. The limit value for migration of lead in this type of toy is currently 3.4 mg/kg.
Nee. De grenswaarde voor migratie van lood in dit type speelgoed is op dit moment 3,4 mg/kg
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Monasch en Van Helvert over het bericht ‘Schiphol dreigt veel eerder ‘vol’ te raken dan voorzien’

MPs Monasch and Van Helvert asked the state secretary about reports that Schiphol may reach its capacity limit sooner than expected, the number of night flights, and whether Schiphol is breaching the Alders agreement. The state secretary confirmed that the 500,000-movement limit is coming into view sooner, that night flights are expected to reach about 31,600, and that the Omgevingsraad talks are ongoing, with a plan of action due by 1 December 2016 and a new noise calculation planned.
I have now called on the ORS to come up with a plan of action for the entire advice request by 1 December 2016.
Ik heb inmiddels de ORS opgeroepen om uiterlijk 1 december 2016 met een plan van aanpak te komen voor de gehele adviesaanvraag.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Monasch over het bericht “Bureaucratie remt ontwikkeling Dronetechnologie”

MP Monasch asked the State Secretary whether bureaucracy is slowing drone technology development, including the authorisation of test centres. The government answered that a lighter mini-drone regulation took effect on 1 July 2016, that test-centre applications are handled with ILT and that new regulation to facilitate testing is being prepared.
The cabinet is preparing regulation to further facilitate the conduct of flights for testing and experimenting with drones.
Het kabinet is regelgeving aan het voorbereiden om de uitvoering van vluchten ten behoeve van testen van en experimenteren met drones verder te faciliteren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jacobi en Monasch over het bericht ‘Modewinkelier staat voor het blok’

MPs Jacobi and Monasch asked the Minister of Economic Affairs whether commission-based platforms like Zalando threaten retailers, including price rises, abuse of dominance under the Competition Act and unfair trading rules. The minister answered that platforms offer benefits, that retailers can choose to leave, that the ACM rather than the minister assesses abuse of dominance and complaints can be filed there, and that unfair-practice rules protect consumers rather than imposing duties on platforms toward retailers.
It is up to the entrepreneur to decide whether he wishes to use a specific platform as a sales channel.
Het is aan een ondernemer zelf om te bepalen of hij gebruik wil maken van een specifiek platform als verkoopkanaal.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kerstens, Monasch en Jacobi over de verscherpte Stempelplicht Opvarenden van de Zeehavenpolitie Rotterdam

MPs Kerstens, Monasch and Jacobi asked whether the Rotterdam Seaport Police has tightened application of the Schengen Borders Code, shortening stays of foreign crew and limiting shipowners' freedom to deploy their crews, and why existing practice was abandoned. The government answers that the police apply the Code no more strictly than before, that exit stamps are given only when departure is imminent (about 300 persons were not stamped), and that it will work with the sector until 1 October to reach a workable implementation.
The Rotterdam Seaport Police does not apply the Schengen Borders Code more strictly than before.
De Zeehavenpolitie Rotterdam past de Schengengrenscode niet strikter toe dan voorheen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kerstens, Monasch en Jacobi over ‘Toezichthouders MCL gaan er fors op vooruit’ (HERDRUK)

MPs Kerstens, Monasch and Jacobi asked whether the Wet normering topinkomens, which raised the maximum pay for supervisory board members, invites supervisors to rush to the new maximum, especially in healthcare, and whether the stated reason for the increase (compensating for lower executive pay) was accurate. The minister answered that the increase reflects broader supervisory roles and greater actual time spent, that individual agreements must stay within the law, and that the increase was separately motivated in the legislative process.
Any increases in remuneration must also be seen in the context of this broadening of roles, responsibilities and time commitment.
Eventuele verhogingen van de bezoldiging moeten ook in het kader van deze verruiming van de rollen, verantwoordelijkheden en tijdsbesteding worden gezien.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kerstens en Monasch over topinkomens bij Luchtverkeersleiding Nederland (HERDRUK)

MPs Kerstens and Monasch asked how top-salary rules (WNT) apply to top officials at Luchtverkeersleiding Nederland after the organisation's management team structure was changed, and whether the rules can be circumvented. Minister Blok answered that the WNT applies based on actual leadership rather than formal structure, that the supervisor is the Eenheid toezicht WNT, that a legislative extension to all employees is in preparation, and that enforcement will follow if formal changes do not reflect actual practice.
Only if it is established that the officials concerned in practice have continued to provide leadership will enforcement action be taken.
Alleen indien komt vast te staan dat de betrokken functionarissen in de praktijk gewoon leiding zijn blijven geven, kan en zal handhavend worden optreden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kerstens, Jacobi en Monasch over het bericht ‘Grote misstanden bij aanleg Friese autoweg’

MPs Kerstens, Jacobi and Monasch asked Minister Asscher about FNV reports of systematic underpayment of workers on the Friesland road project 'De Centrale As', and about the responsibilities of contracting authorities under the Wet Aanpak Schijnconstructies. The minister said he could not judge the allegations, pointed to social partners and the Inspectorate SZW as the proper investigators, and described contractor liability and existing information efforts for lower governments, while committing to monitoring the law but not to new action.
It is extremely difficult for me to form a judgement on the FNV's allegations of underpayment by parties involved in the construction of 'De Centrale As'.
Het is voor mij buitengewoon lastig om mij een oordeel te vormen over de door de FNV gedane beweringen t.a.v. onderbetaling door partijen die bij de aanleg van «De Centrale As» zijn betrokken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jacobi en Monasch over de mogelijkheid voor consumenten om bij annulering van een vliegticket deze over te kunnen dragen aan een ander

MPs Jacobi and Monasch asked why consumers can transfer package holidays but not airline tickets, and whether the government would allow resale of cancelled flight tickets as proposed by TradeYourTrip. The minister answered that package transfers are governed by Civil Code rules, airline resale is banned by IATA-based airline terms, and that the government will consult industry and consumer groups and examine feasibility, fraud and safety implications.

I will, together with the State Secretary for Infrastructure and the Environment, enter into discussions with the Consumentenbond, industry bodies such as ANVR and BARIN, and airlines to discuss the possibilities and implications.

Ik zal in samenwerking met de Staatssecretaris van Infrastructuur en Milieu in gesprek gaan met de Consumentenbond, brancheorganisaties zoals de ANVR en de BARIN en luchtvaartmaatschappijen om de mogelijkheden en implicaties te bespreken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jacobi en Monasch over de zorgen van waterschappen over de verdieping van de Nieuwe Waterweg en de Botlek

Two PvdA MPs asked the minister about water boards' concerns over deepening the Nieuwe Waterweg and Botlek, including salinisation, groundwater, freshwater supply and whether source-based mitigation was considered beyond compensation. The minister answered that source measures are not feasible per the MER, that the permit procedure is ongoing and monitoring and conditions will be set in the Ontgrondingenwet permit, while declining to anticipate the draft decision.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Monasch en Cegerek over de financiering van de restauratie van de Eusebiuskerk in Arnhem

MPs Monasch and Cegerek asked the Minister of Education, Culture and Science about funding for restoring the Eusebius church in Arnhem, including past state subsidies, Brim maintenance subsidy eligibility, and the provincial role. The minister answered that the church is important, outlined subsidy history, explained that Brim covers only maintenance and that provinces manage restoration funds, and said a joint approach will be discussed after an inventory due before summer.
It is important to get an overall picture of cases that may pose a bottleneck for provinces, as is currently the case with the Eusebius.
Het is van belang om een totaalbeeld te krijgen van gevallen die mogelijk een knelpunt kunnen zijn voor provincies, zoals dat nu het geval is met de Eusebius.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Monasch over het bericht “betalen is brevet behalen”

An MP asked the state secretary about a report on the CAE Oxford Aviation Academy Amsterdam, including its oversight, the loosening of training requirements, the lack of sanctions, profit motives, and ABN AMRO ending pilot loans. The secretary said oversight passed to the British authority in 2014, that EU standards were unchanged, that access to training is mainly a sector matter, and that she will facilitate talks between the parties.
Since that date, supervision has been carried out by the British authority.
Sinds die datum vindt toezicht plaats door de Britse autoriteit.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Monasch en Marcouch over passagiers die grote vertraging hebben opgelopen op Schiphol door een overboekt vliegtuig

MPs Monasch and Marcouch asked the state secretary about passengers held for hours on an Air Arabia flight from Amsterdam to Nador, and how compensation, enforcement and in-flight care are handled. The government answered that a sudden crew illness forced offloading of 21 passengers on a voluntary basis, that the ILT found no violation, and that the ILT enforces the EU passenger rights regulation through complaints and inspections.
Based on the information currently available, the ILT has found no violation, so enforcement action is not at issue.
Op basis van de nu beschikbare informatie heeft de ILT geen overtreding geconstateerd, daarom is optreden niet aan de orde.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Monasch over het artikel uit het Financieel Dagblad van 29 februari 2016 over ‘ABN AMRO staakt financiering pilotenopleiding’

An MP asked the State Secretary whether ABN AMRO withdrawing financing for pilot training makes the training inaccessible, what alternatives exist, and what the government will do to safeguard quality and access. The State Secretary answered that pilot training is primarily the sector's responsibility, that quality is guaranteed through EASA rules and inspection, and that she will facilitate talks between the parties and report back.
The pilot training institutions are private bodies and are primarily a matter for the aviation sector.
De pilotenopleidingen zijn private instellingen en zijn primair een aangelegenheid van de luchtvaartsector.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Günal-Gezer, Albert de Vries en Monasch over het bericht 'Amper profijt Zeeuwse bedrijven bij bouw marinierskazerne'

Three PvdA MPs asked the Defence and Economic Affairs ministers whether tender specifications for the marine barracks construction could favour regional firms in Zeeland, and why such room is possible in other public tenders but not here. The minister answered that favouring local firms through specification requirements is not permitted under procurement law, and that regional businesses can instead take part via consortia or as subcontractors.
Making room for local businesses in the programme of requirements leads to favouring those businesses and is not permitted.
Ruimte maken voor lokale bedrijven in het programma van eisen leidt tot bevoordeling van deze bedrijven en is niet toegestaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Monasch over het onderzoek dat loopt naar de mogelijkheden om piloten met Insulin-Treated Diabetes Mellitus (ITDM) alsnog te laten vliegen

An MP asked whether the Dutch government would join the UK study allowing pilots with insulin-treated diabetes to fly, and whether it would commission a second opinion on the restrictions imposed. The State Secretary answered that the UK authority would not accept the additional Dutch conditions (no take-offs/landings, third pilot only), so the government will await the UK study results and EASA's follow-up and sees no added value in a second opinion now.
I am awaiting the results of the British study and any follow-up steps by EASA.
Ik wacht de resultaten van het Britse onderzoek af en de eventuele vervolgstappen van EASA.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kerstens, Vermeij en Monasch over het faillissement van Dolcis, Invito, Manfield, Pro Sport en Steve Madden

Three PvdA MPs asked the ministers of Economic Affairs and Social Affairs about the bankruptcy of Dolcis, Invito, Manfield, Pro Sport and Steve Madden, and whether the government would help preserve jobs and engage the retail sector. The minister said the ministry is actively involved behind the scenes, that sales of much of the Macintosh group are advanced, and that retail partners are exploring acceleration of the Retailagenda and transition support for workers.
My ministry has been involved in the bankruptcy process since late December and takes an active stance behind the scenes.
Mijn ministerie is sinds eind december betrokken bij het faillissementsproces en neemt achter de schermen een actieve houding aan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Cegerek en Monasch over het faillissement van onder andere V&D en Macintosh

MPs Cegerek and Monasch asked about the bankruptcies of V&D and Macintosh, the risk of retail vacancy, and why the ministers suspended parts of Zuid-Holland's retail ordinance without informing parliament. The government answered that restructuring is underway, pointed to the Retailagenda and Retaildeals, and explained that suspension was justified by doubts about compliance with national and EU law, with the provincial dispute still pending.
When there is genuine doubt that this is being complied with, intervention is necessary.
Wanneer er gerede twijfel is dat hier niet aan wordt voldaan, is ingrijpen noodzakelijk.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jacobi en Monasch inzake de gaswinning in Súdwest-Fryslân

Two PvdA MPs asked the Minister of Economic Affairs why he proceeds with the Oppenhuizen gas extraction and pipeline despite opposition from the municipality and province, and about the peat soil, the expected subsidence and the scale of the field. The minister replied that he is legally bound to decide on the winning plan regardless of local opposition, that subsidence will be assessed and monitored by Staatstoezicht op de Mijnen and TNO with mandatory plan revision if it deviates, and that Vermilion will engage in local consultations and agreements.
This political position of the municipality and province does not, however, release me from my legal responsibilities and the applicable legal framework.
Deze politieke stellingname van gemeente en provincie ontslaat mij echter niet van mijn wettelijke verantwoordelijkheden en de daarbij geldende wettelijke kaders.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kerstens, Otwin van Dijk en Monasch over het bericht “Salaris bobo's Friese thuiszorg verdubbeld”

MPs asked the government about reports that supervisory board pay at home-care organisation Patyna had doubled and whether this complies with the Wet Normering Topinkomens. The minister answered that the board pay was reversed, stays at prior levels, falls within WNT limits as far as applicable, and that setting pay and consulting staff are the organisation's own responsibility.
Within the limits set by law, in particular the WNT, it is for the institution and the top official to determine what constitutes appropriate remuneration.
Binnen de grenzen die de wet, in het bijzonder de WNT, stelt is het aan de instelling en de topfunctionaris om te bepalen wat een passende beloning is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Monasch over het artikel ‘Schiphol kan verder met uitbreiding’

An MP asks the state secretary about the demolition of Vrachtgebouw 1 at Schiphol, the expected decline in freight volume after Martinair's fleet reductions, and the value of freight to the Schiphol mainport. The state secretary answers that freight capacity is not materially affected, that Air France KLM will keep a substantial freight fleet, and that freight and passenger traffic both matter to the mainport, with an Actieagenda Schiphol to address freight.
This has no effect on the development of freight traffic at Schiphol.
Dit heeft geen effect op de ontwikkeling van het vrachtverkeer op Schiphol.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Nijboer en Monasch over de ondoorzichtige kostenstructuur die banken hanteren bij valutatransacties voor het MKB

MPs Nijboer and Monasch asked the Finance Minister whether banks' cost structures for foreign currency transactions for SMEs are opaque and whether margins reach hundreds of percent. The minister answered that banks say they are transparent and charge fair prices, that the minister has no view of their margins, and that SME clients should compare offers across providers.
I have no insight into the profit margins of banks on foreign currency transactions for SMEs.
Ik heb geen zicht op de winstmarges van banken op valutatransacties voor het MKB.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Monasch en Groot over het artikel ‘Toeristenbelasting is een melkkoe’

MPs Monasch and Groot asked about a report that municipal tourist tax is a cash cow, with hotels and bungalow parks charging guests more than the municipal rate, and whether this breaches advertising rules and is lawful. The minister confirms hoteliers may pass on the tax under article 224 Gemeentewet, says overcharging would be undue payment and misleading, and leaves enforcement to the consumer authority ACM and courts while declining to judge specific conduct.
It is not correct to withhold more tourist tax than the municipality in question charges.
Het is daarbij niet juist om meer in te houden aan toeristenbelasting dan dat door de desbetreffende gemeente in rekening wordt gebracht.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Monasch inzake de onevenwichtige spreiding van cultuursubsidies over het land

An MP asked the Minister of Education, Culture and Science about the concentration of a Mondriaan Fonds heritage grant in the Randstad and Amsterdam, and whether the Minister would address the imbalance. The Minister confirmed the figures (14 of 20 grants in the Randstad, 47% of applicants and grants in the Randstad across all Mondriaan schemes), said she did not share the surprise given these proportions, and promised a separate letter on regional distribution of arts subsidies.
I asked your House to put your questions on paper. I will then send your House a letter answering these questions.
Ik heb uw Kamer gevraagd uw vragen op papier te zetten. Vervolgens stuur ik uw Kamer een brief met een antwoord op deze vragen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Monasch inzake de aanwijzing van Professionele Organisaties voor Monumentenbehoud

An MP asked the Education, Culture and Science minister about the POM status for heritage organisations, including the rejection of Alde Fryske Tjerken, the falling AOM status, volunteer impact, administrative burden and evaluation. The minister said the criteria are stricter to raise professionalism, reported application numbers, and promised to keep the scheme largely unchanged until 2018 with an evaluation around 2017.

I have asked the Council to advise me on how things have gone so far and how the Council, the designated POMs and the Cultural Heritage Agency can work together to help more organisations reach the level needed to qualify as POM.

Ik heb de Raad gevraagd om mij te adviseren over de gang van zaken tot dusver en hoe de Raad, de aangewezen POM's en de Rijksdienst voor het Cultureel Erfgoed, zich in kunnen spannen om meer organisaties het niveau te laten bereiken om als POM gekwalificeerd te kunnen worden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Monasch en Mei Li Vos over de artikelen ‘Ce que veut faire Air France-KLM avec ses deux Transavia (La Tribune, 4 november 2015) en ‘Strijd om Transavia’

Two MPs asked the government about reported plans to merge or restructure the governance of Transavia Holland and Transavia France within Air France-KLM, and whether this threatens KLM and Schiphol's network. The government confirmed talks are ongoing, said Transavia France does not fly from Schiphol, stressed the importance of KLM and Schiphol's network, and said it raised concerns with Air France-KLM, without committing to a concrete binding step.
As for possible changes in the governance structure of Transavia Netherlands, no definitive answer can yet be given, because for this airline the talks are still ongoing.
Wat betreft mogelijke wijzigingen in de governancestructuur van Transavia Nederland is nog geen uitsluitsel te geven, omdat wat deze luchtvaartmaatschappij betreft de gesprekken nog lopen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Monasch en Mei Li Vos over het artikel “Air France-KLM topman komt Franse staat tegemoet”

MPs Monasch and Mei Li Vos asked whether Air France-KLM's leadership was backing away from reorganisation plans, whether this shifts losses onto KLM, and whether the Dutch state should take a larger shareholding. The government denies reversing the plans, says it is seeking alternative cost reductions, and declines to take up a larger stake for now while maintaining contact with French counterparts.
Should the Dutch state also acquire a stake at least equal to the French stake in Air France-KLM to strengthen the position of Dutch interests within the holding?
Vraag 7 Zou de Nederlandse staat ook een aandeel gelijk aan tenminste het Franse aandeel moeten krijgen in Air France-KLM om de positie van de Nederlandse belangen binnen de holding te versterken?
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Monasch over de voorgenomen subsidiëring van particulier bezit door woningcorporaties in Rotterdam

An MP asked whether Rotterdam housing associations may subsidise private homeowners with 2 million euros, whether the Rijk's 30 million euro contribution could fund it, and whether the Ministry would act. The minister said such subsidy does not fit the core tasks of associations, that the Rijk's funds were not used for it, and that the Autoriteit woningcorporaties has asked the associations for information and will enforce if activities fall outside the legal framework.

The Autoriteit woningcorporaties has asked the Rotterdam associations to report which activities they carry out regarding maintenance of third-party property and under which regulations obligations for these activities were entered into.

De Autoriteit woningcorporaties heeft de Rotterdamse corporaties verzocht te melden welke activiteiten worden verricht ten aanzien van het onderhoud van bezit van derden en onder welke regelgeving verplichtingen voor deze activiteiten zijn aangegaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Monasch over de renovatiewerkzaamheden van flats in Soest van woningcorporatie Portaal

An MP asked the Minister of Housing about a troubled renovation of flats in Soest by housing corporation Portaal, covering delays, nuisance, temporary housing, asbestos and safety, and forged handover signatures. The minister acknowledged the renovation went badly and that the corporation and municipality took corrective steps, but said the national government has no direct role and the municipality and corporation are responsible.
There is no role here for the supervisor of housing corporations.
Er is in deze geen sprake van een rol voor de toezichthouder op corporaties.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Oosenbrug en Monasch over de dreigende 'digitale dementie' in het openbaar bestuur

MPs Oosenbrug and Monasch asked whether the government shares mayors' concerns about 'digital dementia' in public administration, meaning the risk that digital records of government action are poorly archived and lost, and what oversight and responsibility exist for archiving at all levels. The minister acknowledged the concern, described archiving initiatives (e-depot, Archief 2020, AIDO) and said provinces oversee municipalities' and water boards' archiving under the Gemeentewet, while the ministers' responsibility is limited to the legal framework.
The management of digital documents is not arranged in such a way that their findability is guaranteed.
Het beheer van digitale documenten is niet dusdanig geregeld dat de terugvindbaarheid daarvan gegarandeerd is.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kerstens en Monasch over de WNT-staffel voor de sector woningcorporaties

Two MPs asked the government about the WNT pay-cap staffel (salary scale) for housing corporations, including whether talks with Aedes had taken place and whether the staffel would be published by 1 June. The minister answered that the sector bodies had submitted a proposal within the lowered WNT norm and that the Chamber would be informed in June, with formal adoption in November.
For the housing corporations, I expect to be able to give your Chamber and the sector clarity on the staffel for 2016 in June.
Voor wat betreft de woningcorporaties, zal ik uw Kamer en de sector naar verwachting in juni duidelijkheid kunnen bieden over de staffel voor 2016.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Monasch en Mohandis over te dure studentenkamers

MPs Monasch and Mohandis asked the minister about student room rents said to be too high, the LSVb findings, possible tougher rules against landlords, how students use rent-review routes, and whether the student housing action plan will ease scarcity. The minister acknowledged the concern, committed to tracking affordability in the monitor, saw no reason to abandon freedom of contract, described the Huurcommissie procedures as accessible, and gave supply figures with a promise of a later update.
From 2015 onward, affordability will be included as a regular indicator in the National Student Housing Monitor to gain better insight into the affordability problem for students.
Vanaf 2015 wordt in de Landelijke Monitor Studentenhuisvesting betaalbaarheid als reguliere meetindicator opgenomen om beter inzicht te krijgen in de betaalbaarheidproblematiek voor studenten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Monasch en Groot over het bericht  ’Amsterdamse verhuurders in de fout met inkomensdata’

MPs Monasch and Groot asked the minister whether Amsterdam landlords wrongly requested income indications for tenants with liberalised leases, and whether such landlords should be denied portal access and rent increases reversed. The minister answered that such requests are unlawful, that the Tax Authority sanctions repeat or deliberate misuse by revoking portal access, and that in 2014 only warning letters were issued, with two landlords now warned.
Landlords who nonetheless include addresses with a liberalised lease in their request file violate both the law and the terms of use of the web portal.
Verhuurders die toch adressen met een geliberaliseerd huurcontract in hun opvraagbestand opnemen, overtreden de wet èn de gebruiksvoorwaarden van het webportaal.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Monasch over de verkoop van al het sociale woningbezit van het Wooninvesteringsfonds

An MP asks whether legal objections delaying the sale of Round Hill prevent the Wooninvesteringsfonds from repaying its bank loans, what financing options it has, and why the board pursued a sale rather than refinancing against the wishes of certificate holders. The minister confirms the delay, states that bridge financing runs to 1 July 2015, and says no parties were willing to refinance or inject capital, so sale was the only option.
Sale was therefore at the end of 2014 the only solution to repay the loan by 31 March 2015.
Verkoop was derhalve eind 2014 de enige oplossing om tot aflossing van de lening per 31 maart 2015 te komen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Monasch over de gevolgen van de bezuinigingen op culturele instellingen

Mr Monasch (PvdA) asked the Minister of Education, Culture and Science whether the cancellation of concerts by HET Symfonieorkest signals financial distress, whether cultural institutions are drawing down reserves and struggling to raise private income, and how successful institutions will be supported under new subsidy allocation. The Minister answered that continuity of the orchestra is not at risk, that institutions are responsible for adapting their activities, that quick-scans of institutions' finances will be published in June, and that cultural policy guidelines will follow.
This spring, before the cultural policy guidelines letter is published, I will have two quick-scans carried out.
Dit voorjaar laat ik, nog voor de uitgangspuntenbrief cultuur verschijnt, twee quick-scans uitvoeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Monasch over woningcorporatie Vestia

MP Monasch (PvdA) asked the minister how market interest rates and Vestia's liquidity would develop, and when Vestia would switch from selling homes to continuing to operate them. The minister said he could not forecast the market rate, described Vestia's liquidity improvement and the conditions (rate thresholds of 4% and 3%) under which its sales strategy would change, while noting the CFV is already discussing alternatives with Vestia.
I cannot estimate how market interest rates will develop in the coming years.
Ik kan niet inschatten wat de ontwikkeling is van de marktrente in de komende jaren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Monasch en Bergkamp over het Filmfonds, de stimulering van de productie van televisieseries in Nederland en oneerlijke concurrentie uit het buitenland

MPs Monasch and Bergkamp asked whether TV series such as Homeland could be supported by the Netherlands Film Production Incentive and whether foreign incentives create an unfair playing field. The minister answered that series are not eligible because extending the scheme would crowd out film funding within the current 20 million euro budget, and that she will consult the Filmfonds and others after the Raad voor Cultuur advice.
Extra budget for the scheme is not available.
Extra budget voor de regeling is niet voorhanden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Monasch en Van der Linde over beschikbaar kapitaal voor woningen dat niet geïnvesteerd kan worden

MPs Monasch and Van der Linde asked whether they know that around 650 million euro of investable capital cannot be placed in housing due to a lack of products, and asked about the causes (land prices) and solutions. The minister answers that record investment of about 3 billion euro was made in 2014, that the market should balance supply and demand without a direct government matching role, and points to housing reforms, corporate sales to investors and transformation of vacant buildings.
It is up to the market itself to bring about a balance between supply and demand.
Het is aan de markt zelf om een balans tussen vraag en aanbod tot stand te laten komen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Monasch over de verkoop van sociaal bezit door het Woninginvesteringsfonds

An MP asked the minister about the planned sale of about 3,800 social rental homes by the Woninginvesteringsfonds to Round Hill, including the bidding process, certificate-holder and municipal opposition, leakage of social capital abroad, refinancing as an alternative, and whether the sale can be stopped. The minister answered that the ILT, acting independently, approved the sale on 5 February 2015 after a sales process, that the sale is at market value, and that objections are open through the normal appeal route, so no irreversible step is being halted.
The ILT approved the sale on 5 February 2015.
De ILT heeft de verkoop op 5 februari 2015 goedgekeurd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Monasch en Wolbert over de Stichting Maatschappij der Weldadigheid te Frederiksoord

MPs Monasch and Wolbert asked the minister about the Stichting Maatschappij der Weldadigheid in Frederiksoord, whose high WOZ-based landlord levy and monumental housing may hinder renovation and preservation. The minister answered that the levy burden follows from low rents relative to property values, that monumental homes do not face special obstacles, and that the position of such landlords will be reviewed in the 2016 evaluation of the levy.
However, the evaluation of the landlord levy, which I will send to your House in 2016, will also pay attention to the position of this type of landlord.
Wel zal in de evaluatie van de verhuurderheffing, die ik in 2016 aan uw Kamer zal doen toekomen, ook aandacht geschonken worden aan de positie van dit type verhuurders.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kerstens en Monasch over de salarissen van bestuurders van woningcorporaties

MPs Kerstens and Monasch asked the government about housing corporation executive salaries exceeding WNT norms, salary increases in 2013, transitional rules, and whether bonuses were paid unlawfully. The Minister answered that 44 of 728 top officials exceeded the 2013 norm, that the 2013 regulation was set aside so some pay rises were lawful under transitional rules, that no unlawful bonuses are known, and that the government will not interfere with transitional rights but welcomes voluntary restraint.
I have received no information showing that there are unlawful bonuses.
Mij heeft geen informatie bereikt waaruit blijkt dat er sprake is van onrechtmatige bonussen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Monasch en Van Dekken over doorverkoop van toegangsbewijzen voor concerten

MPs Monasch and Van Dekken asked the ministers about resellers selling concert tickets before official sales start, unusable tickets, and whether this amounts to internet fraud. The government answered that such resale is not per se unlawful but must be clearly disclosed, that consumers and the ACM have remedies, and that a bill criminalising professional internet non-performance is expected in 2015.
We have no insight into the nature and extent of the risk buyers face when purchasing resold entrance tickets.
Wij hebben geen inzicht in de aard en omvang van het risico dat kopers lopen bij de aankoop van doorverkochte toegangskaarten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Monasch over de mogelijkheden van collega woningcorporaties om Vestia bezit over te nemen

An MP asked whether local housing associations should get a first right to buy Vestia's Den Bosch housing stock rather than foreign investor Patrizia. The minister answered that sales rules allow deviating from the offering order for rescue corporations, that the ILT assesses the sale by weighing interests, and that corporation interest is considered but a first right of purchase is not preferred.
As indicated, housing associations were able to show their interest through the public offering and at Vestia's invitation. I do not consider further research into this necessary.
Zoals aangegeven hebben woningcorporaties via de openbare aanbieding en op uitnodiging van Vestia hun belangstelling kunnen tonen. Nader onderzoek daarnaar acht ik niet nodig.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Monasch over de gevolgen van de toename in de uitstroom van erkende asielzoekers uit de reguliere opvangcentra op het aanbod van beschikbare woningen

MP Monasch asked the minister about the surge in recognised asylum seekers leaving reception centres and competing for regular social rental housing, and whether the national housing quota could be met within the existing stock. Minister Blok answered that municipalities and housing associations are primarily responsible, that the 2015 quota of about 14,450 homes is roughly 6% of annual turnover, and that he will not impose redistribution of the quota between municipalities from above, while a platform with VNG and ministries is being set up.
I do not intend to impose the redistribution of the quota between municipalities from above.
Ik ben niet voornemens om de herverdeling van de taakstelling tussen gemeenten onderling van bovenaf op te leggen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Albert de Vries en Monasch over het bericht dat de gasleiding van honderdduizenden Nederlanders lekt

MPs Albert de Vries and Monasch asked about reports that gas pipes leak in hundreds of thousands of homes, including claims of explosion risk, deaths, lost gas, lapsed municipal inspections and a periodic inspection scheme. The minister answered that leaks are rare and mainly in older homes, that owners are responsible under the Building Decree, that a national inspection programme is not justified, and that a possible ministerial regulation will be explored with municipalities and report in 2015.
The Minister for Housing and Central Government Organisation will take the initiative for this exploration and will inform the House of Representatives further on its results in 2015.
De Minister voor Wonen en Rijksdienst zal het initiatief nemen voor deze verkenning en zal in 2015 de Tweede Kamer nader informeren over de resultaten hiervan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Monasch over de voorgenomen verkoop door Ymere van 180 woningen in Amsterdam

An MP asked the minister whether Ymere's plan to evict 180 tenants in Amsterdam Centrum via dringend eigen gebruik to sell the homes is lawful, and how renovation costs and sociale huur segregation bear on it. The minister answered that sale alone cannot justify dringend eigen gebruik, that courts decide case by case considering renovation necessity and tenant interests, and that Amsterdam sets its own housing agenda.
If sale of the dwelling is the sole objective, a landlord's invocation of urgent own use upon termination of tenancy is therefore not permitted.
Als verkoop van de woning de enige doelstelling is, is een beroep van een verhuur op dringend eigen gebruik bij huuropzegging dus niet toegestaan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Monasch en Hamer over het bericht dat de grenzen wagenwijd open staan voor buitenlandse bouwers

MPs Monasch and Hamer asked whether German administrative requirements imposed on Dutch construction firms, such as prior registration of workers and posting of deposits, conflict with EU free movement and whether Dutch SMEs can be protected, including via a LIMOSA-type register. The minister replied that host-state rules must be necessary and proportionate, that the government will push for reduction of disproportionate requirements, and that a registration system and identity passes are being considered in implementing the new enforcement directive.
The Netherlands is currently examining which control measures it wishes to adopt and will make a proposal for this when implementing the Enforcement Directive.
Nederland beziet thans welke controlemaatregelen zij wenst over te nemen en zal hiervoor een voorstel doen bij de implementatie van de Handhavingsrichtlijn.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Monasch over de bescherming van maritiem historisch erfgoed naar aanleiding van het bericht dat de SS Rosalie is verkocht en zal worden versleept naar Turkije

An MP asked the Minister of Education, Culture and Science why the historic steamship SS Rosalie, subsidised by the Mondriaan Fund, could be sold and towed to Turkey, and whether its export could be halted or the sale price disclosed. The minister answered that no return condition applied, the price is a private matter, the export licence was lawfully granted after the Erfgoedinspectie raised no objection, and suspending the export is not legally possible.
I do not see it as my task to disclose the sale price, of which I am in any case not aware, as it was determined by a private transaction.
Ik zie het niet als mijn taak om de hoogte van de verkoopprijs, waar ik overigens niet van op de hoogte ben, en die door een particuliere transactie is bepaald, openbaar te maken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hoogland, Jacobi en Monasch over de spoorverbinding met Leeuwarden in verband met het besluit Leeuwarden te nomineren als Culturele Hoofdstad 2018

Three PvdA MPs asked the state secretary how rail services to Leeuwarden will cope with extra visitors if it is Culturele Hoofdstad 2018, and whether NS will offer incentives or a cultural-capital train. The state secretary answered that rail choice is up to travellers, that organisers should contact NS early about visitor numbers, that discounts and marketing are commercial matters for NS, and that Leeuwarden and NS should take up the train-promotion ideas themselves.
This is primarily a consideration for NS.
Dit is primair een afweging voor NS.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Monasch en Albert de Vries over de kosten van een hypotheek in krimpgebieden

Two MPs asked whether mortgages are more expensive in shrinking regions, whether this lowers housing demand, and whether lenders may impose such costs given mortgage rules and the tax deduction. The minister answered that the NVM and lenders do not recognise higher rates in specific regions, that rates reflect demonstrable risk, and that lenders' code bars refusing applications solely on location.

Lenders have, through the Mortgage Lending Code of Conduct, committed to the rule that the mere fact that the mortgaged home is located in a particular district or postcode area may not be grounds to reject the application in its entirety.

Financiers hebben zich middels de Gedragscode Hypothecaire Financieringen wel gebonden aan de bepaling dat het enkele feit dat de hypothecair te verbinden woning is gelegen in een bepaalde wijk of postcodegebied geen grond mag zijn om de aanvraag in zijn geheel af te wijzen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Albert de Vries en Monasch over de berichtgeving omtrent zijn werkbezoek aan Noordoost-Friesland

MPs Albert de Vries and Monasch asked minister Blok whether he told Northeast Friesland it cannot expect help from The Hague in tackling population decline, and whether rules that hinder the response will be reviewed. The minister confirmed the remark, said the regions bear primary responsibility while the state provides conditions and support, and pointed to existing tools and an inventory of obstacles.
I did indeed indicate on site that no ready-made solutions can come from The Hague for the shrinking and anticipating regions.
Ik heb inderdaad ter plaatse aangegeven dat er geen kant en klare oplossingen vanuit Den Haag kunnen komen voor de krimp- en anticipeerregio's.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Monasch over het bericht dat corporatiedirecteuren in Limburg massaal salarisverhoging krijgen, tegen de nieuwe salarisnorm in

Monasch (PvdA) asked whether pay rises for housing corporation directors in Limburg, reported as breaching the new salary norm, are unacceptable and whether the minister will reverse them. Minister Blok replied that the 2012 data do not confirm the newspaper figures, that most rises matched the CAO Woondiensten, and that no reversal is possible yet under the WNT transitional rules, though action will follow if 2013 pay exceeds them.
If the accountability for pay in 2013 shows increases that do not fit within the transitional rules, action will be taken.
Indien bij de verantwoording over de bezoldiging over het jaar 2013 blijkt dat er sprake is van verhogingen die niet passen binnen het overgangsrecht dan zal worden opgetreden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Groot, Monasch en Omtzigt over het mislukken van het overleg over directe huurtoeslagbetaling aan woningbouwcorporaties

MPs Groot, Monasch and Omtzigt asked why the motion-based arrangement for direct payment of rent allowance (huurtoeslag) to housing associations failed. The State Secretary answered that housing association umbrella body Aedes judged the partnership arrangement commercially unviable, and that no alternative route for direct payment is available within the legal framework.
I see no possibilities, within the statutory scheme and the conditions attached to it, to give direct payment of rent allowance to housing corporations an alternative form.
Ik zie geen mogelijkheden om binnen de wettelijke regeling en de daarbij geldende randvoorwaarden een directe betaling van huurtoeslag aan woningcorporaties op alternatieve wijze vorm te geven.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Monasch en Groot over de gevolgen van het inflatiecijfer op de huurstijgingen

Two MPs from the Labour party asked the ministers whether the Woonbond's claim that the inflation figure inflates rent increases is valid, and whether the calculation method should be changed. The minister rejected the Woonbond's three arguments as consistent with international guidelines and declined to start a study of an alternative inflation measure.
I therefore see no reason to start a study into a different inflation figure as the basis for rent policy.
Ik zie dan ook geen aanleiding om een onderzoek te starten naar een ander inflatiecijfer als basis voor het huurbeleid.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Monasch over het rentebesluit van de ECB

MP Monasch asked whether the minister knows the ECB will keep rates low for a long time, how this affects mortgage interest deduction in the Netherlands, and whether he will consult banks about lowering mortgage rates. The minister confirmed the ECB position, explained that banks decide themselves how much of lower funding costs to pass on, and pointed to recent measures and an ACM study on competition in the mortgage market.
It is up to providers themselves to decide whether and to what extent they pass on the possible benefit of low financing costs through a lower mortgage interest rate.
Het is aan aanbieders zelf om te bepalen of en zo ja in welke mate zij het eventuele voordeel van lage financieringskosten doorberekenen middels een lagere hypotheekrente.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Monasch en Van Dekken en De Boer over het verdwijnen van de unieke collectie typemachines van de schrijver W.F. Hermans naar het buitenland

MPs asked the minister why W.F. Hermans' typewriter collection was allocated to a Belgian bookshop, whether museum rules leave a gap allowing such export, and what tools exist to keep it in the Netherlands. The minister defended the selection process, said the collection stays accessible in the Dutch-language area, stated that museum self-regulation rather than a gap explains the outcome, promised Erfgoedwet rules on state disposal of heritage, and rejected using the Wet tot behoud van cultuurbezit in this case.
I intend to regulate further, in the Heritage Act, the process by which governments, important owners of collections, dispose of cultural objects.
Ik ben voornemens in de Erfgoedwet het proces van afstoten van cultuurvoorwerpen door overheden, belangrijke eigenaars van collecties, nader te regelen
Antwoord vragen Marcouch, Heijnen en Monasch over de toekomst van het Oranjehotel Scheveningen nu het kabinet van plan is de Scheveningse gevangenis te sluiten

MPs Marcouch, Heijnen and Monasch asked whether the government still supports keeping the Oranjehotel monument (Dodencel, Poortje, Gedenkplaat) after the planned closure of the Scheveningen prison, and how its future will be secured. The state secretary confirmed the monument should be preserved, said a future design is being developed with the Stichting Oranjehotel and that the detailed plan will follow once the DJI masterplan decision is taken.

Once the decision-making on the DJI Masterplan is completed, and it is therefore clear whether the PI Scheveningen will continue to exist, the Foundation, in consultation with the state, will further develop the preliminary design of a Oranjehotel Monument.

Zodra de besluitvorming over het Masterplan DJI is afgerond en daarmee ook duidelijk is of de PI Scheveningen blijft bestaan, zal de Stichting in samenspraak met het rijk het voorlopige ontwerp van een Monument Oranjehotel verder uitwerken.
Antwoord vragen Monasch over de stand van zaken in het juridisch onderzoek naar bestuurders van woningbouwcorporatie Rentre

An MP asked the housing minister about the status of the legal investigation into former executives of housing corporation Rentree, including civil liability, cooperation of the current board, and whether limitation periods for former supervisors were being interrupted. The minister replied that the investigation stems from earlier reports, that Rentree has summoned the former executive for civil liability, that former supervisors are not being pursued, and that no interruption is needed because a procedure is underway.
Rentree states that the former executive was summoned on 26 April 2013.
Rentree geeft aan dat op 26 april 2013 de voormalig bestuurder is gedagvaard.
Antwoord vragen Monasch en Mohandis over de kosten van kamerverhuur

MPs Monasch and Mohandis asked about the high cost of student rooms in Amsterdam and Utrecht, the norm rent used for student housing, and how many extra student rooms are needed beyond the national action plan. The minister answered that rents are set by free contract with limited tenant remedies via the rent commission, that housing shortages are tied to tight local markets, and that the action plan's additional units are considered sufficient with private landlords expected to expand supply.
In rent law for residential accommodation, the principle of contractual freedom applies in principle.
In het huurprijzenrecht voor woonruimte geldt in beginsel contractvrijheid.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Monasch en Jasper van Dijk over de toekomst van de Tropenmuseum

MPs Monasch and Jasper van Dijk asked ministers whether the future of the Tropenmuseum is at risk, how the KIT budget cuts and 90 job losses affect it, and which ministry should fund it after 2013. The ministers answered that the KIT subsidy ended under earlier decisions, a transition grant of 15.3 million was given for 2013 with 7.5 million earmarked for the museum, the KIT is responsible for its own plans and cut allocation, and post-2013 funding talks with Amsterdam and the ministries are ongoing.
Responsibility for distributing the cuts across the different departments lies with the KIT.
De verantwoordelijkheid voor de verdeling van de bezuinigingen over de verschillende afdelingen ligt bij het KIT.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Dekken, Jacobi en Monasch over het bericht ‘Almere nieuwe schaatscentrum’

Three PvdA MPs asked the health minister about reports that Almere would host a new national speed-skating centre, questioning KNSB's commitment to Thialf and the selection criteria. The minister replied that the ministry is not involved in choosing among the three bids, that the KNSB and NOC*NSF make the decision on 15 August 2013, and that she will not intervene.
The Ministry of VWS is not involved in the assessment and choice among the three initiatives.
Het ministerie van VWS is niet betrokken bij de beoordeling en keuze voor één van de drie initiatieven.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paulus Jansen en Monasch over de naleving van de Woningwet en de Wet op het overleg

MPs Jansen and Monasch asked whether a housing corporation may restrict the statutory right of tenants' organisations to make binding nominations for supervisory board seats, the board size and tenure rules, and what sanctions apply. The minister answered that corporations cannot deviate from the mandatory two binding nominations, that the supervisory board may refuse a nominee who does not fit the profile, and that the Herzieningswet will entrench tenant rights, but that no ministerial intervention is currently warranted, only a call on the parties to act.
The corporation cannot include deviating provisions on this point in its statutes, because otherwise the minister for Housing and Government Service would not approve the amendment to the statutes.
De corporatie kan geen afwijkende bepalingen op dit punt opnemen in de statuten, omdat anders door de minister voor Wonen en Rijksdienstgeen goedkeuring voor de statutenwijziging wordt verleend.
Antwoord vragen Monasch en Nijboer over grote winstmarges voor banken op hypotheken

MPs Monasch and Nijboer asked about reports that Dutch banks' mortgage profit margins rose between January 2012 and January 2013 despite small rate cuts, and about the size of the extra margin and its effect on borrowers and the housing market. The minister confirmed margins have risen since 2011 per an ACM study, but said the absolute size is uncertain and gave an estimated increase of 0.24 to 0.74 percentage points, with ACM promising further research into competition in the mortgage market.
The ACM has indicated it will conduct further research this year into possibilities for improving market competition in the banking sector, including the mortgage market.
De ACM heeft aangegeven nog dit jaar nader onderzoek te zullen verrichten naar mogelijkheden voor verbeteringen van de marktwerking in de bancaire sector, waaronder de hypotheekmarkt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Monasch, Albert De Vries Albert en Otwin Van Dijk over mantelzorgwoningen en groepswonen

MPs asked about the savings potential of care annexes (mantelzorgwoningen) and group housing for elderly care, the status of housing experiments, deregulation under the BOR, the risk that temporary housing becomes permanent, and a barrier inventory for care providers. The government answered that savings cannot be quantified, experiments have ended and a new programme is being discussed, deregulation is planned via the BOR, enforcement remains with municipalities, and a municipal guidance note is expected after the summer.
On the subject of care annexes, a guidance note for municipalities is being prepared.
Op het terrein van mantelzorgwoningen is een handreiking voor gemeenten in de maak.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Jan Vos en Monasch over het bericht dat Nederland meer zonnepanelen wil

MPs Jan Vos and Monasch asked whether the government will engage with the energy and construction sectors to take firm steps toward more solar panels in new buildings, given public support. The minister welcomed the enthusiasm, said the market is growing well and that intervention would distort it, so he sees no reason for extra action.
I therefore see no reason to undertake additional activities.
Ik zie daarom geen reden om extra activiteiten te ondernemen.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Monasch, Jan Vos en Albert De Vries over de milieuprestatieberekening bij aanvragen in het kader van de omgevingswet

Three PvdA MPs asked why some municipalities do not require environmental performance calculations under the Omgevingswet and what the minister will do about it. The minister answers that no thresholds exist yet at the request of industry, that municipalities must still check submitted documents, and that enforcement responsibilities are shared with the provinces, with binding requirements possibly set around 2015.
First-line supervision of building regulations still lies with the municipality.
Het eerstelijns toezicht op de bouwregelgeving ligt nog steeds bij de gemeente.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Monasch en Yücel over de renovatie van woningen door corporatie Eigen Haard

Two PvdA MPs asked ministers about a housing corporation renovating a flat building for Muslim residents, including whether religious wishes should be funded from guaranteed public loans and whether allocation should avoid segregation. The minister answered that corporations may consider residents' wishes but that housing must not become suitable for only one religious group, that the extra tap cost is minor and pragmatically accepted, and that allocation stays with the top of the waiting list.
It is good that housing corporations take residents' wishes into account. However, this may not lead to homes being suitable only for residence by a single religious or philosophical group.

Het is goed dat woningcorporaties rekening houden met wensen van bewoners. Dit mag er echter niet toe leiden dat woningen enkel nog geschikt zijn voor bewoning door één religieuze of levensbeschouwelijke groep.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Monasch over bemiddelingskosten bij tijdelijke verhuur van corporatiewoningen

MP Monasch asked whether housing corporation De Sleutels outsourced temporary letting of 125 Leiden homes to Villex and whether tenants paying a deposit plus fees was acceptable. The minister confirmed the outsourcing, said Villex charges one month deposit and a 42.50 euro admin fee matching De Sleutels' own, that two addresses were overcharged and refunded, and stated that tenants may in general not be charged brokerage costs.
In general, no brokerage costs may be charged to tenants at all.
In het algemeen mogen aan huurders in het geheel geen bemiddelingskosten in rekening gebracht worden.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Van Dam en Monasch over de aanbesteding van elektrische bussen in Friesland

Two PvdA MPs asked the minister why Friesland awarded an electric bus tender to Chinese firm BYD rather than a Dutch producer, and whether Chinese state aid made the award unfair. The minister replied that the tender followed EU rules on price and quality, that state aid to BYD was not excessive, and that the province could not legally be ordered to cancel the award, while promising to push for a stronger EU procurement and trade policy towards China.
It is up to a contracting authority to determine whether such a case arises.
Het is aan een aanbestedende dienst om te bepalen of zo'n geval zich voordoet.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Nijboer en Monasch over het bericht dat de hypotheekrentes in Nederland in internationaal perspectief zeer hoog zijn

MPs Nijboer and Monasch asked the Finance Minister whether Dutch mortgage margins are too high by international standards, whether the mortgage market is uncompetitive, and whether the price-leadership ban is to blame. The minister said DNB attributes much of the gap to higher bank funding costs, that the NMa found margins had returned to pre-crisis levels in 2011, and that ING's price-leadership ban was lifted and NN Bank will enter the market, with the NMa continuing to monitor.
Because margins may have risen since then, given changed competitive conditions after several parties recently left the Dutch market, I welcome the NMa closely monitoring the mortgage market.

Omdat de marges sindsdien kunnen zijn gestegen, mede gegeven de gewijzigde concurrentieverhoudingen ten gevolge van het feit dat recentelijk een aantal partijen de Nederlandse markt hebben verlaten, juich ik toe dat de NMa de hypotheekmarkt scherp monitort.

Vragen van de leden Monasch en Nijboer (beiden PvdA) aan de ministers voor Wonen en Rijksdienst en van Financiën over de striktere regels omtrent de Nationale Hypotheek Garantie bij oversluiten van een hypotheek (ingezon

MPs Monasch and Nijboer asked the ministers whether stricter NHG rules requiring annuity or linear repayment when remortgaging would apply to all existing NHG mortgages, and why. The minister answered that the rule was unintended, asked the WEW to amend it so existing savings and interest-only NHG mortgages can move to a new home without mandatory repayment change, and the WEW agreed to do so.

I have therefore asked the WEW to adjust the rules so that existing savings and/or interest-only mortgages with National Mortgage Guarantee can be carried over to a next home without owners being required to repay annuity-style.
Ik heb daarom het WEW verzocht de regels zodanig aan te passen dat bestaande spaar- en/of aflossingsvrije hypotheken met Nationale Hypotheek Garantie meegenomen kunnen worden naar een volgende woning
Antwoord vragen van de leden Hamer, Kerstens en Monasch over "Bouwbedrijven rommelen met faillissementen"

MPs Hamer, Kerstens and Monasch asked minister Kamp whether he would act on reports of construction firms abusing bankruptcies, dismissals of workers rehired as self-employed, and threats to collective sector agreements. The minister answered that government has no active role in preventing bankruptcy fraud beyond criminal enforcement, that dismissal permits are granted only for genuine self-employed workers, and that no signals of endangered sector arrangements exist, with an SER advice pending.
As already indicated in answering earlier parliamentary questions on bankruptcy fraud, the government has no role in preventing and combating bankruptcy fraud.
Zoals bij de beantwoording van eerdere Kamervragen over het onderwerp faillissementsfraude al is aangegeven heeft de overheid geen rol bij het voorkomen en bestrijden van faillissementsfraude.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Monasch over het bericht dat er bijna geen mobiele dekking op Utrecht C.S. is

Mr Monasch (PvdA) asked the minister of Infrastructure and Environment whether NS refuses to cooperate on a solution to nearly absent mobile coverage at Utrecht Centraal and whether the minister will mediate. The minister replied that NS is not refusing, is working on a fix including free wifi at major stations and talks with telecom providers to improve capacity this year.
NS is in talks with various telecom providers to improve capacity at the major stations this year.
NS is in gesprek met diverse telecom-aanbieders om de capaciteit op de grote stations nog dit jaar te verbeteren.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Monasch over de plannen van Vestia in de gemeente Pijnacker-Nootdorp

An MP asks the Minister of Interior whether Vestia's plan to sell about half its social rental stock in Pijnacker-Nootdorp breaches earlier promises to protect tenants, and whether such sales should be prevented. The Minister disputes that reading, says sales are unavoidable for Vestia's debt repayment, and says it is too early to judge while the municipality analyses housing needs.
My department regularly consults with Vestia on the state of affairs regarding the sale of homes.
Mijn departement heeft regelmatig overleg met Vestia over de stand van zaken rondom de verkoop van woningen.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Monasch over exploderende huren in Amsterdam vanwege de ‘Donnerpunten’

MP Monasch asked the minister whether, after reports of social rents in Amsterdam rising above the liberalisation limit due to extra WWS points, he still considered rent increases acceptable, and whether the extra points unacceptably reduce rental supply. Minister Spies replied that no unacceptable rent rises had been shown, pointed to the forthcoming annual rent-trends report, and said the extra points do not unacceptably reduce supply since corporations are bound by local agreements and no signal of non-compliance is known to him.
This report will be available this autumn, after which it will be sent to the House of Representatives.
Dit rapport komt dit najaar beschikbaar waarna deze aan de Tweede Kamer zal worden toegezonden.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Groot en Monasch over het verschil in belastingdruk tussen bouwrijpe en braakliggende grond

MPs Groot and Monasch asked why selling a demolished building plot with foundations left attracts only 2% transfer tax while removing the foundations triggers 19% VAT, and whether this discourages greening vacant land and harms neighbourhood liveability. The State Secretary of Finance answered that VAT applies only to a building plot as defined under the VAT Act, that removing foundations does not create a building plot merely to make a garden or lawn, and that no liveability signals are known; he declined to change the law pending a Court of Justice ruling.
I do not intend to take legislative measures for the time being pending that ruling.
Ik ben niet voornemens om in afwachting daarvan thans wettelijke maatregelen te nemen.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Monasch en Groot over de aanpak van derivatengebruik bij woningcorporaties

MPs Monasch and Groot asked whether a ban on speculative derivative positions should extend beyond formally approved housing associations to non-profit housing bodies, and how the planned AMvB listing permitted banks would be designed. The minister answered that the new rules apply only to toegelaten instellingen, that extension to other NWIs is not intended, and that the AMvB will be sent to parliament once drafted, with supervision and sound finance considered.
When the relevant AMvB (draft) is ready, I will send it to your House for discussion.
Als de betreffende AMvB (in concept) gereed is zal ik deze ter bespreking aan uw Kamer toezenden.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Monasch over overvragende woningcorporaties en toereikende financiële buffers bij woningbouwcorporaties

An MP asked the Minister of Interior about Amsterdam housing corporations charging very high rents, a 37m2 unit liberalised above the rent-control threshold, the drop in affordable rentals after the WWS point increases, and whether corporations have sufficient financial buffers to support Vestia and invest. The minister replied that corporations may set rents within legal limits, that no failure to honour the Amsterdam agreements is known, and that the sector as a whole is financially capable of its investments, while not ruling out undisclosed financial problems at individual corporations.
I am not aware of any signal that the corporations are not honouring their agreements in this regard.
Mij is geen signaal bekend dat de corporaties hun afspraken in deze niet nakomen.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Jadnanansing en Monasch over hypotheekverstrekking aan mensen met een studieschuld

MPs Jadnanansing and Monasch asked whether banks' practice of applying a 2% monthly norm to the total student debt, rather than actual repayments, inflates the mortgage burden and whether they will raise this with lenders. The State Secretary answered that lenders must consider student loan burdens under the Wft, that DUO loans are not consumer credit under that rule, and that banks and insurers agreed to use 0.75% of the original loan from 1 April 2013, with the government endorsing this method.
In good consultation these parties agreed that the mortgage lender will, in future, in principle base the monthly financial burden attached to the student debt on 0.75% of the original loan.

In goed overleg zijn deze partijen overeengekomen dat de hypothecair financier in de toekomst bij de berekening van de aan de studieschuld verbonden maandelijkse financiële lasten in beginsel uitgaat van 0,75% van de oorspronkelijke lening.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Monasch over de bijgestelde verkoopplannen van het ouderencomplex 55 plus door woningcorporatie Stichting Ouderenhuisvesting Rotterdam

An MP asks the Minister of the Interior about the prolonged, repeatedly delayed sale of the Prinsehof 55+ elderly complex by housing corporation SOR, including neglected maintenance, residents left uncertain, and whether new advice rounds and parliamentary consultation should precede irreversible steps. The minister confirms the delays, states the corporation will provide clarity around September with a sale-leaseback arrangement, agrees a new advice round is needed for a possible sale, but declines to consult parliament before irreversible steps, citing his own competence.
I have independent authority to take decisions subject to review against the regulations.
Ik heb eigenstandige bevoegdheid tot het nemen van besluiten onder toetsing aan de regelgeving.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Van Bochove en Monasch over de ontwikkeling van Lelystad

MPs Van Bochove and Monasch asked about the development of Lelystad, including the Lelystadtafel commitments, fragmented housing ownership from the Centrada sale obligations, and the lack of private renovation funds.
