The minister responded that the municipality received funds and an extra annual contribution, that responsibility for the sales lies with the corporation and owners, and that a round-table with relevant parties will be organised to seek solutions.
It is important that with fragmented ownership the approach to corporation and private homes is aligned.
Het is belangrijk dat bij versnipperd bezit de aanpak van de woningen van corporaties en particulieren wordt afgestemd.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Monasch over het bericht dat NS Poort zijn positie in Zaanstad misbruikt

An MP asked the minister whether NS Poort is abusing its position in a dispute with the municipality of Zaanstad over a office building and a rail overbuilding, and whether the minister will hold NS to account as concession grantor. The minister says the dispute is in confidential mediation, that the minister has no substantive knowledge of it, and that the minister sees no reason to engage NS because NS Stations' activities fall outside the concession.
Given the ongoing mediation and its confidentiality, I have no substantive knowledge of this file.
Gezien de lopende bemiddeling en de vertrouwelijkheid daarvan, heb ik geen inhoudelijke kennis van dit dossier.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Monasch en Plasterk over het bericht ‘Bank zet trouwe klant in de kou’

MPs Monasch and Plasterk asked whether banks have substantially reduced mortgage financing for existing clients with stable incomes, whether banks interpret tightened rules too strictly, and whether high mortgage rates are justified given banks' cheap funding. The minister replied that LTI norms were tightened by recalculated Nibud norms and the Gedragscode Hypothecaire Financieringen, that exceptions and room for tailoring remain, that banks face funding and risk pressures, and that the NMa found margins had fallen back to pre-crisis levels by early 2011.
The banks, the AFM and I myself remain in discussion about this.
De banken, de AFM en ikzelf blijven hierover in gesprek.
Antwoord vragen Monasch en Dikkers over de berichtgeving dat woningcorporaties geen prioriteit geven aan recycling

MPs Monasch and Dikkers asked whether housing associations are neglecting recycling of lamps and luminaires and whether the government should improve their recycling results. The state secretary acknowledged that only about half of discarded lamps are collected, called the missed opportunity a gap in the collection system, and promised to alert housing associations via their association and to examine collection options in implementing the revised EU WEEE directive.
Antwoord vragen Marcouch en Monasch over het ontstaan van no-go area’s in de grote steden

Two PvdA MPs asked whether neglected neighbourhoods in Rotterdam and Amsterdam risk becoming no-go areas, how the government supports municipalities and measures investment there, and how cuts to municipal safety and neighbourhood policy fit with that risk. The minister rejects the professor's conclusion, describes the monitoring instruments and the continued neighbourhood approach, and refers back to earlier answers without committing to new action.
The total investment in the neighbourhoods is not tracked at national level.
Het totaal aan investeringen in de wijken wordt niet op rijksniveau bijgehouden.
Antwoord vragen Monasch en Groot over het bericht in de Volkskrant over de vrije val van de huizenverkoop

Two MPs from the PvdA asked the Minister of the Interior and the State Secretary for Finance about a newspaper report of a sharp fall in home sales in February 2012 and why the Dutch housing market is weaker than neighbouring countries. The minister answered that the drop is partly overstated when compared with recent months, attributed the decline to market dynamics and the economic situation, and listed measures the cabinet has already taken to support the housing market.
This cabinet has taken various measures to give a targeted boost to confidence in the housing market and to remove obstacles to transactions.
Er zijn door dit kabinet verschillende maatregelen genomen om het vertrouwen op de woningmarkt een gerichte impuls te geven en belemmeringen voor transacties weg te nemen.
Antwoord vragen Monasch over de financiële situatie bij woningcorporaties

An MP asks the Minister of Interior Affairs about a Brinkgroep report and press coverage showing many housing corporations with weak interest coverage, high debt and high market risk, and whether supervision should be intensified. The minister answers that the figures are signals but do not by themselves show continuity risk, that supervision is already being strengthened in the short term, and that the regulator will pay more attention to liquidity risks in 2012.
For the short term, intensifications were already set in motion in 2011.
Voor de korte termijn zijn reeds in 2011 intensiveringen in gang gezet.
Antwoord vragen Monasch over het bericht dat de NS niet bereikbaar is vanuit het buitenland

An MP asked the minister whether NS (Dutch Railways) is unreachable by phone from abroad and whether a Dutch bank account is required to buy NS products, and whether abroad-based travellers can reach NS and whether a solution is in progress. The minister said NS has launched a regular phone number for calls from abroad, that one-off payments are possible abroad but monthly direct debits still need a Dutch account until a planned change by July 2013, dependent on banks.
According to NS's current planning, customers with a foreign bank account will be able to make the same payments as customers with a Dutch bank account by 1 July 2013 at the latest.
Volgens de huidige planning van NS zullen klanten met een buitenlandse bankrekening uiterlijk vanaf 1 juli 2013 dezelfde betalingen kunnen doen als klanten met een Nederlandse bankrekening.
Antwoord vragen Monasch en Recourt over de berichtgeving dat er vals spel wordt gespeeld op de huizenveiling

MPs Monasch and Recourt asked about reports of cheating at house auctions and the WEW's decision to stop auctioning NHG-guaranteed homes. The minister said the WEW works with financiers to avoid auctions, a bill on forced-sale procedures is planned, existing sanctions suffice against cartel conduct, and the WEW refused 25% of executive auction requests in 2011.
This proposal is expected to be submitted to your House this summer.
Dit voorstel wordt naar verwachting in de zomer van dit jaar bij uw Kamer ingediend.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Monasch over vermeende fraude bij het GVB

An MP asked the minister whether millions of euros had disappeared through alleged ov-chip fraud at GVB Amsterdam, what the independent investigation covers, when results are expected, and whether the damage to travellers and the role of TLS are included. The minister confirmed the investigation is necessary and waits for results, deferring the scope and timing details to the municipality, the sole shareholder, which expects first results in about four weeks.
The municipality of Amsterdam has informed me that the investigation will primarily focus on the alleged fraudulent acts and irregularities at GVB Amsterdam.
De gemeente Amsterdam heeft mij geïnformeerd dat het onderzoek zich primair zal richten op de vermeende frauduleuze handelingen en onregelmatigheden bij het GVB Amsterdam.
Antwoord vragen Monasch en Klijnsma over het bericht dat toegankelijkheid van stations zeer te wensen overlaat

MPs Monasch and Klijnsma asked the minister about a TV report that station accessibility for people with disabilities is poor, including whether assistance is available at only about 110 of 386 stations and how far in advance it must be booked. The minister responded that the government aims for self-reliant accessibility by 2015 for visually and auditorily impaired people and faster for motor-impaired people, and committed to reducing the advance booking window in the 2015-2024 rail concession.
Within the concession for the main rail network 2015-2024, I will make agreements with NS on improving assistance provision.
In het kader van de concessie voor het hoofdrailnet 2015–2024 ga ik met NS afspraken maken over het verbeteren van assistentieverlening.
Antwoord vragen Monasch over de aanpak van geluidsoverlast bij Lansingerland

MP Monasch asks the minister of Infrastructure and Environment why the M+P bureau dismissed adjusting noise barriers in the pilot phase for noise nuisance from the HSL-Zuid near Lansingerland, and whether this option should be excluded and what measures can reduce noise in 2012. The minister answers that M+P's plan focuses on additional measures judged more effective, that barrier insulation will be studied by TNO, that the option is not excluded, and that measures are expected to be in place by late summer 2012.
I expect that these measures, if no safety-technical aspects affect them, will be implemented by the end of the summer, so that noise reduction will already occur in 2012.
Ik verwacht dat deze maatregelen, indien er geen veiligheidstechnische aspecten van invloed zijn, eind van de zomer zijn getroffen, zodat er in 2012 al sprake zal zijn van geluidreductie.
Antwoord vragen Monasch over het advies van de Commissie voor de Milieu Effect Rapportage (CieMER) over de Goederenroutering Oost Nederland van het Programma Hoogfrequent Spoorvervoer (PHS).

An MP from the PvdA asked the minister whether the government would heed the CieMER advice to first clarify long-term freight rail needs before the environmental impact assessment for Eastern Netherlands freight routing, and whether the EIA comment deadline should be extended. The minister declined to adopt the CieMER advice, arguing a parallel approach avoids delay, and said the comment period need not be extended since the EIA already provides for interim decisions.
I do not adopt the CieMER advice to carry out the studies one after another.
Het advies van de CieMER om de onderzoeken ná elkaar uit te voeren neem ik niet over.
Antwoord vragen Monasch over het bericht ‘Buskaartje te duur door truc NS’

An MP asked whether NS's 2000 share sale proceeds (226 million euro for OV-chipkaart development) were misused, whether TLS losses were financed by NS loans, and whether bus and tram fares would rise as a result. The minister answered that the money was earmarked private funds under an agreement with ProRail and the ministries, that 121 million went into TLS, and that NS gave no loans to TLS, so fare increases can be excluded.
Through quarterly reports, your House is informed about the spending of the FENS funds.
Via kwartaalrapportages wordt uw Kamer geïnformeerd over de besteding van de FENS-gelden.
Antwoord vragen Jadnanansing en Monasch over hypotheekverstrekking aan mensen met een studieschuld

MPs Jadnanansing and Monasch asked whether borrowing for study is responsible and whether banks have tightened mortgage rules for people with student debt. The state secretary replied that student debt is rightly counted in mortgage assessments, that banks have not tightened norms but apply them more strictly, and that starters remain important to the housing market.
From the Dutch Banking Association (NvB) I have learned that the norms for granting a mortgage to people with student debt have not become stricter.
Van de Nederlandse Vereniging van Banken (NvB) heb ik vernomen, dat de normen ten aanzien van het verstrekken van een hypotheek aan mensen met een studieschuld niet strenger zijn geworden.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Monasch en Groot over de voortvarendheid waarmee de Belastingdienst huiseigenaren van dienst is bij het achterhalen van de hoogte van het inkomen van achteloze huurders

MPs Monasch and Groot asked whether the Tax Authority's web tool letting landlords check whether a household's income exceeds 43,000 euro is lawful and privacy-compliant, and what safeguards and enforcement exist against misuse. The minister answered that a temporary exemption from tax secrecy covers the tool, that landlords can only query their own properties and must accept usage terms, and that misuse is unlawful and subject to civil, data-protection and criminal sanctions.
Landlords may only request the information for that purpose.
Verhuurders mogen de informatie alleen maar voor dat doel opvragen.
Antwoord vragen Monasch en Spekman over de berichtgeving over ernstige huurbetalingsproblemen in Breda

MPs Monasch and Spekman asked whether reports that one in five Breda tenants face serious rent payment problems, and the government's rent and housing-allowance measures, would worsen tenants' situation. The minister replied that the RIGO study measures housing cost ratios rather than actual payment arrears, that the measures are not expected to worsen payment problems, and that the housing-allowance cuts are necessary to cover budget shortfalls.
I am not willing to do so, since these cuts are necessary to cover shortfalls in the housing allowance budget.
Ik ben hiertoe niet bereid, aangezien deze bezuinigingen noodzakelijk zijn om tekorten op de huurtoeslagbegroting te dekken.
Antwoord vragen Monasch en Plasterk over de berichtgeving op 9 januari 2012 over de beperking van de hypotheekruimte voor tweeverdieners

Two PvdA MPs asked the ministers of Finance and Interior whether major mortgage lenders are refusing to apply the looser Nibud borrowing norm for two-earner households and whether the AFM fines lenders who do so, and what the government will do for households earning up to 40,000. The minister replied that lenders signalled they will follow the AFM, that no fines can be assumed in advance, and that the existing borrowing capacity method is unchanged, with renting as an alternative.

The AFM has indicated that lenders cannot assume in advance that an expansion of borrowing capacity for consumers earning between average and one and a half times average income will be seen by the AFM as responsible lending.

De AFM heeft aangegeven dat de kredietverstrekkers er niet op voorhand vanuit kunnen gaan dat een verruiming van de leencapaciteit voor consumenten met een modaal tot anderhalf keer modaal inkomen door de AFM als verantwoorde kredietverlening wordt gezien.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Monasch over het vermeende negeren van adviezen van de Onderzoeksraad voor Veiligheid aangaande de veiligheid op het treinspoor door de minister van Infrastructuur en Milieu en ProRail

An MP asked the minister whether railway safety recommendations from the Dutch Safety Board had gone unimplemented a year after publication, and what measures were taken. The minister denied that the recommendations were unimplemented, referred to earlier letters on safety measures, and stated that the roles and responsibilities in the rail sector are clear and need no sharpening.
Antwoord vragen Monasch over het bericht dat passagiers met een OV-chipkaart geweigerd worden in De Gelderlander van 12 januari 2012

MP Monasch asked the minister of Infrastructure and Environment about reports that passengers with valid paper subscriptions were refused boarding on some bus lines because operators would not load subscriptions onto OV-chipkaarts. The minister explained that regional authorities chose differing transitional arrangements, acknowledged the refusal in the specific case was regrettable, and said regional authorities and operators are taking additional measures such as better passenger communication and a customer-friendly coulance policy.
This unfortunately could not prevent that in the specific case from the report, access to the bus was refused.
Dit heeft helaas niet kunnen voorkomen dat in het specifieke geval uit het bericht de toegang tot de bus werd geweigerd.
Vragen van de leden Groot, Monasch (beiden PvdA) en Koolmees (D66) aan de staatssecretaris van Financien over de fiscale behandeling van transformatie van kantoorpanden (ingezonden 23 december 2011).

MPs Groot, Monasch and Koolmees asked the State Secretary of Finance about tax obstacles to converting office buildings into housing, including double VAT, the transfer-tax exemption period and WOZ valuation. The State Secretary rejected changes to VAT integration levy, transfer tax and other fiscal incentives, citing budgetary, EU and simplicity considerations, and gave no commitment to action.
No, I am not willing to do that.
Nee, daar ben ik niet toe bereid.
Vragen van de leden Monasch (PvdA) en Verhoeven (D66) aan de minister van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties over constructiefouten in de bouw (ingezonden 16 december 2011).

MPs Monasch and Verhoeven asked the Minister of Interior about reports of thousands of construction defects, the safety risks, the estimated 20,000 yearly defects, and their causes and costs. The minister answered that most reported defects cause only economic damage, that the estimate was a rough illustration without verified basis, and that monitoring is primarily the sector's responsibility, with no separate study of costs planned.
I currently see no need to conduct additional research into the causes, consequences and societal costs of structural defects.
Ik zie op dit moment geen noodzaak om in aanvulling hierop onderzoek te doen naar de oorzaken, gevolgen en maatschappelijke kosten van constructieve fouten.

Vragen van de leden Monasch en Van Dekken (beiden PvdA) aan de minister van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties over de bezuinigingen bij de Friese woningbouwcorporatie Elkien (ingezonden 15 december 2011).

Two PvdA MPs asked the minister of Interior about cuts at housing corporation Elkien, which plans to withdraw from small rural villages due to the proposed levy on housing corporations, and whether this harms the krimp policy and whether talks with corporations and Aedes will follow. The minister answered that Elkien's strategy is a responsible, demographically based choice with a village-visioning project, that the effects are largely compensated nationally, that regional and provincial parties share responsibility, and that talks with several corporations and SEV have already taken place.
Elkien's policy regarding small villages generally fits well with my policy on shrinking areas.
Het beleid van Elkien inzake de kleine kernen verdraagt zich over het algemeen goed met mijn beleid inzake de krimpgebieden.
Vragen van het lid Monasch (PvdA) aan de minister van Infrastructuur en Milieu over het bericht dat Veolia haar transportdivisie in de etalage zet (ingezonden 15 december 2011).

An MP asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Environment about reports that Veolia would sell its transport division, including effects on Dutch concessions, staff and passengers, the company's stance on public transport tendering, and whether a hedge fund owner would be desirable. The minister said nothing was known beyond media reports, pointed to legal protection of passengers and staff and to competition authorities, and declined to judge hypothetical situations.
Other than the media reports, I am not aware of anything regarding this.
Anders dan de berichtgeving in de media is mij hierover niets bekend.

Vragen van de leden Recourt en Monasch (beiden PvdA) aan de minister van Veiligheid en Justitie over het bericht dat de Nederlandse politie nog nooit grote bendes koperdieven heeft opgespoord (ingezonden 17 november 2011

MPs Recourt and Monasch asked the Minister of Security and Justice whether reported figures on copper theft were accurate, whether the Koperslag action plan and ID requirement were in force, whether organised copper theft exists in the Netherlands, and how copper theft is registered. The minister answered that theft is increasing, that a recent KLPD analysis shows both individuals and organised groups are being tracked, that a convenant was signed in June 2011 with amendments in preparation, and that police use a separate project code for copper theft reports.
To enable nationwide introduction of the identification requirement, the implementing decree under article 437 of the Criminal Code is being amended.
Ten behoeve van de landelijke invoering van de legitimatieplicht wordt het uitvoeringsbesluit bij artikel 437 van het Wetboek van Strafrecht aangepast.
Vragen van het lid Monasch (PvdA) aan de minister van Infrastructuur en Milieu over het bericht «Onwettige prijsverhogingen stad- en streekvervoer» (ingezonden 2 december 2011).

An MP asked the minister whether public transport fare increases above the agreed one-year fare freeze, and not submitted to consumer bodies as legally required, were acceptable. The minister said the increases were a regional matter, that the increase breaches the agreed fare freeze and that regional authorities were warned and reminded of the consumer advisory duty, and that the effect on ridership is unknown.
I have therefore informed the decentralised authorities, by letter to the chairs of the umbrella organisations IPO and SkVV, that I expect them to abide by the agreements on the fare freeze

Ik heb de decentrale overheden daarom, middels een brief aan de voorzitters van de koepelorganisaties IPO en SkVV, laten weten dat ik er van uitga dat ze zich zullen houden aan de gemaakte afspraken over de tariefrust
Vragen van het lid Monasch (PvdA) aan de minister van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties over vermeende staatssteun van woningcorporaties (ingezonden 11 november 2011).

MP Monasch asks the Interior Minister whether the European Commission's planned replacement of its 2005 state-aid decision on services of general economic interest, which may remove the definition of social housing and the reference to housing corporations, will affect Dutch housing corporations, and why Parliament was not informed sooner. Minister Donner answers that the Commission has published a new DAEB package, that Nederland is lobbying for clarity, that the 2009 Dutch-specific decision remains binding, and that the new rules leave the income-limit question open for Dutch implementation.
At the consultation of 6 October on state aid and housing corporations I informed the House that at that time there was still no clear picture of the consequences for Dutch housing corporations.

Tijdens het AO van 6 oktober jl over staatsteun en woningcorporaties heb ik uw Kamer gemeld dat er op dat moment nog geen duidelijk beeld bestond van de gevolgen voor de Nederlandse woningcorporaties.

Vragen van de leden Monasch en Dijksma (beiden PvdA) aan de ministers van Infrastructuur en Milieu en van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie over de markteffectentoets van het kabinet in het algemeen en die voor de

MPs Monasch and Dijksma asked the government whether the market effects test (MET) for public transport tendering had been fully shared with parliament and whether it followed the 24 questions proposed by the SER. The minister answered that the test results are in the explanatory memorandum to the Wp2000, that tendering regional public transport is established policy, and that the market effects test was carried out in 2009 without following the SER structure, though the questions are answered in substance.
The results of the market effects test you ask about are included in the explanatory memorandum to the Passenger Transport Act 2000 (Wp 2000).
De resultaten van de markteffectentoets waar u naar vraagt zijn opgenomen in de Memorie van Toelichting van de Wet personenvervoer 2000 (Wp 2000).

Vragen van de leden Haverkamp (CDA) en Monasch (PvdA) aan de ministers van Infrastructuur en Milieu en van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie over het bericht «oprichting RETBuzz gaat niet door (ingezonden 4 novemb

MPs Haverkamp and Monasch asked whether the planned RET-Qbuzz joint venture was blocked by the competition authority NMa and what the government can do given the tender deadline. The minister answers that the NMa issued no decision because the parties withdrew their notification, that the late filing was the parties' own responsibility, and that the tender timing is for the Stadsregio Rotterdam and the companies to decide.
The Stadsregio Rotterdam is responsible for further organising the tender procedure.
De Stadsregio Rotterdam is verantwoordelijk voor de verdere inrichting van de aanbestedingsprocedure.

Vragen van de leden Monasch, Plasterk en Groot (allen PvdA) aan de ministers van Financiën en van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties over de uitspraken van de President van de Nederlandse Bank over noodzakelijke a

PvdA MPs asked the finance and interior ministers whether they agree with the DNB president that mortgage interest deduction must be adjusted given high Dutch mortgage debt, and whether they will pursue a national housing accord and legislation. The government answered that it keeps the mortgage interest deduction, points to existing measures such as the new mortgage code limiting interest-only loans, and sees no need for a housing accord or a debate on changing the deduction.
Vragen van het lid Monasch (PvdA) aan de minister van Infrastructuur en Milieu over het bericht «Geen directe treinverbinding meer vanuit Brabant naar België in 2012» (ingezonden 29 september 2011).

An MP asked the minister whether the direct Intercity link between Brabant and Belgium would end in 2012 and when the planned Fyra via Breda would run. The minister confirmed the Benelux train remains the only direct link until the Fyra runs 16 times daily, that the Fyra start date is unknown, and that a faster alternative link will be pursued with Belgian and Dutch rail parties.
I will consult again with my Belgian colleague at the end of this year, from whom I also want clarity about this connection.
Ik zal eind dit jaar opnieuw overleg voeren met mijn Belgische collega waar ik ook duidelijkheid wil krijgen over deze verbinding.
Vragen van het lid Monasch (PvdA) aan de minister van Infrastructuur en Milieu over het bericht dat de FNV een brandbrief heeft gestuurd naar NS omtrent veiligheid (ingezonden 6 oktober 2011).

An MP asked the minister about a union letter to NS on train safety and broken train public address systems, which could hinder passenger communication during calamities. The minister acknowledged about 3,000 yearly repairs, said NS Reizigers is responsible for operations, and pointed to an ongoing investigation and Inspectorate monitoring.
This is an important issue, with regard to safety during calamities, that falls under the operational management of NS Reizigers.
Het betreft een belangrijk issue – met het oog op de veiligheid bij calamiteiten – dat valt onder de bedrijfsvoering van NS Reizigers.
Vragen van de leden Dijksma, Monasch en Jacobi ( allen PvdA) aan de minister van Infrastructuur en Milieu over de vertraging van de aanleg van het knooppunt Joure (ingezonden 22 september 2011).

MPs from the PvdA asked the minister why the start of construction of the Joure junction slipped from 2012 to 2013, whether designing for 130 km/h caused the delay and extra costs of EUR 4 million, and whether the budget increase and cost decisions are justified. The minister confirmed the 2013 start and the extra EUR 4 million for a 130 km/h-proof design, said the opening year stays 2015, and rejected calling it a delay.
By way of explanation of my decision on 130 for Joure, the following.
Ter toelichting op mijn 130-besluit voor Joure het volgende.

Vragen van de leden Hamer en Monasch (beiden PvdA) aan de minister van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid en de staatssecretaris van Infrastructuur en Milieu over de luchtkwaliteit in kinderdagverblijven (ingezonden 8 sept

MPs Hamer and Monasch asked about indoor air quality in daycare centres, including whether all daycare should be required to use an objective ventilation assessment method and whether remaining crisis funds are available. The minister answered that ventilation assessment should remain a private quality matter, that funds were passed via municipalities to schools, and that a phased voluntary improvement programme plus new Bouwbesluit rules from 2012 are in place.
No, I do not intend to make the objective assessment method mandatory for all daycare centres.
Nee, ik ben niet van plan om de objectieve beoordelingsmethode verplicht te stellen voor alle kinderdagverblijven.
Vragen van het lid Monasch (PvdA) aan de minister van Infrastructuur en Milieu over duurder reizen met korting op de OV-kaart (ingezonden 26 augustus 2011).

The MP asks whether it is acceptable that travellers using discount products on the OV-chipkaart often pay more than those without discounts, and whether the minister will address this and whether the OV-chipkaart can become a national ticket. The minister acknowledges the problem, says the traveller should be central, notes regional authorities will ask operators to study system changes, and says a coordination structure under the Meijdam follow-up may help, but gives no firm timeline and states the OV-chipkaart is not a national ticket.
The regional authorities have informed me that they will ask the operators to investigate whether adjustment of the chip card system is possible and at what cost.
De decentrale overheden hebben mij laten weten dat ze de vervoerders zullen vragen te onderzoeken of aanpassing van het chipkaartsysteem mogelijk is en tegen welke kosten.
Vragen van het lid Monasch (PvdA) aan de minister van Infrastructuur en Milieu over de antwoorden op schriftelijke vragen over de reisinformatie op het spoor (ingezonden 2 september 2011).

The MP asks the minister what information is still missing for the planning of rail passenger information, whether the matter will be settled before winter, and whether a 'winter-ready' sign can be given on 1 November 2011. The minister states that the formal transfer of rail passenger information from ProRail to NS is expected by mid-2012, gives no guarantee before winter, and refers to earlier measures and progress reports to parliament.
I have also informed the House of Representatives about the progress of these measures and their effect for the winter.
Ik heb de Tweede Kamer ook geïnformeerd over de voortgang van deze maatregelen en het effect daarvan voor de winter.

Vragen van de leden Jacobi, Monasch en Wolbert (allen PvdA) aan de staatssecretaris van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over de getroffen maatregelen van een verpleeghuis te Sneek (ingezonden 7 juli 2011).

Three PvdA MPs asked the state secretary about a Friesland nursing home leaving beds empty because of a tight AWBZ budget, whether freed funds for staff would be made more flexible, and how to prevent empty beds alongside growing waiting lists. The state secretary confirmed awareness, said the 12,000 staff convenant is not flexible, and said the NZa advises €25 million in redistribution funds to two care-purchasing concessionaires, which the minister intends to follow, plus a request for further NZa investigation.
I intend to follow this NZa advice.
Ik ben voornemens dit Nza-advies te volgen.

Vragen van de leden Marcouch en Monasch (beiden PvdA) aan de ministers van Veiligheid en Justitie en van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties over de gevolgen van de bezuinigingen voor het aantal inbraken (ingezonde

MPs Marcouch and Monasch asked ministers whether budget cuts are driving a rise in home burglaries and what will be done about it. The minister confirms a rising trend in registered burglaries, cites a CBS and CCV decline in Politiekeurmerk certificates, and points to prevention measures and citizen responsibility without committing to new funding.
An increase in home burglary is for me a worrying signal.
Een toename van woninginbraak is voor mij een zorgwekkend signaal.
Vragen van het lid Monasch (PvdA) aan de minister van Infrastructuur en Milieu over het bericht «ProRail in gebreke bij veiligheid» (ingezonden 14 september 2011).

Monasch (PvdA) asked the minister whether she shares the Safety Board's conclusion that ProRail fell short in the Stavoren accident, whether stricter inspection will follow, and whether ProRail routinely applies safety rules too leniently. The minister agreed ProRail fell short per the Board, saw no reason yet for stricter checks, and rejected the claim of a systemic pattern, citing a recent positive Inspectorate audit.
ProRail takes the Safety Board's recommendations seriously and has demonstrably taken improvement actions based on the Board's findings.
ProRail neemt de aanbevelingen van de Onderzoeksraad serieus en heeft op basis van de bevindingen van de Raad aantoonbaar verbeteracties ondernomen.

Vragen van de leden Jadnanansing en Monasch (beiden PvdA) aan de minister van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties over de groeiende wachtlijsten voor studentenkamers (ingezonden 25 augustus 2011).

MPs Jadnanansing and Monasch asked the Minister of Interior about growing waiting lists for student rooms and whether vacant government offices could be converted into student housing. The minister said demand varies locally, a regional monitor is being developed with Kences, an action plan on student housing is in preparation, and vacant government buildings can be sold or transformed, though this depends on local initiative.
In this letter I announced an action plan on student housing for this autumn, which I intend to draw up together with the parties involved in order to increase the supply of student housing locally.

In deze brief heb ik een actieplan studentenhuisvesting aangekondigd voor dit najaar, dat ik samen met de betrokken partijen wil opstellen om zo het aanbod voor studentenhuisvesting lokaal te vergroten.

Vragen van het lid Monasch (PvdA) aan de minister van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties over de analyse van het SCP dat het kabinet de middeninkomens in de steek laat door zijn eenzijdige beleid op de woningmarkt

Monasch (PvdA) asks the Interior Minister to respond to a SCP analysis claiming the cabinet's housing policy disadvantages middle incomes, including the tax treatment of owner-occupied homes and a 5% above-inflation rent rise for incomes above €43,000. Minister Donner rejects the partial analysis, defends continuing the mortgage tax relief, says there is no trend break, and promises measures to improve housing mobility for middle incomes.
The cabinet pursues an integrated income policy that takes into account all income effects of government policy.
Het kabinet voert een integraal inkomensbeleid dat rekening houdt met alle inkomenseffecten van overheidsbeleid.

Vragen van de leden Monasch en Dijksma (beiden PvdA) aan de ministers van Infrastructuur en Milieu en van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie over de markteffectentoets van het kabinet in het algemeen en die voor de

Two PvdA MPs asked why the government did not apply the SER-recommended enhanced market-effects test (markteffectentoets) to the mandatory tendering of regional public transport in the G3 cities, and how it will ensure the test is applied across departments. The ministers answered that market effects were already assessed for the Wp2000 and its amendment, that the enhanced test is now embedded in the Integraal Afwegingskader, and that departments will be checked through the IAK framework and coordinators.
I therefore see no added value in mapping the effects again.
Ik zie daarom geen meerwaarde in het opnieuw in kaart brengen van de effecten.

Vragen van de leden Monasch en Smeets (beiden PvdA) aan de minister van Infrastructuur en Milieu over het bericht dat de rechtstreekse trein van Maastricht naar Brussel verdwijnt (ingezonden 20 juli 2011).

Two MPs asked the minister whether the direct Maastricht–Brussels train, run under a contract between NMBS and NS, is being discontinued at the end of 2011, and what Dutch steps would follow. The minister confirms the decision, says NMBS is investigating a fast Maastricht–Liège stopping service as an alternative, and states support for cross-border rail links while committing only to pursue them within the 2015 concession and bilateral talks.
I consider a fast Maastricht–Liège connection important (see my answer to question 2).
Ik vind een snelle verbinding Maastricht–Luik belangrijk (zie mijn antwoord op vraag 2).
Vragen van de leden Klijnsma en Monasch (beiden PvdA) aan de minister van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties over levensloopbestendig bouwen (ingezonden 28 juli 2011).

Two MPs asked the Minister of the Interior about the Delft 'Wel Thuis' project on age-appropriate housing, the expected demand for such homes, the digital step-by-step guide's continuity after 2011, and national stimulation of lifetime-suitable building. The Minister welcomed the local project, quantified demand at about 40,000 extra suitable homes per year, said continuity of the guide is a local responsibility, and pointed to an extended support programme until end 2011.
I regard the digital step-by-step plan and the model home as good examples.
Het digitale stappenplan en de modelwoning zie ik als goede voorbeelden.

Vragen van de leden Van Dekken en Monasch (beiden PvdA) aan de staatssecretaris van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie over het bericht dat 170 000 kippen zijn omgekomen bij een brand (ingezonden 21 juli 2011).

Two MPs asked the state secretary whether the fire killing 170,000 chickens shows that stable fire safety must improve, whether the fire brigade's approach will be followed, which rules will change, and whether the promised action plan will be sent to parliament by September 2011. The state secretary agreed more must be done, said an action plan on stable fire prevention is being finalised with stakeholders, and promised to inform parliament by letter shortly and send the plan soon after.
I expect to be able to send you the action plan soon afterwards.
Het plan van aanpak verwacht ik vervolgens snel aan u toe te kunnen zenden.

Vragen van het lid Monasch (PvdA) aan de minister van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties over de problemen van mensen met een laag middeninkomen en mensen met een zorgindicatie bij het vinden van een betaalbare pa

An MP asked the Interior Minister about middle-income households and people with care needs struggling to find affordable suitable rented housing under the new 10% allocation rule tied to the EU state-aid income threshold of EUR 33,614. The minister acknowledged fewer households above the threshold can be allocated social housing, said the data do not yet prove a major problem, declined to raise the threshold or pursue it with the EU, and promised monitoring and ongoing consultation with the European Commission.
A complete picture will emerge on the basis of the results for 2011.
Een compleet beeld zal ontstaan op basis van de resultaten over 2011.
Vragen van het lid Monasch (PvdA) aan de minister van Infrastructuur en Milieu over het bericht dat de vervoerders ruziemaken over de reizigersinformatie (ingezonden 24 juni 2011).

MP Monasch asked the minister about reports of disputes among rail operators over passenger information, whether ProRail is properly implementing the House's request to transfer passenger information to NS, how far the transfer has progressed, and whether it will finish before winter. The minister answered that a joint NS-ProRail plan has been received and will be assessed, that information will follow after the summer recess, and that NS takes end responsibility for all information channels from 1 August 2011.
In accordance with the commitment, I will inform your House about this after the summer recess.
Conform de toezegging zal ik uw Kamer hierover na het zomerreces informeren.
Vragen van het lid Monasch (PvdA) aan de minister van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties over het op voorraad bouwen van de Rijksgebouwendienst (ingezonden 7 juni 2011).

The MP Monasch asked the Minister of Interior whether the Rijksgebouwendienst would build office space speculatively in Zwolle, whether this is a precursor to relocating government services there, and how it fits with a motion on shrinking regions. The minister denied speculative building, said the plan concerns efficient housing of existing services under the Compacte Rijksdienst programme, and said Zwolle is not a shrinkage region.
No. There is no speculative building in Zwolle.
Nee. Er is in Zwolle geen sprake van bouwen op voorraad.
Vragen van de leden Haverkamp (CDA) en Monasch (PvdA) aan de minister van Infrastructuur en Milieu over het bericht «Duitse verbinding Betuwelijn vertraagd» (ingezonden 6 juni 2011).

MPs Haverkamp and Monasch asked whether the minister had discussed with German minister Ramsauer the German schedule for the third track at Emmerich, and about German budgets and the need for the line in Rotterdam. The minister replied that talks were held and a visit is planned, that the third track has high priority in Germany, that the start of construction is delayed, and that existing track capacity should suffice until about 2015.
I am asking ProRail and Keyrail, together with DBnetz, to raise the utilisation rate and look for logistical options to use the existing two tracks more intensively.
Ik vraag ProRail en Keyrail om samen met DBnetz die benuttingsgraad te gaan verhogen en naar logistieke mogelijkheden te zoeken om de bestaande twee sporen intensiever te gebruiken.
Vragen van het lid Monasch (PvdA) aan de minister van Infrastructuur en Milieu over overstapproblemen in het OV (ingezonden 7 juni 2011).

Monasch asks whether single paper bus tickets in Westland became much more expensive after the strippenkaart was abolished, and whether this creates transfer problems compared with the rest of the region. The minister answers that the Stadsgewest Haaglanden is responsible for fares, that the paper tickets were deliberately priced to discourage cash purchases, that the OV-chipkaart allows cheaper, transfer-friendly travel, and that the one-year fare freeze applies.
Fares for public transport in Westland are the responsibility of the Stadsgewest Haaglanden.
De tarieven van het openbaar vervoer in het Westland zijn een verantwoordelijkheid van het Stadsgewest Haaglanden.

Vragen van de leden Karabulut (SP), Voortman (GroenLinks), Monasch (PvdA) en Van Bochove (CDA) aan de minister van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties over de Maastrichtse woningcorporatie Servatius (ingezonden 28

Opposition and coalition MPs asked the Minister of Interior whether the WSW guarantee fund could cover liquidity shortfalls at Maastricht housing corporation Servatius, including the Campus Calatrava losses, and why a sanitation route via CFV was not used. The minister answered that WSW guarantees under category 6 were permitted, that the financing plan was approved by the appointed supervisor and the CFV/WSW, and that the planned sale of 1,850 homes was acceptable and that no formal council decision was needed.
It has been agreed with the backstoppers (the State and municipalities) that in all cases where the WSW considers guarantees under category 6, consultation with the backstoppers takes place first.
Met de achtervangers (Rijk en gemeenten) is afgesproken dat in alle gevallen dat het WSW borging onder categorie 6 overweegt, eerst overleg plaatsvindt met de achtervangers.
Vragen van de leden Monasch en Plasterk (beiden PvdA) aan de ministers van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties en van Financiën over erfpachttarieven (ingezonden 8 april 2011).

MPs Monasch and Plasterk asked ministers about banks refusing mortgages on leasehold (erfpacht) land and steep leasehold rent increases by municipalities such as Bernheze. The minister answered that banks see no current problem with mortgages on municipal leasehold, that a roundtable has agreed criteria and model contracts to be developed over four months, and that rent-rise validity is a matter for other ministers and letters.
I cannot make a statement on the validity of proposed increases in leasehold rates.
Ik kan geen uitspraak doen over de validiteit van voorgestelde stijgingen van erfpachttarieven.

Vragen van de leden Paulus Jansen (SP), Van Bochove (CDA), De Boer (VVD), Voortman (GroenLinks) en Monasch (PvdA) aan de minister van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties over de kwaliteitsborging van energielabels

MPs asked the minister of Interior about quality assurance of energy labels, including how many were deregistered in 2010, whether spot checks by certifying bodies are legally regulated, whether certifying bodies may check firms they certified, and how many labels failed checks. The minister answered that certifying bodies found 582 deviations among 4,365 checked labels, leading to suspensions or withdrawals, that the market-based system is adequately safeguarded, and that the VROM-Inspectie's findings are not directly comparable.
I will continue to closely monitor the work of the Certifying Institutions and have them report to me regularly on their findings.
Ik zal de werkzaamheden van de Certificerende Instellingen nauwgezet blijven volgen en mij regelmatig laten rapporteren over hun bevindingen.
Vragen van het lid Monasch (PvdA) aan de minister van Infrastructuur en Milieu over de verwarring rondom het gebruik van de studenten-ov op 5 mei (ingezonden 10 mei 2011).

Rep. Monasch asked why students with student OV cards are repeatedly confused about free travel on Liberation Day (5 May), whether DUO and NS will improve information and whether all card holders can travel free that day. The state secretary replied that students are responsible for checking travel conditions, that 5 May follows the Algemene Termijnenwet, that information will be improved in consultation with carriers, but that free travel for all card holders is not necessary and not affordable within the budget.
DUO and the transport companies will consult on how information for students can be improved.
DUO en de vervoerbedrijven zullen in overleg treden over hoe de voorlichting aan studenten kan worden verbeterd.
Vragen van de leden Dijksma en Monasch (beiden PvdA) aan de minister van Infrastructuur en Milieu over slachtoffers door te gladde wegen (ingezonden 7 april 2011).

MPs Dijksma and Monasch asked the minister of Infrastructure and Environment about elderly people injured by slippery roads and footpaths, and how winter gritting is prepared, evaluated and funded. The minister answered that road managers are responsible for gritting under the Wegenwet, that cooperation with IPO and VNG on brine and training is ongoing, and that funding is a decision for municipal and provincial boards.
Under the Wegenwet, each road manager is itself responsible for keeping the roads it manages in good and safe condition
Op grond van de Wegenwet draagt elke wegbeheerder zelf de zorg voor het in goede en veilige staat houden van de wegen

Vragen van de leden Marcouch en Monasch (beiden PvdA) aan de ministers van Veiligheid en Justitie en van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties over het kunnen sluiten van mechanische ventilatie bij rampen (ingezonden

MPs Marcouch and Monasch asked whether mechanical ventilation in homes can be quickly switched off during disasters involving hazardous substances, and what has been done since 2008 (including after the Moerdijk fire). The minister answered that switching off is desirable, that industry guidance exists, that the situation has changed little, and that calamity switches are rarely installed, while promising a policy response in a later progress report.

Consultation in the industry has led to the technical information on arrangements for temporarily switching off mechanical ventilation systems being developed, generally available and brought to the attention of members by industry organisations.

Overleg in de branche heeft er toe geleid dat nu de informatie over de technische mogelijkheden om voorzieningen te realiseren voor het tijdelijk uitschakelen van mechanische ventilatiesystemen is ontwikkeld, algemeen beschikbaar is en door brancheorganisatie bij hun leden onder de aandacht wordt gebracht.
Vragen van de leden Marcouch en Monasch (beiden PvdA) aan de minister van Veiligheid en Justitie over de onveiligheid in Vinexwijken (ingezonden 22 februari 2011).

MPs Marcouch and Monasch asked the Minister of Security and Justice about insecurity in Vinex neighbourhoods, including the claim that these areas could become future ghettos, rising complaints, and budget cuts to safety funding. The minister replied that there is no evidence Vinex areas are worse than elsewhere, that local problems are primarily for municipalities with national support, that structural safety funding continues, and that police intervention is not shown to be higher than in comparable neighbourhoods.
Centrally there is no insight into this information at neighbourhood or district level.
Centraal bestaat er geen inzicht in deze informatie op wijk- of buurtniveau.

asks the government to inform the House shortly whether and how the EU can move toward regulation in this area

Asks the government to draw up a list of monuments most in need of the unspent 40 million euro and spend it quickly.

and inform the House of it without delay
en de Kamer daarvan onverwijld in kennis te stellen
Gewijzigd amendement van het lid Ten Broeke ter vervanging van nr. 60 om de middelen voor een sterke cultuursector effectief te besteden
Amendment to the 2009 culture budget that cuts a matching scheme and development budget and reallocates funds to infrastructure, a new patronage fund and Beelden voor de Toekomst.
This amendment aims at more effective spending of funds for a strong culture sector.
Dit amendement ziet toe op een effectievere besteding van de middelen voor een sterke cultuursector.
Amendement van het lid Ten Broeke over het schrappen van de bijdrage aan 'Beelden voor de Toekomst'
Removes the contribution to 'Beelden voor de Toekomst' from the Economic Structure Enhancement Fund budget, funding it instead by a cut in natural gas revenue lines.
With this amendment the submitter aims to remove the contribution to Beelden voor de Toekomst from the FES budget.
Met dit amendement beoogt de indiener de bijdrage aan «Beelden voor de Toekomst» te schrappen uit de FES-begroting.
Amendement van het lid Ten Broeke om de middelen voor een sterke cultuursector effectief te besteden

Amendment reallocates culture budget lines: scraps a matching scheme and development budget, adds a generic cut, and redirects funds to basic infrastructure, a new patronage fund and Beelden voor de Toekomst.
This amendment aims at more effective spending of funds for a strong cultural sector.
Dit amendement ziet toe op een effectievere besteding van de middelen voor een sterke cultuursector.
Amendement van het lid Ten Broeke dat er ondermeer toe strekt een aantal uitgaven verplichtingen uit de cultuurbegroting te schrappen
Amendment cutting several culture budget commitments and spending items, reducing government subsidy and expanding the role of private free choice.
In article 14 Culture the commitment amount and the expenditure amount are reduced
In artikel 14 Cultuur worden het verplichtingenbedrag en het uitgavenbedrag verlaagd
qa: Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ploumen, Voordewind, Ten Broeke, Van Ojik, Agnes Mulder, Sjoerdsma en Van der Staaij over de berichten dat tegen vijf Soedische mensenrechtenactivistes de doodstraf is geëist

Seven MPs asked the Foreign Minister about reports that prosecutors sought the death penalty against five Saudi human rights activists, including one woman, and whether the trial is fair and what pressure the Netherlands can exert. The minister answered that the government is deeply concerned, opposes the death penalty, raises concerns with Saudi authorities and through EU channels including a joint demarche, and will raise the issue at the November UPR, but gave limited information on the trial itself.
The cabinet is following developments, including the trial of the female activist mentioned in the reports, closely.
Het kabinet volgt de ontwikkelingen, waaronder het proces van de in de berichtgeving genoemde vrouwelijke activist, op de voet.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ten Broeke over door de OVSE waargenomen schendingen van de Minsk-akkoorden door de Russische Federatie

An MP asks the Foreign Minister about OSCE observations of Russian-linked arms supplies to separatists in eastern Ukraine, heavy weapons in prohibited zones, and obstruction of the mission under the Minsk agreements. The minister confirms awareness, says convoys were observed but Russia claims humanitarian aid and not all can be verified, states violations occur almost daily without detailing each, and says the international community repeatedly urges all parties, including Russia, to stop obstructing the OSCE.
Almost daily the OSCE observes and reports on the presence of heavy weapons on both sides of the front line.
Vrijwel dagelijks constateert en rapporteert de OVSE over de aanwezigheid van zware wapens aan beide zijden van de frontlinie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ten Broeke en Lodders over de voornemens omtrent landonteigening in Zuid-Afrika

Two VVD MPs asked the Foreign Minister about South African plans for land expropriation without compensation, farm attacks, Dutch and European business caution, the ICC withdrawal and asylum applications by South Africans. The minister answered that the government is monitoring developments, expects the parliamentary inquiry report and the post-2019 ICC decision, and will raise concerns at the EU-South Africa summit.
Once this report is published, the government will study the outcomes and share them with the House.
Het kabinet zal, zodra dit verslag is uitgebracht, de uitkomsten bestuderen en met de Kamer delen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Voordewind, Ten Broeke, Van Helvert, De Roon en Van der Staaij over een rapport over schoolboeken, uitgegeven door de Palestijnse Autoriteit

MPs from five parties asked the Foreign Minister how the government assesses a report finding that Palestinian Authority textbooks delegitimise Israel, glorify violence and lack peace education, and whether the government will press for change and join a British-led review. The ministers agree problematic elements remain, say Dutch and EU pressure on both sides against incitement has had limited results as relations deteriorate, and decline to contribute to the British review because the Netherlands is not a donor in education and lacks specific expertise.
However, the Netherlands is not a donor in the education sector and has no specific expertise on Palestinian education.
Nederland is echter geen donor in de onderwijssector en heeft geen specifieke expertise op het Palestijnse onderwijs.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Voordewind, Ten Broeke en Van der Staaij over de brief van de Hoge Vertegenwoordiger van de EU Federica Mogherini aan de Israëlische minister van Strategische Zaken Gilad Erdan

MPs asked the government about an EU High Representative letter to Israeli minister Erdan and reports that a Palestinian NGO, Ma'an Development Center, employed a man allegedly linked to the PFLP, and whether Dutch funds reached it and whether NGO funding policy should change. The government answered that the man worked on a project basis and not in permanent employment, that it has no independent evidence of the alleged affiliation, that its selection criteria are adequate and it would act if subsidy conditions were breached, and that no policy revision is currently needed.
Revision of the Dutch policy towards NGOs is currently not on the agenda.
Herziening van het Nederlandse beleid ten aanzien van NGO's is op dit moment niet aan de orde.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ten Broeke over de aankoop van olie en gas afkomstig van ISIS door Turkije

An MP from the VVD asked the Foreign Minister whether Turkey bought oil and gas from ISIS, whether the government still has no evidence of Turkish tolerance of such smuggling, whether the coalition still aims to destroy ISIS oil infrastructure, whether Dutch F-16s contributed, whether NATO allies undermining the anti-ISIS effort should be raised, and how many persons or companies have been punished for dealing with ISIS. The minister answered that the government has no evidence Turkey tolerates oil smuggling, that Dutch F-16s have not attacked ISIS oil infrastructure, that dealings with ISIS are prohibited under UN and EU sanctions, and that no one has yet been convicted in the Netherlands for such dealings.
The cabinet has no indications that the Turkish state would tolerate oil smuggling from Syria or Iraq.
Er zijn bij het kabinet geen aanwijzingen bekend dat de Turkse staat oliesmokkel vanuit Syrië of Irak zou gedogen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ten Broeke, Voordewind, Sjoerdsma en Van Dam over de Amerikaanse steun voor het Joint Investigation Team (JIT) onderzoek naar de daders van MH17

MPs from VVD, CU, D66 and CDA asked the Foreign Minister about reports that the US State Department went silent or softened its MH17 statement after the Trump-Putin summit, and whether MH17 was discussed there. The minister replied that the US fully supports the JIT and the Dutch approach, reaffirmed in the G7 statement of 16 July, while declining to share confidential allied information and calling Russia's criticism unfounded.
As the House is aware, on the basis of alliance agreements no statements can be made about information confidentially shared by allies.
Zoals de Kamer bekend kunnen op basis van bondgenootschappelijke afspraken geen mededelingen worden gedaan over door bondgenoten vertrouwelijk gedeelde informatie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ten Broeke over een explosie in Caïro op 6 augustus 2018

The VVD MP Ten Broeke asked the Foreign Minister whether the government knew of a 6 August 2018 explosion in central Cairo, whether it occurred opposite the Dutch-supported human rights organisation Karama, and asked to be kept informed given possible terrorism. The minister answered that the minibus explosion injured thirteen bystanders, that it is not for the ministry to disclose Karama's office location, and that Egyptian authorities assume an accident, with the Chamber to be informed of new developments.
It is not for the ministry to provide information about the location of Karama's office.
Het is niet aan het ministerie om informatie te verstrekken over de locatie van het kantoor van Karama.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ploumen, Voordewind, Diks, Van der Staaij, Ten Broeke, Sjoerdsma en Agnes Mulder over de arrestatie van opnieuw twee vrouwenrechtenactivisten in Saoedi-Arabië

MPs asked the Foreign Minister about the arrest of two more Saudi women's rights activists, whether it constitutes an attack on the movement, what joint EU steps were taken, and how the government supports civil society. The minister said the government is concerned, an EU demarche was delivered on 8 August urging clarification of charges and fair treatment, but Saudi space for civil society is limited.

On 8 August the Chargé d'Affaires of the European diplomatic mission, together with the European countries present in Riyadh including the Netherlands, delivered a demarche to the Saudi Foreign Minister.

Op 8 augustus jl. voerde de Tijdelijk Zaakgelastigde van de Europese diplomatieke missie samen met de in Riyad aanwezige Europese landen, waaronder Nederland, een demarche uit bij de Saoedische Minister van Buitenlandse Zaken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Helvert, Van Dam, Ten Broeke en Arno Rutte over terreurvlaggen Hezbollah bij de Tweede Kamer

MPs asked whether Hezbollah flags shown at a June 2018 Quds Day demonstration outside parliament were punishable and why police did not act, and whether the OM enforcement framework or local coordination should change. The minister answers that the flag is punishable under article 131 Sr (incitement) in principle, that no arrest was made for lack of hard investigative indications, and that current frameworks suffice, with each case judged on its own.
Displaying the Hezbollah flag would in principle constitute a punishable offence under article 131 of the Criminal Code, incitement, an offence against public order.
Het tonen van de Hezbollah-vlag zal in beginsel strafbaarheid op grond van artikel 131 Sr, opruiing, opleveren, een misdrijf tegen de openbare orde.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma, Van Helvert, Voordewind, Ten Broeke, Van Ojik, Ploumen en Karabulut over de inning Eritrese diasporabelasting nadat de Tijdelijk Zaakgelastigde persona non grata is verklaard

Seven MPs asked the Foreign Minister whether the dwangmatige inning of Eritrean diaspora tax has changed since the Eritrean chargé was declared persona non grata, whether reports and prosecutions have increased, and whether a central reporting point should be created. The minister answered that no new chargé has been appointed, that there are no indications of change in reports, that a study on banning diaspora tax is underway, and that a special reporting point is not considered necessary.
The cabinet is currently examining the possibilities for a ban on diaspora tax in the Netherlands, in line with the motion by MPs Karabulut and Van Ojik.
Het kabinet onderzoekt momenteel de mogelijkheden met betrekking tot een verbod op diasporabelasting in Nederland, conform de motie van de leden Karabulut en van Ojik.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Becker, Ten Broeke en Koopmans over de brief van de Turkse president Erdogan inzake de Turkse verkiezingen

MPs Becker, Ten Broeke and Koopmans asked the government about a letter from Turkish President Erdogan to Turkish voters in the Netherlands before the 2018 Turkish elections, including who supplied the address data, whether the Dutch data protection authority investigated, and whether Turkish election signs on Dutch motorways were justified. The government answered that the letter was not a literal voting instruction but was inappropriate, that address lists can be obtained in Turkey under Turkish law, that the data protection authority acted independently and the GDPR does not apply, and that local authorities handled the signs and no disclaimer will be added.
The Dutch Data Protection Authority is an independent supervisory body that itself determines which investigations it carries out.
De Autoriteit Persoonsgegevens is een onafhankelijke toezichthouder die zelf bepaalt welk onderzoek zij uitvoert.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ten Broeke en Bosman over gezamenlijke productie van S500-raketten door Turkije en Rusland

MPs Ten Broeke and Bosman asked whether Turkey proposed joint production of S-500 missiles with Russia, whether NATO had reacted, and whether Turkey's S-400 purchase would be integrated with NATO systems and operated by Russian personnel. The government said it could not confirm the reports, that neither NATO nor the Netherlands had been formally informed, that arms procurement is a sovereign matter, and that integration of the S-400 with NATO systems is nearly ruled out.
The cabinet therefore cannot confirm these reports and does not wish to speculate about them.
Het kabinet kan deze berichten daarom niet bevestigen en wil hier niet over speculeren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma, Ten Broeke, Voordewind, Ploumen, Van Ojik en Van Helvert over het bericht dat Syrië komende maand voorzitter is van de VN-Conferentie over Ontwapening

Six MPs asked the Foreign Minister whether Syria's rotating presidency of the UN Conference on Disarmament, given the regime's use of chemical weapons, undermines UN credibility and whether the Netherlands would raise objections with the UN Secretary-General. The minister agreed Syria lacks moral authority, said the Netherlands has reduced its representation and will leave sessions if Syria misuses the chair, but declined to raise the matter with the Secretary-General because the Conference is autonomous.
The Netherlands will immediately leave the meetings when Syria uses its chairmanship position politically.
Nederland zal de vergaderingen terstond verlaten wanneer Syrië in voorzitterscapaciteit zijn positie politiek aanwendt
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Becker, Ten Broeke, van Helvert, Voordewind en Van der Staaij over aanvallen op de Kerem Shalom-grensovergang in Israël

MPs asked whether Gazan demonstrators tried to damage the Kerem Shalom crossing, whether the Dutch-funded scanners and cargo flows were affected, how much freight crossed this year, and whether the government accepts Israel's view that the border protests amount to a state of war. The minister answered that damage occurred on the Palestinian side with minimal effect on trade, gave UN cargo figures for January to April, and rejected the war qualification, stating that Gaza is occupied territory under the law of occupation.
On Friday 4 May Gazan demonstrators caused damage on the Palestinian side of the Kerem Shalom / Karm Abusalem crossing.
Op vrijdag 4 mei hebben Gazaanse demonstranten aan Palestijnse zijde van de Kerem Shalom / Karm Abusalem grensovergang beschadigingen aangebracht.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Voordewind, Van der Staaij, Ten Broeke, Van Helvert en De Roon over het bericht dat EU-subsidies terecht komen bij organisaties die oproepen tot boycot van Israël

MPs from five parties asked the Foreign Minister whether the EU funds organisations calling for a boycott of Israel (BDS), and whether funds reached Palestinian groups linked to terrorism. The government answered that the EU opposes a boycott, that BDS advocacy is protected speech and not a funding bar, that only one NGO was named in the report (training for youth including Hamas and PFLP members, funded by Norway), and that it sees no reason to ask the Commission to act.
The fact that organisations support the BDS movement is not a criterion for rejecting funding for the cabinet.
Het feit dat organisaties de BDS-beweging ondersteunen, is voor het kabinet geen afwijzingscriterium voor financiering
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ten Broeke over nieuwe Amerikaanse sancties tegen leden van de Iraanse Revolutionaire Garde

MP Ten Broeke asked the Foreign Minister about new US sanctions on five individuals linked to the Iranian Revolutionary Guard, whether they are on EU lists, and whether sanctions for ballistic missile activity are consistent with the JCPOA and UN resolutions. The minister confirmed the US sanctions, said none of the individuals is on an EU list, committed to exploring with E3 partners the best pressure tools against ballistic missile proliferation, and argued that Iran's conduct is inconsistent with resolution 2231 but that resolution 2216 cannot be invoked.
In the coming months I will work with European partners to examine the best combination of pressure instruments against persons involved in developing and spreading ballistic missile technology.

De komende maanden zal ik mij in samenwerking met Europese partners inzetten om te bekijken wat de beste combinatie van drukmiddelen is tegen personen die betrokken zijn bij het ontwikkelen en verspreiden van ballistische rakettechnologie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma, Ten Broeke, Van Dam en Voordewind over de persconferentie van het JIT over de ramp met MH17

Four MPs asked the Foreign Minister about the JIT press conference on MH17, in particular Russia's failure to share information on the Buk missile's origin and whether Russia breaches UN resolution 2166. The minister agreed that the Buk belonged to the Russian military, that Russia must cooperate fully, and that he raised the matter in the UN Security Council.
In the Security Council I called on Russia to take its responsibility, to engage with Australia and the Netherlands on this, and to cooperate fully as demanded by UN Security Council Resolution 2166.

In de Veiligheidsraad heb ik Rusland opgeroepen zijn verantwoordelijkheid te nemen, met Australië en Nederland daarover in gesprek te gaan en volledig mee te werken zoals wordt geëist door VNVR-resolutie 2166.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Becker, Ten Broeke, Voordewind en Van der Staaij over het bericht dat Iran stiekem delen van het atoomprogramma zou hebben voortgezet

MPs Becker, Ten Broeke, Voordewind and Van der Staaij asked whether Israeli claims that Iran secretly continued parts of its nuclear weapons programme after the JCPOA were new, whether the IAEA and the Dutch government had received the material, and how the Dutch government would keep the JCPOA in place after the US withdrew support. The minister answered that the information offers no new insight, that the IAEA reports Iran is complying, that Nederland urges Israel to share the material with the IAEA, and that Nederland is working with EU partners to preserve the agreement and consider measures on ballistic missiles.
The information presented by Israeli Prime Minister Netanyahu does not lead to new insights into the Iranian nuclear programme.
De informatie die de Israëlische minister-president Netanyahu presenteerde leidt niet tot nieuwe inzichten over het Iraanse nucleaire programma.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Becker en Ten Broeke over het bericht dat Diyanet, het Turkse ministerie voor geloofszaken met 140 moskeeën in Nederland, de uitspraak heeft gedaan dat kinderen in de puberteit, voor meisj

MPs Becker and Ten Broeke asked whether Diyanet, the Turkish religious affairs ministry operating 140 mosques in the Netherlands, issued a fatwa allowing child marriage and whether this fits a pattern of rights violations, and what it means for mosque leaders and children. The government answered that Diyanet distanced itself from the report and opposes child marriage, that child marriage under 18 is banned and punishable in the Netherlands, and that it is exploring ways to make foreign funding of religious organisations more transparent.
Diyanet issued a press statement explicitly distancing itself from this interpretation as described in the original article in the Turkish newspaper Sözcü.
Diyanet heeft een persverklaring afgegeven, waarin zij nadrukkelijk afstand doen van deze interpretatie zoals beschreven in het oorspronkelijke artikel in de Turkse krant Sözcü.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Staaij, Ploumen, Van Helvert, Voordewind, Van Ojik, Ten Broeke, Karabulut en De Roon over de onderdrukking van Papoea’s in Indonesië

MPs asked the minister about the expulsion of a BBC journalist from Papua, press freedom, deteriorating human rights, and Dutch police training in Indonesia. The minister confirmed the expulsion, said foreign journalists need permits, described Dutch support for press freedom and the Community Policing Programme, and said human rights including Papua are raised in bilateral and EU/UN dialogue.
Enquiries showed that the BBC journalist indeed had to leave the province.
Bij navraag is gebleken dat de BBC-journaliste inderdaad de provincie moest verlaten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Staaij, De Roon, Ten Broeke, Voordewind en Van Helvert over een nieuwe serie moorden onder christenen in Nigeria

Five MPs asked the Foreign Minister about reported killings of Christians in Nigeria and whether Fulani herdsmen are responsible, why the Nigerian state fails to protect civilians, whether religion plays a role, Boko Haram's current strength, and how the Netherlands can help. The minister said the government cannot independently confirm the figures, attributed the violence mainly to economic and land-related causes rather than a religious agenda, and committed to pressing Nigerian authorities to document crimes and prosecute perpetrators.
The Netherlands will, preferably together with other partners or within the EU, press the Nigerian authorities that the perpetrators of the killings must not go unpunished
Nederland zal er, bij voorkeur ook samen met andere partners, dan wel in EU-verband, bij de Nigeriaanse autoriteiten op aandringen dat de daders van de moordpartijen niet vrijuit gaan
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ten Broeke en Karabulut over een nieuw rapport inzake Noord-Koreaanse dwangarbeid in de EU en de betrokkenheid van Nederlandse bedrijven

MPs Ten Broeke and Karabulut asked about a report on North Korean forced labour in the EU, including Dutch firms' involvement in building ships, and the government's response on enforcement, the Polish role, and the Netherlands' legal jurisdiction. The minister answers that the situation could possibly qualify as forced labour or trafficking, outlines EU and UN measures, states that Poland has issued no new work permits since August 2017, and refers largely to company responsibility, the OECD guidelines, and the ILO process, without confirming the scale of Dutch firms' involvement.
How many companies and shipyards are involved, and over what period this occurred, cannot be established with certainty.
Om hoeveel bedrijven en werven het gaat, en in welke periode hiervan sprake was, valt niet met zekerheid vast te stellen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma en Ten Broeke over het betrekken van Nederlanders in het buitenland bij de verbetering van het postennetwerk en consulaire dienstverlening

MPs Sjoerdsma and Ten Broeke asked the Foreign Minister how the government will strengthen the diplomatic network and consular services, whether it will actively involve the Dutch abroad, push digitalisation, set up a 24/7 one-stop shop, and consider an Irish-style 'Global Irish' initiative. The minister answered that a policy letter (Consulaire Canon) and a network vision will come before summer 2018, that consultations and surveys of Dutch citizens abroad are ongoing, that digitalisation aims for maximum feasible digital service by 2020, that the one-stop shop will be built stepwise over 3-4 years, and that foreign examples like Global Irish will be considered.

Before summer, the House will be further informed about the cabinet's vision on the diplomatic network and how the funds announced in the Coalition Agreement for its expansion and strengthening will be spent.

Uiterlijk voor de zomer wordt uw Kamer nader geïnformeerd over de visie van het kabinet op het postennet en de wijze waarop de in het Regeerakkoord aangekondigde middelen voor de uitbreiding en versterking hiervan zullen worden besteed.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Becker, Ten Broeke en Bosman over het bericht “Deal in Nederland onder de radar”

MPs Becker, Ten Broeke and Bosman asked about reports that a Dutch administration office became shareholder in a large Venezuelan oilfield, whether this breaches Venezuelan law and EU sanctions, and what risks and oversight apply. The government declined to discuss the specific case citing tax secrecy, stated the EU sanctions do not restrict oil-sector transactions, noted firms must self-check compliance, and said the OECD guidelines research by the National Contact Point will be sent to parliament before summer 2018.
Under the confidentiality obligation of Article 67 of the General State Taxes Act, individual taxpayers cannot, as is well known, be discussed.
Op grond van de geheimhoudingsplicht van artikel 67 Algemene wet inzake rijksbelastingen kan zoals bekend niet worden ingegaan op individuele belastingplichtigen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ten Broeke over het voornemen om nieuwe sancties aan Noord-Korea op te leggen

An MP asked the Foreign Minister whether the Netherlands supports new US-considered sanctions on North Korea, how sanctions are being enforced and whether ships are used to evade them, and why China and Russia were absent from the Vancouver meeting. The minister answered that Nederland supports further pressure and autonomous measures beyond UN resolutions, stresses enforcement and ship inspections, and notes that China and Russia's role was emphasised in the meeting's summary.

The Netherlands and the other countries attending the Vancouver meeting on North Korea (15–16 January 2018) agreed to consider autonomous sanctions or diplomatic actions going beyond the UN Security Council resolutions.

Nederland en de andere landen die aan de bijeenkomst over Noord-Korea in Vancouver deelnamen (15–16 januari 2018), hebben afgesproken autonome sancties of diplomatieke acties te overwegen die verder gaan dan de VN-Veiligheidsraadsresoluties.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Karabulut, Arissen, De Roon, Ten Broeke, Van Helvert, Ploumen, Sjoerdsma, Van der Staaij, Van Ojik en Voordewind over het bericht dat moordaanslagen op Turkse burgers in Europa in voorbere

MPs from ten parties asked the government whether it knew of reports that assassinations of Turkish citizens in Europe were being planned, how it assessed these claims, and whether it would investigate and take extra security measures. The minister said the government is alert and monitors tensions and safety in the Turkish-Dutch community, cannot confirm the existence of such plans, and urged anyone threatened to report it.
I cannot confirm the existence of plans for assassinations of Turkish citizens.
Het bestaan van plannen voor moordaanslagen op Turkse burgers kan ik niet bevestigen.
Antwoord op vragen van  het lid Ten Broeke over de illegale smokkel van Russische olie naar Noord-Korea

An MP asked the Foreign Minister about reports of Russian oil smuggled to North Korea and Russian help with missile technology, and what the Netherlands would do as chair of the UN sanctions committee. The minister said the government cannot confirm the reports, would await the UN Expert Panel report, and committed to urging member states to report violations and to outreach activities on sanctions implementation.
The Netherlands will also call on countries to raise reports of possible sanctions violations with the Expert Panel assisting the 1718 Sanctions Committee.
Nederland zal ook landen oproepen om meldingen van eventuele schendingen van sancties aan te kaarten bij het Expertpanel dat het 1718-Sanctiecomité bijstaat.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ten Broeke en Van Oosten over vrijspraak van de heer Poch in Argentinië

MPs Ten Broeke and Van Oosten asked the ministers about the Argentine acquittal of Mr Poch, the state's role in facilitating his prosecution, an anonymous prosecutor's remark, and the adequacy of consular assistance. The government answered that legal aid was given within the existing framework, that the state does not interfere in foreign criminal cases, that consular support was provided throughout detention, and that Mr Poch returned to the Netherlands on 7 December 2017.
The State refrains from substantive involvement in criminal cases that are before the (foreign) judge.
De Staat onthoudt zich van inhoudelijke bemoeienis met strafzaken die onder de (buitenlandse) rechter zijn.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ten Broeke, Van der Staaij en Voordewind over de steun aan het Human Rights and International Humanitarian Law Secretariat en de samenwerking met de Women’s Affairs Technical Committee

MPs asked why the Dutch government ended funding for the Women's Affairs Technical Committee after it refused to distance itself from a youth centre named after a convicted terrorist, and why the Human Rights and International Humanitarian Law Secretariat still lists WATC and touts its advocacy against Israel. The ministers answered that donors ended the partnership after WATC refused to distance itself from glorifying violence, that the last payment was in May 2017, that the website figures were adjusted, and that support for Israeli and Palestinian human rights organisations will continue under review.
The cabinet considers glorifying violence simply unacceptable and expects all its partners to keep well away from it.
Het kabinet acht het verheerlijken van geweld simpelweg onacceptabel en verwacht van al zijn partners dat zij zich hier verre van houden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Helvert, Ten Broeke, De Roon en Van der Staaij over de omstandigheden in Noord-Koreaanse politieke gevangenissen
