MPs from CDA, VVD, PVV and SGP asked the Foreign Minister about reports that North Korean political prisons resemble Nazi camps, including detention numbers, alleged crimes against humanity, UN and ICC action, and protection for Christians. The minister answered that the UN commission reports are authoritative, that Netherlands raises the issue at the UN and supports referral to the ICC though this requires Security Council agreement, and that it supports documentation projects and religious freedom.
The Netherlands, together with the EU, regularly raises the human rights situation in North Korea, including abuses in (political) prisons.
Nederland stelt de mensenrechtensituatie in Noord-Korea, inclusief misstanden in (politieke) gevangenissen, mede in EU-verband regelmatig aan de orde
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ten Broeke en Remco Dijkstra over uitstel verruiming Twentekanalen

MPs Ten Broeke and Remco Dijkstra asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management about a regional call to speed up the Twentekanalen widening, why the tender was withdrawn, and how to avoid the 18-month delay. The minister confirmed regular consultation with the region, explained the tender was withdrawn due to groundwater risks, and said the delay cannot be avoided, though some measures such as traffic restrictions and acceleration options are being explored.
Following this, the tender has been withdrawn in its current form.
Hierop is de aanbesteding in de huidige vorm ingetrokken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Voordewind, Ten Broeke en Van Helvert over het bericht dat Nederland in de VN meestemt met anti-Israëlische resoluties als gevolg van EU-beleid

Three MPs asked the Foreign Minister whether Dutch voting on anti-Israel UN resolutions is determined by EU policy and whether this conflicts with a parliamentary motion, and whether the government will change its voting. The minister answered that each proposal is assessed on its merits, that EU unity is pursued for influence, and that the motion is seen as encouragement to continue the current approach, without committing to a change in voting.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ten Broeke en Azmani over het bericht dat Tunesië een nieuwe springplank voor illegale migratie naar Europa wordt

MPs Ten Broeke and Azmani asked the ministers about reports that Tunisia is becoming a new departure route for illegal migration to Europe, including the scale of arrivals, possible undercounting, and cooperation with Tunisia. The government answered that arrivals from Tunisia have risen sharply but remain far below 2011 levels, that Tunisia is cooperating on border control and root causes, and that an integrated approach is needed.
Although this is relatively limited compared with the total number of arrivals in Italy, it is a striking increase compared with 2016.
Hoewel dit op het gehele aantal aankomsten in Italië relatief beperkt is, betreft het een opvallende stijging ten opzichte van 2016.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Staaij, Van Helvert en Ten Broeke over de implementatie van het vredesakkoord in Colombia

MPs Van der Staaij, Van Helvert and Ten Broeke asked the Foreign Minister about the slow and uneven implementation of the Colombia peace agreement, including rising violence and rights abuses, and what the Netherlands is doing and will do about it. The minister acknowledged the concerns, described mixed progress, listed Dutch funding and diplomatic initiatives, and said the government will press Colombia on faster implementation.
The cabinet will therefore seize every opportunity to press for the most effective and swift possible implementation of the peace agreement.
Het kabinet zal dan ook elke gelegenheid aangrijpen om aan te dringen op een zo effectief en spoedig mogelijke uitvoering van het vredesakkoord

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma, Ten Broeke, Voordewind, Van Nispen, Van Ojik, Thieme, Baudet, Kuzu, Van de Hul en Knops over het bericht dat de Nederlandse overheid grote steken heeft laten vallen in het verle

MPs from many parties asked the ministers of Foreign Affairs and Justice whether the Dutch government failed to assist Mr Singh, a Dutch national imprisoned in the US for 33 years, including over consular visits, a transfer request and the handling of his case. The government rejects the picture of failure, says it cannot intervene in foreign justice, explains that transfer was refused on legal grounds and pledges continued support for parole and review requests.
The ministries of Foreign Affairs and Justice and Security do not recognise that picture.
De ministeries van Buitenlandse Zaken en Justitie en Veiligheid herkennen zich niet in dat beeld.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ten Broeke en Karabulut over het bericht dat Noord-Koreaanse dwangarbeiders in Europa zouden hebben gewerkt aan de bouw van een Deens marineschip

MPs Ten Broeke and Karabulut asked whether North Korean forced labour was used to build a Danish navy vessel, a NATO ally's ship, and whether this poses a security risk and has been raised in NATO. The government answered that the issue has not been discussed in NATO, that individual allies bear responsibility for ships they make available, that the Danish government cannot yet confirm or deny the reports, and that the EU has adopted measures to reduce North Korean workers in the EU to zero.
The matter has not been discussed within NATO.
De kwestie is niet in NAVO-verband besproken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Becker, Ten Broeke en Van den Bosch over landen die in Nederland onderdelen voor massavernietigingswapens proberen te kopen

MPs from the VVD asked the ministers whether countries such as Iran, Syria and Pakistan are procuring weapons-of-mass-destruction components in the Netherlands, what has been done about successful purchases, what extra measures are needed, how businesses and SMEs are made aware of the risk, and whether a blacklist of intermediaries exists. The government confirmed the risk, described export-control and awareness measures, and declined to publish a blacklist or specific case details for national security reasons.
The cabinet does not make public statements about case matters that touch on the current knowledge level and modus operandi of the Dutch intelligence and security services.
Het kabinet doet in het openbaar geen uitspraken over casuïstiek die het actuele kennisniveau en de modus operandi van de Nederlandse inlichtingen- en veiligheidsdiensten raken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Staaij, Ten Broeke en De Roon over het stopzetten van de financiering aan de Women’s Affairs Technical Committee (WATC)

MPs Van der Staaij, Ten Broeke and De Roon asked whether Dutch funding to the Women's Affairs Technical Committee (WATC) was stopped after WATC backed a youth centre named after a terrorist, and whether other subsidised organisations glorify terrorism. The ministers confirm the funding was halted with other donors, citing glorification of violence, and state that existing subsidy conditions are sufficient to prevent support to such organisations.
For this reason, the Netherlands, together with the other donors of the Human Rights and International Humanitarian Law Secretariat, has decided to immediately end cooperation with WATC.
Om deze reden heeft Nederland – samen met de andere donoren van het Human Rights and International Humanitairan Law Secretariat – besloten de samenwerking met WATC per direct stop te zetten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ten Broeke en Knops over het bereiken van een definitief akkoord tussen Turkije en Rusland over het leveren van S-400 luchtverdedigingssystemen

MPs Ten Broeke and Knops asked whether Erdogan's claim of a settled deal with Russia on S-400 air defence systems is confirmed, why Turkey chose Russian rather than NATO-compatible systems, and what the consequences would be for NATO if a deal is final. The government answered that no definitive agreement has been confirmed, so it cannot yet assess motives or consequences, though interoperability problems and exclusion from NATO networks are likely if the purchase proceeds.
The cabinet therefore cannot confirm that Russia and Turkey have concluded a definitive agreement.
Het kabinet kan daarom niet bevestigen dat Rusland en Turkije een definitieve overeenkomst hebben gesloten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Karabulut, Ten Broeke, Knops, Van Ojik, Sjoerdsma en Voordewind over de arrestatie van een Turkse Nederlander in Turkije

MPs from six parties asked the Foreign Minister about the arrest in Turkey of Dutch-Turkish national Volkan Çalışkan over a banner, whether consular assistance was given, and about the travel bans on eleven Dutch citizens and wider rule-of-law concerns. The minister confirmed the arrest, said the Netherlands requested consular access and will ask the Turkish authorities for attention to the cases, and described diplomatic efforts on Turkey's rule of law.
The Netherlands will continue to request extra attention for these cases so that those involved can return to the Netherlands as soon as possible.
Nederland zal extra aandacht voor deze gevallen blijven vragen opdat betrokkenen zo spoedig mogelijk naar Nederland kunnen terugkeren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ten Broeke en Karabulut over Noord-Koreaanse dwangarbeiders in Europa

MPs Ten Broeke and Karabulut asked the government about reports that North Korean workers in Europe, largely in Poland, are subjected to forced labour that funds the North Korean state, and about the government's knowledge, EU subsidies and NATO-ship links. Minister Asscher answered that Poland has found no illegal work or forced labour, that the matter has been raised in the UN, Council and International Labour Conference, that EU subsidy control lies first with member states, and that no North Korean workers were found working on Dutch navy ships at CRIST.
Precise amounts are not known and estimates vary.
Precieze bedragen zijn niet bekend en schattingen lopen uiteen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ten Broeke over risico’s van willekeurige arrestaties in Turkije

An MP from the VVD asked the Foreign Minister whether he was concerned that Turkey arrests foreign journalists and activists for statements made abroad, and what this means for Dutch travellers. The government says it urges Turkey to respect the rule of law, has reinforced travel advice warning of prosecution for insulting the head of state and terrorism-linked activity, and will keep raising concerns in EU and Council of Europe settings.
The Ministry of Foreign Affairs continuously considers whether travel advice needs to be adjusted.
Het Ministerie van Buitenlandse Zaken kijkt voortdurend of reisadviezen aanpassing vragen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ten Broeke over de aanschaf van een Russisch luchtafweersysteem door NAVO-lid Turkije

MPs Ten Broeke asked the Defence and Foreign Ministers about reports that NATO member Turkey agreed to buy the Russian S-400 air defence system, and the consequences for NATO. The government said it could not confirm a definitive deal, declined to speculate on consequences, and noted that arms purchases are sovereign and NATO has no rules barring them.
However, the cabinet cannot currently confirm that Russia and Turkey have concluded a definitive agreement and also has no further information about this possible agreement.
Echter, het kabinet kan thans niet bevestigen dat Rusland en Turkije een definitieve overeenkomst hebben gesloten en beschikt ook niet over nadere informatie over deze mogelijke overeenkomst.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ten Broeke en Yesilgöz-Zegerius over het bericht dat Israël een Nederlands ontwikkelingsproject heeft gesloopt

Two VVD MPs asked whether Dutch development projects in Israeli-controlled Area C without permits fit Dutch policy, and whether the embassy notified Israeli authorities that the Dutch-funded project was seized. The government answered that Israel rarely issues permits, that it need not disclose donors, that the seizure lacked a prior stop-work order, and that it will leave coordination to implementing agencies without announcing a change.
As long as there is no fundamental change in the permit system, the cabinet will leave it to the implementing organisations to decide the extent to which they coordinate with the Israeli authorities.

Zolang er geen fundamentele verandering in het vergunningstelsel komt, zal het kabinet het aan de uitvoerende organisaties laten om te bepalen in welke mate zij wel of niet coördineren met de Israëlische autoriteiten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Staaij, De Roon, Ten Broeke en Voordewind over het besluit van Unesco over de Oude Stad van Hebron

Four MPs asked the Foreign Minister whether UNESCO's decision to place the Old City of Hebron on the World Heritage List, which they said neglects Jewish history, distorts history, and whether the Netherlands will protest. The minister answered that the decision was taken by the World Heritage Committee members, that ICOMOS could not verify the emergency procedure criteria because Israel denied a site visit, that the cabinet follows ICOMOS advice, and that the Netherlands will not protest but will urge coexistence.
The cabinet's position is that it follows the advice of ICOMOS.
Het kabinet hanteert als standpunt dat het de adviezen van ICOMOS volgt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Voordewind, Ten Broeke, Karabulut, Van Raan, De Roon en Van der Staaij over de confiscaties door Turkse overheid van Aramese kerken en kerkbezittingen

MPs asked the Foreign Minister whether Turkey's transfer of over 50 Aramaic churches and monasteries to the Diyanet amounts to confiscation, and whether the Netherlands would seek clarification and urge EU partners to respond. The minister said the transfers stem from administrative reorganisation under Turkish law, that Diyanet denied receiving property and Mardin confirmed this, but that the Aramaic community has lost property it used for over a thousand years; the embassy will raise minority rights and a field visit with EU partners is planned.
The Netherlands will continue to raise the rights of religious minorities in Turkey with the authorities.
Nederland zal de rechten van religieuze minderheden in Turkije bij de autoriteiten blijven aankaarten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Helvert, Ten Broeke en Voordewind over een politieteam in Indonesië tegen LHBT'ers (Lesbiënnes, Homoseksuelen, Biseksuelen en Transgenders) moet opsporen

MPs Van Helvert, Ten Broeke and Voordewind asked about a planned West Java police unit to hunt LHBT people, alleged threats of harsh punishment, Dutch aid to Indonesia, and whether the Netherlands will act via EU dialogue. The government says the unit has not been formally established, confirms the Netherlands raised LHBTI concerns bilaterally and via the EU, lists aid being phased out by 2020 while support to civil society continues, and commits to raising the issue in the EU-Indonesia human rights dialogue.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ten Broeke en Bosman over het bericht “Curaçaose kust gaat dicht”

MPs Ten Broeke and Bosman asked the government about a report that Curaçao was closing its coast to stem Venezuelan migration, and about the scope of the Kustwacht's tasks and the Dutch role in any investigation. The minister answered that the report rests partly on misinterpretation, that border control is Curaçao's own responsibility, that no concrete signs of a large refugee flow exist, and that the Kustwacht's border-guarding task is not new.
Border control is an autonomous matter of the country Curaçao.
Grensbewaking is een autonome aangelegenheid van het land Curaçao.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Tellegen en Ten Broeke over het bericht 'honderden zeeschepen van de radar'

Two VVD MPs asked the Ministers of Justice and Security and of Foreign Affairs about reports that hundreds of ships enter Dutch waters each month after switching off their GPS/AIS signals, and about controls on such vessels. Minister Blok answered that the Coast Guard monitors the North Sea around the clock, cannot confirm the report's claims, uses risk profiling and information-led intervention, and sees no problems with ship registration.
The Coast Guard does not have the research data on which Windward based its conclusions and therefore cannot confirm such a statement.
De Kustwacht beschikt niet over de onderzoeksgegevens waarop Windward haar conclusies heeft gebaseerd en kan derhalve een dergelijke uitspraak niet bevestigen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Voordewind, Van der Staaij, Ten Broeke en De Roon over de berichten dat Turkije Koerdische doelen in Noord-Syrië en Noord-Irak heeft aangevallen

Four MPs asked the Foreign Minister about reported Turkish strikes on Kurdish targets in northern Syria and Iraq, including whether evidence supports Turkey's claim the targets were PKK smugglers and what is known of casualties among Syrian Christians and Yazidis. The minister answered that Turkey has a right to self-defence but should show restraint and act proportionately, that the government has no evidence to confirm or refute Turkey's claim, and that it has no independent information on casualties, only open-source reports of protests.
The Netherlands does not have independent intelligence on the basis of which these reports can be confirmed or refuted.
Nederland beschikt niet over eigenstandige inlichtingen op basis waarvan deze berichten bevestigd of ontkracht kunnen worden.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Voordewind, Van Helvert, De Roon, Karabulut, Van der Staaij, Ten Broeke, Diks, Van den Hul en Sjoerdsma over de veroordeling van de gouverneur Tjahaja Purnama van Jakarta

MPs from nine parties asked the Foreign Minister how the government views the two-year prison sentence of Jakarta governor Purnama for blasphemy, whether it will press Indonesia for his release and raise the case in the EU-Indonesia human rights dialogue. The minister answered that the government is concerned, that the human rights ambassador raised it with Indonesian officials, that the EU issued a statement, and that the case will be followed closely, without committing to demand release.
The Dutch government will continue to closely monitor the case and the situation regarding freedom of expression and of religion or belief, together with other EU partners.
De Nederlandse regering zal de zaak en de situatie rondom de vrijheid van meningsuiting en van godsdienst en levensovertuiging, samen met andere EU-partners, nauw blijven volgen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ten Broeke over de beveiliging van websites van Nederlandse ambassades

An MP asked the Foreign Minister about insecure websites of Dutch embassies in Afghanistan, China, Egypt and Sudan, whether the risks were known for months, and when a fix would come. The minister denied the sites remained insecure, said they have been replaced by new HTTPS-enforcing sites, and argued the earlier risk was low because no sensitive personal data was collected.
No, it is not correct that the websites of the Dutch embassies in the four named countries are still insufficiently secured.
Nee, het klopt niet dat de websites van de Nederlandse ambassades in de vier genoemde landen nog altijd onvoldoende zijn beveiligd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Voordewind, Segers, Knops, Ten Broeke, Martin Bosma en Van der Staaij over de verboden stille tocht van Christenen voor Israël in Rotterdam

Six MPs asked why Rotterdam's mayor banned a silent march by Christians for Israel, questioning the security rationale given the comparable treatment of a Palestinian Return Centre congress and the impact on Jewish residents. The minister replied that maintaining public order is the mayor's responsibility and accountable to the municipal council, that the organisation itself chose to cancel the march, and that police capacity decisions in similar future cases rest with the mayor.
Maintaining public order in Rotterdam is the responsibility of the mayor of Rotterdam.
De handhaving van de openbare orde in Rotterdam is de verantwoordelijkheid van de burgemeester van Rotterdam.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Knops, Ten Broeke , Van Bommel, Sjoerdsma, Grashoff en Voordewind over schandalige intimidatiepraktijken en misleiding door Turkije

Six MPs asked the government about reported intimidation of Turkish-Dutch citizens and a Rotterdam CDA councillor by Turkish consular officials, whether the consul misled Dutch authorities, and whether the consul should be expelled. The government answered by referring the MPs to a separate letter to parliament (Kamerstuk 34 824, nr. 195) on the ministerial campaign visits and the events of 11 March 2017, without answering the questions in the reply itself.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Staaij, De Roon, Baudet, Ten Broeke, Voordewind en Knops over haatzaaien in Palestijnse schoolboeken

MPs from several parties asked the Foreign Minister whether Palestinian schoolbooks incite hatred against Israel, glorify martyrdom and fuel terrorism, and whether the Netherlands funds such curricula. The minister answered that UNRWA screens textbooks and found problematic passages in some, that the government has no comparative data showing a trend toward more incitement, and that the Netherlands is not a donor to the Palestinian education sector.
The Netherlands is not a donor to the Palestinian education sector and therefore does not contribute to the curriculum.
Nederland is geen donor voor de Palestijnse onderwijssector en draagt derhalve ook niet bij aan het curriculum.

Antwoord op vragen gesteld door de leden Voordewind, Van der Staaij, De Roon en Ten Broeke over het bericht dat UNESCO een resolutie in stemming wil brengen waarin de soevereiniteit van Israël over West-Jeruzalem ontkend

MPs from ChristenUnie, SGP, PVV and VVD asked whether the government would use its influence in UNESCO to block a draft resolution denying Israeli sovereignty over West Jerusalem, and why UNESCO engages with such politicised texts. The minister said the Netherlands criticised the draft, voted against the adopted version together with Germany, Greece and Lithuania, and that UNESCO's focus on the Old City reflects its World Heritage listings, but did not commit to further action.
The Netherlands therefore voted against the decision, as explained in a joint statement of vote with Germany, Greece and Lithuania.
Nederland heeft daarom tegen het besluit gestemd, zoals toegelicht in een gezamenlijke stemverklaring met Duitsland, Griekenland en Litouwen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Staaij, Thieme, Ten Broeke, Voordewind, Knops, Karabulut en Van Rooijen over repressieve maatregelen tegen de oppositie door de regering van Wit-Rusland

Six MPs asked the Foreign Minister about repressive measures against the opposition in Belarus, including arrests of demonstrators and Christian Democrat leaders around the 25 March protest. The minister said the Belarusian authorities' measures were disproportionate, that Nederland raised concerns via EU statements and with the Belarusian ambassador, and that the issue was discussed in the OSCE Permanent Council.
In the cabinet's view, the measures of the Belarusian authorities are not proportionate.
De maatregelen van de Wit-Russische autoriteiten zijn in de ogen van het kabinet niet proportioneel.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Taverne en Ten Broeke over het bericht dat de EU-steun aan Afrika ten zuiden van de Sahara voor het genereren van inkomsten “nog niet doeltreffend” is.

MPs Taverne and Ten Broeke asked about a European Court of Auditors report finding EU budget support to sub-Saharan Africa not yet effective for domestic revenue mobilisation, and about Dutch positions, EU budget support share, and Zimbabwe tax-training assistance. The minister answered in detail, accepting the report's six recommendations, defending budget support as broadly effective, and noting the Dutch stance and the ended training assistance.
The cabinet welcomes more information and evaluations on the contribution of budget support to domestic revenue mobilisation.
Het kabinet verwelkomt meer informatievoorziening en evaluaties over de bijdrage van begrotingssteun aan de mobilisering van binnenlandse inkomsten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ten Broeke, Azmani en Koopmans over het bericht dat de Turkse AK-partij weer een ronselbrief aan Nederlanders met een Turkse achtergrond heeft gestuurd

VVD MPs asked whether the Turkish AK party again sent a recruitment letter, signed by the Turkish prime minister, to Turkish-Dutch citizens about the referendum, whether it used the same address list as in 2015, and whether the government will raise this with Turkey. The minister confirmed some recipients received the letter, said it is unknown whether the 2015 address list was reused, noted Turkish parties can buy voter address lists, and said the government remains opposed to political campaigning by Turkish officials in the Netherlands.
It is not known whether the AK party used the same address list as in 2015.
Het is niet bekend of de AK-partij gebruik heeft gemaakt van hetzelfde adressenbestand als in 2015.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ten Broeke, Nijkerken-de Haan en Visser inzake de Duitse tol

MPs Ten Broeke, Nijkerken-De Haan and Visser asked whether the German Bundesrat's approval of the road toll (vignette) removes obstacles to its introduction, what its effects are for Dutch motorists, transport and border regions, and what the minister will do, including a border-impact assessment. The minister answered that the EU-required changes were adopted, that the infringement procedure continues, that he opposes the toll, will seek clarification from the Commission and Austria, and will carry out a border-effects assessment once the German law is final.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Visser en Ten Broeke over vliegen boven conflictgebieden

MPs Visser and Ten Broeke asked the State Secretary about aviation over conflict zones, including ICAO measures, information sharing, the Ten Broeke motion on safety management certification, and airspace closure powers. The State Secretary answered that ICAO has adopted measures with implementation timelines, that a convenant on threat information sharing works well with a formal evaluation planned, and that the government is pushing for further ICAO and EU rules.
As laid down in the Convenant, a formal evaluation will take place this year before the summer.
Zoals in het Convenant is vastgelegd vindt een formele evaluatie dit jaar voor de zomer plaats.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ten Broeke, Eijsink, Van Bommel en Belhaj over het gebruik van een door Nederland gefinancierd mortuarium in Afghanistan als jongensbordeel

MPs asked whether the government knew that a mortuary it helped fund near Kamp Holland in Tarin Kowt, Afghanistan, was used as a brothel for boys (bacha bazi), when it was discovered, and what measures followed. The government answered that it had no information during ISAF that the building was misused, learned of it from the Brandpunt broadcast, raised child abuse with local leaders regularly, and confirmed it financed the mortuary (about EUR 15,000) in 2008.
During the ISAF mission the cabinet had no information showing that the mortuary was being used for other purposes.
Het kabinet beschikte gedurende de ISAF-missie niet over informatie waaruit bleek dat het mortuarium voor andere doeleinden werd gebruikt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Voordewind, Ten Broeke, Van der Staaij en De Roon over aanslagen op christenen in de Sinaï, Egypte

MPs from several parties asked the Foreign Minister about ISIS killings of Christians in North Sinai, whether Egypt can protect them, whether the government will raise concerns with Egypt and President Sisi, and whether Dutch radar deliveries to the Egyptian navy improve Sinai surveillance. The minister answered that the government is concerned, cannot judge the army's protection capacity given limited access and information, will raise concerns bilaterally and via the EU, and that the radars are not yet operational and are not clearly linked to Sinai surveillance.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ten Broeke over het bericht inzake de illegale opstelling van raketten door Rusland

MP Ten Broeke asks the Foreign and Defence Ministers whether Russia deployed new intermediate-range missiles in breach of the INF treaty and how NATO has responded. The government says it cannot yet confirm the deployment, notes that such deployment would breach the treaty, and describes ongoing NATO-Russia dialogue and a pattern of Russian provocations.
the government cannot yet confirm that the Russian armed forces have deployed a ground-launched cruise missile with a range of 500 to 5,500 kilometres
kan de regering het opstellen van een grondgelanceerd kruisvluchtwapen met een bereik van 500 kilometer tot 5.500 kilometer door de Russische krijgsmacht vooralsnog niet bevestigen
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Visser, Ten Broeke en Azmani over de financiële bijdragen van provincies aan het hoofdwegennet

VVD MPs asked the minister why Overijssel appears to contribute the most provincial co-financing to national motorway projects, and how investment priorities and the Infrastructure Fund figures were determined. The minister answered that investments follow the SVIR and NMCA bottleneck analyses and File Top 50, that the table reflects cash flows (inflated for Overijssel by a 2015 transfer), and listed 2006-2015 and upcoming Overijssel projects with co-financing amounts.
The table was compiled from the annual reports of the Infrastructure Fund (IF).
De tabel is tot stand gekomen vanuit de jaarverslagen van het Infrastructuurfonds (IF).
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Knops, Keijzer en Ten Broeke over uitspraken van de president van Mali over terugname van uitgeprocedeerde asielzoekers en illegalen

MPs from CDA and VVD asked the ministers whether Mali's president's statements that Mali would never sign a readmission agreement undermined the EU-Mali migration deal and whether Mali was cooperating enough on returning its nationals, and whether pressure or aid conditionality should be used. The government answered that the joint declaration remains valid, that Mali is bound by international law to cooperate on returns, that only about ten Malians returned voluntarily since 2014 and none forcibly, and that it prefers a broad pragmatic approach over negative incentives such as cutting aid.
The cabinet is of the view that measures to encourage this cooperation are most effective when they are part of a broader package.
Het kabinet is van mening dat maatregelen om deze medewerking te stimuleren het effectiefst zijn als zij onderdeel zijn van een breder pakket.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ten Broeke over het bericht dat een Nederlandse vrouw het Verenigd Koninkrijk na 24 jaar moet verlaten

An MP asks the Foreign Minister about reports that a Dutch woman married to a Briton, with 24 years' residence in the UK, was told to leave after her citizenship/residence application was refused over her passport copy, and whether more Dutch citizens face the same problem. The minister says the case is not confirmed, the ministry was not involved, the woman reapplied and reportedly got a residence permit, and that Brexit rights will be addressed in negotiations.
The Ministry of Foreign Affairs is not automatically involved in immigration or naturalisation applications by Dutch citizens abroad.
Het Ministerie van Buitenlandse Zaken is niet automatisch betrokken bij immigratie of naturalisatie aanvragen van Nederlandse burgers in het buitenland.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ten Broeke over weer een lancering van een ballistische raket door Iran

An MP asked the Foreign Minister whether Iran's January 2017 Khorramshahr ballistic missile launch violates UN resolution 2231, what measures were taken after earlier launches, and whether Iran's conduct is tolerated. The minister confirmed the launch, said it is legally not a violation but inconsistent with Annex B, and described raising the issue in the UN Security Council, EU statements and bilateral contacts while noting insufficient support for new sanctions.
The cabinet will have to keep increasing pressure on Iran, as far as possible jointly with the EU partners.
Het kabinet zal, zoveel mogelijk gezamenlijk met de EU-partners, druk op Iran moeten blijven opvoeren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Lodders en Ten Broeke over dreigende antidumpingmaatregelen van Brazilië

MPs Lodders and Ten Broeke asked about Brazil's threatened anti-dumping duties on Dutch chips exports, including whether the Brazilian authorities used improper arguments, whether the measures comply with WTO rules, and what steps the government has taken. The minister answered that the Commission considers the measures insufficiently substantiated, that the Netherlands has lobbied repeatedly through its embassy and the Commission, and that the Commission can challenge the measures at the WTO.
The cabinet shares the European Commission's view that the measures are insufficiently substantiated and motivated.
Het kabinet deelt de lezing van de Europese Commissie dat de maatregelen onvoldoende zijn onderbouwd en gemotiveerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Staaij, Voordewind, Ten Broeke, De Roon, Knops en Van Bommel over de Ranglijst Christenvervolging 2017 van Open Doors

MPs from several parties asked the Foreign Minister about Open Doors' 2017 ranking of Christian persecution, including whether the rise in persecution, the role of religious nationalism and Saudi-linked financing in Sub-Saharan Africa, Dutch policy and the fight against ISIS are being addressed. The minister confirmed the increase in persecution, said the causes are hard to pin down, described Dutch efforts through the Human Rights Fund and diplomacy, and said the fight against ISIS also serves Christians.
To gain more clarity on this, the Netherlands is supporting research in the region into both the sources and the effects of these financing flows in the Horn of Africa.
Om hier meer duidelijkheid over te krijgen steunt Nederland onderzoek in de regio naar zowel bronnen als effecten van deze financieringsstromen in de Hoorn van Afrika.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ten Broeke en Taverne over het rapport van de Europese Rekenkamer over EU-bijstand aan Oekraïne

MPs Ten Broeke and Taverne (VVD) asked about the European Court of Auditors report on EU assistance to Ukraine, including reporting on indicators, repayment options, and measures to strengthen control over EU aid to Georgia, Moldova and Ukraine. The minister welcomed the Court's recommendations, explained the aid framework, conditionality and transparency, and said the EU Association Agreement does not affect member states' decisions on financial aid to Ukraine.
The Netherlands will use the Council discussion of the report to invite the Commission to place greater emphasis on conditionality in programming.
Nederland zal de bespreking in Raadsverband van het rapport aangrijpen om de Commissie uit te nodigen nog meer nadruk te leggen op conditionaliteit in de programmering.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ten Broeke over het mogelijk bestaan van een Nederlandse nepambassade in Ghana

An MP asked the Foreign Minister whether a Dutch fake embassy operated in Ghana alongside a US one, and what the government knew of its activities, the response from Ghanaian authorities, and the risks to Dutch visas and security. The minister replied that Ghanaian authorities found no evidence of a Dutch or US fake embassy, that contacts with the US are ongoing and the investigation continues, and that found Schengen visas, including five long-expired Dutch visas, pose no recent security risk.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ten Broeke, Sjoerdsma, Van Bommel, Knops, Voordewind en Servaes over de arrestatie van een Nederlandse journalist in Panama

MPs from several parties asked the Foreign Minister about the arrest in Panama of Dutch journalist Okke Ornstein, whom they linked to exposing corruption, and what the ministry was doing about it. The minister answered that Ornstein faced criminal defamation charges, that the Dutch embassy and minister pressed Panama for press freedom and visits, and that a presidential pardon was expected so he would be released soon.
At my request, the Dutch ambassador spoke with several ministers of the Panamanian government and with President Varela.
Op mijn verzoek sprak de Nederlandse ambassadeur met verschillende ministers van de Panamese regering en met president Varela.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bosman en Ten Broeke over het dispuut rondom Oyster Pond

MPs Bosman and Ten Broeke asked whether French authorities inspected a construction site on the Dutch side of Oyster Pond, whether the border there is settled, and whether this is a territorial dispute and what its consequences are. The minister confirms a disagreement over the land border, says the status quo agreed in 2014 was breached by the French inspection, notes that border negotiations will start soon, and says relations with France are not affected.
The land border negotiations will be started as soon as possible.
De landgrensonderhandelingen zullen zo spoedig mogelijk worden aangevangen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Maij, Ten Broeke, Van Bommel, Verhoeven, Grashoff, Voordewind en Thieme over het bericht dat EU-Turkijerapporteur Kati Piri wordt geweerd uit Turkije

MPs asked the Foreign Minister whether Turkey had barred EP Turkey rapporteur Kati Piri from entering the country, what reasons were given, and what the government was doing to secure her access and support her criticism of arrests of HDP parliamentarians. The minister confirmed the report, referred to an earlier letter, said Turkey had cancelled her scheduled meetings rather than denying entry, and stated the Turkish reasons were unknown while promising to keep raising the issue with Turkey.

The matter is primarily a matter between the European Parliament and Turkey, but the Netherlands will continue to bring to the attention of the Turkish authorities the importance of dialogue with the EP and access for its rapporteurs.

De kwestie is primair een zaak tussen het Europees parlement en Turkije, maar Nederland zal het belang van een dialoog met het EP en de toegang van haar Rapporteurs bij de Turkse autoriteiten onder de aandacht blijven brengen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid ten Broeke over het besluit van de Britse regering om gelden ten behoeve van de Palestijnse Autoriteit te bevriezen

An MP asked the Foreign Minister whether the UK froze aid to the Palestinian Authority over payments to terrorists' salaries, and whether the Netherlands would press the EU to act and use aid as leverage. The government denied a freeze, said the Netherlands is pushing to change the prisoner-payment system, and stated that Dutch and EU funds cannot be used for payments to the PLO or prisoners.
The cabinet will continue along the chosen path of gaining support within the EU to convince the Palestinian Authority that the system must be changed.
Het kabinet zal doorgaan op de ingeslagen weg om binnen de EU steun te vergaren om de Palestijnse Autoriteit te overtuigen dat het systeem veranderd moet worden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ten Broeke over de kosten van extra veiligheidsmaatregelen rond de Amerikaanse ambassade in Wassenaar

An MP asked the Minister of Security and Justice who bears the costs of extra security around the new US embassy in Wassenaar and whether the municipality is liable for unforeseen measures. The minister replied that under the 2015 circular the costs are borne locally, the mayor is responsible for public-order security measures, and the matter is a local affair on which he has already spoken with the mayor.
Designating these objects does not mean that the Minister of Security and Justice is therefore also responsible for financing these measures.
Het aanwijzen van genoemde objecten brengt niet met zich mee dat de Minister van Veiligheid en Justitie daarmee ook verantwoordelijk is voor de financiering van deze maatregelen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ten Broeke over de subsidie ten behoeve van het tijdschrift OneWorld

An MP asked the Minister of Foreign Affairs about the government subsidy to the online magazine OneWorld via the NCDO, its aims, how its effects were measured, and whether a competing trade journal was treated unfairly. The minister answered that the subsidy is being phased out through 2017 under an agreed transition, that the aims focus on core functions, and that the government has no further agreements beyond the current arrangement.
Er is geen nieuwe evaluatie voorzien.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ten Broeke over de Nederlandse positie inzake een AVVN-resolutie over een internationaal verbod op kernwapens

An MP asked how a UN General Assembly resolution launching negotiations on a treaty banning nuclear weapons fits with NATO nuclear commitments, the NPT, and Russian nuclear posturing. The minister answered by referring the MP to a separate letter to parliament on the negotiations, without answering the questions on substance here.
have been answered by means of the letter 'Negotiations on an international ban on nuclear weapons' (Parliamentary paper 33 783, no. 23)
zijn beantwoord middels de brief «Onderhandelingen over een internationaal verbod op kernwapens» (Kamerstuk 33 783, nr. 23 )
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Servaes, Ten Broeke, Jasper van Dijk, Knops, Sjoerdsma, Voordewind, Grashoff en Van der Staaij over het gebruik van chemische wapens in Darfur

MPs asked the Foreign Minister about Amnesty's report of possible chemical weapons use in Darfur, lack of humanitarian and UNAMID access to Jebel Marra, and whether Sudan should be asked to explain under the Chemical Weapons Convention and face inspection. The minister said the OPCW is examining the report, has requested more information from Sudan, and that Netherlands will press for accountability and raise the issue with EU and UN partners if use is confirmed.
The Netherlands asked the OPCW to act proactively and to actively inform the States Parties about the findings.
Nederland heeft de OPCW verzocht om proactief optreden en de Staten Partijen actief over de bevindingen te informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Staaij, Voordewind, Van Bommel, Bontes, Ten Broeke, Servaes, Knops en Sjoerdsma over het uitoefenen van internationale druk op Noord-Korea

MPs from several parties asked the Foreign Minister how North Korea's missile launches and nuclear tests affect regional stability, what diplomatic and sanctions pressure can be applied via China and the UN/EU, and how the Netherlands prepares for regime destabilisation. The minister answered that the Netherlands condemns the launches, supports UN sanctions enforcement and IAEA action, will press for a human rights resolution at the UN General Assembly, and sees no concrete signs of regime collapse.
The Netherlands will – as in recent years – continue to raise human rights violations both bilaterally and in relevant international forums.
Nederland zal – net als in afgelopen jaren – zowel bilateraal als in relevante internationale fora aandacht blijven vragen voor mensenrechtenschendingen.
Antwoord op de vragen leden Van der Staaij, Voordewind, Ten Broeke, De Roon en Knops over het wereldwijd toegenomen geweld tegen Joden

MPs from several parties asked the Foreign Minister about a reported global rise in violence against Jews, including the Pew Research figures, its causes, the countries affected, Dutch funding of BDS-linked organisations, monitoring, and follow-up on a motion on antisemitism. The minister answered that the findings are concerning, that causes are complex and context-specific, that BDS activities are protected by free speech, and listed Dutch and EU initiatives against discrimination and antisemitism.
These findings from Pew Research are very concerning.
Deze bevindingen van Pew Research zijn zeer zorgelijk.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ten Broeke, Vuijk en Bosman over het bericht “Venezuela beschuldigt Nederland en VS opnieuw van agressie”

MPs Ten Broeke, Vuijk and Bosman asked the Foreign Minister whether he knew of Venezuela's accusations against the Netherlands and the US of airspace violation and aggression, and whether the government would respond. The minister answered that Venezuela did not accuse the Netherlands of airspace violation, that the government has no information on any airspace breach, and that he voiced concern to the Venezuelan foreign minister and urged that such statements be avoided.
In a conversation with the Venezuelan Minister of Foreign Affairs, I expressed my surprise and concern about these unjustified and public accusations directed at Venezuela.
In een gesprek met de Venezolaanse Minister van Buitenlandse Zaken heb ik mijn verbazing en zorg over deze onterechte en publieke beschuldigingen uitgesproken richting Venezuela.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Taverne en Ten Broeke over uitspraken van de Nederlandse ambassadeur in Kenia

MPs Taverne and Ten Broeke asked whether the minister's earlier answers on the Dutch ambassador in Kenya's remarks were complete, and how a 'firm conversation' with the ambassador squares with freedom of expression. The minister answered that the remarks conflicted with aid and trade policy, that a talk with the ambassador took place, and that the matter is closed.
I consider the matter closed with this.
Ik beschouw de kwestie hiermee als afgedaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ten Broeke over het bericht dat Turkije nog altijd onderdak biedt aan talloze islamitische extremisten

MP Ten Broeke asked the Foreign Minister whether Turkey deliberately shelters leaders of Islamist groups designated as terrorist by the EU and US, including Jabhat al-Nusra and Muslim Brotherhood figures, and how the government views Turkish conduct against ISIS and Hamas. The minister answered that Turkey is an essential counter-terrorism partner, that Nusra is on Turkey's national terrorism list, that Turkish support for other groups cannot be excluded, and that Turkish counter-terrorism efforts have strengthened, while stating that the Erdogan statements are his own responsibility.
The cabinet is of the view that it is not at odds with the fight against terrorism that members of the Egyptian Muslim Brotherhood reside in Turkey.
Het kabinet is van mening dat het niet op gespannen voet staat met de strijd tegen terrorisme dat leden van de Egyptische Moslimbroederschap woonachtig zijn in Turkije.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ten Broeke over het bericht dat de Duitse regering Turkije een platform voor islamisten noemt

An MP asked the Foreign Minister whether he knew of reports that the German government calls Turkey a platform for Islamists, whether Turkey supports the Muslim Brotherhood, Hamas and armed opposition groups, and how he judges that support by a NATO ally. The minister confirmed awareness, said the German answers were only partly public and the leaked part is confidential, and stressed Turkey remains a counter-terrorism partner while confirming Turkish contacts with these groups.
The cabinet can confirm that Turkey maintains contacts with the Egyptian Muslim Brotherhood, Hamas and various armed opposition groups.
Het kabinet kan bevestigen dat Turkije contacten onderhoudt met de Egyptische Moslimbroederschap, Hamas en verschillende gewapende oppositiegroepen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ten Broeke over het bericht dat Iran na het sluiten van de atoomdeal zou hebben geprobeerd nucleair materiaal aan te schaffen

An MP asked the Foreign Minister about reports that Iran tried to acquire nuclear-relevant materials after the 2015 nuclear deal, and about Iranian ballistic missile tests. The minister answered that the government has no evidence of procurement in breach of the JCPOA or UNSC Resolution 2231, that no new sanctions were pursued, and that NATO missile defence is being strengthened.
Given the sensitivity of this information, no statements can be made about possible procurement activities for proliferation-sensitive goods in the Netherlands and the European Union.
Gezien de gevoeligheid van deze informatie kunnen er geen uitspraken gedaan worden over eventuele verwervingsactiviteiten van proliferatiegevoelige goederen in Nederland en de Europese Unie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ten Broeke over het testen van een ballistische raket door Iran in juli 2016

An MP from the VVD asked the Foreign Minister whether Iran conducted a further ballistic missile test in July 2016, whether North Korean technology was used, whether this violates UN resolutions 1929 or 2231 and the nuclear deal, and why stronger action has been slow. The minister answered that the reported test could not be confirmed, that intelligence services are investigating, that the Netherlands has raised concerns in the EU and UN Security Council, and that sanctions lacked support in those bodies.
The cabinet cannot for the time being confirm this news report.
Het kabinet kan dit nieuwsbericht vooralsnog niet bevestigen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Voordewind c.s. over de bijdrage van Nederland aan politietrainingen op Papua

Dutch MPs asked the Foreign Minister about Dutch support for police training on Papua, including monitoring of Indonesian security forces, possible human rights abuses by trained officers, and the Community Policing Programme's design and evaluation. The minister answered that a mid-term evaluation shows gradual progress, that no guarantee can be given that trained officers did not commit abuses, and that embassy staff monitor the situation through dialogue with local actors.
No guarantee can be given that trained officers did not take part in violating human rights.
Er kan geen garantie worden gegeven dat getrainde agenten niet hebben deelgenomen aan het schenden van mensenrechten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Taverne en Ten Broeke over het bericht “Government austerity policy a breach of international human rights, says UN report”

Two VVD MPs asked the ministers about a UN committee report finding UK austerity policy breaches economic and social rights, and whether such committee judgments are appropriate for the Netherlands. Minister Koenders answered that the committee's recommendations are non-binding, that the Dutch parliament is better placed to judge Dutch laws, and that the Optional Protocol ratification is still under consideration.
The Committee was established by ECOSOC with the aim of supervising compliance with the ICESCR by states parties.
Het Comité is door ECOSOC in het leven geroepen met als doel toezicht te houden op de naleving van het ESC-Verdrag door de staten die partij zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ten Broeke over het interview met de Turkse zaakgelastigde in Nederland

An MP asked the Foreign Minister about a Turkish chargé d'affaires' interview alleging intelligence surveillance of Gülen-linked Turkish Dutch residents, intimidation, and staged violence in the Netherlands. The minister confirmed six staff were deregistered at Turkey's request, said the Netherlands does not bear responsibility for an embassy's personnel matters, and stated the government has repeatedly urged Turkey not to import tensions into the Netherlands, without committing to a new request for explanation.
The cabinet bears no responsibility for internal personnel matters of a foreign embassy.
Het kabinet draagt geen verantwoordelijkheid voor interne personeelsaangelegenheden van een buitenlandse ambassade.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ten Broeke en Bosman over oproep van een Arubaanse minister om een visumplicht voor Venezolanen in te voeren

Two VVD MPs asked the ministers of Foreign Affairs and Interior about an Aruban minister's call for a visa requirement for Venezuelans, and whether the issue had been discussed among the Kingdom countries. The government answered that there is currently no reason or request from Aruba for a temporary Caribbean visa requirement, that the issue has been raised in consultations and videoconferences, and that screening measures are preferred.
There is currently no request to that effect from the Aruban government or other Kingdom countries.
Er ligt op dit moment geen verzoek daartoe van de Arubaanse regering of andere Koninkrijkslanden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Taverne en Ten Broeke over uitspraken van de Nederlandse ambassadeur in Kenia

MPs Taverne and Ten Broeke asked the minister whether she would hold a firm talk with the Dutch ambassador to Kenya over remarks in a ViceVersa interview and whether ambassadors should fear such talks when their observations diverge from ministerial policy. The minister confirmed the interview, said ambassadors are the ministry's eyes and ears and may publicly promote policy, and admitted that remarks deviating from Dutch policy prompted a conversation with the ambassador.
In the interview you cite, various remarks were made that deviate from the Dutch position. This was the reason for a conversation with the ambassador concerned.
In het door u aangehaalde interview zijn diverse opmerkingen gemaakt die afwijken van de Nederlandse inzet. Dit is aanleiding geweest voor een gesprek met de betreffende ambassadeur.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Bommel, Ten Broeke, Thieme en Van der Staaij over de arrestatie van een mensenrechtenactivist in Bahrein

Four MPs asked the Foreign Minister about the arrest of human rights activist Nabeel Rajab in Bahrain, its charge, and whether the government would raise it with Bahrain. The minister confirmed the arrest on the charge of spreading false news, said the government finds the repression very concerning, and said the EU will make a demarche in Manama seeking clarification.
The European Union will shortly make a demarche in Manama to the Bahraini authorities to raise the recent pressure on human rights defenders and the opposition.
De Europese Unie zal op korte termijn in Manama een demarche uitvoeren bij de Bahreinse autoriteiten om de recente druk op mensenrechtenverdedigers en de oppositie aan te kaarten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bosman en Ten Broeke over het bericht “Arubaanse delegatie in Caracas voor Citgo-deal”

Two VVD MPs asked the Foreign Minister whether the Dutch ambassador played a formal role in an Aruban trade delegation's visit to Venezuela tied to a lease of the San Nicolas refinery. The minister answered that the ambassador only received and accompanied the Aruban delegation as is customary, and that the Dutch government has no formal role because the matter is Aruba's autonomous responsibility.
This concerns an autonomous competence and responsibility of Aruba.
Dit betreft een autonome bevoegdheid en verantwoordelijkheid van Aruba.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ten Broeke, Servaes, Knops, Van Bommel, Voordewind, Van der Staaij, Sjoerdsma en Grashoff over de arrestatie van een Nederlandse vrouw in Qatar

MPs from eight parties asked the Foreign Minister about the arrest of a Dutch woman in Qatar after she reported rape, and what the government had done to free her. The minister confirmed the arrest and sentencing, described consular assistance provided by the Doha embassy, and said the woman was to be deported within days.
For privacy reasons and to prevent misunderstandings, the ministry does not provide information to other persons, including (close) family members, without the consent of the person concerned.
Om privacyredenen en om misverstanden tegen te gaan, verstrekt het ministerie zonder toestemming van betrokkene geen informatie aan andere personen, inclusief (naaste) familieleden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Voordewind, Ten Broeke en Van der Staaij over de indirecte Nederlandse steun aan de Boycot, Desinvesteringen en Sancties (BDS)-beweging

Three MPs asked whether Dutch-funded NGOs fund other NGOs promoting the BDS campaign against Israel, whether this fits subsidy criteria, and to list supported NGOs. The minister answered that the government does not finance BDS activities against Israel, that support for BDS is not a disqualifying criterion because of freedom of expression, and that it does not keep an overview of such organisations.
The cabinet ensures that it does not finance BDS activities against Israel.
Het kabinet stelt zeker dat het geen BDS-activiteiten tegen Israël financiert.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ten Broeke over arrestatie van een Nederlands-Iraanse journalist in Iran

An MP asked the Foreign Minister whether the arrest of a Dutch-Iranian journalist in Iran was true, whether contact had been made with Iranian authorities, and for an update on the journalist's condition. The minister replied that the Dutch ambassador had requested confirmation of the arrest, that Iran recognises only Iranian nationality for dual nationals and so provides no consular access, and that the Netherlands will pursue consular assistance through quiet diplomacy.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ten Broeke over het testen van een ballistische middellange afstandsraket door Iran

An MP asked the Foreign Minister to confirm reports of an Iranian mid-range ballistic missile test, whether it violates UN resolutions 1929 and 2231, what consequences earlier launches had, and whether trade easing is compatible with a critical stance. The minister said the cabinet cannot confirm the report, outlined UN and EU responses to earlier launches while stating Netherlands did not sign the letters from the four permanent-member states, and said trade-related payment easing does not preclude a critical stance.
The cabinet does not have information that can confirm this report.
Het kabinet beschikt niet over informatie die dit bericht kan bevestigen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Staaij, Ten Broeke, De Roon, Voordewind en Knops over geweld tegen christenen door extremistische hindoes in India

MPs from several parties asked the Foreign Minister about attacks on Christians by extremist Hindus in India, including whether police intervened and what the government would do internationally. The minister acknowledged rising religiously motivated violence, said six suspects were arrested, and described diplomatic efforts on religious freedom without committing to new concrete steps.
The cabinet uses various opportunities to raise human rights, including freedom of religion and belief, with India.
Het kabinet maakt van verschillende mogelijkheden gebruik om mensenrechten – en daarbinnen vrijheid van godsdienst en levensovertuiging – in India aan de orde te stellen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bosman en Ten Broeke over niet meer internationaal bellen vanuit Venezuela

MPs Bosman and Ten Broeke asked whether Venezuela's mobile operators stopping international calling, the end of international post, and its effects on opposition and migration reflect a repressive escalation affecting the Kingdom. The government answered that the cut stems from foreign-currency shortages linked to the economic crisis, that opposition risks are not shown to rise, and that it monitors migration closely without expecting large-scale flows.
The government closely monitors developments in Venezuela.
De regering monitort de ontwikkelingen in Venezuela nauw.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma, Ten Broeke, Servaes, Van Bommel, Knops, Voordewind en Van der Staaij over een eventueel gratieverzoek voor een in Egypte veroordeelde Nederlandse journaliste

Seven MPs asked the Foreign Minister why the Netherlands has not pursued or joined pardon requests for Dutch journalist Rena Netjes, convicted in absentia in Egypt, despite other countries supporting such requests. The minister answered that a pardon request can only be filed by Netjes herself, that the Netherlands will support it if she files, and that Netjes has so far declined to file.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ten Broeke over vermeende standrechtelijke executies door Iraakse militairen

An MP asked the Foreign Minister whether reported video evidence of summary executions of IS fighters by Iraqi soldiers was known, how the government judged it, and whether it would press Iraq on humanitarian law. The minister replied that the allegations could not be verified, that there was no sign of a pattern of violations, and that the government repeatedly stresses compliance with humanitarian law to Iraqi authorities and in coalition training.
It has not been possible to obtain information showing whether these images and allegations are correct or not.
Het is niet mogelijk gebleken informatie te verkrijgen waaruit kan worden opgemaakt of deze beelden en beschuldigingen juist zijn of niet.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Voordewind, Van der Staaij, Servaes, Sjoerdsma, Ten Broeke, Knops en Van Bommel over de situatie in West-Papoea

MPs asked the Foreign Minister about reports of 'slow genocide' against Papuans, the failure of quiet diplomacy, the Netherlands' historical responsibility, and whether he would raise the issue with Indonesia. The minister answered that the report was not yet public, outlined ongoing concerns and recent gestures by Jakarta, described bilateral and EU/UN channels, and committed to studying the report and raising the issue during his Indonesia visit.

As explained in the letter to Parliament of 22 November 2005, Professor Drooglever's academic research is a further contribution to describing Papua's own history and the course of events surrounding the 'Act of Free Choice'.

Zoals in Kamerbrief van 22 november 2005, stuk 30 300V is toegelicht vormt het academische onderzoek van professor Drooglever een nadere bijdrage aan de beschrijving van de eigen geschiedenis van Papoea en het verloop van de gebeurtenissen rond de «Act of Free Choice» .
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ten Broeke over de aanstelling van Michael Lynk als VN-rapporteur

An MP from the VVD asked the Foreign Minister whether the appointment of Michael Lynk as UN Special Rapporteur on the Palestinian territories is impartial, given alleged bias against Israel, and whether the Netherlands tried to block it. The minister replied that the appointment followed a transparent UN procedure, that rapporteurs are bound by a code of conduct, that the government will assess his reports on expertise, independence and impartiality, and that Canada did not object to the appointment.
The government will assess Michael Lynk on his work and examine whether his reports are expert, independent and impartial.
De regering zal Michael Lynk beoordelen op zijn werk en bezien of de rapporten van deze rapporteur deskundig, onafhankelijk en onpartijdig zijn opgesteld.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ten Broeke over de benoeming van een omstreden hoogleraar tot rapporteur van de VN-Mensenrechtenraad

MP Ten Broeke asked the Foreign Minister whether the UN Human Rights Council's shortlisted special rapporteur on the Palestinian territories, Penny Green, is partial given her alleged BDS sympathies, and what the government had done to counter bias against Israel in the Council. The minister answered that no appointment had yet been made, that rapporteurs must be independent and impartial and will be judged on that, and that the Netherlands criticises one-sided UN resolutions while coordinating with the EU.
Special Rapporteurs are expected to report independently, competently and impartially.
Special Rapporteurs worden geacht onafhankelijk, competent en onpartijdig te rapporteren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Staaij, De Roon, Ten Broeke en Voordewind over financiering van veroordeelde terroristen door de Palestijnse Autoriteiten

Four MPs asked the Foreign Minister whether reports that the Palestinian Authority funds convicted terrorists with foreign aid should change Dutch donor policy and how the government implements earlier motions calling for pressure on the PLO to stop such payments. The minister replied that the Israeli deputy minister's claims are her own, that the World Bank made no such finding, and that the government keeps raising the PLO's payment policy bilaterally and in the EU, where only one member state shares the concern.
The cabinet continues to raise the PLO's policy in bilateral talks with the PA and the PLO.
Het kabinet blijft het beleid van de PLO aankaarten in bilaterale gesprekken met de PA en de PLO.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ten Broeke, Servaes, Van Bommel, Omtzigt, De Roon, Sjoerdsma en Bontes over het rondetafelgesprek van 22 januari 2016 over de beleidsreactie onderzoeksrapporten over MH17

MPs asked the government to reflect on the January 2016 round-table discussion on prosecution of the MH17 downing, including suggestions on a possible Dutch-Russian tribunal, the interpretation of article 552y of the Dutch Code of Criminal Procedure, and victims' relatives' rights in proceedings. The government answered that it keeps both national and international prosecution options open pending the criminal investigation, acknowledges that article 552y should be amended (a bill is with the Council of State), and will consider the concerns raised about relatives' participation.
Should there be a need to speed up the legislative process with a view to possible prosecution of offences related to the downing of MH17, the available options will be used.

Mocht er met het oog op de eventuele berechting van misdrijven gerelateerd aan het neerhalen van MH17 behoefte zijn om het wetgevingsproces te versnellen zullen de beschikbare mogelijkheden daartoe aangegrepen worden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ten Broeke over het lot van gewonde Koerden in de Turkse stad Cizre

MP Ten Broeke (VVD) asked the Foreign Minister about the fate of Kurdish civilians trapped in a cellar in Cizre, how many remain alive, what has been done to rescue them, and whether the EU and the Netherlands pressed Turkey for aid. The minister answered that the government urges all parties to lay down arms and resume the peace process, and that Turkey may act against terrorism within proportionality and human rights, but gave no specifics on rescue or numbers.
According to Turkish authorities, those involved are PKK fighters. According to HDP, they are injured civilians, including children.
Volgens Turkse autoriteiten betreft het PKK-strijders. Volgens HDP betreft het gewonde burgers, waaronder kinderen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ten Broeke over de ‘verdwenen’ radarbeelden van MH17

MP Ten Broeke asked whether the government took action through ICAO to obtain the allegedly missing MH17 radar images, whether ICAO received legal assistance requests, how ICAO's dispute procedure works, and whether the Safety Board and JIT need the images. Minister Van der Steur answered that the government pressed for cooperation bilaterally, that the prosecutor and Safety Board currently have sufficient information, that no ICAO request was made, and that JIT legal assistance requests were sent to states holding the images without disclosing details.
Evidence gathering and the legal assistance requests aimed at it are by their nature confidential.
Bewijsgaring en daarop gerichte rechtshulpverzoeken zijn naar hun aard vertrouwelijk.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ten Broeke over het executeren van 47 mensen door Saoedi-Arabië

An MP asked the Foreign Minister about Saudi Arabia's execution of 47 people, including Shia cleric Nimr al-Nimr, and related UN, regional escalation and counterterrorism-law questions. The government condemned the executions, said it pressed for an EU statement and would keep raising the death penalty in the UN Human Rights Council, but gave limited detail on the evidence and on specific protests.
The evidence in the al-Nimr case has not been made public.
De bewijzen in de zaak van al-Nimr zijn niet publiek gemaakt.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma, Ten Broeke, Servaes, Van Bommel, Knops, De Roon, Voordewind, Grashoff, Van der Staaij, Thieme, Bontes, Kuzu, Van Vliet, Krol, Klein en Houwers over de levensbedreigende situatie

MPs asked the ministers about the humanitarian siege of Madaya in Syria, where about 40,000 people face starvation, and whether the Netherlands would press for a ceasefire, humanitarian access and airdrops. The ministers confirmed the severity of the situation, described Dutch funding and diplomatic efforts through the UN and ICRC, and explained why airdrops are not considered feasible.
The Netherlands has for some time been pressing within the UN for a ceasefire so that humanitarian aid can be provided to the population.
Nederland dringt in VN-verband al geruime tijd aan op een staakt-het-vuren zodat humanitaire hulp geboden kan worden aan de bevolking.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ten Broeke over de lancering van een medium range ballistische raket door Iran

An MP asked whether Iran's 21 November 2015 ballistic missile launch breached UN Security Council resolution 1929 and what the government would do about it. The minister said the missile likely falls under MTCR Category 1, that the matter should be examined through UN mechanisms such as the Expert Panel, and that the UN Security Council is handling the earlier October launch, which the Expert Panel found to be a breach, with no consensus expected on new sanctions.
At this stage it is not obvious to raise this issue with Iran outside the multilateral framework.
Het ligt in dit stadium niet voor de hand om buiten het multilaterale kader dit vraagstuk bij Iran aan de orde te stellen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Staaij, Ten Broeke, Voordewind en De Roon over resoluties bij de Algemene Vergadering van de Verenigde Naties

MPs asked the Foreign Minister why 19 or 20 of the UN General Assembly resolutions in the 70th session target Israel, how the Netherlands voted, whether the Golan resolution language is fair, and how the UN could better address states that violate international law. The minister replied that the Netherlands pushed for balance and proportionate wording, supported 15 of 19 resolutions in EU coordination, saw many actors responsible for the Golan conflict, and pointed to resolutions on other states and the UN Human Rights Council review.
The Netherlands works in several ways to ensure that countries violating international law are called to account by the UN General Assembly.
Nederland zet zich er op verschillende manieren voor in dat landen die het internationaal recht schenden daarop worden aangesproken door de AVVN.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ten Broeke en Bosman over Visumplicht Venezuela

Two MPs asked whether a visa requirement for Venezuelans, floated by Aruba's tourism minister, should be considered, and about risks to Bonaire. The minister confirmed the remarks, said visa requirements affect bilateral relations and reduce bona fide tourism, noted Aruba and Curaçao's stricter entry controls, and said a visa requirement is not currently warranted but would be decided jointly for all Caribbean parts of the Kingdom.
Aruba and/or Curaçao cannot unilaterally decide to introduce the visa requirement.
Aruba en/of Curaçao kunnen niet eenzijdig beslissen tot het instellen van de visumplicht.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ten Broeke, Van der Staaij en Voordewind over het besluit van de Duitse Bondsdag om nieuwe richtsnoeren over etikettering van producten uit de Westelijke Jordaanoever, Oost-Jeruzalem en de

MPs Ten Broeke, Van der Staaij and Voordewind asked the Foreign Minister about the German Bundestag's reported rejection of EU labelling guidance for products from the West Bank, East Jerusalem and the Golan Heights, and whether Griechenland and Hungary also refuse to implement it. The minister says the cabinet has no knowledge of a German decision, that the Netherlands stands by its signature on the earlier letter, and that member states are expected to implement the interpretive communication, with the implementation question left to the businesses and to the member states' own deliberation.
The cabinet sees no reason to revise its position, which is based on established policy.
Het kabinet ziet geen reden om zijn standpunt, dat gebaseerd is op staand beleid, te herzien.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ten Broeke over de situatie in Moldavië

An MP from the VVD asked the Foreign Minister about the disappearance of about 1 billion euro in Moldova, the status of an investigation, the frozen EU budget support and the rule of law there. The minister replied that the Central Bank of Moldova's investigation is unpublished, EU budget support remains frozen pending a new IMF programme, and that Moldova bears primary responsibility for the investigation and reforms.
The European Commission has not launched its own investigation into the missing funds. The Moldovan authorities bear the primary responsibility for this.
De Europese Commissie heeft geen eigen onderzoek ingesteld naar de verdwenen fondsen. De Moldavische autoriteiten dragen hiervoor de primaire verantwoordelijkheid.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Potters en Ten Broeke over de oproep van World Wide Relief-woordvoer Ouaali om Israëlische toeristen aan te vallen

Two VVD MPs asked the government about public calls by World Wide Relief spokesperson Ouaali to attack Israeli tourists, including whether the group is state-funded and what is being done against rising antisemitism. The government answered that the statements are condemned and under criminal investigation, that the group receives no Dutch state funding, that antisemitism incidents rose in 2014, and outlined existing police and anti-discrimination measures.
World Wide Relief receives no financial support from the Dutch government.
World Wide Relief ontvangt geen financiële ondersteuning van de Nederlandse overheid.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ten Broeke over het claimen van de westmuur als onderdeel van de Al-Aqsa moskee door de Palestijnen

MP Ten Broeke asked the Foreign Minister about a draft UNESCO resolution by Arab states that would have called the Western Wall part of al-Aqsa mosque, and whether the Netherlands would oppose related requests and the status quo of the Temple Mount. The minister answered that the Western Wall clause was dropped after Dutch and other pressure, that the final resolution was one-sided and the Netherlands voted against it, and described Dutch de-escalation efforts.
Because of the one-sided nature of the resolution put to a vote, the cabinet concluded that it does not contribute to maintaining the status quo on the Haram al-Sharif / Temple Mount.

Vanwege het eenzijdige karakter van de resolutie die ter stemming werd voorgelegd, heeft het kabinet geconcludeerd dat deze niet bijdraagt aan de handhaving van de status quo op de Haram al-Sharif / Tempelberg.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ten Broeke over een aanslag op Kamp Hurriya in Irak

MP Ten Broeke asked the Foreign Minister about the rocket attack on Camp Hurriya/Liberty in Iraq, including who claimed it, whether refugee status and UNHCR protection apply to residents, the Iraqi government's treatment of the camp, and alleged Iranian involvement. The minister answered that a pro-Iranian militia claimed the attack, the Iraqi government was called on to investigate and protect residents, UNHCR provides support, living conditions meet UN standards, and there is no evidence of Iranian involvement.
There are no indications pointing to Iranian involvement in the attack, or violence against the residents of Camp Hurriya/Camp Liberty.
Er zijn geen aanwijzingen die duiden op Iraanse betrokkenheid bij de aanslag, of geweld tegen de inwoners van Kamp Hurriya/Camp Liberty.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Voordewind, Van der Staaij, Ten Broeke en Klaveren over het bericht dat de Palestijnse Autoriteit veroordeelde Hamas terroristen heeft betaald

MPs asked whether the Palestinian Authority pays convicted Hamas terrorists, the total amounts paid, and what the government will do to press the EU to stop the policy. The minister declined to confirm the reported amounts, referred to earlier answers, said Pegase payments do not fund prisoners, and said the Netherlands will keep raising the issue bilaterally with the PA and PLO.
The cabinet cannot confirm the amounts mentioned in the news report.
Het kabinet kan de in het nieuwsbericht genoemde bedragen niet bevestigen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ten Broeke over de lancering van een ballistische raket door Iran

The MP asked whether Iran's October 2015 ballistic missile launch violated UN Security Council resolution 1929, what consequences should follow, whether the JCPOA is breached, and how the EU snapback on sanctions is secured. The minister answered that the launch very likely violated resolution 1929, that the UN panel and sanctions committee should address it, that ballistic missile restrictions are not part of the JCPOA, and that EU sanctions will be reinstated by Council commitment if Iran significantly breaches the deal.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Staaij, Servaes, Ten Broeke, Van Klaveren, Knops en Voordewind over “De oplaaiende terreur in Nigeria”

MPs asked the Foreign Minister about escalating attacks on civilians, many of them Christians, in Central Nigeria, the government's protection efforts, Boko Haram's trajectory, regional cooperation, humanitarian funding and gender-specific attention. The minister answered that the Middle Belt violence is largely driven by economic and land/water conflicts between herders and farmers, that Nigerian authorities have been ineffective at protecting civilians, and that Nigeria bears primary responsibility for countering Boko Haram, with Dutch support channelled through EU and humanitarian programmes.
The violence against the population makes clear that the Nigerian authorities have not been effective in protecting civilians.
De gewelddadigheden tegen de bevolking maken duidelijk dat de Nigeriaanse autoriteiten niet effectief zijn geweest in de bescherming van burgers.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ten Broeke en Bosman over Venezolanen die Curaçao weigeren te verlaten

Two VVD MPs asked the ministers whether Venezuelan holidaymakers refusing to leave Curaçao were a problem, whether Curaçao's controls at sea and on arrival were adequate, and whether the Kingdom government had pressed for monitoring under a motion, plus what it knew of a Curaçao taskforce. The minister confirmed a modest rise in overstays, said Curaçao has autonomous control over entry and that sea controls were tightened, and stated that close contact with Aruba and Curaçao is maintained without giving precise figures.
Admission is a competence of Curaçao. It is up to Curaçao to organise the process of entry and exit.
Toelating is een bevoegdheid van Curaçao. Het is aan Curaçao om het proces rondom in- en uitreis in te richten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ten Broeke over verbanning van twee journalisten uit Oekraïne

An MP asked the Foreign Minister about reports that Ukraine expelled two BBC journalists, and about press freedom in Ukraine and the Association Agreement. The minister said the journalists were placed on a sanctions list, not expelled, that the list was withdrawn after protest and excuses were given, and that press freedom has improved in government-controlled Ukraine while the Association Agreement contains no specific press freedom provisions.
It is correct that a number of foreign journalists, including two BBC journalists working in Moscow, were initially placed on the Ukrainian sanctions list.
Het klopt dat een aantal buitenlandse journalisten, waaronder ook twee in Moskou werkende BBC-journalisten, aanvankelijk op de Oekraïense sanctielijst zijn geplaatst.
