Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ten Broeke over het bericht dat Syrië nog steeds over chemische wapens beschikt

An MP asked whether reports that Syria still holds the most lethal nerve gases and had hidden chemical weapons from OPCW inspectors are true, and whether the destruction effort was futile. The minister said the government has no information confirming nerve gas remains, that Syria will submit a supplementary declaration around October 2015, and that the mission (1,300 tons destroyed) is a success.
The cabinet has no information confirming the reports that the Syrian army still has nerve gases.
Het kabinet beschikt niet over informatie die de berichten dat het Syrische leger nog over zenuwgassen zou beschikken bevestigt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ten Broeke en Bosman over drugssmokkel van Venezuela naar het Caribisch deel van het Koninkrijk

Two VVD MPs asked the ministers about a July 2015 interception of 125 kilos of cocaine on a Venezuelan boat, the scale of drug smuggling from Venezuela to the Caribbean part of the Kingdom, and whether Aruba and Curaçao have enough capacity to fight it. The government confirmed the interception (later put at 150 kilos, handed to the Venezuelan navy), said reliable data on the scale of smuggling do not exist, and stated that the Caribbean authorities have adequate tools and cooperate with international partners.
There are no reliable data on the scale and origin of drug smuggling in or via the Caribbean region.
Er zijn geen betrouwbare gegevens over de omvang en herkomst van drugssmokkel in of via het Caribisch gebied.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ten Broeke over de relatie tussen Turkije en ISIS

The MP asks the government about reports of evidence linking Turkish officials to ISIS, how this affects the coalition strategy, and whether recent Turkish strikes signal a change. The ministers acknowledge the report, state that the Netherlands cannot confirm Turkish support for ISIS, and describe Turkey's anti-ISIS measures since the Suruç attack.
The Netherlands cannot confirm that Turkey provides support to jihadist organisations such as ISIS.
Nederland kan niet bevestigen dat Turkije steun levert aan jihadistische organisaties zoals ISIS.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ten Broeke over het onderzoek naar de grootschalige bankenfraude in Moldavië

An MP asked the Foreign Minister about the status of the Kroll report and recovery of funds in the Moldovan bank fraud, whether EU budget support was halted and linked to the fraud, and about Dutch diplomatic representation in Chisinau. The minister said further investigation and recovery are Moldovan responsibilities, confirmed the EU suspended budget support pending an IMF deal, and said no decision on opening a Dutch embassy in Chisinau has been taken.
This is the responsibility of the Moldovan authorities, and they must do everything possible to achieve thorough investigation, prosecution and recovery.
Dit is de verantwoordelijkheid van de Moldavische autoriteiten en zij dienen alles in het werk te stellen om grondig onderzoek, vervolging en terugvordering te realiseren.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Servaes, Maij, Ten Broeke, Van Bommel, Sjoerdsma, Hachchi, Voordewind en Van der Staaij over de gezette stappen een jaar na de moord op de Libische mensenrechtenactiviste Salwa Bugaighis

MPs asked whether the government will keep pressing Libyan authorities for a thorough investigation into the murders of activists Salwa Bugaighis and Fariha Al-Barqawi, and what has been done on protecting female human rights defenders. The minister answers that investigations never got off the ground because Libya lacked effective central authority, that the embassy supported women's organisations and raised protection in EU, UN and bilateral settings, and that the government will raise these cases at the UN Security Council in October 2015.
The cabinet maintains that the murderers of Libyan human rights activist Salwa Bugaighis must not go unpunished and has pressed for a thorough investigation within the EU framework.
Het kabinet blijft van mening dat de moordenaars van de Libische mensenrechtenactiviste Salwa Bugaighis niet ongestraft mogen blijven en heeft in EU-kader aangedrongen op een gedegen onderzoek.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ten Broeke over het bericht dat ISIS in staat zou zijn om massavernietigingswapens te maken

MP Ten Broeke asked the Foreign Minister whether Australian intelligence concluded ISIS had enough radioactive material for a dirty bomb and what the coalition is doing to prevent ISIS obtaining chemical, biological or WMD capabilities. The minister confirmed awareness of the reports, declined to comment on intelligence assessments and said the coalition is alert to indicators of such weapons.
Publicly no statements can be made about intelligence investigations, including those of possible partner services.
In het openbaar kunnen geen uitspraken worden gedaan over inlichtingenonderzoeken, ook niet van eventuele partnerdiensten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Staaij, Ten Broeke en Voordewind over het bericht dat alleen Israël door de World Health Organization is veroordeeld voor het schenden van gezondheidsrechten

Three MPs (Van der Staaij, Ten Broeke, Voordewind) asked why the WHO assembly adopted a resolution singling out Israel's health conditions in occupied territories and whether the Netherlands backed it. The minister answered that the decision was a compromise, all EU states voted for it, the US, Canada and Australia opposed it, and that the Netherlands favours non-politicised WHO texts and supports phasing out country-specific resolutions.
Where possible, the Netherlands therefore works within the EU framework for balanced, non-politicised texts and advocates within the EU for phasing out these resolutions and decisions.
Nederland zet zich waar mogelijk in EU-kader dan ook in voor gebalanceerde, niet-politiserende teksten en pleit in EU-kader voor uitfasering van deze resoluties en besluiten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ten Broeke over het bericht “Russen: wel een Boek, niet van ons”

An MP asks whether a leaked report on MH17, reported by Novaya Gazeta, was prepared by official Russian bodies and whether it was handed to the Dutch Safety Board or the JIT. The ministers answer that the government leaves the investigation to the Safety Board and the Public Prosecution Service, which report no official handover from Russia, while the Safety Board declines to share what information it has obtained.
During the investigation, the Dutch Safety Board does not give insight into the information that has or has not been obtained for the investigation.
Gedurende het onderzoek geeft de Onderzoeksraad voor Veiligheid geen inzicht in de informatie die al dan niet is verkregen ten behoeve van het onderzoek.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ten Broeke over het VN-rapport over incidenten rondom VN-gebouwen in de Gaza-strook

An MP asked the Foreign Minister about the UN Board of Inquiry report on incidents at UN buildings in Gaza in 2014, including weapons found in UN schools and whether Israeli strikes breached international law. The minister welcomed the summary, said the government lacks the factual information to judge the incidents or Israel's legal compliance, noted UNRWA security recommendations, and said it is unknown whether the findings feed into the UN Human Rights Council inquiry.
The government does not have the necessary factual information to confirm the incidents.
Het kabinet beschikt niet over de benodigde feitelijke informatie om de incidenten te kunnen bevestigen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ten Broeke, Voordewind, Sjoerdsma en Van der Staaij over de uitgifte van Turkse paspoorten aan jihadgangers. Deze vragen werden ingezonden op 15 april 2015

MPs asked whether reports that over 100,000 Turkish passports were given to ISIS fighters, and that around 50,000 Uyghurs joined ISIS through a loophole in Turkish law, are true, and what Turkey does with detained jihadists and to prevent departures. The minister said the government has no independent information to verify the claims, that Dutch jihadists are removed from Turkey after procedures with Dutch authorities informed, and that Turkey cooperates with origin countries and in the anti-ISIS coalition working group.
The cabinet does not have independent information to verify the claims in this article.
Het kabinet beschikt niet over eigenstandige informatie om de beweringen in dit artikel te verifiëren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ten Broeke over het bericht dat een Russisch museum delen van de MH17 tentoon gaat stellen

An MP asked the ministers whether a Russian local war museum would exhibit MH17 wreckage, whether the pieces were deliberately left behind and donated, and whether the government would raise concerns with Russia. The government answered that it has no indication the exhibition will take place, that it protested to Russian and Ukrainian authorities, that Russia denies the reports, and that it has publicly and bilaterally voiced concerns.
Naturally, developments will be closely monitored and further action will be taken if necessary.
Vanzelfsprekend zullen de ontwikkelingen nauwlettend gevolgd worden en zal nadere actie ondernomen worden indien nodig.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ten Broeke over het voorlopige akkoord omtrent het Iraanse nucleaire programma

The VVD MP Ten Broeke asked the Foreign Minister about the preliminary Iran nuclear framework, including inspections, sanctions relief, snap-back, break-out time, missiles, proliferation and regional arms. The minister welcomed the framework, said it must be verified rather than trusted, and answered most questions by pointing to the detailed agreement still to be negotiated by 30 June.
Only after that will it be possible to inform the House which sanctions will be lifted under which conditions.
Pas daarna zal het mogelijk zijn om de Kamer te informeren welke sancties onder welke voorwaarden worden opgeheven.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ten Broeke over het bericht dat Dino Bouterse is veroordeeld voor het verlenen van steun aan Hezbollah

An MP asked the Foreign Minister about the conviction of Dino Bouterse for supporting Hezbollah and whether Hezbollah plans activities in Latin America. The minister said the government has no independent information confirming Hezbollah activity in Suriname or Latin America, notes the court found no proof of arms supply or shelter, and reiterates that Hezbollah is considered a terrorist organisation.
Furthermore, the cabinet does not have independent information regarding Hezbollah's intentions to carry out activities in Latin America.
Hiernaast beschikt het kabinet niet over eigenstandige informatie inzake de voornemens van Hezbollah om activiteiten te ontplooien in Latijns-Amerika.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid ten Broeke over politieke ontwikkelingen in Zuid-Afrika

An MP asked the Foreign Minister about the state of democracy and the rule of law in South Africa, racism and discriminatory legislation, affirmative action and emigration, the EU-South Africa human rights dialogue, and South Africa's regional role. The minister answered that the country has strong institutions and progressive law but a gap between law and reality, that the incidents of racism are not systematic and there is no discriminatory legislation, and that the dialogue has taken place twice; these answers concern a foreign state rather than Dutch executive power.
The country has strong institutions, a vibrant democratic rule of law, a well-functioning bureaucracy and sufficient popular support for democratisation.
Het land kent sterkte instituties, een levendige democratische rechtsstaat, een goed werkende bureaucratie en er is voldoende steun onder de bevolking voor democratisering.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ten Broeke en Dijkhoff over het faciliteren van assemblees van de Inter-Parlementaire Unie in de Europese Unie

Two VVD MPs asked whether the EU's travel restrictions on sanctioned third-country parliamentarians could be lifted for Inter-Parliamentary Union assemblies held in the EU, since no such assembly has taken place there since 1999. The Minister of Foreign Affairs answered that the restrictions stem from EU sanctions targeting individuals, that the IPU falls under none of the standard exemption grounds, and that seeking an exemption is neither desirable nor feasible, though visas for bona fide travellers can be facilitated.
In light of the above arguments, the cabinet considers it neither desirable nor feasible to advocate such an exemption.
Het kabinet acht het, in het licht van bovenstaande argumenten, wenselijk noch haalbaar om een dergelijke ontheffing te bepleiten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ten Broeke over de onderhandelingen inzake het Iraanse nucleaire programma

The MP asks the Foreign Minister about IAEA reports that Iran is not fully answering questions on its nuclear programme and cannot verify it is peaceful, and about the state of the negotiations. The minister acknowledges the IAEA's concerns and the incomplete answers, says the Netherlands demands full cooperation, and states the government's aim of reaching a good comprehensive agreement by the deadline while keeping pressure on Iran.
As stated in the reports, the International Atomic Energy Agency (IAEA) cannot establish that the Iranian nuclear programme is peaceful in nature.
Zoals gesteld wordt in de rapportages kan het Internationaal Atoomenergie Agentschap (IAEA) niet vaststellen dat het Iraanse nucleaire programma vreedzaam van aard is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ten Broeke over het bericht dat Cyprus Rusland aanbiedt bases te openen

An MP asked the Foreign Minister about reports that Cyprus offered Russia air and naval bases, whether an agreement was imminent, and whether this conflicts with EU sanctions. The minister confirmed awareness of the report, denied knowledge of a signing announcement, noted Cyprus's denial of bases and mention of maintenance and spare-parts contracts, and said the EU arms embargo and sanctions remain in place with no reason to think Cyprus would breach them.

The cabinet has no reason to assume that Cyprus intends to act in breach of the sanctions regime or to distance itself from the Union's previously adopted common positions on Russia's actions in Ukraine.

Het kabinet heeft geen reden om aan te nemen dat Cyprus voornemens zou zijn in strijd met het sanctieregime te handelen of zich te distantiëren van de eerder aangenomen gemeenschappelijke standpunten van de Unie over het Russische optreden in Oekraïne.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ten Broeke over het bericht dat Syrië bezig is met de ontwikkeling van kernwapens

An MP from the VVD asked the Foreign Minister about reports that Syria may be developing nuclear weapons, including the likelihood of Hezbollah, North Korean and Iranian assistance, the reported underground storage site near Qusayr, and whether Dutch intelligence has enough capacity to investigate independently. The minister confirmed awareness of the reports, cited the IAEA's 2011 conclusions on the destroyed Dair Alzour reactor, said the Qusayr reports cannot be confirmed, and stated that the cabinet values independent intelligence but would not disclose the capacity of the intelligence services.
The cabinet cannot make public statements about the capacity of the intelligence services.
Over de capaciteit van de inlichtingendiensten kan het kabinet in het openbaar geen mededelingen doen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Veen en Ten Broeke over het artikel ‘Twentse bedrijven op weg naar Duitse grond’

Two VVD MPs asked the Minister of Economic Affairs about a newspaper report that Twente firms are moving to German land, the investment climate, land price differences with Germany, and whether officials actively recruit cross-border firms. The minister referred to an earlier letter on the Twente investment climate, gave indicative land price differences and six 2013 cases where Germany was chosen, denied an active official lobby for German firms, and explained the regional aid map.
See my letter of 20 January 2015 (Parliamentary Paper 32 637, no. 164) on the Twente investment climate and the closure of the Philips site in Emmen.
Zie mijn brief van 20 januari 2015 (Kamerstuk 32 637, nr. 164 ) over het vestigingsklimaat Twente en de sluiting van de Philips-vestiging in Emmen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ten Broeke over het bericht dat de Organisatie voor het Verbod op Chemische Wapens heeft bevestigd dat er chloorgas is gebruikt in Syrië

MP Ten Broeke asked the Foreign Minister about the OPCW's confirmation of chlorine gas use in Syria, the non-publication of the third FFM report, attribution to the Syrian regime, and whether the UN Security Council should address it. Minister Koenders answered that the report is not secret but not posted online, that it adds detail rather than new conclusions, that attribution was outside the FFM mandate and helicopter use is a strong but not hard indication, and that formal UNSC agenda-setting is unlikely due to Russia though eight members sent the report.
It is not secret, although it has not been posted on the OPCW website.
Het is niet geheim, hoewel het niet op de website van de OPCW is geplaatst.
Antwoord op aanvullende vragen van het lid Ten Broeke over Nederlandse steun aan het Jordaanse Media Instituut in relatie tot uitlatingen over Hamas

An MP asked whether the Dutch embassy in Amman sponsors a Jordanian media institute that presents Hamas figure Ahlam Tamimi as a role model, and whether Dutch funds should be used this way. The minister confirms awareness of the report and refers to earlier answers to parallel questions, providing no new substance.
See the answer on the previous page (questions from Van Klaveren and Bontes)
Zie antwoord op voorgaande pagina (vragen Van Klaveren en Bontes)
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ten Broeke, Voordewind en Van der Staaij over het bericht dat Hamas mogelijk van de Europese terreurlijst verdwijnt

Three MPs asked the Foreign Minister about reports that Hamas might be removed from the EU terrorist list after a General Court ruling, and whether the designation was based on media reports. The minister answered that the court annulled the listing on procedural grounds but kept its effects for three months, so Hamas remains listed for now, that the Council may appeal or re-list, and that the government will work with other member states to address the defects.
The General Court decided to annul the listing on procedural grounds.
Het Gerecht heeft besloten de plaatsing op de lijst nietig te verklaren, wegens procedurele gebreken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Staaij, Servaes, Ten Broeke over doodschieten van Papoea's door de Indonesische politie

Seven MPs asked the Minister of Foreign Affairs about reports that Indonesian police or soldiers shot dead five Papuans during a protest, and what the Netherlands would do. The Minister said the government deeply regrets the deaths, that Indonesia has launched an inquiry, that he will raise it with his counterpart, and that the Netherlands supports community policing and human rights training in Papua.
The Indonesian authorities immediately launched an investigation into the circumstances.
De Indonesische autoriteiten hebben direct een onderzoek naar de toedracht ingesteld.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ten Broeke over de stand van zaken rondom de rampplek MH17

An MP from the VVD asked the ministers of Foreign Affairs and Security and Justice whether wreckage and personal belongings remain at the MH17 crash site after the recovery mission, and about the security situation there. The government answered that some wreckage and possible remains remain at burn sites and north of Petropavlivka, that recovery will resume after winter if security allows, and that the frontline is a few kilometres north of the site.
After winter, and if the security situation allows, the repatriation mission will resume its work at the crash site.
Na de winter, en indien de veiligheidssituatie dit toelaat, zal de repatriëringsmissie haar werkzaamheden op de rampplek hervatten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Voordewind, Van der Staaij, Omtzigt, Van Bommel en Ten Broeke over de positie van Pakistaanse minderheden

Five MPs asked the government about the position of religious minorities in Pakistan, including reported lynchings of Christians, a judge's apparent embrace of a blasphemy-case killer, and whether Pakistani Christians should be treated as an asylum risk group. The minister acknowledges rising violence against minorities, notes Dutch and EU pressure on Pakistan over blasphemy laws and minority protection, and says the State Secretary will review the new country report for possible changes to asylum policy.
The State Secretary for Security and Justice will examine whether the information in the thematic country report gives cause for changes to the current asylum policy for Pakistani Christians.
De Staatssecretaris van Veiligheid en Justitie zal bezien of de informatie in het thematisch ambtsbericht aanleiding geeft tot aanpassingen in het huidige asielbeleid voor Pakistaanse christenen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ten Broeke over beschuldiging van het Turkse Ministerie van Buitenlandse Zaken dat Nederland de Turkse gemeenschap discrimineert

The MP asks whether the Foreign Minister raised with his Turkish counterpart the Turkish ministry's accusation that the Netherlands discriminates against Turks, and whether that statement will be removed from the website. The minister replies that he expressed serious concerns the same day, that the Turkish side clarified no accusation against the Dutch government or people was intended, and that a public spokesperson's remarks cannot formally be withdrawn.
I pointed out that the Netherlands conducts its own integration policy and that interference by other countries is not appropriate in this regard.
Ik heb erop gewezen dat Nederland een eigen integratiebeleid voert en hierbij geen inmenging van andere landen past.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Staaij, Omtzigt, Voordewind, De Roon, Servaes, Ten Broeke en Van Bommel over het doodvonnis van Asia Bibi

Six MPs from several parties asked the Foreign Minister how the government views the Pakistani appeal court's upholding of Asia Bibi's death sentence, what remaining appeal options exist, and what Dutch and international steps can prevent execution. The minister said the government deeply regrets the ruling, outlined the appeal path to the Pakistani Supreme Court, and listed bilateral and EU advocacy, embassy actions and planned follow-up without committing to a specific new step.

The Netherlands will continue to raise the case of Ms Asia Bibi, the blasphemy legislation and the death penalty with the Pakistani authorities at every opportunity, both bilaterally and within the EU.

Nederland zal bij iedere voorkomende gelegenheid bij de Pakistaanse autoriteiten aandacht blijven vragen voor mevrouw Asia Bibi, de blasfemiewetgeving en de doodstraf, zowel bilateraal als in EU-verband.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Voordewind, Van der Staaij, De Roon, Ten Broeke en Omtzigt over ‘Gaza met onmiddellijke ingang onder controle van Hamas en Fatah’

MPs from several parties asked the Foreign Minister about reports that Hamas and Fatah would jointly govern Gaza, and about whether Dutch or EU funds could reach Hamas through Palestinian Authority salaries and prisoner payments. The minister answered that there is no joint budget, that Qatari one-off payments are not salaries, that EU-funded civil servant lists are unchanged, and that the prisoner payment rules remain duration-based, with the Netherlands continuing to press for reform.
The money concerns Qatar, not the EU or the Netherlands.
Het betreft geld van Qatar, niet van de EU of NL.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ten Broeke en Servaes over misdaden van ISIS tegen Yezidi’s in Irak (nieuwe versie)

MPs Ten Broeke and Servaes asked the Foreign Minister about ISIS crimes against Yezidis in Iraq, including reported killings, rape, slavery and mustard gas use, and whether the government confirms UN figures. The minister said the government has no independent information to confirm these reports, referred to UN OHCHR/UNAMI figures on killings and detention, and described the Dutch military and humanitarian contributions.
The cabinet does not have independent information that can confirm such reports.
Het kabinet beschikt niet over eigenstandige informatie die dergelijke berichten kan bevestigen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ten Broeke over de normalisering van de diplomatieke betrekkingen met Suriname

An MP asked the Foreign Minister whether he had decided to restore full diplomatic relations with Suriname after speaking with his counterpart, what other reasons underlay this, and whether the Chamber would be informed of recent developments. The minister answered that Suriname agreed to the ambassador-level appointment of the current chargé d'affaires, that the Netherlands had requested agrément in December 2013, and that shared history and ties justify ambassador-level relations, and he agreed to inform the Chamber.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ten Broeke over aanwezigheid van een Hezbollah-cel in Suriname

An MP asked the Foreign Minister about reports that Dino Bouterse admitted housing Hezbollah militants in Suriname and planned to arm them for attacks on the US and the Netherlands, and about measures against Hezbollah activity. The minister replied that the cabinet has no independent information confirming the reports and pointed to EU terrorist listing of Hezbollah's military wing and related criminal prohibitions.
The cabinet does not have independent information that confirms these reports.
Het kabinet beschikt niet over eigenstandige informatie die deze berichtgeving bevestigt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ten Broeke over de rol van Turkije in de strijd tegen de Islamitische Staat

An MP asked the Foreign Minister about Turkey's role against IS, including whether Erdogan refused a rescue operation from Turkish soil, Turkey's NATO coalition membership, and alleged ties to extremist groups. The minister said the cabinet lacks independent information on the rescue, confirmed Turkey's participation, and found no evidence of Turkish support for jihadist groups.
The cabinet does not have independent information on this.
Het kabinet beschikt niet over eigenstandige informatie hierover.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bosman, Ten Broeke en Verheijen over de Sanctiewet van Curaçao

MPs from the VVD asked the ministers how the Curaçao parliament's rejection of the Kingdom sanctions law affects implementation of EU sanctions against Russia and whether a national Kingdom sanctions law (Rijkssanctiewet) is needed. The government answered that EU sanctions must apply across the Kingdom, that Aruba and Sint Maarten have adapted their rules, that work on a national law continues because Curaçao has not yet adapted its ordinance, and that Curaçao's autonomous legislative competence cannot be overridden.
The draft national sanctions law does allow each country to determine separately which parts of the law enter into force.
De concept Rijkssanctiewet voorziet overigens in de mogelijkheid om voor elk Land afzonderlijk te bepalen welke onderdelen van de wet in werking treden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ten Broeke en Van Bommel over de dreigende veroordeling van de Tunesische mensenrechtenactiviste Héla Boujneh

Two MPs asked the Foreign Minister about the arrest of Tunisian human rights activist Héla Boujneh, whether she was held without reasons or lawyer access, and whether the Netherlands would raise her case and send an observer to her trial. The minister confirmed the arrest, said the government is seeking facts, noted her release pending trial, committed to raising the case with his Tunisian counterpart, and said the embassy intends to send an observer, while answering the women's rights question with general praise for Tunisian reforms.
The cabinet is trying to establish the factual circumstances of Héla Boujneh's arrest.
Het kabinet tracht de feitelijke omstandigheden van Héla Boujnehs arrestatie te achterhalen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ten Broeke en Leegte over investeringen van Nederlandse bedrijven in de Palestijnse gebieden

Two VVD MPs asked whether Dutch government pressure discouraged Dutch firms from investing in the Palestinian territories, and whether the government would contact a company that suspended a joint venture. The minister replied that businesses decide their own activities, the government addresses firms involved in settlement activity and provides no services for it, and it will not intervene in the individual company's decision.
However, the cabinet does not interfere in the decisions of individual companies about their economic activities.
Het kabinet treedt echter niet in de beslissingen van individuele bedrijven over hun economische activiteiten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bosman en Ten Broeke over de recente ontwikkelingen omtrent de arrestatie van de Venezolaanse consul op Aruba

Two VVD MPs asked how the accreditation of Venezuelan consul-general Carvajal on Aruba went wrong, who grants consular approval, and whether the US contacted Dutch ministries before requesting his arrest. Minister Timmermans answered that the nota was not sent through proper diplomatic channels, so no exequatur was granted, that Venezuela could reasonably assume provisional admission and immunity, that only the Foreign Minister decides on such matters, and that the US did not inform the Netherlands and the reason is unknown.
It is not known why the US did not inform the Netherlands.
Het is niet bekend waarom de VS Nederland niet heeft ingelicht.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Servaes en Maij, Ten Broeke, Van Bommel, Sjoerdsma en Hachchi, Voordewind en Van der Staaij over het bericht dat de Libische mensenrechtenactiviste Salwa Bugaighis is vermoord

MPs from several parties asked whether the Minister had raised the murder of Libyan activist Salwa Bugaighis with Libyan authorities, requested a thorough investigation, and asked what the Netherlands could do to protect threatened women's rights activists in Libya. The Minister answered that the Libyan authorities bear primary responsibility, that the issue will be raised bilaterally and in EU channels, and that the Netherlands supports civil society programmes and is exploring support for a hotline.
This point will be raised both in bilateral contacts and within the EU with the authorities in Tripoli as well as with the Libyan embassy in The Hague.
Dit punt zal zowel in bilaterale contacten als in EU-verband met de autoriteiten in Tripoli alsook met de Libische ambassade in Den Haag worden opgebracht.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma, Ten Broeke, Voordewind, Servaes, Van Ojik over de Egyptische strafeis tegen een Nederlandse journaliste

MPs from several parties asked the Foreign Minister how the government responded to Egypt seeking maximum prison terms against about 20 journalists, including Dutch journalist Rena Netjes, and whether Egypt kept its promise of a fair trial. The minister answered that the Netjes sentence of ten years in absentia is not a fair process, that the Netherlands raised concerns bilaterally and in the EU, and referred to a separate letter for further measures.
The Netherlands informed the Egyptian authorities that it deeply regrets that, due to the course of events in Egypt, Ms. Netjes is denied the possibility of returning safely and doing her work there.
Nederland heeft de Egyptische autoriteiten geïnformeerd dat het zeer betreurt dat mw. Netjes door de gang van zaken in Egypte de mogelijkheid wordt ontzegd om veilig te kunnen terugkeren
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Voordewind, van der Staaij, Ten Broeke, Omtzigt, Sjoerdsma, de Roon en van Bommel over de vrijlating en arrestatie van een zwangere vrouw in Sudan

MPs asked the Foreign Minister whether Merriam Ibrahim was re-arrested after a court acquitted her of a death sentence, on what grounds, and whether the Sudanese ambassador would be summoned. The minister confirmed she was held at the airport on suspicion of using false documents, released on 26 June and is now at the US embassy, and said international pressure is being raised through quiet diplomacy.
Ms Ibrahim was held on suspicion of using false documents, but she was not formally arrested.
Mevrouw Ibrahim werd vastgehouden op verdenking van het gebruik van valse documenten, maar zij is niet officieel gearresteerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ten Broeke over de Saoedische handelsmaatregelen tegen Nederland

An MP from the VVD asked the Foreign Minister about Saudi trade sanctions against the Netherlands, including effects on Dutch firms, the handling of the dispute, human rights and whether an apology should be avoided. The minister answered that no confirmed measures had been received, that firms face varying problems, that a senior delegation and ministerial contacts are ongoing, and that dialogue on human rights continues.
The cabinet is doing everything it can to remove the concerns of Dutch business.
Het kabinet doet er alles aan om de zorgen van het Nederlandse bedrijfsleven weg te nemen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ten Broeke over een incident met VN-gezant Serry in Jeruzalem

An MP asked the foreign minister about a reported incident in which UN envoy Robert Serry was delayed and denied access at Easter 2014 in Jerusalem, and whether religious freedom was at stake and how Israeli justifications were judged. The minister confirmed awareness, said Serry's account is known but not endorsed by Israeli authorities, and stated that access improved compared with the previous year while parties still disagree on further access for Palestinian Christians.
Consultation before the Easter festival between the Christian communities and the Israeli police led to improved access compared with last year.
Overleg voorafgaand aan het Paasfeest tussen de Christelijke gemeenschappen en de Israëlische politie heeft tot een verbeterde toegang ten opzichte van vorig jaar geleid.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ten Broeke over een VN-onderzoek naar gifgasaanvallen in Syrië

An MP asked the Foreign Minister about a UN/OPCW fact-finding mission into alleged chlorine gas attacks in Syria and whether accountability and consequences would follow. The minister confirmed the mission departed on 1 May, said chlorine is not a scheduled chemical but its use as a weapon would breach humanitarian law, and committed to informing parliament of any consequences.
Your House will be informed if such or other consequences of the use of chemical weapons arise.
Uw Kamer wordt geïnformeerd indien dergelijke of andere gevolgen van de inzet van chemische wapens optreden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ten Broeke over CG Osaka

An MP asked the Foreign Minister about the NFIA figures showing 15 Japanese investment projects creating 673 jobs in 2013, and whether the Osaka consulate could stay open in reduced form given the economic importance of Japan. The minister confirmed the figures, said the size of an economy need not match the number of posts, and stated that a halved structural cut to the post network would allow Osaka to remain open in slimmed-down form focused on investment promotion.

With a halving of the structural cut to the post network and continuation of the planned savings, it is possible to keep the Osaka consulate open in slimmed-down form, focused on investment promotion.

Met een halvering van de structurele korting op het postennet en bij voortzetting van de voorgenomen besparingen is het mogelijk CG Osaka in afgeslankte vorm, toegespitst op investeringsbevordering, open te houden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ten Broeke over het bericht dat in Egypte 529 aanhangers van Morsi ter dood zijn veroordeeld

An MP asked the Foreign Minister about reports that 529 Morsi supporters were sentenced to death in Egypt, questioning the fairness of the trial, the EU response and whether the ambassador would be challenged. The minister called the trial a flagrant violation of rule-of-law principles, said appeal remains possible, pointed to EU statements and the incentive-based approach, and said Nederland would raise the matter bilaterally.
The cabinet sees in the trial a flagrant violation of the most fundamental principles of the rule of law.
Het kabinet ziet in het proces een flagrante schending van de meest fundamentele beginselen van de rechtsstaat.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ten Broeke over hervorming van Israëlische arrestatieprocedures op de Westelijke Jordaanoever

An MP asked the Foreign Minister about Israeli military reforms to arrest and prosecution of Palestinian minors in the West Bank, including a pilot to end night arrests and a low rate of abuse complaints. The minister answered that the government welcomes the IDF pilot, has raised concerns with Israeli authorities, and will raise the issue in further contacts, while noting that complaint rates are reported differently by various sources.
The cabinet welcomes the announcement of the IDF pilot intended to improve the situation regarding night-time arrests, and will raise it in contacts with EEAS and Israeli interlocutors.

Het kabinet verwelkomt de aankondiging van de pilot van het IDF die de situatie m.b.t. nachtelijke situaties dient te verbeteren en in contacten met EDEO en Israëlische gesprekspartners zal het ter sprake worden gebracht.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ten Broeke en Sjoerdsma over het EU-Visserijakkoord met Marokko

MPs Ten Broeke and Sjoerdsma asked whether the new EU-Morocco fisheries protocol covers occupied Western Sahara, whether EU rules bar spending in occupied territories, and how the deal fits EU and international law. The minister answered that the protocol does not name Western Sahara but does not exclude application there, that economic activity is lawful provided it benefits the local population, and that the Netherlands will press for concrete safeguards.
The protocol contains no direct reference to Western Sahara, but in practice it does not exclude its application there.
Het protocol bevat geen rechtstreekse verwijzing naar de Westelijke Sahara, maar sluit toepassing op de Westelijke Sahara in de praktijk niet uit.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ten Broeke en Van Ark over het bericht dat homoseksualiteit weer strafbaar wordt gesteld in India

MPs Ten Broeke and Van Ark asked the Foreign Minister about India's Supreme Court ruling reinstating criminalisation of same-sex relations, and whether legal steps, political support for reform, and EU pressure are possible. The minister answered that the court left reform to parliament, that a review petition is possible but mainly addresses procedural errors, that protests occurred, and that the EU High Representative had already expressed concern.
With this ruling the Supreme Court has placed the initiative with the legislature to remove or amend this provision.
Met deze uitspraak heeft het Hooggerechtshof het initiatief bij de wetgevende macht neergelegd om deze bepaling te verwijderen dan wel te wijzigen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ten Broeke over de nieuwe Egyptische grondwet

MP Ten Broeke asked the Foreign Minister whether he knows the new Egyptian constitution, how he assesses the rights of women and minorities and the expanded military position including military trials of civilians, and whether High Representative Ashton has responded. The minister confirms awareness, says the Netherlands follows the process closely but finds it too early to judge the content before the referendum, and says Ashton has not yet responded.

Given that the Egyptian population still has to vote in a referendum on the amendment of the constitution, the cabinet considers it too early to give a judgement on the content of the future constitution.

Gezien het feit dat de Egyptische bevolking zich nog per referendum moet uitspreken over aanpassing van de Grondwet acht het kabinet het echter te vroeg om een oordeel te geven over de inhoud van de toekomstige Grondwet.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Staaij, Ten Broeke, De Roon, Voordewind over het gegeven dat waterbedrijf Vitens zijn samenwerkingsverband met het Israëlische waterbedrijf Mekorot heeft beëindigd 'om neutraal' te

Four MPs asked the foreign minister whether the government was involved in Vitens ending its cooperation with Israel's Mekorot, whether this harms innovation and the peace process, and whether it fits the water top-sector policy. The minister answered that the government does not interfere in individual companies' decisions, that the ministry only explained Dutch non-encouragement policy when consulted, and that companies decide their own economic relations.
The government does not intervene in the decisions of individual companies.
De regering treedt niet in de besluiten van individuele bedrijven.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden de Caluwe en Ten Broeke over steniging in Afghanistan

Two VVD MPs asked the foreign and development ministers about a reported proposal in Afghanistan's law reform working group to reintroduce stoning, and whether Dutch funding to the Afghan bar association should be stopped. The ministers answered that no such proposal was made by the sub-working group or the bar association chair, that Dutch funding is for lawyer training via local partners, and that Nederland will monitor the reform and raise concerns if needed.
The Netherlands will monitor the criminal law reform process with its partners and, if necessary, raise this point again.
Nederland zal met de partners het proces van de herziening van de strafwet monitoren en indien nodig, dit punt opnieuw onder de aandacht brengen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ten Broeke over het bericht dat Rusland en Saudi-Arabië gekozen zijn in de VN-Mensenrechtenraad

An MP asked the foreign minister about Russia and Saudi Arabia being elected to the UN Human Rights Council, including whether the election reflects their human rights records and how the council's legitimacy is affected. The minister replied that votes are secret, that all members can take part in agenda-setting and debates, that candidates pledge to improve their human rights situation, and that Israel was invited to join the WEOG group.
The elections for a seat on the UN Human Rights Council (HRC) are secret.
De verkiezingen voor een zetel in de VN-Mensenrechtenraad (MRR) zijn geheim.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ten Broeke over de VN-vredesinspanningen voor de Westelijke Sahara

An MP from the VVD asked the Foreign Minister about human rights in Western Sahara, UN peace efforts under envoy Ross, the rejected US proposal for monitoring, a US internal report, and Western Sahara's legal status. The minister answered that rights monitoring is hard to verify, the EU backs Ross's shuttle diplomacy, MINURSO's mandate was extended without human rights, and the Dutch government cannot assess the unofficial US report.
The cabinet does not have it and therefore cannot assess it.
Kabinet beschikt daar niet over en kan het daarom ook niet beoordelen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ten Broeke over het falen van het Kompas-syteem op de Filipijnen

An MP asked the Foreign Minister whether the newly launched Kompas registration system for Dutch citizens in the Philippines failed to warn people before Typhoon Haiyan, how many registered, how many Dutch nationals remain unaccounted for, and what is being done to find them. The minister answered that the system only became operational on 1 October and was still in its start-up phase, that 343 Dutch nationals had registered, that none of the four people without contact were registered, that Dutch citizens had been warned through other channels, and that a consular team was deployed.
The system is technically operational. Over the coming period work will be done to expand the number of registrations so that more Dutch nationals can be reached.
Het systeem is technisch operationeel. De komende tijd zal worden gewerkt aan het uitbreiden van het aantal registraties zodat meer Nederlanders bereikt kunnen worden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ten Broeke over het incident in het Corinthia hotel

An MP asked the Foreign Minister about the 10 October 2013 armed abduction of Libya's prime minister from the Corinthia Hotel in Tripoli, including whether EU and Dutch diplomats' rooms were entered, whether diplomatic immunity under the Vienna Convention was violated, and whether security measures would change. The minister answered that the group entered EUBAM rooms but took only bulletproof vests, that a violation of diplomatic immunity would occur only if accredited diplomats' rooms were entered, and that no change to the security regime was currently warranted, while withholding the location of diplomats for security reasons.
With a view to the safety of the Dutch and other European diplomats sent to Libya, the cabinet cannot say anything about their accommodation location.
Met het oog op de veiligheid van de naar Libië uitgezonden Nederlandse en andere Europese diplomaten, kan het kabinet geen uitspraken doen over hun huisvestingslocatie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Servaes en Ten Broeke over het bericht "Syrian chemical weapons mission only funded until end of month

Two MPs asked the Foreign Minister whether the OPCW lacks funds to continue its Syrian chemical weapons programme after November. The minister denied any funding shortfall, listed donors and pledges, and said Syria bears responsibility for destruction costs.
As stated in the answer to question 2, there is currently no funding shortfall at the OPCW.
Zoals gesteld in het antwoord op vraag 2 is er op dit moment geen sprake van een financieringstekort bij de OPCW.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Staaij, Omtzigt, Ten Broeke, Servaes, Voordewind, Van Ojik, Van Bommel over het ongekende geweld tegen christenen in Egypte, zoals gedocumenteerd door Amnesty International

MPs from seven parties asked the Foreign Minister about Amnesty's documentation of large-scale violence against Coptic Christians in Egypt, including trends, casualty figures, the interim government's protection efforts and possible international initiatives. The minister said the reports are troubling, that the government urges independent investigation bilaterally and in EU and UN fora, that no reliable casualty figures exist, and that Dutch initiatives include judicial training and interfaith contacts.
The cabinet advocates the need for such an impartial investigation with the Egyptian authorities, both bilaterally and within the EU and UN.
Het kabinet bepleit de noodzaak van een dergelijk onpartijdig onderzoek bij de Egyptische autoriteiten, zowel bilateraal als in EU- en in VN-verband.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ten Broeke en Dijkhoff over de aanslag van Al Shabaab in Nairobi

Two VVD MPs asked why Al Shabaab is not on the Dutch, EU and UN terrorist lists, whether it should be listed, and about Dutch jihadists and the progress of motions on citizenship revocation and travel visas. The minister replied that Al Shabaab is covered by UN and EU Somalia sanctions (asset freeze, travel bans, arms embargo) but not by the terrorism lists, that no dossier suitable for EU listing exists, and that the Justice minister will inform parliament by letter on the motions.
The House will shortly be informed by the Minister of Security and Justice, by letter, about the commitments made and motions adopted.
De Kamer wordt binnenkort door de minister van Veiligheid en Justitie door middel van een brief geïnformeerd over de gedane toezeggingen en moties
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Voordewind, Segers, Ten Broeke, Servaes, Omtzigt, Van der Staaij, Van Bommel en Sjoerdsma over mogelijke financiering van Al-Shabaab via het consulaat van Eritrea

MPs from several parties asked whether money from the Eritrean consulate's diaspora tax in the Netherlands may fund Al-Shabaab, whether the OM investigated, and whether the consul should be expelled or the consulate closed. The government answered that the OM has received no complaints and started no investigation, that the tax is not per se contrary to Vienna Conventions or sanctions, that there are no concrete indications the funds financed terrorism, and that no measures are warranted.
The Public Prosecution Service has not started an investigation into the so-called diaspora tax because it had received no reports on this matter.
Door het Openbaar Ministerie is geen onderzoek begonnen naar de zgn. diaspora taks omdat het Openbaar Ministerie dienaangaande geen aangiften had ontvangen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ten Broeke over het bericht dat Koeweit voornemens is bij binnenkomst in het land een ‘medische screening’ te doen om zodoende homoseksuelen te detecteren

An MP asked the Foreign Minister whether Kuwait plans medical screening at entry to identify gay people, whether homosexuals would be unwelcome across GCC states, and whether the government will raise this with Kuwait. The minister answered that the proposal concerns gender tests for visa applicants and seems aimed more at transgender people, that the ambassador did not confirm it, that the government lacks information on GCC-wide exclusion, and that it is monitoring the situation and may act jointly with partners if appropriate.
The cabinet does not have such information.
Het kabinet beschikt niet over zulke informatie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ten Broeke, Verheijen en Taverne over de dreigende deportatie van een journalist uit Turkije

Three VVD MPs asked the Foreign Minister why Turkey threatens to deport NRC correspondent Vermeulen as a security risk, and what the Netherlands is doing about it. The minister said the government does not know what the alleged security problem is, that the ministry has raised the case with Turkish authorities and pressed for his right to return and work, and that the government is concerned about press freedom in Turkey.

The Ministry of Foreign Affairs has raised attention with the Turkish authorities for Mr Vermeulen and urges that he be able to enter Turkey, where he lives, and carry out his work as a journalist there.

Het Ministerie van Buitenlandse Zaken heeft bij de Turkse autoriteiten aandacht gevraagd voor de heer Vermeulen en dringt er op aan dat hij Turkije – waar hij woont – binnen kan komen en daar zijn werkzaamheden als journalist kan verrichten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ten Broeke over de bouw van een nieuwe nederzetting op de Westelijke Jordaanoever

An MP asked the Foreign Minister about the construction of a new Israeli settlement (Leshem) on the West Bank, its legal status, the attendance of a minister at its inauguration, its compatibility with the Oslo Accords, and whether the government would call for its dismantling. The minister answered that Leshem is formally treated by Israel as a neighbourhood of Aley Zahav but shows settlement characteristics, that the government considers such construction harmful to the peace process, and that the Dutch position has been conveyed to Israeli authorities without committing to a demand for dismantlement.
The Dutch position on construction in and of settlements is known to the Israeli authorities.
Het Nederlands standpunt ten aanzien van bouw in en van nederzettingen is bekend bij de Israëlische autoriteiten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ten Broeke, Van Oosten en Van der Steur over de civiele aansprakelijkheid van de Staat der Nederlanden bij militaire uitzendingen

Three VVD MPs asked whether the Supreme Court's 6 September 2013 rulings on State civil liability for the Srebrenica deployment affect future military deployments, local staff, command structures, the Bakker commission framework, and whether such liability can be excluded. The government answered that the rulings rest on Srebrenica-specific facts, do not change current practice, command or the assessment framework, and that excluding liability is not possible.

In future military deployments other facts and circumstances will be at issue. It is therefore not possible to make statements in advance about the possible liability of the State in future deployments.

Bij toekomstige militaire uitzendingen zullen andere feiten en omstandigheden aan de orde zijn. Het is dan ook niet mogelijk op voorhand uitspraken te doen over de eventuele aansprakelijkheid van de Staat bij toekomstige uitzendingen.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Ten Broeke over sektarisch geweld in Irak

An MP asked the foreign minister about rising sectarian violence in Iraq, alleged torture by Iraqi security services, and the attack on Camp Ashraf, and whether the Iraqi ambassador had been contacted. The minister acknowledges growing sectarian tensions but says a civil war is not yet underway, notes UNAMI's findings on Camp Ashraf and an announced Iraqi investigation, and says contact with the ambassador is regular.
Regarding Camp Hurriya, the Netherlands supports the efforts of the United Nations, both UNAMI and UNHCR, to increase security at Camp Hurriya.
Ten aanzien van Kamp Hurriya steunt Nederland de inspanningen van de Verenigde Naties, zowel van UNAMI als van VN-vluchtelingenorganisatie UNHCR, om de veiligheid in Kamp Hurriya te vergroten.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Ten Broeke over mogelijke proliferatie van Syrische chemische wapens

An MP asks the Foreign Minister whether he knows of reports that Syria transferred chemical weapons to Hezbollah and Iraqi actors, and what the consequences would be for UN Resolution 2118 and OPCW inspections. The minister answers that the transfers cannot be confirmed, that a breach would violate the resolution, and that the matter will be judged after OPCW verification, so no separate investigation is announced.
The statements by Mr al-Sakat and various other sources that Syria would be moving chemical weapons to Hezbollah and actors in Iraq cannot be confirmed.
De uitspraken van de heer al-Sakat en verschillende andere bronnen dat Syrië chemische wapens zou wegvoeren naar Hezbollah en actoren in Irak kunnen niet worden bevestigd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ten Broeke over de bouw van een Russisch hek aan de Georgische grens

Ten Broeke (VVD) asked the foreign minister whether he agrees that a Russian fence on the Georgian border with South Ossetia violates the 2008 ceasefire, breaches international law and restricts local residents' movement, and what the EU and EUMM can do. The minister confirms the fence, says the Netherlands is concerned and that it conflicts with the 6-point plan, and describes EU and EUMM statements and Geneva talks, while noting the EUMM has no mandate to stop construction.
The EUMM has no mandate to prevent the construction of the fence.
De EUMM heeft geen mandaat om de bouw van de afscheiding tegen te gaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ten Broeke over het incident in Khirbet Al-Makhul op de Westelijke Jordaanoever

An MP asked the foreign minister about a clash at Khirbet al-Makhul in the West Bank in which an EU diplomat was reportedly involved, asking whether she joined a protest and whether Israeli forces acted disproportionately. The minister answered that the diplomat accompanied a humanitarian convoy rather than joining the crowd, that the Netherlands considers the Israeli army acted disproportionately, and that EU representatives have requested explanations from Israeli authorities.
Inquiries by the Dutch representation in Ramallah confirm that the diplomat in question did not join the gathered crowd.
Navraag door de Nederlandse vertegenwoordiging in Ramallah bevestigt dat de diplomaat in kwestie zich niet heeft aangesloten bij de verzamelde menigte.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ten Broeke over de opstelling EU en vredesproces Midden-Oosten met betrekking tot de inspanningen van US Secretary of State Kerry

An MP asks the Foreign Minister how the Netherlands views new EU guidelines barring EU funding for Israeli entities beyond the 1967 Green Line, and whether they could undermine US Secretary Kerry's renewed Middle East peace talks. The minister answers that the guidelines follow from established EU policy that settlements are illegal, that the Netherlands welcomes the talks, and that the EU will support the process without linking it to the guidelines.
These guidelines are prompted by the fact that settlements are illegal and form an obstacle to the peace process.
Deze richtsnoeren zijn ingegeven door het feit dat nederzettingen illegaal zijn en een obstakel vormen voor het vredesproces.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Ten Broeke en Van Ark over het bericht "homo's Rusland digitaal vernederd"

Two VVD MPs asked the Foreign Minister about reports of digital humiliation of gay people in Russia and about rising anti-LGBT violence after Russia's anti-'homopropaganda' law. The minister acknowledged the law's discriminatory effect, said Nederland will raise LGBT rights with Russia and seek an EU position, and noted IOC assurances that the law will not apply during the Sochi Games.
At the next Foreign Affairs Council meeting, the Netherlands will raise the human rights situation in Russia broadly and push for a joint EU position on the anti-homopropaganda law.

Nederland zal bij de eerstvolgende bespreking van de RBZ de mensenrechtensituatie in Rusland in brede zin aan de orde stellen en bevorderen dat over de anti-homopropagandawet een gezamenlijk EU-standpunt zal worden ingenomen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Lodders, De Liefde en Ten Broeke over het importverbod van Rusland op pootaardappelen en plantmateriaal

Three VVD MPs asked the state secretary for Economic Affairs and the foreign trade minister about Russia's import ban on Dutch seed potatoes and plant material, asking about EU and Dutch action, WTO compliance, and how to prevent such unilateral bans. The government answered that it keeps pressing the European Commission for quick follow-up talks with Russia, supports a derogation and traceability measures, and sees no WTO challenge yet, while acknowledging the ban harms Dutch growers.
I will keep urging the European Commission for swift follow-up steps given the major trade interests of Dutch business.
Ik zal bij de Europese Commissie blijven aandringen op spoedige vervolgstappen gezien de grote handelsbelangen van het Nederlandse bedrijfsleven.
Antwoord vragen Ten Broeke en Van Ojik over de arrestatie van vier Nederlandse documentairemakers in Moermansk op verdenking van 'homopropaganda'

Two MPs asked the foreign minister about the arrest in Murmansk of four Dutch documentary makers on suspicion of 'homopropaganda', and whether they could leave Russia and what the government would do about the law's effect on journalists. The minister answered that the group left Russia after paying small fines for a visa violation, the propaganda charge was dismissed on procedural grounds, and the government raised the matter with Russian authorities and the EU's High Representative, and will raise LGBT rights again at the next Foreign Affairs Council.
At the next discussion of developments in Russia in the Council, the Netherlands will again raise attention to LGBT rights in that country, partly in response to this matter.
Nederland zal bij de eerstvolgende bespreking van ontwikkelingen in Rusland in de Raad opnieuw aandacht vragen voor LHBT-rechten in dat land, mede naar aanleiding van deze kwestie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ten Broeke over de deelname van Sam Rainsy aan de Cambodjaanse verkiezingen

An MP asked the foreign minister about Sam Rainsy's exile, the Paris Peace Agreements, and whether the Netherlands would press for charges and immunity to be lifted so he could contest the 2013 Cambodian elections. The minister acknowledged concern about freedom of expression, said Cambodia's election schedule meets the Paris Agreement, and noted the EU's technical assistance and that Rainsy had been pardoned and was expected to return.
It is worrying that freedom of expression is under pressure.
Het is zorgelijk dat de vrijheid van meningsuiting onder druk staat.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ten Broeke over Iran

An MP asked the foreign minister about reports that Iran runs a terror and intelligence network through its embassies in South America, including Suriname, and about Canada closing its Iranian embassy. The minister said the ministry has received no signals of Iranian use of its posts in Suriname for intelligence or terror, that unconfirmed reports circulate and services monitor foreign interference without public disclosure, and that Canada expelled Iranian diplomats and closed its embassy in Teheran.
The Ministry of Foreign Affairs has received no signals that Iran uses its diplomatic network for intelligence services and terror attacks in Suriname.
Het Ministerie van Buitenlandse Zaken heeft geen signalen gekregen dat Iran het postennetwerk gebruikt voor inlichtingendiensten en terreuraanslagen in Suriname.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Ten Broeke over het gebruik van chemische wapens in Syrië

MP Ten Broeke asks the Foreign Minister whether the US claim that Assad used sarin, and the evidence behind it, changes the Dutch assessment, whether chemical weapons use is a red line, and whether the OPCW/UN investigation is still active. The minister replies that the Dutch government is seriously concerned, that the underlying evidence is not known to it, that chemical weapons use is prohibited by international law regardless of perpetrator, and that Syria has refused the UN team free access beyond one site.
The data underlying those statements are not known to the cabinet, and therefore the cabinet cannot make any statements about them.
De gegevens die ten grondslag liggen aan genoemde verklaringen zijn het kabinet niet bekend en hierdoor kan het kabinet daarover dus geen uitspraken doen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Verheijen en Ten Broeke over het bericht «EU-miljard voor Egypte verdween in zwart gat»

Two MPs asked the Foreign Minister about a newspaper report that EU aid of a billion euros to Egypt had disappeared, and about the European Court of Auditors' critical findings on the use of the funds. The minister acknowledged serious shortcomings, said the Netherlands had pressed the Commission and EEAS for stricter conditions, noted that Egypt's remaining aid is withheld pending IMF-linked reforms, and said Dutch bilateral aid carries negligible risk of misuse.
The Netherlands argued that this critical report again confirms the need to set clearer conditions on the use of funds for the Arab region.
Nederland heeft ingebracht dat dit kritische rapport nog eens de noodzaak bevestigt van het stellen van duidelijkere voorwaarden aan de besteding van fondsen voor de Arabische regio
Antwoord vragen van de leden Van Bommel, Bonis en Ten Broeke over de detentie van Abdulkareem Yousef al-Khoder in Saudi-Arabië

MPs from many parties asked the foreign minister whether the four-month detention of human rights activist Abdulkareem Yousef al-Khoder in Saudi Arabia was justified, whether the government agrees with Amnesty International that he is a prisoner of conscience, and whether it will urge Saudi Arabia to release him. The minister answered that the EU is investigating the background of the arrest with Saudi bodies, that EU action will depend on the outcome, and that the Netherlands generally raises human rights defender issues with Saudi authorities.
Depending on the outcome of the investigation, the EU will consider whether, and if so what, action is effective and desirable.
Afhankelijk van de uitkomsten van het onderzoek zal in EU-verband worden bezien of, en zo ja welke, actie effectief en wenselijk is.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Voordewind, Van der Staaij, Ten Broeke, De Roon en Van Bommel over de benoeming van Iran tot voorzitter van de VN-Ontwapeningsconferentie

MPs from several parties asked the foreign minister whether Iran's rotating chairmanship of the UN Conference on Disarmament, and the US boycott of it, undermines disarmament progress and whether the Netherlands should follow a boycott. The minister replied that the chair rotates alphabetically rather than being elected, that the Netherlands will attend but leave if the Durban criteria are violated, and that a policy letter is forthcoming.
The Netherlands is a strong supporter of (nuclear) disarmament and non-proliferation, with the ultimate goal of a world without nuclear weapons.
Nederland is een groot voorstander van (nucleaire) ontwapening en non-proliferatie, waarbij het uiteindelijke doel is een wereld zonder kernwapens.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Verheijen en Ten Broeke over het bericht "EU diplomats to spend more on salaries, less on security"

MPs Verheijen and Ten Broeke asked the foreign minister about reports that EU diplomatic service spending would shift toward salaries and away from security, and about high pay levels and allowances at the EEAS. The minister said the figures could not be confirmed as they come from draft budgets not yet public, defended the higher grades as a legacy of merged structures, and pledged to push for lower staff conditions and to inform the House after the EEAS evaluation.
The content of the report cannot be confirmed.
De inhoud van het bericht kan niet bevestigd worden.
Antwoord vragen Voordewind, Bonis, Omtzigt, Ten Broeke, Sjoerdsma, Van Bommel, Van der Staaij en Van Ojik over de ontvoering van twee Syrische bisschoppen

MPs from eight parties asked the foreign minister whether the government knew of the abduction of two Syrian bishops, whether their driver was killed, and whether the Netherlands would seek mediation with the parties to the conflict. The minister confirmed awareness, declined to give details on the circumstances or the bishops' status, and said the Netherlands is working with EU partners and the Syrian opposition to secure their release and promised to inform the House.

Regarding the precise circumstances of the abduction of Bishop Boulos Yazigi and Bishop Yohanna Ibrahim and the specific question of whether their driver was killed, it is not possible to provide further information.

Over de precieze omstandigheden van de ontvoering van bisschop Boulos Yazigi en bisschop Yohanna Ibrahim en de concrete vraag of hun chauffeur hierbij is gedood is het niet mogelijk nadere inlichtingen te verschaffen.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Ten Broeke over het gebruik van chemische wapens in Syrië

An MP asked the foreign minister about reports of Assad regime use of sarin in Syria, including verification, contacts with Israel, the UK's findings, and a possible NATO role. The minister said Dutch information was insufficient to verify use, backed a UN investigation with free access, and said NATO was focused on protecting Turkey.
We currently do not have sufficient information to verify whether, where and by whom such agents were used.
Wij beschikken op dit moment niet over voldoende informatie om te verifiëren of, waar en door wie dergelijke middelen zijn ingezet.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ten Broeke, Sjoerdsma, Van Bommel en Bonis over de arrestatie en vervolgens vrijlating van de Nederlandse journaliste Rena Netjes in Cairo

MPs from VVD, D66, SP and PvdA asked the foreign minister about the arrest and release of Dutch journalist Rena Netjes in Cairo, including whether a citizen's arrest could fuel a witch-hunt against Western journalists. The minister confirmed no formal charge was filed, described ambassador contact with the Egyptian prosecutor leading to her release, and said the Egyptian authorities found the citizen's arrest unlawful.
As far as the embassy in Cairo could verify, there was no official charge against Ms Netjes.
Er is voor zover door de ambassade in Cairo kon worden nagegaan geen officiële aanklacht tegen mevrouw Netjes geweest.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Ten Broeke over het door Marokko weigeren van een bezoek van vier Europarlementariërs aan de Westelijke Sahara

Ten Broeke (VVD) asked the Foreign Minister about Morocco refusing entry to four MEPs travelling to Western Sahara, and whether the government would protest and press for better access and human rights within the EU-Morocco relationship. Minister Timmermans answered that the trip was private, that Morocco considered the MEPs biased, that the free-trade talks fall under the existing Association Agreement with its human rights clauses but do not include Western Sahara access conditions, and that he would contact the UN envoy and inform parliament.
As I promised the House on 27 March during the General Consultation on the Arab region, I will shortly contact him and inform the House about that conversation.
Zoals ik uw Kamer heb toegezegd op 27 maart tijdens het Algemeen Overleg over de Arabische regio zal ik binnenkort met hem contact leggen en uw Kamer informeren over dat gesprek.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Van der Staaij, Voordewind, De Roon en Ten Broeke over de aanval op een christelijke wijk in de Pakistaanse stad Lahore

Four MPs (Van der Staaij, Voordewind, De Roon, Ten Broeke) asked the foreign minister about a mob attack on a Christian neighbourhood in Lahore over alleged blasphemy, Pakistan's government response, the misuse of blasphemy law and what the Netherlands will do to press Pakistan. The minister answered that Punjab ordered a judicial inquiry and compensation was paid, that the blasphemy law is open to abuse, and that the Netherlands raises the issue bilaterally, multilaterally and in GSP+ assessment, but gave no concrete new commitments beyond existing channels.
I do not have confirmed figures on the number of people imprisoned on charges under this law.
Ik beschik niet over geconfirmeerde cijfers over het aantal personen dat gevangen zit vanwege een beschuldiging op grond van deze wet.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Lodders en Ten Broeke over bontproductie in China

Two VVD MPs asked the state secretary of Economic Affairs about fur farming conditions in China, how Dutch fur farming standards compare, global demand for fur, the revenue lost from the Dutch fur farm ban, and whether production will shift to countries with weaker animal welfare. The state secretary answered that data on Chinese fur farming is scarce, outlined regulatory differences, cited industry figures on rising fur turnover, estimated the Dutch fur sector's turnover above 300 million euro without quantifying lost state revenue, and said production may shift to countries like Denmark, Poland, Romania or Belarus and China, though the extent is unknown.
To what extent the Dutch state is losing revenue cannot be said on this basis, as it depends on various factors.
In hoeverre de Nederlandse staat inkomsten mis loopt is op basis hiervan niet te zeggen, dit is afhankelijk van diverse factoren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Staaij, Voordewind, De Roon, Ten Broeke, Maij en Van Bommel over de marginalisatie van de Papua's in sociaal en economisch opzicht

Dutch MPs asked the foreign minister whether Papuans are marginalised in the exploitation of natural resources, whether large development programmes bring in immigrants, who benefits, how their land is legally protected, and how the Netherlands can help. The minister acknowledged the reports, said development is aimed at the whole population, admitted the Special Autonomy Law's consultation duty and local regulation are not consistently implemented or completed, and committed to pressing Indonesia for transparency and NGO access.
This consultation obligation is not always complied with in practice.
Deze consultatieplicht wordt in de praktijk niet altijd nageleefd.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Ten Broeke over betrokkenheid Hezbollah bij de busaanslag in Bulgarije

An MP asked the Foreign Minister whether there are strong indications that Hezbollah, rather than Iran, was involved in the Bulgarian bus bombing, whether this warrants listing Hezbollah as a terrorist organisation, and whether he would consult Europol. The minister confirmed awareness of the report, said only Hezbollah (not Iran) is named by Bulgarian authorities and Europol, and said the Netherlands will again push for EU listing of Hezbollah and will provide a Europol statement.
The Netherlands will once again strongly advocate placing Hezbollah on the European Union's list of terrorist organisations.
Nederland zal zich er andermaal sterk voor maken Hezbollah op de lijst van terroristische organisaties van de Europese Unie te plaatsen.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Ten Broeke over het bericht dat Iran een manier heeft gevonden om de Westerse oliesancties te ontlopen

An MP from the VVD asked the Foreign Minister whether a report that Iran had found a way to evade Western oil sanctions was accurate, which route it used, and how sanctions could be made more effective. The minister declined to comment on the Iranian minister's motives or the truth of the claims, stated that EU sanctions are being actively enforced with no known violations, and said Iran's rerouting of oil transport outside the EU is not a breach of EU sanctions, which the EU cannot prevent.
The EU does, however, actively lobby third countries to join the sanctions.
Wel voert de EU een actieve lobby bij derde landen om zich bij de sancties aan te sluiten.
Antwoord vragen Ten Broeke over het bericht “Magnitsky wet tergt Russen”

An MP from the VVD asked the foreign minister about the US Magnitsky law and its reach to Russian rights abusers, and whether the Netherlands would take the lead for a similar EU position. The minister said he shares concerns about the Russian rule of law but that the EU lacks support for a visa ban, so he will keep raising the case with colleagues and Russian authorities.
However, there is no support within the EU for a visa ban.
Er is echter binnen de EU geen draagvlak voor een visumban.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Ten Broeke over de berichtgeving dat de Egyptische president Morsi meer macht naar zich toe heeft getrokken

An MP asks the foreign minister whether the new decree by Egyptian president Morsi, which curbs judicial review of presidential decisions, goes beyond what is desirable in a state under the rule of law, and how it affects EU aid. The minister answers that Morsi restored judicial review on 8 December, calls on Egypt to guarantee the rule of law, and says the EU currently does not plan to change aid to Egypt.
President Morsi issued a new decree on 8 December whereby the judiciary can again review his decisions.
President Morsi heeft op 8 december jl. een nieuw decreet uitgevaardigd waardoor de rechterlijke macht zijn besluiten weer kan toetsen.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Ten Broeke over het bericht ‘Omwonenden blij met extra geluidsmetingen JSF’

An MP asked the Defence Minister whether planned US noise measurements of the F-35 in spring 2013 were needed given existing RIVM and NLR studies, and whether those institutes would be involved. The minister answered that existing studies remain valid, the new US tests cover other F-35 variants and specific aspects, and NLR's expertise will be offered for the measurements while Netherlands will keep monitoring developments.
Defence will abide by the statutory noise contours.
Defensie zal zich houden aan de wettelijke geluidscontouren.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Ten Broeke, Hennis-Plasschaert en Verheijen over het veiligheidsrisico van Chinese telecomproducenten

Three VVD MPs asked the government whether Chinese telecom producers pose a security risk to Dutch critical infrastructure, what steps will be taken to map such risks, and whether KPN and others will be questioned. The minister answers that vulnerabilities are a conceivable risk but there is no direct evidence of espionage use, that intelligence services remain alert and will warn relevant parties if concrete indications emerge, and that the matter will be raised actively with companies.
For the time being there is a conceivable risk, but there are no direct indications that these vulnerabilities are actually being used for espionage purposes.
Vooralsnog is hier sprake van een voorstelbaar risico, maar zijn er geen directe aanwijzingen dat deze kwetsbaarheden daadwerkelijk worden gebruikt voor spionagedoeleinden.
Antwoord vragen Ten Broeke over de 'diaspora-belasting' voor Eritrese Nederlanders

An MP asked the Foreign Minister whether the Eritrean government forces Eritrean-Dutch citizens to pay a 2% diaspora tax, whether the funds finance al-Shabaab, and what action would be taken. The minister confirmed the tax is collected via Eritrean embassies and consulates, that police and prosecutors act on complaints, that the UN Monitoring Group found no evidence of Eritrean support to al-Shabaab, and that the Eritrean chargé d'affaires was summoned.
To establish whether offences such as extortion are at issue, the police and the Public Prosecution Service depend largely on reports and complaints from victims.

Voor het vaststellen of misdrijven als afpersing en soortgelijke delicten aan de orde zijn, zijn politie en het openbaar ministerie (OM) in belangrijke mate afhankelijk van aangifte en melding door de slachtoffers.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ten Broeke over de aanslag in de Sinaï bij de grensovergang Rafah

An MP asked the foreign minister about Egyptian Brotherhood claims that Mossad was behind the August 2012 Sinai attack near the Rafah crossing, the position of President Morsi, the Sinai security situation, and pipeline attacks. The minister answered that the Brotherhood's claims rest on Israeli travel warnings, that Egyptian authorities blame terrorist elements, that Sinai security has deteriorated with military intensified, and that the latest pipeline attack was on 22 July 2012.
The security situation in Sinai has deteriorated over the past year.
De veiligheidssituatie in de Sinaï is het afgelopen jaar verslechterd.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Ten Broeke over de constitutionele wijzigingen in Egypte

An MP from the VVD asked the Foreign Minister whether the dismissal of Egypt's military leaders signals an end to military rule, what the links are to the Sinai border attack, and what role Egypt's parliament plays while it remains dissolved. The minister answered that the military transition ended with Morsi's inauguration, the two leaders were retired to advisory roles, no instability is expected, the Shura council is not involved, and the EU has urged an inclusive solution to the parliamentary crisis.
Tantawi and Anan, the number one and two of the SCAF, were retired by President Morsi as of 11 August and appointed as advisers to the President.
Tantawi en Anan, de nummers één en twee van de SCAF, zijn per 11 augustus jl. door president Morsi gepensioneerd; en benoemd tot adviseur van de President.
Antwoord vragen Neppérus en Ten Broeke over belastingheffing bij Nederlanders door Duitsland over pensioenen

MPs Neppérus and Ten Broeke asked why Germany taxes Dutch pensions at what they reported as the top German rate, how many people are affected, and how to improve information and prevent such surprises. The State Secretary replied that the German tax follows a 2002 constitutional court ruling, that the applicable rate is often 14% rather than the top rate, that about 45,000 Dutch residents are affected, and that the Tax Administration will improve information and cooperate with Germany.
Yes, I believe there is room for improvement in the information provided to pensioners with a pension from abroad.
