Ja, ik vind dat er verbetering te behalen is in de informatievoorziening aan gepensioneerden met een pensioen uit het buitenland.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Ten Broeke over de NH-90

MPs Ten Broeke asked whether Portugal and Norway were considering cancelling NH-90 helicopter orders, what the consequences would be for the programme and Dutch deliveries, and whether freed-up production capacity could speed up Dutch helicopters for search and rescue. The minister answered that Portugal has announced withdrawal and cancellation of ten helicopters with consequences being studied, that Norway has not announced cancellation, and that Dutch deliveries are unaffected.
Given the relatively limited size of the Portuguese order in relation to the total number of helicopters ordered from NHIndustries, these costs will however be limited.
Gezien de relatief beperkte omvang van de Portugese bestelling in verhouding tot het totale aantal helikopters dat bij NHIndustries besteld is, zullen deze kosten echter beperkt zijn.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Ten Broeke over het bericht “Directeur Wereldomroep krijgt miljoen euro bij vertrek”

An MP asked ministers about reports that the Wereldomroep director would receive about one million euro in severance on departure, and whether such payments are permissible in the public sector. The ministers answered that the Raad van Toezicht sets the severance under the Wereldomroep's contractual and sector frameworks, that the director's pay would be assessed critically using the kantonrechter formula, and that the WNT caps severance at 75,000 euro once in force.
I have urged the RvT to critically assess the severance payment once it becomes relevant.
Ik heb er bij de RvT op aangedrongen om de ontslagvergoeding kritisch te beoordelen zodra deze aan de orde is.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Ten Broeke en Schaart over de levering van een SIGMA korvet aan Indonesië

Two VVD MPs asked about the sale of a SIGMA corvette by Damen Schelde Naval Shipbuilding to Indonesia, including contract value, jobs, prior deliveries and whether EU arms export criteria were applied. The government confirmed a contract of about $220 million for one corvette with an option on more, said a positive preliminary assessment against the EU criteria was made, and provided an overview of export licences for Indonesia.
In an exploratory phase, a so-called sondage, a positive opinion was given based on assessment against the eight criteria of the EU Common Position.
In een verkennende fase, een zogenaamde sondage, is een positief advies gegeven aan de hand van de beoordeling van de acht criteria van het EU Gemeenschappelijk Standpunt.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Pechtold en Ten Broeke over de uitzending op de Azerbeidzjaanse staatstelevisie AzTV over het alternatieve songfestival op 26 mei

MPs Pechtold and Ten Broeke asked whether the minister was aware of an Azerbaijani state TV broadcast discrediting Dutch NGOs such as IKV Pax Christi over an alternative song festival, and what the government would do about media pressure on critical NGOs. The minister acknowledged the broadcast, said there was no evidence it harmed the NGOs or their partners, noted the ambassador had raised the issue, and said the matter would be raised with the Azerbaijani foreign minister.
However, I have no indication that this one-off broadcast will hinder the work of the Dutch organisations concerned.
Ik beschik echter niet over aanwijzingen dat deze eenmalige uitzending het werk van de betreffende Nederlandse organisaties zal bemoeilijken
Antwoord vragen Ten Broeke over benoeming van Mugabe tot ambassadeur van toerisme door de Wereld Toerisme Organisatie (UNWTO)

An MP from the VVD asked the Foreign Minister whether Robert Mugabe was appointed tourism ambassador by the UN World Tourism Organization and, if so, whether the Netherlands should boycott the assembly and stop its contribution. The minister answered that the reports are incorrect, UNWTO denies any such appointment, and stopping the contribution is not an option.
The report is incorrect. UNWTO denies such an appointment.
Het bericht is onjuist. UNWTO weerspreekt een dergelijke benoeming.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hennis-Plasschaert en Ten Broeke inzake Antwoorden het bericht 'Politieweb aan grens in gevaar'

Two VVD MPs asked the Justice and Defence ministers whether the national police merger would end the mobile cross-border police teams at the German border, and about results, funding and possible use of Koninklijke Marechaussee teams. The minister answered that cross-border cooperation under the Treaty of Enschede continues, that the Twente joint team's funding runs to July 2013 with a continuity commitment, and that the team's form may change after evaluation.
The ministry is periodically informed about project progress and the (interim) results and deployment of the GPT.
Het ministerie wordt periodiek geïnformeerd over de projectvoortgang en de (tussentijdse) resultaten en de inzet van het GPT.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Houwers en Ten Broeke over het bericht dat de gemeente Almelo circussen weert met wilde dieren

MPs Houwers and Ten Broeke asked the state secretary whether municipalities such as Almelo may ban circuses with wild animals without a public order threat, and whether the law should be changed so municipalities cannot refuse circuses that meet the animal welfare law. The state secretary answered that municipalities may regulate circuses only for public order or safety purposes, not for animal welfare, and declined to change the legislation.
Municipalities do have the power to make rules concerning animals for a different purpose, provided these rules do not conflict with the standards of the Animal Health and Welfare Act.
Gemeenten hebben wel de bevoegdheid om met een ander oogmerk regels te stellen inzake dieren, mits deze regels niet in strijd zijn met de normen in de Gezondheids- en welzijnswet voor dieren.
Antwoord vragen Ormel, Voordewind en Ten Broeke over 'een Palestijnse Christen'

MPs Ormel, Voordewind and Ten Broeke asked the Foreign Minister about Palestinian Christian Daoud Nassar, who cancelled a Dutch visit, and about a long-running land and legal dispute with Israeli authorities over the family farm. The minister confirmed the cancellation, disputed that the family was described as illegal residents, outlined the land registration dispute and court process, and said there was no reason for the Netherlands to intervene.
Based on the available information, I currently see no reason for the Netherlands to get involved in this matter.
Op basis van de beschikbare informatie zie ik op dit moment geen aanleiding voor Nederland om zich te mengen in deze kwestie.
Antwoord vragen Ten Broeke over het artikel ‘Bemanning Nederlands schip ontvoerd in Nigeria’

An MP asked the Defence and Foreign Affairs ministers about the kidnapping of a Dutch-operated ship's crew in Nigerian waters, the nationalities of those involved, how their release would be secured, and whether Nigeria had been pressed to protect anchored ships. The government answered that the Nigerian authorities are responsible for handling the incident, that Netherlands will assist where possible, and that piracy in West Africa is rising and is being addressed in the UN Security Council and ECOWAS.
Since the robbery and kidnapping took place within Nigeria's territorial waters, handling the incident is a responsibility of the Nigerian authorities.
Aangezien de beroving en kidnapping heeft plaatsgevonden binnen de territoriale wateren van Nigeria, is de afhandeling van het incident een verantwoordelijkheid van de Nigeriaanse autoriteiten.
Antwoord vragen Ten Broeke over de landing van een Apache gevechtshelikopter aan boord van Hr. Ms. Rotterdam

An MP asked the Defence Minister whether a test landing of an Apache helicopter on a navy ship changes the earlier position that Apaches are not yet suited to ship operations, and whether results of the study will be shared and anti-piracy deployment pursued. The minister confirmed the landing, said it is part of a broader study whose unclassified results will be shared with parliament, and that any deployment decision will weigh defined goals against available capabilities.
After completion of the study, I will share the relevant, unclassified results with the House as soon as possible.
Na voltooiing van het onderzoek zal ik de relevante, niet geclassificeerde resultaten zo spoedig mogelijk met de Kamer delen.
Antwoord vragen Voordewind, Van der Staaij, De Roon, Van Bommel, Ormel, Ten Broeke en El Fassed over vrouwenrechten in Egypte

MPs from several parties asked the minister of Foreign Affairs about reports of abductions and forced conversions of Coptic girls in Egypt, the link to Salafism, and whether the government would raise women's rights with Egyptian and EU counterparts. The minister said reliable crime statistics are lacking, pointed to Egypt's wider human rights concerns, noted that Dutch government cooperation under Matra-Zuid was suspended, and listed women's rights projects being funded.
The Netherlands stresses, both in bilateral contacts with Egyptian authorities and within the EU, the importance of applying and implementing the rule of law and of countering impunity.

Nederland onderstreept zowel in bilaterale contacten met Egyptische autoriteiten, als in EU-verband, het belang van de toepassing en uitvoering van rechtsstatelijkheid en het belang om straffeloosheid tegen te gaan.
Antwoord vragen Ten Broeke over inperking van internetvrijheid in Iran

An MP asked the Foreign Minister whether reports that Iran would shut down popular email services and internet access were accurate, and whether the Netherlands could still support internet freedom in Iran. The minister said EU embassies could not verify Iranian intentions, but that the government has earmarked 1 million euros for emergency internet technology and support for Iran, with further funds from the Human Rights Fund.
It is therefore impossible at this time to establish what the intentions and capabilities of the Iranian authorities are.
Het is daardoor onmogelijk om op dit moment vast te stellen wat de intenties en mogelijkheden van de Iraanse autoriteiten zijn.
Antwoord vragen Ormel en Ten Broeke over de veroordeling van Papoea’s in Indonesië

MPs Ormel and Ten Broeke asked the Foreign Minister about the conviction of five Papuan men for declaring Papuan independence at a congress, and about Indonesia's continued harsh sentencing of peaceful demonstrators, the transfer of prisoners, and the slow implementation of the Special Autonomy Law. The minister confirmed the convictions as attempted treason, noted that an appeal was filed and awaited, stated Dutch concern has been raised bilaterally and in the EU, acknowledged slow autonomy implementation as a cause of protests, and described UP4B office openings and possible Dutch support for programmes in Papua.
I am awaiting the appeal ruling.
Ik wacht de uitspraak in hoger beroep af.
Antwoord vragen Ten Broeke over de actie 'plant een olijfboom'

MP Ten Broeke asked the foreign minister about a Dutch-supported olive-tree planting action in the Palestinian territories, including whether the land was privately owned and whether Norway's and Israel's handling of the incident should be raised. The minister confirmed the facts of the statements, declined to rule on land ownership as a local legal matter, said owners should be able to act without outside disruption, and said the matter is primarily for Norway.
This concerns a legal question that must be interpreted under local applicable law. It is not for the Netherlands to rule on it.
Het betreft een juridische kwestie die naar lokaal geldend recht dient te worden geïnterpreteerd. Het is niet aan Nederland daarover een uitspraak te doen.
Antwoord vragen Ten Broeke en Ormel over het bericht dat de Afghaanse president Karzai het standpunt van de Ulema Council steunt dat vrouwen niet mogen mixen met mannen op school of tijdens het werk

MPs Ten Broeke and Ormel asked whether President Karzai endorsed the Ulema Council's ruling that women may not mix with men at school or work, and what the Netherlands and the international community are doing to protect women's position in Afghanistan from Taliban influence. The minister confirms Karzai called the statement consistent with Islamic law but reaffirmed support for constitutional women's rights, notes shared concern, and describes Dutch support for women's organisations, programmes and diplomatic raising of the issue.
The Netherlands shares the concerns of MP Fawzia Koofi.
Nederland deelt de zorgen van parlementslid Fawzia Koofi.
Antwoord vragen Ten Broeke over het mandaat van de EU-operatie Atalanta

An MP asked the Defence and Foreign Affairs ministers about the EU anti-piracy operation Atalanta, including reports of a more robust approach, UK Apache plans and the mandate under UN resolution 1816. The ministers answered that there is no objection to extending the operating area, that the EU decision on land-effect action is still pending and will be reported to parliament by letter.
Once the decision-making at EU level on action from the sea with effect on land is completed, your House will be informed about this.
Zodra de besluitvorming in EU-verband over optreden, vanaf zee, met effect op land voltooid is, wordt uw Kamer hierover geïnformeerd.
Antwoord vragen Ten Broeke over recente ontwikkelingen in Jemen

An MP asks the foreign minister about the immunity granted to former Yemeni president Saleh under the transition deal, whether he still exerts influence, and whether sanctions or pressure remain possible. The minister confirms the immunity is part of the November transition agreement, acknowledges signals of Saleh's continued influence, but says there is no information he is using capital for political gain and that sanctions are not currently appropriate.
Immunity for President Saleh is part of the transition agreement concluded in November between President Saleh and the opposition parties.
Immuniteit voor president Saleh maakt deel uit van het transitieakkoord dat in november tussen president Saleh en de oppositiepartijen werd gesloten.
Vragen van de leden Ten Broeke en Dijkhoff (beiden VVD) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over de ontvoering van de Irakese vrouwenrechtenactiviste Aya Al Lami (ingezonden 10 oktober 2011).

Two MPs asked the Foreign Minister about the abduction and mistreatment of Iraqi women's rights activist Aya Al Lami, and about reported rises in arrests and assaults of women at demonstrations in Iraq. The minister answered that the Dutch embassy in Baghdad has contact with OWFI, inquired about the case, shared information with EU partners, and that it cannot be established whether the reported incidents form a trend.
It cannot be established whether the events mentioned in the article are part of a trend or whether they concern incidents.
Het is niet vast te stellen of de in het artikel vermelde gebeurtenissen deel uitmaken van een trend of dat het hier incidenten betreft.
Vragen van het lid Ten Broeke (VVD) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over de detentie van de Egyptische blogger Maikel Nabil (ingezonden 9 september 2011).

An MP asked the foreign minister about the detention of Egyptian blogger Maikel Nabil, who was jailed after a military court conviction for insulting the army and faces retrial, and whether the government would raise the case with Egyptian authorities and support an EU version of the US Global Online Freedom Act. The minister expressed concern over restrictions on free expression, said the Netherlands opposes trying civilians in military courts, reported diplomatic raising of the case through quiet diplomacy, and described EU and Dutch steps on dual-use internet surveillance technology and an upcoming internet freedom conference.
The Netherlands is against trying civilians in military courts, because given the nature of these courts a full trial for civilians cannot be guaranteed.
Nederland is tegen berechting van burgers in militaire rechtbanken, omdat gezien de aard van deze rechtbanken een volwaardig proces voor burgers niet kan worden gewaarborgd.
Vragen van de leden Bosman en Ten Broeke (beiden VVD) aan de minister van Defensie over het bericht dat er nog steeds niet voldoende kleding voor militairen is (ingezonden 26 augustus 2011).

Two VVD MPs asked the defence minister why military clothing and equipment remained insufficient, after a union had begun distributing clothes because Defence could not. The minister acknowledged shortages, attributed them to financial problems, procurement delays and KPU company problems, and promised improvement by end 2012, though he declined to commit to a full evaluation of the KPU company for now.
Vragen van de leden Bosman en Ten Broeke (beiden VVD) aan de minister van Defensie over het artikel «Bestuur en administratie bij Defensie niet op orde» (ingezonden 17 augustus 2011).

Two VVD MPs asked the defence minister about press reports that Defence is poorly prepared for upcoming budget cuts, including claims of weak governance, backlog in personnel files, and Court of Audit concerns about business operations. The minister answered that reorganisation and an internal improvement programme are underway, that personnel file checks are behind schedule with completion expected mid-2012, and that he will report on budget cuts and operational improvements in the annual report.
In addition, I will inform you about the progress of improvements in business operations.
Daarnaast zal ik u informeren over de voortgang van de verbeteringen in de bedrijfsvoering.
Vragen van de leden De Caluwé en Ten Broeke (beiden VVD) aan de minister en de staatssecretaris van Buitenlandse Zaken over hongersnood in Oost-Afrika (ingezonden 13 juli 2011).

Two VVD MPs asked the ministers of Foreign Affairs about the famine in East Africa, the Kenyan closure of the Ifo II refugee camp, Dutch contributions to it, and whether Kenya should be pressed to open it. The state secretary answered that the crisis is severe, that Nederland contributed 500,000 euro earlier and an extra 2 million euro for UNHCR, and that the Dutch government has repeatedly urged Kenya to open the camp extension.

In addition, the Netherlands has held regular consultations in Nairobi with the Kenyan government on the refugee situation, both bilaterally and within the EU, repeatedly calling for the extension to be opened.

Daarnaast heeft Nederland in Nairobi geregeld overleg met de Keniaanse regering over de vluchtelingensituatie, zowel bilateraal als binnen EU-verband, waarbij meermaals is gepleit voor openstelling van de uitbreiding.
Vragen van de leden Nicolaï en Ten Broeke (beiden VVD) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over aantasting van de vrijheid van meningsuiting in Libanon (ingezonden 25 mei 2011).

Two VVD MPs asked the Foreign Minister about the restriction of freedom of expression in Lebanon after a World Press Photo exhibition was closed following removal of photos by an Israeli photographer. The minister agreed this was a serious infringement, said the embassy supported WPP's decision, and stated that freedom of expression is not well anchored in Lebanon.

Vragen van de leden Voordewind (ChristenUnie), Ten Broeke (VVD), De Roon (PVV) een Van der Staaij (SGP) aan de ministers van Buitenlandse Zaken en van Veiligheid en Justitie over de nieuwe Gaza-flottielje (ingezonden 21

MPs from four parties asked the foreign and justice ministers whether a Dutch charity (ISRAA) collected 100,000 euro for a new Gaza flotilla, whether an Italian partner and the Union of Good are linked, and whether this warrants reviewing participating organisations or stopping the flotilla. The government answered that Greece has banned the ships from sailing, that it cannot confirm the donation figure or the Union of Good links, and that it cannot prevent private persons or organisations from participating despite discouraging it.
I cannot make any statements about possible links with the Union of Good.
Ik kan geen mededelingen doen over mogelijke banden met de Union of Good.
Vragen van het lid Ten Broeke (VVD) aan de minister van Defensie over de problemen met het infanteriegevechtsvoertuig CV-90 (ingezonden 16 juni 2011).

An MP asked the Defence Minister about reported design flaws, fast wear, and low availability of the CV-90 armoured vehicle, including whether repair costs can be recovered from the manufacturer. The minister acknowledged a shortage of spare parts and some non-normal defects, said warranty covers manufacturer-caused damage, and promised a later update on outsourcing maintenance.

Vragen van de leden Ten Broeke (VVD), Knops (CDA) en Voordewind (ChristenUnie) aan de minister van Defensie over de dreigende sluiting van recreatiepark «OASE Hoenderloo» dat grenst aan Schietkamp Harskamp (ingezonden 8

MPs Ten Broeke, Knops and Voordewind asked the Defence Minister why Defence will not renew the ground lease of recreation park OASE Hoenderloo, which borders a shooting range, and whether it will reconsider given budget cuts and a residents' counter-proposal. The minister answers that the range's 2007 environmental permit with noise zoning restricts its operational use, that the lease ends by law in 2013 and was announced in 2008, and that there is no link to budget cuts, so no reconsideration is planned, while ongoing talks with the owners are not disrupted by direct contact with the residents' committee.
To prevent these talks with the owners from being disrupted, Defence has communicated with the residents' committee of De Oase only in writing.
Om te voorkomen dat deze gesprekken met de eigenaren worden doorkruist, heeft Defensie met de recreantencommissie van De Oase alleen schriftelijk gecommuniceerd.

Vragen van de leden Ten Broeke en Bosman (beiden VVD) aan de staatssecretaris van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie en de minister van Defensie over het bericht dat legertrucks al twee jaar vaststaan door plantjes

Two VVD MPs asked why army trucks sat for two years on a site with protected fern (blaasvaren) growing under them, and what would be done to move them. The state secretary answered that the ferns were transplanted under a Flora and Fauna Act exemption, most trucks are gone, and the remaining population will be decided after an evaluation in September.
With the Ministry of Defence it has been agreed that, before the last ferns are removed, the project plan will first be evaluated.
Met het ministerie van Defensie is de afspraak gemaakt dat, voordat de laatste varens worden verwijderd, eerst het projectplan wordt geëvalueerd.

Vragen van de leden Ten Broeke en Van Nieuwenhuizen (beiden VVD) aan de minister voor Immigratie en Asiel en de staatssecretaris van Buitenlandse Zaken over het verzoek van Eurocommissaris Malmström Eritrese vluchtelinge

Two VVD MPs asked the Immigration minister and State Secretary for Foreign Affairs whether the Netherlands would accept Eritrean refugees in North Africa proposed for EU relocation by Commissioner Malmström, and whether this made FRONTEX redundant. The government answered that resettlement would only occur within the Dutch quota with priority on regional reception and return, and that it supports regional aid through UNHCR, IOM and the Red Cross.
Only insofar as this fits within the Dutch quota for invited refugees (resettlement).
Uitsluitend voor zover dit past binnen het Nederlandse quotum voor uitgenodigde vluchtelingen (hervestiging).

Vragen van de leden Van Nieuwenhuizenen Ten Broeke(beiden VVD) aan de ministers van Buitenlandse Zaken, van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties en voor Immigratie en Asiel over Turkse kritiek op het Nederlandse imm

MPs Van Nieuwenhuizen and Ten Broeke asked the ministers about Turkish criticism of Dutch immigration and integration policy, Turkish government interference, Turkish visa fees, minority rights in Turkey, and EU accession. The government rejected the interference claims, said it raised fee reductions and minority rights with Ankara, and treated the integration issue as bilateral.
The Netherlands itself determines the integration conditions for migrants.
Nederland bepaalt zelf de integratievoorwaarden voor migranten.

Vragen van het lid Ten Broeke (VVD) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over recente uitlatingen van de Turkse premier Erdogan over de integratie van Turken in Duitsland (ingezonden 14 maart 2011).

An MP asked the foreign minister about Turkish Prime Minister Erdogan's statements urging Turks in Germany to teach their children Turkish before German, and whether the government would raise Turkish state involvement with the diaspora at EU level. The minister confirmed the statements, reiterated that integration and language learning are the individual's responsibility, said a tie to Turkey is acceptable if voluntary and lawful, and stated the cabinet disagrees with Erdogan's views and had raised integration policy with Ankara.
In this light, the Cabinet fundamentally disagrees with the said statements of Prime Minister Erdoğan.
Het Kabinet is het in dit licht ten principale oneens met genoemde uitspraken van premier Erdoğan.

Vragen van de leden Ten Broeke en Ziengs (beiden VVD) aan de minister van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie over subsidies voor innovatieve technologieën voor de Floriadetentoonstelling 2012 in Venlo (ingezonden 1

Two VVD MPs asked the minister of Economic Affairs whether subsidies for the Floriade 2012 Villa Flora office park were tied to using the most innovative climate technology, and whether an innovative heat exchanger was dropped after impossible conditions and a less innovative supplier was chosen. The minister confirmed the contractor chose another supplier on its own assessment, said the national Unique Opportunities subsidy (EUR 500,000) does not require the most innovative technologies but only an energy performance target, and left the regional subsidies to the region's own responsibility.
As for the subsidies granted by the municipalities and the province, I would note that the region has its own responsibility to deploy the financial resources effectively.

Voor wat betreft de subsidieverlening van de gemeenten en provincie wil ik opmerken dat de regio hierin haar eigen verantwoordelijkheid heeft om de financiële middelen op een effectieve manier in te zetten.

Vragen van de leden Harbers en Ten Broeke (beiden VVD) aan de minister van Financiën over het artikel «Nederlandse staatsschuld hoger door lening aan Ieren» en het persbericht «The statistical recording of operations und

Two VVD MPs asked the finance minister whether Eurostat's proportional recording of EFSF loans in member states' gross debt, which raises the Dutch debt by up to about 2 percent of GDP, would force Dutch consolidation under the Stability and Growth Pact and would disadvantage contributing countries. The minister confirmed the recording, said the 60 percent debt rule is applied to gross debt but that EFSF claims will be taken into account, so no forced measures follow, and said an arrangement on this has been agreed.
Member states will therefore not be forced under the SGP to take additional measures to reduce their debt.
Lidstaten zullen dan ook niet op basis van het SGP gedwongen worden om extra maatregelen te nemen om hun schuld terug te brengen.
Vragen van het lid Ten Broeke (VVD) aan de minister en staatssecretaris van Buitenlandse Zaken over toetreding Bulgarije en Roemenie tot de Schengen Zone (ingezonden 24 december 2010).

MP Ten Broeke asked the government about Bulgarian demands for Schengen accession and the Franco-German view that Bulgaria and Romania are not yet ready, citing corruption and organised crime concerns under the CVM. The minister confirmed awareness, said the CVM reports will inform the assessment, noted disappointing progress, and agreed it is too early for accession.

The cabinet will take the European Commission's reports on both countries' progress under the Cooperation and Verification Mechanism (CVM) into account when assessing their readiness for Schengen accession.

Het kabinet zal bij de beoordeling van de gereedheid van Bulgarije en Roemenië voor toetreding tot Schengen de rapportages van de Europese Commissie over de voortgang van beide landen in het kader van het Coöperatie en verificatie mechanisme (CVM) betrekken.
Vragen van het lid Ten Broeke (VVD) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over de Mediawet in Hongarije (ingezonden 23 december 2010).

An MP asks the Foreign Minister about Hungary's new media law, which creates a Media Authority able to fine journalists for non-objective reporting, the OSCE's criticism of restrictions on press freedom, and the new financial-sector taxes affecting foreign investors. The government confirms awareness, says press freedom is fundamental and that Hungary would be addressed if the law conflicts with European rules, notes Hungary's promise to amend it if needed, and says the Commission and member states are responsible for enforcement.
If the new Media Act in Hungary is indeed in conflict with European regulations or the ECHR, Hungary will be called to account for it.
Als de nieuwe Mediawet in Hongarije inderdaad strijdig is met de Europese regelgeving of het EVRM dan zal Hongarije hierop aangesproken worden.
Vragen van de leden Ten Broeke en Hennis-Plasschaert (beiden VVD) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over de verkiezingen in Wit-Rusland (ingezonden 23 december 2010).

VVD MPs asked the Foreign Minister about the arrests of opposition candidates, journalists and activists after Belarus's December 2010 election, the reported unfair vote and violence, and what the government would do. The minister condemned the election and arrests, called for release of detainees, and said he asked the EU to consider reimposing a travel ban and to formulate further steps.

Vragen van de leden Ziengs en Ten Broeke (beiden VVD) aan de ministers van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie en van Buitenlandse Zaken over het feit dat de Europese aanbesteding voor politievoertuigen slechts één

MPs Ziengs and Ten Broeke asked why a European tender for police vehicles drew only one bidder per lot, and whether clustering the contracts was desirable. The minister explained that cost savings motivated the clustering, that a market consultation showed sufficient competition, and that the government will tighten rules on clustering in the new Aanbestedingswet.
The bill for a new Public Procurement Act already contains a number of important elements that improve small businesses' access to tenders.
Het wetsvoorstel voor een nieuwe Aanbestedingswet bevat reeds een aantal belangrijke elementen die de toegang van kleine ondernemers bij aanbestedingen verbetert.

Vragen van de leden Van Nieuwenhuizen en Ten Broeke (beiden VVD) aan de ministers voor Immigratie en Asiel en van Buitenlandse Zaken over het uitstel van toetreding van Roemenië en Bulgarije tot het Schengen-verdrag (ing

Two VVD MPs asked the ministers whether Romania and Bulgaria were ready for Schengen accession in 2011, given shortcomings in EU reports on organised crime, corruption and border control, and whether the Netherlands would press with France for a delay and a structural link to the Cooperation and Verification Mechanism. The government answered that it would seek to delay accession until the Commission's summer 2011 report and tie approval to strict criteria, while judging a legal link to the CVM unfeasible and planning to oppose new CVMs for future entrants.
The Netherlands will work to ensure that new EU entrants are not again subject to a CVM like the one now in place for Bulgaria and Romania.
Nederland zal zich ervoor inzetten dat voor nieuwe EU-toetreders niet opnieuw een CVM, zoals dat nu bestaat voor Bulgarije en Roemenië, worden ingesteld
Vragen van het lid Ten Broeke (VVD) aan de staatssecretaris van Buitenlandse Zaken over geheim overleg met Turkije (ingezonden 11 november 2010).

The MP asks the State Secretary whether the Commission held secret talks with Turkey on opening frozen EU accession negotiation chapters, and whether any concession on the Ankara Protocol is possible. The Minister answers that Turkey must implement the Ankara Protocol, that the Commission recommends keeping the 2006 freezing measures, and that the Commission's confidential contacts are understood as part of its role.
The cabinet has understanding for the sometimes confidential character within which the European Commission operates in this respect.
Het kabinet heeft begrip voor het soms vertrouwelijke karakter waarbinnen de Europese Commissie in dit opzicht opereert.

MPs from several parties asked the Minister of Foreign Affairs about excessive director salaries at development organisation SNV, how the government will recover the excess against subsidies, whether other non-MFS organisations also pay above the cap, and whether a salary ceiling will be enforced. Established differences between director salaries and the DG norm can be settled afterwards against the subsidy fixed afterwards for a given year.
Vastgestelde verschillen tussen directiesalarissen en de DG-norm kunnen achteraf worden verrekend met de eveneens achteraf vastgestelde subsidie over een bepaald jaar.

Two VVD MPs asked why unspent EU agricultural money would be redirected to the ITER fusion project, and whether this breaches earlier agreements. Vragen van het lid Ten Broeke (VVD) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over de kosten van een verblijfsvergunning voor Nederlanders in Turkije (ingezonden 20 augustus 2010).

An MP asked the foreign minister why Dutch nationals in Turkey pay much higher residence-permit fees than nationals of other EU states such as Belgium and Germany, and whether Turkey should be pressed to treat EU citizens equally. The minister confirmed the fee differences are based on reciprocity, said the appeal against the Rotterdam court ruling is pending, and said the Netherlands is in talks with Turkish authorities about the fees Turkey levies.

The minister replied that the interpreters' contracts run through NATO's NAMSA, that about 50 have been placed with the CTU and 20 with the RDTF, that a new contract runs to 1 December 2010, and that the Netherlands will work for continued employment after redeployment.
The new call-off contract the Netherlands has concluded with NAMSA runs until 1 December 2010 and will be extended if necessary.
Het nieuwe afroepcontract dat Nederland heeft gesloten met NAMSA loopt tot 1 december 2010 en zal indien nodig worden verlengd.

Dit is ook niet de insteek van de Kaderprogramma's voor onderzoek en technologische ontwikkeling.

De veroordeling van het homostel heeft vooralsnog geen consequenties voor de hulp van de Europese Commissie aan Malawi.

Asks the government to draw up a plan to tackle illegal trade in exotic animal species and curb their import.
requests the government to draw up a plan of action to tackle the illegal trade in exotic animal species
verzoekt de regering een plan van aanpak op te stellen om de illegale handel in uitheemse diersoorten aan te pakken

Asks the government to send the House the communication plan and evaluation design, and any results, of the publicly co-financed 'Jij kan kiezen' campaign.
requests the government to send the communication plan of the 'Jij kan kiezen' campaign, with the evaluation design and any results, to the House

requests the government to undo the Ormel amendment by including article 60 in the Animal Health and Welfare Act

Asks the government to draw up a plan for expanding cultivation of protein crops.
requests the government together with agricultural partners to draw up a plan for further development and expansion of protein crop cultivation

requests the government to no longer hold trade missions aimed at promoting and/or selling animal products

requests the government to heed this call and at least double efforts to conserve biodiversity

Amendement van de leden Ouwehand en Thieme om extra budget te reserveren voor onderzoek naar de mogelijk de aanvullend te beschermen gebieden op de Noordzee

to reserve extra budget for research into possibly additional protected areas in the North Sea

in article 25 Food quality and animal health the commitment and expenditure amounts are reduced by 240 thousand euro

to reserve budget for the replacement, reduction and refinement of animal testing

Shifts budget within the agriculture budget from consumer information on food to consumer information promoting more plant-based protein.
Amendement van de leden Thieme en Ouwehand over ondersteuning van intensieve veehouders die willen omschakelen naar een biologische veehouderij- of akkerbouwbedrijf
Shifts funds from the intensive livestock subsidies to support intensive farmers converting to organic farming.
This amendment aims to reserve budget to support agricultural entrepreneurs in switching to organic farming.
Dit amendement strekt ertoe budget te reserveren om agrarische ondernemers te ondersteunen in de omschakeling naar biologische landbouw.
Amendement van de leden Thieme en Ouwehand om het budget voor ontwikkeling en stimulering dierenwelzijn te koppelen aan het aantal productiedieren in Nederland
Links the animal welfare budget to the number of production animals, raising it by 50 million euro.
aims to link the budget for developing and stimulating animal welfare to the number of production animals in the Netherlands
strekt ertoe het budget voor de ontwikkeling en stimulering van dierenwelzijn te koppelen aan het aantal productiedieren in Nederland
Amendement van de leden Thieme Ouwehand om budget te reserveren voor de vervanging, vermindering en verfijning van dierproeven
Reallocates a small budget amount from the animal-health subsidy line to fund replacement, reduction and refinement of animal testing.
This amendment aims to reserve budget for the replacement, reduction and refinement of animal testing.
Dit amendement strekt ertoe budget te reserveren voor de vervanging, vermindering en verfijning van dierproeven.
Amendement van de leden Thieme en Ouwehand om de subsidie voor luchtwassers af te schaffen en deze middelen in te zetten voor krimp van de veestapel en diervriendelijke veehouderijen
Moves agricultural budget from the subsidy for air scrubbers to shrinking the livestock herd and animal-friendly farming systems.
The amendment aims to abolish the subsidy for air scrubbers and use the freed funds for the intended purposes
Het amendement beoogt de subsidie op luchtwassers af te schaffen en de daarbij vrijkomende middelen in te zetten
Amendement van de leden Thieme en Ouwehand over uitbreiding taken AID voor controle op naleving dierenwelzijnseisen en controle
Shifts budget from destruction funds to the Algemene Inspectiedienst to expand animal welfare and illegal wildlife trade inspections.
use part of the reserved destruction budget to expand the capacity of the General Inspection Service (AID)

Dit amendement strekt ertoe budget te reserveren voor de structurele financiële ondersteuning van dierenasielen en dierenambulances

financial resources for animal welfare cannot be spent on other matters during the budget year
financiële middelen voor dierenwelzijn tijdens het begrotingsjaar niet aan andere zaken besteed kunnen worden

to reserve budget for the replacement, reduction and refinement of animal testing

qa: Antwoord op vragen van de leden Thieme en Ouwehand over de Amazonebranden en de westerse verantwoordelijkheid bij de branden

MPs Thieme and Ouwehand asked the government whether Amazon fires are human-caused, whether the EU-Mercosur trade deal incentivises deforestation, and whether Dutch firms and trade partners should face sanctions or procurement exclusion. The minister replied that the fires are likely set deliberately, pointed to Brazil's primary responsibility, promised diplomatic pressure within the EU-Mercosur process, and said the Dutch government does not support the soy corridor while the procurement exclusion of named firms is not legally straightforward, so it will only explore aligning procurement with OECD guidelines.
Excluding parties from public procurement is not straightforwardly legally possible.
Het uitsluiten van partijen van overheidsaanbestedingen is niet zonder meer juridisch mogelijk.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Thieme en Van Kooten-Arissen over het bericht ‘Staatsbosbeheer wil duidelijker bosbeleid van minister’

MPs Thieme and Van Kooten-Arissen asked the minister about Staatsbosbeheer's timber harvesting, nesting-bird protection during felling, net CO2 effects of forest loss, biomass burning and EU carbon-neutral treatment. The minister answered that harvesting is limited to regular management and calamities, that surveys precede felling under the code of conduct, and that biomass is treated as carbon-neutral under international rules, with a forest strategy to follow.
However, the forest strategy I am developing together with the provinces will also address forest management and the questions that arise.
Wel zal bij het maken van de bossenstrategie, die ik samen met de provincies ga ontwikkelen, ook worden ingegaan op het beheer van bossen en de vragen die daarbij spelen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Thieme over het bericht dat de Duitse regering bij alle officiële gelegenheden vegetarisch zal eten

An MP from the Party for the Animals asked the government whether it would follow Germany in serving vegetarian food at official events, and whether it would act on climate-friendly food choices and nudging concepts. The Minister of Agriculture replied that food production contributes to emissions, that government catering sustainability is already being promoted through procurement and projects, that a proposal to drop meat at all official catering goes too far, and that the government will continue its sustainable food policy as set out in the Paris-linked climate and food reduction targets.
The suggestion to offer no meat at all government catering unless specifically requested goes too far for the cabinet.
De suggestie om bij alle overheidscatering geen vlees meer aan te bieden, tenzij daar specifiek om gevraagd wordt, gaat het kabinet te ver.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Thieme over het bericht 'Weisglas maakt einde aan parlementaire BBQ'

An MP asked the Prime Minister whether the renaming of the 'parlementaire BBQ' to 'Binnenhof BBQ' and the meat-industry lobby event at Nieuwspoort create an appearance of ties between government, parliament and the meat sector, and asked for consequences. The government answered that the event is initiated by two meat-sector organisations at the press centre Nieuwspoort, which decides on its own terms, and that the cabinet is not involved; any parliamentary position is for the House itself.
The press centre itself determines to whom and on what conditions it makes facilities available. The cabinet is not involved in this.
Het perscentrum bepaalt zelf aan wie en op welke voorwaarden zij faciliteiten ter beschikking stelt. Het kabinet is hierbij niet betrokken.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma, Ten Broeke, Voordewind, Van Nispen, Van Ojik, Thieme, Baudet, Kuzu, Van de Hul en Knops over het bericht dat de Nederlandse overheid grote steken heeft laten vallen in het verle

MPs from many parties asked the ministers of Foreign Affairs and Justice whether the Dutch government failed to assist Mr Singh, a Dutch national imprisoned in the US for 33 years, including over consular visits, a transfer request and the handling of his case. The government rejects the picture of failure, says it cannot intervene in foreign justice, explains that transfer was refused on legal grounds and pledges continued support for parole and review requests.
The ministries of Foreign Affairs and Justice and Security do not recognise that picture.
De ministeries van Buitenlandse Zaken en Justitie en Veiligheid herkennen zich niet in dat beeld.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma, Voordewind, Karabulut, Van Ojik, Van der Staaij en Thieme over het referendum over onafhankelijkheid voor Iraaks Koerdistan

Six MPs asked whether the independent international law adviser should assess whether Iraqi Kurdistan meets the Montevideo criteria for statehood in light of its independence referendum, and how the government interprets such advice. The answer states that the questions were answered in a separate letter ('Situatie Koerdische regio') to parliament, so no substantive reply is given in this document.

The written questions from MPs Sjoerdsma, Voordewind, Karabulut, Van Ojik, Van der Staaij and Thieme, question number 2017Z12850, have been answered by means of the letter 'Situation in the Kurdish region'.

Mededeling De schriftelijke vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma (D66), Voordewind (ChristenUnie), Karabulut (SP), Van Ojik (GroenLinks), Van der Staaij (SGP) en Thieme (PvdD), vraagnummer 2017Z12850 , zijn beantwoord middels de brief «Situatie Koerdische regio» (Kamerstuk 32 623, nr.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Thieme over een veetransport naar West-Siberië

An MP asked the government about a planned road transport of around 5,000 dairy cows from the Netherlands and Germany to West Siberia, and whether it complies with EU animal transport rules. The government answered that the NVWA is not aware the transport is ordered by Danone, that a travel plan must be assessed before approval, pregnant animals are restricted, and that no permanent veterinary supervision can be enforced outside the EU.
The NVWA supervises the planning and, prior to transport, the conditions under which such transports take place.
De NVWA ziet toe op de planning en voorafgaand aan het transport op de condities waaronder dergelijke transporten plaatsvinden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Karabulut, Thieme en Van den Hul over een ter dood veroordeelde Amerikaan

MPs asked the minister whether he knows of claims that US inmate Clinton Lee Young was wrongly convicted and whether the government will contact the Texas governor to seek a stay of execution. The minister confirmed awareness, restated Dutch opposition to the death penalty, and said the EU ambassador and the Dutch ambassador in Washington will write to the Texas governor expressing objections.
In this case too, the European objections will be conveyed by a letter from the EU ambassador in Washington to the governor of Texas.
Ook in dit geval zullen de Europese bezwaren door middel van een brief van de EU-ambassadeur in Washington aan de gouverneur van Texas kenbaar gemaakt worden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Staaij, Thieme, Ten Broeke, Voordewind, Knops, Karabulut en Van Rooijen over repressieve maatregelen tegen de oppositie door de regering van Wit-Rusland

Six MPs asked the Foreign Minister about repressive measures against the opposition in Belarus, including arrests of demonstrators and Christian Democrat leaders around the 25 March protest. The minister said the Belarusian authorities' measures were disproportionate, that Nederland raised concerns via EU statements and with the Belarusian ambassador, and that the issue was discussed in the OSCE Permanent Council.
In the cabinet's view, the measures of the Belarusian authorities are not proportionate.
De maatregelen van de Wit-Russische autoriteiten zijn in de ogen van het kabinet niet proportioneel.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Thieme over uitspraken van de minister in de Frankfurter Allgemeine Zeitung van 19 maart 2017

MP Thieme asks the Finance Minister whether he said eurozone crisis states should not have spent their money on women and drink before seeking help, and questions the factual basis and moral responsibility of such a remark. The minister denies the quote is accurate, gives the correct German text stressing solidarity with obligations, and calls the link to programme countries unfortunate, neither said nor meant.
It is very unfortunate that a link was made with the mentioned programme countries; I neither said nor meant this.
Het is zeer onfortuinlijk dat er een link is gelegd met de genoemde programmalanden, dit heb ik noch zo gezegd noch zo bedoeld.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Thieme over het extreem doorfokken van dieren in de vee-industrie voor verhoogde productie

MP Thieme asks the State Secretary for Economic Affairs how the government will respond to reports that breeding in the livestock sector is pushing poultry, pigs and cattle toward extreme productivity at the cost of welfare, and whether the government will set limits on production per animal. The State Secretary calls such a direction undesirable, points to market-driven breeding programmes and existing sector initiatives, refers to earlier letters for the advisory body question, and says sector parties are primarily responsible while stronger government intervention could follow if results are insufficient.
I expect the parties involved in the chain to take concrete steps to tackle the problems you have identified and improve animal welfare. They are primarily responsible for this.
Ik verwacht van betrokken partijen in de keten concrete stappen om de door u gesignaleerde problemen tegen te gaan en dierenwelzijn te verbeteren. Zij zijn daarvoor primair verantwoordelijk.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Thieme over de mishandeling en verwaarlozing van nertsen op fokkerijen

An MP asks the government about cruelty and neglect of mink on fur farms in Alphen aan den Rijn, including the NVWA's inspection history, whether the farms should be closed, when information on individual farm inspections will be published, and the status of a proposed ban on keeping animals after cruelty. The state secretary reports few past inspections with minor findings, commits to continued NVWA inspections in 2017, and promises a framework note on the animal-keeping ban before 1 April.
If violations are found, the NVWA will take appropriate enforcement action.
Als er overtredingen worden vastgesteld, dan zal de NVWA op passende wijze tot handhaven overgaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Thieme over uit de lucht geschoten zeldzame zeearend

An MP asked the state secretary and justice minister about a rare white-tailed eagle shot in Friesland, including whether a hunter could mistake it for a goose, whether prosecution and ballistic evidence were pursued, whether a reward was considered, and whether enforcement against raptor persecution is adequate. The government said police did not make the claimed statement, that a criminal investigation under the Public Prosecution Service is ongoing and it cannot comment further, that a reward was not considered because the offence does not qualify, and that oversight of hunting rules is sufficient though incidents cannot always be prevented.
Because this investigation is still ongoing, I cannot make any further statements about it.
Omdat dit onderzoek nog gaande is, kan ik daar geen verdere mededelingen over doen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Thieme over mensonterende omstandigheden bij de teelt van koffie in Brazilië

MP Thieme asked the minister about reports of slavery-like conditions, child labour, hazardous pesticides and lack of drinking water in Brazilian coffee cultivation, and whether Dutch coffee buyers such as Nestlé and Douwe Egberts were implicated. The minister acknowledged the concerns, relied on due diligence expectations, voluntary IMVO agreements and support for IDH and Solidaridad projects, and said legislation could be considered if voluntary agreements prove insufficient.
In case those agreements lead to insufficient results, other avenues can be considered, including legislation.
In het geval dat die afspraken tot onvoldoende resultaten leiden, kunnen andere wegen worden overwogen, waaronder wetgeving.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Thieme over het Apache ongeluk in Mali

An MP asked the Defence Minister whether the government knew of contamination of hydraulic fluid in the AH-64D Apache control system before the fatal Mali crash, and whether that caused the crash. The minister confirmed awareness of the US findings, said both incidents involved the same component but the Dutch failure had a different technical cause, and stated that Dutch ground equipment and fluid testing showed no shortcomings.
At the time, Defence examined whether the Dutch ground equipment met the requirements and whether the hydraulic fluid was periodically tested and analysed.
Destijds heeft Defensie onderzocht of de Nederlandse gronduitrusting voldeed aan de eisen en of de hydraulische vloeistof periodiek werd getest en geanalyseerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Voordewind, Recourt, Gesthuizen, Sjoerdsma, Voortman, Van der Staaij en Thieme over uitlevering van verdachten aan Rwanda

MPs asked the Minister of Justice whether the extradition of two Rwandan-national suspects should be reconsidered in light of testimony from Witteveen about Rwandan courts, fair-trial risks and the Bandora case, and whether a broader extradition inquiry should be conducted. The minister refused to revisit the decision, stating Witteveen's findings were already weighed, the Court of Appeal found no real fair-trial risk, and the two men were extradited on 12 November 2016.
I see no reason to revisit the decision regarding the extradition.
Ik zie geen aanleiding om de beslissing ten aanzien van de uitlevering te herzien.
Antwoord op vragen van lid Thieme over de ophokplicht en de dreigende vogelgriep

An MP asks the state secretary about animal welfare under the mandatory housing order for poultry, the risk of zoonoses from dense farming, the structure of the poultry sector since 2003, and additional measures against bird flu. The state secretary answers that housing meets EU rules, sets up a welfare commission, reports that the sector has grown in animal numbers per farm while total poultry stayed stable, and notes that bird flu risk cannot be reduced to zero.
Since measures have been taken regarding housing, I set up the welfare commission on 18 November.
Aangezien er maatregelen zijn ingesteld op het gebied van huisvesting, heb ik op 18 november jl. de welzijnscommissie ingesteld.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Maij, Ten Broeke, Van Bommel, Verhoeven, Grashoff, Voordewind en Thieme over het bericht dat EU-Turkijerapporteur Kati Piri wordt geweerd uit Turkije

MPs asked the Foreign Minister whether Turkey had barred EP Turkey rapporteur Kati Piri from entering the country, what reasons were given, and what the government was doing to secure her access and support her criticism of arrests of HDP parliamentarians. The minister confirmed the report, referred to an earlier letter, said Turkey had cancelled her scheduled meetings rather than denying entry, and stated the Turkish reasons were unknown while promising to keep raising the issue with Turkey.

The matter is primarily a matter between the European Parliament and Turkey, but the Netherlands will continue to bring to the attention of the Turkish authorities the importance of dialogue with the EP and access for its rapporteurs.

De kwestie is primair een zaak tussen het Europees parlement en Turkije, maar Nederland zal het belang van een dialoog met het EP en de toegang van haar Rapporteurs bij de Turkse autoriteiten onder de aandacht blijven brengen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Thieme over het onterecht afschieten van reeën op Terschelling

An MP asked the state secretary about the expulsion of a whistleblower from a wildlife management unit on Terschelling after reporting unlawful deer culling, and whether this undermines the law and the role of such units. The state secretary said the board decides on membership, that the province must supervise the conditions of exemptions, and saw no reason for central intervention in provincial culling permits.
It is up to the province to supervise this and, if it deems it necessary, to intervene.
Het is aan de provincie om daar op toe te zien en, indien zij dat nodig acht, in te grijpen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma, Servaes, Van Bommel, Voordewind, Grashoff, Thieme en Öztürk over deelname aan onderhandelingen over een internationaal verbod op kernwapens

MPs from several parties asked the Foreign Minister why the Netherlands opposed paragraph 67 of the OEWG report recommending negotiations on a nuclear weapons ban, whether it would support the UNGA resolution to negotiate such a ban in 2017, and whether it would take part in the conference. The answer refers to a separate letter ('Onderhandelingen over een internationaal verbod op kernwapens') rather than answering the questions in this document.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Thieme over het binden van handelsconsequenties aan de dolfijnslachtingen en illegale walvisvangst door Japan

The MP Thieme asks whether the government will make an end to Japanese dolphin slaughter in Taiji and illegal whaling a condition in EU trade and partnership negotiations with Japan, and how the minister will act on this during a trade mission. The minister answers that the government opposes dolphin slaughter and all whaling, will state this at the IWC meeting, and supports the Commission's push to address the issue in a sustainability chapter of the trade deal rather than linking it as a formal condition.
The cabinet supports this approach of the European Commission.
Het kabinet steunt deze inzet van de Europese Commissie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Thieme over het opnieuw onterecht afschieten van beschermde dieren op Terschelling

An MP asked whether the province of Friesland permits culling of protected roe deer on Terschelling without meeting the legal necessity test of the Flora- and faunawet, and whether this repeats fact-free wildlife policy after a Council of State ruling on rabbits. The State Secretary replied that the province granted an exemption on public-safety and crop-damage grounds under an approved management plan, that he sees no fact-free policy, and that the province says the Terschelling culling falls outside the exemption's scope and it will prevent recurrence.

The province of Friesland has indicated that the culling of roe deer as carried out on Terschelling by the Wildbeheereenheid does not fall within the purpose and conditions for which the exemption was granted.

De provincie Friesland heeft laten weten dat de afschot van reeën zoals dat op Terschelling door de Wildbeheereenheid is uitgevoerd, niet valt binnen het doel en de voorwaarden waarvoor de ontheffing is verstrekt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Thieme over het onterecht toestaan van het afschieten van damherten door de provincie Zeeland

An MP from the Party for the Animals asked the State Secretary for Economic Affairs how he views the court annulment of Zeeland's permit for culling fallow deer, whether protected-species culls are being authorised without the statutory public-interest test, and whether decentralising fauna policy to provinces risks unequal treatment. The State Secretary answered that the court ruling is for the province to follow up, that provincial executives decide culls under the Flora and Fauna Act and the forthcoming Nature Conservation Act with appeal to the courts open, and that some inter-provincial variation is an intended effect of decentralisation, subject to national frameworks.
It is up to the province of Zeeland to act on the court's ruling.
Het is aan de provincie Zeeland om gevolg te geven aan de uitspraak van de rechtbank.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Thieme over de landelijke uitbraak van een dodelijke konijnenziekte

An MP asked the state secretary about the nationwide RHDV2 rabbit disease outbreak, its expected impact on wild rabbit populations, and whether rabbit hunting should be halted. The state secretary acknowledged the concern, expected populations to recover based on expert judgement, and declined to list rabbits as threatened or close hunting for now, while promising ongoing monitoring.
Therefore there is currently no urgent reason to proceed to closing the hunt for rabbits.
Derhalve is er thans geen dringende reden over te gaan tot sluiting van de jacht op het konijn.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bergkamp, Sjoerdsma, Recourt, Van Nispen, Van Tongeren, Thieme, Van Klaveren, Krol, Houwers en Klein over de brief van een Nederlandse politieliaison in Thailand aan de Thaise autoriteiten

MPs asked the ministers about a 14 July 2014 letter from a Dutch liaison officer in Thailand requesting that Thai authorities open their own investigation into Van Laarhoven, and whether the Dutch government bears responsibility for his Thai prosecution. The minister answered that the request was made at the public prosecutor's request to speed up mutual legal assistance, that the courts found the state's conduct lawful, that consular assistance is provided, and that the prosecutor decides on instruments such as a transfer.
In general, cooperation with foreign authorities is not unusual when a suspect is located in another country.
In zijn algemeenheid is het niet ongebruikelijk dat samenwerking plaatsvindt met buitenlandse autoriteiten indien een verdachte zich in een ander land bevindt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Thieme over de dode dieren bij de brand van een pluimveebedrijf in het Drentse Orvelte

An MP asked about 15,000 chickens killed in a barn fire in Orvelte, including whether fire prevention in existing barns is adequate, whether asbestos roofs should be removed faster, and how many animals died in barn fires in 2015. The Secretary of State says the barns date from the 1970s, municipal inspections found nothing, the cause is under investigation, the fire-prevention action plan will be evaluated in early 2017, and the asbestos-roof removal goal is 2024 with a subsidy scheme and a versnellingsaanpak; he refers to an earlier report for the 2015 animal death figures.
I will take the outcomes of this investigation into account in the barn fire action plan.
Ik zal de uitkomsten van dit onderzoek meenemen in het actieplan stalbranden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Thieme over een nieuwe vondst van het hepatitis E-virus op Nederlandse leverworst en paté

An MP from the Party for the Animals asked the minister whether leverworst and paté containing hepatitis E should be withdrawn from sale, labelled, or subject to systematic testing and a reporting duty for farms and slaughterhouses. The minister refused withdrawal and labelling because the risk to the general population is very low, announced a nutrition advice for high-risk patients and ongoing NVWA testing, and declined a reporting duty.
I see no reason to withdraw leverworst and paté from sale or to take additional labelling measures for these pork products.
Ik zie geen aanleiding voor het uit de handel halen van leverworst en paté of aanvullende maatregelen voor het etiketteren van deze varkensvleesproducten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Thieme over de verwaarlozing van dieren in Caribisch Nederland (Herdruk)

An MP asked the State Secretary for Economic Affairs about animal neglect and roaming livestock on Sint Eustatius, including a petition by 500 residents and whether the local government had failed to act. The government answered that the island government is taking steps (2014 project funding, July 2016 bylaw changes, preventive measures) and that animal neglect is primarily the island government's responsibility, so a meeting is not currently needed.
Animal neglect is primarily the responsibility of the Public Body of Sint Eustatius, and given the steps the local government has taken, a meeting is not currently on the agenda.
Verwaarlozing van dieren is primair de verantwoordelijkheid van het Openbaar Lichaam Sint Eustatius en gezien de stappen die de lokale overheid heeft gezet, is een gesprek nu niet aan de orde.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jasper van Dijk en Thieme over het informeren van de Kamer over de ambities inzake TAFTA

MPs Van Dijk and Thieme asked why the government did not inform parliament about its ambitions for TAFTA/TTIP, including full liberalisation and the claim that failure was not an option. The minister replied that parliament was kept informed through regular letters and committee debates on the Dutch position, and that the Commission now proposes CETA as a mixed agreement, which meets the Dutch demand.
The House was informed of the Dutch position through the usual methods.
De Kamer is volgens de gebruikelijke methodes geïnformeerd over de Nederlandse inzet.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Bommel, Ten Broeke, Thieme en Van der Staaij over de arrestatie van een mensenrechtenactivist in Bahrein

Four MPs asked the Foreign Minister about the arrest of human rights activist Nabeel Rajab in Bahrain, its charge, and whether the government would raise it with Bahrain. The minister confirmed the arrest on the charge of spreading false news, said the government finds the repression very concerning, and said the EU will make a demarche in Manama seeking clarification.
The European Union will shortly make a demarche in Manama to the Bahraini authorities to raise the recent pressure on human rights defenders and the opposition.
De Europese Unie zal op korte termijn in Manama een demarche uitvoeren bij de Bahreinse autoriteiten om de recente druk op mensenrechtenverdedigers en de oppositie aan te kaarten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Thieme over de noodzaak tot het verduurzamen van voedsel, mede via prijsprikkels

An MP from the Party for the Animals asks whether the government will act on an international panel's call for sustainable food systems, including pricing externalities via taxes, ending subsidies for unsustainable production, and a national awareness campaign. The state secretary agrees the government has a role, says true-pricing research is underway with results due in late 2016, rejects broadening taxation for now, and points to existing awareness efforts by other bodies and schools.
The cabinet is not in favour of broadening the instrumental use of taxation at this time.
Het kabinet is geen voorstander om het instrumentele gebruik van belastingheffing op dit moment te verbreden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Thieme over de omstreden komst van een gigastal voor 5.100 geiten

An MP asked whether the municipality of Maasdriel would involve the council in a permit for a 5,100-goat stal, whether a family link to a CDA leader raises integrity concerns, and whether the government would act on Q-fever risks and impose a moratorium. The State Secretary answered that the municipality decides on the permit and bestemmingsplan, family ties play no role, the GGD gave a positive advice, and no moratorium is planned, pointing to earlier answers.
The municipality will make a substantive judgment on this application, in which family relationships play no role.
De gemeente zal een inhoudelijk oordeel vellen over deze aanvraag, waarbij familierelaties geen rol spelen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Thieme en Van Dekken over de risico’s voor de volksgezondheid die de groei van de melkveestapel met zich mee brengt en heeft gebracht

MPs Thieme and Van Dekken asked whether growing dairy herds and farm sizes pose public health risks, including infectious disease and Streptococcus agalactiae, and whether hard caps on cow numbers should be set. The minister answered that farm size is only one factor among many, that no link to S. agalactiae in humans is established, that the VGO study on livestock and resident health will report before summer, and that no hard caps are planned.
A possible link between livestock farming and public health, however, I take very seriously.
Een mogelijk verband tussen veehouderijen en volksgezondheid neem ik echter zeer serieus.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Thieme over de wettelijke overtredingen op paardenmarkten

An MP asked the state secretary of Economic Affairs about repeated animal welfare violations at horse markets (Zuidlaren), the Protocol Welfare Horse Markets, whether horse trade should be banned, municipal payments to traders, and disease spread. The state secretary said the sector and municipalities must ensure welfare, asked the Animal Affairs Council to update the protocol, rejected a ban, and said disease was not a designated notifiable disease.
I am of the view that the parties involved must themselves be able to guarantee the welfare of the animals.
Ik ben van mening dat de betrokken partijen zelf in staat moeten zijn om het welzijn van de dieren te waarborgen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Thieme over aanhoudende misstanden rondom zwanendrifters in het Groene Hart

MP Thieme asked the State Secretary for Economic Affairs and the Minister of Security and Justice about persistent abuses in swan herding (zwanendrifters) in the Groene Hart, including whether convicted offenders should lose hunting permits, protection for the complainant, and a ban on collecting swan eggs for commercial purposes. The government answered that the police chief decides on withdrawing permits, that police increased surveillance around the complainant's home, and that egg collection is allowed only for damage control under provincial permit, while hatching and selling swans is not permitted.
It is up to the chief of police to decide on any withdrawal of hunting permits he has granted when violations of the Flora and Fauna Act are established.
Het is aan de korpschef van politie om te beslissen over een eventuele intrekking van door hem verleende jachtakten bij geconstateerde overtredingen van de Flora- en faunawet.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Thieme over het bericht “Toenemende sterfte van biggen”

MP Thieme asked the State Secretary for Economic Affairs about rising piglet mortality, the reliability of Varkens in Nood and Agrovision data, the failure of the Stuurgroep Bigvitaliteit plan, and whether breeding for more piglets per sow should end. The State Secretary largely referred to the standvanzakenbrief on animal welfare and to earlier answers, and said the stuurgroep's latest results were recently added to the website.
No figures are known on the killing of animals at primary farms by non-veterinarians.
Over het voorkomen van het doden van dieren op het primaire bedrijf door niet-dierenartsen zijn geen cijfers bekend.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Laar, Jasper van Dijk, Van Veldhoven, Voordewind, Grashoff, Dijkgraaf, Thieme over het gebrek aan bescherming van Syrische kinderen

MPs from several parties asked the ministers about the lack of protection for Syrian children, including the petition and reports by UNICEF, Save the Children, War Child and World Vision, and what the Netherlands does on education, psychosocial aid and school protection. The minister answered that Dutch funding for education and psychosocial support in Syria and neighbouring countries is ongoing, that it supports the call to honour pledges, and that it will raise school protection and MHPSS at the EU and World Humanitarian Summit, but gave few figures on outcomes and no new binding commitments.
The Netherlands is working within international frameworks to ensure that the pledges are also honoured.
Nederland zet zich in internationaal verband in om ervoor te zorgen dat de toezeggingen ook worden nagekomen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Thieme over een jager die ongeboren reekalfjes uit moeder snijdt

An MP asked whether a certified hunter who shot a pregnant roe doe and removed the unborn fawns should be prosecuted, and whether a general ban on shooting protected animals during gestation is planned. The State Secretary answered that the shooting was lawful under a provincial exemption within the permitted February-March season, no report was drawn up, and no general ban is planned, while acknowledging that shooting suckling does is undesirable.

Inquiries with the national police and the Faunabeheereenheid Noord-Brabant showed there was no poaching, but that the roe doe was shot by a certified hunter acting in accordance with the conditions of the exemption granted by the Noord-Brabant provincial executive.

Uit navraag bij de Nationale politie en de Faunabeheereenheid Noord-Brabant, is gebleken dat hier geen sprake is van stroperij, maar dat de reegeit is geschoten door een gecertificeerde jager die conform de voorwaarden uit de door gedeputeerde staten van Noord-Brabant verleende ontheffing heeft gehandeld.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Thieme over misstanden rondom het vangen en transporteren van leghennen

An MP asks the State Secretary of Economic Affairs about reported animal suffering when laying hens are caught and transported, including injuries, lack of protection from weather, long transports to Poland, and too many inspection violations. The government says existing rules apply, an NVWA chain analysis is underway with results due in Q3 2016, it will not unilaterally ban long transports but will press for EU changes, and it finds long transport for cost reasons unacceptable and will discuss this with the sector.
I will inform your House in the third quarter of this year about the results of the chain analysis.
Ik zal uw Kamer in het derde kwartaal van dit jaar informeren over de resultaten van de ketenanalyse.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Thieme over de zware mishandeling van knobbelzwanen door jagers

An MP asked the government how it would respond to a broadcast showing hunters seriously mistreating wounded mute swans, why police did not act on complaints, and whether it would ban swan hunting and hagel shot. The state secretary said police checked hunting requirements and that a criminal investigation into possible mistreatment is being considered, but declined to say more, and defended provincial discretion on swan culling without committing to a ban.
Regarding possible criminal offences, such as mistreatment, it is currently being considered whether a criminal investigation should be launched.
Ten aanzien van eventuele strafbare feiten, zoals mishandeling, wordt op dit moment bezien of een strafrechtelijk onderzoek moet worden ingesteld.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Thieme over de voorlichting aan Nederlandse ondernemers over problemen met kinderarbeid in Oekraïne

The MP Thieme asks why RVO.nl removed a warning to Dutch entrepreneurs about child labour in Ukraine's agriculture and construction sectors shortly before the April 2016 referendum, and whether the government will pressure Ukraine on child labour. The minister answers that the text was outdated (dating from 2009), removed autonomously by RVO during routine updating ahead of a trade mission, with no political pressure, and that the text has since been updated and republished while Ukraine will be engaged on labour standards through the Association Agreement and OECD channels.
In an update round for the CSR texts it was found that the information dates from 2009.
In een actualisatieronde voor de MVO-teksten is geconstateerd dat informatie dateert uit 2009.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Thieme over het verlenen van het predicaat ‘Koninklijk’ aan Vee & Logistiek Nederland

An MP asked the state secretary whether the trade association Vee & Logistiek Nederland, which represents livestock transport firms with many recorded welfare and inspection violations, should be denied the royal predicate 'Koninklijk'. The state secretary confirmed the application, explained the procedure via the mayor and the commissioner of the King, and declined to pre-judge the decision.
Pending the assessment of the application, I do not consider it opportune to anticipate the decision that will be taken on this.
Hangende de beoordeling van de aanvraag acht ik het niet opportuun vooruit te lopen op het besluit dat hierover genomen zal worden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Thieme over de huisvestingseisen van runderen in de veehouderij

An MP asked the State Secretary for Economic Affairs about housing requirements for cattle after a court ruled the NVWA's penalty against an overcrowded dairy farm was not properly imposed and that the law does not explicitly require an individual lying place per cow. The government answered that it will not amend the legislation, arguing the CBb ruling gives enough grounds to prove future violations, and that the enforcement order was reformulated to require a clean, dry lying place for each animal.
I do not intend to amend the legislation.
Ik ben niet voornemens de wetgeving aan te passen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Thieme over het staken van jacht op de wilde eend

An MP from the Party for the Animals asked the State Secretary for Economic Affairs whether he would halt recreational hunting of wild ducks given their declining population, and whether he would press provinces to stop culling. The State Secretary declined to pre-empt a Sovon population study due before summer and referred to earlier answers on the same question.
I do not want to anticipate the outcomes of this research into the population development of wild ducks among others; the report is expected before the summer.
Ik wil niet vooruitlopen op de uitkomsten van dit onderzoek naar de populatieontwikkeling van onder meer wilde eenden, naar verwachting verschijnt het rapport voor de zomer.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Thieme en Rudmer Heerema over Nederland als knooppunt van wildstropers

MPs Thieme and Rudmer Heerema asked the State Secretary of Economic Affairs about the Netherlands as a hub for wildlife trafficking, the enforcement of import exemptions, and the motion on banning hunting trophy imports. The State Secretary rejected the claim that the Netherlands is a key trafficking hub, described enforcement and priorities, and promised to inform the House later on the conference outcomes and trophy import ban options.

I will inform you shortly about the outcomes of the conference 'Save Wildlife: Act Now or Game Over' and about the options for introducing a ban on hunting trophies in response to the Thieme/Heerema motion.

Ik zal u op korte termijn informeren over de uitkomsten van de conferentie «Save Wildlife: Act Now or Game Over» en over de mogelijkheden om een verbod voor jachttrofeeën in te stellen in reactie op de motie Thieme/Heerema.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Dekken en Thieme over het doden van honderden gezonde kalveren

MPs Van Dekken and Thieme asked the State Secretary about hundreds of healthy under-weight calves being killed for economic reasons, including whether the government would intervene given dairy expansion, transport and antibiotic problems, and the reliability of industry registrations. The State Secretary acknowledged the concern, pointed to a sector plan and NVWA enforcement, and stated that industry registrations show about 200 calves per week euthanised, with the photographed dead calves being illustrative only.
I will still study the plan, but I am mainly pleased that these sectors are taking their joint responsibility here and have come up with an integrated action plan.
Ik ga het plan nog bestuderen maar ik ben vooral blij dat deze sectoren hier hun gezamenlijke verantwoordelijkheid nemen en zijn gekomen met een integraal plan van aanpak.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Thieme over de massale wetsovertredingen tijdens diertransporten naar Turkije

An MP asked the State Secretary about reported systematic violations of EU animal transport rules on live animal transports to Turkey, including Dutch carriers, and whether the NVWA would act and whether the Netherlands would end or time-limit such transports.
