The State Secretary acknowledged the problems, said the NVWA can investigate Dutch carriers and an ongoing investigation will be reported on, and said unilateral national limits are not possible but that he will push the EU to ban slaughter-animal transports longer than 8 hours and to press Turkey on border conditions.
The investigation into this is still ongoing. Once this investigation is concluded I will inform you of the outcome.
Het onderzoek hierover is nog lopende. Als dit onderzoek is afgerond zal ik u over de uitkomst informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Thieme over het voorzorgsbeginsel in de onderhandelingen tussen de EU en de VS over TTIP

An MP from the Party for the Animals asks the minister whether the EU's precautionary principle will be preserved in the TTIP trade negotiations with the US, citing US negotiators' statements that risk assessments could be harmonised and that the EU should rely more on US assessments. The minister replies that the precautionary principle is not up for discussion in TTIP, that regulatory cooperation does not mean adopting each other's standards, and that the Commission publishes reports on each negotiating round.
The precautionary principle is not up for discussion in TTIP.
Het voorzorgsbeginsel staat niet ter discussie in TTIP.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Thieme over toenemend onderwatergeluid door onder meer olieplatforms, scheepvaart en militaire activiteiten als oorzaak van strandende potvissen en andere walvisachtigen

An MP asked the State Secretary for Economic Affairs whether rising underwater noise from platforms, shipping and military activity contributed to the stranding of sperm whales and dolphins on the North Sea coast, and what the government is doing about it. The government answered that a causal link cannot be confirmed, that the cause of stranding is not yet known, and that it is pursuing existing permit regimes, monitoring and international initiatives.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Thieme over het toestaan van het doodschieten van konijnen, terwijl schadeonderzoek ontbreekt

An MP asks the state secretary how the government responds to a Council of State ruling that Staatsbosbeheer may not allow rabbit culling on Terschelling without adequate damage research, and how it will prevent culling decisions on an insufficient legal basis. The state secretary answers that Staatsbosbeheer withdrew its permission, that the responsible bodies will take the ruling's interpretation of article 65 of the Flora- en faunawet into account, and that the new Wet natuurbescherming will require approved fauna management plans based on population counts.

The Division noted in this ruling that the law requires, as one of the conditions for this exemption, that the land user can demonstrate that they are trying to prevent significant damage at the moment they act.

De Afdeling heeft in deze uitspraak erop gewezen dat uit de wet volgt dat één van de voorwaarden waaronder deze vrijstelling geldt is dat de grondgebruiker kan aantonen dat hij belangrijke schade tracht te voorkomen op het moment dat hij optreedt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Thieme en Van Gerven over over giftige bontkragen op kinderjassen

MPs Thieme and Van Gerven asked whether fur collars on children's jackets, found to contain formaldehyde and ethoxylates above guideline levels, should be recalled and banned, and whether fur labelling should be improved. The minister replied that the NVWA and RIVM judge exposure acceptable, that no national ban or recall is warranted for now, and that EU consultation on formaldehyde and labelling efforts are ongoing.
The NVWA concludes that the actual amount of toxic substances that can be released from the product is at a scientifically acceptable level.
De NVWA concludeert dat de feitelijke hoeveelheid giftige stoffen die uit het product kunnen vrijkomen onder het wetenschappelijk gezien acceptabele niveau liggen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Krol, Pieter Heerma, Verhoeven, Jasper van Dijk, Thieme en Kuzu over de behandeling van de Mediawet in de Eerste Kamer

MPs asked the State Secretary about appointments to the supervisory boards of the NOS and NTR and the NPO, including alleged political favouritism and whether a board chair's position at UWV made the appointment incompatible with the Mediawet. The State Secretary denied any legal incompatibility, said the NPO appointment followed an independent advisory committee, and refused to reverse it.
I regret the impression that has arisen and do not consider it consistent with the actual course of events.
Ik betreur het beeld dat is ontstaan en vind dat ook niet in overeenstemming met de feitelijke gang van zaken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Thieme over het referendum over het associatieverdrag Oekraïne

MP Thieme (PvdD) asked whether the government would suspend implementation of the EU-Ukraine Association Agreement pending the April 2016 advisory referendum, and whether it would respect a no vote. Minister Koenders answered that provisional application continues because the referendum is part of national ratification, that the government will follow the Referendum Act, and that a negative outcome would lead to a further decision in consultation with parliament.
In the event of an irrevocable advisory rejection, the cabinet will submit to the House, under the Referendum Act, a bill to withdraw or to bring into force the approval act.

Bij een onherroepelijke raadgevende uitspraak tot afwijzing zal het kabinet op grond van de Wet raadgevend referendum een wetsvoorstel tot intrekking dan wel tot inwerkingtreding van de goedkeuringswet bij de Kamer aanhangig maken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Thieme over een importverbod van kangoeroeproducten

An MP asks the health and economic affairs ministers about hygiene, health risks, welfare and a possible import ban on kangaroo meat, citing Australian and US reports. The minister answers that current contamination levels give no reason to change policy, that a Russian-style ban is not justified, and that the welfare-based ban argument lacks a legal basis under EU rules.
The current contamination level of kangaroo meat gives me no reason to change the policy pursued.
De huidige besmettingsgraad van kangoeroevlees geeft mij geen aanleiding het ingezette beleid te wijzigen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Thieme over de verspreiding van een besmettelijke konijnenziekte via de jacht

An MP asked the state secretary for Economic Affairs whether the rabbit disease VHD, which killed tame and wild rabbits, threatens wild rabbit populations and whether rabbit hunting should be halted to prevent spread. The state secretary answered that the impact on wild rabbits is unknown, that hunting may spread the virus but stopping it would have little effect given other routes, and that a temporary hunting ban is not considered useful.
A (temporary) ban on rabbit hunting is therefore not considered meaningful by me.
Een (tijdelijk) verbod op de konijnenjacht acht ik dan ook niet zinvol.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Thieme over het ontstaan van een winstgevende industrie rondom het doden van ganzen

An MP asked the State Secretary of Economic Affairs whether a commercial goose-shooting industry for foreign hunters, and Friesland's request to allow sale of shot geese, reflects a flawed goose policy and whether alternatives should be promoted. The State Secretary defended the legal framework and provincial control, rejected commercial hunting trips, and committed to consult provinces and the hunters' association on ending such practices.
I disapprove of organising commercial hunting trips and the associations this evokes.
Het organiseren van commerciële jachtreizen en de associaties die dit oproept keur ik af.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Thieme over het mishandelen van merries en hun ongeboren veulens voor de productie van hormoonmiddelen voor de Europese en Nederlandse zuivel- en vleesindustrie

An MP asked the State Secretary for Economic Affairs about horse mistreatment in the production of PMSG fertility hormone used in dairy and livestock industries, and about import chains, veterinary hormone use and a possible ban. The government answered that the product is authorised under EU rules, that animal welfare is not a Good Manufacturing Practice criterion but will be raised when those rules are updated, and that a WUR study on hormone use is expected in spring.
I will therefore raise the criterion of animal welfare when the Good Manufacturing Practice requirements are updated.
Ik zal daarom het criterium van dierenwelzijn aan de orde stellen, wanneer de eisen van Good Manufacturing Practice worden geactualiseerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Thieme over een nieuwe vondst van Colistine resistentie op Nederlands kippenvlees en geïmporteerd kalkoenvlees

An MP (PvdD) asked the minister whether conditions for pigs and poultry should be improved to reduce antibiotic use, whether colistin should be phased out early, whether consumers should be warned about antibiotic-resistant bacteria in meat, whether colistin resistance should be monitored and reported, and whether colistin resistance exists in pigs. The minister answered that colistin sales fell by about 67% since 2011 on a voluntary basis, that EU-level measures and a 2016-2020 policy will be presented in spring 2016, that a warning label on poultry is being optimised, that testing for colistin resistance will be extended, and that a reporting obligation would need legal change and will be considered after the EMA advice.
Tightening of the legal conditions of use or statutory phase-out is reserved for the EU.
Aanscherping van de wettelijke gebruikseisen of wettelijke uitfasering is voorbehouden aan de EU.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Thieme over het gooien van jonge nertsen in gaskisten

An MP asked the State Secretary and Minister whether a Rosmalen fur farm treated mink cruelly, whether it should be closed as a notorious offender, and when a permanent fur-farming ban would be added to the Criminal Code. The government reported two welfare inspections showing no violations, four NVWA inspections in five years with one fine, found no basis to call the firm a notorious offender, and promised the evaluation and policy response of the criminal ban to Parliament soon.
Actively making the inspection results of an individual company public is currently not possible.
Het actief openbaar maken van de inspectieresultaten van een individueel bedrijf is op dit moment niet mogelijk.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma, Ten Broeke, Servaes, Van Bommel, Knops, De Roon, Voordewind, Grashoff, Van der Staaij, Thieme, Bontes, Kuzu, Van Vliet, Krol, Klein en Houwers over de levensbedreigende situatie

MPs asked the ministers about the humanitarian siege of Madaya in Syria, where about 40,000 people face starvation, and whether the Netherlands would press for a ceasefire, humanitarian access and airdrops. The ministers confirmed the severity of the situation, described Dutch funding and diplomatic efforts through the UN and ICRC, and explained why airdrops are not considered feasible.
The Netherlands has for some time been pressing within the UN for a ceasefire so that humanitarian aid can be provided to the population.
Nederland dringt in VN-verband al geruime tijd aan op een staakt-het-vuren zodat humanitaire hulp geboden kan worden aan de bevolking.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Thieme over de verkoop van wildklemmen en vangnetten

An MP asked whether the online sale of gin traps and nets for protected mammals and birds, and their use, is illegal and how the government will act against it. The State Secretary answered that such non-selective traps are prohibited under the Flora- and faunawet, that possession outside buildings is banned, and that the law does not prohibit trading them, though carrying one outside without an exemption is punishable.
Against that background, the Flora- and faunawet does not provide for a ban on trading these devices.
Tegen die achtergrond voorziet de Flora- en faunawet niet in een verbod op het verhandelen van deze middelen.
Antwoord op de vragen van het lid Thieme over hondsdolheid bij vossen

An MP asks the State Secretary whether culling foxes, which the reporting suggests creates vacancies refilled from neighbouring countries carrying rabies, is counterproductive, and whether the fox should be removed from the national exemption list. The State Secretary answers that rabies cases in the Netherlands were all acquired abroad, that Dutch and Belgian foxes are rabies-free, that the risk of infected foxes entering is negligible, and that no reason is seen to remove the fox from the list.
In view of the answers given to questions 2, 3 and 4, I see no reason to remove the fox from the national exemption list.
Gelet op de antwoorden gegeven op de vragen 2, 3 en 4, zie ik geen aanleiding om de vos van de landelijke vrijstellingslijst te halen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Thieme over het bejagen en serveren van beschermde zwanen

An MP asked the State Secretary for Economic Affairs whether a restaurant serving shot protected swans lacks the required permit, whether the Zuid-Holland permit allows commercial use, and about damage figures, shooting numbers and alternatives. The State Secretary answered that provinces make their own permit decisions within legal limits, that the Zuid-Holland permit does not allow commercial use or consumption, and that the figures must be obtained from the province.
The requested factual data can be obtained from the province of Zuid-Holland.
De gevraagde feitelijke gegevens zijn te verkrijgen bij de provincie Zuid-Holland.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Thieme over de ethische aanvaardbaarheid van het houden van dieren in dolfinaria

Thieme (PvdD) asks the State Secretary for Economic Affairs whether dolphinaria should be banned in the Netherlands given closures abroad, animal welfare reports and a Loro Parque breeding plan involving the wild-born orca Morgan. The State Secretary declines a ban, says the Dolfinarium Harderwijk treats its dolphins responsibly and is inspected by the NVWA, and promises to answer the Free Morgan Foundation letter soon.
No. The Dolfinarium in Harderwijk treats the dolphins responsibly, including during training.
Nee. Het Dolfinarium in Harderwijk gaat op verantwoorde wijze om met de dolfijnen, ook tijdens de trainingen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Thieme over het verkrijgen van panda’s uit China

An MP asked whether three former Prime Ministers wrote letters to China to obtain pandas, what those letters argued, and whether the cabinet accepts animals as diplomatic currency and taxpayer money is involved. The minister answered that the loan is part of a wider conservation project with Ouwehands Dierenpark funded by the zoo, declined to provide the letters as a commitment, and stated that no Dutch government money was invested.
Can the House be given access to all letters written by the cabinet regarding the supply of pandas?
Kan de Kamer inzage krijgen alle brieven die vanuit het kabinet inzake de levering van panda’s zijn geschreven?
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Thieme over dolfijnenslachtingen en de walvisjacht als onderwerp van de economische missie naar Japan

An MP from the Party for the Animals asked how the government would press its opposition to Japanese dolphin hunts and whaling during the economic mission to Japan, and how it used the EU-Japan trade agreement to secure a whaling moratorium. The government answered that it raised its position with Prime Minister Abe, promised to inform parliament afterwards, and said it backs the Commission's push for an ambitious sustainability and animal welfare chapter in the trade deal.
The Netherlands, like several other member states, has repeatedly urged the European Commission to include an ambitious chapter on sustainability and animal welfare in the EU-Japan trade agreement.

Nederland heeft – net als verscheidene andere lidstaten – bij de Europese Commissie meerdere malen aangedrongen om een ambitieus hoofdstuk over duurzaamheid en dierenwelzijn in het handelsverdrag tussen de EU en Japan op te nemen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Thieme over het afschieten van katten

An MP asked the state secretary about the provincial shooting of cats, including whether counts are kept and why some provinces still allow it. The government replied that provinces decide themselves, no registration of cat shootings is kept, and an advisory opinion on alternatives is expected this year with a government response to follow.
No, the Ministry of Economic Affairs does not keep any registration of the shooting of cats.
Nee, er wordt door het Ministerie van Economische Zaken geen registratie bijgehouden van afschot van katten.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Thieme, Klaver en Voordewind over het rapport van de onafhankelijke klachtencommissie van de Nederlandse financieringsmaatschappij voor ontwikkelingslanden FMO m.b.t. de Barro Blanco dam i

MPs Thieme, Klaver and Voordewind asked the minister about the FMO complaints committee finding that indigenous rights were not fully assessed before approving the Barro Blanco dam loan in Panama, and about human rights impact assessments, parliamentary oversight of FMO, and the state's influence over FMO investment decisions. The minister acknowledged the incomplete information, promised to raise FMO's tightened approval process and transparency with FMO, supported a dialogue process with indigenous authorities, and rejected several proposals such as a public open session of FMO's supervisory board and a construction halt.
At the next consultation with FMO I will explicitly raise this issue.
In het eerstvolgende overleg met FMO zal ik dit nadrukkelijk aan de orde stellen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Thieme over het rapport “Stoppen met kiloknallen”

An MP asks the State Secretary for Economic Affairs about a Wakker Dier report on 'kiloknallers' (supermarket meat price-cutting), linking lower margins to rising animal density, antibiotic resistance, food fraud and animal welfare problems, and asks whether production limits, sales-below-cost bans or export bulk phase-outs will be introduced. The State Secretary answers that welfare is primarily the keeper's responsibility, rejects new production or density norms, relies on sector-led antibiotic reduction and voluntary supermarket agreements, and rejects a legal ban on sales below cost.
I am in discussion with the piglet vitality steering group about this.
Ik ben hierover in gesprek met de stuurgroep bigvitaliteit.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Thieme over duizenden kalveren die langzaam stikken tijdens en na de slacht van de moederkoe

An MP asked the state secretary about reports that thousands of unborn calves suffocate during slaughter of pregnant cows, and whether the Netherlands would ban such slaughter and extend transport restrictions. The state secretary said pregnant animals are not registered in Dutch slaughterhouses, that EFSA advice is due by 30 November 2016, and that measures will be decided after that advice and a Wageningen study.
No registration is kept of this.
Hier wordt geen registratie van bijgehouden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Thieme over het openen van een Hy-Care stal voor vleesvarkens

MP Thieme (PvdD) asked whether the minister would open a Hy-Care pig housing concept for fattening pigs in Bladel, which critics say confines pigs in stackable plastic crates, and how this fits government opposition to further industrialisation of intensive livestock farming. The minister answered that the farmer was told the minister would not attend the opening, that developing new housing concepts is the sector's responsibility under existing welfare, health, antibiotic and environmental rules, and that the minister never made the commitment to open the stal.
Developing new housing concepts is the responsibility of the sector.
Het ontwikkelen van nieuwe houderijconcepten is de verantwoordelijkheid van de sector.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Thieme over uitkeringsgerechtigden die vanwege ethische of gewetensbezwaren werk weigeren en hun uitkering dreigen te verliezen

An MP asked whether benefit recipients with ethical objections (such as to slaughterhouse work) can refuse jobs without losing benefits, and whether the UWV job bank CBBS should drop poultry slaughterhouse jobs. The minister answered that the law allows conscientious objection in reintegration and fitness-for-work assessments, but declined to remove the job or add ethical criteria to the CBBS.
Within reintegration, a beneficiary is obliged to accept suitable work.
In het kader van de re-integratie is een gerechtigde verplicht om passende arbeid te accepteren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Thieme over de dolfijnenslachtingen op de Faeröer-eilanden

The MP asked about dolphin drive hunts in the Faroe Islands, Danish protection of the hunt, and what the government has done or will do to stop it. The government answered that it raised the issue through the IWC and ASCOBANS, will keep pressing Denmark and will ask the Commission to examine EU action, while noting the Faroes' autonomy over whaling.
I will ask the European Commission to examine whether and how the EU can act.
Ik zal de Europese Commissie verzoeken om mogelijkheden te onderzoeken of en op welke wijze de EU kan optreden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma, Voordewind, Thieme en Voortman over de Europese migratieproblematiek.

MPs Sjoerdsma, Voordewind, Thieme and Voortman asked the government about the European migration crisis, including limits of reception capacity, funding for regional refugee aid, safe third country returns, relocation quotas and Dublin rules. The state secretary answered largely on substance, describing the planned approach and noting that many details remain to be negotiated with the EU and third countries.
Once the ideas take more concrete shape at European level, we can further develop the plans together with relevant reception countries, such as Syria's neighbours.
Zodra in Europees verband de ideeën concreter vorm krijgen, kunnen we de plannen verder uitwerken samen met relevante opvanglanden, zoals de buurlanden van Syrië.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Thieme over het per ongeluk doodschieten van honden door jagers

An MP from the Party for the Animals asks the State Secretary about two incidents in which hunters mistakenly shot dogs, and about evidence that hunters often miss their prey, asking whether the law should be tightened and whether the hunters should be prosecuted and lose their licences. The State Secretary answers that these incidents are regrettable and rare, that the Public Prosecution Service is investigating, that she sees no reason to amend legislation or repeat the research, and that prosecution is for the Public Prosecution Service and the courts to decide.
Pending the results of the Public Prosecution Service investigation, I see no reason at this time to amend legislation.
In afwachting van de resultaten van het onderzoek van het Openbaar Ministerie zie ik op dit moment geen aanleiding om wetgeving aan te passen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Thieme en Smaling over het gebrekkige toezicht en de handhavingsaanpak bij zwanendriften

MPs Thieme and Smaling asked whether police and NVWA enforcement against swan-harassment is inadequate, whether the NVWA emergency line works, and whether a ban is needed. The minister rejects claims of inadequate enforcement, says NVWA and police coordinate well, and promises to investigate a legal ban by autumn.
There is no question of deficient enforcement.
Er is geen sprake van een gebrekkige handhavingsaanpak.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Thieme over illegale vogelvangst in Nederland

An MP asked the State Secretary for Economic Affairs about illegal wild bird trapping and fraud disguising wild-caught birds as captive-bred, and whether enforcement in rural areas and the NVWA's inspectors' expertise were adequate. The State Secretary pointed to existing measures such as digital ring registration and inter-ministerial letters, saw no need to intensify enforcement, and rejected the claim of a knowledge gap among NVWA inspectors.
Given current efforts and ongoing initiatives for further improvement, supervision and enforcement in rural areas can now and in the future take place at a sufficient level.
Door de huidige inzet en de lopende initiatieven voor verdere verbetering kan het toezicht en handhaving in het buitengebied nu en in de toekomst op voldoende niveau plaatsvinden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Thieme over de zeehondenjacht in Canada

MP Thieme asked whether the government knows that Norwegian sealers stopped after subsidies ended, whether Canada would end its seal hunt if it stopped subsidising, and whether the minister raised the seal hunt during the Canada trade mission as promised. The minister confirmed the Norwegian development, declined to judge Canadian hunters' motives, and said the topic was not raised because no Canadian federal minister could be met, while pledging to keep raising it bilaterally and in Europe.
During this mission it proved not possible for scheduling reasons to meet a member of the Canadian government, so this topic was not raised this time.
Tijdens deze missie bleek het om agendatechnische redenen niet mogelijk om een ontmoeting te hebben met een lid van de Canadese regering, derhalve is dit onderwerp dit keer niet ter sprake gekomen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Thieme over het uitroeien van de Indische huiskraai in Hoek van Holland

MP Thieme asks the State Secretary for Economic Affairs why the Indian House Crow was ordered eradicated in Hoek van Holland given its stable population, what the costs and results are, and whether the operation is judged a success. The State Secretary answers that a risk assessment and NVWA advice justified early intervention, that about 23,600 euro has been spent and 26 crows removed with 5 remaining, and that it is too early for a final judgement.
Eliminating the birds requires effort and care.
Het elimineren van de vogels vergt inzet en zorg.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Thieme over het massaal afschieten van ganzen

An MP asks the State Secretary for Economic Affairs about mass goose culling in Utrecht that, according to Sovon research, has not reduced goose numbers, and whether the government will back more effective, non-lethal measures. The State Secretary says provinces are responsible for goose management, that culling serves safety and damage-prevention purposes, that further research is needed to judge other measures, and that provinces may pursue experiments such as laser systems with Wageningen expertise.
The province is responsible for managing goose populations and makes its own considerations in this regard.
De provincie is verantwoordelijk voor het beheer van ganzenpopulaties en maakt daarin zijn eigen afwegingen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Thieme over de berichten dat, tegen gemaakte afspraken in, varkenshouders weer beginnen met castreren van biggen

An MP asked the state secretary about reports that pig farmers resumed castrating piglets despite the 2018 Brussels Declaration goal, and whether a legal ban would follow. The state secretary said the 2018 ambition stands but that the market is primarily responsible, refused a unilateral national ban, and saw no need for further research on Improvac.
I will not proceed to a unilateral ban on castration in the Netherlands.
Ik zal niet overgaan tot een eenzijdig verbod op het castreren in Nederland.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Thieme over het ontbreken van een visie op privacybescherming

An MP asked the Minister of Security and Justice whether he would respond to a coalition's call for a vision on privacy protection, and whether he would develop such a vision and facilitate public debate. The minister answered by referring to a letter sent to the parliamentary committee in response to its request, which contains the answers.
The letter to the Committee with my response is attached to this letter and also contains the answers to your questions about a vision on and public debate on privacy protection.

De brief aan de Commissie met mijn reactie vindt u bijgevoegd bij deze brief en bevat tevens de beantwoording van de door u gestelde vragen omtrent een visie op en het publieke debat over privacybescherming.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Thieme over de gevolgen van de ISDS-clausules in Nederlandse handelsverdragen voor ontwikkelingslanden

MP Thieme asked the minister whether ISDS clauses let investors claim compensation from developing countries for public-interest regulation, and about the scale of use and treaty shopping. The minister defended ISDS as a needed safeguard, described the EU reform proposals and a renegotiation plan for the 92 Dutch BITs, and agreed to explore substance requirements against treaty shopping.
I am willing to examine the extent to which it is possible to include a provision in BITs under which only companies carrying out substantial economic activities could use the treaty benefits.

Ik ben bereid te onderzoeken in hoeverre het mogelijk is om in IBO's een bepaling op te nemen, waarbij alleen bedrijven die substantiële economische activiteiten ontplooien, gebruik zouden kunnen maken van de verdragsvoordelen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Thieme over het afsterven van spenen bij melkkoeien

An MP asked the State Secretary whether rising reports of ischemic teat necrosis in young dairy cows, linked to housing, feed, exercise, cold and higher milk yield, warrant further research and stricter supervision. The State Secretary replied that there is no evidence of a causal link to milk yield or reduced grazing, sees no reason for research, does not systematically record the data, and notes the condition itself is not a welfare violation.
At this moment I therefore see no reason for research into the condition ischemic teat necrosis.
Op dit moment zie ik dan ook geen reden voor onderzoek naar de aandoening ischemische speennecrose.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Thieme en Ouwehand over de illegale handel in puppy’s

MPs Thieme and Ouwehand asked the State Secretary and Justice Minister about illegal cross-border puppy trade, document fraud, online sales, veterinary complicity, police and NVWA enforcement, and a lifetime animal-keeping ban. The government answered that it has taken measures, pointed to separate letters, said veterinarians cannot be prosecuted without proven intent, rejected mandatory parent-dog presence, and promised an evaluation of the keeping ban before the summer recess.
At the request of the House, the Minister of Justice will also examine in the evaluation the possibilities of imposing the keeping ban as a standalone measure or penalty.
Op verzoek van uw Kamer laat de Minister van V&J in de evaluatie ook kijken naar de mogelijkheden het houdverbod als zelfstandige maatregel of straf op te leggen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Thieme over ‘de dood van tienduizenden veldleeuweriken door maaien’

An MP asked the state secretary about reports of tens of thousands of skylarks killed by mowing, the trend in other provinces, whether field supervision and enforcement should be tightened, and how this relates to the Rli's criticism of agri-environment management. The state secretary said trends in most provinces show modest decline, that provinces are seeking solutions and that strengthening field supervision is a provincial responsibility, and pointed to the new collective agri-environment scheme from 2016.
Strengthening field supervision is also an option, but that is a consideration that falls within the powers of the province.
Versterking van het veldtoezicht is ook een optie, maar dat is een afweging die tot de bevoegdheden van de provincie behoort.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Thieme over het verstrekken van subsidie op het versnipperen van kuikens

An MP asked whether the government's bird-flu compensation scheme for hatching eggs and day-old chicks rewarded hatcheries that kept hatching and sent surplus chicks to the macerator, and what would be done about animal suffering during transport bans. The state secretary said the sector is responsible for mitigating suffering, the scheme was a short 10-day compensation based on market value that she judged created little incentive, and she would consult the poultry sector on requiring temporary chick-holding facilities.
I have no statistics on the way in which the companies have done this.
Ik heb geen statistieken over de wijze waarop de bedrijven dit hebben gedaan.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Thieme over de dreigende toelating van Amerikaanse chloorkippen tot de Europese markt

MP Thieme asks whether the EU will lift its ban on chlorine-washed American chicken before end-2015, linked to TTIP, and whether this erodes EU food and environmental standards, including on cloned-animal products and endocrine disruptors. The minister replies that such chicken is not admitted, that the EU ban on hormone-treated beef is kept under the precautionary principle, that the Commission has committed to keeping EU standards in TTIP talks, and that EFSA found no health differences for clone offspring.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Thieme over kunstmatige vossenburchten en jacht

An MP asked whether artificial fox earths sold online for fox hunting are animal-unfriendly and non-species-specific, possibly endangering badgers, and whether their sale should be banned. The minister said the rules do not prohibit artificial earths, that hunters would act if badgers were found, that keeping the diameter small prevents badger use, that provinces hold any figures on frequency, and referred back to these points on the ban question.
The regulations do not exclude the use of an artificial fox earth, the so-called kunstbouw.
De regelgeving sluit het gebruik van een kunstmatige vossenburcht, de zogenaamd kunstbouw, niet uit.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Thieme en Ouwehand over het veilen en opvangen van dieren na een inbeslagname

MPs Thieme and Ouwehand asked why a severely neglected pony was auctioned after a bankruptcy and whether curators may auction animals and pressure debtors with seizure threats. The government answered that auctions are permitted under the Bankruptcy Act, that criminal complaints were filed, that curators must follow the Animal Welfare Act and may be complained about to the rechter-commissaris, and that no additional national policy is considered necessary.
This of course does not prevent those involved from complaining about the curator's conduct to the rechter-commissaris, who supervises the proper handling of the bankruptcy.
Dit laat uiteraard onverlet dat betrokkenen zich over het gedrag van de curator kunnen beklagen bij de rechter-commissaris, die toeziet op de correcte afwikkeling van het faillissement.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Thieme over het gebruik van CO2 voor het vergassen van veldmuizen in Friesland

An MP asked the State Secretary for Economic Affairs whether the use of CO2 under a drag sheet to gas field voles in Friesland complies with the EU biocides directive and whether enforcement is planned. The government agreed the method should not be used under the directive, but said it will examine whether it could be applied in future and what legal steps would be needed.
With that in mind, I will have it examined whether this method can be applied in the future and, if so, what legal steps would need to be taken.
Ik zal met het oog daarop laten nagaan of deze methode in de toekomst toegepast kan gaan worden en zo ja, welke juridische stappen hiertoe gezet moeten worden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Thieme over het Duitse beroepsverbod aan een Nederlandse varkenshouder

MP Thieme asks the state secretary about a German professional ban on a controversial Dutch pig farmer, whether Dutch sites were affected, past NVWA inspections, and prosecutions. The state secretary confirms the German ban is limited to Germany, reports 14 NVWA inspections since 2007 with fines and an injunction, and says the NVWA will inspect the farmer's sites very regularly from now on.
The NVWA will therefore continue to inspect the farmer's businesses very regularly in the coming period.
De NVWA zal de bedrijven van de betreffende veehouder komende tijd dan ook zeer regelmatig blijven inspecteren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Thieme over afschot van herten op het eiland Haringvreter

The MP asks the State Secretary for Economic Affairs about the culling of fallow deer on Haringvreter, the basis for the deer population growth assumptions and the need for independent research, and whether the permit should be withdrawn. The State Secretary answers that the province of Zeeland is the competent authority for the Flora- and faunawet permit, that population growth and grazing pressure justify culling, and that the province is responsible for the decision.
For issuing any exemption under the Flora- and faunawet, the province of Zeeland is in this case the competent authority and therefore responsible for taking a considered decision.

Voor het afgeven van een eventuele ontheffing op grond van de Flora- en faunawet is de provincie Zeeland in dit geval het bevoegd gezag en daarmee verantwoordelijk voor het nemen van een afgewogen besluit.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Thieme over ganzen afschotdag

An MP from the Party for the Animals asked the state secretary about a mass goose-shooting day in Limburg, questioning whether it violated animal welfare duties and the rules on competitions with animals, and whether residents were informed. The state secretary answered that the shooting was invasive-species management within legal bounds, that no disturbance of nature was evident, informing residents is the hunters' responsibility, and that there was no reason to ban the event.
Reports of the goose shooting day of 21 February show no sign that it conflicted with the provisions of the Animal Welfare Act.
Uit verslaggeving van de ganzen afschotdag op 21 februari jl. blijkt niet dat hier sprake was van strijdigheid van de bepalingen van de Wet Dieren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Thieme over de langetermijneffecten van Q-koorts

An MP asked why livestock farmers can claim compensation for animal disease outbreaks while people made ill by Q fever cannot, and whether the government will pay damages to Q fever victims. The minister replied that Dutch law places own-damage risk on individuals with solidarity-based health care, that farmers receive culling compensation from the Animal Health Fund but not consequential losses, and that the state sees no unlawful act and therefore no reason for damages, though it funded the Q-support foundation.
According to the State, there is however no unlawful act as a result of which Q fever patients have suffered damage.
Volgens de Staat is evenwel geen sprake van onrechtmatig handelen als gevolg waarvan Q-koortspatiënten schade hebben geleden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Thieme over het in beslag nemen van nachtegalen en sijzen

An MP asked the State Secretary for Economic Affairs about the seizure of Japanese nightingales and siskins and why a trader caught with unringed siskins received only a warning and loss of the birds, and whether stricter action should follow. The State Secretary confirmed the news, said the birds could not have come from the wild so seizure and a warning were deemed sufficient, and considered the action adequate.
In the present case, in my view, action was taken adequately.
In het onderhavige geval is naar mijn mening adequaat opgetreden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Thieme over dieronvriendelijke muizenbestrijding

An MP asked the state secretary about a 'drowning machine' used by farmers to kill mice and whether the state would discourage it. The state secretary said the grower may choose how to control mice causing crop damage, and that a joint study will look at alternatives before any discouragement is considered.
I see no reason to discourage the method in question in advance of that.
Ik zie geen aanleiding om vooruitlopend daarop de betreffende methode te ontmoedigen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Thieme over de belangen van jachtopzieners naar aanleiding van het schieten van houtsnippen door jachtopzieners

An MP asked about a hunting party at Landgoed Duivenvoorde where a gamekeeper and others shot woodcock unlawfully, asking about proces-verbaal, revocation of hunting licences, the dual role of gamekeepers, and a ban on woodcock trade. The state secretary answered that a police investigation is ongoing and licence revocation will follow it, defended the gamekeeper's dual role, and stated that woodcock trade is already prohibited.
When this is concluded, the chief of police will decide, under Article 42 of the Flora and Fauna Act, whether the hunting licences of those involved will be revoked or not.
Wanneer dit is afgerond zal de korpschef, op grond van artikel 42 van de Flora- en faunawet, besluiten of de jachtaktes van de betrokkenen al dan niet worden ingetrokken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Thieme over verkeersveiligheid en faunabeleid naar aanleiding van wilde zwijnen op de A1

An MP from the Party for the Animals asked the State Secretary for Economic Affairs about wild boar on the A1 motorway, including fence quality, the planned shooting, and wider boar management and night-hunting rules. The State Secretary answered that the fence was in place but three boar got through, that shooting was planned but not carried out because the animals had left, and that boar management and shooting policy are the responsibility of the provinces.
As a result of this incident with wild boar, Rijkswaterstaat has decided to carry out an extra one-time inspection at the location concerned.
Als gevolg van dit incident met wilde zwijnen heeft Rijkswaterstaat besloten om op de betreffende locatie éénmalig een extra inspectie uit te voeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Thieme over pijnbestrijding bij het onthoornen van kalveren

An MP asked the State Secretary of Economic Affairs about pain relief when calves are dehorned, including the share of farmers giving no analgesia, whether pain relief should be mandatory, and who may perform the procedure. The State Secretary said pain relief is promoted through sector agreements rather than regulation, that dehorning remains permitted for safety reasons, and that compliance is checked by the NVWA, without committing to new rules or an interim evaluation.
This approach, in which the sector takes its responsibility, is my preference over regulation.
Deze aanpak waarbij de sector haar verantwoordelijkheid neemt heeft mijn voorkeur boven regelgeving.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt, Van Bommel, Bontes, De Roon, Thieme en Van Ojik over de tussenrapportages van de Onderzoeksraad voor Veiligheid (OVV) onderzoeken

MPs asked whether the Safety Board (OVV) runs three MH17 investigations, whether interim reports were published, and under which ICAO Annex 13 reporting obligations. The minister confirmed three investigations, that only the cause investigation has a published preliminary report, and that the other two have no interim reports.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Thieme over de positie van identiteitsgebonden zorgcentra met een landelijke functie

MPs Leijten and Thieme asked whether the vegetarian care home Felixoord, which has a national identity-based function, should be protected from closure caused by decentralisation and the shift to home care. The State Secretary replied that care providers must prepare for fewer light-care residents, that no national status exists for care homes since 2001, that contracting must offer a varied supply, and that he knows of no other identity-based homes threatened.
I have no signals that specifically identity-based care centres are threatened in their continued existence.
Ik heb geen signalen dat specifiek identiteitsgebonden zorgcentra in hun voortbestaan worden bedreigd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt, Van Bommel, Segers, Dijkgraaf en Thieme over het wachtgeld voor de voorzitter van de Europese Raad

Five MPs asked the Finance and Foreign Affairs ministers about the EU transitional allowance (wachtgeld) for the outgoing President of the European Council, who had already reached pensionable age and could draw his Belgian pension alongside it, and about pension accrual rates and job-seeking obligations. The minister confirmed the facts, said the EU rules (Regulation 422/67/EEG) cap the allowance at three years with no job-seeking duty, and said the Netherlands is willing to examine modernising and reducing the scheme, though any change requires Council action.
The Netherlands is willing to examine whether modernising and reducing the current scheme for political office holders in the EU is possible
Nederland is bereid te bekijken of modernisering en versobering van de huidige regeling voor politieke ambtsdragers in de EU mogelijk is
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Thieme over het afschieten van een bijna verdronken vos

An MP from the Party for the Animals asked the State Secretary for Economic Affairs whether a hunter who shot an exhausted fox from a moving car, after a near-drowning, acted lawfully, and whether provincial variation in hunting rules is acceptable. The State Secretary confirmed the incident, stated that the Flora- and faunawet's hunting rules did not apply to foxes, that the matter is a criminal question on which she cannot judge, and that provinces apply the same rules but may differ in practice.
Whether the hunter in this case acted in accordance with the legal requirements is a criminal matter on which I cannot make any statements.
Of de jager in dit geval al dan niet in overeenstemming met de wettelijke vereisten heeft gehandeld, is een strafrechtelijke kwestie waarover ik geen uitspraken kan doen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Thieme over het agressieve gedrag van paardenhandelaren jegens NVWA-inspecteurs

An MP asked the state secretary about aggressive behaviour by horse dealers toward NVWA inspectors at the Hedel horse market, the removal of tailed horses, and enforcement of the tail-docking ban and voluntary welfare protocols. The state secretary replied that inspectors did not experience the behaviour as aggressive, that two docked horses were removed while two others were allowed to stay, and that the NVWA enforces the existing law rather than private protocols.
NVWA staff did not experience the behaviour of the horse dealers or market staff as aggressive.
De medewerkers van de NVWA hebben het gedrag van de paardenhandelaren of de medewerkers van de paardenmarkt niet als agressief ervaren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Thieme over het bericht dat Nederland door Rusland als grote illegale vleessmokkelaar wordt genoemd

MP Thieme asked whether reports that Russia had found Dutch pork disguised as other goods in containers were accurate and whether stricter controls via EFSA would be pursued. The government confirmed no Dutch pork certificates have been issued to Russia since January 2014, that the containers were not registered, and that the meat was sold to traders for other EU destinations; it declined to pursue EFSA controls because enforcement lies with member states.
Enforcement of European food safety legislation is the responsibility of member states, not EFSA.
De bevoegdheid tot controle op de naleving van de Europese wetgeving ten aanzien van voedselveiligheid ligt bij de lidstaten en niet bij de EFSA.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Thieme over de verschillen in faunabeleid tussen provincies

An MP asked the State Secretary about differences in provincial fauna policy, notably Utrecht allowing cage traps for crows and rooks while North and South Holland do not. The government answered that provinces apply the same Flora- and Faunawet with room for regional tailoring, that provinces bear primary responsibility with only interbestuurlijk toezicht available, and that no separate investigation is planned.
I see no reason to launch an investigation into this.
Ik zie geen aanleiding om hierover een onderzoek in te stellen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Thieme over de aanwezigheid van furazolidon in de voedselketen en het lopende strafrechtelijk onderzoek

An MP asked whether potentially carcinogenic furazolidon in meat poses consumer health risks and whether the precautionary principle should apply to informing consumers while a criminal investigation is ongoing. The minister answered that the NVWA's risk assessment found negligible risk, that consumers are informed when a real health risk exists, and that affected animals were destroyed.
If there is a danger to public health from possibly contaminated foodstuffs, the consumer is informed of this so that they can take their own measures.
In het geval er een gevaar voor de volksgezondheid is door mogelijk besmette of verontreinigde voedingsmiddelen wordt de consument daarover geïnformeerd, zodat deze zelf maatregelen kan nemen
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Thieme over trofeereizen waarbij in het buitenland wordt gejaagd op bedreigde diersoorten

An MP asked the State Secretary for Economic Affairs about Dutch-booked trophy hunts of protected species abroad, including whether hunting licences could be revoked and whether such trips or trophy imports should be banned. The government answered that the trips are legal under CITES and EU rules, that it sees no legal basis to revoke licences for foreign kills, and that it will pursue tighter international rules and anti-wildlife-crime projects rather than a ban.
No, these are legal activities that are bound by rules within the EU and internationally.
Nee, het betreft legale activiteiten die binnen de EU en internationaal aan regels gebonden zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Thieme over verspreiding van besmettelijke dierziekten door de jacht

An MP asked the State Secretary whether hunting of infected wild boar spread African swine fever and whether hunting and intensive livestock farming endanger public health, and whether protocols on culling and housing orders should be revised. The State Secretary declined to confirm the Commission remark, found no scientific study linking hunting to spread, and refused to revise culling or housing protocols as current measures suffice.
I see no reason, based on the cited dissertation, to revise the protocols on culling and housing orders during animal disease outbreaks.
Ik zie geen reden om op grond van het aangehaalde proefschrift de protocollen rond ruimingen en ophokplicht bij uitbraken van dierziekten te herzien.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt, Van Bommel, De Roon, Voordewind, Van der Staaij, Thieme en Van Klaveren over Beschuldiging van Turkse wapenleveranties aan terroristische organisaties

MPs from several parties asked the Foreign Minister about allegations that Turkey supplied arms to jihadist groups including IS, and about reports of recruitment centres and a prisoner swap. The minister said the government could not confirm the allegations, relied on Turkey's denials and its IS listing, and declined to seek clarification from Turkey or back an independent international inquiry.
The cabinet is aware of these reports, as is the House, but, as indicated in earlier answers to parliamentary questions, cannot confirm them.
Het kabinet is net als de Kamer op de hoogte van deze berichten, maar kan, zoals ook in eerdere antwoorden op Kamervragen aangegeven, deze niet bevestigen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Thieme over indirecte investeringen van ambtenaren via pensioenfondsen in legbatterijen en megastallen in het buitenland

An MP asked whether civil servants' pension fund ABP indirectly invests in megastables and battery cages abroad, and whether the government would engage ABP or switch funds. The minister declined to monitor individual investments, stating pension funds and their boards decide investment policy under legal frameworks, and refused to engage ABP or change funds.
It is not the government's task to monitor and assess specific investments of individual funds, so I cannot comment on this.
Het is niet de taak van het kabinet om specifieke beleggingen van individuele fondsen te monitoren en te beoordelen, dus ik kan hier geen uitspraken over doen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Thieme over afschot van wilde zwijnen in de draag- en zoogtijd

An MP asks the state secretary whether boar piglets are shot in the nursing period under provincial permits, and questions the ethics, evidence and oversight of such culling and of night hunting. The state secretary replies that provinces (gedeputeerde staten) are responsible for permits and culling policy, that a closed season runs 15 March to 1 July, and declines a national evaluation or to end the practice.
Handling of such exemption applications is the responsibility of the provincial executive (gedeputeerde staten).
Afdoening van dergelijke ontheffingsaanvragen is de verantwoordelijkheid van gedeputeerde staten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Thieme met betrekking tot een reddingsactie van wilde zwijnen

An MP asked the state secretary whether a hunting warden shot wild boar that had just been rescued from water, and how that squares with the duty of care under the Flora and Fauna Act. The government said three animals were shot, some were already dead, no proces-verbaal was drawn up, the warden's police authorisation was withdrawn, and it deferred the zero-population policy to the provinces.
In the given circumstances the hunter should first have consulted the police to see whether alternatives to shooting existed.
In de gegeven omstandigheden had de jager eerst met de politie moeten overleggen of er alternatieven waren behoudens afschot.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Thieme over de maatschappelijke onrust over het vangen van wilde ezels op Bonaire

An MP asked about public unrest over the capture of wild donkeys on Bonaire, the current status of a sustainable solution, and whether the minister will play a role in protecting the donkeys' welfare. The State Secretary answered that mares and foals are sheltered, stallions are castrated and released, unsalvageable animals are euthanised, that the policy is the Openbaar Lichaam Bonaire's and is supported as addressing nature damage and traffic danger, and that the Openbaar Lichaam is primarily responsible for animal welfare.
The Openbaar Lichaam Bonaire is primarily responsible for animal welfare.
Het Openbaar Lichaam Bonaire is eerstverantwoordelijke voor het welzijn van dieren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Thieme over de dreiging van ziekmakende en levensbedreigende bacteriën op vlees

An MP asked the minister about Wakker Dier findings of bacteria such as ESBL-producing strains, E. coli, Listeria and Campylobacter on barbecue meat, and whether bacterial counts above ten million cfu per gram show spoiled meat and call for a legal limit. The minister confirmed the findings, said that bacterial counts are a hygiene signal rather than a spoilage measure, and declined to introduce a legal cfu limit for fresh meat, pointing to producer and supermarket responsibility.
This is also the reason why there is no legal norm for the number of bacteria per gram of meat.
Dit is ook de reden dat er geen wettelijke norm is voor het aantal bacteriën per gram vlees.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Thieme over de betrouwbaarheid van aantalsschattingen van ganzen en andere watervogelsoorten

An MP asked the state secretary whether Alterra research showing that hunting-association (WBE) counts of geese and waterbirds are systematically higher than SOVON counts undermines the reliability of hunting plans, and whether the bias could lead to excessive culling. The secretary acknowledged the findings, attributed the differences to counting methods and timing, said provinces decide which figures to use, and defended the role of WBEs in the proposed Natuurwet.
Provincial executives, which are responsible for issuing culling exemptions, work on the basis of the best information available at the time.
Gedeputeerde staten, die verantwoordelijk zijn voor de afgifte van ontheffingen voor afschot, gaan uit van de op dat moment best beschikbare informatie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Thieme over experimenten waarbij Facebookgebruikers betrokken zijn en de privacy van social mediagebruikers

An MP asked the government about Facebook's 2012 experiment on 689,000 users that manipulated news feeds, whether consent, transparency of selection criteria, protection of minors and third-party data sharing comply with the Dutch data protection act. The state secretary declined to give a substantive ethical judgment, pointed to the Wbp consent and information rules, and left specific compliance questions to the independent CBP data protection authority.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Thieme over het bericht ‘NVWA veegt fouten onder het tapijt’

The MP Thieme asks the state secretary how she assesses an Ombudsman report on non-transparency about pigs contaminated with a hormone in feed, whether the Ombudsman's recommendations were followed, whether further test results will be disclosed, and the status of the NVWA investigation into illegal hormones. The state secretary replies that the Ombudsman is independent, that the recommendation was followed with a conversation with the farmer whose outcome is confidential, that all available information was already shared, and that the investigation is ongoing with no new results to report yet.
All available information has been shared; I therefore refer to the answers to parliamentary questions 1, 2, 3, 4, 5 and 8 of 7 March 2013.
Alle beschikbare informatie is gedeeld, ik verwijs hiervoor dan ook naar de beantwoording op Kamervragen 1 2, 3, 4, 5 en 8 van 7 maart 2013.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Thieme over het bericht dat dieren gedood worden als gevolg van de vondst van het verboden antibioticum furazolidon op diverse kalverhouderijen

An MP asks the State Secretary for Economic Affairs about mass culling of calves after the banned antibiotic furazolidon was found in feed, including whether individual testing should be required, who bears testing costs, how the contamination occurred, and how it relates to past feed-sector scandals and a positive list of feed ingredients. The State Secretary answers that individual testing is an option for farmers under EU Directive 96/23/EC, that costs fall on the farmer, that the criminal investigation prevents comment, and that a positive list is unnecessary given existing EU registration.
No statements can be made about ongoing criminal investigations.
Over lopende strafrechtelijke onderzoeken kunnen geen mededelingen worden gedaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Thieme over de toenemende verwaarlozing van landbouwdieren

An MP asked the government about rising neglect of farm animals and the NVWA finding that 60 farmers are notorious offenders, including whether a permanent ban on keeping animals could be imposed as a standalone measure. The state secretary described an integrated prevention and support approach, reported the violations and animals taken into custody, and deferred the question on a standalone ban to answers from the Minister of Justice and Security.

For the answer to these questions I refer you to the answers to the questions from members Van Gerven (SP) and Schouw (D66) to the Minister of Security and Justice on the ban on keeping animals as a standalone penalty

Voor het antwoord op deze vragen verwijs ik u naar de antwoorden op de vragen van de leden Van Gerven (SP) en Schouw (D66) aan de Minister van Veiligheid en Justitie over het houdverbod als zelfstandige straf
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Thieme over het houden van kamelen en dromedarissen en de overdracht van MERS

An MP asked whether the Berlicum camel dairy's exemption for keeping dromedaries, its routine oxytocin use and mother-young separation, and the MERS transmission risk were acceptable. The State Secretary answered that the exemption was extended to 2018 under conditions, oxytocin is no longer used structurally, MERS is not present in the Netherlands, and no ban or further investigation is planned.

Given that the welfare regulations for production animals are complied with, the company is under veterinary supervision and oxytocin is no longer structurally used to stimulate milk release, I extended the exemption for the company in 2013 by 5 years to 1 March 2018, subject to conditions.

Gelet het feit dat de voorschriften van het Besluit welzijn productiedieren wordt nageleefd, het bedrijf onder controle staat van een dierenarts en oxytocine niet meer structureel wordt toegepast om de melkgift te stimuleren heb ik onder voorwaarden de ontheffing voor het bedrijf in 2013 verlengd met 5 jaar tot 1 maart 2018.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Thieme en Ouwehand over het gebruik van levende dieren bij militaire oefeningen

MPs Thieme and Ouwehand asked whether the Ministry of Defence should stop using live animals in military medical training, given available simulators and EU rules, and why it allegedly told PETA US otherwise. The minister acknowledged live-animal training remains mandatory for trauma surgeons and anaesthetists (DSTC/DATC courses) with no alternative, denied a breach of Dutch law, and admitted the 2011 statement to PETA was inaccurate.
This information is not known to me. There are no international agreements or obligations regarding such reporting, and in practice this information is also not exchanged.
Deze informatie is mij niet bekend. Er zijn geen internationale afspraken of verplichtingen inzake dergelijke rapportages en ook in de praktijk wordt deze informatie niet uitgewisseld.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Gesthuizen, Van Laar, Thieme en Voordewind over misstanden bij de productie van handgeknoopte tapijten in India

MPs from SP, PvdA, PvdD and ChristenUnie asked the minister for Foreign Trade and Development about child labour and forced labour in India's hand-knotted carpet industry, and whether Dutch importers are involved. The minister acknowledges the severe abuses, reports that the Dutch import market is small and that voluntary initiatives such as Goodweave and Care & Fair have limited reach, and lists development projects and dialogue with India as follow-up.
Statistics Netherlands publishes only aggregated data and provides no overview of individual companies importing carpets from India.
Het CBS publiceert alleen geaggregeerde data en geeft geen overzicht van individuele bedrijven die tapijten uit India importeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Thieme over Chinees mensenhaar in brood

An MP asked whether Chinese human hair or goose feathers are used to make L-cysteine, a bread improver ingredient, and whether this reaches Dutch bread, and called for an import ban. The minister answered that the source is not known to her, that EU law prohibits human-origin L-cysteine and bans relevant animal-origin imports from China, and that Dutch bakery suppliers reportedly use only plant-based L-cysteine, so no further consumer information is planned.
I am not aware whether L-cysteine is extracted from human hair in China or whether this hair is collected from local hairdressers.
Mij is niet bekend of L-cysteïne in China uit mensenhaar wordt gewonnen en of deze haren bij de plaatselijke kappers worden opgehaald.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Thieme over het stelen van honden in Roemenië

An MP asked the government about reports that a Dutch dog shelter in Romania was looted, whether Romanian authorities reward killing stray dogs, and whether EU funds are used and what action will be taken. The government said it had no evidence of killing bounties beyond small local payments and some municipal fees, called the case regrettable, and said it will raise concerns about local enforcement with its Romanian counterpart.
I will therefore share my concerns about the implementation of Romanian legislation at local level with my Romanian colleague on the margins of the Agriculture and Fisheries Council.
Ik zal daarom mijn zorgen over de uitvoering van de Roemeense wetgeving op lokaal niveau en marge van de Landbouw- en Visserijraad delen met mijn Roemeense collega.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Thieme over het serveren van halal voedsel tijdens NSS2014

An MP asked whether all food served at the 2014 Nuclear Security Summit was halal, whether meat from non-stunned animals was served without guests being informed, and whether the government would stop serving such meat at officially commissioned meals. The state secretary answered that not all food was halal, that the caterer used both regular and halal-certified meat, and that the EU is studying mandatory labelling while government meals accommodate guests' dietary wishes.
The cabinet follows developments on this closely.
Het kabinet volgt de ontwikkelingen hieromtrent op de voet.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Thieme over over het weigeren meerjarige tapstatistieken van de AIVD openbaar te maken

Thieme (PvdD) asked whether Minister Plasterk was right to refuse public release of multi-year AIVD wiretap statistics, despite CTIVD's view that they are not state secret. The minister confirmed the refusal, arguing that long-run tap figures would reveal the service's modus operandi and that disclosure breaches the secrecy duty in article 15 WIV 2002, while noting the exact figures are shared confidentially with the parliamentary committee and the CTIVD.
Publicly disclosing that data would violate the secrecy obligation laid down in article 15 of the Intelligence and Security Services Act (WIV2002).
Het openbaar maken van die gegevens is in strijd met de geheimhoudingsplicht, zoals vastgelegd in artikel 15 van de Wet op de Inlichtingen- en Veiligheidsdiensten (WIV2002).
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Thieme over wedstrijden dieren doodschieten

An MP asks whether hunting contests to shoot as many crows and jackdaws as possible, including during breeding season, are acceptable and whether the exemption list should be reconsidered. The Secretary of State calls framing pest control as a contest inappropriate but says the species may legally be hunted year-round and defers responsibility for conduct to hunters.
I find it inappropriate that pest control and damage control are announced as a contest.
Ik vind het ongepast dat beheer en schadebestrijding als wedstrijd wordt aangekondigd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Thieme over zwanendrifter in de fout

An MP asked the ministers whether a swan drifter caught with 18 swans, some bloodied, was fined or prosecuted for animal cruelty and Flora- and Faunawet violations, and whether his exemption could be revoked. The government answered that no fine or animal-cruelty report was issued, that the police findings are recorded and the violations are still being assessed, that revocation is possible if violations are established, and that the NVWA carried out no inspections in 2013 but plans to do so this year.
At this moment it is being examined whether there has been a violation of the laws and regulations and if so which.
Op dit moment wordt bekeken óf er sprake is geweest van een overtreding van de wet- en regelgeving en zo ja welke.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Thieme over de Gelderse voorkeur voor afschot boven hekken

An MP (Thieme, PvdD) asks the State Secretary for Economic Affairs whether a Gelderland deputy's preference for culling over fencing conflicts with the Flora and Fauna Act's requirement that other solutions come first. The State Secretary says the provinces are responsible for wildlife management and the deputy's views are his own, so she will not intervene, though she accepts the statutory principle that harm should be minimised.
I leave the statements in question to the responsibility of the deputy.
De bedoelde uitspraken laat ik voor rekening van de gedeputeerde.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Thieme over het afschieten van huiskraaien

An MP asked the state secretary about shooting house crows in Hoek van Holland by a hired wildlife manager who allegedly killed a protected jackdaw, and about the classification of native versus alien species. The secretary answered that the permit decision lies with the province of Zuid-Holland, that shooting was allowed only as a last resort per the provincial order, and that the house crow is an invasive alien species under national rules while the Vogelrichtlijn protects all wild European species.
Withdrawing the order is, incidentally, a power that lies with the province.
Het eventueel intrekken van de aanwijzing is overigens een bevoegdheid, die ligt bij de provincie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Thieme over gefokte fazanten voor de jacht

An MP from the Party for the Animals asked the State Secretary for Economic Affairs whether a pheasant breeder supplying birds for hunting and consumption violates the ban on releasing animals for hunting, and whether labelling or a breeding ban is needed. The State Secretary said there is no indication birds are sold to Dutch hunters for release, that releasing is banned under the Flora and Fauna Act, that breeding captive animals is permitted, and referred back to earlier answers on labelling.
I have no indications that animals are sold to Dutch hunters to be released.
Ik heb geen aanwijzingen dat dieren aan Nederlandse jagers worden verkocht om deze uit te zetten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Thieme en Ouwehand over het gebruik van levende dieren bij militaire oefeningen

Two MPs asked the government whether it condones live-animal military training such as shooting pigs and goat trauma drills, and whether Dutch soldiers take part in such training. The minister answered that the armed forces limit animal use as far as possible, that survival and trauma-surgery training uses pigs and rabbits or chickens under supervision, and that she cannot commit to ending such training for Dutch soldiers.
No, this information is not available.
Nee, deze informatie is niet beschikbaar.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Thieme over het verbod op het aanbinden van koeien

MP Thieme asked the State Secretary of Economic Affairs about extending the tie-stall derogation for organic cows, the number of organic farms still tying cows, and animal welfare concerns. The State Secretary answered that the small-stall definition will be temporarily widened to 50 animals until 1 January 2016, with agreements with Bionext to phase out tying, and that inspections and welfare rules remain in place.
I have decided to temporarily widen the definition of small stalls until 1 January 2016, from 10 to 50 animals.
Ik heb besloten de definitie voor kleine stallen tijdelijk tot 1 januari 2016 te verruimen van 10 tot 50 dieren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Thieme over het doodschieten van een verweesd jong damhert bij Marum

An MP asked whether police shot a young orphaned fallow deer in a pasture near Marum, whether less lethal alternatives were tried, and whether protocols were followed. The minister said an internal police investigation is ongoing and cannot be anticipated, and that the duty of care under the Flora- and faunawet applies, but whether it was met cannot be said while the investigation runs.
An internal police investigation into the precise events in this case is under way. I cannot anticipate the results of this investigation.
Er loopt een intern politieonderzoek naar de precieze gebeurtenissen in deze zaak. Ik kan niet op de resultaten van dit onderzoek vooruitlopen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Thieme over biggensterfte door onderkoeling

An MP from the Party for the Animals asked the State Secretary of Economic Affairs about piglets hung on wash clips to prevent drowning after hypothermia, the number of piglets dying from cold, and whether reducing litter size would reduce piglet mortality. The State Secretary said the rescue action is acceptable within the sustainable livestock vision but could be replaced by welfare-friendlier vests, and that no data exist on hypothermia deaths or the share of mortality it causes.
No data on this are recorded.
Hier worden geen gegevens over geregistreerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Thieme over de mogelijkheden voor een importverbod op foie gras

An MP from the Party for the Animals asked the State Secretary for Economic Affairs whether the Netherlands could ban imports of foie gras because its production breaches EU animal welfare Directive 98/58/EC and Council of Europe recommendations, and whether the Dutch government would press for an EU-wide ban on individual cages and force-feeding. The State Secretary opposed the force-feeding practice but said an import ban is not legally possible on animal welfare grounds under EU law, and committed to ask the Commission to monitor France's cage phase-out by 2016 and to commission research into welfare and alternatives.
Moreover, introducing a national import ban on grounds of animal welfare is not possible under European law.
Het instellen van een nationaal importverbod op grond van dierenwelzijn is Europeesrechtelijk bovendien niet mogelijk.
Antwoord op vragen het lid Thieme over de ontwikkeling van stapelbakstallen

The MP Thieme asks the State Secretary of Economic Affairs about the Hy-care stacked-pen pig housing concept, including plastic pens moved by conveyor and stacking, and whether this is ethical and has social support. The State Secretary answers that the concept may improve welfare and reduce antibiotics if it meets current law, but acknowledges it may further industrialise pig farming and that ethical and social acceptance must be examined further.
From the perspective of social acceptance and ethics, such a development must be examined further.
Vanuit maatschappelijke acceptatie en ethisch oogpunt moet een dergelijke ontwikkeling nader worden bezien.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Thieme over rondslingerende munitie in de natuur

An MP asked the Minister of Security and Justice whether lead ammunition should be banned for hunting and pest control in the Netherlands, following reports of hunters losing ammunition in nature. The minister answered that such data are unavailable, noted that 14 EU states ban lead shot, and declined to extend the ban to lead bullets, citing insufficient grounds from the single incident.
The incident mentioned in the cited media report gives me insufficient reason to extend the existing ban on lead shot to a ban on lead cartridges for hunting and pest control.

Het incident, genoemd in het aangehaalde mediabericht, geeft mij onvoldoende aanleiding om het geldende verbod op het gebruik van loodhoudende hagel uit te breiden met een verbod op het gebruik van loodhoudende kogelpatronen voor jacht en schadebestrijding.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Thieme over de toepassing van arsenicum in de kippen- en kalkoenindustrie in de Verenigde Staten

An MP asked the government about US use of arsenic-based growth promoters in poultry and turkey, EU bans, arsenic toxicity, labelling of imported products, and whether an EU-US trade deal would allow imports of meat from animals given such additives. The government welcomed US attention, confirmed EU bans and limits on arsenic in feed, said it lacked an overview of other countries' rules, and stated that EU food and product safety standards are not up for negotiation in the trade talks.
There will be no compromise on consumer and product safety.
Er zal niet ingeboet worden op consument- en productveiligheid.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Thieme over geweld tegen Australisch exportvee in Gaza

An MP asked the Dutch government whether it knows of videos showing extreme violence against Australian export cattle in Gaza, whether Dutch live animals are exported there, and whether it will press Gaza and Australian counterparts to act. The government confirmed the videos, stated that no live cattle are exported directly from the Netherlands to Gaza because no veterinary certificate exists, declined official contact with Gaza under its no-contact policy, and said Australia must make its own decision.
No live cattle are exported directly from the Netherlands to Gaza, because the Netherlands has not agreed a veterinary export certificate with Gaza.
Er worden vanuit Nederland in directe zin geen levende runderen naar Gaza geëxporteerd omdat Nederland geen veterinair exportcertificaat is overeengekomen met Gaza.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Thieme over het gebruik van de geboortekrik

An MP asked the State Secretary of Economic Affairs about the use of calving jacks (geboortekrik) in cattle births, which is banned, including whether it is used illegally, whether enforcement occurs, and whether difficult births and calf mortality are rising. The government answered that use is hard to detect, no enforcement action was taken in the past twelve months, difficult births have fallen, and it intends to regulate use with conditions for users and equipment.
Use of a calving jack is difficult to establish and check, because it can only be detected in the act.
Het gebruik van een veeverlosser is lastig te constateren en te controleren, omdat dit alleen op heterdaad kan gebeuren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Voordewind, Jan Vos, Gesthuizen, Agnes Mulder, Thieme, Baay-Timmerman en Van Ojik over kinderarbeid bij de katoenproductie in Turkije

Seven MPs asked the Minister for Foreign Trade and Development about child labour in Turkish cotton production, the follow-up to a Dutch-funded study, pressure on Turkish authorities and the ILO, the textile sector's responsibility, traceability of Turkish cotton, the MVO risk analysis, ILO child labour figures and child labour raised on trade missions. The minister answered that projects, workshops and a sector action plan are underway, that no EU action plan is needed given ILO efforts, that traceability is not feasible, and that the sector selection will be presented in summer 2014.
The Turkish government is primarily responsible for eliminating child labour.
De Turkse overheid is primair verantwoordelijk voor de uitbanning van kinderarbeid.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Thieme over het vangen van duiven in Amsterdam

An MP asks the State Secretary for Economic Affairs about a pigeon-catching operation in Amsterdam, including whether the licence conditions were met and whether the licence should be withdrawn. The State Secretary declines to answer the questions substantively, citing an ongoing police investigation and a pending enforcement request, and promises to inform the House once the investigation is concluded.
While the investigation is ongoing, I will not disclose information about this case.
Lopende het onderzoek breng ik geen informatie over deze zaak naar buiten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Thieme over de angorawolproductie

An MP asked the State Secretary for Economic Affairs about the treatment of rabbits in angora wool production, the share of Chinese imports, a possible national import ban, and labelling rules. The State Secretary condemned the practice, reported EU import volumes, said the government would consult on possible actions, and confirmed that EU regulation already requires angora labelling.
Statistics on global production of angora wool are not known.
Statistieken over de wereldwijde productie van angorawol zijn niet bekend.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Thieme over het jagen op vossen in het donker
