An MP from the Party for the Animals asked the State Secretary for Economic Affairs and the Minister of Security and Justice about Council of State rulings that the Benelux treaty bans night hunting and artificial light in fox management, and how many provincial exemptions exist and whether they will be revoked. The State Secretary confirmed the rulings, said two exemptions were annulled and others are in court, and referred to a letter of 6 December 2013 for the remaining questions.
Two of those exemptions were annulled last Wednesday.
Twee van die ontheffingen zijn afgelopen woensdag vernietigd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Bommel, Voordewind, Van der Staaij, Sjoerdsma, Thieme, Van Ojik en Omtzigt over het autorijverbod voor vrouwen in Saoedi-Arabië

MPs from several parties asked the Foreign Minister about arrests and fines of women defying Saudi Arabia's driving ban and the detention of a journalist supporting women's right to drive, and whether the government would press Saudi counterparts. The minister confirmed short detentions that could not be independently verified, said the journalist was briefly held and has been released, described the situation as concerning while noting some reforms, and stated the issue is raised in EU and UPR dialogue.
However, it is not possible to independently confirm the number of women detained, nor whether they were fined.
Het is echter niet mogelijk om het aantal vrouwen dat is vastgezet onafhankelijk bevestigd te krijgen, noch of zij zijn beboet.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Thieme over de belofte van de minister aan de Van Drie Group

MP Thieme asked the minister about her reported promise to help the Van Drie Group export, given inspection failures and the food-safety investigation into slaughterhouses and meat handling. The minister defended export support for the meat sector, pointed to NVWA reforms, a Taskforce Voedselvertrouwen and a pending Safety Board investigation, and refused to retract her earlier statements.
I cannot anticipate the conclusions of this.
Ik kan niet vooruitlopen op conclusies hiervan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Thieme over het doden van honden in Roemenië

An MP asked the State Secretary for Economic Affairs and the Foreign Minister about Romania's law permitting mass killing of stray dogs and whether the government will raise it with Romania. The government replied that decisions are made case by case by local authorities, that euthanasia must be performed by a vet using a quick, painless method, and that Dutch NGOs can be put in contact with Romanian authorities.
It is for the Romanian authorities to formulate policy in compliance with European and international regulations.
Het is aan de Roemeense autoriteiten om beleid te formuleren met in achtneming van Europese en internationale regelgeving.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Thieme over seleenvergiftiging bij zeugen en de volksgezondheidsrisico’s bij de consumptie van varkensvlees

An MP asked about possible selenium poisoning in sows, excessive selenium use in pig feed and public health risks from pork, and whether intensive sow breeding endangers animal welfare. The minister replied that there are no signs of widespread overdosing, that the two farm cases were isolated and within the legal limit, and that existing projects address sow longevity and welfare.
I have no indications that selenium is excessively administered to sows on a large scale.
Ik heb geen aanwijzingen dat selenium op grote schaal overmatig aan zeugen wordt toegediend.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Thieme over Canadese en Nederlandse robotvogels

An MP asked the state secretary for Economic Affairs whether a trial with robotic birds (drones) to deter geese and gulls, as used in Ottawa, would be organised in the Netherlands, and why robirds are no longer used at Schiphol. The government answered that Schiphol's experiments in 2008-2009 were ended because results were insufficient, since the robot bird was hard to fit into airport bird-control operations, could not operate in wind or rain, and only worked on airport grounds.
The experiments were ended because the results were not sufficient.
De experimenten werden beëindigd omdat de resultaten niet voldoende waren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Thieme over de sloop van flats in Hoensbroek zonder ontheffing

An MP asked the state secretary whether the municipality of Heerlen would demolish flats in Hoensbroek without the required wildlife exemption protecting house sparrows and swifts, and whether enforcement would follow. The state secretary answered that Heerlen has committed to applying for the exemption for these species before starting demolition, so the state secretary expects the legal rules to be followed.
I assume, following the commitments of the municipality of Heerlen, that the legal rules will be observed.
Ik ga er, na de toezeggingen van de gemeente Heerlen, van uit dat de wettelijke regels in acht genomen zullen worden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Thieme over bijsluiters bij diergeneesmiddelen

MP Thieme asked the state secretary whether owners buying veterinary medicines receive no package leaflet, and whether leaflets should be mandatory as for human medicines to fight antibiotic resistance. The state secretary replied that leaflets are mandatory and must contain all relevant information, and that a leaflet may only be omitted if the information is already on the packaging, including when medicines are repackaged.
A package leaflet is mandatory and may only be omitted when all relevant information is already on the primary and outer packaging.
Een bijsluiter is verplicht en mag alleen achterwege gelaten worden wanneer alle relevante informatie al op de primaire en op de buitenverpakking is aangebracht.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Thieme over het verjagen van herten met gemeenschapsgeld in de Hierdense Poort

MP Thieme asks why community money (EUR 5,000 from the province of Gelderland) is paid to a hunting unit to chase red deer away from a wildlife overpass, and whether the overpass should be closed to deer and the province held to account under the Flora and Fauna Act. The State Secretary replies that the payment is a one-off support measure to build goodwill and prevent damage, that ecoducts are important for biodiversity but deer should be chased from farmland, and that she sees no violation or need to amend the code.
No, I do not share this view. The province implements nature policy, including by reconnecting nature areas through ecoducts.
Nee, deze mening deel ik niet. De provincie geeft uitvoering aan natuurbeleid, onder andere door het (weer) verbinden van (natuur)gebieden door ecoducten
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Thieme over het uitzetten van edelherten in klein omhekt gebied

An MP asked the State Secretary of Economic Affairs about releasing red deer into a small fenced area in Noord-Brabant, questioning whether the herd is viable, whether it counts as release under the Flora and Fauna Act, the provincial role, and the biodiversity claims. The State Secretary answered that the animals are kept rather than released, that captive-bred deer fall under a statutory exemption, that the provincial policy is autonomous, and that low deer density can benefit biodiversity.
There is no question of release here but of keeping red deer.
Er is hier geen sprake van uitzetten maar van het houden van edelherten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Thieme over het serveren van de beschermde spreeuw

An MP asked the state secretary whether a Utrecht restaurant serving protected starling should be stopped, whether the species' decline warrants removing it from the pest-control list, and whether pest-control exemptions create a perverse incentive for commercial hunting. The state secretary answered that the starling stays on the list because it is still common and can cause local damage, that commercial use of protected species is undesirable, that the existing law already requires no satisfactory alternatives, and that enforcement against the restaurant is for the province.
It is up to the province to take enforcement action.
Het is aan de provincie om handhavend op te treden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Thieme over het stikken van varkens door een kapot ventilatiesysteem

An MP from the Party for the Animals asked the state secretary for Economic Affairs about the deaths of about 1,100 pigs after a ventilation failure at a farm in Milheeze, whether the fault went unnoticed for a day, whether earlier similar incidents occurred, and whether alarm, timing-control or outdoor-access rules should be imposed. The state secretary said the investigation is ongoing, cited three earlier pig incidents and two poultry cases, and declined to introduce mandatory alarm-logging or timing-control systems, instead promising extra summer stable-climate inspections.
The investigation into the cause of this calamity has not yet been completed, but preliminary results show that neither the emergency system nor the alarm came into operation.
Het onderzoek naar de toedracht van deze calamiteit is nog niet afgerond maar uit voorlopige resultaten blijkt dat zowel het noodsysteem als het alarm niet in werking zijn getreden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Thieme over Mishandeling van pony’s

An MP asked the state secretary about online videos showing women riding and mistreating undersized ponies, whether the perpetrators are Dutch, and whether enforcement against animal mistreatment should be tightened. The government confirmed it disapproves of the conduct, declined to comment on the ongoing criminal investigation, and pointed to strengthened enforcement capacity, seeing no reason for further tightening.
A criminal investigation is currently ongoing. Due to the investigative interest, no statements can be made about the criminal investigation.
Er loopt momenteel een strafrechtelijk onderzoek. In verband met het opsporingsbelang kunnen over het strafrechtelijk onderzoek geen mededelingen worden gedaan.
Antwoord vragen Voordewind, Thieme, Krol en Gesthuizen over kinderarbeid en lage lonen bij Nederlandse zaadbedrijven in India

Four MPs asked the minister about child labour and low wages at Dutch seed companies Bejo Zaden and Nunhems in India, and about the sector's due diligence and CSR commitments. The minister responded that the government wants child labour eliminated, that Bejo Sheetal did not join the FLA, that Plantum will evaluate members' policies, and that Bejo and Nunhems will introduce new measures including monitoring and minimum wage commitments.
In the meeting with Plantum, the implementation of the Plantum statement on the prevention of child labour was discussed.
In het gesprek met Plantum is de uitvoering van de « Plantum statement on the prevention of child labour» aan de orde geweest.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Thieme met betrekking tot de opgehangen ezels op Bonaire

An MP asked the state secretary about images of wild donkeys hanged in Bonaire, the status of a donkey management plan, and whether the Bonaire authority will investigate abuse. The state secretary confirmed knowing the images, said the plan's timing is unknown, and said animal welfare is the responsibility of the Bonaire public body, adding that the reports may concern goats rather than donkeys.
As indicated in the answers to questions on the welfare of donkeys on Sint Eustatius of 17 April, ensuring animal welfare is a responsibility of the public body.

Zoals aangegeven in de antwoorden op vragen over het welzijn van ezels op Sint-Eustatius van 17 april jl. is het waarborgen van het welzijn van dieren een verantwoordelijkheid van het Openbaar Lichaam.
Antwoord vragen Thieme over dode dieren in een Rotterdamse dierenwinkel.

An MP asked the state secretary how about a hundred dead animals could lie unnoticed for months in a Rotterdam pet shop, whether the shop had the required competence and permits, and whether sales rules and enforcement would be tightened. The state secretary confirmed the case, said enforcement relies on reports, withheld details due to an ongoing criminal investigation, and pointed to planned Besluit gezelschapsdieren rules and joint NVWA/LID enforcement from 2014 while rejecting a fixed registration of every animal and a sharp cut in sales outlets.
Because of the interest of criminal investigation, no statements can be made about the criminal investigation.
In verband met het opsporingsbelang kunnen over het strafrechtelijk onderzoek geen mededelingen worden gedaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Thieme over het doodmaaien van vogels en verwoesten van nesten

An MP from the Party for the Animals asked the government how it reconciles mowing during the breeding season and destroying nests with the Flora and Fauna Act, whether it will ban maintenance and hunting during breeding season, and how it will improve enforcement and a code of conduct for mowing. The state secretary answered that the Act already protects nesting sites, rejected a general breeding-season ban as disproportionate, saw the Rhenoy case as an incident with local enforcement working well, and reported that an agricultural code of conduct lacked sufficient support.

No, such a ban would constitute too severe an intrusion on practice in the agricultural and timber sectors, would have only a very minimal added value compared with the current legal protection, and would therefore overshoot its goal.

Nee, een dergelijk verbod zou een te zware inbreuk vormen op de praktijk van onder andere de agrarische en de houtsector, slechts een zeer minimale meerwaarde hebben ten opzichte van de huidige wettelijke bescherming en daarmee zijn doel voorbij schieten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Thieme over het schieten van zogende dieren

An MP asked the State Secretary of Economic Affairs whether shooting a nursing fox, leaving her cubs orphaned, is unacceptable animal suffering and whether a hunting ban during gestation and nursing should be introduced, and whether prosecution should follow under the Flora- and Faunawet duty of care. The State Secretary answered that shooting nursing animals should be avoided and a general hunting ban is disproportionate, leaving prosecution to the Public Prosecution Service.
I do not comment on prosecuting persons in individual cases. That decision is for the Public Prosecution Service.
Ik doe geen uitspraak over het vervolgen van personen in individuele zaken. Die beslissing is aan het Openbaar Ministerie.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Thieme over bevorderen van voedselzekerheid

An MP asked the trade and development minister whether reducing meat consumption should guide Dutch policy and whether export promotion of livestock and animal protein should be abandoned. The minister answered that Dutch livestock exports will not be discouraged, that sustainable production and export of housing systems is supported, and that vegetarian options are offered at official dinners.
I therefore do not want to discourage the export of these high-quality housing systems.
Export van deze hoogwaardige houderijsystemen wil ik dan ook niet ontmoedigen.
Antwoord vragen Thieme over de openbaarheid van jachtgegevens

Parliamentary questions from MP Thieme ask whether the government will ask provinces to publish hunting-area data after the Council of State ruled in a Gelderland case, and whether AIVD reports support the claim that disclosure enables disruption of wildlife management. Minister Plasterk declines to judge the province's conduct, says the Council of State's reasoning concerns only the specific parties, and states that the AIVD will publish an extremism report in September 2013 which will be shared with parliament.
I expect this publication to appear in September 2013 and will therefore share it with the House.
Ik verwacht dat deze publicatie in september 2013 zal verschijnen en zal haar dan ook delen met de Kamer.
Antwoord vragen Thieme over de inzet van chemicaliën tegen betogers in Turkije

MP Thieme asked the Foreign Minister whether the reported use of chemicals against protesters in Istanbul is disproportionate and whether the government will raise its concerns with Turkey. Minister Timmermans said he deplores the excessive force, shared his concerns with his Turkish counterpart, who promised an investigation, and that good relations allow mutual concerns to be voiced.
I deplore the excessive violence used against demonstrators, such as during the clearing of Taksim Square and Gezi Park on the weekend of 15 and 16 June.
Ik betreur het buitensporige geweld dat is gebruikt tegen demonstranten, zoals bij de ontruiming van het Taksimplein en het Gezi park in het weekend van 15 en 16 juni.
Antwoord vragen Thieme over het vergassen van ganzen in de wijde omgeving van Schiphol in 2013

MP Thieme asks the state secretaries about the 2013 CO2 gassing of geese around Schiphol, the exemption granted to Duke Faunabeheer, lease conditions, the Luchthavenindelingbesluit, the grain-ploughing subsidy, transparency of the goose management plan, the Raad voor Dierenaangelegenheden advice, costs, and the scientific basis for the cull. The government answers that the exemption was granted, lease conditions and bird-test plans are being developed, the subsidy runs to 2017, the Stichting withheld tender details, and costs are about 5 euro per goose.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Thieme over boogschieten op damherten

MP Thieme asked the ministers whether the perpetrator of a bow-and-arrow shooting of a fallow deer had been found, whether the government is aware of the Dutch archers' association's push to legalise bow hunting, and whether there are plans to legalise it. The minister replied that the police investigation was halted for lack of leads, that bow hunting remains prohibited under the Flora- and faunawet because of the risk of unnecessary suffering, and that there are no plans to legalise it.
There are no plans to legalise bow hunting.
Er zijn geen plannen om de boogjacht te legaliseren.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Thieme over het verlenen van een omgevingsvergunning voor de uitbreiding van een nertsenhouderij

An MP asked whether the municipality of Bladel could grant an environmental permit for expanding a mink farm given the Dutch ban on fur farming, and whether the state would stop violations. The state secretary answered that municipalities cannot refuse such permits under the Wabo because the ban is ethical rather than environmental, and that the NVWA will enforce the ban.
Under the Wabo, the municipality therefore has no possibility to refuse a permit with a view to the Fur Farming Ban Act.
Op grond van de Wabo is er voor de gemeente dus geen mogelijkheid om een vergunning te weigeren met het oog op de Wet verbod pelsdierhouderij.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Thieme over de wettelijke bescherming van de huiskraai

Thieme (PvdD) asks why the state secretary removed the house crow from the protected species list in March 2013, whether it is native, and whether the change should be reversed while a court case by the Faunabescherming is pending. The secretary answers that the species is treated as an invasive alien species, that the removal resolves confusion between two regulations, that the European Commission confirmed the position, and that the government awaits the court's rulings.

Following the ruling, I concluded that the conflicting designations of the house crow as an invasive alien species in the Regulation on animal management and damage control, and as a protected species in the Announcement of protected species lists, cause unnecessary confusion.

Naar aanleiding van de uitspraak heb ik geconcludeerd dat de tegenstrijdige aanwijzingen van de huiskraai als invasieve exoot in de Regeling beheer en schadebestrijding dieren enerzijds en als beschermde soort in de Bekendmaking lijsten beschermde diersoorten anderzijds, tot onnodige verwarring leidt.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Thieme en Ouwehand over het gebruik van slangen in amusementsprogramma’s

MPs Thieme and Ouwehand asked the state secretary of Economic Affairs about snakes used in the entertainment show Killer Karaoke, including whether the stress caused to the animals should be combated and whether oversight should be tightened. The state secretary replied that the NVWA has started a criminal investigation under the Animal Health and Welfare Act, declined to comment on the stress while it is ongoing, and saw no reason to tighten oversight.
Pending that investigation, I make no statements about the remarks of Dr. Freek Vonk and the stress the snakes may have undergone.
Hangende dat onderzoek doe ik geen mededelingen over de uitlatingen van Dr. Freek Vonk en de stress, die de slangen mogelijk ondergaan hebben.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Thieme over het doden van zwerfdieren in Sotsji

An MP asked the Minister of Health, Welfare and Sport about reports that Sochi was removing stray animals before the 2014 Winter Olympics, including whether poison had been used and whether the minister would raise it with foreign counterparts. The minister answered that the matter is for Russian authorities, that animals should be killed humanely if necessary, and that she sees no need to contact foreign colleagues.
It is up to the Russian authorities themselves to determine how the problem of stray animals is tackled.
Het is daarbij aan de Russische autoriteiten zelf om te bepalen op welke wijze het probleem van zwerfdieren wordt aangepakt.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Thieme over de aanhouding van een jachtopziener voor illegale jacht

An MP asked the Minister of Security and Justice and the State Secretary of Economic Affairs about the arrest of a gamekeeper for illegal hunting at estate De Eese, including whether employers, hunters, the crown prince and the gamekeeper's BOA status should be scrutinised. The minister declined to say more on the ongoing criminal investigation, stated the BOA powers were withdrawn, denied the crown prince had hunted there, and rejected changes to BOA oversight.
In the interest of the investigation, the Public Prosecution Service cannot currently make any further statements.
In het belang van het onderzoek kan het Openbaar Ministerie thans geen verdere mededelingen doen.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Voordewind Bonis en Thieme over financiering van bouwprojecten in India waar schending van arbeids- en kinderrechten plaatsvindt

MPs Voordewind, Bonis and Thieme asked whether Dutch-funded Asian Development Bank projects in India involve child labour and labour rights abuses, and what the Netherlands will do about oversight and sanctions. Minister Ploumen answered that the ADB has labour standards in its contracts and monitoring mechanisms, that the Netherlands has pressed the bank to strengthen complaint and sanction mechanisms, and that she will ask Dutch-represented constituencies at other development banks to scrutinise labour standards.
In talks with the ADB, the Netherlands has pointed out that complaint handling, a sanctions mechanism and monitoring are important.
Nederland heeft in gesprek met de ADB erop gewezen klachtenbehandeling, een sanctiemechanisme en monitoring belangrijk te vinden.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Thieme over de aanwezigheid van huisdieren in voedsel en veevoer

An MP asked about reports that stray dogs, road-killed animals and pets were rendered into feed ingredients in Spain, possibly supplied to Dutch firms, and whether Dutch food safety controls (NVWA) are adequate and why no RASFF alert was raised. The state secretary answered that Spanish tests found no dog DNA, no evidence of Dutch involvement, that NVWA controls are sufficient, that licences can be withdrawn for illegal trade, and that dolphin DNA findings in tuna were from a small 2010 study and are being addressed at EU level.
So far there are no indications that this prohibition is being violated in the Netherlands.
Vooralsnog zijn er geen aanwijzingen dat in Nederland dit verbod wordt overtreden.
Antwoord vragen Thieme over de aanwezigheid van castoreum als smaak- of geurstof

An MP asked whether castoreum (beaver gland extract) is used as a flavouring in food, whether it must be labelled, and where it originates. The minister confirmed castoreum may be used as a natural aroma under EU rules, declined to research which foods contain it or to change labelling rules, and said the extract comes from North American beavers since European beavers are protected.
Given that castoreum extract is legally permitted for use as a flavouring in foodstuffs, I see no reason to investigate which foodstuffs contain castoreum extract.
Gezien het feit dat castoreum-extract wettelijk is toegestaan voor gebruik als aroma in levensmiddelen zie ik geen aanleiding om te onderzoeken in welke levensmiddelen castoreum-extract is verwerkt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Thieme over een vergunning voor de omstreden geitenstal in Landerd

An MP asked the ministers whether the controversial goat stable in Landerd may proceed despite a provincial construction stop and the Health Council's report on livestock health risks, and whether the Crown should annul the building permit. The government answered that annulment is discretionary, that no conflict with law or the general interest was found, that the permit was lawfully granted, and that it will not further suspend or annul the permit or await the cabinet response.
In this case it has become clear to me that no conflict with the law or the general interest has been shown.
In deze zaak is het mij duidelijk geworden dat er niet van strijd met het recht of het algemeen belang is gebleken.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Thieme over het pensioen van prinses Beatrix en belastingen voor de Koninklijke familie

MP Thieme (PvdD) asked the Prime Minister about a reported royal pension for Princess Beatrix, whether royal family members are exempt from personal taxes, how that fits article 40 of the constitution, and about transparency and comparisons with other European monarchies. The Prime Minister answered that royal family members are taxable with limited constitutional exemptions, pointed to the 2009 financial statute law's added transparency, and said a comparison with other monarchies is not feasible, without addressing the specific pension figures.

During the oral debate on the bill, the Prime Minister explained that members of the royal family are taxable and that the Constitution partially exempts a limited number of royal house members for a few specified subjects.

Tijdens de mondelinge behandeling van het wetsvoorstel heeft de minister-president toegelicht dat leden van de koninklijke familie belastingplichtig zijn en dat de Grondwet een beperkt aantal leden van het koninklijk huis hiervan ten dele vrijstelt
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Thieme over natuurbezuinigingen en schaapskuddes

An MP asked whether nature budget cuts caused the bankruptcy of a sheep herder on the Veluwe and whether the government would support finding a solution for the flock. The state secretary answered that the herder's problems stemmed from losing a tender for a project rather than from cuts, that an acute solution has been found, and that provinces now handle nature management subsidies.

I am glad that a solution for this flock appears to have been found, and I am willing to think along about solutions for roaming herded sheep flocks, taking into account the responsibility of the provinces.

Ik ben blij dat er een oplossing voor deze kudde gevonden lijkt en ik ben bereid mee te denken over oplossingen voor rondtrekkende gescheperde schaapskuddes, met in acht neming van de verantwoordelijkheid van de provincies.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Thieme over de verwaarlozing van ezels op Sint Eustatius

An MP asked the government about reports that dozens of stray donkeys on Sint Eustatius were held in a fenced area without adequate food and water, and whether national authorities should intervene and harmonise animal welfare rules. The state secretary answered that a drought caused a temporary feed shortage now resolved, that the public body is responsible and has acted with a stakeholder action plan, and that legislative restraint toward Caribbean Netherlands applies until the 2015 evaluation.
Ensuring animal welfare is a responsibility of the public body.
Het waarborgen van het welzijn van dieren is een verantwoordelijkheid van het openbaar lichaam.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Thieme en Ouwehand over Europese subsidies die het stierenvechten in stand houden

MPs Thieme and Ouwehand asked whether EU agricultural and cultural subsidies sustain bullfighting in Spain, including bull breeding, arena upkeep, and whether such subsidies should be withheld. The government answered that EU cultural funds do not finance arenas, bull breeding is not a separate EU subsidy category, and animal welfare and spending of national funds are member-state responsibilities, while promising only to support future welfare rules.
Fighting bulls do not form a separate category in relation to EU subsidies.
Vechtstieren vormen geen aparte categorie in relatie tot EU-subsidies.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Thieme over het zwanendriften

An MP asked whether the 2008 exemption allowing swan farming expires on 31 March 2013 and whether no new exemptions will be granted, and whether unannounced inspections took place in 2012. The state secretary confirmed the expiry and that no new exemptions will be issued, noting swans may still be kept as ornamental birds, and confirmed two inspections in 2012 found no violations.
Yes, no more exemptions will be granted.
Ja, er zullen geen ontheffingen meer worden verleend.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Thieme over preventie van obesitas bij kinderen door het toevoegen van smaakjes aan melkproducten te ontraden

MP Thieme asked the minister whether, following a study linking flavoured milk products to childhood overweight, the government would discourage adding flavours to dairy products for children's obesity prevention. The state secretary answered that the evidence is too limited to draw conclusions, that policy focuses on the overall diet rather than specific foods, and that the government will not discourage flavoured dairy, leaving responsibility with parents and industry.
No. See my answer to questions 1 and 2.
Nee. Zie mijn antwoord op vraag 1 en 2.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Thieme over preventief afschot van grote hoefdieren in Drenthe

An MP asked the state secretary about Drenthe province preemptively shooting red deer, wild boar and fallow deer when they cross provincial borders, and how this fits with ecological corridor policy. The state secretary confirmed the policy is provincial responsibility, declined to provide the requested cull figures, and said the state secretary will keep in contact with the responsible provincial deputy.
The culling concerned is the responsibility of the province of Drenthe.
Het betreffende afschot is de verantwoordelijkheid van de provincie Drenthe.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Thieme over de schandalen rond de herkomst van voedsel

An MP asks the state secretary about German egg-fraud scandals and the origin of food, including the scale of illegal battery-hen eggs and whether enforcement capacity will be expanded. The state secretary says the Dutch authorities are investigating, declines to give further details on an ongoing investigation, describes existing inspection arrangements, and promises a taskforce proposal before summer.
In the interest of the criminal investigation, I cannot provide further information on this.
In het belang van het opsporingsonderzoek kan ik hierover geen nadere mededelingen doen.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Thieme over een steakhouse dat al 63 jaar paard verkoopt als rund

An MP asked whether a steakhouse that served horse meat as beef for 63 years violated the Warenwet and why no proces verbaal had been drawn up. The minister answered that the Warenwet allows meat sold as steak regardless of species, that misleading labelling is assessed case by case by the NVWA, and that no proces verbaal had yet been drawn up but the NVWA has been asked to give the case due attention and report back.
I have asked the NVWA to give this matter the required attention and to inform me how it assesses this specific case.
Ik heb de NVWA verzocht hieraan de vereiste aandacht te geven en mij te informeren over hoe zij deze specifieke casus beoordeelt.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Thieme over diarreebacteriën die van varkens overgaan op mensen

An MP asks the state secretaries whether the transmission of resistant diarrhoea bacteria from pigs to humans, and their presence in air and meat, poses public health risks and calls for testing and policy changes. The government answers that the risk to public health is not large, that a follow-up NVWA meat study is planned for 2014, and that antibiotic reduction policy will continue, but declines to link the findings to the Health Council report or to extend the research beyond planned studies.
The NVWA has planned a follow-up study for 2014 on the presence of the bacterium on meat.
De NVWA heeft voor 2014 een vervolgonderzoek gepland naar het voorkomen van de bacterie op vlees.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Thieme over het bericht dat alle Nederlandse kip halal is

An MP asked the state secretary of Economic Affairs whether nearly all Dutch chickens are slaughtered halal without prior stunning, and about the NVWA's oversight, consumer labelling and welfare implications. The state secretary denied that nearly all chickens are slaughtered unstunned, said most halal poultry is stunned under EU-permitted methods that the NVWA enforces, and deferred labelling to the European Commission.
The NVWA does not track whether, or how much, meat from unstunned slaughtered animals ends up in the regular circuit.
De NVWA houdt niet bij of en zo ja hoeveel vlees afkomstig van onbedwelmd geslachte dieren in het reguliere circuit terecht komt.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Thieme over het bericht ‘NVWA veegt fouten onder het tapijt’

An MP asks the State Secretary for Economic Affairs why a pig farmer's requests for MPA test results from the MPA feed crisis were refused, whether the NVWA destroyed data, and what protocols and controls now exist. The State Secretary answers that the results were no longer archived after retention periods expired, denies intentional destruction, states that results are provided on request, and lists measures taken since then.
Test results are kept by the NVWA for 3 years.
Uitslagen van testen worden door de NVWA gedurende 3 jaar bewaard.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Thieme over de aanwezigheid van paardenvlees in rundvlees

An MP asked the state secretary why horsemeat mixed into beef escaped inspection, why a previously convicted trader could resume activities, and about stray dogs and diseased sheep in pet food, plus stricter enforcement, labelling and DNA testing. The government answered that such practices are hard to detect without cause, that the NVWA has a criminal investigation and a large-scale chain inspection underway, and that it will consider further measures and push for EU-level horse registration and origin labelling.
At present the NVWA is carrying out a large-scale chain investigation to check for the illegal mixing of beef with horsemeat.
Op dit moment voert de NVWA een grootschalig ketenonderzoek uit om te controleren op het illegaal vermengen van rundvlees met paardenvlees.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Thieme over een onlangs verleende vergunning voor een nertsenhouderij door de gemeente Putten

An MP asked the state secretary whether it is acceptable that the municipality of Putten granted a permit for a new mink farm just before the mink ban took effect, and whether steps can be taken to stop it. The state secretary answered that municipal environmental and building permits are assessed only on environmental and building criteria, so the ethical ground of the ban cannot be used to refuse them, and that no steps can be taken if the operator meets the ban's conditions.
Under the Wabo, the municipality therefore has no possibility to refuse a permit with a view to the Fur Farming Ban Act.
Op grond van de Wabo is er voor de gemeente dus geen mogelijkheid om een vergunning te weigeren met het oog op de Wet verbod pelsdierhouderij.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Thieme over de hermelijnen koningsmantel die zou worden gedragen t.b.v. staatsieportretten en de kroning

An MP asked whether the royal ermine-lined coronation mantle would be worn at the 2013 inauguration and state portraits, and whether this conflicts with protected-species and anti-fur-farming rules, and asked for the 1980 decree to be amended. The government answered that the historical mantle uses ermine fur, no fur has been added since 1980, wearing it follows existing rules and tradition, and it declined to amend the decree.
Wearing the mantle by the King is in accordance with the applicable regulations, the Flora and Fauna Act and historical custom.
Het dragen van de mantel door de Koning is in overeenstemming met de hiervoor geldende voorschriften, de Flora- en Faunawet en het historisch gebruik.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Thieme over het voorgeschreven hermelijnenbont in het kostuum- en titulatuurbesluit voor de rechtelijke organisatie

MP Thieme asks whether the 1997 robes decree, which prescribes ermine trim for Supreme Court judges' gowns and berets, should be amended given the ban on fur farming and ermine's protected status under the Flora and Fauna Act. The minister replies that the Supreme Court already uses imitation ermine in practice, so the decree is applied in spirit and no amendment is planned.
In practice, the prescriptions of Article 5(2) and Article 12(1) of the robes and titles decree for the judiciary are thereby implemented in the spirit of the law.

In de praktijk wordt daarmee aan de voorschriften uit artikel 5, tweede lid, en artikel 12, eerste lid, van het kostuum- en titulatuurbesluit rechterlijke organisatie, in de geest van de wet, uitvoering gegeven.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Thieme over de illegale handel in antibiotica in de veehouderij

An MP asked the government about the illegal trade in antibiotics for livestock farming, including a seizure of 3.5 tonnes, whether the registration system could prevent such trade, and whether further illegal circuits exist and will be investigated. The state secretary answered that the practice is condemned, the network was detected and dismantled by the NVWA, registration cannot prevent illegality but aids enforcement, a new registration duty for antibiotic traders under the Animal Act is coming, and extra enforcement funding is provided, though no indication of further circuits currently exists.
We have no indication that the illegal network in question could have been detected (much) earlier.
Wij hebben geen indicatie dat het betreffende illegale netwerk (veel) eerder had kunnen worden opgemerkt.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Thieme over topsalarissen op de ministeries

An MP asked the Minister of Interior about top salaries at ministries, including whether officials at the Education, Culture and Science ministry exceed the government norm, and whether a hourly rate cap for external advisers should be introduced. The minister confirmed two Wopt-reported cases, explained the WNT norm and the existing maximum hourly rate of 225 euros for external advisers, and stated no new hourly norm is planned, while agreeing that uncapped rates could fuel outsourcing.

For the ministries it has been agreed that they report annually in their departmental annual reports to the House of Representatives how often and on what grounds this maximum hourly rate has been exceeded.
Voor de ministeries is afgesproken dat zij jaarlijks in hun departementale jaarverslag aan de Tweede Kamer rapporteren hoe vaak en op grond van welke noodzaak dit maximumuurtarief is overschreden.
Antwoord vragen Thieme (PvdD) over gewonden door jachtongelukken

An MP asked the state secretary about hunting accidents that injured passers-by and a relative, whether such incidents are tracked, and whether shooting-skill tests and hunting-licence validity should be tightened. The government answered that no centralised data on such injuries exists, that the existing hunting exam and annual licence renewal are adequate, and that the incidents give no reason to tighten the rules.
The requested data on the number of passers-by or other people hit by hunting rifle bullets are not kept in a centralised system.
De gevraagde gegevens over het aantal passanten of andere mensen dat geraakt werd door kogels uit jachtgeweren, worden niet in een gecentraliseerd systeem bijgehouden.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Thieme over het aanbieden en uitzetten van kweekwild voor de jacht en consumptie

An MP from the Animal Party asked whether a company breeding wild animals for hunting and consumption could be selling them for release in the wild, and whether the sale of farmed game should be controlled or labelled. The state secretary replied that releasing animals is prohibited under the Flora and Fauna Act but breeding and trade are allowed, that cross-border free movement means released animals may end up sold in the Netherlands, and that no additional labelling or consumer information is planned.
Releasing animals is prohibited (Article 14 of the Flora and Fauna Act).
Het uitzetten van dieren is verboden (artikel 14 Flora- en faunawet).
Antwoord vragen van het lid Thieme over meer stroperij door vermindering van toezicht

MP Thieme (PvdD) asks whether reduced numbers of nature wardens (BOA's) and planned job cuts at Staatsbosbeheer increase poaching, and whether nature oversight should be independent of landowners and hunting organisations. State Secretary Dijksma answers that about 800 green BOA's are active, that most are employed by nature organisations, provinces and municipalities rather than hunting bodies, that poaching is mainly a police/security matter, and that oversight of BOA's is exercised by the functional prosecutor.
Supervision of nature in the Netherlands is independent.
Het toezicht in de Nederlandse natuur is onafhankelijk.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Thieme over de afslachting van zwijnen voor decoratie tijdens het Halloween-feest

An MP asked whether wild boar shot for Halloween decoration were killed illegally, whether the ammunition was investigated, and whether a forester who trusted hunters' word should have pursued further inquiry. The government answered that police found the killings were legal, the Public Prosecution Service decided not to prosecute, the forester has no investigative powers, and it disapproves of how the carcasses were handled.
Police investigation showed that the wild boars were shot dead in a legal manner.
Uit politieonderzoek is gebleken dat de zwijnen op legale wijze zijn doodgeschoten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Thieme over het promoten van het bereiden van houtsnippen voor consumptie

An MP asked the ministers whether the public broadcaster's cooking of woodcock, which is protected in the Netherlands, promotes illegal hunting, and whether trade and import should be banned. The government answered that broadcasters are responsible for their content, that woodcock may legally be hunted and traded if obtained lawfully abroad, and declined to investigate, ban imports or monitor trade.
The Media Act provides that the public broadcaster is itself responsible for the form and content of its programmes.
In de Mediawet is opgenomen dat de publieke omroep zelf verantwoordelijk is voor de vorm en inhoud van zijn programma’s.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Thieme en Van Dekken over financiering van megastallen in het buitenland

MPs Thieme and Van Dekken asked why Dutch public money still indirectly supports megastables abroad, such as Myronivsky Hliboproduct in Ukraine, despite the Ouwehand motion, and demanded an exclusion list for Atradius DSB. The minister replied that export credit insurance is available case by case under IFC performance standards, that a megastable-specific exclusion would not be imposed, and that the government will discuss the link between stable size and animal welfare with colleagues and inform the House.
I will discuss the relationship between stable size and animal welfare with my colleagues at Economic Affairs and will inform the House of this as soon as possible.
Ik zal in overleg met mijn collega’s van Economische Zaken de relatie stalomvang en dierenwelzijn bespreken en zal de Tweede Kamer daar zo spoedig mogelijk over informeren.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Thieme over de uitspraak van Z.K.H. de Prins van Oranje tijdens de handelsmissie in Brazilië

An MP asked the government about remarks by the Crown Prince on feeding 9 billion people through more meat production, a bull producing over a million offspring, and an apparent contradiction with his earlier call to reduce meat consumption. The minister answered that the remarks concerned efficient, sustainable agriculture and dairy shortages in Brazil, denied any call to reduce meat consumption, and said the remarks were made under ministerial responsibility.
The statements by His Royal Highness the Prince of Orange were made under the ministerial responsibility of myself and of my colleague of Economic Affairs.
De uitspraken van Z.K.H. de Prins van Oranje zijn gedaan onder ministeriële verantwoordelijkheid van mijzelf en die van de collega van Economische Zaken.
Antwoord vragen Thieme over het bericht “‘Land- en tuinbouw goed voor 10 pct van economie en werkgelegenheid', NRCnext checkt”

An MP asked why the government website still claimed agriculture is 10% of the economy after the minister had conceded the primary sector is only about 1.2% of GDP, and whether the figure would be corrected. The state secretary agreed to correct the website, saying the broader agro-complex (including processing and supply) accounts for about 10%, and committed to distinguishing these sectors clearly in future communication.
To give a correct picture, the government website has been adjusted so that the Dutch agro-complex accounts for about 10% of the Dutch economy and employment.
Voor een correct beeld is de website van de Rijksoverheid aangepast in die zin dat het Nederlandse agrocomplex goed is voor circa 10% van de Nederlandse economie en werkgelegenheid.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Schouw c.s. over de zaak Van Rey - Weekers

Opposition and coalition MPs ask the State Secretary for Finance about the Van Rey–Weekers affair: a billboard donation, the sale of a tax office and a tax request involving real estate. They press on the nature and financing of the donation, contacts about closing tax offices, and handling of a personal tax request. The item is a bundle of written questions; the answers are not included in the text provided.
Have you verified that the donation was indeed made only by Mr Van Rey and, as agreed, processed via the regional campaign fund? Can you make the accounts public?

Heeft u zich ervan vergewist dat de donatie inderdaad alleen door de heer Van Rey is gedaan en, zoals afgesproken, via de regionale campagnekas is afgehandeld? Kunt u de rekeningen hiervan openbaar maken?
Antwoord vragen van het lid Thieme over terugkeer legbatterijeieren in Europa

Thieme (PvdD) asked whether plans to lower import duties on non-EU eggs would bring battery eggs back to Europe, whether consumers can be protected, and whether the Netherlands will push for a ban on imported battery eggs. The minister denied any general duty cut, said trade deals include only limited quota-based tariff reductions and animal welfare commitments, and rejected an import ban as incompatible with WTO rules.
There is therefore no question of a general reduction of import duties on eggs and egg products.
Er is dan ook geen sprake van een algemene verlaging van de invoerheffingen op eieren en ei-producten.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Voordewind, Thieme, Gesthuizen, Krol, Maij, Mulder en Van Ojik over kinderarbeid bij de productie van schoenen door grote ketens

MPs asked the government whether shoe companies using child labour in their supply chains should be held to account, excluded from state support and trade missions, and whether embassies and public procurement could be used to address it. The minister answered that due diligence duties under the OECD guidelines apply, that no shoe companies receive state support or joined trade missions, and that embassies raise labour standards where possible, while procurement social conditions already apply.
No, there are no shoe companies currently receiving government support or having previously joined trade missions.
Nee, er zijn geen schoenenbedrijven die momenteel overheidssteun ontvangen of in het verleden mee zijn geweest met handelsmissies.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Thieme over een streekbezoek van Hare Majesteit de Koningin aan de provincie Noord-Brabant

An MP asked the government why the Queen would attend a round-table on intensive livestock farming during a regional visit to Noord-Brabant, what information she would receive, who organised it, which parties would attend, and whether a list of attendees would be provided. The state secretary answered that the round-table was a customary part of regional visits prepared with the province, that it was confidential, and listed the types of attendees (residents, farmers, a welfare/environment-type organisation, a health body) but no Q-fever patient organisation.

It concerned a confidential conversation attended by citizens and residents of Reusel-de Mierden and surroundings, entrepreneurs/livestock farmers, a representative of an organisation for humans and animals and of a health institution, and a representative of the Provincial Health Council.

Het betrof een vertrouwelijk gesprek waarbij aanwezig waren burgers en inwoners van Reusel-de Mierden en nabije omgeving, ondernemers/veehouders, een vertegenwoordiger van een belangenorganisatie voor mens en dier en van een gezondheidsinstantie en een vertegenwoordiging van de Provinciale Raad voor de Gezondheid.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Thieme over het afschieten van herten omwille van de openstelling van een ecoduct

MP Thieme (PvdD) asked the state secretary about the culling of deer near the Hierden/A28 ecoduct, questioning who initiated it, its cost, the buffer zone, consistency with animal welfare, and the central government's role. The state secretary answered that the ecoduct was a national-funded MJPO project on provincial initiative, that culling follows the provincial Faunabeheerplan and is unrelated to the ecoduct, and that natural policy is decentralised so the province is responsible.
Because of the decentralisation of nature policy, the province is responsible.
Vanwege de decentralisatie van het natuurbeleid is de provincie verantwoordelijk.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Thieme over veehouders die nog niet voldoen aan antibioticaregels

An MP asked the state secretary whether he would ensure all cattle farmers comply with the new antibiotic registration and inspection rules by year end, and whether he would inform parliament before year end. The government acknowledged 7,000 of about 32,000 dairy and beef farmers were non-compliant, said they were given until 1 December 2012 with disciplinary measures to follow, and promised an updated progress overview in spring 2013.
If a cattle farmer is still in violation after 1 December 2012, the PVV will take disciplinary measures.
Als blijkt dat een rundveehouder na 1 december 2012 nog steeds in overtreding is, zal het PVV tuchtrechtelijke maatregelen nemen.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Thieme over campylobacterbesmettingen in slachthuizen

MP Thieme asked the ministers whether unequal Campylobacter contamination between slaughterhouses, the lack of progress since 1997 commitments, and the non-public identification of high-risk slaughterhouses were acceptable, and whether sanctions would be strengthened. The minister replied that Campylobacter is hard to control, that Dutch slaughterhouses perform better than foreign ones, that the industry-run Convenant will provide data, and that RIVM cannot identify individual slaughterhouses while the NVWA enforces against violators.
The RIVM does not have this data.
Het RIVM beschikt niet over deze gegevens.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Thieme over nieuwe besmettingen Q-koorts

An MP asks how a goat dairy farm whose goats were all vaccinated against Q fever became infected again, whether faulty bulk-milk testing was to blame, and what will be done about public health risks. The state secretary answers that vaccination reduces but does not eliminate infection, that bulk-milk monitoring is adequately supervised by the national reference institute, and that visitor bans, transport restrictions and hygiene measures are in place.
Control of bulk milk is therefore adequately secured by the national reference institute.
De controle van tankmelk is dus adequaat geborgd door het nationale referentie-instituut.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Thieme over nestgedrag zeugen

An MP from the Party for the Animals asked the state secretary about sows' nest-building behaviour, the availability of nesting material and whether a legal obligation should be introduced. The state secretary answered that EU rules already require nesting material in the last week before farrowing, that the government is funding innovation in farrowing systems, and that economic considerations are a matter for farmers.
If it turns out that the results are as promising as this research indicates, I expect large-scale application in practice in the short term.
Als hieruit blijkt dat de resultaten net zo perspectiefvol zijn als uit dit onderzoek blijkt dan verwacht ik op korte termijn een grootschalige toepassing hiervan in de praktijk.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Thieme over een toename van locomotieproblemen bij vleeskuikens

An MP asked the State Secretary for Economic Affairs, Agriculture and Innovation about the rise in locomotion problems in broiler chickens, their other causes, and whether the GD's research would cover wider causes and welfare issues. The State Secretary answered that Enterococcus cecorum is the main identified driver, that the GD's research focuses on it for now, that the government will inform parliament of results in due course, and that welfare research is ongoing with a decision on further research in 2013.
I am willing to inform the House in due course about the results of the research.
Ik ben bereid de Kamer te zijner tijd te informeren over de resultaten van het onderzoek.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Thieme over insecten als eiwitbron voor varkens- en kippenvoer

MP Thieme asks why a Wageningen study into insects as feed protein was subsidised before the rules allow it, and whether ethical and public-support assessments were done before funding insect farming that would kill many more animals. The state secretary replies that the EUR 40,000 study tests feasibility, that the ethical framework and next steps will be considered after the results, that no public-support research was done, and that no law change is planned for now, as insects already appear on the GWWD list.

Now that the results of this study are known, and this animal husbandry appears to have sufficient future prospects, the next steps, including going through the ethical assessment framework, will be further considered.

Nu de resultaten van dit onderzoek bekend zijn, en deze dierhouderij voldoende toekomstperspectieven lijkt te hebben, zullen de vervolgstappen, waaronder het doorlopen van het ethisch afwegingskader, verder worden bezien.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Thieme over een dodelijk jachtongeluk in Zwiggelte

An MP asked the government about a fatal hunting accident in Zwiggelte, the legality of night hunting with lights, and whether such hunts should be banned. The minister said the victim was a bystander, an investigation is ongoing, foxes fall outside the statutory night-hunting ban, provinces can grant exemptions, and no change to the framework is planned while the case and court proceedings are pending.
The answer from the Benelux Court on those questions is awaited.
Gewacht wordt op het antwoord van het Beneluxgerechtshof op die vragen.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Voordewind, Van Dam, Van Ojik, Schouw, Gesthuizen en Thieme over vrijheidsbeperking

Six MPs asked the minister for Immigration, Integration and Asylum whether a Hague court ruling requiring individual proportionality for restricting the liberty of rejected asylum-seeking families with children should lead to halting transfers to family locations and to a rethink of shelter provided under liberty restrictions after a Supreme Court ruling on children's rights. The minister replied that the ruling concerns one case with a lack of reasoning and draws no general conclusions, that transfers are handled with care pending government formation, and that the Supreme Court ruling does not conflict with the liberty-restriction measure, which serves public order and availability for departure.
In this individual case the court concluded that insufficient reasons were given for imposing a liberty-restricting measure.
In deze individuele zaak is door de rechter geconcludeerd dat onvoldoende was gemotiveerd waarom een vrijheidsbeperkende maatregel is opgelegd.
Antwoord vragen Thieme over het doden van kikkers voor consumptie

An MP asks the ministers whether a broadcast promoting frog's legs for consumption is acceptable for public broadcasting, whether a ban on importing and selling frog legs should be introduced, and whether research into how frogs are caught and killed in Europe will be done. The minister says the broadcaster is responsible for its own content, the state secretary sees no need for a national import ban, and no research is planned.
The State Secretary for EL&I does not intend to carry out research into the scale and methods by which frogs are caught and killed in Europe for human consumption.
De Staatssecretaris van EL&I is niet voornemens onderzoek te doen naar de schaal en de wijzen waarop kikkers in Europa worden gevangen en gedood ten behoeve van de humane consumptie.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Thieme over antibioticaresistentie bij kalveren door melk

Party for the Animals MP Thieme asked whether feeding calves antibiotic-contaminated milk from treated cows poses resistance and health risks and what the government will do. The state secretary acknowledges the practice is common and risks promoting resistance, says it is contrary to EU feed rules but hard to enforce, and promises sector engagement, possible enforcement, and raising the issue at EU level.
Because of the risk of promoting resistance, milk from cows that have received antibiotics should not be fed to calves within the withdrawal period.
Vanwege het risico dat resistentie bevorderd wordt, dient melk van koeien die antibiotica hebben gekregen, binnen de wachttijd niet aan kalveren gevoederd te worden.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Thieme over het doodschieten van een stier die is gevallen uit een omgeslagen aanhangwagen op de A2

Thieme (Partij voor de Dieren) asked why a bull fell from an overturned trailer on the A2 and was shot by police, whether transport rules were breached, whether the NVWA checks small transports, and what protocol applies. The state secretary answered that the transport fell under the lighter rules for trips under 50 km, no breach was found, NVWA samples such transports, police guidelines allowed shooting when the vet lacked sedative, and a joint protocol is being drafted.
It is not known whether, and if so why, the animals in the trailer were restless.
Het is niet bekend of, en zo ja waarom, de dieren in de aanhangwagen onrustig waren.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Thieme over een geitenbedrijf zonder vergunning

An MP asked why a goat farm with about 1,000 goats operates without a permit, is tolerated by the municipality, and plans to expand to 5,650 goats, and whether the state will prevent this. The state secretary answered that the municipality is competent authority, that enforcement was judged disproportionate given expected legalisation, that vaccination limits health risk, and that no new permit request exists under the motion, deferring the scale decision to the next cabinet.
The municipality of Hof van Twente is the competent authority for the environmental permit.
De gemeente Hof van Twente is het bevoegd gezag voor de milieuvergunning.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Thieme over een stalvergassing na brand

An MP asked whether a poultry farm in Groesbeek gassed about 30,000 hens after a fire, whether TCC-group carried out the gassing despite its contract being terminated, whether the NVWA was present, and how animal welfare was ensured. The state secretary answered that the farmer decided on gassing for animals weakened by smoke, that the contract was terminated for a different context, that the NVWA attended, and that the same indicators as in official culling were checked, with a reference to a separate letter on fire safety in stables.
The government supervises compliance with these provisions.
De overheid ziet toe op de naleving van deze bepalingen.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Thieme over miljoenensubsidie voor de megastal in Grubbenvorst

An MP asked the state secretary whether the Grubbenvorst megastable received hidden government subsidies, whether that fits a planned ban on megastables, and whether subsidies to such farms should be ended. The state secretary replied that the subsidies were open to all entrepreneurs under standing schemes, were innovation grants rather than construction funding, cannot lawfully be reclaimed, and that the next cabinet will decide on size limits and subsidy exclusion.
Deploying subsidies by other authorities I regard as primarily their own responsibility, in which I do not wish to interfere.
Het inzetten van subsidies door andere overheden acht ik bij uitstek hun eigen verantwoordelijkheid waarin ik niet wil treden.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Thieme inzake aanpak van brandveiligheid in stallen

An MP asked the state secretary and the interior minister about fire safety in livestock barns after pig deaths, and why a parliamentary motion requiring fire-safety rules by 1 January 2013 had not been implemented. The government answered that an Action Plan on barn fires has been drawn up, that research on current requirements is underway, and that advice on possible regulatory changes will follow by end 2012, without committing to new rules by the deadline.
The Action Plan provides for research into the adequacy of the current requirements and into how animals in practice can be better protected against fire through more effective regulation.

Het Actieplan voorziet in de uitvoering van een onderzoek naar de toereikendheid van de huidige eisen alsmede naar de wijze waarop dieren in de praktijk door effectievere regelgeving beter tegen brand beschermd kunnen worden.
Antwoord vragen Thieme over kippen die zijn gestikt door de warmte

An MP asks the state secretary about broiler chickens that suffocated in heat in Schuinesloot and other farms, whether the deaths relate to large-scale housing, and whether publicly funded fire brigade assistance should be charged to the farmer. The secretary confirms about 200 birds died there, says housing scale is not the issue, states the fire brigade's assistance was a legal duty and not charged, and commits to working with the poultry sector on heat preparedness.
I am willing, together with the poultry sector, to look at the risks that a heat period poses to poultry in relation to housing.
Ik ben bereid samen met de pluimveesector te kijken naar de risico's die een hitteperiode met zich meebrengt voor het pluimvee in relatie tot de huisvesting.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Thieme over de uitbraak van vogelgriep

An MP asked the state secretary about the August 2012 bird flu outbreak in Hagestein, its cause, the risk of spread or mutation, and measures to prevent further outbreaks. The state secretary said the exact cause is rarely known, the Hagestein farm was detected through the monitoring system and is unrelated to the Mexico outbreak, and a working group is assessing measures to reduce risks from free-range access.
Once the working group has completed this analysis, I will inform you of the results.
Zodra de werkgroep deze analyse heeft afgerond, zal ik u op de hoogte stellen van de resultaten.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Thieme over een uitbraak van vogelgriep

An MP asked the state secretary about the duration, method and monitoring of the August 2012 culling of 32,870 laying hens at Hagestein during an avian flu outbreak, including whether the culling ran until Sunday and whether the NVWA monitored it properly. The government answered that the process was correct, indicators were met, the NVWA monitored continuously, and the contractor followed an approved work plan.
The entire process proceeded correctly and the prescribed indicators were achieved.
Het hele proces is correct verlopen en de voorgeschreven indicatoren zijn behaald.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Thieme over de voorbeeldfunctie van leden van het Koninklijk Huis in relatie tot de plezierjacht

An MP asked the Prime Minister whether Prince Willem-Alexander's duck hunting is compatible with the royal family's exemplary role, whether publicly funded royal hunting staff or security were involved, and whether he should apologise like King Juan Carlos did. The government answered briefly that hunting is legally permitted for those following the rules, that duck hunting is lawful, and that the Faunabeheer department manages game on the royal domain, without addressing the involvement of public staff or the apology question.
Hunting is subject to legal rules. Anyone who fully complies with these rules may hunt.
Voor de jacht gelden wettelijke regels. Iedereen die deze regels volledig in acht neemt, kan jagen.
Antwoord vragen Thieme over een hectarevergoeding Schipholboer voor weren ganzen

An MP asked whether the state agreed a per-hectare payment of 853 euro with farmers near Schiphol to plough under grain stubble quickly to deter geese, why the Chamber was not informed, and why food crops are not banned near the airport. The State Secretary confirmed the payment under a voluntary convenant, defended voluntariness and the four-track approach, rejected a crop ban as too drastic, and said no changes to state-owned land leases are planned.
The Chamber was not informed about this because it concerns implementation of established policy, namely the convenant on reducing the risk of bird strikes at Schiphol.
De Kamer is hierover niet geïnformeerd omdat het uitvoering van vastgelegd beleid betreft, te weten het convenant reduceren risico vogelaanvaringen Schiphol.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Thieme over het niet voldoen aan de vaccinatieplicht tegen Q-koorts (sts ELI)

An MP from the Party for the Animals asked why 18% of professional goat and sheep farms had not vaccinated against Q fever by the deadline, whether this poses a public health risk, and whether sanctions and breeding bans should be tightened. The state secretary replied that all farms eventually complied after orders under administrative coercion, that current sanctions are adequate with criminal reports filed, and that a breeding ban already applies to unvaccinated animals.
I therefore see no reason to increase the sanctions for failing to vaccinate on time.
Ik zie daarom geen aanleiding voor verhoging van de sancties voor het niet tijdig vaccineren.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Thieme over de schorsing van de zwanenredder

An MP asked the minister why NS suspended a railway worker who tried to rescue an injured swan on the tracks, and whether this sets a bad example given leniency toward animal abusers. The minister answered that the suspension is a labour matter between NS and the employee, that an investigation will establish whether the worker breached the safe-working norms, and that the rescue attempt was not an intention issue.
This is a labour law matter between employer and employee in which I do not intervene.
Dit is een arbeidsrechtelijke kwestie tussen werkgever en werknemer waar ik niet in treed.
Antwoord vragen Thieme over Bonaire die wilde ezels als lastdier naar Haïti wil sturen

An MP asked whether Bonaire's plan to capture wild donkeys and ship them to Haiti as pack animals is supported by the Dutch government, and asked for humane alternatives. The state secretary replied that the Dutch government has no role in the plan, that Bonaire's public body is primarily responsible for stock management and is still studying options, and that the government will await the proposal and is willing to discuss it if Bonaire asks.
The primary responsibility for initiating, shaping and implementing stock management of these donkeys lies with the public body of Bonaire.
Het is de primaire verantwoordelijkheid van het openbaar lichaam Bonaire bestandsbeheer t.a.v. deze ezels te initiëren, dit vorm en inhoud te geven en vervolgens te implementeren.
Antwoord vragen Thieme over het beperken van het beschermingsregime in enkele Natura 2000-gebieden

An MP from the Partij voor de Dieren asked why the government limited the protection regime in some Natura 2000 areas during the summer recess while the cabinet was caretaker, and whether that was compatible with its demissionary status. The state secretary replied that the measure implements a 2011 policy decision already discussed with parliament, that the Natura 2000 file is not controversial, and that the draft amending decree was open for public consultation until 13 September 2012.
This concerns implementing the decision to remove complementary objectives.
Het gaat hier om het effectueren van het besluit tot het schrappen van complementaire doelen.
Antwoord vragen Thieme over de stijgende graanprijzen

MP Thieme asked the State Secretary about record-low EU grain stocks, Dutch grain reserves, promoting protein crops, meat consumption and the shift to plant proteins. The State Secretary answered that the Netherlands holds no strategic grain stocks, that cultivation should be market-driven, that no active government role in reducing meat consumption is foreseen, and referred to earlier letters on protein.
No, the Netherlands does not hold strategic grain reserves.
Nee, Nederland houdt geen strategische voorraden graan aan.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Dibi, Voordewind, Gesthuizen, Dijksma, Thieme, Schouw over het bericht 'Syrische asielzoekers eisen duidelijkheid'

Six MPs asked the minister about a report that Syrian asylum seekers demanded clarity on their status, including whether group-wide protection under the Qualification Directive applies and how hunger strikes could be prevented. The minister replied that a 3 August letter sets out the policy, that individual assessment remains the starting point, and that Syrians not shown to be active supporters of the regime may receive temporary asylum residence permits under the Aliens Act.
On 3 August I informed your House about how I have shaped the country-based asylum policy regarding Syria.
Op 3 augustus jl. heb ik uw Kamer geïnformeerd over de wijze waarop ik het landgebonden asielbeleid ten aanzien van Syrië heb vormgegeven.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Thieme over een zeer lage straf voor ernstige dierenmishandeling

An MP asked why a very light sentence was imposed for serious animal cruelty to 115 birds of prey, whether supervisors failed, and whether bans on keeping animals or hunting licences should follow. The state secretary answered that individual criminal cases are not communicated, that inspections found no welfare problems, that the company went bankrupt, and that existing law already allows refusing hunting licences, while withholding details on privacy grounds.
It is not for me to communicate about individual criminal cases.
Het is niet aan mij om te communiceren over individuele strafzaken.
Antwoord vragen Thieme over sancties voor een jager in overtreding

An MP asked about the delayed prosecution of hunters for Flora and Fauna Act violations, sanctions, membership of the hunting association, and withdrawal of hunting licences. The government answered that the case is before the economic police court, that hunting licences were revoked by the police chief and upheld by the Council of State, and that some statistics are not centrally recorded.
The requested data are not kept by the Public Prosecution Service in a centralised system.
De gevraagde gegevens worden door het Openbaar Ministerie niet in een gecentraliseerd systeem bijgehouden.
Antwoord vragen Thieme over de Nederlandse toestemming voor het massaal doden van ganzen met behulp van CO2

An MP asks why the minister granted an exemption allowing mass gassing of geese with CO2 near Schiphol despite the EU biocides directive, and questions the necessity, animal welfare basis, costs, and preventive measures. The minister answers that the exemption rests on a convenant and motion, that the Commission was informed, that the welfare basis is a Wageningen study, and that the risk increase was not foreseeable.
I refer to the explanatory note accompanying the exemption (No. IenMbsk-201269716) of 10 May 2012, published in the Staatscourant on 15 May 2012.
Ik verwijs naar de toelichting bij de vrijstelling (Nr. IenMbsk-201269716) van 10 mei 2012 welke op 15 mei 2012 in de Staatscourant gepubliceerd is.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Thieme over het opsporen van de daders van een misdrijf op het platteland

An MP from the Party for the Animals asked the Justice minister about the investigation into the shooting of a cow on a farm and whether a reward would be offered for tips. The state secretary answered that the public prosecutor has launched an investigation with witness appeals, cannot disclose more while it is ongoing, and that a reward has been offered by an animal-welfare foundation but the prosecution sees no reason yet to offer one.
Since the investigation is still ongoing, I cannot provide further information on it.
Aangezien het onderzoek nog gaande is, kan ik daarover geen nadere mededelingen doen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Thieme over deelname van de Minister-President aan de Bilderberg-conferentie

Thieme (PvdD) asked the Prime Minister whether the Chatham House Rule allowed participants in the 2012 Bilderberg conference to speak publicly about the discussions, whether the participant list could be withheld, and whether government funds covered Dutch non-government participants. Rutte answered that the rule means off-the-record discussions with no statements to third parties afterwards, that publishing a participant list is up to each organiser, and that government funding of non-government participants can be ruled out for this cabinet period.
Whether or not the participant list of a meeting with third parties is shared is up to the organisation of each meeting.
Het al dan niet delen van de deelnemerslijst van een bijeenkomst met derden is aan de organisatie van een iedere bijeenkomst.
Antwoord vragen Thieme over het vernietigen van een onrechtmatige vergunning voor de bouw van een geitenstal

An MP asked the Interior Minister whether a building permit for a large goat barn in Landerd, issued despite a provincial building stop after Q-fever cases, should be annulled, since the province considered it unlawful. The minister answered that the application predates the building stop, that only the Crown can annul, that no annulment request had been filed yet, and that annulment is a last resort.
Annulment of a decision by the Crown can take place if there is a conflict with the law or the general interest.
Vernietiging van een besluit door de Kroon kan plaats vinden indien er sprake is van strijd met het recht of het algemeen belang.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Thieme aan de minister-president over de Bilderbergconferentie 2012

An MP asked the Prime Minister whether he attended the 2012 Bilderberg conference, in what capacity, and for details on its agenda, invitation policy, public disclosure and costs. The Prime Minister confirmed attendance as PM, deferred to the Chatham House Rules and the conference's public topic list, and said government travel costs are paid from state funds.
Like many other international conferences, the discussions at the Bilderberg Conference fall under the so-called Chatham House rules.
Net als veel andere internationale conferenties, vallen de besprekingen van de Bilderberg Conferentie onder de zogenoemde Chatham House rules.
Antwoord vragen Thieme over het bericht dat een vermeende stroper die een vergoeding heeft ontvangen van de gemeente Putten

An MP asked whether a suspected poacher acquitted over a bait trap with a dead deer and bird was truly cleared on legal grounds, whether the prosecution will appeal, and whether the municipal compensation sends a wrong signal. The minister answered that the case was dismissed on a prosecution drafting error (wrong statutory basis), not a substantive finding, that no appeal will be lodged, and that the compensation covered legal costs rather than the bait use.
An error was made when drafting the summons.
Bij het opstellen van de dagvaarding is een fout gemaakt.

Vragen van de leden Ouwehand en Thieme (beiden Partij voor de Dieren) aan de staatssecretaris van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie over het bericht dat orka Morgan gebruikt zal worden in een fokprogramma en in sh

MPs Ouwehand and Thieme asked the state secretary whether orca Morgan would be used in shows and a breeding programme at Loro Parque and how this squares with his earlier statements on education, research and orca welfare. The state secretary answered that the transfer was based on Spanish authority approval and the park's claimed educational and research purposes, that enforcement lies with Spanish authorities, and that Morgan's move was the better of two options for her welfare.
It is not for me but for the Spanish authorities to monitor compliance with CITES legislation and international treaties on marine mammals.
Het is niet aan mij maar aan de Spaanse autoriteiten om toe te zien op CITES wetgeving en internationale verdragen inzake zeezoogdieren.
Vragen van het lid Thieme (PvdD) aan de staatssecretaris Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie over het op slot blijven van ecoducten op de Veluwe voor groot wild (ingezonden 23 december 2011).

An MP from the Party for the Animals asks why three ecoducts on the Veluwe remain closed to red deer, whether disease risk justifies this, and when they will open. The state secretary replies that the province of Gelderland is still completing fencing and habitat works, that the disease risk was studied and found small, and that opening is the province's responsibility, which he expects to proceed once feasible.
Moreover, whether or not ecoducts are closed is a matter for the province.
Overigens is het al dan niet afsluiten van ecoducten een zaak van de provincie.

Vragen van de leden Thieme en Ouwehand (beiden Partij voor de Dieren) aan de staatssecretaris van Economische zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie over de 28 in beslag genomen pony’s in Elkenrade (ingezonden 9 december 2011).

MPs Thieme and Ouwehand asked the state secretary about 28 confiscated ponies in Elkenrade, the role of police and inspection bodies, action against the owner, shelter capacity, and whether the animals could be euthanised or sent to slaughter.
