The state secretary answered that the case is still under criminal investigation, the owner has not formally relinquished the animals, shelter places are sufficient, the animals are well cared for, and it cannot guarantee they will not end at a slaughterhouse.
Since the investigation is still ongoing, I cannot make further statements about it.
Aangezien het onderzoek nog loopt kan ik daar verder geen uitspraken over doen.

Vragen van de leden Thieme en Ouwehand (beiden Partij voor de Dieren) aan de staatssecretaris van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie over de 28 in beslag genomen pony’s in Elkenrade (ingezonden 22 december 2011).

MPs Thieme and Ouwehand asked the state secretary about 28 seized ponies in Elkenrade, including one pony found still dirty and infected after four weeks at a shelter and one that later died there, and whether shelter inspections should be tightened. The state secretary defended the shelter care as appropriate given the animals' condition, explained the death as heart failure, and rejected tightening inspections, pointing to annual NVWA inspections and Dienst Regelingen visits.

Do you share the view that inspections of (temporary) shelter addresses should be tightened, so that neglected animals after seizure do not end up in exactly the same situation they were removed from?

Deelt u de mening dat de controles op (tijdelijke) opvangadressen aangescherpt moeten worden, zodat verwaarloosde dieren na inbeslagname niet in exact dezelfde situatie terecht komen als waaruit ze zijn weggehaald?

Vragen van de leden Thieme en Ouwehand (beiden Partij voor de Dieren) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken en de staatssecretaris van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie over het bewapenen van schepen voor de ille

MPs Thieme and Ouwehand asked whether Japanese disaster-relief funds were used to arm whaling ships and whether the Netherlands would protest and act on a 2008 shooting incident. The minister replied that the Japanese government denied using relief funds for arming vessels, that the Netherlands opposes whaling, and that no protest was planned beyond calling on both sides to respect maritime rules.
The Japanese Ministry of Foreign Affairs has assured me that the Japanese whaling ships are not armed.
Het Japanse ministerie van Buitenlandse Zaken heeft mij verzekerd dat de Japanse walvisschepen niet bewapend zijn.

Vragen van het lid Peters (GroenLinks), van Bommel (SP), Voordewind (CU), Thieme (PvdD) en Pechtold (D66) aan de ministers van Veiligheid en Justitie en van Buitenlandse zaken over de gerechtelijke uitspraak die de Staat

MPs from several parties asked whether the government would drop cassation against the Hague appeals court ruling holding the State liable for the deaths of three men during the Srebrenica genocide, and whether it would apologise to the victims' relatives. The minister answered that the ruling is an interim judgment so cassation is not yet possible, and reaffirmed the 2002 Kok cabinet statement on Dutch political co-responsibility rather than apologising.
The appeals court ruling is, technically speaking, an interim judgment.
De uitspraak van het hof is juridisch-technisch gezien een tussenarrest.

Vragen van de leden Ouwehand en Thieme (Partij voor de Dieren) aan de staatssecretarissen van Economische zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie en van Infrastructuur en Milieu over nieuwe toelatingen van bestrijdingsmiddelen op b

MPs Ouwehand and Thieme asked why the Ctgb authorised new pesticides containing glyphosate (RoundUp Force, also for public green maintenance) and imidacloprid (Sombrero, for beet seed treatment) despite a motion against non-commercial glyphosate use and known imidacloprid water and bee risks, and asked for withdrawal. State Secretary Bleker answered that the authorisations meet EU criteria, that EU rules do not allow excluding non-commercial uses or withdrawing authorisations, and that the motion will be implemented in the national action plan.

No, if a plant protection product meets the set requirements, the European regulation does not provide the authority to exclude 'non-commercial applications' from the requested authorisation or to withdraw a granted authorisation.

Nee, indien een gewasbeschermingsmiddel voldoet aan de gestelde eisen, biedt de Europese verordening niet de bevoegdheid om «niet-commerciële toepassingen» uit te sluiten van de aangevraagde toelating of om een verleende toelating weer in te trekken.

Vragen van het lid Thieme (Partij voor de Dieren) aan de staatssecretaris van Economische zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie over misstanden tijdens een nertsentransport van Nederland naar Griekenland (ingezonden 6 december 20

An MP asked the state secretary about welfare abuses found in Italy during a transport of 1800 mink from the Netherlands to Greece, including overcrowding, missing authorisation and health certificate, and whether such transport should be banned. The state secretary answered that Italian authorities found the transport improperly carried out, fined the carrier, and that EU rules do not require export certification or notification for mink, while the welfare regulation contains no transport rules and responsibility lies with the organiser.
In response to these questions I requested information from the Italian authorities.
Ik heb naar aanleiding van deze vragen informatie opgevraagd bij de Italiaanse autoriteiten.
Vragen van het lid Thieme (Partij voor de Dieren) aan de staatssecretaris van Economische zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie over thuisslachting konijnen (ingezonden 13 december 2011).

An MP asked the state secretary whether live rabbits advertised on Marktplaats for home slaughter should be cracked down on, given that home slaughter is claimed to be punishable, and whether extra enforcement is planned over the holidays. The state secretary replied that home slaughter for private use is permitted under conditions and not punishable, that the NVWA supervises compliance with animal-killing rules, and that Marktplaats warns users against unlawful offers, without announcing extra enforcement.
Home slaughter for private use is permitted under conditions and not punishable.
Thuisslachting voor privaat gebruik is onder voorwaarden toegestaan en niet strafbaar.

Vragen van de leden Thieme en Ouwehand ( beiden Partij voor de Dieren) aan de staatssecretaris van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie over het mogelijk versoepelen van de regelingen om honden als trekdier in te kun

MPs Thieme and Ouwehand asked the state secretary whether a new protocol would ease exemptions allowing dogs to pull carts, and whether this conflicts with the animal welfare law and with mandatory X-ray screening. The secretary answered that exemptions exist for sled dog sport, that the procedure is being formalised for uniformity and transparency without a policy change, that a veterinary health statement is already required, and that no separate notification to parliament is planned.
Currently work is being done on formalising the procedure by which requests for exemption from the ban on traction are assessed.
Momenteel wordt gewerkt aan het formaliseren van de procedure waarmee de verzoeken tot ontheffing van het verbod op trekkracht beoordeeld worden.
Vragen van het lid Thieme (Partij voor de Dieren) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over het doden van zwerfdieren in Oekraïne (ingezonden 14 oktober 2011).

An MP asks the Health minister whether she knows of mass killings of stray dogs and cats in Ukraine ahead of Euro 2012, and whether she will raise it with Ukraine, protest officially, or discuss it with foreign colleagues. The minister answers that Ukraine has taken measures after UEFA pressure, that the choice of method is for Ukrainian authorities though killings should be humane per OIE guidelines, and that no protest or diplomatic action is planned.
The Ukrainian government has meanwhile, partly at UEFA's urging, taken measures to end the killing and mistreatment of stray dogs.
Door de Oekraïense regering zijn inmiddels, mede op aandringen van UEFA, maatregelen genomen om een eind te maken aan het afmaken en de mishandeling van zwerfhonden.

Vragen van het lid Thieme (Partij voor de Dieren) aan de staatssecretaris van Economische zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie over het zonder toestemming afschieten van een damhert (ingezonden 9 november 2011).

An MP from the Party for the Animals asked the state secretary whether a deer was shot without the mayor's required permission, whether a report was drawn up, and whether separating wildlife policy, regulation and enforcement is needed. The state secretary answered that the mayor of Leiderdorp is competent to grant such permission, that questions on the case belong to the municipal executive, and that there was no unauthorised action by a hunter warranting changes to how policy and oversight are organised.
It is not for me to answer questions about that, but for the college of B&W.
Het is niet aan mij om daarover vragen te beantwoorden, maar aan het college van B&W.

Vragen van het lid Thieme en Ouwehand (Partij voor de Dieren) aan de staatssecretaris Economische zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie over ongelukken tijdens het vervoer van dieren (ingezonden 10 november 2011).

MPs Thieme and Ouwehand asked about an animal transport incident on the A4 in which a cow or ox got stuck in a trailer, whether police shot the animal, whether hobby trailers require periodic inspection, and figures on accidents and AID/nVWA inspection findings. The state secretary replied that the animals were not shot, that it was hobby transport in an unexamined horse trailer that met general Transport Regulation requirements, that no periodic inspection is planned, and that 36 deficiencies were found in controls from 2006 to 2011.
A veterinarian was present on site and determined that the animal had only sustained a minor abrasion to one of its hind legs.
Er is een dierenarts ter plaatse geweest en die heeft vastgesteld dat het rund slechts een kleine schaafwond had opgelopen aan één van de achterpoten.

Vragen van de leden Thieme en Ouwehand (beiden Partij voor de Dieren) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over mogelijke belangenverstrengeling bij de EFSA (ingezonden 21 oktober 2011).

MPs asked the minister about alleged conflicts of interest among EFSA panel members advising on aspartame, including industry payments, and whether EFSA should re-examine aspartame after new studies and threatened legal action against a watchdog NGO. The minister mostly referred to a letter from another state secretary and to EU timelines, and said the NGO matter is for the parties involved to decide.
I gladly refer to the recent letter from the state secretary of I&M to your House of 9 November.
Ik verwijs graag naar de recente brief van de staatssecretaris van I&M aan uw Kamer van 9 november jl.

Vragen van het lid Thieme (Partij voor de Dieren) aan de staatssecretaris van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie en de minister van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over de Wageningen Universiteit (ingezonden 21 ok

An MP asks whether a news item claiming Wageningen University had no evidence on milk's health effects remains online without correction, and why Wageningen falls under a different ministry than other universities. The minister says the publishing decision lies with Wageningen UR and that the university follows the same legal rules as other universities, with the agriculture minister responsible for green education.
It is up to Wageningen UR to decide whether or not to withdraw reporting on this subject from its magazine Resource for students and staff of Wageningen UR.
Het is aan Wageningen UR om te beslissen of zij berichtgeving over dit onderwerp in haar blad Resource voor studenten en medewerkers van Wageningen UR wel of niet intrekt.

Vragen van het lid Thieme (Partij voor de Dieren) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport en de staatssecretaris van Economische zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie over berichten dat melk lang niet goed is voor e

MPs Thieme asked the ministers about reports that Wageningen University altered a press release on milk research, its ties to the dairy industry, and whether the Voedingscentrum should warn consumers about high dairy intake. The government answered that the press release was adjusted but no investigation is warranted, that industry partnerships do not compromise independence, and that it sees no reason to intervene with the Voedingscentrum.
There is no reason to request an internal investigation, see also answer 4.
Er is geen aanleiding om een intern onderzoek te vragen, zie ook antwoord 4.

Vragen van de leden Çörüz en Omtzigt (beiden CDA), Timmermans (PvdA), De Roon (PVV), Van Bommel (SP), Schouw (D66), Voordewind (CU), Thieme (PvdD) en Van der Staaij (SGP) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over het a

MPs asked the foreign minister about reports that the UK had secretly banned Russian officials linked to the death of lawyer Magnitsky from entering, whether Russian investigations could still be trusted, and whether the Netherlands would ban the same officials. The minister replied that no visa ban was introduced by the UK or US, that Russia has continued prosecuting doctors, and that the Netherlands would raise the matter as it has before, without committing to a new measure.
The government has repeatedly expressed its concern about the death of Mr Magnitsky and the circumstances under which he died.
De regering heeft herhaaldelijk haar zorg uitgesproken over de dood van de heer Magnitsky en over de omstandigheden waaronder hij is overleden
Vragen van het lid Thieme (Partij voor de Dieren) aan de staatssecretaris van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie over kauwen als vogelverschrikkers (ingezonden 17 oktober 2011).

An MP asked the state secretary whether hanging dead jackdaws as scarecrows is permitted and whether it should be banned, and whether exemptions were granted or enforcement taken. The state secretary answered that hanging dead birds is a permitted way to deter crows on a small scale, that no provision of the Flora- and faunawet prohibits it, and that no proces-verbaal or AID enforcement is warranted.
No, hanging dead birds is not a form of control but a suitable way to deter crow-like birds on a small scale.
Nee, het ophangen van dode vogels is geen vorm van bestrijding maar een geschikte manier om op kleine schaal kraaiachtigen te weren.
Vragen van het lid Thieme (Partij voor de Dieren) aan de staatssecretaris van Economische zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie over het in beslag nemen van fazanten door de nVWA (ingezonden 21 oktober 2011).

An MP asks the state secretary whether the nVWA seizure of 80 pheasants apparently intended for release for shooting raises concerns about the hunter keeping his licence, and whether stronger sanctions should be added in the new nature law. The state secretary answers that the birds were seized for lacking closed leg rings, that the hunter was dealt with under administrative law, that a hunting licence can be withdrawn at the discretion of the regional police chief, and that existing sanctions are adequate.
It is up to the regional police chief to decide whether the hunting licence is withdrawn.
Het is aan de korpschef om te beslissen of de jachtakte wordt ingetrokken.
Vragen van het lid Thieme (Partij voor de Dieren) aan de staatssecretaris van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie over het wederom overschrijden van de melkquota (ingezonden 21 oktober 2011).

An MP asks why Dutch dairy producers again exceeded EU milk quotas after an earlier levy and whether the government regrets it and can guarantee no further overshoot. The state secretary replies that no member state was fined, producers simply pay a superlevy by choice, the government cannot intervene in producers' freedom, and quotas end after 2015 as already decided.
It is up to the producer himself to decide whether he wants to produce milk within the limits of the allocated quota
Het is aan de producent zelf om te bepalen of hij melk wil produceren binnen de grenzen van het toebedeelde quotum

Vragen van het lid Thieme (Partij voor de Dieren) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport en aan de staatssecretaris van Economische zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie over minimale afstanden tussen woningen en i

An MP asked the health and agriculture ministers whether they would set minimum distances between intensive livestock farms and homes after the GGD advised such norms, and whether they would legislate these and a health assessment requirement. The minister replied that she will take a position only after the Health Council's advice, due in Q3 2012, and did not commit to legislation.

I want and can only assess this advice after the Health Council has issued the advice requested by me, on behalf of the state secretaries of I&M and EL&I, on an assessment framework for micro-organisms and endotoxins from livestock farming.

Ik wil en kan dit advies pas beoordelen nadat de Gezondheidsraad het door mij, mede namens de staatssecretarissen van I&M en EL&I, gevraagde advies over een beoordelingskader voor micro-organismen en endotoxinen afkomstig uit veehouderijen heeft uitgebracht.

Vragen van het lid Thieme (Partij voor de Dieren) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport en aan de staatssecretaris van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie over de opnamestops in Nederlandse ziekenhui

An MP from the Party for the Animals asked the health minister and the agriculture state secretary about hospital admission stops caused by livestock-associated MRSA, including the Weert and Twente cases and whether hospitals have special admission protocols. The minister answered that the strains involved were mostly not livestock-associated, that existing WIP guidelines apply, that the government will review them after recent outbreaks, and gave cost estimates for screening and isolation.
For data on the number of infections in specific hospitals, I refer you to the public information department of the hospital concerned.
Voor gegevens over het aantal besmettingen in specifieke ziekenhuizen verwijs ik u naar de afdeling voorlichting van het betreffende ziekenhuis.

Vragen van het lid Thieme (Partij voor de Dieren) aan de staatssecretaris van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie en de minister van Infrastructuur en Milieu over verstoorde bronst (ingezonden 7 oktober 2011).

An MP from the Partij voor de Dieren asked the state secretary about traffic deaths linked to disturbed red deer rutting on Veluwe B-roads, whether speed limits or night closures should be imposed, and whether hunting during the rut should be banned. The state secretary answered that the provincial Gedeputeerde Staten are responsible for secondary road safety, deer management and any measures, and that there is no hunting of red deer, only culling under a provincial management plan.
Although I regret that accidents occur, it is the provincial Gedeputeerde Staten (GS) who are responsible for the safety of secondary roads and for disturbance of the rut.

Hoezeer ik het ook betreur dat er ongevallen plaatsvinden, zijn het de Gedeputeerde Staten (GS) van de provincies die verantwoordelijk zijn voor de veiligheid van secundaire wegen en over de verstoring van de bronst.

Vragen van het lid Thieme (Partij voor de Dieren) aan de minister van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie en de staatssecretaris van Veiligheid en Justitie over onwettig gebruik van DPI (ingezonden 30 augustus 2011)

An MP from the Party for the Animals asks why the Central Information Point for Victims closed its inquiry into alleged unlawful use of Deep Packet Inspection by telecom providers, why police sent a one-day letter citing insufficient leads, and whether the OM's inquiry into KPN and OPTA's findings warrant further action. The state secretary answers that information points cannot close investigations, that the OM concluded on 28 July 2011 that further criminal investigation is not warranted because KPN's encryption prevented staff from viewing content, and that OPTA's preliminary scan found no grounds for enforcement while the CBP investigates data protection.
On 28 July 2011 the National Public Prosecution Service Office concluded that further criminal investigation is not warranted.
Op 28 juli 2011 heeft het Landelijk Parket van het Openbaar Ministerie geconcludeerd dat een nader strafrechtelijk onderzoek niet in de rede ligt.
Vragen van het lid Thieme (Partij voor de Dieren) aan de minister-president over een vegetarische dierendag (ingezonden 7 oktober 2011).

An MP asked the Prime Minister whether the government would introduce a vegetarian day on animal day in ministries and canteens, following The Hague municipality's plan. The minister refused, saying eating meat is a personal choice and that civil servants should decide for themselves, while promising more vegetarian options and information.
I am of the view that it should be a personal choice whether or not one eats meat.
Ik ben van mening dat het een persoonlijke keuze moet zijn of men wel of geen vlees eet.
Vragen van het lid Thieme (Partij voor de Dieren) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over ESBL-producerende bacteriën (ingezonden 24 augustus 2011).

MP Thieme asks the health minister whether ESBL bacteria spread from intensive livestock farming into hospitals via food, whether hospitals should be restricted to certified ESBL/MRSA-free food, whether antibiotic use in farming should be curbed or taxed, and whether farm and human antibiotic use should be separated. The minister answers that the Health Council sees probable transmission from animals but no evidence that hospital food causes infections, rejects certification and a levy, and points to the planned halving of farm antibiotic use and the Health Council advice follow-up.
It cannot be ruled out that ESBL-producing bacteria found on raw meat or vegetables may spread further through the food chain.
Het is niet uitgesloten dat ESBL-producerende bacteriën die kunnen voorkomen op rauw vlees of groenten zich via de voedselketen verder kunnen verspreiden.
Vragen van het lid Thieme (Partij voor de Dieren) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over mens-op-mens besmettingen met MRSA (ingezonden 26 augustus 2011).

An MP asked the health minister whether MRSA and ESBL bacteria are transmitted person-to-person in the Netherlands, whether this is a worrying situation, and whether further research and restrictions on shared antibiotics will be pursued. The minister confirmed person-to-person transmission, called the situation worrying, pointed to existing monitoring and guidelines, and promised a further letter to parliament on reducing livestock antibiotic use.
I share the view of the Statens Serum Instituut that the transmission of resistant bacteria between animals and humans and between humans is worrying.
Ik deel de mening van het Statens Serum Instituut dat de overdracht van resistente bacteriën tussen dieren en mensen en tussen mensen onderling zorgwekkend is.

Vragen van de leden Thieme en Ouwehand (beiden Partij voor de Dieren) aan de staatssecretaris van Infrastructuur en Milieu over het afwijken van landelijke stanknormen door een gemeente zodat melkveehouderijen kunnen uit

MPs Thieme and Ouwehand asked the state secretary whether they object to Kaag en Braassem municipality deviating from national odour distances so dairy farms can expand, and whether he will urge the municipality to keep national limits. The state secretary replied that the Wet geurhinder en veehouderij lets municipalities set tailored odour policy within set bandwidths, that courts can review such ordinances, and that he sees no reason to intervene.
Whether the ordinance meets the legal requirements can be reviewed by the administrative court in appeal proceedings against the granting of a permit for expanding a livestock farm.

Of de verordening aan de wettelijke vereisten voldoet, kan door de bestuursrechter worden getoetst in het kader van een beroepsprocedure tegen de verlening van een vergunning voor de uitbreiding van een veehouderij.

Vragen van de leden Thieme en Ouwehand (Partij voor de Dieren) aan de staatssecretaris van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie over de doorgaande achteruitgang van de weidevogels (ingezonden 5 september 2011).

MPs Thieme and Ouwehand asked the state secretary about the continuing decline of meadow birds, intensive farming as a cause, and whether agri-environment subsidies require results and are checked for effectiveness. The state secretary acknowledged intensive farming as one cause, pointed to collective management and provincial responsibility, and stated that individual farmers are no longer subject to a result obligation under the SNL scheme.

The reason for abolishing the result obligation for the individual farmer is that, besides the measures the farmer can take himself, a multitude of factors beyond his influence can affect the outcome on his land.

De reden van het afschaffen van de resultaatverplichting bij de individuele boer is dat naast de maatregelen die de boer zelf kan nemen, tevens een veelheid van factoren waar de boer geen invloed op heeft het resultaat op zijn terrein kunnen beïnvloeden.

Vragen lid Thieme (Partij voor de Dieren) aan de staatssecretaris van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie over de aanhoudende dierenmishandeling in de rashondenfokkerij (ingezonden 21 september 2011).

An MP from the Party for the Animals asks the state secretary about ongoing hereditary disease and welfare problems in purebred dog breeding, the Raad van Beheer's role in issuing pedigrees and shows, and whether bans are planned. The state secretary points to existing research, a kinship project with the Raad van Beheer, and the forthcoming AMvB on companion animals, but declines to commit to bans or a dedicated legal framework beyond referring to a separate letter.
I have committed to the House that I will send the AmvB companion animals to the House before it enters into force.
Ik heb toegezegd aan uw Kamer dat ik de AmvB gezelschapsdieren voordat deze van kracht wordt aan uw Kamer zal sturen.

Vragen van de leden Omtzigt (CDA), Dezentjé Hamming-Bluemink (VVD), Vermeij (PvdA), Ulenbelt (SP), Klaver (Groenlinks), Koolmees (D66), Schouten (ChristenUnie), Dijkgraaf (SGP), Van den Besselaar (PVV) en Thieme (Partij

Ten MPs asked the minister of Social Affairs about a reported 450 million euro fee paid by pension funds (PME and another fund) to Mn Services for asset management, and about transparency and remedies for members. The minister said the fee passage in the court ruling contained a typo, that supervisors alone may request such information and are bound by confidentiality, that members can raise concerns with the accountability body and as a last resort the Ondernemingskamer, and that a cost-reporting guideline is due in November 2011.
The Pension Act provides that only the supervisors, DNB and AFM, have the authority to request information from pension funds.
In de Pensioenwet is bepaald dat alleen de toezichthouders, DNB en AFM, de bevoegdheid hebben om informatie op te vragen bij pensioenfondsen.

Vragen van de leden Ouwehand en Thieme (Partij voor de Dieren) aan de staatssecretaris Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie en van Infrastructuur en Milieu over het houden van powerboatraces in de Waddenzee (ingezond

MPs Ouwehand and Thieme asked whether a three-day powerboat race in the Wadden Sea, a protected Natura 2000 area, should be permitted given its disturbance to marine life, cumulative effects and the precautionary principle. The state secretary replied that the handhavingsverzoek lapsed because the organiser cancelled, that activities must pass the Natuurbeschermingswet test, and that the province of Noord-Holland is the competent authority, which has granted a permit now under appeal.
Gedeputeerde Staten of Noord-Holland is the competent authority in this matter.
Gedeputeerde Staten van Noord-Holland is in deze het bevoegd gezag.

Vragen van het lid Thieme (Partij voor de Dieren) aan de staatssecretaris van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie en de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over de aanwezigheid van salmonella in vlees (in

An MP from the Party for the Animals asked whether the EU salmonella ban in poultry meat will be strictly enforced, whether campylobacter will also be banned, and who will pay for a collective fund and independent research on pathogens in meat. The minister replied that enforcement is delegated to the Productschap Pluimvee en Eieren with audits by the nVWA, campylobacter is not banned due to lack of EU support, the fund is privately financed by the sector, and safety is a shared responsibility of the supply chain.
Compliance checks are carried out under co-regulation by the Productschap Pluimvee en Eieren (PPE), and the nVWA supervises them through audits.
De controle op de naleving wordt in medebewind uitgevoerd door het Productschap Pluimvee en Eieren (PPE). De nVWA houdt hier toezicht op door middel van audits.

Vragen van het lid Thieme (Partij voor de Dieren) aan de staatssecretaris van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie en de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over het gezondheidsrisico voor transporteurs en

An MP asks the State Secretary for Economic Affairs, Agriculture and Innovation and the Minister of Health about the MRSA health risk to transporters and slaughterhouse staff, and questions the search-and-destroy policy, its costs, liability and the livestock sector's role. The government answers that the risk for healthy workers is low, that antibiotic-use reduction is the main measure, that liability is covered by existing civil law and social security, and that costs are a business risk that should not be shifted to the sector.
No studies have been carried out into the total costs of this policy.
Er zijn geen studies uitgevoerd naar de totale kosten van dit beleid.

Vragen van het lid Thieme (Partij voor de Dieren) aan de staatssecretaris van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie over het niet respecteren van gewetensbezwaren bij oormerken (ingezonden 19 juli 2011).

An MP from the Party for the Animals asks the state secretary why conscientious objectors to ear-tagging and other livestock treatments get no legal exemption, and whether prosecutors and the law can accommodate their ideals. The state secretary refuses a conscientious-objector law, citing uniform EU rules on animal identification and registration, but points to EU proposals to reduce ear-tagging through electronic identification.
I cannot create a legal exemption for livestock keepers with objections to ear-tagging.
Ik kan geen wettelijke uitzonderingspositie creëren voor veehouders met bezwaren tegen oormerken.

Vragen van het lid Thieme (Partij voor de Dieren) en Van Dekken (PvdA) aan de staatssecretaris van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie over de aanhoudende meldingen van misstanden bij diertransporten (ingezonden 22

MPs Thieme and Van Dekken asked the state secretary about reported animal welfare abuses on livestock transports by Keus en Mollink, including whether the company's licence should be revoked and whether oversight of transports should return to government hands. The state secretary said the company received a EUR 1,500 administrative fine, that the Hungarian authority certified the transport, that licence suspension was not warranted, and that details on the animal police would follow in October 2011.
On 29 June 2011 the nVWA imposed an administrative fine of EUR 1,500 on the company for not carrying out the transport of these cattle to their destination without delay.
De nVWA heeft op 29 juni 2011 het bedrijf een bestuurlijke boete van € 1 500 opgelegd wegens het niet zonder oponthoud uitvoeren van het transport van deze runderen naar de plaats van bestemming.

Vragen van het lid Thieme (Partij voor de Dieren) aan de staatssecretaris van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie en aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over bedrijven die niet hebben voldaan aan d

An MP asked the state secretary whether 55 goat and sheep dairy farms had failed to vaccinate against Q fever, when penalties would be imposed, and how mating before full vaccination would be checked. The state secretary answered that all dairy goat and sheep farms had now vaccinated, so no enforcement order would be issued, and that physical inspections would follow.
Since all companies have been vaccinated, there is no increased risk of infection.
Aangezien alle bedrijven zijn ingeënt, is er geen sprake van een vergroot besmettingsrisico.

Vragen van het lid Thieme (Partij voor de Dieren) aan de staatssecretaris van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie over levering van met dioxine vervuild vet door een Nederlands bedrijf (ingezonden 29 augustus 2011).

Thieme asks the state secretary about a Dutch firm that supplied dioxin-contaminated fat to Danish and German feed producers, including the timing of notification, the cause, existing safeguards, and whether a positive list for feed ingredients should be introduced. The state secretary confirms the supply, says the firm reported promptly, withholds the company name for investigative reasons, and rejects a positive list as no guarantee against contamination.
Given the importance of the investigation, I believe it is not desirable to name the company concerned.
Gelet op het belang van onderzoek, meen ik dat het niet wenselijk is om de naam van het betrokken bedrijf te noemen.
Vragen van het lid Thieme (Partij voor de Dieren) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over het onderschatte aantal Q-koortspatiënten (ingezonden 26 augustus 2011).

An MP asks the health minister about underestimated Q-fever infections, deaths, chronic cases, and whether government response and goat/sheep-farm rules should change. The minister answers that infections exceed notified cases as usual for infectious diseases, that vaccination is the main long-term measure, and that no compulsory liability insurance or public warnings are planned.
The number of infection cases is higher than the number of reported cases, but not higher than expected.
Het aantal besmettingsgevallen is hoger dan het aantal gemelde gevallen, maar niet hoger dan verwacht.
Vragen van het lid Thieme (Partij voor de Dieren) aan de minister-president en de minister van Defensie over de garanties over de missie in Kunduz (ingezonden 30 augustus 2011).

Thieme (Partij voor de Dieren) asked the ministers whether news reports that Dutch-trained Afghan police would fight in Kunduz contradicted the government's earlier guarantee that they would not engage in combat, and how the government holds Afghanistan to its commitments. Minister Rosenthal answered that the police are trained for civil tasks, that offensive military action is excluded, that self-defence is permitted, and that the government has reaffirmed its commitments with Afghan officials and sees no reason to change them.
The government sees no reason to adjust or withdraw the commitment that Dutch-trained police will not be deployed for offensive military actions.
De regering ziet geen redenen om de toezegging dat door Nederland opgeleide agenten niet zullen worden ingezet voor offensieve militaire acties aan te passen of in te trekken.

Vragen van het lid Thieme (Partij voor de Dieren) aan de staatssecretaris van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie en de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over het mogelijk verband tussen de gevaarlijke

An MP from the Party for the Animals asks whether the Klebsiella OXA-48 outbreak at Maasstad Hospital and a new MRSA variant in cattle relate to antibiotic use in livestock farming, and whether the government will act. The state secretary answers that no link to animals has been found, the source of the outbreak cannot be determined, and the broader antibiotic reduction policy will be addressed in a forthcoming reply to the Health Council report.
Based on the above, I see no reason to contact my English counterpart.
Ik zie op grond van het bovenstaande dan ook geen aanleiding om contact op te nemen met mijn Engelse ambtsgenoot.

Vragen van het lid Thieme (Partij voor de Dieren) aan de staatssecretaris van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie en de minister van Infrastructuur en Milieu over de illegale dump van Nederlandse mest in Duitsland (

An MP from the Party for the Animals asked the state secretaries about manure exports to Germany, the size of Dutch manure production and exports, illegal manure dumping, enforcement, and a possible manure levy. The government answered that German demand remains, reported export and production figures, pointed to enforcement and cross-border data sharing, and said it would send its manure policy vision in September.
I am after all not able to act against illegal conduct where the Netherlands has no jurisdiction.
Ik ben immers niet in staat om op te treden tegen illegaal gedrag daar waar Nederland geen rechtsmacht heeft.

Vragen van het lid Thieme (Partij voor de Dieren) aan minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over landelijke regels voor de aanpak van uitbraken van antibioticaresistente bacteriën (ingezonden 31 augustus 2011).

An MP asked the health minister whether national rules and a reporting duty should be imposed on hospitals where antibiotic-resistant bacteria are found, and whether such outbreaks warrant a stronger prevention and enforcement policy. The minister acknowledged the concern, said she is considering an extra support structure coordinated by the RIVM and will inform parliament soon, but stated a statutory reporting duty is not an aim in itself and pointed to existing professional guidelines enforced by the Inspectorate.
I will inform you about this as soon as possible.
Ik zal u hier zo spoedig mogelijk over informeren.

Vragen van de leden Thieme (Partij voor de Dieren) en Van Dekken (PvdA) aan de staatssecretaris van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie over pluimveehouders die de komende tien jaar nog snavels van kippen en kalkoen

MPs Thieme and Van Dekken asked why the state secretary extended for ten years the exemption allowing beak trimming and other procedures on poultry, despite the 2001 ban, and whether the sector would be forced to comply. The secretary defended the extension as necessary to prevent feather pecking, reported no enforcement problems, and declined to add enforcement measures or levies, pointing to ongoing research and a plan of action.
The period during which a number of procedures remain permitted originally expired on 1 September 2011 and has been extended by 10 years.
De periode waarbinnen een aantal ingrepen nog is toegestaan liep oorspronkelijk af op 1 september 2011 en is verlengd met 10 jaar.
Vragen van het lid Thieme (Partij voor de Dieren) aan de staatssecretaris van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie over het gebruik van de term scharrelei (ingezonden 11 augustus 2011).

An MP asked whether the Dutch term 'scharrelei' misleads consumers, since scharrel hens are kept indoors at high density, and whether it should be replaced by 'schuurei' or restricted to hens with outdoor access. The state secretary answered that the term is well known, the EU regulation 589/2008 governs it so the Netherlands cannot change it alone, and he opposes changing it, pointing instead to industry and consumer communication.
The requirements for using the designation 'scharrelei' are laid down in EU Regulation 589/2008.
De eisen die van toepassing zijn voor het gebruiken van de benaming «scharrelei» zijn vastgelegd in de EU-verordening 589/2008.
Vragen van het lid Thieme (Partij voor de Dieren) aan de staatssecretaris van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie over het doden van vossen met vangkooien (ingezonden 14 juli 2011).

An MP from the Party for the Animals asks the state secretary whether cage traps for foxes are non-selective, whether there are rules on checking traps, whether killing foxes during the breeding season should be banned, how trapped animals may be killed, and how inspectors should respond to a newspaper-reported proposal to kill a trapped fox in a pit. The state secretary confirms cage traps are non-selective, cites the duty of care under the Flora- and faunawet, refuses a breeding-season ban because foxes are a designated pest species, notes that unnecessary suffering must be avoided, and says inspectors would draw up a report for animal cruelty.

Vragen van het lid Thieme (Partij voor de Dieren) aan de staatssecretaris van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie over het afschieten van zwijnen binnen de bebouwde kom (ingezonden 15 juli 2011).

An MP from the Partij voor de Dieren asks the state secretary about provincial permission for shooting wild boar inside built-up areas in Epe and Gelderland, including the absence of fencing, the use of buckshot, the responsibility of municipalities and provinces, and the Benelux treaty. The state secretary answers that the Province of Gelderland is responsible for management and permitted methods, that he will not interfere, and that decisions are subject to objection and appeal.
Management and damage control, and determining which means may be used, is the responsibility of the province. I do not wish to step into that responsibility.
Beheer en schadebestrijding en het vaststellen van welke middelen gebruik mag worden gemaakt is de verantwoordelijkheid van de provincie. Ik wil niet in die verantwoordelijkheid treden.

Vragen van het lid Thieme (Partij voor de Dieren) aan de staatssecretaris van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie over het illegaal begraven van mogelijk aan een besmettelijke ziekte overleden dieren (ingezonden 19

An MP from the Party for the Animals asked the state secretary about illegal burial of animals that may have died of contagious disease, including whether similar cases occurred, what measures prevent such burial, and whether a reporting duty gap exists. The state secretary answered that such large-scale burials are exceptional, that existing duties to report and deliver dead animals are supervised by the nVWA, and that an investigation into dumping in two regions has been started.
However, the nVWA has recently launched an investigation into dumping of dead animals in the regions of Hardenberg and Zuidhorn.
Wel heeft de nVWA recent onderzoek ingesteld naar dumpingen van dode dieren in de regio's Hardenberg en Zuidhorn.
Vragen van het lid Thieme (Partij voor de Dieren) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over de fabrikanten die sigaretten steeds verslavender maken (ingezonden 19 juli 2011).

An MP asked the health minister about reports that cigarette manufacturers make cigarettes more addictive through thousands of additives, and whether additives should be banned, labelled, independently studied, or costs recovered from industry. The minister rejected each demand, saying there is no specific evidence of increased addictive ingredients, the RIVM already monitors ingredients, and the Health Insurance Act rests on solidarity.
I see no reason for additional independent research into the use of additives and their consequences for smokers.
Ik zie geen aanleiding tot een aanvullend onafhankelijk onderzoek naar het gebruik van additieven en de gevolgen daarvan voor rokers.

Vragen van het lid Thieme (Partij voor de Dieren) aan de staatssecretaris van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie over het wederom grootschalige afschot van zwijnen op de Veluwe (ingezonden 6 juli 2011).

An MP from the Party for the Animals asks the state secretary about a plan to cull two-thirds of wild boar on the Veluwe, the basis for the cull, transparency and separation of implementation and oversight, and feeding bans. The state secretary replies that faunabeheer is the responsibility of the provincial executive, that the government will not set national requirements on oversight, and that feeding and sanctions are covered in earlier answers.
Policy and implementation regarding wildlife management and damage control are the responsibility of the provincial executive (gedeputeerde staten).
Beleid en uitvoering ten aanzien van faunabeheer en schadebestrijding is de verantwoordelijkheid van gedeputeerde staten van de provincie.
Vragen van het lid Thieme (Partij voor de Dieren) aan de staatssecretaris van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie over plannen voor het vergassen van ganzen (ingezonden 26 mei 2011).

An MP from the Party for the Animals asked the State Secretary whether gassing geese was being considered from 1 July, and how the government would respond to court rulings that geese fall under the Birds Directive and that gassing them was forbidden. The State Secretary denied a new study on a 1 July start, said the government will not change its policy while the cases are pending, and refused to amend the Flora and Fauna Act, arguing that CO2 gas is an adequate, efficient method and that population growth poses risks.
As long as the case is before the court, I see no reason to change my policy on tackling the Egyptian goose.
Zolang de zaak onder de rechter is, zie ik geen aanleiding om mijn beleid omtrent de aanpak van de nijlgans te veranderen.

Vragen van het lid Thieme (Partij voor de Dieren) aan de staatssecretaris van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie over het gebruik van een wildredder bij maaiwerkzaamheden (ingezonden 10 juni 2011).

An MP from the Party for the Animals asks the state secretary about animal casualties during mowing and the use of electronic wildlife-rescue devices, and whether the government will stimulate them. The state secretary confirms a 2010 court conviction for running over fawns, notes wildlife rescue is only one option alongside outward mowing, and says the mower bears responsibility for preventing accidents.
I consider it the responsibility of the mower to take such measures that accidents are prevented.
Ik vind het de verantwoordelijkheid van de maaier om zodanige maatregelen te treffen dat ongelukken worden voorkomen.
Vragen van het lid Thieme (Partij voor de Dieren) aan de staatssecretaris van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie over het grootschalig afschieten van ganzen (Ingezonden 10 mei 2011).

An MP from the Partij voor de Dieren asks the state secretary about proposals for large-scale culling of geese, including the role of manure and nitrogen, the scientific basis for culling, humane alternatives, hail-shot wounding, and an LEI report on cheaper options. The state secretary answers that provinces are responsible for fauna management, cites research on culling and alternatives, and says the seven organisations' proposal will be costed against the coalition agreement.
The Provincial Executives are responsible for wildlife management and for weighing which management instruments are deployed.
De Gedeputeerde Staten van de provincie zijn verantwoordelijk voor het faunabeheer en de afweging welke beheersinstrumenten worden ingezet.

Vragen van het lid Thieme (Partij voor de Dieren) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport en de staatssecretaris van Economische zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie over de EHEC-bacterie en antibiotica (ingezonden

An MP asks the health and agriculture ministers whether the EHEC outbreak strain is resistant to most antibiotics, whether livestock manure and surface water carrying ESBL bacteria can be used on crops, and whether a ban on manure containing ESBLs is planned. The government confirms the outbreak strain is multiresistant, promises a manure overview and a Health Council advice, but declines to commit to bans pending further research.
There are no standards for ESBL-producing bacteria in surface water.
Er zijn geen normen voor ESBL-producerende bacteriën in oppervlaktewater.

Vragen van de leden Thieme en Ouwehand (beiden Partij voor de Dieren) aan de minister van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie over de lobby voor de vestiging van een Europees onderzoekscentrum van Heinz in Nederland

MPs Thieme and Ouwehand asked the minister whether the government lobbied Heinz to locate its European research centre in Nijmegen, whether subsidies, permits, deregulation or animal testing were involved. The minister answered that EL&I pitched the Netherlands and gave location information but made no agreements, subsidy promises or regulatory exemptions, that permits are for the municipality, and that no animal tests are registered for Heinz.
The cabinet is working to strengthen the investment climate to be attractive to national and international companies that create employment and innovation.
Het kabinet zet in op versterking van het vestigingsklimaat om aantrekkelijk te zijn voor nationale en internationale bedrijven die zorgen voor werkgelegenheid en innovatie.

Vragen van het lid Thieme (Partij voor de Dieren) aan de minister-president, minister van Algemene Zaken en de staatssecretarissen van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatieen van Infrastructuur en Milieu over het bevo

An MP from the Party for the Animals asks the government about promoting animal protein consumption in Asia, including a trade mission to Vietnam involving the royal couple, Dutch aid for dairy projects, and tensions with the policy agenda on sustainable food systems. The state secretary answers that the mission was led by him and aimed at sustainable chains rather than sales, that no royal promotion role exists, and that the government does not promote meat consumption abroad.
The Netherlands does not promote the consumption of meat in developing countries and emerging economies.
Nederland doet niet aan promotie van de consumptie van vlees in ontwikkelingslanden en opkomende economieën.

Vragen van het lid Thieme (Partij voor de Dieren) aan de ministers van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties en van Veiligheid en Jusititie over het gebruik van Deep Packet Inspection (DPI) (ingezonden 17 mei 2011).

An MP asked ministers whether the use of Deep Packet Inspection by telecom providers complies with Dutch law, whether it should be investigated as unlawful interception, and whether providers should be barred from differentiating data by use. The government answered that DPI is lawful only under case-by-case legal limits, that OPTA and the Public Prosecution Service are investigating, and that it will implement a net neutrality motion.
The National Public Prosecution Service is currently conducting a preliminary investigation into this matter.
Het Landelijk Parket van het Openbaar Ministerie verricht op dit moment een oriënterend onderzoek naar deze kwestie.

Vragen van de leden Roemer (SP), Cohen (PvdA), Wilders (PVV), Sap (GroenLinks), Van der Staaij (SGP), Blok (VVD), Slob (ChristenUnie), Thieme (PvdD), Pechtold (D66) en Van Haersma Buma (CDA) aan de staatssecretaris van V

MPs from ten parties asked the state secretary of Security and Justice why Germany refused to extradite the fugitive war criminal Klaas-Carel Faber, whether German nationality obtained through a Hitler decree was the reason, and whether the Netherlands would press Germany to enforce the sentence. The minister answered that a Munich court refused extradition because Faber is a German national who did not consent, that German authorities also consider him German without the decree, and that letters were sent to the Bavarian and federal German justice ministers asking that the sentence be enforced in Germany.
By letter of 31 May 2011 I made known to the Minister of Justice of the German state of Bavaria the importance I attach to the law taking its course in this case.
Bij brief van 31 mei 2011 heb ik het belang dat ik eraan hecht dat in deze zaak het recht zijn loop krijgt kenbaar gemaakt aan de Minister van Justitie van de Duitse deelstaat Beieren.

Vragen van het lid Thieme (Partij voor de Dieren) aan de staatssecretaris van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie over gebrek aan provinciale registratie van jachtgegevens (ingezonden 22 april 2011).

An MP asked the state secretary whether the provinces, as principal of game management, should keep a registry of shot animals, citing a court ruling that Gelderland had wrongly refused Wob access to hunting records held by its supervisors. The state secretary answered that the court did not require such an administration, that game management and its registration are the responsibility of the provinces, and that he will not impose national requirements or take action on the Wob matter.
Game management and damage control are the responsibility of the provincial executive (gedeputeerde staten).
Beheer en schadebestrijding is de verantwoordelijkheid van gedeputeerde staten van de provincie.
Vragen van het lid Thieme (Partij voor de Dieren) aan de staatssecretaris van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie over het onthoofden van ganzen bij carnaval (ingezonden 3 maart 2011).

An MP from the Party for the Animals asks the state secretary whether the goose-pulling carnival game, in which a goose killed for the event is beheaded in a mounted contest, is acceptable and whether steps will be taken to prevent it in Grevenbicht this year. The state secretary says the practice shows no respect for animals and that killing animals purely for entertainment sets a wrong example, but says it is currently not prohibited if the animal suffers no avoidable pain, and only plans to address killing for entertainment through implementing rules to the Animal Act.
Killing geese for this purpose is currently not prohibited provided that the animal is spared any avoidable agitation or pain or any avoidable suffering when killed.
Het doden van ganzen voor dit doel is op dit moment niet verboden mits het dier bij het doden elke vermijdbare opwinding of pijn of elk vermijdbaar lijden bespaard blijft.

Vragen van het lid Thieme (Partij voor de Dieren) aan de staatssecretaris van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie over door de EU gefinancierde promotie van kalfsvlees (ingezonden 23 maart 2011).

An MP asks the state secretary about an EU co-funded campaign promoting veal, questioning whether it informs consumers objectively about public health risks such as MRSA and whether mandatory MRSA warnings on meat packaging should be introduced. The secretary replies that the campaign informs on quality systems and does not need to address MRSA, that no misleading information is given, and that a warning on packaging is not proportionate.
The programme meets the Community requirements and I therefore see no reason to refuse cooperation.
Het programma voldoet aan de communautaire eisen en ik zie dan ook geen reden om medewerking te weigeren.

Vragen van het lid Thieme (Partij voor de Dieren) aan de staatssecretaris van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie over het doorschuiven van ontheffingsbesluiten voor de bouw van megastallen door gemeenten naar de pr

The MP asks whether it is acceptable that municipalities, fearing damage claims, pass pending megastable permit decisions to the province, and whether the cabinet will enforce the House's requested moratorium on megastables. The state secretary replies that the decisions lie with the province under transitional rules, that the allocation of competence between province and municipalities is not a national matter, and that the government has urged provinces and municipalities to respect the House's wish.
The mutual allocation of competence between the province and municipalities on this point is not a national matter.
De onderlinge bevoegdheidsverdeling tussen de provincie en gemeenten op dit punt is geen rijksaangelegenheid.

Vragen van het lid Thieme (Partij voor de Dieren) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport en de staatssecretarissen van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie en van Infrastructuur en Milieu over het verr

An MP from the Party for the Animals asked the ministers why EU radioactivity limits for food from Japan were loosened without informing parliament, and urged an import ban instead. The government answered that the decision was an implementing measure taken in Brussels, that Japan is the only affected source, that an import ban would be disproportionate, and that limits were since tightened to Japan's own levels.
I am of the view that an import ban would not be proportionate, as the shipments arriving in Europe are not expected to be contaminated.
Ik ben van mening dat een importverbod niet proportioneel zou zijn, omdat naar verwachting de ladingen die aankomen in Europa niet besmet zijn.
Vragen van het lid Thieme (Partij voor de Dieren) aan de staatssecretaris van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie over het bericht «14 nieuwe megastallen in Brabant» (ingezonden 1 april 2011).

An MP asked the state secretary about reports of 14 new mega-stables in Brabant despite the stated intent to pause such construction during public debate, and whether the government would act against it. The state secretary replied that these were relocations of firms whose applications predated 19 March 2010, that spatial planning is primarily a provincial and municipal matter, and that a vision would follow in October 2011.
Responsibility for spatial planning lies primarily with the provinces and municipalities.
Verantwoordelijkheid voor het ruimtelijk beleid ligt primair bij de provincies en gemeenten.

Vragen van het lid Thieme (Partij voor de Dieren) aan de staatssecretarissen van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie en van Infrastructuur en Milieu, en de minister van Defensie over het afschieten van reeën op vlie

An MP asked the state secretaries and the defence minister why deer were being shot at Eindhoven air base, whether fencing could prevent their entry and whether fencing should be made mandatory at airfields. The government answered that deer posed an aviation safety risk after a collision, that the base fence is 2.3 metres high, and that shooting was chosen as the only feasible option among welfare, feasibility and safety considerations.
On the basis of the balance between animal welfare, feasibility and aviation safety, shooting was therefore chosen.
Op grond van de afweging tussen diervriendelijkheid, uitvoerbaarheid en vliegveiligheid is daarom gekozen voor afschot.
Vragen van het lid Thieme (PVDD) aan de minister van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie over de aansprakelijkheid voor kernongevallen (ingezonden 30 maart 2011).

An MP asked the government whether the state reserves 14 billion euros against nuclear accident liability, whether insurers exclude nuclear damage, and whether the rules should change after Fukushima. The minister answered that the 14 billion is a state guarantee rather than a cash reserve, that insurers' exclusions are cushioned by a Dutch atomic pool and state policies, and that the liability law amendment will follow treaty ratifications and OECD review.
The cabinet has told the House that all lessons from Japan will be incorporated into nuclear energy policy.
Het kabinet heeft uw Kamer aangegeven dat alle lessen uit Japan zullen worden meegenomen in het kernenergiebeleid.

Vragen van de leden Spekman (PvdA), Rik Janssen (SP), Schouw (D66), Dibi (GroenLinks), Voordewind (CU) en Thieme (PVDD) aan de minister voor Immigratie en Asiel over uitspraken van de minister voor Immigratie en Asiel in

Six MPs asked the immigration minister whether his media remarks linking the Hbrahimgel family's repeated asylum procedures to delay were accurate, and whether the family's prolonged stay and their children's interests were fairly weighed. The minister said the remarks were about future procedural policy, that the case was reassessed under new policy on westernised girls to Afghanistan, and that because a residence permit will be granted, his appeal will be withdrawn.
Since the Hbrahimgel family will be granted a residence permit, the appeal will be withdrawn.
Aangezien aan het gezin Hbrahimgel een vergunning zal worden verleend, wordt het hoger beroep ingetrokken.

Vragen van het lid Thieme (Partij voor de Dieren) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport en de staatssecretaris van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie over nieuwe gevallen van Q-koorts op melkgeitenb

An MP asked the State Secretary and Minister why Q-fever infections reappeared on dairy goat farms despite vaccination, how many farms are infected, how compliance with restrictions and omwonenden notification are handled, and whether breeding bans and testing will be tightened. The government answered that vaccinated animals shed less bacteria so residual risk is very limited, that three farms were newly declared infected in 2011, that about a third of infected farms are checked yearly, that no letters to residents or stricter individual testing and lifelong breeding bans are planned, and that bulk tank milk testing continues fortnightly during lambing.
The nVWA is investigating the causes of the new infections.
De nVWA onderzoekt de oorzaken van nieuwe besmettingen.
Vragen van het lid Thieme (Partij voor de Dieren) aan de staatssecretaris van Infrastructuur en Milieu over nieuwe maatregelen tegen vogels bij Schiphol (ingezonden 15 maart 2011).

An MP asked the state secretary about extending the bird-attracting activity restriction zone around Schiphol from 6 to at least 10 km, the competent authority, wetland and agricultural land, and the status of the Regiegroep Vogelaanvaringen research. The state secretary confirmed the zone extension is being studied without guaranteeing timing, said the Minister of I&M is responsible, and that agriculture will not be banned though pilots are running.
I am examining the possibilities to extend this zone to at least 10 kilometres.
Ik onderzoek de mogelijkheden om deze zone op te rekken naar minimaal 10 kilometer.

Vragen van het lid Thieme (Partij voor de Dieren) aan minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport en de staatssecretaris van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie over Q-koorts op kinderboerderijen (ingezonden 11 m

An MP from the Party for the Animals asks the health and agriculture ministers about Q fever found on 14.4% of children's farms (35% in North Brabant), the risk to visitors, foreign travel warnings, vaccination levels, hygiene oversight, and lambing practices. The minister refers to earlier answers on some points, says oversight of vaccination and isolation duties lies with the nVWA with 90 inspections planned, and declines to intervene in breeding policy because expert advice saw no need for further measures.
Based on the submission of vaccination declarations, the nVWA concludes that in 2010 all known businesses with a public function vaccinated their sheep and goats.
Op grond van de inzending van de vaccinatieverklaringen concludeert de nVWA dat in 2010 alle bij ons bekende bedrijven met een publieksfunctie de schapen en geiten gevaccineerd hebben.

Vragen van het lid Thieme (Partij voor de Dieren) aan de minister van Veiligheid en Justitie en de staatssecretaris van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie over bedreigingen door jagers (ingezonden 11 februari 2011)

An MP asked the Justice and Agriculture ministers about reported threats by hunters against members of the public, the police's initial handling of one complaint, the number of such incidents, and whether hunters breaking conduct rules should lose hunting rights. The minister said the police communication was unclear rather than a refusal, that six incidents were found since 2006 with limited prosecution, and that existing law already allows hunting permits to be refused or withdrawn.
There was no initial refusal to come to the location, but rather unclarity.
Er is geen sprake geweest van een aanvankelijke weigering om ter plaatse te komen, maar van onduidelijkheid.
Vragen van het lid Thieme (PVDD) aan de staatssecretaris van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie over de inadequate Nederlandse controle op veetransporten (ingezonden 2 maart 2011).

An MP asked the state secretary about EU Food and Veterinary Office criticism of Dutch controls on livestock transport, including whether the FVO's findings on destination-site welfare checks reflect outsourcing of controls, and about implementing a motion to bring transport and slaughterhouse controls back fully into government hands. The state secretary replied that the FVO found official controls broadly in line with EU rules, listed improvement points to be adopted, said the FVO did not conclude controls were substandard, and promised a response on the motion in April.

Vragen van de leden Dibi (GroenLinks), Schouw (D66), Spekman (PvdA), Rik Janssen (SP), Voordewind (ChristenUnie) en Thieme (PvdD) aan de minister-president, minister van Algemene Zaken en de minister voor Immigratie en A

MPs from six parties asked the Prime Minister whether he would accept a request for a meeting with civil servants about a 17 September 2010 discussion on the numerical effects of the government's migration and asylum plans. The Prime Minister declined, saying the conclusion was a political one for which the government took responsibility and referring to ministerial contact rules under the Aanwijzingen inzake externe contacten.

No. In the debate with the House of Representatives on 3 March I explained that in the discussion, based on information orally provided by expert civil servants, a substantive conclusion was drawn for which we then took political responsibility.

Nee. In het debat met de Tweede Kamer op 3 maart jl. heb ik toegelicht dat in het gesprek op basis van door deskundige ambtenaren mondeling verstrekte informatie een inhoudelijke conclusie is getrokken waarvoor wij vervolgens politieke verantwoording hebben genomen.
Vragen van het lid Thieme (PVDD) aan de staatssecretaris van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie over de MKZ-crisis in Zuid-Korea (ingezonden 1 maart 2011).

MP Thieme asked the state secretary about the latest status of the foot-and-mouth disease outbreak in South Korea, whether animals are still being buried alive, whether a Dutch expert team and more vaccines could be sent. The state secretary replied that the outbreak appears under control, that South Korean law requires killing before burial and Dutch pressure for humane methods continues, that a Dutch expert mission would be facilitated if requested, and that no further vaccines can be released to protect the Dutch herd.
I have also been informed that in the control of FMD this often did not happen.
Ook ik ben geïnformeerd dat bij de bestrijding van MKZ dit in veel gevallen niet is gebeurd.
Van het lid Thieme (PvdD) aan de ministers van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties en van Veiligheid en Justitie over infiltratie binnen de milieubeweging (ingezonden 22 februari 2011)

An MP asks whether the former politician Roel van Duijn was shadowed by the BVD for a long period, on what grounds, whether the CTIVD chair was informed, and whether the College of Procurators-General gave consent. The minister replies that the BVD acted within its statutory tasks in the 1960s and 1970s, that rehabilitation is not at issue, that the CTIVD did not exist then, and that the College's consent applies only to police infiltration, not to intelligence-service methods.
In accordance with the provisions of the Intelligence and Security Services Act (WIV) 2002, I cannot go further into the question of what this attention to Mr Van Duijn consisted of.
Overeenkomstig de bepalingen van de Wet op de Inlichtingen- en Veiligheidsdiensten (WIV) 2002 kan ik niet nader ingaan op de vraag waaruit deze aandacht voor de heer Van Duijn bestond.

Vragen van de leden Pechtold (D66), Cohen (PvdA), Roemer (SP), Halsema (Groenlinks), Rouvoet (ChristenUnie) en Thieme (PvdD) aan de minister van Infrastructuur en Milieu over afrekenbare en controleerbare kabinetsdoelen

MPs asked whether the cabinet's speed-limit increase to 130 km/h could be measured by kilometres of road where 130 km/h is allowed, what the targets and milestones are, and how accountability will be given. The minister confirmed the plan, described an eight-stretch dynamic-speed experiment (about 330 km) and a goal of at least a third of motorways at 130 km/h this term, and said accountability would be given during budget debates without fixed annual targets.
The cabinet will account for this during the budget debate.
Het kabinet zal bij de begrotingsbehandeling verantwoording afleggen.

Vragen van het lid Thieme (PvdD) aan de staatssecretaris van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie en de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over vermindering van het antibioticagebruik in de veehouderij (i

MP Thieme asked whether consumers should pay for reduced antibiotic use in livestock, whether a levy on antibiotics should be introduced, whether dispensing should be limited to independent pharmacies, and who should lead the fight against MRSA and ESBL bacteria. The state secretary replied that higher prices stem mainly from better housing conditions, that a levy is unlikely to be effective per the Berenschot report, that the sector's own approach is preferred, and that VWS and EL&I share responsibility for antibiotic resistance.
On the basis of this report, it is not plausible that a levy on antibiotics will be effective.
Op basis van dit rapport is het niet aannemelijk dat een heffing op antibiotica effectief zal zijn.

Vragen van het lid Thieme (PvdD) aan de staatssecretaris van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie en de ministers van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties en van Veiligheid en Justitie over het wederom ten onter

An MP asked the state secretary and ministers whether courts have ruled that the Benelux convention bans night-vision devices, silencers and artificial light in hunting, and whether provinces tolerating such methods should be acted against. The government answered that the matter is before the courts (appeal pending in Leeuwarden, interim ruling in Zwolle-Lelystad) and that it will not comment on substance until a final ruling, after which it will consider steps.
As long as the question of which means may be used under the Benelux convention during hunting and management and damage control is before the courts, I cannot and will not go into substance on this.

Zolang de vraag welke middelen op grond van de Benelux-overeenkomst mogen worden gebruikt tijdens de jacht en beheer en schadebestrijding onder de rechter is, kan en wil ik hier niet inhoudelijk op ingaan.

Vragen van de leden Slob (ChristenUnie), Dijksma (PvdA), Bashir (SP), Van Tongeren (GroenLinks), Verhoeven (D66) en Thieme (PVDD) aan de minister van Infrastructuur en Milieu over de voortgang van de werkzaamheden Landtu

Six MPs asked the minister of Infrastructure and Environment about the schedule, budget and legal challenges for the A2 Leidsche Rijn tunnel and the temporary bypass. The minister answered that the schedule and budget are unchanged, the court rejected residents' challenge on 11 February 2011, and the bypass will open by 1 April 2011.
On Friday 11 February 2011 the court ruled. The appeal was declared unfounded and the request for an interim injunction was also rejected.
Op vrijdag 11 februari 2011 heeft de Rechtbank uitspraak gedaan. Het beroep is ongegrond verklaard en ook het verzoek voor een voorlopige voorziening is afgewezen.

Vragen van het lid Thieme (PvdD) aan de staatssecretaris van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie en de minister van Veiligheid en Justitie over zeer ernstige dierverwaarlozing (ingezonden 26 januari 2011).

MP Thieme asks the state secretary and justice minister about severe animal neglect at a Den Ham farm, including why 205 calves were left on site, what the inspectorate found, prior violations, and whether a permanent ban on keeping animals should be possible. The government answers that the calves are housed adequately and not seized, that 100+ animals were removed and 140 sold, weekly inspections continue, a report was filed, and that courts can already impose keeping bans, pointing to a pending bill to extend them.
As already indicated in answering earlier parliamentary questions, current legislation allows a keeping ban to be imposed in certain cases.
Zoals al eerder in beantwoording van Kamervragen 2 is aangegeven, biedt de huidige wetgeving de mogelijkheid om in bepaalde gevallen een houdverbod op te leggen.
Vragen van het lid Thieme (PvdD) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over het bericht dat dierziekten zich via bloedtransfusies kunnen verspreiden (ingezonden 17 december 2010).

An MP asks the health minister whether zoonoses such as Q fever and hepatitis E spread through blood transfusions, what it costs to prevent this, and whether routine testing of donors is warranted. The minister states that donors are screened and blood tested under EU rules, that Sanquin takes necessary measures, that the Health Council has been asked to advise on testing, and that she will inform parliament if policy changes.
I will inform you if the Council's advice leads to a change in my policy.
Ik zal u informeren als het advies van de Raad leidt tot verandering van mijn beleid.

Vragen van het lid Thieme (PvdD) aan de ministers van Buitenlandse Zaken, van Veiligheid en Justitie en van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties over de behandeling van klokkenluiders (ingezonden 20 januari 2011).

MP Thieme asks the ministers about the treatment of whistleblower Bradley Manning (a harsh detention regime), whether the Netherlands should intervene with the US, suspend extraditions, guarantee no extradition of Gonggrijp, and limit sharing of internet data with foreign states. The government answers that it is not familiar with Manning's detention regime, that the UN monitors it, that extradition practice gives no reason to suspend, that no US request concerning Gonggrijp exists, and that foreign data requests go through legal assistance with proportionality and safeguards.
I am not familiar with the detention regime of Mr Manning.
Met het detentieregime van de heer Manning ben ik niet bekend.

Vragen van de leden Pechtold (D66), Cohen (PvdA), Roemer (SP), Halsema (Groenlinks), Rouvoet (ChristenUnie), Van der Staaij (SGP) en Thieme (PvdD) aan de minister van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over afrekenbare en

MPs asked the Minister of Education, Culture and Science how the cabinet measures Dutch knowledge-economy position, what the baseline and interim targets are for reaching the global top 5, and how it will be held accountable. The minister answered that the position is based on the Global Competitiveness Index, that sub-targets with concrete benchmarks will follow in the 2012 budget, and that annual reporting will occur through the departmental annual report.
The chosen sub-targets for education, science and innovation will be further elaborated in the 2012 budget, with concrete target values.
De gekozen subdoelstellingen voor onderwijs, wetenschap en innovatie zullen in de begroting 2012 nader worden uitgewerkt, met concrete streefwaarden.

Vragen van de leden Pechtold (D66), Cohen (PvdA), Roemer (SP), Halsema (Groenlinks), Rouvoet (ChristenUnie) en Thieme (PvdD), aan de minister van Infrastructuur en Milieu over afrekenbare en controleerbare kabinetsdoelen

Six opposition MPs asked the minister to specify measurable, enforceable CO2 targets for 2020, including Mton limits inside and outside the ETS, interim targets, foreign allowance purchases and accountability. The state secretary confirmed the 20% target, explained the EU ETS and non-ETS split, said the exact Dutch non-ETS figure awaits a PBL analysis and a spring 2011 letter, and promised such clarity then.
Due to uncertainties it is too early to draw conclusions, but the Netherlands appears to be on track with current policy to achieve sufficient reduction in the non-ETS sectors.
Door onzekerheden is het te vroeg conclusies te trekken, maar Nederland lijkt met het huidig ingezette beleid goed op weg om voldoende reductie in de niet-ETS sectoren te realiseren.

Vragen van de leden Pechtold (D66), Cohen (PvdA), Roemer (SP), Halsema (Groenlinks), Rouvoet (ChristenUnie) en Thieme (PvdD) aan de minister van Infrastructuur en Milieu over afrekenbare en controleerbare kabinetsdoelen

Six opposition MPs asked the minister of Infrastructure and Environment for measurable targets, indicators, baselines, interim goals, instruments and accountability for the government's inland shipping investments meant to relieve roads and the environment. The minister listed indicators (lock passage times, waterway norm compliance, emissions, incidents), pointed to the annual report and planned targets for 2012 onward, and referred the jeugdzorg budget question to another minister.
For the accessibility of waterways, annual target values are formulated.
Voor de bereikbaarheid van vaarwegen worden jaarlijkse streefwaarden geformuleerd.

Vragen van de leden Pechtold (D66), Cohen (PvdA), Roemer (SP), Halsema (Groenlinks), Rouvoet (ChristenUnie) en Thieme (PvdD) aan de minister van Infrastructuur en Milieu over afrekenbare en controleerbare kabinetsdoelen

Six opposition MPs asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Environment for measurable, verifiable government targets on backlog maintenance of flood defences and on how the government will report on progress each year. The state secretary answered that the existing 6-yearly assessment cycle sets the framework, that a new flood-protection programme (HWBP3) and an integral safety programme will be presented before the 2012 budget, and that progress will be reported through the budget cycle and separate programme reports.

As I promised in a Second Chamber debate on 13 December 2010, I will present an integral safety programme before the 2012 budget, giving insight into the flood-safety task in the coming years and the costs involved.

Zoals, tijdens een debat in de Tweede Kamer op 13 december 2010 door mij is toegezegd, zal ik vóór de begroting 2012 een integraal veiligheidsprogramma aanbieden dat inzicht zal bieden wat de waterveiligheidsopgave de komende jaren zal zijn en welke kosten daarmee gepaard zullen gaan.

Vragen van het lid Thieme (PvdD) aan de staatssecretaris van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie en de minister van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties over digitale jacht op de Veluwe (ingezonden 17 januari 2

MP Thieme asked whether using solar-powered digital cameras with transmitters to track wild boar on the Veluwe for culling breaches the Benelux hunting convention, whether this is unlawful, and how camera use affects recreants' privacy and hunting licence revocation. The state secretary replied that the cameras analyse wild boar movements for population management, that they are not hunting aids under the convention and their use is not unlawful, and that the cameras are mostly on private land with public notification required where open to the public, with licence revocation being a matter for the regional police chief.
The Benelux Convention regulates the permitted rifles, ammunition and other means, equipment and hunting methods that may be used directly in hunting.
De Beneluxovereenkomst reguleert de toegestane geweren, munitie en andere middelen, tuigen en jachtmethoden die direct bij de jacht mogen worden gebruikt.
Vragen van het lid Thieme (PvdD) aan de staatssecretaris van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie over de aanwezigheid van met dioxine besmette eieren in Nederland (ingezonden 7 januari 2011).
