The operation of the location, and therefore the number of animals kept, is the responsibility of Wageningen UR.
De bedrijfsvoering van de locatie en daarmee het aantal te houden dieren is de verantwoordelijkheid van Wageningen UR.

Vragen van de leden Pechtold (D66), Cohen (PvdA), Roemer (SP), Halsema (Groenlinks), Rouvoet (ChristenUnie) en Thieme (PvdD) aan de minister van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties over afrekenbare en controleerbar

MPs ask the Minister of Interior Affairs for measurable, verifiable targets, baselines, interim milestones, instruments and accountability arrangements for the cabinet's plan to scale up provincial government in the Randstad. The minister replies that a vision memo on internal governance will follow in March 2011, that the Randstad plans are one of 17 cabinet reforms, and that progress will be reported in the policy agenda and annual report.
In this memo I will also address the cabinet's intentions regarding the scaling up of provincial government in the Randstad.
In deze nota zal ik ook in gaan op de kabinetsvoornemens inzake de opschaling van het provinciaal bestuur in de Randstad.

Vragen van de leden Pechtold (D66), Cohen (PvdA), Roemer (SP), Halsema (Groenlinks), Rouvoet (ChristenUnie), Van der Staaij (SGP) en Thieme (PvdD) aan de minister van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties over afreke

MPs asked whether the cabinet aims to reduce civil servants across all government tiers, and asked for measurable targets, interim goals, instruments and annual accountability. The minister replied that the goal is a smaller state expressed as a financial cut of EUR 6.6 billion structurally (EUR 1.8 billion for central government), not in headcount, with an implementation programme to be sent to parliament before March 2011 and annual accountability on Accountability Day.
It concerns a financial target that has not been translated into numbers of persons or fte's.
Het betreft een financiële taakstelling die niet is vertaald in aantallen personen of in fte's.

Vragen van de leden Pechtold (D66), Cohen (PvdA), Roemer (SP), Halsema (Groenlinks), Rouvoet (ChristenUnie) en Thieme (PvdD) aan de minister van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid over afrekenbare en controleerbare kabinet

MPs from several parties asked the minister of Social Affairs whether the cabinet is cutting childcare allowance, what the effects, measurable goals, indicators, baselines and milestones are, and how accountability will be given. The minister confirmed the cuts, gave budget figures, but mostly deferred measurable goals and indicators to the 2012 budget and the forthcoming bill, promising a legislative proposal and annual accountability.
The objectives of the cabinet policy based on the coalition agreement will be incorporated into the regular operational objectives and indicators in the relevant articles of the 2012 budget.

De doelstellingen van het kabinetsbeleid op basis van het regeerakkoord zullen worden verwerkt in de reguliere operationele doelstellingen en indicatoren in de betrokken artikelen van de begroting 2012.

Vragen van de leden Pechtold (D66), Cohen (PvdA), Roemer (SP), Halsema (Groenlinks), Rouvoet (ChristenUnie), Van der Staaij (SGP) en Thieme (PvdD) aan de minister van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid over afrekenbare en

Opposition MPs asked the Social Affairs minister for measurable, checkable targets for phasing out the transferable general tax credit in the reference minimum wage and for its effects on benefits, purchasing power and budget. The minister gave brief answers, mostly referring to future budget indicators, and confirmed a bill for 2012 without giving baseline or interim targets.
The cabinet's policy objectives based on the coalition agreement will be incorporated into the regular operational objectives and indicators in the relevant articles of the 2012 budget.

De doelstellingen van het kabinetsbeleid op basis van het regeerakkoord zullen worden verwerkt in de reguliere operationele doelstellingen en indicatoren in de betrokken artikelen van de begroting 2012.

Vragen van de leden Pechtold (D66), Cohen (PvdA), Roemer (SP), Halsema (Groenlinks), Rouvoet (ChristenUnie), Van der Staaij (SGP) en Thieme (PvdD) aan de minister van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid over afrekenbare en

MPs asked the Minister of Social Affairs for measurable, checkable targets, baselines, interim goals, instruments, income and budget effects for a unified regime for the lower labour market (Wajong, Wsw, WWB). The minister mostly referred back to the letter of 6 December and to the 2012 budget, giving only the Wajong benefit cut and a budget table.
The objectives of cabinet policy will be incorporated into the regular operational objectives and indicators in the relevant articles of the 2012 budget.
De doelstellingen van het kabinetsbeleid zullen worden verwerkt in de reguliere operationele doelstellingen en indicatoren in de betrokken artikelen van de begroting 2012.

Vragen van de leden Pechtold (D66), Cohen (PvdA), Roemer (SP), Halsema (Groenlinks), Rouvoet (ChristenUnie), Van der Staaij (SGP) en Thieme (PvdD) aan de minister van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid over afrekenbare en

MPs asked the minister of Social Affairs for measurable, accountable targets for reducing benefit fraud and how the government will achieve them. The minister confirmed harder enforcement, gave budgetary savings targets, and deferred the measurable indicators, baseline, interim goals, action plan and costs to a plan of action due in February, with accountability via the annual report and the Integrale Rapportage Handhaving.
In February the House of Representatives will receive the action plan setting out how the government intends to achieve the fraud target.
In februari ontvangt de Tweede Kamer het plan van aanpak hoe de regering de fraudedoelstelling wil behalen.

Vragen van de leden Pechtold (D66), Cohen (PvdA), Roemer (SP), Halsema (Groenlinks), Rouvoet (ChristenUnie) en Thieme (PvdD) aan de minister van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid over afrekenbare en controleerbare kabinet

MPs from several parties asked the Minister of Social Affairs for measurable, checkable targets, baselines, interim goals, budget effects and timing for the government's cuts to the child benefit (kindgebonden budget). The minister confirmed the cuts, deferred measurable indicators to the 2012 budget, gave budget figures and said a bill would be prepared in 2011 with the wealth test effective 2013.
The objectives of the cabinet policy will be incorporated into the regular operational objectives and indicators in the relevant articles of the 2012 budget.
De doelstellingen van het kabinetsbeleid zullen worden verwerkt in de reguliere operationele doelstellingen en indicatoren in de betrokken artikelen van de begroting 2012.

Vragen van de leden Pechtold (D66), Cohen (PvdA), Roemer (SP), Halsema (Groenlinks), Rouvoet (ChristenUnie) en Thieme (PvdD) aan de minister van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties over afrekenbare en controleerbar

MPs from six parties asked the Minister of Interior whether the cabinet's cuts to the municipal and provincial funds and the ISV/BLS urban renewal budget are linked to measurable, checkable targets, and what indicators, interim goals and accountability will apply. The minister answered that the cuts serve the restoration of public finances measured by the EMU balance, that no separate effect or performance indicators apply, and that accountability will be given annually in May.
Question 4: Which effect and performance indicators are used? Answer 4: In view of the answer to question 3, this question does not apply.
Vraag 4 Welke effect- en prestatie-indicatoren worden gehanteerd? Antwoord 4 Gelet op het antwoord bij vraag 3 is deze vraag niet van toepassing.
Vragen van het lid Thieme (PvdD) aan de staatssecretaris van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie over het afschotbeleid van wilde zwijnen (ingezonden 11 november 2010).

MP Thieme asks the state secretary about the wild boar culling policy, including a dispute with the Productschap Vee en Vlees over its levy to the animal health fund, disease risk from wild boar to domestic pigs, a claimed link between hunting and boar movement, rising nuisance reports despite culling, and whether annual culling is a sustainable solution. The state secretary answers that the Productschap is aware of the disease risk evaluation, that the Alterra report shows no link between hunting-induced movement and road accidents, that the province is responsible for drawing conclusions on nuisance, and that culling remains a sustainable tool so no broader public debate is planned.
It is up to the competent authority (in this case the province) whether or not to draw conclusions from this.
Het is aan het bevoegde gezag (in casu de provincie) om hier al dan niet conclusies aan te verbinden.

Vragen van het lid Thieme (PvdD) aan de staatssecretaris van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie en aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over het verzwijgen van antibioticagebruik door varkensboeren

An MP asked whether the government would publish a LEI/Wageningen study showing pig farmers concealing antibiotic use, and whether it would treat the concealment as a public health danger, impose a supply ban, fines, or extend such research to other livestock sectors. The state secretary referred to the thesis, said 99.9% of tested pigs met residue rules, rejected a supply ban as ineffective while promising a review of sanctions, referred fines to earlier answers, and said no follow-up study was planned while routine inspection continues.
I am currently examining, within the antibiotic resistance policy, the effectiveness of the current sanctions regime and will make improvements where necessary.
Ik onderzoek momenteel in het kader van het antibioticaresistentiebeleid de effectiviteit van het huidige sanctieregime en zal zo nodig verbeteringen aanbrengen.
Vragen van het lid Thieme (PvdD) aan de staatssecretaris van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie over onderzoek naar robuuste dieren (ingezonden 30 november 2010).

An MP asked the state secretary whether the government would start or fund a breeding project for disease-resistant livestock, following a Danish initiative, and whether it would match Danish public funding. The state secretary replied that existing policy already addresses robustness, that no extra Dutch public funding is needed, and that Dutch poultry breeders and Danish research results will contribute.
In my view this development can be achieved without an additional financial injection from the Dutch government.
Deze ontwikkeling kan in mijn ogen worden gerealiseerd zonder extra financiële impuls vanuit de Nederlandse overheid.

Vragen van de leden Voordewind (ChristenUnie), Van der Staaij (SGP), Van Bommel (SP), Pechtold (D66) en Thieme (PvdD) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken, voor Immigratie en Asiel en de staatssecretaris van Buitenland

Five MPs asked the foreign minister whether the Netherlands would temporarily admit wounded Iraqi Christians, recognise Christians as a specific target of violence, and press Iraq and the EU to protect and aid the Nineveh plain Christian community. The minister declined admission outside regular policy, said protection of minorities is primarily Iraq's responsibility while noting EUR 2.3 million in humanitarian aid, and could not meet the requested answer date.
Such a request would mean deviating from the regular Dutch admission policy.
Een dergelijk verzoek zou betekenen dat moet worden afgeweken van het reguliere Nederlandse toelatingsbeleid.
Vragen van het lid Thieme (PvdD) aan de staatssecretaris van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie over het laten afmaken van duizenden kuikens (ingezonden 30 november 2010).

An MP asked the state secretary about the reported culling of tens of thousands of chicks after antibiotic residue findings, including residue limits, sanctions, and whether names of the firms would be released. The state secretary said no similar measure occurred in the past three years, the chicks were removed as category-2 material, the names would not be released, and the antibiotic policy is under review.
The names of the poultry farmer and slaughterhouse concerned will not be released.
De namen van de betreffende pluimveehouder en slachterij worden niet vrijgegeven.
Vragen van het lid Thieme (PvdD) aan de staatssecretaris van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie over honderden dode varkens die zijn aangetroffen in Limburg (ingezonden 30 november 2010).

An MP asked the state secretary about hundreds of dead pigs found on a farm in Limburg, including why the municipality was withheld, whether there was no electricity, how long carcasses lay there, when the farm was last inspected, and whether inspection frequency should rise. The state secretary answered that the municipality was withheld for privacy until Nederweert named itself, that no electricity was found and its duration is under investigation, that carcasses were about two years old, that the farm was last inspected in 2007, and that inspection frequency will not be raised.
The current incident gives me no reason to increase the inspection frequency at pig farms.
Het huidige voorval vormt voor mij geen aanleiding om de controlefrequentie op varkensbedrijven op te voeren.

Vragen van het lid Thieme (PvdD) aan de ministers van Veiligheid en Justitie en van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties over Nederland als koploper bij het opvragen van telecomgegevens (ingezonden 15 november 2010)

An MP asked the ministers whether reported figures showing the Netherlands as the European leader in requests for telecom data are correct, why requests per capita are so high, and whether privacy is seriously harmed. The minister confirmed about 2.93 million CIS requests in 2009, called the 78,000 figure unverified, said the requests are lawfully regulated and privacy is carefully protected, and committed to publishing request totals and historical traffic data counts while withholding the breakdown by requesting body.
The number of historical traffic data requested will be included in the departmental annual report starting this year.
Het aantal opgevraagde historische verkeersgegevens zal met ingang van dit jaar in het departementale jaarverslag worden opgenomen.
Vragen van het lid Thieme (PvdD) aan de minister van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie over het bericht dat MRSA zich snel verspreidt in slachthuizen (ingezonden 20 oktober 2010).

An MP asked the minister about reports that MRSA spreads quickly among pigs in slaughterhouses, including through holding pens that are not disinfected daily, and about hygiene rules and enforcement, MRSA isolation of slaughterhouse staff, disinfection of livestock transport vehicles, and meat as a transmission route. The state secretary answered that continuous disinfection of reception areas is not feasible, that the existing HACCP and EU hygiene regime is the company's responsibility with NVWA spot-check supervision and no plan to change it, that slaughterhouse staff fall under the Search and Destroy policy, and that meat is considered a negligible transmission route.
I do not intend to make changes to this approach.
Ik heb niet het voornemen om wijzigingen aan te brengen in deze werkwijze.
Vragen van het lid Thieme (PvdD) aan de minister van Landbouw, Natuur en Voedselkwaliteit over het afschieten van duizenden katten (ingezonden 8 oktober 2010).

MP Thieme asked the minister whether hunters shoot 8,000 to 13,000 stray cats yearly, whether domestic cats are also shot, whether cats are checked for chips, and what sanctions apply. The state secretary answered that the figures come from a hunters' association publication, that a few domestic cats being shot cannot be excluded, that reversing the burden of proof would be counterproductive, that chip checks are not mandatory, and that hunters' licences can be withdrawn and killing a pet is punishable as property damage.
Reversing the burden of proof is counterproductive.
Het omkeren van de bewijslast is contraproductief.

Vragen van het lid Thieme (PvdD) aan de minister van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie over het bericht dat de MRSA-bacterie zich via de handel in gelten verspreidt (ingezonden 20 oktober 2010).

MP Thieme asked whether MRSA spreads through pig breeding-gilt trade and whether the Netherlands, as a major exporter, contributes to spread and should impose controls or an export ban. The state secretary answered that gilt trade is a spreading factor, that EFSA results were already shared, that verification of replacement gilts will be explored with the sector, and that an export ban is not effective in the current situation.

In view of the above, and the known information on the spread of MRSA on pig breeding farms in EU member states, an export ban to MRSA-free countries does not appear to be an effective measure in the current situation.

Gelet op het bovenstaande, en de bekende informatie over de verspreiding van MRSA op bedrijven met fokvarkens in de EU-lidstaten, lijkt een exportverbod naar MRSA-vrije landen in de huidige situatie geen effectieve maatregel.
Vragen van het lid Thieme (PvdD) aan de staatssecretaris van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie over de uitlatingen van een hoge ambtenaar over de veehouderij (ingezonden 27 oktober 2010).

An MP from the Party for the Animals asked the state secretary about remarks by the Chief Veterinary Officer that Dutch livestock farming should not be led by societal pressure toward more animal-friendly and sustainable production, and whether these remarks reflect new policy. The state secretary replied that the remarks were factual observations in an open discussion, not a new policy line, and that sustainability and animal welfare are necessary and aligned with the sector's economic future.
The remarks of the Chief Veterinary Officer were made in an open discussion at an event marking the 50th anniversary of the business economics chair group at Wageningen University (WUR).

De uitspraken van de Chief Veterinary Officer zijn gedaan in een open discussie tijdens een bijeenkomst ter ere van het 50-jarig bestaan van de leerstoelgroep bedrijfseconomie van de Wageningen Universiteit (WUR).
Vragen van het lid Thieme (PvdD) aan de minister van Landbouw, Natuur en Voedselkwaliteit over het knippen van tanden als maatregel tegen bijterij bij varkens (ingezonden 5 oktober 2010).

An MP asks the minister whether pig farmers clip or file pigs' teeth to prevent biting despite the ban, how the inspectorate enforces this, and whether research into humane alternatives will be commissioned. The state secretary replies that the surveyed clipping occurred before the 2009 ban, that filing is allowed only for piglets under seven days in limited cases, that enforcement follows violations, and that a multi-year Wageningen research project will report by end 2011.
Since 1 January 2009 clipping of canine teeth has been prohibited.
Sinds 1 januari 2009 is het knippen van hoektanden verboden.
Vragen van het lid Thieme (PvdD) aan de minister van Landbouw, Natuur en Voedselkwaliteit over het rapport «Zoelen van varkens en implicaties voor dierenwelzijn» (ingezonden 9 september 2010).

MP Thieme asked the minister, citing a 2010 report, whether pigs' need to wallow (zoelen) for cooling and skin care is a welfare necessity and should be mandatory in pig farming, and whether this fits sustainable husbandry. The state secretary replied that the sector should meet these needs through various innovative means such as showers and rubbing posts rather than mud baths, that existing herd-design programmes aim for welfare-friendly sustainable husbandry by 2023, and that ethical latitude is set through law and dialogue between industry and society.
The way in which the pig farming sector meets these needs I consider its own responsibility.
De wijze waarop de varkenshouderij tegemoet komt aan deze behoeften acht ik hun verantwoordelijkheid.
Vragen van het lid Thieme (PvdD) aan de minister van Landbouw, Natuur en Voedselkwaliteit over nieuw wetenschappelijk bewijs van de giftigheid van RoundUp (ingezonden 5 oktober 2010).

An MP asks the minister whether new scientific evidence showing glyphosate and RoundUp to be toxic, endocrine-disrupting and linked to birth defects, cancer and harm to amphibians and fish means the herbicide should be banned or restricted, and asks about usage data and information to users. The government answers that the product was authorised after assessment showing no unacceptable risks when used as prescribed, that glyphosate is EU-reviewed, provides rough usage estimates, and rejects a ban or restriction while favouring integrated pest management.
A product is only authorised if, used as prescribed, there are no unacceptable risks to humans, animals and the environment.
Een middel wordt alleen toegelaten als er bij gebruik volgens voorschrift geen onaanvaardbare risico's zijn voor mens, dier en milieu.

Vragen van het lid Thieme (PvdD) aan de minister van Landbouw, Natuur en Voedselkwaliteit over het laten inslapen van jonge kalveren omdat zij niet geschikt zouden zijn om af te mesten (ingezonden 20 september 2010).

An MP asked the minister whether calves under 36 kg at 30 days are being killed on farms or at collection points because they are no longer wanted for fattening, and whether this breaches the rules on killing animals outside slaughterhouses. The minister confirmed such calves are sometimes not collected, said responsibility lies with the farmer under existing welfare rules subject to government inspection, and declined to quantify numbers or commit to halting the practice.
It is the responsibility of the farmer to give every animal the necessary care and to comply with the applicable regulations.
Het is de verantwoordelijkheid van de veehouder aan elk dier de nodige zorg te besteden en te voldoen aan de hierop van toepassing zijnde regelgeving.

Vragen van het lid Thieme (PvdD) aan de minister van Landbouw, Natuur en Voedselkwaliteit over het bericht dat de Voedsel en Waren Autoriteit (VWA) vanwege de fusie veel gegevens kwijt is (ingezonden 20 september 2010).

An MP asks whether the food safety inspectorate VWA lost inspection data during its 2006 merger with predecessor bodies, and whether this explains a lawsuit where data first refused were later found not to exist, and calls for publication of all inspection data. The minister confirms that some outdated inspection records were destroyed in the merger, explains the lawsuit chronology, acknowledges weak ICT, but rejects full publication of inspection data as unnecessary.
No, I do not share that view. This does not concern inspection results but other types of data.
Nee, die mening deel ik niet. Het gaat hier niet om controleresultaten, maar om andersoortige gegevens.

Vragen van het lid Thieme (Partij voor de Dieren) aan de minister-president, minister van Algemene Zaken en de minister van Volkshuisvesting, Ruimtelijke Ordening en Milieubeheer over het slopen van twee monumentale boer

An MP asked the Prime Minister whether the planned demolition of two historic farm buildings on the De Horsten estate in Wassenaar, to make way for luxury villas, is acceptable given royal involvement and state funding. The government replied that the estate is privately owned, the buildings are dilapidated and non-viable, and that the municipality of Wassenaar must decide on the demolition permit.
It is up to the municipality to decide on the permit applications for Eikenhorst 3 and Raaphorst 5 that have come up in the media.
Het is aan de gemeente om een beslissing te nemen over de in de publiciteit aan de orde gekomen vergunningaanvragen met betrekking tot Eikenhorst 3 en Raaphorst 5.
Vragen van het lid Thieme (PvdD) aan de minister van Landbouw, Natuur en Voedselkwaliteit over de subsidieregeling voor integraal duurzame stallen (ingezonden 16 september 2010).

MP Thieme asked the minister whether €15 million extra was reserved for integrated sustainable barns, whether eligibility criteria were widened to allow purely environmental investments, and whether stricter criteria should apply. The minister confirmed the €15 million reservation and said criteria were unchanged except that environmental and animal-health over-statutory costs are now eligible only alongside animal-welfare investment, denying that unilateral environmental investments qualify.
With this amendment, 15 million euros has been reserved for investments in integrated sustainable barns.
Met deze wijziging is 15 miljoen euro gereserveerd voor investeringen in integraal duurzame stallen.
Vragen van het lid Thieme (PvdD) aan de minister van Landbouw, Natuur en Voedselkwaliteit over nieuwe feiten omtrent de schadelijkheid van bestrijdingsmiddelen voor bijen (ingezonden 30 juli 2010).

MP Thieme asks the minister of Agriculture, Nature and Food Quality about new findings on the harmfulness of neonicotinoid pesticides (imidacloprid, thiacloprid) to bees, the calls for a ban, water contamination and the use of imidacloprid as a plant stress reducer. The minister answers that the risk assessment is still under review via an objection at the Ctgb, that no measures are currently foreseen, that a three-year bee-mortality study is ongoing, and that unauthorised uses will be addressed.
I will inform you about the handling of the objection by the Ctgb.
Ik zal u informeren over de afhandeling van het bezwaarschrift door het Ctgb.
Vragen van het lid Thieme (PvdD) aan de minister van Landbouw, Natuur en Voedselkwaliteit over de inbeslagname van dieren (ingezonden 13 augustus 2010).

MP Thieme asked the minister about the Zwartboek on animal seizures, how seized animals are registered by Dienst Regelingen, whether storage holders were found non-compliant, and about general care and housing rules under the Wet dieren. The minister said the Zwartboek's picture was not recognised, that the three shelters were checked by the AID with no violations found, and that the general care rules decision should be left to a next cabinet.
In all cases no violations or irregularities were found and the conditions are met.
In alle gevallen zijn er geen overtredingen of onregelmatigheden geconstateerd en wordt voldaan aan de voorwaarden.

Vragen van het lid Thieme (PvdD) aan de ministers van Landbouw, Natuur en Voedselkwaliteit en van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over het hoge antibioticagebruik in de veehouderij (ingezonden 30 juni 2010).

An MP asks the Agriculture and Health ministers about high antibiotic use in livestock farming, resistant Clostridium difficile bacteria, advertising of antibiotics to farmers, and carry-over of medicines into ordinary feed. The minister says research and a Health Council advice are underway, the VWA will publish carry-over findings and intensify inspections, and a ban on medicated feed is not yet advisable pending further advice.
At my request, the VWA started in 2009, together with RIKILT, a study into the extent to which antibiotics and coccidiostats carry over into other animal feeds.
Op mijn verzoek is de VWA in 2009 in samenwerking met het RIKILT een onderzoek gestart naar de mate waarin antibiotica en coccidiostatica verslepen naar andere diervoeders.

Vragen van het lid Thieme (PvdD) aan de ministers van Landbouw, Natuur en Voedselkwaliteit en van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over het niet melden van aangiftplichtige dierziekten (ingezonden 13 augustus 2010).

An MP asked the agriculture and health ministers about notifiable animal diseases not always being reported promptly, including how many suspicions were reported, whether sanctions apply, and what measures will improve reporting. The minister answered that 1240 suspicions were reported with 141 confirmed, that failure to report is a punishable economic offence though no violations were proven last year, and listed awareness and communication efforts without committing to new legal measures.
Last year no violations of the reporting obligation were proven, and therefore no sanctions were imposed on livestock farmers or veterinarians.
Afgelopen jaar zijn er geen overtredingen van de meldplicht bewezen en zijn er dus ook geen sancties opgelegd aan veehouders of dierenartsen.

Vragen van het lid Thieme (PvdD) aan de ministers van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport en van Landbouw, Natuur en Voedselkwaliteit over het VWA advies om contact met schapen te vermijden (ingezonden 29 juli 2010).

An MP asked the ministers of Health and of Agriculture about VWA advice to avoid contact with sheep and untreated wool, whether this should lead to warnings at petting farms and cancellation of sheep-shearing events. The government answered that it will pass the advice to the Stichting Kinderboerderijen Nederland, that no mandatory visitor warnings or event cancellations are imposed, and that hygiene responsibility lies with citizens and organisers, with Q-fever-specific measures such as mandatory vaccination.
There is no obligation imposed by the central government to warn visitors to petting farms and other venues keeping sheep about the possible risks.

Er is geen sprake van een door de Rijksoverheid opgelegde verplichting tot een waarschuwing aan bezoekers van kinderboerderijen en andere gelegenheden en inrichtingen waar schapen gehouden worden over de mogelijke risico's.
Vragen van het lid Thieme (PvdD) aan de minister van Landbouw, Natuur en Voedselkwaliteit over 300 overleden biggen tijdens een veetransport (ingezonden 31 augustus 2010).

An MP asked the minister about 300 piglets that died during a transport to Spain, the transporter's prior violations, why no penalty was imposed, and whether self-regulation and sample checks suffice. The minister said the transport permit was suspended, the company's protocol was approved and the permit reinstated under closer supervision, but declined to give details on the transporter or the criminal investigation, and deferred figures on inspections to the annual report.
This takes time, and pending the investigation and its follow-up I will make no further statements about this case.
Dit kost tijd en hangende het onderzoek en het vervolg hierop doe ik verder geen mededelingen over deze zaak.
Vragen van het lid Thieme (PvdD) aan de minister van Landbouw, Natuur en Voedselkwaliteit over het essay over de ethische vragen over voedsel (ingezonden 22 juli 2010).

MP Thieme asked the Minister of Agriculture whether a Trouw-reported essay by Staman and Slob was written for the ministry on ethical food questions, and whether it would be shared with the House. The minister confirmed the report, said no new essay was written but an existing ethics strategy note was updated, and offered to send the note with a reply to the committee.
I will send the note along with my letter in response to the questions from the standing House committee for LNV.
Ik zal de nota meesturen met mijn brief in reactie op de vragen van de vaste Kamercommissie voor LNV.

Vragen van het lid Thieme (PvdD) aan de ministers van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport, van Volkshuisvesting, Ruimtelijke Ordening en Milieubeheer en van Landbouw, Natuur en Voedselkwaliteit over de resistente schimmels

An MP asked three ministers about reports that resistant fungal infections in hospitals may be causing deaths and whether agricultural azole use contributes, including the scale of deaths, resistance trends and whether azoles should be banned. The ministers answered that the data is too limited to estimate deaths nationally or confirm the link to azoles, announced an expert meeting and a VWA research project, and pointed to Nethmap 2010 figures on MRSA and ESBL.
To gain more insight into the problem, the Centre for Infectious Disease Control (CIb) of the National Institute for Public Health and the Environment (RIVM) will convene an expert meeting.
Om meer inzicht te krijgen in de problematiek zal het Centrum Infectieziektenbestrijding (CIb) van het Rijksinstituut voor Volksgezondheid en Milieu (RIVM) een deskundigenberaad beleggen.

Vragen van het lid Thieme (Partij voor de Dieren) aan de minister van Economische Zaken over de toezegging van SDE subsidie aan twee offshore windmolenparken van de BARD groep (ingezonden 3 augustus 2010).

An MP asked the minister of Economic Affairs whether the BARD-linked offshore wind projects ZeeEnergie and Buitengaats, granted SDE subsidy, can realistically be built within five years despite no financing, grid connection agreement or bank guarantee, and why the permit-revocation option was not used. The minister answered that the SDE agreements impose fines and bank guarantees on the project companies, that the grid connection is still being arranged, that the feasibility assessment found no reason to doubt the five-year timeline, and promised annual progress updates to parliament.
Vragen van het lid Thieme (PvdD) aan de ministers van Landbouw, Natuur en Voedselkwaliteit en van Economische Zaken over gevonden dode wasbeerhonden (ingezonden 2 augustus 2010).

An MP asked the ministers of Agriculture and Economic Affairs about boxes of dead raccoon dogs found near the A2, their origin, prosecution prospects, a possible import ban on raccoon dog fur and fur labelling. The minister answered that the animals were illegally kept, an investigation by the Utrecht police has not identified suspects, imports are not monitored and no import ban is planned, while supporting a labelling obligation at EU level.
No, trade flows of raccoon dog fur are not monitored.
Nee, de handelsstromen van wasbeerhondenbont wordt niet gemonitord.

Vragen van het lid Thieme (PvdD) aan de ministers van Verkeer en Waterstaat, van Economische Zaken, van Volkshuisvesting, Ruimtelijke Ordening en Milieubeheer en van Landbouw, Natuur en Voedselkwaliteit over de vogels op

An MP from the Party for the Animals asked several ministers about bird strikes at Schiphol, whether culling, scaring and egg treatment are sustainable, the costs, and whether farmland near the airport should be converted to solar energy or food crops banned there. The government answered that bird strikes are a safety priority, that a Regiegroep Vogelaanvaringen is examining feeding reduction via crop management, that a ban on food crops would be too far-reaching, and that solar panels on farmland are not yet economical or covered by subsidy.
Question 6: Are you willing to introduce a ban on growing food crops in the immediate vicinity of airports?
Vraag 6 Bent u bereid een verbod in te stellen op het verbouwen van voedingsgewassen in de directe nabijheid van luchthavens?
Vragen van het lid Thieme (PvdD) aan de minister van Landbouw, Natuur en Voedselkwaliteit over het afschieten van de beschermde zilvermeeuw op de Oosterschelde (ingezonden 20 juli 2010).

MP Thieme asks the minister whether shooting protected herring gulls in the Oosterschelde to protect mussel cultivation is acceptable, whether this fits the mussel transition plan, and how many birds may be shot. The minister answers that the province granted a derogation under the Birds Directive and Flora and Fauna Act to prevent serious damage to fisheries, that shooting is limited to ten gulls per year between 1 July and 1 November through 2012, and that the population is not endangered.
The derogation applies only between 1 July and 1 November, for the first three weeks after sowing of the plots, and runs until and including 2012.
De ontheffing geldt slechts tussen 1 juli en 1 november, voor de eerste drie weken na inzaai van de percelen, en loopt tot en met 2012.
Vragen van het lid Thieme (PvdD) aan de ministers van Defensie en van Buitenlandse Zaken over een door het Amerikaanse leger uitgegeven stripboek over homoseksuelen (ingezonden 20 juli 2010).

MP Thieme asks the Defence and Foreign Affairs ministers whether a US military comic book explaining how to treat gay colleagues is acceptable, whether it has caused problems for Dutch gay soldiers in joint projects, and whether Dutch soldiers are protected from discrimination by superiors. Minister Van Middelkoop answers that the US is changing the don't ask, don't tell policy, that cooperation is excellent and no problems are known, and that Defence opposes discrimination of gay personnel, without criticising the ally directly.
I will therefore not raise this with my American counterpart.
Ik zal mijn Amerikaanse ambtsgenoot hierop daarom niet aanspreken.
Vragen van het lid Thieme (PvdD) aan de minister van Justitie over het bericht dat Google via Streetview persoonlijke gegevens verzamelt (ingezonden 25 juni 2010).

An MP asks the Minister of Justice about reports that Google's Streetview cars collected personal data, including Wi-Fi data and email passwords in France, and whether the Netherlands requested the data be handed over for investigation and what other steps were taken. The minister confirms awareness, says the independent privacy regulator CBP asked Google to preserve the data and will not comment during its investigation, and states no grounds currently exist to bar the Streetview cars from the Netherlands.
The College bescherming persoonsgegevens (CBP) has informed me that, as an independent supervisor, it has asked Google to secure the data for investigation by the CBP.
Het College bescherming persoonsgegevens (CBP) heeft mij bericht dat het als onafhankelijk toezichthouder Google heeft verzocht de gegevens veilig te stellen ten behoeve van onderzoek door het CBP.
Vragen van het lid Thieme (PvdD) aan de minister van Landbouw, Natuur en Voedselkwaliteit over oververhitte varkens op transport (ingezonden 6 juli 2010).

Party MP Thieme asked the minister of Agriculture, Nature and Food Quality about pigs overheated during transport after Eyes on Animals reported temperatures up to 42 degrees, and whether a transport ban and stronger enforcement were needed. The minister said the footage gave no basis for investigating a specific transport, pointed to existing EU temperature rules and VWA checks, and saw no need for additional measures.
The footage as such provides no information on the basis of which this specific transport could be investigated further.
De beelden als zodanig geven geen informatie op grond waarvan dit specifieke transport nader onderzocht kan worden.

Vragen van het lid Thieme (PvdD) aan de ministers van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport en van Landbouw, Natuur en Voedselkwaliteit over de nieuwe Q-koortsbesmetting in Lunteren (ingezonden 9 juli 2010).

An MP asked why a newly infected dairy goat farm in Lunteren with fully vaccinated animals was not subject to a lifelong breeding ban, and whether the vaccine's limited effect was honestly communicated. The minister answered that vaccination greatly reduces shedding and abortion risk, so culling and a breeding ban are unnecessary, and that the restrictions would be relaxed as planned.
Vaccination reduces the chance that animals become infected.
Vaccinatie verkleint de kans dat dieren besmet raken.

Vragen van het lid Thieme (PvdD) aan de ministers van Verkeer en Waterstaat, van Buitenlandse Zaken en van Landbouw, Natuur en Voedselkwaliteit over de situatie van een boorplatform in de Noordzee (ingezonden 25 mei 2010

An MP asks ministers about reports that a Norwegian North Sea production platform was at risk after repeated drilling incidents, whether a Norwegian government report exists, whether the government will press Norway on environmental risks, and whether an emergency plan exists. The government answers that no official Norwegian report exists yet, that Statoil's investigation will be published, that Norway's regulator PSA considers the situation serious but stable, and that Dutch and Norwegian emergency plans exist.
I am willing to send the investigation report once it is available.
Ik ben bereid het onderzoeksrapport toe te zenden op het moment dat het er is.
Vragen van het lid Thieme (PvdD) aan de minister van Landbouw, Natuur en Voedselkwaliteit over het bericht dat vleeslijm niet in de hele EU is toegelaten (ingezonden 15 juni 2010).

MP Thieme asks the agriculture minister about meat glue (thrombin-based binder) reportedly not being approved across the EU, whether it can make small meat pieces appear as one piece, its health risks, and whether it will be banned in the Netherlands. The minister replies that it is not banned in the Netherlands but must be labelled, that the European Commission is still considering measures, that trombin is sourced from cattle or pig blood, and that consumers should know whether meat was treated with it.
It is not prohibited in the Netherlands.
Het is in Nederland niet verboden.
Vragen van het lid Thieme (PvdD) aan de ministers van Justitie en van Verkeer en Waterstaat over het bericht «Fileleed is goudmijn justitie» (ingezonden 14 april 2010).

MP Thieme asked the Justice and Transport ministers whether using licence-plate data collected by Rijkswaterstaat for traffic research in criminal investigations is lawful, how long data is kept, who can access it, and why CBP advice on deleting unmatched scans was not followed. Minister Hirsch Ballin answered that such data can be demanded under the Code of Criminal Procedure, that Rijkswaterstaat deletes personal data within three months, that data reaching the prosecution falls under the Wjsg with retention periods, and that automobilists are only registered if they opt in, so no change is planned.
Demanding and using data collected by third parties (persons, agencies and companies) for criminal investigation is permitted under article 126nc-uh of the Code of Criminal Procedure.

Het vorderen en gebruiken van door derden (personen, instanties en bedrijven) verzamelde gegevens voor strafrechtelijk onderzoek is toegestaan op grond van artikel 126nc-uh van het Wetboek van Strafvordering

Vragen van het lid Thieme (PvdD) aan de minister van Landbouw, Natuur en Voedselkwaliteit over de bijzondere omstandigheden van met Q-koorts besmette melkschapenbedrijven met bedreigde landbouwrassen (ingezonden 21 april

An MP asked the minister about the special situation of Q-fever-infected dairy sheep farms with rare breeds, including whether surviving animals could be tested individually and what support and breed-preservation measures would be taken. The minister answered that individual testing cannot give certainty, described existing support schemes, and said the culling does not threaten the Friese/Zeeuwse melkschaap breed.
The number of culled animals and animals under a lifelong breeding ban on these two infected farms do not pose a threat to the survival of the breed.
Het aantal geruimde dieren en dieren met een levenslang fokverbod op deze twee besmette bedrijven vormen geen bedreiging voor het voortbestaan van het ras.

Vragen van het lid Thieme (PvdD) aan de ministers van Landbouw, Natuur en Voedselkwaliteit en van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over het gebruik van dieren in amusementsprogramma's (ingezonden 25 mei 2010).

An MP asked ministers whether using animals in TV entertainment, such as a TROS game show with live eels, is acceptable for public broadcasting, and whether a binding code of conduct on animal welfare should be drawn up. The minister said use of animals is acceptable if welfare is not harmed without reasonable purpose, that this cannot be determined outright for this programme, and that broadcasters' own codes of conduct, which they set themselves, are the appropriate instrument.
It is up to them to determine the form and content of this code of conduct and to decide whether the code regulates the treatment of animals in television programmes.
Het is aan hen om de vorm en de inhoud van deze gedragscode te bepalen en te besluiten om in de gedragscode de omgang met dieren in televisieprogramma's te reguleren.
Vragen van het lid Thieme (PvdD) aan de minister van Landbouw, Natuur en Voedselkwaliteit over misplaatste uitlatingen van ambtenaren (ingezonden 25 mei 2010).

An MP from the Party for the Animals asks the agriculture minister whether measures were taken against the authors of a satirical piece mocking an MP, whether the ministry and minister are responsible for it, and how to view a 2006 newspaper report of officials aiming to undermine the party. The minister answers that the officials were confronted, fully accept that the remark was misplaced, measures were taken to prevent recurrence, and the matter is closed for her as ultimately responsible.
With this, the matter is closed for me as the ultimately responsible person.
Hiermee is voor mij als eindverantwoordelijke de zaak afgesloten.
Vragen van het lid Thieme (PvdD) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over het bericht van een ritueel geslachte koe voor het WK in Zuid-Afrika (ingezonden 4 juni 2010).

An MP from the Party for the Animals asked the foreign minister whether he condemns the ritual slaughter of a cow near a World Cup stadium in Johannesburg, whether he will hold FIFA and the South African ambassador to account, and the minister replied that he rejects the ritual, that FIFA was not involved and that the South African authorities were not involved, so he sees no reason to act. The answers rest on the claim that local chiefs carried out the slaughter, with no commitment to further action.
According to our information, the ritual slaughter was carried out by local tribal chiefs and FIFA was in no way involved in the ritual slaughter.
Volgens onze informatie is de rituele slachting uitgevoerd door lokale stamhoofden en is de FIFA op geen enkele wijze betrokken geweest bij de rituele slachting.
Vragen van het lid Thieme (PvdD) aan de minister van Landbouw, Natuur en Voedselkwaliteit over bijensterfte en niet aangepaste zaaimachines (ingezonden 21 april 2010).

An MP asked the Minister of Agriculture, Nature and Food Quality whether maize seed is still being sown with unadapted seed drills lacking bee-protection deflectors, whether the Food and Consumer Product Safety Authority (AID) would enforce this, and whether that is acceptable. The minister confirmed that the deflector requirement applies from 1 July 2010 after a sell-off period set by the Ctgb, that 22 AID preventive checks found no violations, and that a fine can be imposed for future breaches.
The Ctgb has thereby anticipated Commission Directive 2010/21/EU of 12 March 2010.
Het Ctgb heeft daarmee vooruitgelopen op Richtlijn 2010/21/EU van de Commissie van 12 maart 2010

Vragen van het lid Thieme (PvdD) aan de ministers van Buitenlandse Zaken en van Landbouw, Natuur en Voedselkwaliteit over de arbeidsomstandigheden van de plukkers van de tomaten van Ahold (ingezonden 16 april 2010).

An MP asked the Foreign and Agriculture ministers about reported forced-labour and poor working conditions among US tomato pickers supplying Ahold, and whether Ahold bears responsibility for suppliers. The government answered that the matter is for Ahold to address and US authorities to enforce, that Dutch imports of these tomatoes are unlikely, and that companies share supply-chain responsibility, which OECD National Contact Points can assess.
The NCP can determine the extent to which a company has (not) taken its supply-chain responsibility.
Het NCP kan bepalen in hoeverre een bedrijf haar ketenverantwoordelijkheid (niet) genomen heeft.

Vragen van het lid Thieme (PvdD) aan de minister van Volkshuisvesting, Ruimtelijke Ordening en Milieubeheer over het duurzaam inkopenbeleid en de keurmerken die daaronder vallen (ingezonden 22 april 2010).

An MP asked the minister whether products carrying the 'Ik kies bewust' health logo are bought under the sustainable procurement policy, which certification marks qualify, and whether the policy will be reassessed for its nature and environmental effects. The minister answered that the logo is not prescribed or promoted under the policy, that health of end users is left to national legislation, and that criteria will be updated in an ongoing consultation process.
Under the Sustainable Procurement policy, no 'Ik kies bewust' logos are prescribed or promoted.
Onder het Duurzaam Inkopen beleid worden geen «Ik kies bewust» logo’s voorgeschreven of gepropageerd.
Vragen van het lid Thieme (PvdD) aan de minister van Landbouw, Natuur en Voedselkwaliteit over vluchtgedrag als gevolg van jachtdruk (ingezonden 3 mei 2010).

An MP asks the minister whether wild boar moving into built-up areas reflect the effectiveness of culling policy, and how the minister assesses scientific publications linking hunting pressure to flight behaviour and disrupted social structure, and whether earlier answers contradict them. The minister says the policy aims at a target population, that fencing is needed to keep boar out of towns, that assessing the publications is not for the minister, and refers to earlier reports and letters.
It is not for me to assess scientific publications.
Het is niet aan mij om wetenschappelijke publicaties te beoordelen.

Vragen van het lid Thieme (PvdD) aan de ministers van Landbouw, Natuur en Voedselkwaliteit en van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties over het bericht dat Nederland opnieuw is gestegen op de lijst van landen waar m

An MP asked the agriculture and interior ministers whether the Netherlands rising on a list of countries with widely reported animal suffering is shameful, whether the rise reflects awareness or incidence, and whether the government will act in the Caribbean and home territories. The minister says the underlying method provides too little information to judge the ranking or its cause, points to growing public awareness, and says the Netherlands Antilles are autonomous on animal welfare, so Dutch animal welfare law does not apply there.
However, there is insufficient information to make valid statements about this top ten.
Het ontbreekt echter aan voldoende informatie om valide uitspraken te doen over deze top tien.

Vragen van het lid Thieme (PvdD) aan de staatssecretaris van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties over het weggooien van stempassen van mensen met een verstandelijke beperking (ingezonden 6 mei 2010).

An MP asks the state secretary whether caregivers destroying voter cards of people with intellectual disabilities is permissible and punishable, and whether action will be taken. The government says it has no data on disability status, that destroying cards may be punishable under the general vandalism article, and that it will write to institutions and check problems in the next election evaluation, but it has no enforcement powers.
However, I have no means to take enforcement action in this area because I do not have the powers to do so.
Ik heb echter geen mogelijkheden om op dit terrein handhavend op te treden daar ik daarvoor geen bevoegdheden heb.
Vragen van het lid Thieme (PvdD) aan de minister van Landbouw, Natuur en Voedselkwaliteit over de hoge aantallen edelherten op de Veluwe (ingezonden 9 april 2010).

Ms Thieme (PvdD) asked the minister whether the Veluwe red deer population of over 1660 exceeds the target, on what ecological grounds the target was set, and whether pre-emptive culling and vehicle traffic were properly weighed. The minister replied that the target is based on long experience, that the required culls were missed by the Wildbeheereenheid Veluwe, that the Veluwe uses a social-support model while the Oostvaardersplassen use an ecological one, and that traffic and population counts are outside the ministry's remit.
Collecting data on the number of cars passing on the Veluwe motorways and on the number of residents in the various Veluwe regions does not fall within the remit of my ministry.

Het verzamelen van gegevens over het aantal auto's dat over snelwegen op de Veluwe passeert en over het aantal inwoners in verschillende regio's van de Veluwe, behoort niet tot de taak van mijn ministerie.
qn: Vragen van het lid Thieme (PvdD) aan de ministers van Volkshuisvesting, Ruimtelijke Ordening en Milieubeer en van Landbouw, Natuur en Voedselkwaliteit over de resultaten van een onderzoek naar het gebruik van luchtwasser

MP Thieme (PvdD) asked the ministers of Housing/Spatial Planning/Environment and of Agriculture/Nature/Food Quality about the results of a study on the use of air scrubbers in livestock farming. The item states the questions may be considered withdrawn and need no answer.
These questions may be considered withdrawn and do not require an answer.
Deze vragen mogen als ingetrokken worden beschouwd en behoeven geen beantwoording.

m: Motie van het lid Diederik van Dijk c.s. over een invoeringstoets uitvoeren naar de werking van de wet in de praktijk
Asks the government to carry out an implementation review one year after the law takes effect, focusing on its effects on people providing aid, to check they are not prosecuted.
requests the government to carry out an implementation review one year after entry into force of the law in practice, with special attention to the consequences for aid workers
verzoekt de regering om een jaar na inwerkingtreding een invoeringstoets uit te voeren naar de werking van de wet in de praktijk, met bijzondere aandacht voor de gevolgen voor hulpverleners
Amendement van de leden Rajkowski en Van Zanten ter vervanging van nr. 29 over een geldigheidsduur van 1 jaar voor de asielvergunning voor subsidiair beschermden en verlenging voor 2 jaar
Sets the validity of residence permits for subsidiary protection holders at one year, renewable for two years, aligning with a stricter admission policy.
a residence permit under this article is granted for a period of one year
wordt een verblijfsvergunning op grond van dit artikel verleend voor de duur van een jaar
Amendement van de leden Rajkowski en Van Zanten ter vervanging van nr. 48 over een ongewenstverklaring kunnen opleggen bij veroordeling voor een misdrijf waarop 2 jaar gevangenisstraf staat
Lowers the threshold for a court-imposed unwanted-alien declaration (ongewenstverklaring) from offences carrying three years to two years of imprisonment.
In the first paragraph, subsection b, 'three years' is replaced by 'two years'.
In het eerste lid, onderdeel b, wordt «drie jaren» vervangen door «twee jaren».
Motie van de leden Boomsma en Rajkowski over de termijn voor naturalisatie verlengen naar tien jaar
Motion asking the government to extend the naturalisation residence term to ten years and raise the language requirement to B1.
the standard naturalisation term is extended to ten years
de standaardtermijn voor naturalisatie wordt verlengd naar tien jaar
Motie van het lid Rajkowski c.s. over in de participatieverklaring opnemen dat vreemdelingen zich dienen te houden aan de Nederlandse rechtsstaat
Asks the government to state explicitly in the participation declaration that foreigners always abide by the Dutch rule of law and human rights, not religious laws such as sharia.
requests the government to explicitly include in the participation declaration that foreigners always abide by the Dutch rule of law
verzoekt de regering om in de participatieverklaring expliciet op te nemen dat vreemdelingen zich in alle gevallen houden aan de Nederlandse rechtsstaat
Motie van het lid Van Zanten c.s. over een wettelijke basis waardoor de IND en DT&V telefoongegevens in hun procedures kunnen betrekken
Asks the government to create a clear legal basis allowing the IND and DT&V to use data from asylum seekers' and returnees' phones when the information cannot be obtained otherwise.
to include a clear basis in law and regulation that enables the IND and DT&V to use data from the phone
om een duidelijke basis in de wet- en regelgeving op te nemen die het mogelijk maakt voor de IND en DT&V om gegevens uit de telefoon te betrekken
Motie van het lid Diederik van Dijk c.s. over het verruimen van de mogelijkheden tot afwijzing van aanvragen van asielzoekers als de aanvrager niet meewerkt aan de procedure
Asks the government to push in the EU for wider grounds to reject asylum applications when applicants do not cooperate with the procedure.
requests the government to work in the European context for broader possibilities to reject asylum seekers' applications
verzoekt de regering zich in Europees verband in te zetten voor het verruimen van de mogelijkheden tot afwijzing van aanvragen van asielzoekers
Motie van het lid Van Zanten c.s. over een opnamelimiet en een verbod op geldtransfers naar het buitenland voor asielzoekers
Asks the government to draft a cash withdrawal limit of about 50 euros on state-provided allowances for asylum seekers and a ban on transfers abroad.
requests the government to draft a proposal for a withdrawal limit
verzoekt de regering een voorstel uit te werken voor een opnamelimiet
Amendement van de leden Van Zanten en Rajkowski ter vervanging van nr. 22 over een maximale gevangenisstraf van 1 jaar in verband met een ongewenstverklaring
Amendment raising the maximum prison sentence for violating a declaration of undesirability of an alien from six months to one year.
Amendement van het lid Rajkowski over een ongewenstverklaring kunnen opleggen bij veroordeling voor een misdrijf waarop 2 jaar gevangenisstraf staat
Lowers the threshold for imposing an unwanted-alien declaration from offences carrying three years to two years, without added safeguards.
In the first paragraph, part b, 'three years' is replaced by 'two years'
In het eerste lid, onderdeel b, wordt «drie jaren» vervangen door «twee jaren».
Amendement van het lid Rajkowski over een verplichte ziektekostenzekering voor nareizende gezinsleden
Requires a subsidiary protection holder bringing adult family members under family reunification to hold health insurance covering them as well.

Therefore the submitter introduces with this amendment the requirement that a subsidiary protection holder, in order to bring adult family members over under family reunification, must have health insurance covering them.

Daarom introduceert indiener met dit amendement de eis dat een subsidiair beschermde, om meerderjarige gezinsleden in het kader van nareis over te laten komen, moet beschikken over een ziektekostenverzekering
Amendement van het lid Rajkowski ter vervanging van nr. 28 over een geldigheidsduur van 1 jaar voor de asielvergunning voor subsidiair beschermden en verlenging voor 2 jaar
Sets the validity of asylum residence permits for subsidiary protection at one year, extendable by two years, to make the Netherlands less attractive.
Through this tightening the Netherlands becomes less attractive for admission, so fewer asylum seekers will come to the Netherlands.
Door deze aanscherping wordt Nederland qua toelating minder aantrekkelijk, waardoor minder asielzoekers naar Nederland zullen komen.
Amendement van het lid Rajkowski over een geldigheidsduur van 1 jaar voor de asielvergunning voor subsidiair beschermden en verlenging voor 2 jaar
Amendment setting the validity of subsidiary protection residence permits at one year initially and two years on renewal, aligning with the EU Pact.
a residence permit under this article is granted for a period of one year and its validity can be extended by two years each time
wordt een verblijfsvergunning op grond van dit artikel verleend voor de duur van een jaar en kan de geldigheidsduur ervan steeds met twee jaren worden verlengd
Amendement van het lid Diederik van Dijk c.s. ter vervanging van nr. 19 over het afschaffen van rechterlijke dwangsommen in vreemdelingenzaken
Abolishes court-imposed penalty payments (dwangsommen) for late decisions in immigration cases, with transitional rules, and requires courts to order a decision instead.
Motie van de leden Rajkowski en Bontenbal over zo spoedig mogelijk een duidelijke en eenvoudige werkinstructie opstellen voor verblijfsaanvragen op grond van artikel 8 EVRM
Asks the minister to quickly draft a clear, simple work instruction setting out conditions and assessment criteria for article 8 ECHR residence applications and share it with the House.

calls on the Minister to draft as soon as possible a clear and simple work instruction for residence applications under article 8 ECHR, setting out the conditions and assessment criteria, and to share it with the House

roept de Minister op om zo spoedig mogelijk een duidelijke en eenvoudige werkinstructie op te stellen voor verblijfsaanvragen op grond van artikel 8 EVRM, waarin de voorwaarden en beoordelingscriteria helder worden uiteengezet en deze met de Kamer te delen
Motie van de leden Bontenbal en Rajkowski over in alle internationale overeenkomsten afspraken opnemen over terugkeer van uitgeprocedeerde asielzoekers
Asks the government to seek return agreements for rejected asylum seekers in all international agreements, trade deals and cooperation with countries of origin.
requests the government to aim to include in all international agreements, trade agreements and cooperation arrangements agreements on the return of rejected asylum seekers

verzoekt de regering om ernaar te streven in alle internationale overeenkomsten, handelsakkoorden en samenwerkingen van Nederland en Europa afspraken op te nemen over terugkeer van uitgeprocedeerde asielzoekers
Motie van de leden Van Nispen en Rajkowski over in overleg met gemeenten en werkgevers met voorstellen komen om nieuwkomers zo snel mogelijk na binnenkomst de Nederlandse taal te laten leren
Asks the government to work with municipalities and employers on proposals to have newcomers learn Dutch as soon as possible after arrival.
requests the government to come up with proposals in consultation with municipalities and employers to have newcomers
verzoekt de regering om in overleg met de gemeenten en werkgevers met voorstellen te komen om nieuwkomers
Motie van het lid Hammelburg c.s. over na inwerkingtreding van de tijdelijke wet een uitvoeringstoets uitvoeren die ziet op de balans tussen passende waarborgen en effectieve taakuitvoering
Motion asking the cabinet to carry out an implementation review one year after the temporary intelligence law takes effect, on balancing safeguards with effective operations.
requests the cabinet to carry out an implementation review one year after the temporary law takes effect, focused on the balance between adequate safeguards and effective performance of duties
verzoekt het kabinet één jaar na inwerkingtreding van de tijdelijke wet een invoeringstoets uit te voeren die ziet op de balans tussen passende waarborgen en effectieve taakuitvoering
Motie van het lid Kathmann c.s. over de cyberweerbaarheid van lagere overheden in kaart brengen
Asks the state secretary to map the cyber resilience of lower governments, offer support where needed, and report to the Chamber.
requests the State Secretary to map the cyber resilience of lower governments
verzoekt de Staatssecretaris de cyberweerbaarheid van de lagere overheden in kaart te brengen
Motie van het lid Rajkowski c.s. over het ontwikkelen van een structurele cyberoefenagenda
Asks the government to develop a structural cyber exercise agenda with the Digital Trust Center and partners, aimed at non-vital businesses.
to develop a structural cyber exercise agenda
Motie van het lid Rajkowski c.s. over onderzoeken hoe bepaalde vormen van deepfaketechnologie tegengegaan kunnen worden
Asks the government to examine in 2023 how certain forms of deepfake technology can be countered and to consider making election or political influencing through disinformation punishable.
requests the government in 2023, in line with the regulatory options in the WODC report, to examine how certain forms of deepfake technology can be countered

Two VVD MPs asked the Minister of Social Affairs about a news report on tighter rules for asylum seekers' access to work, including barring those from safe countries and Dublin claimants, and shortening the waiting period from six months to three. The government answered that the proposal is in internet consultation, that the 24-week rule was struck down by the Council of State, that the new rules are to take effect with the Migration Pact on 12 June 2026, and that other countries use various waiting periods, while promising to review consultation responses.
The cabinet expects to send the documents to the House at the beginning of 2026.
Het kabinet verwacht uw Kamer de stukken begin 2026 toe te zenden.
Antwoord op vragen  van het lid Rajkowski over het bericht 'Techsamenwerking in gevaar: Florida plaatst Nederlandse universiteiten op zwarte lijst'

MP Rajkowski asked whether a Florida pension fund's blacklist naming Dutch universities, prompted by anti-BDS legislation, would harm Dutch companies' cooperation and research infrastructure, and what the government would do. Minister Moes answered that no impact is expected because the fund does not invest in Dutch institutions, that no signals of suspended cooperation exist, and that the ministry keeps contact with universities and federal US channels rather than state governments.
It is not clear which information precisely led to the inclusion of the named Dutch educational and research institutions.
Het is niet duidelijk welke informatie precies heeft geleid tot de toevoeging van de genoemde Nederlandse onderwijs- en onderzoeksinstellingen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Rajkowski en Van der Burg over de aankondiging van Netanyahu dat migratiestromen uit Gaza zullen ontstaan

MPs Rajkowski and Van der Burg asked the government whether Netanyahu's announcement of Palestinian departures from Gaza would cause migration flows to the EU, how screening would catch Hamas members among asylum seekers, and how the Netherlands would press Israel and support the region. The minister answered that the Netherlands opposes forced displacement, screens asylum seekers for war-crime indicators, works on regional reception and EU migration measures, and continues diplomatic pressure for a ceasefire.
For Dutch policy it is beyond question: Gaza belongs to the Palestinians.
Voor het Nederlands beleid staat buiten kijf: Gaza is van de Palestijnen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Rajkowski en Veltman over het bericht ‘Arriva: 92 procent van boetes voor zwartrijden van en naar azc Ter Apel niet betaald’

VVD MPs Veltman and Rajkowski asked the state secretary and the asylum minister about reports that 92 percent of fare-evasion fines near the Ter Apel asylum centre went unpaid, and whether identity checks, reentry bans and fine collection could be improved. The state secretary acknowledges the problem, describes identity-check procedures and fine processes, and says talks with carriers and COA are ongoing with the asylum minister committed to examining how fines can be recovered, though a concrete pilot was not committed to.
Fare evasion and not paying the fine undermine the system and contribute to the deterioration of public transport.
Zwartrijden en het niet betalen van de boete ondermijnen het systeem en dragen bij aan een verloedering van het openbaar vervoer.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Rajkowski over het bericht ‘Verdachte aangehouden voor ernstig zedenmisdrijf op Amsterdamse Weesperzijde

An MP asked the Minister of Asylum and Migration whether the rule of law applies to asylum seekers, whether consequences such as withheld allowances or asylum withdrawal always follow offences, how repeat offending is prevented, whether an amendment on unwelcome declarations should be used, whether experts should be consulted, and how unpaid public transport fines are charged to asylum seekers. The minister replied that criminal law applies equally, that lik-op-stuk policy and asylum withdrawal on public order grounds are applied, that existing measures suffice for now, and that fine collection is the responsibility of carriers, with ongoing talks with COA and other parties.
The collection rate is commercially confidential information and cannot be shared for either company.
Het inningspercentage is bedrijfsvertrouwelijke informatie en kan voor beide bedrijven niet worden gedeeld.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Rajkowski over het bericht 'Nederland mag van rechter geen mannelijke asielzoekers terugsturen naar België: 'Enorm frustrerend''

An MP asks the government about a court ruling that bars the Netherlands from returning single male asylum seekers to Belgium under Dublin, and what this means for migration control, the reception shortage and plans to restore transfers. The minister acknowledges the ruling undermines the Dublin system, reports about 170 affected men, and says talks with Belgium aim to resume transfers, with further steps on reception restrictions.
On that basis, the cabinet will consider whether the transfer of Dublin claimants can be resumed as soon as possible.
Het kabinet zal op basis daarvan bezien of de overdracht van Dublinclaimanten weer zo spoedig mogelijk hervat kan worden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Rajkowski over het bericht ‘COA opnieuw honderden miljoenen extra kwijt aan asielopvang’

An MP asked the minister about reported unlawful spending of 655 million euros by the COA asylum reception agency in 2024 and the causes, measures and reporting. The minister acknowledged the irregularities, attributed them to high reception pressure and urgent need, listed categories and measures, and pointed to annual financial reporting rather than periodic briefings to parliament.
The COA reports on unlawful spending annually in its financial accountability report.
Het COA rapporteert in haar financiële verantwoording jaarlijks over onrechtmatigheden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Rajkowski en Michon-Derkzen over het bericht ‘student encampment for Palestine’ op de Universiteit van Amsterdam (UvA)

MPs Rajkowski and Michon-Derkzen asked about Samidoun's role in a June 2025 student encampment at the University of Amsterdam, whether such organisations should be banned, how the planned terrorism-glorification offence applies to campus protests, and whether universities have guidelines and suspension powers. The minister answered that individual cases cannot be discussed, that banning organisations is for the courts on a prosecutor's request, that the new offences will depend on circumstances, that universities have a joint protest guideline and can suspend students under the WHW, and that a further letter on organisation bans will follow in autumn 2025.

As you will understand, individual cases cannot be discussed, nor the specific involvement of organisations in demonstrations, because this would encroach on the powers of the local triangle, namely the mayor, the police and the Public Prosecution Service.

Zoals u begrijpt kan er niet op individuele casuïstiek in worden gegaan, zo ook niet waar het gaat over de specifieke betrokkenheid van organisaties bij demonstraties, omdat hiermee in de bevoegdheid van de lokale driehoek, te weten de burgemeester, de politie en het Openbaar Ministerie, wordt getreden.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Rajkowski en Veltman over de berichten ‘Perroncontroles 'overlasttrein' Zwolle - Emmen komen niet terug’ en ‘Staatssecretaris: snel oplossing voor mogelijk overslaan treinstation Maarheeze

Two VVD MPs asked the ministers about reports that perron checks on the Zwolle-Emmen line had stopped and that Maarheeze station might be skipped, and about safety, identification and enforcement against nuisance by asylum seekers on public transport. The minister answered that safety is a shared responsibility, that operators have replaced perron checks with on-board staff, that identification of offenders is limited because operators lack access to the basic register of foreigners, and that a structural solution for Maarheeze is still being negotiated.
The collection rate is commercially confidential information and cannot be shared for either company.
Het inningspercentage is bedrijfsvertrouwelijke informatie en kan voor beide bedrijven niet worden gedeeld.

MPs Van Eijk and Rajkowski asked about a stabbing by a tbs patient who had earlier been granted unaccompanied leave, victims' speaking rights, and the legal basis for leave for unlawfully present foreigners in tbs. The Secretary of State answered that individual cases cannot be discussed, outlined the victim-notification and speaking-right arrangements, and acknowledged the tension between migration and criminal law, promising talks with the Minister of Asylum and Migration.
I do not make statements about individual cases.
Ik doe geen uitspraken over individuele gevallen.

An MP asked the minister how a US woman wanted for murder could register for asylum in Ter Apel under her real name and stay unnoticed for weeks, and what checks exist for international alerts. The government declined to discuss the individual case, explained that SIS alerts are checked at intake, and said no structural change is needed beyond adding European databases under the Migration Pact.
I cannot make statements about ongoing criminal proceedings.
Over lopende strafrechtelijke procedures kan ik geen uitspraken doen.

An MP asked the State Secretary for the timeline of planned tightening of naturalisation rules: extending the standard residence term from five to ten years (requires a law change, expected consultation Q3 2025) and raising the language requirement from A2 to B1 (general administrative measure). The bill for this is in preparation and is expected to go to (internet) consultation in the third quarter of this year.
Het wetsvoorstel daartoe is in voorbereiding en wordt naar verwachting in het derde kwartaal van dit jaar in (internet)consultatie gegeven.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Rajkowski over het bericht 'Asielzoekers die overlast geven of crimineel zijn komen op speciale lijst, maar aanvraag loopt door: teller staat op ruim 1.180'

An MP asked the Minister for Asylum and Migration about reports that asylum seekers causing nuisance or crime are placed on a Top-X list, and about incident registration, reporting to the IND, prosecution, revocation of residence permits and legal aid fees. The minister answered that COA registers incidents and encourages reporting, that not all incidents are shared with the IND, that the number of residence permits revoked or refused on public order grounds rose, and that there is no 'perverse business model' in asylum legal aid.
The number of reports against asylum seekers cannot be traced from the police system in that way.
Het aantal aangiften tegen asielzoekers valt op die manier niet uit het politiesysteem te herleiden.

An MP from the VVD asks the Minister of Asylum and Migration why most asylum seekers subject to Dublin transfers do not leave for the responsible EU state, why other member states accept so few transfers, and how courts' blocking of transfers fits EU mutual trust. The Minister answers that transfers depend on several factors, outlines legal reforms and EU Pact measures, and commits to further steps on Dublin enforcement and ending irregular stays.
In response, on 15 May I submitted a bill to the Council of State for advice that provides that the six-month transfer period only begins after the (appeal) procedure has ended.

Als antwoord hierop heb ik op 15 mei jl. een wetsvoorstel ter advisering voorgelegd aan de Raad van State dat regelt dat de overdrachtstermijn van zes maanden pas aanvangt na afloop van de (hoger)beroepsprocedure.

Three MPs asked the Minister of Asylum and Migration about reports of misuse of taxi transport for asylum seekers, including a rejected Woo request, the costs and number of medically indicated taxi rides, verification of medical appointments, suspected 'ghost rides' and whether the rules should be tightened. The minister answered in detail on numbers, indication criteria and controls, stated that further investigation is underway, and announced stricter rules for non-medical taxi rides from 1 June.
COA refused the document on the ground that it contains competitive and commercially sensitive information provided to COA in confidence.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Podt, Piri, Rajkowski, Van Nispen, Boomsma en Van Zanten over het preventiefonds en schaderegelingen voor ondernemers in Ter Apel

MPs asked whether the 800,000 euro preventive fund for Ter Apel is nearly exhausted, how remaining costs will be financed, whether damage settlement will be broadened by this summer, and whether a single counter for damage claims and preventive funds can be set up. The minister said the funds were paid to Westerwolde municipality, that the damage scheme will be widened case by case, and that a single counter is being explored with a decentralised grant to be decided by the municipality.
As promised to the House and stated in the letter of 11 March 2025, the damage scheme will be broadened.
Zoals aan de Kamer toegezegd en benoemd in de Kamerbrief op 11 maart 2025, zal de schaderegeling verruimd worden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ellian en Rajkowski over de capaciteit vreemdelingendetentie

Two VVD MPs asked how the government would create 50 to 100 extra immigration detention places, where they would be located, and whether this reduces prison capacity. The minister answers that 90 places will be created at Justitieel Complex Schiphol in phases (August and November 2025) and that staffing shortages may force some prison capacity offline.
We have decided to realise 90 places for immigration detention at Justitieel Complex Schiphol from 1 August 2025.
We hebben besloten om per 1 augustus 2025 90 plekken voor vreemdelingenbewaring te realiseren op het Justitieel Complex Schiphol (hierna: JCS).
