An MP asks the Minister of Asylum and Migration about the sharp rise in penalty payments (dwangsommen) paid by the IND to asylum seekers, the cost of court proceedings, and whether these payments should be abolished. The minister explains rising backlogs and more default notices, says the IND cannot prioritise cases by penalty notices, confirms asylum seekers must in principle contribute to reception costs, and states the government aims to abolish judicial penalty payments in migration cases.
The judicial penalty payment in fact does not function as an effective legal remedy because it does not lead to what the applicant is actually seeking: a decision in the short term.
De rechterlijk dwangsom functioneert feitelijk niet als effectief rechtsmiddel doordat het niet leidt tot dat waar het de rechtzoekende om gaat: een beslissing op korte termijn.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Rajkowski over diverse cijfers omtrent asiel

An MP from the VVD asked the Minister for Asylum and Migration about asylum application numbers, outflow from COA reception, the growing share of status holders in reception, plans and costs for transitional housing locations, and reducing emergency reception costs. The Minister answered with figures and projections, committed to informing the House on transitional locations in February, and said the government will prioritise faster outflow of status holders, though several cost and timing questions were left open.
I am aware of this article.
Ik ben bekend met dit artikel.
Antwoord op Vragen van de leden Michon- Derkzen, Becker en Rajkowski over de komst van omstreden predikers naar de Ramadan Expo in de Jaarbeurs

MPs from the VVD asked the Justice and Asylum ministers how to keep three controversial preachers with past antisemitic, homophobic and extremist statements from speaking at the Ramadan Expo in Utrecht, and what could be done about the organisers and the venue. The Minister said the three were barred via SIS signalling, that a court suspended this until a decision on objection, that the municipality holds the power over public order and any prohibition, and that prosecution remains possible if speech is criminal.

On 20 February 2025 the interim relief judge suspended these decisions until six weeks after the decision on the objection, with the result that the alerts in the Schengen Information System were removed and the persons can travel to the Netherlands.

Op 20 februari 2025 heeft de voorzieningenrechter deze besluiten geschorst tot zes weken na bekendmaking van de beslissing op bezwaar, met als gevolg dat de signaleringen in het Schengeninformatiesysteem verwijderd zijn en personen Nederland in kunnen reizen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dral en Rajkowski over het artikel ‘Mensensmokkel via zee goudmijn’

MPs Dral and Rajkowski asked the government about reports that criminal networks use the Netherlands as a hub for preparing people-smuggling crossings to the UK, including monitoring of networks, reporting by the maritime sector, social media recruitment and protection of unaccompanied minor Vietnamese girls. Minister Van Weel answered that preparatory acts occur in the Netherlands, that international cooperation (Europol OTF Wave, Calais Group) is ongoing, that reports are not centrally recorded so no comparative figures exist, and that current protection measures for unaccompanied minors are considered sufficient.
However, figures on these reports are not centrally recorded and therefore cannot be compared with previous years.
Cijfers over deze meldingen worden echter niet centraal bijgehouden, en zijn dus ook niet te vergelijken met voorgaande jaren.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Rajkowski en Peter de Groot over het bericht 'Helft van het aantal asielopvangplekken in 2026 bezet door statushouders'

MPs Rajkowski and De Groot (VVD) asked about projected statushouder occupancy of asylum reception places, rising family reunification, and housing for status holders after the taakstelling is abolished. The Minister of Asylum and Migration answered that the government is pursuing stricter family reunification rules, expects a two-status system to reduce reunification, and will bring forward measures and temporary housing plans with local authorities, without giving a firm timeline for permanent solutions.
The cabinet has included in its Coalition Agreement and Government Programme that family reunification will be further restricted.
Het kabinet heeft in haar Hoofdlijnenakkoord en in het Regeerprogramma opgenomen dat nareis verder wordt beperkt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Rajkowski over het bericht 'Eén man, 25 baby’s: ‘verblijfskinderen’ zijn een nieuwe manier om asiel te krijgen'

An MP asks the Minister of Asylum and Migration about reports of men recognising many children to obtain residence permits, including IND fraud-signal figures, EU comparisons, nationalities, financial effects, municipal patterns and enforcement capacity. The minister gives figures and explains the legal framework, but declines to share an internal IND report and defers the new approach to schijnerkenningen.

Are you willing to share the IND report referring to a network of 'sham fathers'? If not, why not? Answer 16: No, because this IND report concerns the elaboration of an individual case and contains confidential personal data.

Bent u bereid het IND-rapport waarin wordt verwezen naar een netwerk van «schijnvaders» te delen? Zo nee, waarom niet? Antwoord 16 Nee, omdat dit IND-rapport de uitwerking van een individuele casus betreft en het rapport vertrouwelijke persoonsgegevens bevat.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Rajkowski, Aartsen en Becker over het bericht 'Duizenden asielzoekers krijgen werkvergunning nu regels soepeler zijn'

VVD MPs asked the ministers about a report that thousands of asylum seekers receive work permits since the 24-week rule was lifted, including refusal rates, processing times, and whether asylum seekers from safe countries or with low chances of asylum can work. The minister answered that the rule change largely explains the rise, about 11% of 2024 applications were refused and 25-30% withdrawn or refused, processing has been partly delayed, only under 1% of permits went to safe-country nationals, and restricting such groups awaits implementation of the EU reception directive by June 2026.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Rajkowski over de toepassing van de Tijdelijke Wet nu het huisvestingsvraagstuk van de CTIVD (voorlopig) opgelost is

An MP asked whether, now that the CTIVD's housing problem is provisionally resolved, the intelligence services' suspended powers under the Temporary Act can be resumed and from when. The government answered that some powers are already being applied under the Temporary Act through agreements with the CTIVD, that a shift to CTIVD oversight is planned, and that full application will follow as CTIVD staffing grows, without giving a firm date.
The starting point is and remains full application of the Temporary Act under the necessary independent oversight, within the shortest possible term that is feasible for all parties.
Uitgangspunt is en blijft volledige toepassing van de Tijdelijke wet onder het noodzakelijke onafhankelijke toezicht, op de kortst mogelijke en voor alle partijen uitvoerbare termijn.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Rajkowski en Boomsma over het bericht 'Onverantwoord veel' asielzoekers vast in aanmeldcentrum Schiphol'

MPs Rajkowski and Boomsma asked the Minister for Asylum and Migration about the rising number of asylum claims at Schiphol and what measures will be taken. The minister confirmed a surge from mid-October 2024 among transit passengers from Chad, Senegal, Mauritania and Central African Republic, introduced a transit visa requirement on 25 November 2024 and said monitoring and airline contacts continue.
Since 25 November 2024, a airport transit visa requirement has therefore been introduced for travellers with Chadian, Senegalese, Mauritanian and Central African nationality.
Sinds 25 november 2024 is daarom een luchthaventransitvisumplicht ingesteld voor reizigers met de Tsjadische, Senegalese, Mauritaanse en Centraal-Afrikaanse nationaliteit.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Rajkowski en Kamminga over het bericht 'Kabinet wil uitgeprocedeerde Afrikaanse asielzoekers naar Oeganda sturen'

MPs Rajkowski and Kamminga asked the government about reports that the cabinet wants to send rejected African asylum seekers to Uganda, and about migration deals with third countries, Uganda's anti-LGBTI law, and plans for return hubs. The minister confirmed that partnerships with third countries are a key element, said talks with Uganda are at an early exploratory stage, and declined to give figures, costs, timelines or a timeframe for answering.
The talks with Uganda are at an initial stage.
De gesprekken met Oeganda bevinden zich in een beginstadium.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Rajkowski over het bericht ‘COA verwacht komende dagen voldoende opvangplekken te hebben in Ter Apel’

An MP asked the Minister of Asylum and Migration about overcrowding at the Ter Apel asylum reception centre, including causes, forecasting, contacts with the mayor and municipalities, and reliance on emergency shelters. The minister answered that reception capacity is full, cited the mix of inflow, status-holder outflow and available places as causes, and said talks with municipalities continue, while declining to list municipalities offering places.
In order not to disrupt the ongoing talks with municipalities, I am not including an overview listing which municipalities are in talks.
Om de lopende gesprekken met gemeenten niet te doorkruisen, neem ik geen overzicht op waarin is vermeld met welke gemeenten gesprekken lopen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Rajkowski en Michon-Derkzen over winkelverboden aan criminele overlastgevende asielzoekers

Two VVD MPs asked about shop bans against criminal nuisance-causing asylum seekers: how many were imposed since 2020, whether shopkeepers must serve them personally and translate them, and how reporting of theft and violations can be encouraged. The minister reported rising numbers of individual and collective shop bans, explained that shop bans must be served in person with no legal translation requirement but must be understandable to the suspect, and pointed to police and CCV measures and the existing toolbox.
There is no statutory provision requiring that a shop ban be issued in the native language of the person concerned.
Er bestaat geen wettelijke bepaling die verplicht tot het uitreiken van een winkelverbod in de (moeder)taal van de betrokkene/verdachte.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Rajkowski over het bericht 'Duitsland gaat paspoorten controleren bij alle landsgrenzen'

An MP asked the Minister of Asylum and Migration about Germany's reinstated internal border checks, including whether they would apply at the Dutch border, what consultation took place, and whether the Netherlands would follow suit. The minister confirmed notification from Germany, ongoing operational contact, and said the Netherlands will introduce temporary, non-systematic internal border checks from 9 December 2024 to 8 June 2025 while limiting economic impact.
I informed the House on 11 November of the cabinet's decision to temporarily reintroduce internal border supervision between 9 December 2024 and 8 June 2025.
Ik heb de Kamer op 11 november jl. geïnformeerd over het besluit van het kabinet om tussen 9 december 2024 en 8 juni 2025 het binnengrenstoezicht tijdelijk her in te voeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Rajkowski over het bericht ‘Asielzoekers veroorzaken overlast in Grave: 'Mensen durven straat niet op'’

An MP from the VVD asked the Minister for Asylum and Migration about reported nuisance by asylum seekers in Grave, including whether it stemmed from a transfer from Budel, which asylum groups were involved, and whether overlast-causing asylum seekers could be moved to stricter locations such as a PBL. The minister answered that police recorded a rise in reports linked to two separate incidents, that two residents were arrested and personal details withheld for privacy, and outlined a tougher policy package including a faster process-availability approach and stricter supervision, while noting local authorities hold public-order responsibility.
For privacy reasons I cannot go further into the information you requested about these persons.
Om privacyredenen kan ik verder niet ingaan op de door u gevraagde informatie over deze personen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Rajkowski over het bericht ‘Ministerie en IND: uitzetting van Mikael en moeder naar Armenië onvermijdelijk’

An MP asked the Minister of Asylum and Migration about a news report that the removal of a boy and his mother to Armenia was unavoidable, and about the rules on repeated asylum applications, the closed Kinderpardon arrangement, the discretionary power of the IND director-general, and humane return of families. The minister answered at length, describing the procedures, the 2019 arrangement statistics, the limited discretionary power since May 2019, and the safeguards for families with children, without committing to a new action.
An asylum application is always assessed individually and is never a political decision, but follows from an objective weighing of the risks on return.
Een asielaanvraag wordt altijd individueel beoordeeld en is nooit een politieke beslissing, maar volgt uit een objectieve weging van de risico's bij terugkeer.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Rajkowski over het bericht ‘Gemeenten met azc’s moeten van minister Faber nog vóór 1 september extra plekken vrijmaken’

An MP asked whether the minister consulted municipalities before ordering extra asylum placements to relieve Ter Apel, how this fits with COA agreements, and what happens if municipalities refuse. The minister answered that COA has legal authority to place asylum seekers and that no prior consultation with municipalities took place, though municipalities could object and alternatives were sought, and that Ter Apel occupancy has since risen again so further measures and new locations are needed.
Therefore, no consultation with municipalities took place prior to this measure.
Derhalve heeft voorafgaand aan deze maatregel geen overleg plaatsgevonden met gemeenten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Rajkowski over het bericht ‘Boodschap aan Oekraïense vluchtelingen: zoek zelf verblijfplaats, eventueel in ander land’

An MP asked the Minister of Asylum and Migration about a flyer telling Ukrainian displaced persons to find their own shelter, possibly in another country, after the Jaarbeurs hub closed, and how this fits Dutch protection obligations. The minister answered that the number of recipients and of those who found shelter is unknown, that shelter capacity is nearly full, and that the flyer's wording was too simplistic and has been clarified, while stating that displaced persons meeting the Temporary Protection Directive keep their right to protection in the Netherlands.
I do not know how many displaced persons received the letter from the Veiligheidsregio Utrecht, nor how many of them ultimately secured a sleeping place.
Mij is niet bekend hoeveel ontheemden de brief van de Veiligheidsregio Utrecht hebben ontvangen, noch hoeveel ontheemden hiervan alsnog een slaapplek hebben bemachtigd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Valize, Six Dijkstra en Rajkowski over de kabinetsbrief Gemelde kwetsbaarheid Cisco Webex vergadervoorziening

MPs Valize, Six Dijkstra and Rajkowski asked about a Cisco Webex vulnerability that exposed metadata of government meetings, whether calls could be joined by phone, and which classification levels may be discussed on Webex. The State Secretary answered that Webex may be used up to Departementaal VERTROUWELIJK, that no Dutch cases of misuse are known, and that the Cisco vulnerability disclosure process will be discussed with Cisco.
However, no cases are known in the Netherlands in which unauthorised users attended confidential video meetings of the national government.
Binnen Nederland zijn echter geen gevallen bekend waarbij ongeautoriseerde gebruikers vertrouwelijke videovergaderingen van de Rijksoverheid hebben bijgewoond.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Rajkowski over het bericht dat werknemers in een brief stellen dat OpenAI roekeloos is en dat het ontbreekt aan toezicht

An MP asked the ministers whether they are aware of employees' letter calling OpenAI reckless and lacking oversight, how the AI Act's delayed entry into force can be bridged, whether an AI advisory council and an AI factory should be set up, and whether the government will press the European Commission for transparency from OpenAI. The government answered at length that the AI Act is being phased in, that Dutch supervisors (AP's DCA, RDI) are preparing oversight, that an AI advisory council is being explored with results expected this autumn, and that the EU AI Office will oversee general-purpose models and draft codes of practice in dialogue with providers.
I expect to be able to share the outcomes of this study with your House this autumn.
Ik verwacht dit najaar de uitkomsten van dit onderzoek met uw Kamer te kunnen delen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Campen en Rajkowski over het zonder veiligheidsonderzoek toelaten door Hongarije van Russische en Wit-Russische «gastarbeiders» tot het Schengengebied

Two MPs asked whether Hungary's extension of its National Card work permit to Russian and Belarusian workers without security screening violates Schengen and sanctions rules, and what risks this poses for the Netherlands. The government answered that individual entry bans still apply, that Hungary must still carry out border checks, that the Commission has asked Hungary for information and the Netherlands is awaiting its assessment, and that the risk of intelligence officers using this route is taken seriously.

EU Commissioner for Home Affairs Ylva Johansson requested by letter on 1 August that Hungary's Minister of Internal Affairs provide text and explanation at short notice on the extension of the National Card to Belarusian and Russian nationals.
Eurocommissaris voor Binnenlandse Zaken Ylva Johansson heeft op 1 augustus jl. per brief aan de Hongaarse Minister van Binnenlandse Zaken Hongarije verzocht op korte termijn tekst en uitleg te geven
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Aartsen en Rajkowski over de huiverigheid van werkgevers om kunstmatige intelligentie in te zetten

MPs Aartsen and Rajkowski asked the Ministers of Social Affairs and Economic Affairs about Dutch employers' reluctance to deploy AI, including its role in easing labour shortages, comparisons with Poland, Germany and Belgium, and government support. The ministers answered that AI offers productivity gains and labour-shortage relief, pointed to existing programmes (AiNed, ROBUST, NL AIC), and announced an SER advisory request and an exploration of an AI advisory council.
It is expected that a proposal will be sent to your House this autumn.
Naar verwachting wordt dit najaar een voorstel aan uw Kamer verstuurd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Rajkowski over het bericht dat “twee kinderopvangcentra in Utrecht per direct zijn gesloten"

An MP asked the Minister of Social Affairs about two unregistered childcare centres in Utrecht closed immediately, including how illegal operations went unnoticed and how to prevent cross-municipal evasion. The minister answered that unregistered centres are unknown to supervisors, that the municipality handles enforcement and a Public Prosecution report was filed, and that no structural change to the system is currently planned beyond existing information-sharing arrangements.
They are not aware of childcare that is not registered in the National Childcare Register.
Zij zijn niet op de hoogte van kinderopvang die niet ingeschreven is in het Landelijk Register Kinderopvang.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Rahimi en Rajkowski over het bericht ‘Experts sabelen overheid neer om belangrijke websites als DigiD: ‘Pas nu domeinnaam aan’

Two MPs from the VVD asked the government about calls to move key government websites such as DigiD to a uniform .gov or .overheid domain to counter cybercrime and phishing. The State Secretary answered that a national top-level domain is not possible for now, that a second-level domain such as overheid.nl or gov.nl is being worked on with an implementation approach to follow, and that such a change alone will not prevent cybercrime.
An implementation approach for a single extension is currently being worked on.
Momenteel wordt gewerkt aan een implementatie-aanpak voor één extensie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Rajkowski en Minhas  over het bericht ‘Ernstig lek bij Kadaster: miljoenen woonadressen door iedereen op te zoeken’

MPs Rajkowski and Minhas asked the minister about a leak at the Kadaster that let anyone look up residential addresses by name, and about the measures taken, the planned law change, data-breach notification and access logging. The minister answered that the leak has been closed, that verification of existing business accounts is nearly complete, that a Kadasterbesluit amendment restricting name search is being prepared, and that affected persons are being informed.
The leak in the registration procedure has now been fully closed.
Het lek in de aanmeldprocedure is inmiddels volledig gedicht.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Rajkowski, Gündoğan en Brekelmans over het bericht 'België verbiedt aankoop van Chinese röntgencamera’s voor de douane, Nederland (nog) niet'

MPs Rajkowski, Gündoğan and Brekelmans asked whether Dutch customs should stop using Chinese Nuctech scanners after Belgium's Council of State upheld exclusion of Nuctech from a tender, and whether this and EU and intelligence warnings should prompt a rethink. The state secretary answered that about 70 of roughly 100 customs scanners are Nuctech, that national security is not currently endangered under a TNO study, that procurement law limits exclusion of EU suppliers, and that stricter security requirements, a supplier-diversification effort and further research are underway.

The first part of the study indicated that national security is currently not endangered if the confidentiality, integrity or availability of the customs scan and detection processes is not compromised.

In het eerste deel van het onderzoek is aangegeven dat de nationale veiligheid op dit moment niet in gevaar komt als de vertrouwelijkheid, integriteit of beschikbaarheid van scan- en detectieprocessen van de Douane worden aangetast.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Rajkowski over het bericht 'Russische hackers trainen voor aanvallen op kritieke infrastructuur'

An MP asked the Justice and Security Minister about reports that Russian hackers train for attacks on critical infrastructure, the Scan-V and Crystal-2V tools, the reinforced vital infrastructure approach, supply-chain attacks, and cyber exercises. The minister acknowledged the threat, pointed to the forthcoming Aanpak vitaal and NIS2 implementation, and described existing exercises (ISIDOOR, national crisis plan) with a commitment to inform parliament before summer.
The cabinet is currently working on a reinforced approach to protecting vital infrastructure (Aanpak vitaal), and parliament will be informed in more detail before the summer.
Momenteel werkt het kabinet aan een versterkte aanpak voor de bescherming van de vitale infrastructuur (Aanpak vitaal). Hier wordt uw Kamer voor de zomer nader over geïnformeerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Minhas en Rajkowski over een mogelijk datalek van klantgegevens van NS-reizigers

Two MPs asked the state secretaries whether NS was aware of a reported data leak of NS customer data via a market research subcontractor and its software supplier, and how it was handled, including legal basis, DPIA, subprocessor oversight and rules for protecting client data. The state secretary answered that NS had a processor agreement and DPIA, that the leak source and whether NS data was included remained unclear, and that existing GDPR rules and Autoriteit Persoonsgegevens budget were adequate.
However, it is not yet certain which data exactly was leaked and whether NS data was also part of the data breach.
Het is echter nog niet zeker welke data precies zijn gelekt en of ook NS-data onderdeel waren van het datalek.
Antwoord op vragen vragen van de leden Brekelmans, Koerhuis, Rajkowski en Valstar over het bericht ‘‘Verdachte’ Chinese kranen staan ook in Nederlandse havens: zorgen om spionage’

The VVD MPs asked the ministers whether Chinese ZPMC cranes in Dutch ports could enable Chinese digital access, espionage, or disruption of military transports, and about Logink data links and subsidies. The government answered that the risks are being investigated in an interdepartmental review due in autumn 2023, that port facilities are responsible for securing their systems, that no Logink cooperation exists in Rotterdam, and that EU rules and NIS2/CER directives may address the risks.

Whether it is possible for the ZPMC facilities in China to gain digital access to the cranes, or whether they are connected in any way or have access to information in the port of Rotterdam, is being investigated in consultation with the Port of Rotterdam Authority.

Of het mogelijk is om vanuit de ZPMC-faciliteiten in China digitale toegang te krijgen tot de kranen, of dat deze op enigerlei wijze verbonden zijn of toegang hebben tot informatie in de Rotterdamse haven, wordt onderzocht in afstemming met het Havenbedrijf Rotterdam.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hermans, Rajkowski en Rahimi over de berichten 'Naaktbeelden borstkankerpatiënten VS gepubliceerd om ziekenhuis af te persen' en 'Paspoorten van dokters op straat na hack bij oudereninstel

MPs Hermans, Rajkowski and Rahimi (VVD) asked about reports of ransomware attacks on Dutch healthcare institutions, leaked patient and staff data, and how the sector and Z-CERT protect against cyber threats. The minister answered that five ransomware incidents were registered in 2022, outlined existing security norms, Z-CERT support, awareness measures and the National Cybersecurity Strategy, and promised to answer the earlier related questions before the 30 March debate.
I am not aware of how many of these incidents involved patient or staff data being stolen.
Het is mij niet bekend bij hoeveel van deze incidenten er gegevens van patiënten of (zorg-)medewerkers zijn ontvreemd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Wijgaarden en Rajkowski over het artikel ‘Draagvlak voor hulp Oekraïense vluchtelingen in Slowakije staat onder druk’

Two VVD MPs asked the foreign minister about a press report that public support for aid to Ukrainian refugees in Slovakia is under pressure, and about Russian disinformation, upcoming Slovak elections, a possible Fico win, EU responses and the revised EU disinformation code. The minister answered that Russian disinformation is concerning, outlined EU tools (FIMI toolbox, DSA co-regulation) and the revised code signed by 34 organisations, but said the government does not track national support figures and could not give a clear list of at-risk member states.
The Netherlands does not keep an overall overview of public support in EU member states for financial aid to Ukraine.
Nederland houdt geen totaaloverzicht bij van steun onder de bevolking in EU lidstaten voor financiële steun aan Oekraïne.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paul, Van der Woude, El Yassini en Rajkowski over kunstmatige intelligentie in het onderwijs

MPs from the VVD asked the education and economic affairs ministers about the risks and opportunities of AI such as ChatGPT in schools, teacher preparedness, research, and cooperation with the Dutch AI Coalition. The ministers answered that they support schools through Kennisnet, SURF, the national education lab NOLAI and funding, but offered no measures to check or constrain executive power.
It is important that school boards and teachers are sufficiently aware of the risks of AI for education, in addition to its opportunities.
Het is belangrijk dat schoolbesturen en leraren naast de kansen ook voldoende op de hoogte zijn van de risico's van AI voor het onderwijs.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Tielen en Rajkowski over het bericht 'Pro-Russische DDoS-aanvallers vallen Nederlandse ziekenhuizen aan'

MPs Tielen and Rajkowski asked the Health and Justice ministers about reported pro-Russian DDoS attacks on Dutch hospitals, their impact on patients and care continuity, the sector's vital-infrastructure status, scrubbing centres, extending Z-CERT to the whole care sector, and sanctions against the perpetrators. The ministers answered that care continuity was not endangered (only hospital websites were briefly unavailable), that the sector's vital designation and a Z-CERT rollout plan will be reported before summer, that scrubbing is up to each organisation, and that sanctions depend on impact and EU unanimity.
The Minister of Health will inform you by letter before summer about the status of designating the healthcare sector as vital.
De Minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport zal u uiterlijk voor de zomer per Kamerbrief informeren over de stand van zaken van het aanwijzen van de zorgsector als vitale sector.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Rajkowski en Van den Hil over het bericht ‘Ik heb je data nodig, want ik wil weten hoe duur je bent’

MPs Rajkowski and Van den Hil asked, after press reports, about the legal basis for the Nederlandse Zorgautoriteit's mandatory one-off collection of patient-level mental health data, who can see the data, why it is needed, and whether patients can access logs. The minister answered that the NZa's powers rest on the Wmg and AVG, the Autoriteit Persoonsgegevens found the collection lawful with conditions, data are stored securely with logging and a non-linkage guarantee, but patients cannot ask the NZa who viewed their data and must ask their provider instead.
It is not always known to clients and patients which data are shared with whom.
Het is niet altijd bekend bij cliënten en patiënten welke gegevens met wie worden gedeeld.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Rajkowski en Verkuijlen over het bericht ‘jongeren vaker betrokken bij fraude en cybercrime, politie maakt zicht zorgen’

MPs Rajkowski and Verkuijlen asked the Justice Minister about the rise in youth involvement in fraud and cybercrime, parental liability, school prevention programmes and the uptake of HackShield and Hack_Right. The minister replied that no clear rise in 2022 is evident yet, outlined prevention initiatives involving schools, parents and municipalities, and committed to further study and a prosecution overview.
I consider it important to gain more insight into the role of young people in crime.
Ik vind het belangrijk om meer inzicht te vergaren in de rol van jongeren in criminaliteit.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Rajkowski en Minhas over het bericht ‘ProRail dumpt Chinese bewakingscamera’s, de NS laat ze hangen’ van Follow The Money

MPs Rajkowski and Minhas asked whether Chinese-made cameras in rail rolling stock, where the rail infrastructure is a designated vital process, are compatible with national security given China's offensive cyber strategy, and whether NS's mitigation measures and NCSC advice are adequate. The government replied that Chinese equipment in vital sectors is not per se undesirable, that vital providers like NS are responsible for risk assessment and mitigation under supervision by the Inspectie Leefomgeving en Transport, that NS has taken measures such as network separation and no direct internet connection, and that the NCSC does not advise on individual products.
That a particular product or service, in this case cameras, within a vital sector originates from a Chinese provider is not necessarily undesirable.
Dat een bepaald product of dienst, in dit geval camera's, binnen een vitale sector afkomstig is van een Chinese aanbieder is niet per definitie onwenselijk.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Brekelmans, Van Strien en Rajkowski over het bericht ‘Chipmaker Nexperia koopt Delftse start-up’

MPs asked the government about the acquisition of Delft start-up Nowi by Nexperia, a Chinese-owned chipmaker, and how the pending Wet Vifo investment screening law applies, including comparisons with UK and German blocking decisions. The minister said the Wet Vifo is not yet in force so no assessment of the Nowi takeover has been made, that it will examine the deal once the law takes effect given its retroactive reach, and that the government is not commenting on UK or German decisions.
Because there is no legal basis yet, I have not been able to carry out any investigations under this law, and therefore no assessment of the Nowi takeover has taken place.
Vanwege het ontbreken van een wettelijke basis, heb ik op dit moment nog geen onderzoeken kunnen doen op grond van deze wet en heeft er dus geen beoordeling plaatsgevonden van de overname van Nowi.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Rajkowski over het bericht ‘Gestreste ondernemer is makkelijke prooi: trap niet in fraudeval’

An MP asked the Justice and Economic Affairs ministers about phishing and ransomware targeting entrepreneurs, including awareness campaigns, reporting rates, support for victims, telecom measures, and a Belgian-style anti-phishing shield. The ministers answered that existing campaigns, the Digital Trust Center, the Fraudehelpdesk and telecom talks are ongoing, and that a Belgian-style shield is being explored, without new binding commitments.

Yes. As reported in the annex to the letter on the integrated approach to cybercrime of 4 November, the Ministry of Justice and Security, together with the NCSC, is exploring whether an anti-phishing shield modelled on the Belgian example can also be set up in the Netherlands.

Ja. Zoals gemeld in de bijlage bij de Kamerbrief over de integrale aanpak van cybercrime van 4 november jl. verkent het Ministerie van Justitie en Veiligheid, tezamen met het NCSC of een «anti-phishing-schild» naar Belgisch voorbeeld ook in Nederland kan worden opgezet.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Strien, Rajkowski en Brekelmans over de Chinese investeringen in Nederlandse bedrijven

VVD MPs asked the ministers about Chinese investments in Dutch firms, the risk of espionage, screening tools such as the Vifo Act, and the EU foreign subsidies regulation. The government answered that existing tools are being strengthened, that it keeps no active overview of ownership structures, and that the Rotterdam port issue is under study, with a country-neutral approach preferred.
The cabinet does not keep an active overview of companies' ownership structures.
Het kabinet houdt geen actief overzicht bij van eigendomsstructuren van bedrijven
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Rajkowski over het bericht ‘De meest gehate sites ter wereld, in de lucht via Flevoland’

An MP asked ministers whether illegal and far-right websites could be hosted via Dutch datacentres and what powers the government has to intervene. The ministers answered that hosts must act once informed of illegal content, that the government relies largely on self-regulation and forthcoming instruments (ATKM, DSA), and that they consider it undesirable for Dutch firms to serve botnet-linked parties.
The Dutch datacentre Serverius did not have to take any action itself for this.
Het Nederlandse datacenter Serverius heeft hiervoor zelf geen actie hoeven te ondernemen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Grevink en Rajkowski over het bericht 'Internet kan tientallen euro’s goedkoper in Nederland'

Two VVD MPs asked the Minister of Economic Affairs whether internet access prices in the Netherlands are too high, whether market entry is hindered, and what will be done to open the market. The minister confirmed Dutch prices are relatively high, noted the ACM has binding commitments from KPN and Glaspoort and is preparing a new market analysis that will be delayed beyond this year, and pointed to the existing legislative framework as the responsibility of the independent regulator.
The ACM is currently working on a new market analysis.
De ACM werkt momenteel aan een nieuwe marktanalyse.

Antwoord op van de leden Dekker-Abdulaziz, Bouchallikh, Kathmann, Azarkan, Ceder, Van Weerdenburg, Koekkoek, Bontenbal, Leijten, Rajkowski en Eerdmans over het bericht ‘Chinese TikTok-medewerkers krijgen toegang tot data

MPs from eleven parties asked the government about a report that Chinese TikTok staff can access data of European users, including children's data, and what steps it would take. The State Secretary answered that TikTok could not say which staff access which data, that the Irish DPC and the Dutch AP are investigating transfers to third countries, and that the government will raise the issue with TikTok but leaves enforcement to the independent regulator.
At this moment we do not know which TikTok employees have access to which data.
Op dit moment weten we niet welke medewerkers van TikTok toegang hebben tot welke gegevens.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paul en Rajkowski over Privacy van leerlingen

MPs Paul and Rajkowski asked the minister about claims that children's online activity, including at school, is recorded and commercially exploited, and about media literacy and EU child-advertising rules. The minister replied that schools must not use pupil data commercially under the GDPR and a privacy convenant, that digital literacy core goals are being developed, and that EU rules ban targeted advertising to minors.
School boards, as data controllers, are themselves responsible for compliance and must make agreements with suppliers of those products that process pupils' data.

Schoolbesturen zijn als «verwerkingsverantwoordelijke» zelf verantwoordelijk voor de naleving daarvan en moeten afspraken maken met leveranciers van die producten waarin gegevens van leerlingen worden verwerkt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Rajkowski over het bericht 'Overheid schendt eigen regels door cookies van derden toe te laten op websites'

An MP asked the State Secretary for the Interior whether third-party cookies on government and government-linked websites comply with the rules and whether they should be banned. The government answered that the Telecommunications Act and GDPR apply equally to government sites, that it will write to other governments and ministries about compliance, draft a guidance document with them, and discuss whether government tracking cookies are desirable.

Because I consider it important that government websites comply with applicable laws and regulations, I will write to subnational governments and central government organisations pointing out the importance of compliance and asking them to check their websites.

Omdat ik het belangrijk vind dat de overheidswebsites voldoen aan geldende wet- en regelgeving, zal ik medeoverheden en rijksoverheidsorganisaties per brief wijzen op het belang hieraan te voldoen, en te verzoeken dit voor hun websites na te gaan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Rajkowski en Minhas over het bericht ‘ProRail dumpt Chinese bewakingscamera’s, de NS laat ze hangen’

MPs Rajkowski and Minhas asked the ministers about reports that NS was buying Chinese-made surveillance cameras for trains and stations and whether the government would restrict such procurement. The government answered that NS uses isolated networks and follows government advice, that concrete procurement criteria are not set in the concession, and that a government guideline and scan of vital infrastructure are being prepared.
As requested in the adopted motion 4 Rajkowski et al., the House will be informed before the Christmas recess about the requested guideline for the central government and its suppliers.
Zoals verzocht in de overgenomen motie 4 Rajkowski c.s. zal de Kamer nog voor het kerstreces geïnformeerd worden over de verzochte richtlijn voor de rijksoverheid en haar leveranciers
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Rajkowski en Michon-Derkzen over de brief ‘Aankondiging van maatregelen ter voorkoming identiteitsfraude’

MPs Rajkowski and Michon-Derkzen asked how many officials issued fraudulent identity documents, whether criminal proceedings exist, which municipalities are involved, and what follow-up is planned for affected citizens and personnel integrity. The government says dozens of cases are known, ongoing criminal investigations cannot be detailed, the RvIG will examine procedural deviations with results expected by year end, and it will promote integrity checks and a possible certification register while noting municipalities hold personnel powers.
I cannot provide further information about these investigations.
Over deze onderzoeken kan ik geen nadere informatie verstrekken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Rajkowski over het bericht ‘NIST kiest wapens tegen kwantumcomputer als cryptokraker’

An MP asked the ministers whether quantum computers threaten secure communication and state and business secrets, what concrete preparations the government is making, and how it is investing in quantum technology. The state secretary agreed the risk is real, described migration to quantum-safe systems, national investments and European participation, and stated the government will publish guidance and coordinate a migration plan.
For the central government and sub-national governments, but also for the private sector, this means they will have to migrate to quantum-safe systems and technologies.
Voor de rijksoverheid en medeoverheden, maar ook voor de private sector, betekent dit dat zij zullen moeten migreren naar kwantumveilige systemen en technologieën.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Tielen en Rajkowski over het bericht over ‘Commercieel softwarebedrijf schendt jarenlang de privacy van tienduizenden patiënten"

MPs Tielen and Rajkowski asked the Health Minister and State Secretary about a Follow the Money report that a commercial software company had for years breached the privacy of tens of thousands of patients and GP medical confidentiality. The minister answered that the case is known to the ministry, that the Data Protection Authority is examining it, that data-protection rules already apply, and that efforts to improve compliance and the Wegiz bill will address such problems, without committing to new specific measures.
The AP in principle makes no statements about individual reports and cases in the context of possible investigation.
Over individuele meldingen en zaken doet de AP in het kader van eventueel onderzoek in principe geen uitspraken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Rajkowski over het bericht 'Directie IT-bedrijf Centric stapt op na conflict met eigenaar Sanderink'

An MP asked the State Secretary for the Interior whether the resignation of Centric's executive board after a conflict with its owner could disrupt IT services to central and local government. The State Secretary replied that central government's contracts with Centric are limited, that Centric assured contractual obligations would be met, and that the VNG and user association report no current risk to services.
Where we have contractual agreements with Centric, we assume they will abide by them.
Daar waar we contractuele afspraken met Centric hebben, gaan wij ervan uit dat zij zich daaraan houden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Rajkowski en Erkens over het artikel 'Hacker ontdekt dat Chinese zonnepanelen een bedreiging zijn voor ons stroomnet'

Two VVD MPs asked the ministers about a report that Chinese solar inverters could threaten the electricity grid, and about dependence on foreign technology in vital infrastructure. The government answered that it shares concerns about state-actor cyber threats, points to existing and planned EU and national rules (NIS, RED, Cyber Resilience Act, Netcode on Cybersecurity, Vifo screening), and promises a scan of foreign-origin equipment in vital infrastructure in response to a motion, with timing still under exploration.
At present the Ministry of Justice and Security, together with the departments concerned, is exploring how to follow up on the motion.
Op dit moment wordt door het Ministerie van Justitie en Veiligheid, in samenwerking met de betrokken departementen, verkend op welke manier opvolging kan worden gegeven aan de motie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Becker en Rajkowski over het bericht 'Erdogans Trolle Schwören sich auf Wahlkampf ein'

MPs Becker and Rajkowski asked the government about reports that Turkish influencers and trolls target Turkish-Dutch and German voters ahead of Turkey's 2023 elections, and whether this interference happens in the Netherlands, along with related questions on counter-strategies, UETD training of candidates, campaign rules and social media regulation. The government condemned unwanted foreign interference, said it has no signals that Turkey is interfering in the 2023 elections, pointed to its existing counter-interference approach, support for municipalities and the Digital Services Act, and did not provide figures on UETD-trained candidates.
These figures are not known to the central government.
Deze cijfers zijn niet bekend bij de rijksoverheid.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Becker en Rajkowski over de uitvoering van de gewijzigde motie Becker c.s. over het structureel tegengaan van extremistische uitingen online

MPs Becker and Rajkowski asked how the government will implement the amended Becker motion on structurally countering extremist online expression, including the role of the new terrorist content authority, cooperation with platforms, financing, and Taskforce casework. Minister Van Gennip answered that extremist but non-terrorist online content falls outside the new authority's mandate on proportionality grounds, that the DSA will be used to tighten notice-and-action procedures, and that the Justice Minister will map preventive and repressive instruments, while many questions were answered only by reference to earlier answers or not answered in time.

To consider what options exist to act against this kind of harmful content, the Minister of Justice and Security will map which preventive and repressive instruments other countries have and what these offer the Netherlands.

Om te bezien wat de mogelijkheden zijn om juist tegen dit soort schadelijke content op te treden zal de Minister van Justitie en Veiligheid in kaart brengen over wat voor preventief en repressief instrumentarium landen om ons heen beschikken en welke mogelijkheden dit biedt voor Nederland.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Rajkowski, Brekelmans en Michon-Derkzen over het bericht 'Omstreden Chinese camera’s hangen overal in Nederland, ook bij ministeries'

MPs from the VVD asked whether Chinese Hikvision and Dahua cameras are used at government buildings, including police and ministries, and what security checks apply when procuring them. The government answered that it does not know how many Chinese cameras are in use, that procurement follows general information-security rules with each organisation assessing national-security risks itself, and that a cross-government study into such risks will be carried out.
It is not known how many cameras this specifically concerns.
Het is niet bekend om hoeveel camera's het specifiek gaat.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Tielen en Rajkowski over het bericht over een mogelijk Europees patiëntendossier

Two MPs from the VVD asked the health minister whether a reported European patient record proposal was behind the postponement of the Wegiz bill and whether it solves any urgent European problem. The minister confirmed the postponement was prompted by the Commission's proposal on a European health data space, stressed it does not create a European patient file, and deferred the appreciation and the stakeholder assessment to a forthcoming BNC fiche.
Under the information agreements, the cabinet will inform the House about its assessment of the proposals by means of a BNC fiche.
De Kamer zal volgens de informatieafspraken geïnformeerd worden door het kabinet over de appreciatie van de voorstellen middels een BNC fiche.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Rajkowski over het bericht ‘Datalek gemeente Buren’

An MP asked the Minister about reports that about 130 GB of data, including personal data, from municipalities Buren and Neder-Betuwe was offered on the darkweb after a ransomware attack on Buren, and about notification of affected people, risk of similar attacks, lessons learned and the cyberdefence protocol motion. The state secretary confirmed the breach, said a police report was filed, that affected residents are being informed and that research and an evaluation are pending, and that municipalities are bound by the BIO security baseline without a single national protocol, promising further measures after the findings.
The investigation is in full swing and the results will, the municipality of Buren informs me, be made available in a public report.
Het onderzoek is in volle gang en de resultaten zullen, zo meldt de gemeente Buren mij, in een publiek rapport beschikbaar worden gesteld.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Rajkowski over een cyberaanval in Oekraïne

An MP asked the Justice and Security Minister about reports of a Russian cyberattack on Ukrainian power plants, the Industroyer2 malware and Sandworm group, whether Dutch vital providers and small firms are protected, and the status of a motion on protecting entrepreneurs. The minister answered that attribution is complex, Industroyer2 has no known Dutch targets so far, the NCSC is in contact with vital providers, responsibility for protection lies primarily with firms, and the Chamber will be informed on the motion before summer.
Such intelligence investigations are generally not communicated publicly.
Over dergelijke inlichtingenonderzoeken wordt doorgaans niet publiekelijk gecommuniceerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Strien en Rajkowski over het bericht ‘Intel kiest voor Duitsland als vestigingsplaats voor Europese megafabriek’

Two VVD MPs asked the Minister of Economic Affairs and Climate about Intel choosing Germany for a European mega-fab and why the Netherlands got no role in its investment plan. The minister called it a positive signal for Europe, said the government does not discuss individual company talks but works closely with industry via NFIA, and listed Dutch chip-sector initiatives and opportunities.
The cabinet does not go into individual conversations with companies.
Het kabinet gaat niet in op individuele gesprekken met bedrijven.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Rudmer Heerema en Rajkowski over het bericht 'Verkoopverbod of niet: jongeren kopen massaal snus'

MPs Heerema and Rajkowski asked why snus and nicotine pouches above 0.035 mg remain widely available despite the Dutch sales ban, and what the NVWA is doing about online and social media sales. The State Secretary replied that the NVWA targets importers and websites, has seized stock and pressed importers to stop sales, uses notice-and-take-down on social media, and is intensifying enforcement while awaiting the Digital Services Act.
I am in discussion with the NVWA about how enforcement can be intensified.
Ik ben met de NVWA in gesprek over hoe de handhaving geïntensiveerd kan worden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Brekelmans en Rajkowski inzake berichten omtrent cyberaanvallen op Oekraïne en Nederlandse servers

Two VVD MPs asked whether Russia used Dutch servers to launch cyberattacks on Ukraine, whether hosting firms screen tenants, and what police can do. The Minister of Justice and Security answered that hosting firms have no legal duty to screen clients, police lack screening powers, and the government supports EU Digital Services Act rules for notice-and-takedown and reseller abuse, while ruling out stricter police checks on hosters.
Screening of clients by hosting providers is not a legal obligation.
Het screenen van klanten door hostingproviders is geen wettelijke verplichting.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ellian en Rajkowski inzake het bericht ‘Ddos'er die fiscus, banken en Tweakers aanviel, krijgt 200 uur taakstraf’

MPs Rajkowski and Ellian asked about a news report on a DDoS attacker sentenced to 200 hours of community service, including whether such attacks on vital services are treated as aggravating, conviction numbers, recidivism, the Hack_Right intervention and delays in criminal cases. The Minister answered that attacks on vital infrastructure can raise the maximum sentence, gave limited conviction figures, said recidivism data are unavailable, described Hack_Right and planned funding, and declined to analyse published judgments on reasonable-time violations as too time-consuming.
Examining published judgments on rechtspraak.nl is very time-consuming and current capacity does not allow such research to be carried out.
Het onderzoeken van gepubliceerde uitspraken op rechtspraak.nl is zeer tijdrovend en de huidige capaciteit laat het momenteel niet toe een dergelijk onderzoek uit te voeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Rajkowski over de beantwoording van de vragen 'Litouwen adviseert consument geen Xiaomi-telefoons meer te kopen'

MPs Rajkowski asked the ministers about Chinese censorship software on Xiaomi phones, state use of such devices, and whether oversight could detect it. The government answered that Lithuanian and German investigations found the functionality disabled in the EU, pledged to consider amending the Telecommunications Act, and declined an additional independent investigation.

As long as the e-privacy regulation is not yet in force, a complicating factor is that article 11.2a of the Telecommunications Act, which transposes article 5 of the e-privacy directive, is directed only at providers of public electronic communication networks and services and not at third parties such as the phone supplier.

Zolang de e-privacyverordening nog niet van kracht is, is een complicerende factor dat artikel 11.2a van de Telecommunicatiewet waarin artikel 5 van de e-privacyrichtlijn is omgezet, zich alleen richt tot aanbieders van openbare elektronische communicatienetwerken en diensten en dus niet tot derden zoals de leverancier van de telefoon.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Ginneken, Dekker-Abdulaziz en Rajkowski over de beantwoording van de schriftelijke vragen inzake de vacature 'Senior beleidsmedewerker interceptie en digitale opsporing' bij het Minist

Three MPs asked the Justice Minister about a senior policy vacancy on interception and digital investigation, and whether intelligence services could intercept encrypted OTT communications, and how quantum threats to encryption should be handled. The minister said intelligence services fall under other ministers, that an inventory of lawful access to encrypted evidence is underway with EU work pending, that OTT providers are currently not subject to decryption obligations, and that quantum effects on encryption fall outside the inventory's scope.
I cannot speak for the intelligence and security services (IenV services), as these services fall under the portfolios of the Ministers of the Interior and Kingdom Relations and of Defence.

Ik kan niet voor de inlichtingen- en veiligheidsdiensten (IenV-diensten) spreken, deze diensten vallen onder de portefeuille van de ministers van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties en Defensie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Rajkowski over het bericht 'Criminelen gebruiken foute hostingbedrijven voor activiteiten vanuit Nederland'

An MP asked the Minister of Justice and Security about police warnings regarding Dutch hosting companies that rent server space to criminals, including what actions were taken and whether hosts can be held liable. The minister replied that hosts currently enjoy conditional liability protection under EU and Dutch law, that the police share lists with the hosting industry body without tracking outcomes, and that the government supports tighter notice-and-takedown rules in the Digital Services Act.
Due to the lack of quantitative data and the low reporting willingness for cybercrime offences, a reliable estimate of the damage is not available.
Vanwege het ontbreken van kwantitatieve gegevens en de lage aangiftebereidheid van cybercrimedelicten is een betrouwbare inschatting van de schade niet beschikbaar.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Rajkowski over de vacature 'Senior beleidsmedewerker interceptie en digitale opsporing'

An MP asks the Justice Minister about a vacancy for a senior policy officer on interception and digital investigation, including research into lawful interception of encrypted OTT messaging services such as WhatsApp and Signal, and about the purpose, pros and cons of end-to-end encryption and how such communication could be made interceptable. The minister confirms the vacancy and the ongoing inventory, explains that encryption currently blocks lawful access, and says the work is open-ended, with a WODC study on encryption's impact and an EU-level process pending, while declining to give concrete options yet.
I cannot yet give an answer to this. Should the research produce results, I will inform the House of the outcomes and take them into account in the assessment and further deliberation.
Ik kan hierop nog geen antwoord geven. Ik zal uw Kamer indien het onderzoek resultaten heeft opgeleverd informeren over de uitkomsten en meenemen in de weging en verdere gedachtenvorming.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Rajkowski en Tielen over het bericht ‘Ziekenhuizen kwetsbaar voor cyberaanval: Wachten totdat het misgaat’

MPs Rajkowski and Tielen asked the health minister about reports that Dutch hospitals remain vulnerable to cyberattacks and that the sector lags behind, including what the IGJ found about information security. The minister answered that hospitals are responsible for their own information security, that data on attacks is not systematically recorded, that the IGJ found over half of inspected hospitals lacked independent NEN 7510 assessments which were then required, and that Z-CERT support and sector measures will be expanded, with a further letter promised.
It is not known exactly how many healthcare institutions were affected by cyberattacks in 2021, 2020 and 2019.
Het is niet bekend hoeveel zorginstellingen in 2021, 2020 en 2019 precies geraakt zijn door cyberaanvallen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Brekelmans, Rudmer Heerema en Rajkowski over de verplichte MY2022 app bij de Olympische Spelen

VVD MPs asked whether data from the mandatory MY2022 Olympic app could be used for surveillance, whether it is securely transmitted and shared with third parties, whether the government will press the IOC and Chinese authorities to make it compliant or optional, and what measures the Netherlands will take. The minister answered that the risks fit a broader picture of Chinese data collection, that the app's encryption lacks authenticity checks, that data is shared with Chinese companies, that Dutch athletes are not obliged to use the app but must use the HMS function (which can be used online), that concerns were raised with the Chinese ambassador, and that briefings for NOC*NSF will be repeated.
Our concerns about this app were therefore conveyed to the Chinese ambassador in The Hague prior to the Games.
Onze zorgen over deze app zijn dan ook voorafgaand aan de Spelen overgebracht aan de Chinese ambassadeur in Den Haag.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Inge van Dijk en Rajkowski over het bericht 'Europese Rekenkamer: uitrol 5G te traag en te versnipperd'

MPs Inge van Dijk (CDA) and Rajkowski (VVD) asked the Minister of Economic Affairs and Climate about the European Court of Auditors' report on slow, fragmented 5G rollout, including the digital divide, cybersecurity coordination, rollout pace, EU funding, data protection, compensation for replacement costs and local licence holders. The minister largely endorsed the report's conclusions but rejected a common EU quality standard, said the rollout is on track, and promised an advisory report by 1 May 2022 and to inform parliament, while deferring some EU matters to the Commission and noting national security competence.
As soon as I have received the advice, I will inform your House about the advice and the next steps and further planning.
Ik zal zodra ik het advies heb ontvangen, uw Kamer over het advies en over de vervolgstappen en nadere planning informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Rajkowski en Erkens over het bericht 'Facebook vs. Zeewolde: hoe lokale politici moeten beslissen over een landelijke kwestie'

MPs Rajkowski and Erkens asked about the planned large Meta data centre in Zeewolde, its impact on grid capacity, energy use, heat reuse, national coordination and the conditions attached to the sale of state land. The minister answered that national spatial policy prefers hyperscale centres at the country's edges, set conditions for the land sale, and committed to tighten national steering and admission criteria in a joint letter this spring.
In line with the coalition agreement, this cabinet will tighten national steering and the admission criteria for (hyperscale) data centres.
In lijn met het coalitieakkoord zal dit kabinet de landelijke regie en de toelatingscriteria ten aanzien van (hyperscale) datacenters aanscherpen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Rajkowski over het bericht 'Technologieleverancier van Defensie en politie gehackt, losgeld geëist voor vertrouwelijke informatie'

An MP asked the Minister of Justice and Security about a ransomware attack on supplier Abiom, which serves the police and Defence, and whether oversight and security requirements for ICT suppliers are adequate. The government acknowledged the incident, described existing security rules (BIO, ABDO, procurement tools) and planned improvements, but said the risk of harm to citizens is limited and declined to give details of the ongoing police investigation.
Because of the ongoing police investigation, the case cannot be discussed in more detail at this time.
In verband met het lopende politieonderzoek kan er op dit moment niet nader in worden gegaan op de casus.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Rajkowski over het bericht ‘Banken en overheden zetten software af uit angst voor hacks’

An MP asked the Justice, Economic Affairs and Interior ministers about reports that banks and governments were disabling software over fears of Log4j hacks, asking about damage, affected organisations, municipalities, vital sectors, international practice and crisis coordination. The government answered that no large-scale damage had been reported, that the NCSC and DTC warned organisations widely, that updating is primarily each organisation's own responsibility, and that it sees no need to replace the software and will respond to the OVV report within the legal deadline.
There is no central overview of which software products use Log4J within the government.
Er bestaat geen centraal overzicht van welke softwareproducten Log4J gebruiken binnen de overheid.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Rajkowski en Strolenberg over de Kamerbrief 'Reactie op de motie van het lid Yeşilgöz-Zegerius over een cyberverdedigingsprotocol voor gemeenten'

Two VVD MPs asked the state secretary why many municipalities lack cyber incident protocols and whether he will implement the Yesilgöz-Zegerius motion for a protocol. The state secretary answered that municipalities are responsible for their own information security under the BIO framework, that he will not impose a single protocol, and points to ENSIA, IBD support and a 'kaartje in de meterkast' tool instead.
I support this by strengthening the supervisory role (horizontal oversight) of the municipal council, including through the ENSIA approach to Single Information Audit.
Ik ondersteun dit door de controlerende taak (het horizontale toezicht) van de gemeenteraad te versterken met onder andere de aanpak Eenduidige Normatiek Single Information Audit (ENSIA)
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Michon-Derkzen, Brekelmans en Rajkowski over het bericht Hoe China met de Nederlandse politie meekijkt

MPs Michon-Derkzen, Brekelmans and Rajkowski asked whether the Dutch police use Chinese DJI drones, whether this was preceded by a security and privacy risk analysis, and whether the government will act given Chinese cyber and data-access risks. The Minister answers that the police use DJI drones only for routine tasks and not for confidential operations, that a security check and data protection impact assessment were done, that mitigating measures are in place, and that no further investigation is planned.
Given the steps the police have already taken, I see no reason to order an investigation.
Ik zie, gezien de stappen die de politie al heeft gezet, geen aanleiding om een onderzoek in te stellen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Rajkowski, Rudmer Heerema en Peter de Groot over het artikel ‘Onderzoek: riolen en bruggen kwetsbaar voor hackers’ in het Financieel Dagblad op 14 oktober 2021

Three VVD MPs asked the ministers about reports that sewer, bridge and lock control systems are vulnerable to hackers, including a case of a good-faith hacker taking over a city sewer system and delayed patching, and what the government has done on patching, procurement, threat sharing and Algemene Rekenkamer recommendations. The minister acknowledges the vulnerabilities, reports no successful attacks or Wbni notifications at Rijkswaterstaat or ProRail in the past two years, and describes existing programmes, regulation and ongoing cooperation, while stating no specific case could be confirmed.
Inquiries show no further information is available about a case of a good-faith hacker who was able to take over the sewer system of a large municipality.
Uit navraag blijkt geen nadere informatie beschikbaar over een casus van een goedwillende hacker die het rioleringssysteem van een grote gemeente kon overnemen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Woude en Rajkowski over het bericht 'Psychische problemen HAN-studenten ook op straat na grote hack'

Two VVD MPs asked the Minister of Education about a cyberattack on the HAN university, including whether sensitive medical data was stolen, whether the Dutch data protection authority was notified, and whether institutions should do more on cyber security. The minister answered all 12 questions, stating that the HAN was hacked via a web form (not ransomware), that about 3% of exposed data was more personal, that the AP was notified, and that the sector is strengthening its cyber preparedness.
A team of professionals has been on standby since the moment of notification to answer any questions.
Een team van professionals heeft vanaf het moment van informeren klaargestaan om eventuele vragen te beantwoorden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Rajkowski over het bericht “Litouwen adviseert consument geen Xiaomi-telefoons meer te kopen”

Dutch MPs asked the government whether it knew of Lithuanian advice against buying Xiaomi phones over possible censorship software, whether Dutch authorities use Xiaomi devices, and whether risk analyses and investigations are planned. The government answered that it sees no reason for a similar warning now, that civil servants' procurement follows a risk-based framework with agencies responsible for their own choices, and that existing regulators could act if censorship were found to be active.
All government organisations are themselves responsible for their operations and for the security of information and information systems.
Alle overheidsorganisaties zijn zelf verantwoordelijk voor hun bedrijfsvoering en de beveiliging van informatie en informatiesystemen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Rajkowski en Ellian over het bericht ‘Duizend inhuurkrachten WhatsApp lezen mee in chats’

Two MPs asked the government about reports that WhatsApp moderators can read the last five messages of a reported user, questioning whether this undermines end-to-end encryption and transparency under GDPR Article 12. The minister answered that the ProPublica article was corrected, that reporting only shares the messages the reporter chooses to send so encryption is not broken, and that no indications of an Article 12 breach were found.
When a WhatsApp user reports another WhatsApp user, the reporting user sends WhatsApp the most recent messages received from the other user.
Wanneer een WhatsApp-gebruiker een andere WhatsApp-gebruiker rapporteert, dan stuurt de rapporterende gebruiker aan WhatsApp

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Rajkowski over het bericht dat het Ministerie van Justitie en Veiligheid de mogelijkheden onderzoekt om verzekeraars te verbieden om losgeld te vergoeden bij slachtoffers van een ransomware

An MP asks the Minister of Justice and Security whether the ministry is studying a ban on insurers reimbursing ransom payments after ransomware attacks, and about the government's stance on paying ransom and prevention. The minister confirms that a ban on insurers covering ransoms is being investigated with no decision yet, maintains the advice not to pay, and says there is no plan to legally ban ransom payments, emphasizing prevention.
At this moment there is no intention to legally prohibit ransom payments.
Op dit moment is er geen voornemen om losgeldbetalingen wettelijk te verbieden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Wijngaarden en Rajkowski over het bericht 'Minister Bijleveld en Admiraals Kramer en Tas uiten zorgen tijdens commando-overdracht'

MPs Van Wijngaarden and Rajkowski asked the Defence Minister about warnings on Russian submarine activity threatening undersea data cables, cable capacity, monitoring and protection measures, and naval capabilities. The minister answered in detail on the threat and cable routes but declined operational specifics, said no incidents had been reported, and noted the matter is handled through NATO and EU cooperation.
For operational reasons we cannot give a further explanation of this.
Om operationele redenen kunnen we hierop geen nadere toelichting geven.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Grinwis en Rajkowski over het bericht 'Miljoenenstrop dreigt voor vier grote zenders bij verlenging FM-vergunning'

MPs Grinwis and Rajkowski asked the State Secretary for Economic Affairs and Climate why the proposed fee for the emergency three-year extension of four national commercial FM radio licences is many times the current price, and how this fits with motions on digitalisation and COVID relief. The State Secretary answered that SEO's market-conform valuation, based on opportunity costs and CPB growth projections, was adopted, that the fee is not meant to compensate losses, and that the extension serves sector stability while digitalisation continues.
I am willing to extend the commercial licences for the requested period of three years.
Ik ben bereid om de commerciële vergunningen te verlengen voor de gevraagde periode van drie jaar.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden El Yassini en Rajkowski over het bericht ‘Grote hack bij ROC Mondriaan: computers plat en bestanden ontoegankelijk’

MPs El Yassini and Rajkowski asked the Minister of Education about the ransomware hack at ROC Mondriaan, including ransom payments, data leaks, reporting to the data protection authority, and the institution's information-security maturity scores. The minister confirmed ransomware and said no ransom was paid, but declined to disclose individual institutions' benchmark scores as they are confidential, and deferred to the institution on notifications and damage assessment.
The benchmark IBP-E scores of individual institutions are not public, and I therefore cannot make statements about the scores of individual institutions.
De scores van de benchmark IBP-E van de individuele instellingen zijn niet openbaar en ik kan dan ook geen uitspraken doen over de scores van individuele instellingen.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Rajkowski over de uitfasering van ISDN30 en de mogelijke onveilige situaties, door minder betrouwbare bereikbaarheid van particuliere alarmcentrales (PACS’s) en zorgcentrales

An MP asked the state secretary for Economic Affairs about the phase-out of ISDN30 lines and the risk that alarm and care centres lose reliable connections, particularly given the differing deadlines of KPN (1 April 2022) and Tele2 (1 October 2021). The state secretary answered that the phase-out is a logical modernisation, that KPN extended its deadline, that Tele2 has put interim measures in place, and that ACM allows KPN to temporarily reactivate the TDM interconnection as a safety net.
Together with the ACM, I will continue to keep a close watch on this.
Samen met de ACM blijf ik hierbij de vinger aan de pols houden.
Antwoord op de vragen van de leden Rajkowski en Aukje de Vries over het incident Testcoronanu BV en de ernstige tekortkoming in de informatiebeveiliging

MPs Rajkowski and Aukje de Vries asked the ministers about the Testcoronanu BV data breach, affected travellers, the audit of the provider's security and the vetting of test providers before connection to CoronaCheck. Minister De Jonge answered that 17,638 people had appointments, that the provider is investigating whether others accessed the database, and that the ministry checks pentest reports before connection, but declined to share the providers' DPIAs and pentest reports.
However, I cannot commit to also sharing with your House the DPIAs and pentest reports submitted by the test provider.
Ik kan echter niet toezeggen dat ook de door de testaanbieder aangeleverde DPIA’s en pentestrapportages met uw Kamer worden gedeeld.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Kort en Rajkowski over de berichtgeving over onbruikbare overheidsapps voor mensen met een beperking

MPs De Kort and Rajkowski asked the State Secretary for the Interior about reports that government apps are unusable for people with disabilities, and what the EU accessibility rules require. The State Secretary answered that municipalities and other public bodies are responsible for accessibility, that 108 app accessibility statements had been published by 23 June 2021 with most apps not fully compliant, and that the ministry supports them through DigiToegankelijk and related teams.
Subnational governments and public organisations are themselves responsible for making their websites and apps more accessible.
Medeoverheden en overheidsorganisaties zijn zelf verantwoordelijk voor het toegankelijker maken van hun websites en apps.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Rajkowski en Michon-Derkzen over het bericht 'Zonnepaneel stoort communicatie van hulpdiensten'

Two VVD MPs asked the State Secretary for Economic Affairs and Climate, together with the Justice Minister, about reports that solar installations with non-compliant inverters interfere with the C2000 emergency communication network and aviation/maritime radio. The government acknowledged the problem, said it is being addressed urgently with the supplier and network manager, and explained that Agentschap Telecom supervises EMC compliance and has enforcement powers, including recalls and sanctions.
Agentschap Telecom assesses such situations and has the powers to intervene.
Agentschap Telecom beoordeelt dergelijke situaties en heeft de bevoegdheden om op te treden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Rajkowski over het bericht 'ISIDOOR 2021: NCTV en NCSC organiseren grootste cybercrisisoefening ooit'

An MP asked the Minister of Justice and Security about the ISIDOOR 2021 national cyber crisis exercise, including its success, participant selection, participant evaluations, and whether it fits the structural exercise programme under the Weverling motion. The minister judged the exercise successful, described how participants were selected, said a COT evaluation would be shared after the summer, and committed to advising the next cabinet on exercise frequency.
The Institute for Safety and Crisis Management (COT) is writing an overarching evaluation report focused on the exercise goals of ISIDOOR 2021.
Door het Instituut voor Veiligheids- en Crisismanagement (COT) wordt een overkoepelend evaluatierapport geschreven, dat zich richt op de oefendoelen van ISIDOOR 2021.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Yeşilgöz-Zegerius en Rajkowski over het bericht ‘Nederland verliest controle op beveiliging van het internet’

MPs Yeşilgöz-Zegerius and Rajkowski asked about the Cyber Security Council's warning that the Netherlands is losing control over internet security and growing dependence on foreign technology, including whether vital processes depend on foreign providers and how much EU recovery funds will support digital investment. The minister answered that digital autonomy is a means rather than a goal, that a full inventory of foreign-provider dependence is not realistic so a risk-based approach is used, and that the telecom sector has a structural approach with other vital sectors to be assessed later.
It is not systematically tracked to what extent service provision within vital processes takes place by, or depends on, foreign providers.

De voordracht voor een krachtens de eerste zin vast te stellen algemene maatregel van bestuur wordt niet eerder gedaan dan vier weken nadat het ontwerp aan beide kamers der Staten-Generaal is overgelegd.

Door het toevoegen van een zware voorhangprocedure aan een algemene maatregel van bestuur die het voorgestelde artikel 38, achtste lid, en het voorgestelde artikel 40a, uitwerkt, wordt deze legitimiteit nog eens extra geregeld en benadrukt.

verzoekt de regering om net als in verschillende Nederlandse gemeenten bij boa's gebeurt, religieuze uitingen zoals een keppeltje of een hoofddoek mogelijk te maken voor politieagenten
