qa: Antwoord op vragen van het lid El Abassi over racisme en geweld na duel tussen Spakenburg en Kozakken Boys El Azzouti en familie belaagd door fans

An MP asked the Justice Minister about racist abuse and violence against a footballer's family after a match, whether police acted, the number of discrimination reports in sport, and whether minimum sanctions, stadium bans, cameras, an independent reporting point and structural funding should be pursued with the KNVB. The minister condemned the incidents, declined to comment on the police investigation, pointed to existing programmes (OVIVI, ADV reporting, the planned ISN integrity centre) and said reporting is already available but gave no new sanctions framework or structural funding commitment.
As usual, I make no statements on the content or progress of individual criminal investigations.
Zoals gebruikelijk doe ik geen uitspraken over de inhoud of voortgang van individuele opsporingsonderzoeken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid El Abassi over de onterechte aanhouding en de gevolgen voor een Marokkaans-Nederlands gezin in Urk

An MP asked the Minister of Justice and Security about the wrongful arrest of a 14-year-old on Urk, the handling of the case by police and the public prosecution service (OM), the lack of protection and redress for the family, and whether independent investigation and national guidelines are needed. The minister declined to comment on the individual case, stated that arrests require concrete suspicion, said no investigation or guidelines are planned, and pointed to compensation, complaint and ombudsman routes.
It does not befit me as Minister of Justice and Security to intervene in the decision-making of the Public Prosecution Service in individual cases.
Het past mij als Minister van Justitie en Veiligheid niet om te treden in de besluitvorming van het Openbaar Ministerie in individuele zaken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid El Abassi over de berichtgeving omtrent uitlatingen van de heer Wilders die door de politie zijn weersproken

An MP asked the Justice Minister about police publicly disputing Wilders' claim of a mistreated garbage collector in Utrecht, asking whether this was misleading the Chamber, whether politicians should be held to accuracy, and whether police guidelines are needed. The minister answered that MPs choose their own words and are responsible for them, that no police information was involved, and declined to comment on the individual case.
MPs are free to choose their own words.
Het staat Kamerleden vrij om hun eigen woorden te kiezen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid El Abassi over haatbrieven aan moskeeën

The MP El Abassi asked the Minister of Justice and Security about threatening letters, some smeared with blood and containing hateful or blasphemous content, sent to mosques in several Dutch cities, and about security measures, a possible mosque security fund, and anti-Muslim incident trends. The minister condemned the letters, declined to detail police and judicial measures or ongoing investigations, said no mosque security fund is planned and that local authorities decide on protection, and pointed to existing prevention initiatives and a forthcoming policy response on Muslim discrimination.
I do not go into the specific measures taken by police and justice, as this often concerns confidential information
Ik treed niet in de specifieke maatregelen die door politie en justitie worden genomen, aangezien dit vaak vertrouwelijke informatie betreft
Antwoord op vragen van het lid El Abassi over het bericht ‘OP wil alsnog volledige sanering vervuilde grond Havenhoofd en Veerdam, maar dat lijkt een utopie’

An MP asks the state secretary about contaminated soil under houses at Havenhoofd and Veerdam in Papendrecht, including late disclosure to residents, gas meters, and the call for a fact-finding inquiry. The state secretary answers that the soil was remediated with a clean layer, that monitoring showed a stable end state, that the provincial competent authority is responsible, and that further questions should go to the provincial and municipal authorities.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid El Abassi over de programmamanager bij de politie en de betrokkenheid bij NTA-onderzoek

An MP asked the Minister of Justice and Security about the police anti-racism programme manager who also directs NTA, the agency found by courts and the Amsterdam Ombudsman to have unlawfully surveilled mosques, and whether the dual role is compatible with the programme's credibility. The minister confirmed awareness of the dual role but declined to intervene, stating that the police decides on its own staffing.
The police itself decides on the appointment of its personnel. Therefore I will not intervene in employment arrangements with individuals.
De politie gaat zelf over de aanstelling van haar personeel. Derhalve zal ik niet interveniëren in arbeidsafspraken met individuen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid El Abassi over het bericht 'Verdachte die biddende moslim doodstak in Zuid-Frankrijk, meldt zich op Italiaans politiebureau'

MP El Abassi (DENK) asked the Justice Minister about the fatal stabbing of a Muslim worshipper in a French mosque, the alleged Islamophobic climate fostered by politicians, and whether Dutch authorities take Muslim concerns about safety and discrimination seriously. The government denies that Dutch ministers foster an Islamophobic climate, acknowledges Muslim discrimination, describes ongoing dialogue and existing guidance, but declines to commit to structural mosque security measures or a dedicated anti-Muslim-hatred campaign.
The cabinet does not register the number of signals received.
Het kabinet registreert niet het aantal binnengekomen signalen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid El Abassi over vernielingen bij de As-Soennah moskee in Assen

An MP from DENK asked the Minister of Justice and Security about two window-smashing incidents at the As-Soennah mosque in Assen, whether they were treated as possibly anti-Islam, why a first complaint was closed quickly, and what protection is planned. The Minister expressed concern and said police and prosecutors pursue discrimination offences actively, but declined to comment on the individual case and left mosque security largely to local authorities.
It is not for me to make statements in individual cases.
Het is niet aan mij om uitspraken te doen in individuele zaken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid El Abassi over het bericht dat Douwe Bob een kortgeding aanspant tegen VVD-leider Dilan Yeşilgöz om Jodenhaat-tweet

An MP asked the Justice Minister about a lawsuit by singer Douwe Bob against VVD leader Dilan Yesilgoz over an antisemitism accusation, asking whether it constitutes defamation and whether the OM should be urged to act. The minister declined to comment on the individual case, said prosecution is for the OM and courts, noted defamation is a complaint offence, and described existing legal safeguards and reporting channels.
As Minister, I do not comment on individual cases.
Als Minister spreek ik mij niet uit over individuele casussen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid El Abassi over de meer dan 2500 ontvangen meldingen van discriminatie na online bericht van Wilders

An MP asked the Justice Minister about over 2,500 discrimination reports after a Wilders post and whether the expression is racist, whether the OM is acting, and what risks and steps follow. The minister declined to qualify the post, said prosecution and free-speech assessment rest with the OM and courts, would not comment on the OM case, and only generally acknowledged the risks and referred to inclusion efforts.
It is up to the Public Prosecution Service (OM) to assess whether a punishable expression is involved and, if so, whether prosecution is instituted.
Het is aan het Openbaar Ministerie (OM) om te beoordelen of er sprake is van een strafbare uiting en, zo ja, of vervolging wordt ingesteld.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid El Abassi over het artikel 'Afname van het aantal zzp’ers in thuiszorg en kinderopvang door strenger optreden tegen schijnzelfstandigheid’

MPs El Abassi asked the Minister of VWS about reports of a sharp fall in self-employed workers in home care and childcare after stricter enforcement against bogus self-employment, and about shortage and quality risks. The minister replied that the enforcement moratorium was lifted without changing rules, that exact figures on exits versus transitions to employment are not yet available (expected this autumn), and that the sector is responsible for continuity while government supports the transition to employment contracts.
Currently no figures are available on the share of self-employed workers, within the percentages mentioned in the article, who left the sector or moved to an employment contract.
Momenteel zijn nog geen cijfers beschikbaar over het aandeel zzp’ers, binnen de in het artikel genoemde percentages, dat de sector heeft verlaten dan wel is overgestapt naar een dienstverband.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid El Abassi over discriminatie van jongeren en mensen met een beperking op de woningmarkt.

MP El Abassi asked the Minister of Housing about housing discrimination against young people and people with disabilities, including low reporting, weak enforcement, and the non-binding nature of College voor de Rechten van de Mens rulings. Minister Keijzer acknowledged the problem, said no data on discrimination reports is kept centrally, pointed to a declining discrimination trend in the third national monitor, and promised a fourth monitor and an inventory of municipal reports by 2026.
There is no insight into how many reports of housing discrimination have been received by municipalities.
Er is geen zicht op hoeveel meldingen van woondiscriminatie er binnen (zijn) gekomen bij gemeenten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid El Abassi over het bericht dat een 100-jarige vrouw een woning vindt na drie jaar op straat te hebben geleefd in Tilburg

MP El Abassi asked ministers about reports that a 100-year-old woman lived on the street in Tilburg for three years, and whether this exposed failures in the safety net for elderly people. The state secretary answered that the woman did not live on the street but stayed with family in Morocco after leaving in 2022, that no national figures on homeless elderly exist, and that municipalities are responsible, so no mandatory reporting structure is planned.
Based on this case, I see no reason to impose on municipalities, in this decentralised system, an obligation to set up an active signalling structure and a national reporting point.
Op basis van deze casus zie ik geen reden om in dit gedecentraliseerde stelsel gemeenten een verplichting op te leggen tot een actieve signaleringsstructuur en een landelijk meldpunt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid El Abassi over het feit dat de eerder vermeende dakloze 100-jarige vrouw in Tilburg helemaal niet op straat zwierf, maar verbleef bij familie in Marokko

Dutch MP El Abassi asked the State Secretary for Health and the Minister for Housing about reports that a 100-year-old woman in Tilburg was homeless for three years when she had in fact stayed with family in Morocco, asking about verification, the municipality's role, and whether guidelines or lessons would follow. The State Secretary confirmed the facts, said journalists are responsible for verification and the municipality could not give more detail for privacy reasons, and refused to draft new guidelines for municipalities while pointing to the existing National Action Plan on Homelessness.
It is the responsibility of journalists to verify reporting.
Het is de verantwoordelijkheid van journalisten om berichtgeving te verifiëren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid El Abassi over de flinke toename van energiearmoede door het wegvallen van overheidssteun

An MP from DENK asked the ministers whether the rise in energy poverty to 510,000 households in 2024 reflects the end of crisis support measures, and why those measures were withdrawn without structural alternatives. The government acknowledges the increase, argues that targeted structural measures (Social Climate Fund, insulation, a noodfonds subsidy) are preferable to the broad energy allowance, and declines to reinstate a price cap or allowance now.

The cabinet therefore chooses to focus on structural targeted measures, such as the Social Climate Fund approach described under question 2 and targeted insulation of homes in specific neighbourhoods.

Het kabinet kiest er daarom voor om in te zetten op structurele gerichte maatregelen, zoals de bij vraag 2 beschreven inzet vanuit het Social Climate Fund en gerichte verduurzaming van de woningen in specifieke wijken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Abassi over het bericht dat een topambtenaar kinderpornografisch materiaal verspreidde onder werktijd

The MP asks how a former senior civil servant at the Ministry of Infrastructure and Water Management could distribute child sexual abuse material during working hours undetected, and what oversight, screening and integrity measures apply. The minister answers that no warning signals existed, the employee was dismissed, some ICT and integrity measures are in place, but no systemic changes or independent inquiry are planned.
As soon as such signals did emerge, action was taken immediately.
Zodra deze signalen er wel kwamen is meteen opgetreden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid El Abassi over het politiegeweld tijdens de ontruiming van het universiteitsgebouw in Utrecht bij een pro-Palestina demonstratie

An MP asked whether police used violence during the eviction of a university building in Utrecht at a pro-Palestinian demonstration, whether excessive force was used, and how complaints can be made and investigated. The Minister declined to comment on the individual incident, citing ongoing investigation, but described the general rules on use of force, the review of force by the hulpofficier van justitie, complaint and criminal complaint procedures, and the right to demonstrate.
An investigation into the incident in Utrecht and the way the police acted is currently being carried out.
Op dit moment wordt onderzoek gedaan naar het voorval in Utrecht en de wijze waarop de politie heeft opgetreden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid El Abassi over de overdracht van persoonsgegevens van Europese burgers aan Israël

An MP asked the Justice Minister about the EU adequacy decision for Israel and the transfer of European citizens' personal data there, citing concerns over surveillance and human rights. The state secretary answered that the Commission's adequacy decision remains in force after a 2024 review, that the Commission can suspend or revoke it, and that controllers must inform data subjects and complaints go to the Dutch data protection authority.
Keeping track of whether, and if so which types of personal data Dutch companies or organisations pass on to Israeli parties is not a task of the cabinet, if that is even feasible.
Het bijhouden of, en zo ja welke, soorten persoonsgegevens Nederlandse bedrijven of organisaties doorgeven aan Israëlische partijen, is – zo dat al doenlijk is – geen taak van het kabinet.
Antwoord op vragen het lid El Abassi over gewelddadige intimidatie en binnendringen van een woning in Arnhem vanwege een opgehangen Palestijnse vlag

The MP asked the Minister of Justice and Security about a reported violent intrusion into a home over a displayed Palestinian flag, whether it is being investigated as ideologically motivated intimidation, what steps police took, and what measures exist to protect citizens. The Minister said no investigation had started because residents had not filed a complaint, that a complaint appointment is now planned, that no specific measures exist for ideologically motivated offences, and declined to give further detail on an ongoing criminal matter.
As is customary, I will not comment further on matters that are the subject of criminal investigation.
Zoals gebruikelijk laat ik mij verder niet uit over zaken die onderwerp van strafrechtelijke onderzoek zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid El Abassi over onaangekondigde huisbezoeken bij demonstranten door de politie

An MP asked the Justice Minister about unannounced police home visits to anti-genocide demonstrators, the Amnesty report on unlawful ID checks and surveillance, and whether guidelines, investigations and changes would follow. The minister said police home visits rest on Article 3 Politiewet with safeguards, that a new bill on information gathering is in preparation, and that some internal guidance and an inspection report exist, but gave no commitment to a new investigation or new binding rules.
It is not for me as Minister to comment on individual cases.
Het is niet aan mij als Minister om in te gaan op individuele zaken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kathmann en El Abassi over het niet naleven van de Wet politiegegevens

MPs Kathmann and El Abassi ask why the police have not complied with the Wet politiegegevens' deletion deadline for removed data, which the korpschef deliberately did not destroy from 2019 pending legal reform, and who oversees this. Minister Van Weel answers that the non-compliance is a deliberate, politically backed choice limited to article 14 data usable in cold cases, that the Raad van State has been asked for advice, and that a bill is planned for consultation in 2025.
There is no question of a tolerance decision. The korpschef decided, pending an amendment of the retention periods in the Wpg, not to proceed with destroying the relevant data.
Er is geen sprake van een gedoogbesluit. De korpschef heeft besloten in afwachting van een wijziging van de bewaartermijnen in de Wpg niet over te gaan tot vernietiging van de betreffende gegevens.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid El Abassi over de ongelijke behandeling van discriminatiemeldingen door de politie en het Openbaar Ministerie

An MP asks the Justice Minister why police referrals of antisemitism reports to the Public Prosecution Service are far higher than for other discrimination grounds, and demands equal treatment and fuller registration by ground. The minister rejects the premise as premature, citing non-comparable data, differing report/complaint definitions and a 2023 football-case surge, and declines a detailed breakdown, external investigation or policy review.
No, I am not willing to do this.
Nee, hiertoe ben ik niet bereid.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid El Abassi over het bericht ‘Minister begaat enorme flater: hij beweert dat moord op Utrechtse Sjaak in 1995 is opgelost, maar dat is niet zo’

MP El Abassi asked the Justice Minister to account for wrongly telling parliament that the 1995 murder of Sjaak Gerwig had been solved, and to apologise to the family. The minister admitted a slip of the tongue, said the case is unsolved, apologised to the relatives, and promised to be more accurate.
By mistake I said that both cases had been solved.
Per abuis heb ik genoemd dat beide zaken waren opgelost.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid El Abassi over het bericht ‘Bewoners in Amersfoort krijgen dreigbrieven na ophangen Palestijnse vlaggen: ‘Kom dan op de koffie’’

An MP asked the Justice Minister about anonymous threatening letters sent to residents in Amersfoort who hung Palestinian flags, and whether the government would act against such intimidation. The minister said the police and Public Prosecution Service can investigate suspected crimes, condemned the intimidation, urged residents to report the letters to the police, and praised their response of inviting the senders for coffee.
In case of a suspicion of a criminal offence, the law gives the police the possibility to launch an investigation.
In geval van een vermoeden van een strafbaar feit, biedt de wet aan de politie de mogelijkheid om een onderzoek in te stellen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid El Abassi over het bericht ‘Overheid gebruikte nationaliteit bij misdaadbestrijding en verzweeg dat’

An MP from DENK asked the Minister of Justice and Security about reports that the RIEC used nationality, including targeting Turkish Dutch people, in organised crime work, asking about oversight, data practices, profiling and whether similar analyses exist for other groups. The Minister acknowledged that the 2016 concept analysis used unacceptable, generalising wording that the organisations distance themselves from, described data-protection safeguards (access requests, objections, the upcoming Wgs), and said nationality is no longer processed and that a study into ethnic profiling is not considered opportune.
An individual citizen may at any time object in writing to the processing of their personal data in the RIEC partnership with the covenant partners.
Een individuele burger kan bij de convenantpartners te allen tijde schriftelijk bezwaar aantekenen tegen de verwerking van diens persoonsgegevens in het RIEC-samenwerkingsverband.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bushoff, Slagt-Tichelman, Westerveld, Paulusma, Krul, Dijk, Dobbe, Bikker, El Abassi, Kostić, Koekkoek en Eerdmans over de Nota van Wijziging op de Ontwerpbegroting van het Ministerie van

MPs from multiple parties asked the health ministry, in a set of written questions on the 2025 budget amendment, about cuts to the Stagefonds Zorg, borstprothesen subsidy, SOV care for the uninsured, Veelbelovende zorg, sports funding and the generic staff cut. The minister's answers defend the cuts as efficient or minimal in impact, give partial figures, and state that several effects are still being examined.
It is not known for how many unique patients the subsidy scheme for medically necessary care for the uninsured (SOV) is used.
Het is niet bekend voor hoeveel unieke patiënten gebruik wordt gemaakt van de subsidieregeling medisch noodzakelijke zorg aan onverzekerden (SOV).
Antwoord op vragen van de leden El Abassi en Lahlah over het bericht 'CJIB wil bevoegdheid om te kunnen stoppen met het verhogen van verkeersboetes'

MPs Lahlah and El Abassi asked the Justice Minister about reports that the CJIB wants powers to stop raising traffic fine surcharges where these cause unreasonable hardship, and about the proportionality and fairness of fines and collection costs compared with commercial agencies. The minister acknowledges the CJIB's signal, points to planned measures (a free reminder before collection costs, and power to waive surcharges in cases of force majeure) and ongoing studies, but does not commit to a legislative change before summer 2025 and gives no firm answer on the fine levels.
First, that the CJIB can first send a free payment reminder before collection costs are charged.
Ten eerste dat het CJIB eerst een gratis betalingsherinnering kan sturen voordat aanmaningskosten in rekening worden gebracht.
Antwoord op van het lid Abassi over het bericht ‘Omwonenden Stampersgat: “Parkeerruzie leidde tot doodschieten Hamza (25)”’

An MP asked the Minister of Justice and Security about a fatal shooting in Stampersgat reportedly linked to a parking dispute, the shooter's public racist statements, whether police check weapon holders involved in neighbour disputes, and how discrimination motives are assessed. The minister answered that police check weapon licence holders regularly, that the criminal investigation is ongoing so the case cannot be discussed, that discrimination aspects are investigated per OM policy, and that criticism of religion is lawful while group insults and incitement are not.
I cannot go into this ongoing criminal investigation.
Ik kan niet ingaan op dit lopende strafrechtelijke onderzoek.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid El Abassi over het bericht ‘Mythe van 'hogere pijngrens bij migranten' blijft een probleem in de zorg’

An MP asked the Minister of Medical Care about reports that patients with migrant backgrounds have their pain dismissed, about the stigmatising content of the huisarts-migrant.nl website funded partly by the ministry, and about discrimination monitoring in care. The minister acknowledged the problem, pointed to existing programmes, research and a forthcoming handreiking, and said the website's outdated pain-threshold article was removed and its editorial process tightened.
I deeply regret that patients experience it this way.
Ik betreur het ten zeerste dat patiënten dit zo ervaren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid El Abassi over het bericht ‘Abdessadak krijgt klappen van mannen die agenten blijken te zijn: ‘Ik viel flauw vanwege de hoofdpijn’

Ten MPs' written questions (El Abassi) asked the Justice Minister about police conduct toward a citizen who filmed plain-clothes officers and was struck, covering identification duties, phone data access, footage access and proportionality of force. The minister declined to comment on the individual case under investigation, stated the general legal framework, and pointed to complaint and investigation procedures.
As you know, I cannot go into this individual case, which is moreover still under investigation.
Zoals u weet kan ik niet ingaan op dit individuele geval, waarnaar bovendien op dit moment nog onderzoek loopt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden El Abassi en Ergin over het bericht ‘Van plofkip tot slacht: hoe heilig is het halalkeurmerk in de supermarkt eigenlijk’

MPs El Abassi and Ergin asked whether supermarkets selling halal-certified chicken that is actually cheaper plofkip (broiler) meat amount to consumer deception, and whether ACM, NVWA oversight of halal slaughter and the 2012 convenant are adequate. The minister replied that supermarkets' move to BLk1* chicken is a private initiative outside government judgment, that halal certification is a private matter with no government role, and that existing accreditation and inspection frameworks are sufficient, committing to no new action.
The halal certification mark is a private initiative.
Het halal keurmerk betreft een privaat initiatief.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen, Lahlah, El Abassi en Palmen over mankementen in het huidige boetesysteem in Nederland

MPs Van Nispen, Lahlah, El Abassi and Palmen asked the Justice Minister about problems in the Dutch traffic fine system, including imprisonment for unpaid fines (gijzeling), debt, child welfare effects, insurance fines, proportionality of escalating reminders, and the possibility of income-dependent fines. The Minister answered that gijzeling is subject to judicial review and that payment arrangements exist, but declined to adopt income-based fines, a 30% reduction, or a maximum of 150 euro, citing costs and burden on the criminal justice chain, while promising a WODC evaluation and a ministry study on escalation.
We cannot entirely rule out that children were placed out of home at the time because their parent was imprisoned for non-payment.
Wij kunnen niet geheel uitsluiten dat kinderen destijds uit huis zijn geplaatst doordat hun ouder werd gegijzeld.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden El Abassi en Ergin over het NOS-bericht “Problemen op werk door uitspraken over Gaza-Israël, soms zelfs ontslag"

MPs El Abassi and Ergin asked ministers about a NOS report on employees facing problems at work, even dismissal, over pro-Palestinian statements, asking whether civil servants can be ordered to remove online posts, whether dismissal for such posts is justified, what they will do about reported unsafe workplaces, whether a national reporting point will be set up, and whether a DJI employee was dismissed on the spot for sharing a video. The minister answered that civil servants have free speech subject to limits in the Ambtenarenwet, that dismissal is a matter for courts and the employer, that the government will strengthen workplace safety and consider mandatory codes and complaint procedures, but declined to create a national reporting point and declined to comment on individual cases.
This concerns a matter between an employer and an employee. As is customary, individual cases are not discussed.
Dit betreft een aangelegenheid tussen een werkgever en een medewerker. Zoals gebruikelijk wordt er niet ingegaan op individuele casuïstiek.

m: Amendement van de leden Stultiens en Abdi over middelen voor het Wetenschapsfonds
Amends the budget to restore 107 million euro cut by the caretaker cabinet from the Science Fund, arguing no budgetary reason exists for the cut.
The caretaker cabinet is taking 107 million euro out of the Science Fund in the current budget year (2025)
Het demissionaire kabinet haalt in het huidige begrotingsjaar (2025) € 107 miljoen weg uit het Wetenschapsfonds
Motie van de leden Segers en Hilkens over strafbaar stellen van prostitutie onder de 21 jaar
Asks the government, if the prostitution regulation bill passes, to propose criminalising all activity aimed at bringing young people under 21 into prostitution.
requests the government, if the bill regulating prostitution takes effect, to propose amending the criminal code to criminalise all activity aimed at bringing young people under 21 into prostitution

verzoekt de regering, indien het voorstel van wet houdende regels betreffende de regulering van prostitutie en betreffende het bestrijden van misstanden in de seksbranche (Wet regulering prostitutie en bestrijding misstanden seksbranche, 32 211 ) in werking treedt, te komen met een voorstel tot wijziging van de strafwet
Motie van de leden Van der Burg en Hilkens over het verplicht stellen van het ouderprotocol Haaglanden
Asks the government to make the Haaglanden parent protocol for child abuse signalling mandatory for all emergency departments, ambulance services and GP out-of-hours posts.
requests the government to make the Haaglanden parent protocol mandatory for all emergency departments in hospitals, ambulance services and GP posts in the Netherlands
verzoekt de regering, het ouderprotocol Haaglanden verplicht te stellen voor alle spoedeisende hulpafdelingen in ziekenhuizen, ambulancediensten en huisartsenposten in Nederland
Motie van het lid Van der Burg c.s. over het inschakelen forensich-pediatrische expertise als optie
Asks the government to explicitly include forensic-pediatric expertise as an option when setting minimum requirements for collegial consultation in the child abuse reporting code.
requests the government, when further elaborating these minimum requirements, to explicitly include the use of forensic-pediatric expertise as an option
verzoekt de regering, bij de nadere uitwerking van deze minimumeisen expliciet het inschakelen van forensisch-pediatrische expertise als optie op te nemen
Motie van de leden Hilkens en Van der Burg over het raadplegen van het AMK of SHG als minimumeis

Asks the government to include in theministerial regulation on the mandatory reporting code that consulting the child abuse or domestic violence advice centres is required when there is doubt after colleague consultation.
requests the government to regulate by or under AMvB that consulting the AMK or SHG, in case of doubt about a serious suspicion of domestic violence or child abuse
verzoekt de regering, bij of krachtens AMvB te regelen dat het raadplegen van het AMK of SHG, bij twijfel over een ernstig vermoeden van huiselijk geweld of kindermishandeling

Amendement van de leden Arib en Hilkens over het verruimen van de strafrechtelijke aanpak van huwelijksdwang en het mogelijk maken van vervolging van personen die hun partner of kind in het buitenland
Amendment extending criminal prosecution of forced marriage to all forms of coercion, including coercion to stay abroad, by removing the marriage-only limitation on extraterritorial jurisdiction.
By deleting in the jurisdiction provisions for article 284 of the Criminal Code the limitation to coercion into marriage
Door in de rechtsmachtbepalingen met betrekking tot artikel 284 Sr de beperking «voor zover het feit oplevert dwang tot het aangaan van een huwelijk» te schrappen
Motie Van der Ham c.s. over juridisch advies over de snelheid van invoering
Asks the government to obtain legal advice on whether the chosen speed of introducing the new cultural policy would withstand legal challenge.
requests the government to obtain further legal advice on whether the chosen speed of introducing the new cultural system will hold up under possible legal challenge after adoption
verzoekt de regering nader juridisch advies in te winnen of de gekozen snelheid van invoering van het nieuwe cultuurstelsel na aanvaarding stand zal houden bij eventuele juridische aanvechting
qa: Antwoord op vragen Hilkens en Fokke over de aanpak van overlast bij coffeeshops

Two PvdA MPs asked the Minister of Security and Justice whether the Maastricht local triangle (mayor, police, prosecutor) is divided over raids on coffeeshops and whether local policy on the residency criterion is unclear. The minister replied that the partners operate in a unified way, that local tailoring within the national framework is preserved, and referred to an earlier letter to parliament.
I in fact observe that in Maastricht the partners in the triangle operate unambiguously and that sales to drug tourists are vigorously tackled both under criminal and administrative law.
Ik constateer juist dat in Maastricht de partners in de driehoek eenduidig opereren en dat de verkoop aan drugstoeristen zowel strafrechtelijk als bestuursrechtelijk voortvarend wordt aangepakt.
Antwoord vragen Hilkens over het bericht dat slachtoffers van mensenhandel allereerst rust nodig hebben

MP Hilkens asks the Justice Minister about a study finding that trafficking victims first need rest, and whether reception, victim identification, the reflection period and central funding should change. The minister acknowledges the study and promises a government policy response after the summer recess, without substantive answers yet.
In accordance with the request of your House of 21 June 2013, the cabinet will prepare a policy response to this study, which will be sent after the summer recess.
Conform het verzoek van uw Kamer van 21 juni 2013 zal het kabinet een beleidsreactie opstellen op dit onderzoek, die na het zomerreces zal worden toegezonden.

Vragen van het lid Hilkens (PvdA) aan de staatssecretaris van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over de mogelijkheden een cannabisclub op wetenschappelijke gronden te stichten (ingezonden 18 april 2013).

Hilkens (PvdA) asked whether the Opium Act allows exemptions for cannabis cultivation for scientific or public health purposes, whether a cannabis club could be set up on scientific grounds, and whether a regulated production chain would help control THC content. The state secretary replied that the minister can grant cultivation exemptions for scientific research on medical use, that cannabis outside such exemptions is not legal and the production chain cannot be regulated under the Single Convention, and promised an inventory of foreign systems before January 2014.

Question 8: Do you agree that setting requirements for cannabis products, such as THC content, pesticide content, labelling and consumer information, is better possible if the whole chain from cultivation to sale of cannabis is regulated?

Vraag 8 Deelt u de mening dat het stellen van eisen aan cannabisproducten, bijvoorbeeld het THC-gehalte, het gehalte aan bestrijdingsmiddelen, eisen ten aanzien van etikettering en consumentenvoorlichting, beter mogelijk is als de hele keten van teelt tot en met verkoop van cannabis gereguleerd is?
Antwoord vragen van de leden Mei Li Vos en Hilkens over het verband tussen het verstrekken van vergunningen voor online kansspelen en gokverslaving

MPs Mei Li Vos and Hilkens asked whether licensing online gambling would increase gambling addiction and what safeguards and measurement exist. The government answered that it does not expect an explosive rise, citing strict licence conditions (warnings, limits, a national exclusion register, a duty of care), monitoring every five years, and enforcement powers of the Kansspelautoriteit.
I do not have data on the private addiction care sector.
Ik beschik niet over gegevens van de «particuliere» verslavingszorgsector.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Hilkens over de verplaatsing van de teelt van cannabis naar andere Europese landen

An MP asked the Minister of Security and Justice whether cannabis cultivation is shifting from the Netherlands to other European countries, what causes this, whether he had contact with Europol and counterpart countries, and whether the Netherlands bears responsibility for supporting enforcement abroad. The minister confirmed reports of more foreign grow sites with some Dutch criminal involvement, cited the threat assessment and possible displacement from Dutch enforcement, and described ongoing Benelux, Hazeldonk and operational Europol contacts while stating that each country is responsible for its own enforcement.
The Netherlands will of course continue to play a (supportive) role in criminal enforcement abroad.
Nederland zal vanzelfsprekend een (ondersteunende) rol blijven spelen bij de strafrechtelijke handhaving in het buitenland
Antwoord op vragen Hilkens over de stijging van het aantal meldingen van slachtoffers van mensenhandel

An MP asked the Minister of Security and Justice about a 40% rise in reports of possible human trafficking victims, the reporting duty for youth care institutions, measures against loverboy exploitation, multilingual information, identifying victims in asylum centres, and CoMensha's call for a prostitution ban. The minister attributed the rise largely to broader registration of weak indications, rejected extending the reporting duty to youth care, listed existing prevention measures and COA cooperation, and rejected a prostitution ban.

Together with the National Rapporteur on Trafficking in Human Beings and Sexual Violence against Children (NRM) and CoMensha, given the greater uncertainty in the 2012 figures, it will be examined how the registration method used by CoMensha can be tightened.

Samen met de Nationaal Rapporteur Mensenhandel en Seksueel Geweld tegen Kinderen (NRM) en CoMensha zal vanwege de grotere onzekerheid in de cijfers over 2012 worden bezien op welke wijze de door Comensha gehanteerde registratiewijze aangescherpt kan worden.
Antwoord vragen Hilkens en Fokke over de aanpak van overlast bij coffeeshops

MPs Hilkens and Fokke asked the Minister of Security and Justice how nuisance around Maastricht coffeeshops should be tackled, including whether the mayor may relax enforcement of the residents-only criterion, whether extra police are needed, and whether illegal street dealers are run by coffeeshop owners. Minister Opstelten answered that local authorities set coffeeshop policy within the national framework, that police capacity will be made available on request, and that he has no evidence for the claim about coffeeshop owners sending runners onto the street.
I told the mayor of Maastricht that I wish to provide support where needed and I will do so.
Ik heb de burgemeester van Maastricht gezegd mijn steun te willen verlenen waar dat nodig is en dit zal ik ook doen.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Hilkens over de aanpak van georganiseerde wietteelt

An MP asked the Minister of Security and Justice about a television report claiming the approach to organised cannabis cultivation is failing, including capacity problems and the limits of following up on criminal organisations after finding a grow house. The minister said the report selectively quoted an expert meeting report, declined to release that report in full because it contains planned enforcement priorities, and argued an integrated approach works better than purely criminal investigation, denying capacity problems.
It is not in the interest of the approach to cannabis cultivation for it to become known which actions are expected and when.
Het is niet in het belang van de aanpak van de cannabisteelt als bekend wordt welke acties er wanneer zijn te verwachten.
Antwoord vragen Hilkens over het bericht Kinderporno veel gemeld

An MP asks the Justice Minister about the sharp rise in child pornography reports in 2012, how to explain it, and whether prevention and care keep pace with digital realities. The minister reports 19,872 reports in 2012 versus 12,542 in 2011, says the trend cannot be fully explained or measured given hidden parts of the internet, and points to the integrated child-abuse action plan, the taskforce, police reorganisation and planned protocol changes for youth care.
It is very difficult to measure the total amount of child pornography on the internet.
Het is zeer lastig om de totale hoeveelheid kinderpornografie op het internet te meten.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Hilkens over het bericht dat ook Nederlandse patiënten in het buitenland organen kopen en deze laten transplanteren

An MP asked the government about a report that Dutch patients buy kidneys abroad and have them transplanted illegally, and whether the government would act on it. The minister confirmed the problem is unwelcome and illegal, pointed to pending criminal-law changes, an NTS proposal for periodic reporting, and a European study, and said more insight into the scale is expected.
To prevent people from resorting to an illegal transplant abroad, the website of the Dutch Transplantation Foundation points out the dangers and possible illegality of a transplant abroad.

Om te voorkomen dat mensen hun toevlucht zoeken tot een illegale transplantatie in het buitenland wordt op de website van de Nederlandse Transplantatie Stichting gewezen op de gevaren en het mogelijke illegale karakter van een transplantatie in het buitenland.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Marcouch en Hilkens over de rechts-extremistische organisatie “Blood&Honour”

MPs Marcouch and Hilkens asked whether statements on the Blood&Honour website could be criminal, whether Mein Kampf publication and SS race-theory content are punishable, and whether the organisation could be dissolved. The minister answered that criminality must be assessed case by case by the Public Prosecution Service and courts, and that there are currently no grounds to start a dissolution procedure since Blood&Honour lacks legal personality.
That assessment of criminality must in an individual case first be made by the Public Prosecution Service and ultimately by the criminal judge.
Die beoordeling van de strafbaarheid dient in een individueel geval in eerste instantie door het Openbaar Ministerie en uiteindelijk door de strafrechter te geschieden.
Antwoord vragen Hilkens over de invloed van nepsigaretten op jonge kinderen

An MP asked the State Secretary for Health whether 'Shisha pens', tobacco-like products sold to primary school children, encourage smoking and trivialise its harms, and whether they should be banned or age-restricted like tobacco. The State Secretary answered that no proven harm exists, sees no reason yet for a ban or age limit, and will ask RIVM to assess the health risks before deciding on further measures.
However, I will ask RIVM to assess the health risks of this product.
Wel zal ik het RIVM vragen een inschatting te maken van de gezondheidsrisico's van dit product.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hilkens, Oosenbrug en Ypma over de bescherming en de bewustwording van jongeren op internet

MPs Hilkens, Oosenbrug and Ypma asked the state secretary of Security and Justice about youth protection and awareness on the internet, including the Digibewust finding that two-thirds of 12-16 year olds had a bad online experience, parental awareness, consent for minors' online profiles, the handling of grooming and the Meldknop website. The government disputed the two-thirds figure citing SCP research, pointed to existing criminal law, Mediawijzer.net, CBP guidance and EU strategy, and largely answered on substance without committing to new concrete steps.
I cannot confirm this conclusion from the YoungWorks research commissioned by Digibewust on the basis of my own data.
Deze conclusie uit het onderzoek van YoungWorks in opdracht van Digibewust kan ik niet op basis van eigen gegevens bevestigen.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Bruins Slot en Hilkens over de uitzending van 1Vandaag over de drug GHB

Two MPs from CDA and PvdA asked the state secretaries about a 1Vandaag broadcast on GHB, covering prevention, addiction treatment waiting lists, hospital care, enforcement, and the GBL precursor. The government answered that prevention and local tailored approaches are underway, that treatment capacity is limited and some regions have waiting lists, and that it will commission a quick scan on GBL and consider policy adjustments.
I will instruct the Coordination Committee for Assessment and Monitoring of New Drugs to carry out a quick scan on the use of GBL.
Ik zal de Coördinatiecommissie Assessment en Monitoring nieuwe drugs opdragen een quick scan uit te voeren met betrekking tot het gebruik van GBL
Antwoord vragen van het lid Hilkens over de opvang van slachtoffers van mensenhandel

An MP from the Labour party asks whether a merger of youth care institutions will remove closed-care places where girls who are victims of loverboys can be treated, and whether separate care for girls will remain available. The state secretary replies that places are not closed, that a mixed-gender pilot has started, that girl-only specialist groups still exist in youth care plus, and that Fier Fryslân will cooperate with Horizon on specialist trajectories.
No, there is a merger, not the closing of places.
Nee, er is sprake van een fusie, niet van het sluiten van plekken.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Hilkens over inbeslagnames van qat

MP Hilkens asked the Minister of Security and Justice about qat seizures after the drug's ban, including whether flights and a warehouse trade had stopped and whether the Somali-community use had fallen. The minister replied that smuggling via cargo and passengers is checked on a sample basis, recent seizures came from England, and the ban will be evaluated after two years as the House requested.
In line with the House's wish expressed in motion 2, the government will evaluate the qat ban after two years, focusing on effectiveness and side effects.
Conform de wens die uw Kamer per motie 2 heeft uitgesproken zal de regering het verbod op qat na twee jaar evalueren, met aandacht voor effectiviteit en neveneffecten.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Hilkens over het bericht dat de afstemming tussen ketenpartners bij de aanpak van huiselijk geweld beter moet

MP Hilkens asked the ministers about reports that coordination among partners in tackling domestic violence must improve, including a fatal Maastricht case, data sharing, and decentralisation. The minister answered that an external commission found inadequate integrated handling and weak steering in Maastricht, that recommendations are being implemented, and that privacy law is not seen as a blocking factor.

However, the commission also concluded that the agencies involved, deviating from the Directive on Domestic and Honour-Related Violence, did not handle this domestic violence case sufficiently in an integrated way.

De commissie heeft echter ook geconcludeerd dat de betrokken instanties, in afwijking van de Aanwijzing Huiselijk Geweld en Eergerelateerd Geweld 2 , deze huiselijk geweldzaak onvoldoende integraal hebben benaderd.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Hilkens en Kerstens over discriminatie van vrouwen bij schadevergoeding na letselschade

MPs Hilkens and Kerstens asked whether insurers may factor a hypothetical childbearing wish or work-care combination into injury compensation, which disadvantages women, and what the government will do about it. The minister says such differential treatment is already prohibited under equal-treatment law, that the College voor de Rechten van de Mens has raised this with the insurance sector, and that affected persons can petition the College or go to court, without committing to new measures.
Discrimination on grounds of sex is already prohibited in this area under the General Equal Treatment Act and the Equal Treatment Decree.
Discriminatie op grond van geslacht is voor dit terrein reeds verboden op grond van de Algemene wet gelijke behandeling en het Besluit gelijke behandeling.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Hilkens en Ypma over het bericht dat er in Nederland meer kinderen seksueel worden uitgebuit

PvdA MPs Hilkens and Ypma asked the Minister of Security and Justice about reports that more children are being sexually exploited in the Netherlands, the National Rapporteur's figures, underreporting by mandatory reporting bodies, and shelter capacity. The minister said he would send the National Rapporteur's report, referred to earlier answers on reporting and shelter capacity, and held that the existing anti-trafficking priority, including the loverboy programme, is sufficient without further intensification.
I will send the NRM report in question to your House shortly.
Ik zal het rapport in kwestie van de NRM binnenkort aan uw Kamer doen toekomen.
Antwoord vragen Hilkens over het bericht dat bij seksueel geweld allochtone jongeren eerder dan autochtone jongeren de schuld bij het slachtoffer leggen

An MP asks the state secretary for Health, Welfare and Sport about reports that Moroccan-origin youths blame sexual assault victims more than native Dutch youths, and about the Rutgers WPF research on cultural differences and sexual boundaries. The government answers that the research informed the 'Maak seks lekker duidelijk' campaign, describes existing sex-education programmes in schools and youth health care, and notes that the new core objectives give extra attention to sexuality.
The research showed that cultural background does indeed play a role in young people's views on sexual boundaries.
Het onderzoek heeft laten zien dat culturele achtergrond inderdaad een rol speelt in de opvattingen van jongeren over seksuele grenzen.

Vragen van de leden Hilkens en Ypma (beiden PvdA) aan de ministers van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport en van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over drugsgebruik in het speciaal onderwijs (ingezonden 20 december 2012).

MPs Hilkens and Ypma asked about high drug and alcohol use among students in special and practical secondary education, and about the Rotterdam approach and youth prevention. The government confirms the problem is national, says the Rotterdam approach will be examined for wider use, and describes existing prevention programmes and a vocational-education plan.
The Ministry of OCW will, in consultation with the relevant sectors and other parties, examine whether and to what extent the Rotterdam approach can be spread more widely nationally.
Het ministerie van OCW zal in overleg met de betreffende sectoren en overige partijen bezien of en hoeverre de aanpak in Rotterdam breder landelijk verspreid kan worden.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Mei Li Vos en Hilkens over multi level marketing

MPs Mei Li Vos and Hilkens asked the ministers of Economic Affairs and Security and Justice about multi-level marketing practices (including ACN's telecom sales), whether they are misleading or illegal pyramid schemes, and whether consumer and gambling authorities are informed. The government answered that MLM is a lawful sales method, that the Consumer Authority and Gambling Authority supervise compliance with existing law, that no change to legislation is currently needed, and that it will not judge individual companies.
It does not befit me to give a judgment on the conduct of individual companies.
Het past mij niet een oordeel te geven over de handelwijze van individuele bedrijven.
Antwoord vragen Hilkens over maatregelen die moeten voorkomen dat mensen gaan roken

An opposition MP asks the health minister why the government opposes stronger tobacco rules at EU level, such as graphic warnings, fewer cigarette vending machines, minimum age 18 and additive regulation, and why Dutch rankings and smoker numbers have worsened. The state secretary answers that no Commission proposal exists yet so no position is taken, plans to raise the minimum age to 18, and says it is too early to call the rise in smokers a trend.
I intend to raise this age to 18, as is already the case in most EU member states.
Ik ben voornemens om deze leeftijd te verhogen naar 18 jaar, net als in de meeste EU-lidstaten al het geval is.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Hilkens over seksueel misbruik door zorgverleners

MP Hilkens asked the state secretary and minister about reports of sexual abuse of patients by care workers, including whether the Inspectorate for Health Care (IGZ) reports these complaints, its enforcement, referral to prosecutors, training, and mandatory certificates of conduct (VOG). The minister answered that the IGZ publishes only aggregate totals, lists enforcement outcomes such as criminal and disciplinary tracks, and says a legal basis for mandatory VOGs in health care is lacking, promising to consider it for non-youth care workers.
I will consider including a mandatory VOG for other care workers.
Ik zal mij beraden over het opnemen van een verplichte VOG voor overige werknemers in de zorg.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Hilkens over baby Donna

An MP asks the State Secretary about the baby Donna case, whether a similar case is still possible, how often surrogacy has led to problems, and whether EU or national rules are needed. The State Secretary says existing criminal law and cooperation agreements reduce such risks but cannot exclude recurrence, and that surrogacy is being raised internationally with a new Hague process while practical measures are pursued.
Given the complexity of cases like this, however, I can never rule out that such a case will occur again.
Gezien de complexiteit van zaken zoals deze, kan ik echter nooit uitsluiten dat een dergelijke zaak zich nogmaals zal voordoen.
Antwoord vragen Hilkens over het bericht waarin sprake is van het toestaan van virtuele kinderporno

An MP asked the Minister of Security and Justice about reports suggesting virtual child pornography might be permitted, including whether the Lanzarote Convention and claimed therapeutic benefits or safety evidence support that. The minister answered that virtual child pornography must remain punishable, that the law already handles realistic images without difficulty for enforcement, that the Convention requires criminalisation with no reservation taken by the Netherlands, and that the therapeutic debate is unresolved.
I share the view that the production, viewing and possession of virtual child pornography must remain punishable.
Ik deel de mening dat het produceren, bekijken en bezitten van virtuele kinderporno strafbaar moet blijven.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Marcouch en Hilkens over illegale bordelen in massagesalons

MPs Marcouch and Hilkens asked the Minister of Security and Justice about reports that about half of Chinese massage parlours in the Netherlands are in fact illegal brothels, including whether the OM research would be shared, whether massage parlours should be subject to licensing and Bibob screening, and whether victim support and information for Chinese-speaking sex workers is adequate. The minister confirmed the research estimates illegal prostitution in roughly half the parlours, said it does not change existing rules, noted parlours offering sexual services need a municipal permit that allows Bibob screening, and pointed to a Chinese-language brochure and planned Chinese translation of a victim-rights leaflet, with a separate letter promised on the report.

Following a request from the Security and Justice committee of your House dated 8 November 2012 for a response on the state of efforts against Chinese massage parlours, I will address the research report in more detail in a separate letter.

Naar aanleiding van een verzoek van de vaste commissie voor Veiligheid en Justitie van uw Kamer van 8 november 2012, waarin wordt gevraagd om een reactie op de stand van zaken met betrekking tot de aanpak van Chinese massagesalons, zal ik in een aparte brief nader ingaan op het onderzoeksrapport.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Hilkens over gedwongen prostitutie en mensenhandel

An MP asked the Justice minister about forced prostitution and human trafficking, including cooperation with Hungary, awareness campaigns, EU strategy, victims who cannot report abuse, and prosecution statistics. The minister answered that the broadcasts contained no new facts, described bilateral police and prosecutor cooperation with Hungary and other source countries, outlined prevention and detection measures, and said prosecution data does not distinguish between ex officio cases and complaints.
The Public Prosecution Service's registration systems do not distinguish between a prosecution initiated ex officio and one initiated following a complaint.
In de registratiesystemen van het Openbaar Ministerie wordt geen onderscheid gemaakt tussen een ambtshalve vervolging of een vervolging die is ingesteld naar aanleiding van een aangifte.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Hilkens over kindslaven uit Afghanistan

An MP asked the Minister of Security and Justice about reports that Afghan boys, possibly child slaves ('dancing boys'), transit through the Netherlands to Scandinavia, and what evidence exists of trafficking or abuse in the Netherlands. The minister answered that the Marechaussee noticed many Afghan illegal migrants transiting to Scandinavia, launched a joint investigation with the police whose results are being analysed, and that the Public Prosecution Service knows of no related cases, so discussion with the Afghan community is not warranted now.
The information obtained from this joint action is currently being analysed.
De uit deze gezamenlijke actie verkregen informatie wordt momenteel geanalyseerd.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Bouwmeester en Hilkens over zwangere rokende vrouwen met een psychische stoornis

Two MPs asked the health minister about pregnant smoking women with psychiatric disorders, including whether mental health providers need specific guidance and a unified message. The minister answered that midwives and GPs are already trained in smoking cessation support, that treatment decisions are left to individual providers, and that no specific mental-health-sector guidance or role is considered necessary.
Specific information for mental health care providers therefore does not appear necessary in my view.
Specifieke voorlichting voor hulpverleners in de GGZ lijkt mijns inziens daarom niet nodig.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Maij en Hilkens over "het uithuwelijken van jonge meisjes en vrouwenrechten"

MPs Maij and Hilkens asked the state secretary for Foreign Affairs whether he would press India to curb child marriage and protect girls' and women's rights, and how this fits Dutch policy. The state secretary answered that the Netherlands raised women's empowerment at India's UPR and in the EU-India human rights dialogue, cited the link between schooling and later marriage, and listed Dutch education and sexual health programmes, without committing to a new bilateral demand.
In addition, women's rights and children's rights are on the agenda of the annual EU-India human rights dialogue.
Daarnaast staan de onderwerpen vrouwenrechten en de rechten van het kind op de agenda van de jaarlijkse EU-India mensenrechtendialoog.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Marcouch en Hilkens over agressie tegen medewerkers van de NS door drugsrunners op Rotterdam CS

Labour MPs Marcouch and Hilkens asked the Minister of Security and Justice about aggression against NS railway staff by drug runners at Rotterdam Centraal, including whether the wietpas (cannabis pass) caused their return, and whether a full police post should be present. The minister said the incident involved a drunk youth rather than a drug runner, that a small number of drug runners are handled by a local supervision model, and that the police post was moved during renovation and will return.
Information from the Rotterdam-Rijnmond police shows there are no indications that the person who fought with the NS employees was a drug runner.

Uit informatie van het korps Rotterdam-Rijnmond blijkt dat ten aanzien van het in de media genoemde incident geen aanwijzingen bestaan dat de persoon die in gevecht raakte met de NS-medewerkers een drugsrunner was.
Antwoord vragen Timmermans en Hilkens over steenkolenmijnen op de UNESCO-werelderfgoedlijst

MPs Timmermans and Hilkens asked whether the government would consult Limburg authorities to nominate remaining Limburg coal-mining heritage for the UNESCO World Heritage List, after three Walloon mines were listed. The state secretary replied that the independent commission's advice, adopted in 2011, did not include Limburg mining heritage, so no consultation was planned.
I therefore see no reason to now enter into discussions with authorities in Limburg about a World Heritage nomination of parts of the mining region.
Ik zie daarom geen aanleiding nu in gesprek te gaan met overheden in Limburg over een werelderfgoednominatie van delen van de mijnstreek.
Antwoord vragen Marcouch en Hilkens over criminele vreemdelingen

MPs Marcouch and Hilkens asked the ministers of Security and Justice and of Immigration about criminal foreigners in Amsterdam, including their share among suspects, their illegal residence, and whether removal powers or capacity should be expanded. The government said national data are not available for the largest cities, that expulsion tools exist and the sliding scale will be tightened from July 2012, and that a targeted use of existing capacity is preferred to new specialist capacity.
We do not have data specific to the situation in the ten largest cities.
Wij beschikken niet over gegevens specifiek voor de situatie in de tien grootste steden.
Antwoord vragen Dibi, Hilkens, Schouw, Voordewind en Gesthuizen over het groeiende aantal gemeenten dat kritiek uit op het illegalenbeleid

MPs from five parties asked the immigration and justice ministers about municipalities criticising the government's policy on undocumented migrants and whether municipalities may set their own police priorities on this. Minister Leers answered that the police keep priority on criminal and nuisance-causing foreigners, that municipal mayors have authority over local police priorities, and that the police will still address vulnerable illegals with due regard for their situation.
Within his authority, the mayor can independently set priorities regarding police deployment in his municipality.
In het kader van zijn gezag kan de burgemeester eigenstandig prioriteiten stellen met betrekking tot de politie-inzet in zijn gemeente.

Vragen van de leden Spekman en Hilkens (beiden PvdA) aan de minister voor Immigratie en Asiel, de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken en de staatssecretaris van Buitenlandse Zaken over de schending van mensenrechten door de

MPs Spekman and Hilkens asked whether EU member states violate asylum seekers' human rights and how the government will ensure a common EU asylum system respecting rights by 2012. The minister answered that the EU and courts oversee compliance, Commission infringement procedures and court cases are the instruments, and Nederland supports the 2012 ambition.
The Commission and the (inter)national judges have an important supervisory task in this matter.
De Commissie en de (inter)nationale rechters hebben in dezen een belangrijke controlerende taak.
Vragen van de leden Timmermans en Hilkens (beiden PvdA) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over groeiend antisemitisme en toenemend geweld tegen Roma in Hongarije (ingezonden 26 april 2011).

MPs Timmermans and Hilkens asked the Foreign Minister about reports of rising antisemitism and violence against Roma in Hungary, including Roma fleeing a village over threats from a paramilitary movement, and whether Hungary's authorities are tolerating it and whether the government will press Hungary under EU and Council of Europe obligations. The minister answered that Hungary has deployed police to protect the village, is drafting legislation to restrict paramilitary movements, and that the Hungarian government rejects such intimidation and is committed to its treaty obligations, while noting the Dutch embassy supports Roma integration projects.
The Hungarian government is committed to guaranteeing safety in these villages.
De Hongaarse regering zet zich in om de veiligheid in deze dorpen te garanderen.
